label: AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_NoSuccessFindingScanner
source: I'm investigating this ship on behalf\nof CAPT. STERN.\pHe also asked me to find a SCANNER,\nbut I haven't had any success…$

label: AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_OhCanYouDeliverScanner
source: Oh! That's a SCANNER!\pListen, can I get you to deliver that\nto CAPT. STERN?\pI want to investigate this ship a\nlittle more.$

label: AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_ThisIsSSCactus
source: This ship is called S.S. CACTUS.\nIt seems to be from an earlier era.$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharlieIntro
source: What's so funny about having my inner\ntube aboard the ship?$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharlieDefeat
source: Whoa, you overwhelmed me!$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharliePostBattle
source: It's not easy throwing POKé BALLS\nwhile hanging on to an inner tube!$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_IsntItFunHere
source: Isn't it fun here?\nI get excited just being here!$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanIntro
source: When we go out to sea, we SAILORS\nalways bring our POKéMON.\lHow about a quick battle?$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanDefeat
source: Whoops, I'm sunk!$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanPostBattle
source: The ship's bottom has sunk into the\ndepths.\pIf a POKéMON knew how to go underwater,\nwe might make some progress…$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_YayItsAShip
source: Yay!\nIt's a ship!$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DoorIsLocked
source: The door is locked.\p“STORAGE” is painted on the door.$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_InsertedStorageKey
source: {PLAYER} inserted and turned the\nSTORAGE KEY.\pThe inserted KEY stuck fast,\nbut the door opened.$

label: AbandonedShip_Text_TheDoorIsOpen
source: The door is open.$

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_Rm1DoorIsLocked
source: The door is locked.\p“RM. 1” is painted on the door.$

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_Rm2DoorIsLocked
source: The door is locked.\p“RM. 2” is painted on the door.$

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_Rm4DoorIsLocked
source: The door is locked.\p“RM. 4” is painted on the door.$

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_Rm6DoorIsLocked
source: The door is locked.\p“RM. 6” is painted on the door.$

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_InsertedKey
source: {PLAYER} inserted and turned the\nKEY.\pThe inserted KEY stuck fast,\nbut the door opened.$

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorRooms_Text_BrightShinyTrash
source: It's bright and shiny!\nBut it's just trash…$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanIntro
source: DAN: While searching for treasures,\nwe discovered a TRAINER!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanDefeat
source: DAN: We couldn't win even though\nwe worked together…$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostBattle
source: DAN: We can't find any treasures…\nI wonder if someone got them already?$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanNotEnoughMons
source: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON.\nYou can't expect to beat us like that.$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraIntro
source: KIRA: Oh?\nWe were searching for treasures.\lBut we discovered a TRAINER instead!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraDefeat
source: KIRA: Ooh, so strong!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostBattle
source: KIRA: Where could the treasures be?\pI've already decided what I'm buying\nwhen we find the treasures!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraNotEnoughMons
source: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON?\nWe'll have to battle some other time!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRegister
source: KIRA: Oh, you make me so angry!\nI'm going to register you for that!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchIntro
source: DAN: We've been searching for\ntreasures all this time.\pOur POKéMON have grown stronger, too.\nLet us show you, okay?$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchDefeat
source: DAN: You're strong, as usual!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostRematch
source: DAN: We can't find any treasures,\nwe lose at POKéMON…\pI want to go home… But if I say that,\nshe gets all angry with me…$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchNotEnoughMons
source: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON.\nYou can't expect to beat us like that.$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchIntro
source: KIRA: Oh? We meet again!\pJust like us, you still haven't given up\nsearching for treasures, have you?\pWant to make it so the loser has\nto give up searching?$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchDefeat
source: KIRA: Oh, we lost again…$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostRematch
source: KIRA: We're not leaving until we raise\nour POKéMON some more and we find\lthe treasures here!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchNotEnoughMons
source: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON?\nWe'll have to battle some other time!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniIntro
source: I'm not good at swimming,\nbut I am good at battles!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniDefeat
source: Oops.\nThat didn't go very well.$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniPostBattle
source: Walking around barefoot in this ship\nis kind of gross.$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonIntro
source: Strength and compassion…\nThose are a TRAINER's treasures!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonDefeat
source: Ah, there is something about you\nthat sparkles.$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonPostBattle
source: In a cabin somewhere on board,\nI saw something sparkle.$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_B1F_Text_PerfectPlaceToGoExploring
source: This is a perfect place to go exploring!\nIt's exciting here!\pI bet there're amazing treasures on\nboard.$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_TakingALookAround
source: Ships of this sort are rare, so I'm\ntaking a look around.\pHmhm…\nThere appear to be other cabins…$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaIntro
source: What on earth would compel you to\ncome here? You must be curious!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaDefeat
source: Not just curious, but also strong…$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaPostBattle
source: The man next door…\pHe says he's just sightseeing,\nbut I don't know about that.$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRegister
source: You're such a tough TRAINER!\nLet me register you as a memento!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRematchIntro
source: What on earth would compel you to\ncome back? You must really be curious!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRematchDefeat
source: Aren't you too strong?$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaPostRematch
source: I'm sure that man's up to something!\nHe just acts so suspiciously!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusIntro
source: Waaah!\nI've been found! …Huh?$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusDefeat
source: Oh, you're not my mom.$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusPostBattle
source: I'm in trouble with my mom, so I ran.\nKeep it a secret where I am!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_B1F_Text_GettingQueasy
source: Urrrrppp…\pI'm getting queasy just being aboard\nthis ship…\pIt's not even moving, but…$

label: Alola_Akala_BattleSandygast_Text_0
source: Coorr!$

label: Alola_Akala_Sign_Text_0
source: AKALA ISLE$

label: Alola_Akala_House_Sign_Text_0
source: AKALA VILLA\pA place for visitors to stay while\non AKALA ISLE.$

label: Alola_Akala_Natu_Text_0
source: NATU: TUUUUU!$

label: Alola_Akala_OldManOnBench_Text_0
source: Ah the weather is so nice today,\nisn't it?\pI was just feeding the NATU and this\none decided to join me on my bench!$

label: Alola_Akala_TotemBattle_Text_0
source: Mortaar!$

label: Alola_Akala_TotemBattle_Text_1
source: Totem MAGMORTAR was defeated!\nIt scampered off somewhere…$

label: Alola_Akala_TotemBattle_Text_2
source: Prrrob!$

label: Alola_Akala_TotemBattle_Text_3
source: Totem PROBOPASS was defeated!\nIt scampered off somewhere…$

label: Alola_Akala_Totem_sign_Text_0
source: The totem is emanating a strong\nenergy…\pTouch the totem to teleport to another\nIsle?$

label: Alola_Akala_Totem_sign_Text_1
source: MELEMELE ISLE$

label: Alola_Akala_Totem_sign_Text_2
source: ULA'ULA ISLE$

label: Alola_Akala_Totem_sign_Text_3
source: PONI ISLE$

label: Alola_Akala_Totem_sign_Text_4
source: CANCEL$

label: Alola_Akala_Totem_sign_Text_5
source: A strange totem stands here,\npower is emanating from it…$

label: Alola_Akala_BattleVsTapuLele_Text_0
source: Le-Lele!$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_0
source: I came to the ISLES to hike the\nmountains!$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_1
source: And down I tumble…$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_2
source: AKALA ISLE has the best hiking!\nIt's got lush forests and rugged trails!$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattlePicnicker_Text_0
source: Ha! Didn't see me, did you?$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattlePicnicker_Text_1
source: I guess the element of surprise isn't\nalways super effective…$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattlePicnicker_Text_2
source: It's so lush on AKALA ISLE,\nI can easily hide in the trees!$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleCamper_Text_0
source: I want to be the first to prove myself\nto the Totem POKéMON!$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleCamper_Text_1
source: Drat,\nthat's not going to help my case.$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleCamper_Text_2
source: There's a weird Totem further ahead but\nI haven't seen a Totem POKéMON.$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerLand_Text_0
source: Hey! No shoes on the beach!$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerLand_Text_1
source: Ouch,\nwhere's a lifeguard when you need one…$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerLand_Text_2
source: AKALA ISLE has the best beaches!\nIt's got soft sand and clear waters!$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerWater_Text_0
source: Out of my way!\nI'm swimming laps!$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerWater_Text_1
source: Not the break I was looking for…$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerWater_Text_2
source: ULA'ULA ISLE has the best beaches!\nIgnore anyone who says otherwise!$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerWaterM_Text_0
source: Hah!\nYou need to ride a POKéMON to surf?$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerWaterM_Text_1
source: If I hadn't swam myself\nmaybe I would've had the energy to win…$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerWaterM_Text_2
source: The current out here is strong!\nA POKéMON must be really powerful to\lmigrate all the way out to the ISLES!$

label: Alola_Akala_Bench_Heal_Text_0
source: Would you like to take a rest on this\nbench?$

label: Alola_Melemele_BattleMarowak_Text_0
source: Raah!$

label: Alola_Melemele_BattleDugtrio_Text_0
source: Cha-Cha!$

label: Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_0
source: You must be tough if you made it all the\nway up here!$

label: Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_1
source: Tougher than me!$

label: Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_2
source: I had to stop climbing because it was\ngetting far too hot.\pIt's like someone's got a fire going\nup on the peak…$

label: Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattlePicnicker_Text_0
source: I'm tired from all this walking,\nlet's have a battle!$

label: Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattlePicnicker_Text_1
source: Well that was refreshing!$

label: Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattlePicnicker_Text_2
source: I'm usually not this tired but\nthe heat in this cave is exhausting!$

label: Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattleCamper_Text_0
source: Check me out!\nI caught some strong POKéMON!$

label: Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattleCamper_Text_1
source: Not bad,\nbut not good enough!$

label: Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattleCamper_Text_2
source: Is it warm in here or is it just me?$

label: Alola_AkalaForest_TrainerBattleBugCatcher1_Text_0
source: Look at all the cool bugs here on the \nISLES!$

label: Alola_AkalaForest_TrainerBattleBugCatcher1_Text_1
source: Ouch, that stung!$

label: Alola_AkalaForest_TrainerBattleBugCatcher1_Text_2
source: The ISLES are far away from other land,\nso Bug-type POKéMON here must have\ladapted to the environment.$

label: Alola_AkalaForest_TrainerBattleBugCatcher2_Text_0
source: Look at what I caught!$

label: Alola_AkalaForest_TrainerBattleBugCatcher2_Text_1
source: Awh, that bites!$

label: Alola_AkalaForest_TrainerBattleBugCatcher2_Text_2
source: The climate is a bit different on the\nALOLA ISLES…\pI'm sure that's why there are some\nunique Bug-type POKéMON here.$

label: Alola_Akala_BattleRaichu_Text_0
source: Gaaah!$

label: Alola_Akala_House_OldWoman_Text_0
source: I tell my husband everyday not to feed\nthe NATU, but he never listens!\pOne day he'll bring one of those darn\nthings home, I just know it!$

label: Alola_MelemeleSea_TrainerBattleSwimmer_Text_0
source: So much open water here!$

label: Alola_MelemeleSea_TrainerBattleSwimmer_Text_1
source: Ouch,\npulled a hamstring…$

label: Alola_MelemeleSea_TrainerBattleSwimmer_Text_2
source: There are some strong currents here.\nI think it attracts strong POKéMON!$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_OurBossIsSnatchingSomething
source:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here! He's gone off to
snatch something important!\p… …
Where did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_WhereMightMagmaHideoutBe
source: What? What?\nAre you a TEAM MAGMA grunt?\pI hear that TEAM MAGMA is trying to\nawaken an awesome POKéMON at their\lHIDEOUT.\pBut where might their HIDEOUT be?$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossWentToJackASubmarine
source:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here!
He's gone off to jack a submarine!\p… …
Where did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsOnRoute122
source:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here! He's on his way to
MT. PYRE on ROUTE 122!\p… …
Why did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_TeamMagmaAtMtChimney
source: What? What?\nAre you a TEAM MAGMA grunt?\pI hear that TEAM MAGMA is after\nan awesome POKéMON at MT. CHIMNEY.\pBut what is that POKéMON like?$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsInSlateportCity
source:
What? What? What do you want with
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here!
He's on his way to SLATEPORT CITY!\p… …
Why did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: Ayiyiyi!\nSuspicious character spotted!$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: Grrrrr…\nI lost it!$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: I took the loss for the TEAM,\nbut I did my job…$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
source: If you want to know the secret about\nour HIDEOUT, you have me to beat!$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: I can't win at all…$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: Our HIDEOUT's secret?\pWell, let's just say…\nThere's a submarine at the far end!\pBut, by now…\nKekekeke…$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
source: Fuel supply loaded A-OK!\nIn-cruise snacks loaded A-OK!\pNothing left to do but KO a pesky\nmeddler!$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
source: I took a serious licking!$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
source: Humph!\nThis was supposed to happen!\pMy mission was to just hold you up!$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Intro
source: Yawn… Keeping watch over the\nHIDEOUT bores me. I'll take you on.$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
source: Yawn…\nOh, I lost…$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
source: If you scurry too much, other TEAM\nAQUA members might get you.$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Intro
source: Hey!\nYou there!\pWhich do you think is cooler?\nTEAM AQUA's uniform or TEAM MAGMA's?$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Defeat
source: I lost in a cool way…$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
source: If you have a cool uniform, you look\ngood even in a loss, don't you think?$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattIntro
source:
Hehehe…\pGot here already, did you?
We underestimated you!\pBut this is it!\pI'm a cut above the GRUNTS you've seen
so far.\pI'm not stalling for time.
I'm going to pulverize you!$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattDefeat
source: Hehehe…\nSo, I lost, too…$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_OurBossGotThroughHisPreparations
source: Hehehe!\pWhile I was toying with you, our BOSS\ngot through his preparations!$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattPostBattle
source:
Hehehe!\pOur BOSS has already gone on his way to
some cave under the sea!\pIf you're going to give chase, you'd
better search the big, wide sea beyond\lLILYCOVE.\pBut will you find it then?
Hehehe!$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4Intro
source: Wahahah, I grew weary of waiting!\nYou owe me a battle, too!$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
source: Tired of waiting…\nLost and dazed…$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
source: BOSS…\nIs this good enough?$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Intro
source:
Warp panels, the HIDEOUT's pride
and joy!\pYou're clueless about where you are,
aren't you?\pFluster and tire out the enemy, then
lower the boom! That's our plan!$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Defeat
source: What's wrong with you?\nYou're not tired at all!$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
source: That reminds me… I can't remember\nwhere I put the MASTER BALL.\pIf I fail to guard it, our BOSS will\nchew me out…$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8Intro
source: When I joined TEAM AQUA, the first\nthing I had to learn was how these\lwarp panels connected.$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8Defeat
source: I was too occupied thinking about\nthe warp panels…$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8PostBattle
source: I'll have to learn about how I can\nbattle more effectively…$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: AZALEA POKéMON GYM$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: AZALEA TOWN POKéMON GYM\pBUGSY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyIntro
source:
I'm BUGSY!\pI never lose when it comes
to bug POKéMON.\pMy research is going to make me the
authority on bug POKéMON!\pLet me demonstrate all I've
learned from my studies.$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyBeaten
source:
Whoa, amazing! You're an
expert on POKéMON!\pMy research isn't complete
yet.\pOK, you win. Take this
BADGE.$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_ReceivedHiveBadge
source: {PLAYER} received HIVEBADGE.$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_HiveBadgeSpeech
source:
Do you know the benefits
of HIVEBADGE?\pIf you have it, POKéMON up
to L30 will obey you,\leven traded ones.\pPOKéMON that know CUT will be able
to use it outside of battle too.\pHere, I also want you to
have this.$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_FuryCutterSpeech
source: TM89 contains U-TURN.\pU-TURN lets you do damage and\nswitch your POKéMON in the same\lturn!\pIsn't that great?\nI discovered it!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyAdvice
source: Bug POKéMON are deep. There are\nmany mysteries to be explored.\pStudy your favorites thoroughly.$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyRematch
source: Wow, you're the JOHTO CHAMPION now!\pYour skills are truly impressive!\pI've been busy with my research.\pI'm ready to show you my new\nfindings.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyRematchDefeat
source: Wow, you must be an expert trainer.\nMy research must not be complete...$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherBennySeen
source: Bug POKéMON evolve young. So they\nget stronger that much faster.$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherBennyBeaten
source: Just evolving isn't enough!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherBennyAfter
source: POKéMON become stronger\nif they evolve. Really!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherAlSeen
source: Bug POKéMON are cool and tough!\nI'll prove it to you!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherAlBeaten
source: You proved how tough you are…$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherAlAfter
source: They're so cool, but most girls\ndon't like bug POKéMON.\pI don't know why…$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherJoshSeen
source: You saved all the SLOWPOKE?\nWhew, you're mighty!\pBut my grown-up POKéMON are\npretty tough too!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherJoshBeaten
source: Urrgggh!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherJoshAfter
source: I guess I should teach them\nbetter moves…$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay1Seen
source: AMY: Hi! Are you challenging\nthe LEADER? No way!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay1Beaten
source: AMY & MAY: Oh, double\ngoodness!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay1After
source: AMY: You're really strong!\pBut BUGSY's even stronger!\nHis SCYTHER's CUT almost\lalways makes critical hits!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay2Seen
source: MAY: You want to see the\nLEADER? Good luck!\pBUGSY is so strong!\nHis SCYTHER's CUT always\lseems to crit!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay2Beaten
source: AMY & MAY: Oh, double\ngoodness!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay2After
source: MAY: Our bug POKéMON lost!\nOh, what a shame.\pBUGSY's won't lose though!\pHis PINECO makes short work\nof ROCK-type POKéMON!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_GymGuide
source:
Yo, challenger!\pBUGSY's young, but his knowledge
of bug POKéMON is for real.\pIt's going to be tough
without my advice.\pLet's see… BUGSY's bagworm POKéMON
knows a move that covers its\lROCK-type weakness.\pOh, and don't forget about those
nasty critical hits! Good luck!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideWin
source: Well done! That was a great\nclash of talented young trainers.\pWith people like you, the\nfuture of POKéMON is bright!$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_RivalBefore
source:
…Tell me something.\pIs it true that TEAM ROCKET
has returned?\pWhat? You beat them? Hah! Quit
lying.\pYou're not joking?
Then let's see how good you are.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_RivalWin
source: …Humph! Useless POKéMON!\pListen, you. You only won because\nmy POKéMON were weak.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_RivalAfter
source:
I hate the weak.\pPOKéMON, trainers. It doesn't
matter who or what.\pI'm going to be strong and wipe
out the weak.\pThat goes for TEAM ROCKET too.\pThey act big and tough in a group.\pBut get them alone, and they're weak.
I hate them all.\pYou stay out of my way. A weakling
like you is only a distraction.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_RivalLoss
source: …Humph! I knew you were lying.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Rocket1
source: It's unsafe to go in there,\nso I'm standing guard.\pAren't I a good Samaritan?$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Rocket2
source: Do you know about SLOWPOKETAIL?\nI heard it's tasty!\pAren't you glad I told you that?$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_GrampsBefore
source: The SLOWPOKE have disappeared\nfrom town…\pI heard their TAILS are being\nsold somewhere.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_GrampsAfter
source: The SLOWPOKE have returned.\pKnowing them, they could've just\nbeen goofing off somewhere.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Teacher
source: Did you come to get KURT to make\nsome BALLS?\pA lot of people do just that.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Youngster
source:
Cut through AZALEA and you'll be
in ILEX FOREST.\pBut these skinny trees make it
impossible to get through.\pThe CHARCOAL MAN's POKéMON
can CUT down trees.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Kurt1
source: ILEX FOREST is restless!\pWhat is going on?$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Kurt2
source: {PLAYER}, here's your GS BALL back!$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Kurt3
source: Could you go see why ILEX FOREST\nis so restless?$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Sign
source: AZALEA TOWN\nWhere People and POKéMON Live in\lHappy Harmony.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_KurtsHouseSign
source: KURT'S HOUSE$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_GymSign
source: AZALEA TOWN\nPOKéMON GYM\pLEADER: BUGSY\pThe Walking Bug POKéMON\nEncyclopedia$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_SlowpokeWellSign
source: SLOWPOKE WELL\pAlso known as the RAINMAKER WELL.\pLocals believe that a SLOWPOKE's\nyawn summons rain.\pRecords show that a SLOWPOKE's\nyawn ended a drought 400 years ago.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_CharcoalKilnSign
source: CHARCOAL KILN$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_IlexForestSign
source: ILEX FOREST\pEnter through the gate.$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Boss1
source:
All the SLOWPOKE have disappeared
from the town.\pThe forest's protector may be
angry with us…\pIt may be a bad omen. We should
stay in.$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Boss2
source: The SLOWPOKE have returned…$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Boss3
source: The SLOWPOKE have returned…\pBut my APPRENTICE hasn't come back\nfrom ILEX FOREST.\pWhere in the world is that lazy guy?$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Boss4
source: You chased off TEAM ROCKET and\nwent to ILEX FOREST alone?\pThat takes guts! I like that.\nCome train with us.$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Apprentice1
source: Where have all the SLOWPOKE gone?\pAre they out playing somewhere?$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Apprentice2
source: The SLOWPOKE came back!$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Apprentice3
source: I'm sorry--I forgot to thank you.\pThis is CHARCOAL that I made.\pFIRE-type POKéMON would be happy\nto hold that.$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Apprentice4
source: The SLOWPOKE came back, and you even\nfound FARFETCH'D.\pYou're the coolest, man!$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Farfetchd
source: FARFETCH'D: Kwaa!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_BallAnyway
source: Anyway, can I make you some BALLS?$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtGetStarted
source: KURT: I'll get started right now!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtMakingBallsMustWait
source:
Hm? Who are you?\p{PLAYER}, eh? You want me to make
some BALLS?\pSorry, but that'll have to wait.\pDo you know TEAM ROCKET?
Ah, don't worry.\pI'll tell you anyhow.\pTEAM ROCKET's an evil gang that
uses POKéMON for their dirty work.\pThey're supposed to have disbanded
three years ago.\pAnyway, they're at the WELL,
cutting off SLOWPOKETAILS to sell!\pSo I'm going to go give them a
lesson in pain!\pHang on, SLOWPOKE! Old KURT
is on his way!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtHonoredToMakeBalls
source:
KURT: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pYou handled yourself like a
real hero at the WELL.\pI like your style!\pI would be honored to make
BALLS for a trainer like you.\pThis is all I have now, 
but take it.$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtBallsFromApricorns
source: KURT: I make BALLS from BERRIES.\pCollect them from trees and bring\n'em to me.\pI'll make POKé BALLS out of them.$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtAskYouHaveAnApricorn
source: KURT: You have BERRIES for me?\pFine! I'll turn them into POKé BALLS.$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtThatsALetdown
source: KURT: I don't see any {STR_VAR_1}s!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtFinishedPlural
source: KURT: {PLAYER}!\nYour {STR_VAR_1}s are done. Here!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtObtainedPlural
source: {PLAYER} obtained\n{STR_VAR_2} {STR_VAR_1}s!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtFinishedSingular
source: KURT: {PLAYER}!\nYour {STR_VAR_1} is done. Here!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtObtainedSingular
source: {PLAYER} obtained\nthe {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtTurnedOutGreat
source: KURT: That turned out great.\pTry catching POKéMON with it.$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtWhatIsThat
source: Wh-what is that?\pI've never seen one before.\pIt looks a like a POKé BALL, but\nit appears to be something else.\pLet me check it for you.$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtImCheckingItNow
source: I'm checking it now.$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtAhHaISee
source: Ah-ha! I see! So…$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtThisBallStartedToShake
source: {PLAYER}!\pThis BALL started to shake\nwhile I was checking it.\pThere must be something to this!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_Kurt_Whatwasthat
source: What was that sound?!\pLet's go outside to investigate!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterSlowpokeGone
source: The SLOWPOKE are gone… \nWere they taken away by bad people?$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterLonely
source: Grandpa's gone… I'm so lonely…$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterSlowpokeBack
source: The SLOWPOKE my dad gave me came back!\pIts TAIL is growing back too!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterDad
source: Dad works at SILPH where\nhe studies POKé BALLS.\pI have to stay home\nwith Grandpa and SLOWPOKE.$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterHelp
source: I get to help Grandpa now!\pWe'll make good BALLS\nfor you, so please wait!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterFun
source: It's fun to make BALLS!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterSound
source: Did that sound come from\nILEX FOREST????$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_Forest
source: Did you check ILEX FOREST yet?\nIt sounds very restless.$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_Slowpoke
source: SLOWPOKE: … Yawn?$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_OakPhoto
source: …A young PROF. OAK?$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_CelebiStatue
source: It's a statue of the forest's\nprotector.$

label: AzaleaMart_Text_CooltrainerM
source:
Are you able to buy a GREAT BALL?
All I can buy are POKé BALLS.\pI heard that more items become
available to buy when you earn\lGYM BADGES!\pI wish KURT would make me some
of his custom BALLS.$

label: AzaleaMart_Text_BugCatcher

label: AzaleaPokecenter_Text_UnusedPCExplanation

source: BILL's PC can store up to 30\nPOKéMON per BOX.$

label: AzaleaPokecenter_Text_PokefanF

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleArena
source: Where the battling spirit of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pI welcome you to the BATTLE ARENA!\pI am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
source:
In the BATTLE ARENA, we undertake
the Set KO Tourney.\pAll participants enter with a team of
three POKéMON.\pThe three POKéMON must be lined up in
the order in which they are to appear.\pDuring battle, the POKéMON will appear
one at a time in the preset order.\pOnce a POKéMON enters battle, it must
remain out until the match is decided.\pIf a match remains undecided in
three turns, it goes to judging.\pIf you wish to interrupt your challenge,
please save the game.\pIf you don't save, you will not be able
to continue with your challenge.\pIf you pull off the feat of beating
seven TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with Battle Points.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OkayToSave
source: Before showing you to the BATTLE\nARENA, you must save. Is that okay?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
source: The BATTLE ARENA offers two levels\nof challenge, Level 50 and Open Level.\lWhich is your choice?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
source: Very well, now select your\nthree POKéMON, please.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
source:
My dear challenger!\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for entry.\pTo qualify, you must bring three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThey also must not hold the same
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsEnd
source: When you have made your preparations,\nplease do return.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
source:
My dear challenger!\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for entry.\pTo qualify, you must bring three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThe three different POKéMON
must all be Level 50 or lower.\pThey also must not hold the same
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_GuideYouToArena
source: I shall now guide you to\nthe BATTLE ARENA.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown
source:
My dear challenger!\pYou did not save the game before
shutting down, did you?\pIt is unfortunate, but that has
resulted in your disqualification\lfrom your challenge.\pYou may, of course, start with a fresh
challenge.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_CongratsOnSevenWins
source: We congratulate you for your splendid\nstring of wins over seven TRAINERS!$

source: Oh?\nYour BAG seems to be full.\pI urge you to clear space and\nreturn for your prize.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch
source: Shall I record your last BATTLE ARENA\nmatch on your FRONTIER PASS?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BadIdeaToNotAttack
source: I lost on the REFEREE's decision…\pI don't think it was a good idea to only\nuse defensive moves and not attack…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LandingHitsWorked
source: I won in judging!\pLanding hits consistently on\nthe opponent's POKéMON worked!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_MatchWasDeclaredDraw
source: Our match was declared a draw.\pWhen we ran out of time, both my\nPOKéMON and the opponent's had about\lthe same amount of HP left.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OrderOfMonsImportant
source:
In the BATTLE ARENA, the order of
POKéMON is totally important.\pFor example, if your first POKéMON
has certain type disadvantages,\ltry making your second POKéMON one\lwith moves that are super effective\lagainst the first one.\pI think that will be a good way of
making an effective team.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
source:
The Set KO Tourney has special rules,
unlike standard battles.\pFirst, one battle lasts only
three turns.\pIf the outcome is not decided after
three turns, it goes to judging.\pThe REFEREE will choose the winner
based on how the POKéMON battled.\pAlso, a POKéMON cannot be switched out
until its battle's outcome is decided.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainMindRules
source: The first judging factor is “Mind.”\nThis factor evaluates how aggressive\lthe battlers were.\pThe judging is based on how often\nthe TRAINERS ordered the use of\loffensive moves.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
source:
The second judging factor is “Skill.”
This factor evaluates how effectively\lPOKéMON moves were used.\pIf a move worked successfully,
the Skill rating goes up.\pIf a move failed, the Skill rating
is lowered.\pIf it was an offensive move, the Skill
rating goes up if the move was “super\leffective” and goes down if it was\l“not very effective.”\pThe Skill rating will not go up for
moves such as PROTECT and DETECT.\pIf the opponent used PROTECT or
DETECT, and your POKéMON failed to\lhit with a move, its Skill rating will not\lgo down.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBodyRules
source: The third judging factor is “Body.”\nThis factor is based on how much HP\lremained at the end of a battle.\pThe rating takes into account how much\nHP a POKéMON had at the start of\lbattle, and what remained at the end.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_CongratsOnDefeatingTycoon
source: A victory snatched from the ARENA\nTYCOON, and a seven-TRAINER sweep!\pWe congratulate you on your most\nsplendid challenge!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_PleaseAcceptBattlePoints

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleArena_hns
source: Where the battling spirit of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pI welcome you to the BATTLE ARENA!\pI am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WishToTakeChallenge_hns
source: Now, do you wish to take\nthe BATTLE ARENA challenge?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge_hns

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge_hns
source:
In the BATTLE ARENA, we undertake
the Set KO Tourney.\pAll participants enter with a team of
three POKéMON.\pThe three POKéMON must be lined up in
the order in which they are to appear.\pDuring battle, the POKéMON will appear
one at a time in the preset order.\pOnce a POKéMON enters battle, it must
remain out until the match is decided.\pIf a match remains undecided in
three turns, it goes to judging.\pIf you wish to interrupt your challenge,
please save the game.\pIf you don't save, you will not be able
to continue with your challenge.\pIf you pull off the feat of beating
seven TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with Battle Points.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OkayToSave_hns
source: Before showing you to the BATTLE\nARENA, you must save. Is that okay?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode_hns

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons_hns
source: Very well, now select your\nthree POKéMON, please.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen_hns
source:
My dear challenger!\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for entry.\pTo qualify, you must bring three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThey also must not hold the same
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsEnd_hns
source: When you have made your preparations,\nplease do return.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50_hns
source:
My dear challenger!\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for entry.\pTo qualify, you must bring three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThe three different POKéMON
must all be Level 50 or lower.\pThey also must not hold the same
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_GuideYouToArena_hns
source: I shall now guide you to\nthe BATTLE ARENA.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown_hns
source:

shutting down, did you?\pIt is unfortunate, but that has
resulted in your disqualification\lfrom your challenge.\pYou may, of course, start with a fresh
challenge.$

source: We congratulate you for your splendid\nstring of wins over seven TRAINERS!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BagFullReturnForPrize_hns

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ThankYouWaitWhileSave_hns

source: We await your challenge on\nanother occasion!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BadIdeaToNotAttack_hns

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LandingHitsWorked_hns

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_MatchWasDeclaredDraw_hns
source: Our match was declared a draw.\pWhen we ran out of time, both my\nPOKéMON and the opponent's had about\lthe same amount of HP left.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OrderOfMonsImportant_hns
source:

POKéMON is totally important.\pFor example, if your first POKéMON
has certain type disadvantages,\ltry making your second POKéMON one\lwith moves that are super effective\lagainst the first one.\pI think that will be a good way of
making an effective team.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead
source:
Hey, my name's NOLAND!
I'm basically in charge of this place,\lwhich is why I'm the FACTORY HEAD!\pI had a look at your Battle Swap data.\pYou seem to have the right idea,
but you're still square in your head!\pListen up, okay? Knowledge isn't only
about reading books or doing desk work.\pJust doing that sort of thing…
It may as well be useless!\pYou have to experience things with
your heart and your body, understand?\pI'll take you on under the same
conditions as you.\pI'll be using rental POKéMON, too!$

You keeping up with your studies?\p…Oh?\pYou've taken on a harder look than

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
source:
The Battle Swap Single Tournament
is a SINGLE BATTLE competition using\lonly rental POKéMON.\pFirst, you will be loaned three
POKéMON specifically for this event.\pUsing the supplied rental POKéMON,
you must conduct a SINGLE BATTLE.\pIf you win, you are permitted to trade

trading--if you win seven times in\la row, you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your

disqualified from your challenge.$

source:
Hi!

are easy since you don't need to have\la raised team of POKéMON?\pI wouldn't be too sure about winning
that easily.\pIf you don't have thorough knowledge
about POKéMON and their moves,\lit will be tough to keep winning.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
source: Where the hearts of TRAINERS\nare put to the test.\pI welcome you to the BATTLE PALACE.\pI accept challenges to the SINGLE\nBATTLE HALLS.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_TakeSingleBattleChallenge
source: Do you wish to take\nthe SINGLE BATTLE HALL challenge?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
source:
In the BATTLE PALACE, there are
several auditoriums for SINGLE BATTLES\lthat are named SINGLE BATTLE HALLS.\pThe SINGLE BATTLES are conducted in
the usual way, except with one crucial\lrule that must be obeyed.\pTRAINERS are permitted only to switch
their POKéMON in and out.\pTRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to
command their POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON are to behave according
to their nature and battle on their own.\pYou must put your trust in your
POKéMON and watch over them.\pIf you achieve the honor of beating
seven TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, you must save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReturnWhenFortified
source: When you have fortified your heart\nand POKéMON, you must return.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhichChallenge
source: There are two BATTLE HALLS,\nLevel 50 and Open Level.\lWhich is your choice of a challenge?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
source:
Sigh…\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for the challenge.\pTo enter, you must provide three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThese POKéMON must all be of
Level 50 or lower.\pThey also must not be holding
the same kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsEnd
source: Come back when you have made\nyour preparations.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
source:
Sigh…\pYou do not have the three POKéMON

different kinds of POKéMON.\pThey also must not be holding

source: Good. Now, you must select your\nthree POKéMON.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MustSaveBeforeChallenge2
source: I must save before I show you to\nthe BATTLE HALL. Is that okay?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FollowMe
source: Good.\nNow, follow me.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ResultsWillBeRecorded
source: I feel privileged for having seen\nyour POKéMON's exploits.\pThe results will be recorded.\nI must ask you to briefly wait.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FirmTrueBondsFor7WinStreak
source: To achieve a 7-win streak…\pThe bonds that bind your heart with\nyour POKéMON seem firm and true.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FeatWillBeRecorded
source: Your feat will be recorded.\nI must ask you to briefly wait.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_BattlePointsFor7WinStreak
source: For the feat of your 7-win streak,\nwe present you with Battle Point(s).$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NoSpaceForPrize
source: You seem to have no space for\nour prize.\pYou should return when you have\norganized your BAG.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WeHaveBeenWaiting
source: We have been waiting for you…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MustSaveBeforeChallenge
source: I must save before I show you to\nthe BATTLE HALL. Is that okay?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FailedToSaveBeforeEndingChallenge
source: Sigh…\pYou failed to save before you ended\nyour challenge the last time.\pAs a result, your challenge has been\ndisqualified. It is most unfortunate.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
source: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
source:
For a hardy fellow like me,
hardy POKéMON are the best.\pOffense is the best defense!
A relentless attack is the ultimate!\pBut that's not what I wanted to chat
about.\pEvery so often a really cute lady
swings by here.\pShe says that she can tell what
POKéMON are thinking.\pI don't know about that part,
but she is really cute.\pHuh?
Why are you looking at me like that?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NatureAndMovesKeyHere
source:
Hmm…\pIt appears that the nature of POKéMON
and the moves that they have been\ltaught are the keys to battle here.\pTo be more precise, it's how well
the moves match the nature of\lthe POKéMON.\pIf your POKéMON is in trouble and
unable to live up to its potential,\lyou may need to examine how well\lits moves match its nature.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MonDocileButTransforms
source: My POKéMON is usually very docile.\pBut when it's in a BATTLE HALL,\nit sometimes seems to become\ltransformed into something wicked!\pIt becomes totally intimidating.\nIt's shocking, even.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhatNatureFavorsChippingAway
source: I wonder what sort of nature a POKéMON\nwould have if it favored enfeebling its\lopponents and chipping away slowly.\pI'd be surprised if it was a LAX nature.\pBut, nah, that can't be right.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesBasics
source: Here, POKéMON are required to think\nand battle by themselves.\pUnlike in the wild, POKéMON that live\nwith people behave differently\ldepending on their nature.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
source:
Depending on its nature, a POKéMON
may prefer to attack no matter what.\pAnother POKéMON may prefer to protect
itself from any harm.\pYet another may enjoy vexing or
confounding its foes.\pDue to its nature, a POKéMON
will have favorite moves that it is good\lat using.\pIt may also dislike certain moves that
it has trouble using.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves
source:
There are offensive moves that inflict
direct damage on the foe.\pThere are defensive moves that are
used to prepare for enemy attacks or\lused to heal HP and so on.\pThere are also other somewhat-odd
moves that may enfeeble the foes with\lstat problems including poison and \lparalysis.\pPOKéMON will consider using moves in

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink_hns

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid
source:
The Battle Quest is a battling
event in which you must explore\lthe PYRAMID and try to reach the top.\pIn the PYRAMID are seven floors of
mazes, all of them filled with not only\lskilled TRAINERS but also wild POKéMON.\pYou must enter with three POKéMON,
none of them holding an item.\pOn your ascent, you will be provided
with a BATTLE BAG for items.\pIf you fail in your challenge, any item
placed in the BATTLE BAG disappears.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, you must select “REST”\land save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBagRules

of ten kinds of items.\pThe contents of the BATTLE BAG are
lost if you fail in your quest.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattlePyramid_hns
source: Where the courage of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE PYRAMID!\pI am your guide to\nthe Battle Quest.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_EmbarkOnChallenge_hns
source: Have you the courage to embark on\nthe Battle Quest challenge?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_AwaitFutureChallenge_hns
source: We await your challenge in the future!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid_hns
source:
The Battle Quest is a battling
event in which you must explore\lthe PYRAMID and try to reach the top.\pIn the PYRAMID are seven floors of
mazes, all of them filled with not only\lskilled TRAINERS but also wild POKéMON.\pYou must enter with three POKéMON,
none of them holding an item.\pOn your ascent, you will be provided
with a BATTLE BAG for items.\pIf you fail in your challenge, any item
placed in the BATTLE BAG disappears.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, you must select “REST”\land save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

source:
It is a delight to see you here!
You have reached the summit of\lthe BATTLE PYRAMID!\pAbove here is the PYRAMID's
lookout point.\pIt is a place open only to those
who have conquered the PYRAMID.\pNow, please!
Up you go!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_PlayerConqueredPyramid
source: The PYRAMID's new conqueror!\nLet the name {PLAYER} be known!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ChiefBeatYouHere
source:
It is a delight to see you here!\pUnfortunately, you were second by
a mere fraction of time!\pOur chief has already conquered
the PYRAMID ahead of you.\pHowever, my young explorer…
You are a TRAINER!\pAssert your power and take the glory
of the pinnacle from our chief!\pNow, please! When you are ready,
take one more step of courage!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ExplorationsAreGrandestAdventure
source: Young adventurer…\pWouldn't you agree that explorations\nare the grandest of adventures?\pYour own wits!\pYour own strength!\pYour own POKéMON!\pAnd, above all, only your own courage\nto lead you through unknown worlds…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ImPyramidKingBrandon
source:
Aah, yes, indeed this life is grand!
Grand, it is! Eh?\pI'm BRANDON!\pI'm the PYRAMID KING, which means
I'm in charge here.\pMost people call me the chief!\pYou coming here means you have
that much confidence in yourself,\lam I right?\pHahahah!
This should be exciting!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BringCourageToOurBattle
source: Now, then!\nBring your courage to our battle!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonFrontierPassPlease
source: BRANDON: Hahahah! Grand it was!\nGrand, yes, indeed!\pWell done! You've earned recognition!\nYour FRONTIER PASS, please!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ReceivedBraveSymbol
source: The Brave Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_LookForwardToNextMeeting
source: Young explorer!\nI look forward to our next meeting!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonYouveReturned
source:
BRANDON: …You've finally returned,
young explorer…\pYour love of adventure seems to come
deep from within your heart…\pYes… You are exactly as I was in
my own youth…\p… … …Ah…\pThe passionate!\pThe dangerous!\pThe desperate!\pThose days of death-defying,
life-affirming adventures are back…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_MyCourageIsOffMeter
source: Now, then!\pI sense my own courage is off\nthe meter!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_EverythingYouHave
source: Everything you have!\nI'm braced for it all!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonRemarkableHaveThis
source: BRANDON: Hahahah!\nRemarkable!\lYes, it's grand, indeed!\pYoung explorer!\pYou've bested me through and through!\nHere! I want you to have this!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BraveSymbolTookGoldenShine
source: The Brave Symbol took on\na golden shine!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_FarewellForNow
source: Ah, yes! It just goes to show that\nI have much to learn still!\pMay our paths cross again!\nFarewell for now, young explorer!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_StepForwardWhenReady
source: Now, when you are ready, take courage\nand step forward.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ReachedSummitUpYouGo_hns
source:
It is a delight to see you here!
You have reached the summit of\lthe BATTLE PYRAMID!\pAbove here is the PYRAMID's
lookout point.\pIt is a place open only to those
who have conquered the PYRAMID.\pNow, please!
Up you go!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_PlayerConqueredPyramid_hns
source: The PYRAMID's new conqueror!\nLet the name {PLAYER} be known!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ChiefBeatYouHere_hns
source:
It is a delight to see you here!\pUnfortunately, you were second by
a mere fraction of time!\pOur chief has already conquered
the PYRAMID ahead of you.\pHowever, my young explorer…
You are a TRAINER!\pAssert your power and take the glory
of the pinnacle from our chief!\pNow, please! When you are ready,
take one more step of courage!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_SalonMaidenOnHerWay
source: Excuse me, but…\pOur leader, the SALON MAIDEN, is on\nher way here in hopes of battling you.\pShe should be arriving very shortly.$

source: You will be facing the SALON MAIDEN.\nAre you prepared?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_GreetingsImAnabel
source:
Greetings…
My name is ANABEL.\pI am the SALON MAIDEN, and I am in
charge of running the BATTLE TOWER…\pI have heard several rumors
about you…\pIn all honesty, what I have heard does
not seem attractive in any way…\pThe reason I've come to see you…
Well, there is but one reason…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_LetMeSeeYourTalent
source: Let me see your talent in\nits entirety…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelTalentShallBeRecognized
source: ANABEL: Fufufu, nicely done…\pYour FRONTIER PASS, please…\nYour talent shall be recognized.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedAbilitySymbol
source: The Ability Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_UntilNextTime
source:
… … … … … …\pYou have confidence in your POKéMON
battling talent, don't you?\pI urge you to keep battling and
keep on winning.\pI will be waiting for you.
Until the next time we meet…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelYouCameBack
source:
ANABEL: You really did come back to
see me…\p… … … … … …\pYou've won straight matches to see me…
I won't have to hold back against you…\pIt's been too long now…\pToo long since I've been able to battle
without thinking about anything…$

source: Let's begin, shall we?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_AboutToFace50thTrainer
source: You're finally about to face the\n50th TRAINER.\pFrom here on, every time you beat seven\nTRAINERS in a row, your POKéMON will\lreceive a commemorative RIBBON.\pGood luck!$

source: Here are some RIBBONS for beating\nseven tough TRAINERS in a row.\p{PLAYER} received some RIBBONS!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_PutRibbonOnMons
source: {PLAYER} put the RIBBONS on\nthe challenger POKéMON.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DescribeFeelingsAboutBattleTower
source: Excuse me, do you have a moment?\pCan you describe your feelings when\nyou're about to begin a BATTLE TOWER\lmatch, or when you've either won or\llost a match?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FeelWhatWhenYouBegin
source: Okay, what are your feelings when\nyou're about to begin a match?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FeelWhatWhenYouveWon
source: What do you feel when you've won\na match?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FeelWhatWhenYouveLost
source: Can I hear about your feelings when\nyou have lost a match?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DontThinkMuchAboutIt
source: Oh, so you don't think much about it?\nYou're one cool customer.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ChangedYourMind
source: Hunh? You changed your mind?\nI guess you're fickle.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ThatsHowYouFeel
source: Okay, so that's how you feel?\nThat's quite original.\pThanks!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WinsInRowRecorded
source: The number of matches you win in a row\nis recorded.\pI'd better not get beaten in\nan embarrassing way!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_CanLeaveUntilLossOrSevenWins
source: Once you've entered the BATTLE TOWER,\nyou can't leave until you either lose\lor you beat seven TRAINERS in a row.\pYou'd best be certain that you're up\nto the challenge.$

is completed.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomSingleBattle
source: Where the talents of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE TOWER!\pI am your guide to the SINGLE\nBATTLE ROOMS.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_TakeSinglesChallenge
source: Would you like to take the SINGLE\nBATTLE ROOM challenge?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
source:
The BATTLE TOWER's SINGLE BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting\lSINGLE BATTLES with three POKéMON.\pThere are many SINGLE BATTLE ROOMS
in the BATTLE TOWER for team battles.\pIn each of the SINGLE BATTLE ROOMS,
seven TRAINERS await your challenge.\pIf you manage to defeat all seven,
you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
source: Now please select the three POKéMON\nthat are to be entered.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomeDoubleBattle
source: Where the talents of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE TOWER!\pI am your guide to the DOUBLE\nBATTLE ROOMS.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_TakeDoublesChallenge
source: Would you like to take the DOUBLE\nBATTLE ROOM challenge?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainDoublesChallenge
source:
The BATTLE TOWER's DOUBLE BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting\lDOUBLE BATTLES with four POKéMON.\pThere are many DOUBLE BATTLE ROOMS
in the BATTLE TOWER for team battles.\pIn each of the DOUBLE BATTLE ROOMS,
seven TRAINERS await your challenge.\pIf you manage to defeat all seven,
you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_PleaseSelectFourMons

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomeMultiBattle
source: Where the talents of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE TOWER!\pI am your guide to the MULTI\nBATTLE ROOMS.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_TakeMultisChallenge
source: Would you like to take the MULTI\nBATTLE ROOM challenge?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultisChallenge
source:
The BATTLE TOWER's MULTI BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting\lMULTI BATTLES.\pFor MULTI BATTLES, you must partner
with a TRAINER in the TOWER and enter\lwith two POKéMON each.\pInside the TOWER is a room named
the BATTLE SALON where you may meet\lother TRAINERS.\pThere, you must find a TRAINER to act
as your partner in MULTI BATTLES.\pOnce you have partnered up, you will
be shown to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM.\pIn the MULTI BATTLE ROOM, seven
tag teams await your challenge.\pIf you manage to defeat all seven
teams, you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainLinkMultisChallenge
source:
The BATTLE TOWER's MULTI BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting\lMULTI BATTLES with a friend.\pYou must link with your friend using
Wireless Adapters or a Game Boy\lAdvance Game Link cable.\pYou must partner with your friend and
enter two different kinds of POKéMON.\pThere are many MULTI BATTLE ROOMS
in the BATTLE TOWER for team battles.\pIn a MULTI BATTLE ROOM, seven
tag teams await you and your friend\lto make a tag-team challenge.\pIf you manage to defeat all seven
teams, you will earn Battle Points.\pPlease beware that unlike other ROOMS,
you may not interrupt your challenge.\pOnce you start, you must battle seven
MULTI BATTLES in a row nonstop.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainTowerRules
source:
The BATTLE TOWER is a facility where
four types of battles are waged--\lSINGLE BATTLE, DOUBLE BATTLE, MULTI\lBATTLE, and LINK MULTI BATTLE.\pFor each of these types, there are
separate BATTLE ROOMS.\pPlease speak with a guide offering
the type of battle you wish to enter.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
source:
Depending on the BATTLE ROOM you are
entering, you will be required to take\la certain number of POKéMON.\pThe SINGLE BATTLE mode requires
three POKéMON.\pThe DOUBLE BATTLE mode requires four,
and the MULTI modes both require two.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainSalonRules
source:
The BATTLE SALON is where you must
find a partner to form a tag team for\lthe MULTI BATTLE ROOM challenge.\pChoose the best partner for you by
examining other TRAINERS'\lPOKéMON and their moves.\pYou may choose a new tag partner
after winning seven straight matches.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultiLinkRules
source:
The LINK MULTI BATTLE Mode is for two
friends to mount a challenge together.\pYou and your friend must be linked with
Wireless Adapters or a GBA Game Link\lcable.\pYou must choose two POKéMON at
the registration counter.\pThese POKéMON must be different
from those of your friend.\pYou may not interrupt this challenge
in the middle, unlike other modes.$

source:
…Huh?

Listen, I have this proposition.\pWe have a little group going here,

source: Giggle!\nA SKITTY is so much cuter than I had\limagined. I'm delighted!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_YouDontWantTo

source: Those ladies, the way they bad-mouth\neach other, you probably think that\lthey don't get along.\pBut if that were true, they wouldn't\nstay out here together, would they?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_BodySlamDesc

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderWaveDesc

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwordsDanceDesc
source: A fighting dance\nthat sharply\nraises ATTACK.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DefenseCurlDesc

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SnoreDesc

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwiftDesc

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcyWindDesc

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ElementalTutorIntro
source: Zzzzzz…\pWhat, how, what?\pOh, sorry, I was snoozing a bit.\pI'm the ELEMENTAL TUTOR.\pI have the power to teach the most\npowerful moves to GRASS, FIRE and\lWATER TYPE POKéMON.\pDid you come to learn such a strong\npower?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ElementalTutorWelcomeBack
source: Zzzzzz…\pWhat, how, what, who?\pOh, did you come to learn the\npower of my strongest moves?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachWhichMoveElemental
source: Which move do you think is suitable\nfor your POKéMON?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_StrongElementalMoveDesc
source: Powerful, but\nleaves the user\nimmobile one turn.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds
source:
What a TRAINER needs…\pKnowledge…
Strategy…\lLuck…\lGuts…\lSpirit…\lBravery…\lAnd ability…\pWell, I'm all set in every way!
I'll be unstoppable at every building!\pHuh? POKéMON?
What's that?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_KnowAboutFrontierBrains
source: Do you know about the FRONTIER\nBRAINS?\pThat's what SCOTT calls the seven\nspecial TRAINERS that run the seven\lfacilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling
source: At the BATTLE TOWER, an older girl\ntold me that I have a lot of talent\lfor battling!\pI like POKéMON CONTESTS more!\pBut I'm no good at CONTESTS!\pI guess having talent and liking\nsomething aren't the same.$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ChaperonGrandson
source: We came here to chaperon our\ngrandson.\pBut since we're here, we thought\nwe should get some souvenirs.$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ProteinMakeNiceGift
source: Dear, what do you think of this?\nWouldn't this make a nice gift?\pIt's…PRO…TE…IN?\nIt sounds delicious, doesn't it?$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_FacilitiesDontAllowItems
source: A lot of the BATTLE FRONTIER's\nfacilities don't allow the use of items\lduring battles.\pThat rule makes things tougher than\nthey already are!$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ChaperonGrandson_hns
source: We came here to chaperon our\ngrandson.\pBut since we're here, we thought\nwe should get some souvenirs.$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ProteinMakeNiceGift_hns
source: Dear, what do you think of this?\nWouldn't this make a nice gift?\pIt's…PRO…TE…IN?\nIt sounds delicious, doesn't it?$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_FacilitiesDontAllowItems_hns
source: A lot of the BATTLE FRONTIER's\nfacilities don't allow the use of items\lduring battles.\pThat rule makes things tougher than\nthey already are!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerSign
source: This is the BATTLE TOWER!\nKeep the win streak as the toughest\lTRAINER!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePalaceSign
source: This is the BATTLE PALACE!\nKeep your eyes on POKéMON battles!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleArenaSign
source: This is the BATTLE ARENA!\nLet the toughest teams gather!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePyramidSign
source: This is the BATTLE PYRAMID!\nAdvance through the Battle Quest!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_RankingHallSign
source: BATTLE FRONTIER RANKING HALL\nSet your sights on new records!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ExchangeCornerSign
source: BATTLE POINT EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER\nExchange your Battle Points!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerFeelsSpecial
source: Wow!\nIt's huge!\pThe BATTLE TOWER feels special.\nIt's different from the others.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerLeagueAndFrontier
source: My grand ambition is to conquer both\nthe BATTLE FRONTIER and the POKéMON\lLEAGUE.\pAnd if my dream comes true…\pI… I'm going to ask MIMI next door\nif she will be friends with me!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PyramidTooHarsh
source: The BATTLE PYRAMID's too harsh!\nI just can't make it to the top!\pSince I'm out of options, maybe I can\nclimb the outside…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ThriveInDarkness
source: I thrive in darkness…\nYes… What is worthy of me?\lNone other than the BATTLE PYRAMID…\pWhat say you to wandering in darkness\nand in utter and total desperation?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PutTogetherUltimateTeam
source: I didn't sleep for a week, but then\nI put together the ultimate team!\pI can't see myself losing, no joke.\nWe're storming the BATTLE ARENA!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScottBringYouHere
source:
Did SCOTT bring you here, too?
What is it with that guy?\pIt sounds like he really does know
how to spot talented TRAINERS, but…\pI've never seen him battling in person
ever.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BelieveInYouBuddy
source: ZIGG!\nI believe in you, little buddy!\pI'll make my little ZIGG any favorite\ntasty treats you like if you win!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ZigzagoonLooksVacant
source: ZIGZAGOON looks vacant…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCallMeBusybody
source:
People call me a busybody,
but I can't help it.\pYour hat's on crooked!
Oh, no, trash on the ground!\lOops, it's almost dinnertime!\pI don't know if I can stand to just
watch at the BATTLE PALACE…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceBeatGymLeader
source: I may not look that impressive now,\nbut I once beat a GYM LEADER.\pWho knows, maybe I should give it\nanother shot at glory.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FastOnBikeAndBattles
source: I'm fast on my BIKE, and that goes for\nthe way I battle, too.\pI win matches in the blink of\nan eye!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BetterThanDaddyAtPokemon
source: I'm better than my daddy\nat POKéMON.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GoRackUpSomeWinsForDaddy
source: Go on, my baby sweetie!\nGo rack up some wins for Daddy!\pYou're just like your mother,\nso you'll be dominating!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPrettyGirlAtBattleArena
source:
It wasn't easy getting here,
but I'd heard about this knockout\lpretty girl at the BATTLE ARENA.\pInstead of her, do you know what
I found?\pA whole teeming mob of sweaty,
stinky, and primitive martial artists!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_SometimesImportantOldManInThere
source: I sometimes see this really important-\nlooking old man going in there.\pHe has these really awesome POKéMON.\nHe seems really nice, though.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid
source:
Do you know it?
The legend of the BATTLE PYRAMID?\pWhen there comes a confident TRAINER
reaching for the golden pinnacle,\lthere shall appear a man among men.\pDon't know that legend?
Well, of course not!\lI just made it up!\pWhat's it supposed to mean?
That, my friend, I can't say!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWipedOut
source:
Man! Oh man!
I've never lost once before!\pBut I got wiped out with no saving
grace at all!\pAnd then I'm told I don't have any
talent?! Man!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTrainerInBattleTower
source: This guy ran into a horribly tough\nTRAINER while he was on the BATTLE\lTOWER challenge.\pNow look at him…\pYou need to be cautious if you ever\ndecide to go to the BATTLE TOWER.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_EnoughBattlePointsForDoll
source: Yes!\nI've finally got enough Battle Points!\pI guess I'll trade for another giant\nplush DOLL!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHaveNameRecordedHere
source: Oh, yeah, okay!\nSo this is the RANKING HALL!\pI'd like to go down in history as\na super champ and have my name\lrecorded here for posterity.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_CanDoAnythingWithYou
source: With you by my side, I can do anything.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
source:
Ooh, darling, you are so wonderful!\pOoh, I just can't wait anymore!\pLet's go to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM
right this instant!\pIf we get together in the BATTLE SALON,
the power of our love will overcome\leveryone we meet.\pWhy, before us, darling, everything
will topple like dominoes!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers
source:
The BATTLE FRONTIER isn't exclusively
for tough TRAINERS.\pMany people with special abilities
have been invited, it seems.\pThat man SCOTT…\pHe may have built this place to serve
a bigger objective…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OddTreeHereSeemsToWiggle
source: Excuse me, young one.\nHave you good eyesight?\pThere is an odd tree past here, and to\nmy tired eyes it seems to wiggle.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceAnOddTreePastHere
source: Excuse me, young one.\nHave you a good memory?\pI have this feeling there once was\nan odd tree past here.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMonWithLongTail
source:
I…
I saw it!\pThere was a sticky sort of a POKéMON
with a long tail up ahead!\pIt was hiding under a boulder, and
it kept staring at me!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTrainerInBattleTower_hns
source: This guy ran into a horribly tough\nTRAINER while he was on the BATTLE\lTOWER challenge.\pNow look at him…\pYou need to be cautious if you ever\ndecide to go to the BATTLE TOWER.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_EnoughBattlePointsForDoll_hns
source: Yes!\nI've finally got enough Battle Points!\pI guess I'll trade for another giant\nplush DOLL!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHaveNameRecordedHere_hns
source: Oh, yeah, okay!\nSo this is the RANKING HALL!\pI'd like to go down in history as\na super champ and have my name\lrecorded here for posterity.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_CanDoAnythingWithYou_hns
source: With you by my side, I can do anything.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome_hns
source:
Ooh, darling, you are so wonderful!\pOoh, I just can't wait anymore!\pLet's go to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM
right this instant!\pIf we get together in the BATTLE SALON,
the power of our love will overcome\leveryone we meet.\pWhy, before us, darling, everything
will topple like dominoes!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers_hns
source:
The BATTLE FRONTIER isn't exclusively
for tough TRAINERS.\pMany people with special abilities
have been invited, it seems.\pThat man SCOTT…\pHe may have built this place to serve
a bigger objective…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OddTreeHereSeemsToWiggle_hns
source: Excuse me, young one.\nHave you good eyesight?\pThere is an odd tree past here, and to\nmy tired eyes it seems to wiggle.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceAnOddTreePastHere_hns
source: Excuse me, young one.\nHave you a good memory?\pI have this feeling there once was\nan odd tree past here.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMonWithLongTail_hns
source:
I…
I saw it!\pThere was a sticky sort of a POKéMON
with a long tail up ahead!\pIt was hiding under a boulder, and
it kept staring at me!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleDomeSign
source: This is the BATTLE DOME!\nYour path to the invincible superstar!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleFactorySign
source: This is the BATTLE FACTORY!\nSeek out the toughest POKéMON!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattlePikeSign
source: This is the BATTLE PIKE!\nChoose one of three paths!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThisIsBattleTower
source: This is the BATTLE TOWER.\pTRAINERS bring their best-raised\nPOKéMON for elimination-style matches.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
source: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHaveTicketToBoard
source: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…\pI'm terribly sorry.\pYou must have a TICKET to board\nthe ferry.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
source: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.\pPerfect! That's all you need!\pAnd where would you like to go?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SlateportItIs
source: SLATEPORT CITY it is, then!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LilycoveItIs
source: LILYCOVE CITY it is, then!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SailWithUsAnotherTime
source: Please sail with us another time!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_PleaseBoardFerry
source: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThenWhereWouldYouLikeToGo
source: Then, where would you like to go?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BestOutOfAllMyFriends
source: I'm the best out of all my friends.\nBut here…\lI've been useless!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_CantFindBattleTower
source: I want to go to the BATTLE TOWER,\nbut I can't find it even though I have\la map of the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThis place is just too big!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_GotSeasickOnWayHere
source: I wanted to take a challenge as soon\nas I arrived here.\pBut on the way, I got seasick…\nUrrrrp…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToughTrainersBroughtHere
source:
It's not as if just anyone can come
here, you know?\pOnly those TRAINERS who've been
recognized as tough are brought here.\pThat's why many TRAINERS don't even
know about the BATTLE FRONTIER.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SureWeCanChallengeWithNoMons
source: Hey, bro…\pAre you sure we can make challenges\neven if we don't have any POKéMON?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySaidIllLendYouMons
source: Uh…\nI'm sure it'll be okay.\pI think…\pBut remember that big scary guy?\nHe said, “I'll lend you POKéMON!”$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhosRaisingThoseRentalMons
source: That's the BATTLE FACTORY.\nYou can rent strong POKéMON there.\pBut it makes me wonder.\nWho's raising those rental POKéMON?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ScaredOfPikeBecauseSeviper
source: I'm scared of going into the BATTLE\nPIKE because of SEVIPER…\pB-but I came all the way here, so I will\ntry to conquer everything!\l…Shudder…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LetsPlayRockPaperScissors
source: Let's play rock, paper, scissors!\nOne, two, three!\p… … … … … …$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WonIllTakePikeChallenge
source: Yay! I won!\nI will take the BATTLE PIKE challenge!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LostIllPutOffPikeChallenge
source: Oh, no…\nI lost.\pI guess I'm not very lucky today.\nI'll put off my BATTLE PIKE challenge\luntil tomorrow.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ChooseFishingOverBattling
source: I believe I'm the only person here who,\nfor some unknown reason, would choose\lfishing over battling.\pHuh? You can't catch anything here?\nThat's disappointing…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_KeepBattlingUntilIGetSymbol
source: Today, I'm going to keep battling, no\nmatter what, until I get a Symbol.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_YoureOffToChallengeDome
source: Oh? You're off to challenge\nthe BATTLE DOME?\pI'll wish you the best of luck.\nLet us both win our way up and meet\lin challenges.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeIsHereGrandpa
source: Grandpa, over here!\nThe BATTLE DOME is here!\lGo get 'em, Grandpa!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WontLetGentlemenBeatMe
source: Ah, so this here is the BATTLE DOME?\nI won't let GENTLEMEN beat me!\pBut where is the entrance?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_NothingHereNotLongAgo
source: There used to be nothing here not all\nthat long ago.\pBut, now look at this place! Amazing!\nI'll bring my mother out to see this.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FinallyArrivedAtFrontier
source: I've finally arrived at the BATTLE\nFRONTIER!\pI'm sure to grab attention with\nmy looks and ability!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFilledWithToughPeople
source: Munch, munch…\pIt looks like this square's filled with\ntough people.\pMunch, munch…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
source:
Crunch, munch…\pA while back, I met this older girl
at the BATTLE PIKE.\pShe had these eyes that were scary
in a real ornery way.\pCrunch, munch…\pShe got all furious: “Will you quit
eating!” Then she whaled on me.\pIt was a hair-raising kind of
scary experience, sure enough.\pCrunch, munch…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LastTimeOurEyesMet
source: Huh? Will you listen to yourself?\nThat's nothing!\pWhy, the last time I cheered for him,\nour eyes met and sparks flew!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceLookedBecauseOfMyCheering
source:
Whaaaaaat?!
Pfft!\pThat only happened because
I happened to be sitting next to you!\pThe DOME ACE only looked our way
because my cheering was so loud!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceIsMine
source:
Oh, shush!
Keep that racket down!\pYou fair-weather fans should stick
to cheering for some GYM LEADER!\pThe DOME ACE is mine!
The only idol for me!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
source:
Those people squabbling over there…\pIt's hard to believe, but they once
were TRAINERS, and good ones, too.\pThey used to be incredibly tough,
and they were famous, too.\pBut they were obliterated by this
certain TRAINER at a tournament.\pThey were so thoroughly whipped,
they became smitten by the TRAINER.\pNow they're just fans of the TRAINER.
They go cheer for their idol at the\lBATTLE DOME every day now.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithLongTailInFrontier
source: I heard a rumor that someone saw\na POKéMON with an unusually long tail\lsomewhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pIt must be adorable. I'm sure of it…\pOh, challenges can wait. I feel driven\nto find the delightful creature!$
