label: CeruleanCity_Text_HardToControlMonsObedience
source: No! That's wrong!\nIt's so hard to control POKéMON!\pYour POKéMON's obedience depends\non your abilities as a TRAINER.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroTookSnooze
source: SLOWBRO took a snooze…$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroLoafingAround
source: SLOWBRO is loafing around…$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroTurnedAway
source: SLOWBRO turned away…$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroIgnoredOrders
source: SLOWBRO ignored orders…$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_WantBrightRedBicycle
source: I want a bright red bicycle.\pI'll keep it at home, so it won't\nget dirty.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_ThisIsCeruleanCave
source:
This is CERULEAN CAVE.\pHorribly strong POKéMON live inside
there.\pIt takes a very special TRAINER to
be allowed inside there.\pYou'd have to be strong enough to
become the POKéMON LEAGUE\lCHAMPION for starters.\pAnd, you would have to have
made a great achievement.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_CitySign
source: CERULEAN CITY\nA Mysterious, Blue Aura Surrounds\lIt$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerTipsHeldItems
source: TRAINER TIPS\pA POKéMON can be made to hold\nan item.\pSome items can even be used by\nthe holding POKéMON in battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_BikeShopSign
source: Grass and caves handled easily!\nBIKE SHOP$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_GymSign
source: CERULEAN CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\lThe Tomboyish Mermaid!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyIntro
source:
Hi, you're a new face!\pOnly those TRAINERS who have a
policy about POKéMON can turn pro.\pWhat is your approach when you
catch and train POKéMON?\pMy policy is an all-out offensive
with WATER-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM03
source: TM03 teaches WATER PULSE.\pUse it on an aquatic POKéMON!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCascadeBadge
source:
The CASCADEBADGE makes all
POKéMON up to Lv. 30 obey.\pThat includes even outsiders you
got in trades.\pThere's more. You can now use CUT
anytime, even out of battle.\pYou can CUT down small trees to
open new pathways.\pYou can also have my favorite TM.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM03FromMisty
source: {PLAYER} received TM03\nfrom MISTY.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_BetterMakeRoomForThis
source: You better make room for this!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyDefeat
source: Wow!\nYou're too much!\pAll right!\pYou can have the CASCADEBADGE to\nshow you beat me.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaIntro
source: What? You?\nI'm more than good enough for you!\pMISTY won't have to be bothered.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaDefeat
source: You overwhelmed me!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaPostBattle
source: You have to face other TRAINERS\nto see how good you really are.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_LuisIntro
source: Splash!\pI'm first up!\nLet's do it!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_LuisDefeat
source: That can't be!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_LuisPostBattle
source: MISTY is a TRAINER who's going to\nkeep improving.\pShe won't lose to someone like you!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
source:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pLet me give you some advice!\pThe LEADER, MISTY, is a pro who
uses WATER-type POKéMON.\pYou can drain all their water with
GRASS-type POKéMON.\pOr, you might use ELECTRIC-type
POKéMON and zap them!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_WeMakePrettyGoodTeam
source: You beat MISTY!\nSee, what'd I tell ya?\pYou and me, kid, we make a pretty\ndarn-good team!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: CERULEAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: CERULEAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: CERULEAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: CERULEAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED, {PLAYER}$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_Note
source: Sorry, I'll be out for a while.\nMISTY, GYM LEADER\pSince MISTY's out, we'll be away\ntoo.\lGYM TRAINERS$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_GruntIntro
source: Oops! I so sorry! You not hurt,\nokay?\pI very busy. No time for talking\nwith you. Not good for me if\lseen by somebody.$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_GruntBigMistake
source: Oh no! You seen me already!\nI make big mistake!$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_GruntBye
source: Hey, you! Forget you see me,\nokay?\pYou see, hear, know nothing,\pokay? Bye, kid! Nothing!\pBye-bye a go-go!$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_Note1
source: Sorry, I'll be out for a while.\nMISTY, GYM LEADER\pSince MISTY's out, we'll be away\ntoo. GYM TRAINERS$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_MistyIntro
source:
MISTY: I was expecting you, you
pest!\pYou may have a lot of JOHTO GYM
BADGES, but you'd better not\ltake me too lightly.\pMy WATER-type POKéMON are
tough!$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_MistyWinLoss
source: MISTY: You really are good…\pI'll admit that you are skilled…\pHere you go. It's CASCADEBADGE.$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_ReceivedBadge
source: {PLAYER} received CASCADEBADGE.$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_MistyFightDone
source: MISTY: Are there many strong\ntrainers in JOHTO? Like you, I\lmean.\pI'm going to travel one day, so\nI can battle some skilled\ltrainers.$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_MistyRematch
source: MISTY: Wow, you're the KANTO\nCHAMPION now!\pThat's amazing! You've come a\nlong way, {PLAYER}.\pBut I'm not backing down.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_MistyRematchDefeat
source: MISTY: You really are good…$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmerfDianaSeen
source: Sorry about being away. Let's get\non with it!$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmerfDianaBeaten
source: I give up! You're the winner!$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmerfDianaAfter
source: I'll be swimming quietly.$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmerfBrianaSeen
source: Don't let my elegant swimming\nunnerve you.$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmerfBrianaBeaten
source: Ooh, you calmly disposed of me…$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmerfBrianaAfter
source: Don't be too smug about beating\nme.\pMISTY will destroy you if you get\ncomplacent.$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmermParkerSeen
source: Glub…\pI'm first! Come and get me!$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmermParkerBeaten
source: This can't be…$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmermParkerAfter
source: MISTY has gotten much better in\nthe past few years.\pDon't let your guard down, or\nyou'll be crushed!$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_GuideIntro
source: Yo! CHAMP in making!\pSince MISTY was away, I went out\pfor some fun too. He-he-he.$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_GuideWin
source: Hoo, you showed me how tough you\nare.\pAs always, that was one heck of a\ngreat battle!$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_Misty_GiveTM
source: Here, take this too.$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_Misty_ExplainTM
source: It's the WATER PULSE TM.\pIt causes damage and sometimes\ncauses confusion as well!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_ThisIsCeruleanCave
source:
This is CERULEAN CAVE.\pHorribly strong POKéMON live inside
there.\pIt takes a very special TRAINER to
be allowed inside there.\pYou'd have to be strong enough to
become the KANTO POKéMON LEAGUE\lCHAMPION for starters.\pAnd, you would have to have
made a great achievement.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_CooltrainerM1
source: KANTO's POWER PLANT?\pIt's near the end of ROUTE 9, the\nroad that heads east from here.\pI think there was an accident of\nsome sort there.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_CooltrainerM2
source: You're collecting every single\nkind of POKéMON?\pThat must be quite a challenge,\nbut it sounds fun too.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SuperNerd
source: The CAPE in the north is a good\nplace for dates.\pGirls like it!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_Slowbro
source: SLOWBRO: Yarah?$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_CooltrainerF1
source: My SLOWBRO and I make an awesome\ncombination!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_CooltrainerF2
source: SLOWBRO, show me your CONFUSION!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_Fisher
source: I'm a huge fan of CERULEAN GYM's\nMISTY.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_Fisher_RocketTip
source: I saw this shady guy go off toward\nCERULEAN's CAPE.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_Youngster1
source: The cave north of town has\nhorribly powerful POKéMON in it.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_Youngster2
source: Ayuh?\pMy ITEMFINDER is responding…$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_Sign
source: CERULEAN CITY\pA Mysterious Blue Aura Surrounds It$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_GymSign
source: CERULEAN CITY\nPOKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\pThe Tomboyish Mermaid$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_BikeShopSign
source: There's a notice here…\pThe BIKE SHOP has moved to\nGOLDENROD CITY in JOHTO…$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_PoliceSign
source: There's a notice here…\pStamp out thievery and make the\ncity a friendlier, more cheerful\lplace!\pCERULEAN POLICE$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_CapeSign
source: CERULEAN CAPE\nAHEAD$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_LockedDoor
source: It's locked…$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_BadgesHaveAmazingSecrets
source: Only skilled TRAINERS can collect\nPOKéMON BADGES.\pI see you have at least one.\pThose BADGES have amazing secrets,\ndid you know?$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DescribeWhichBadge
source: Now then…\pWhich of the eight BADGES should\nI describe?$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ComeVisitAnytime
source: Come visit me anytime you wish.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AttackStatFlash
source: The ATTACK stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nFLASH outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv30Cut
source:
POKéMON up to Lv. 30 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
CUT outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpeedStatFly
source: The SPEED stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nFLY outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv50Strength
source:
POKéMON up to Lv. 50 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
STRENGTH outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DefenseStatSurf
source: The DEFENSE stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nSURF outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv70RockSmash
source:
POKéMON up to Lv. 70 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
ROCK SMASH outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpStatsWaterfall
source: The SP. ATK and SP. DEF stats of\nall your POKéMON rise a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nWATERFALL outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AllMonsWillObeyYou
source: All POKéMON will obey you!$

label: CeruleanHouse1_Text_PokefanM
source: Are you collecting KANTO GYM\nBADGES?$

label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_RocketsStoleTMForDig
source:
Those miserable ROCKETS!\pLook what they've done to my
house!\pThey stole a TM for teaching
POKéMON how to DIG holes!\pI was going to use it on a
MANKEY or a SANDSHREW…\pThat cost me a bundle, it did!$

label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeachDiglettDigWithoutTM
source: I figure what's lost is lost.\pI decided to teach DIGLETT how to\nDIG without a TM.$

label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeamRocketTryingToDigIntoNoGood
source: TEAM ROCKET must be trying to DIG\ntheir way into no good!$

label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeamRocketLeftWayOut
source: TEAM ROCKET left a way out!$

label: CeruleanPolice_Text_FishingGuru
source: I heard that some shady character\nis skulking about.\pI won't stand for it if he turns out\nto be a thief.$

label: CeruleanPolice_Text_PokefanF
source: We were held up by robbers before.$

label: CeruleanPolice_Text_Diglett
source: DIGLETT: Dug dug.$

label: CeruleanCity_House3_Text_PleaseTradeWithMyHusband
source: My husband likes trading POKéMON.\pYou're collecting POKéMON for your\nPOKéDEX, aren't you?\pWould you please trade with him?$

label: CeruleanHouse_Text_Granny
source: My husband lives happily with\nPOKéMON he got through trades.$

label: CeruleanHouse_Text_Gramps
source: Ah… I'm so happy…$

label: CeruleanHouse_Text_Kangaskhan
source: KANGASKHAN: Garu garuu.$

label: CeruleanHouse_Text_Zubat
source: ZUBAT: Zuba zubaa.$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_NothingEntertaining
source: Sigh…\nToo much time, too little to do…\pIs nothing entertaining happening\nanywhere?$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_NewNewsInformativeHaveThis
source:
Ah!
A new news report!\pHmm…\pI see!
That was quite informative!\pI applaud you for taking interest
in the news at your young age.\pAs my thanks for sharing the news
with me, I want you to have this.$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_IncredibleNewsHaveBerries
source:
Oh, oh!
Th-this news report!\pHmm…\pAmazing!
What an incredible piece of news!\pI haven't seen a news story this
incredible in too long a time!\pThanks for sharing this fantastic
news. Have a bunch of BERRIES!$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_WishCouldShareNewsWithOthers
source: It seems such a shame to not share\nthis news with other folks…\pI wish I could tell someone…\nLet others know the news…$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_ThanksForSpreadingNewsTakeThis
source: Ah, you've spread the news for me?\pGood news becomes worthwhile when\nall sorts of people share it.\pAs my thanks for your spreading\nthe news, take this!$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_MagnificentNewsSpreadHaveBerries
source:
You've spread the news some more?
Magnificent!\pThat piece of news must be
delighted to be passed around so.\pYes, indeed!\pConsider this a show of
appreciation from me and the news.\pI'll give you more BERRIES than
I usually do.$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_EnjoyingMyselfWithAllSortsOfNews
source: I'm quite enjoying myself with all\nsorts of news.\pYes, I am satisfied!\nI won't be bored for a while.$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_YourBerryPouchIsFull
source: Hm? Your BERRY POUCH is full.\nMy gift remains ungiven, then.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AnyInterestInBerries
source:
I concoct a variety of medicine
from BERRY POWDER.\pUsing good BERRY POWDER, I can
make any kind of medicine.\pNow tell me, have you any interest
in BERRIES?$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveJustTheThing
source: Ah, good! For you, then, I have\njust the thing.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_GoCrushBerriesAtDirectCorner
source:
There's something new on the second
floor of POKéMON CENTERS, at the\lDIRECT CORNER.\pThey installed a Wireless Adapter
machine for crushing BERRIES.\pThis is where you come in.\pI have a favor to ask, one that
I can entrust only to you.\pCould you make BERRY POWDER for
me using that machine?\pDon't forget, the machine is at the
DIRECT CORNER of POKéMON CENTERS.\pI'll concoct medicine for you if
you bring me some BERRY POWDER.\pDon't forget, crush BERRIES into
BERRY POWDER and bring it to me.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_WhyMustYouLieNoBerries
source: Why must you lie to me?\pHow many BERRIES do you have?\nNot a one!$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TakeInterestInAllSortsOfThings
source: You have no interest in BERRIES?\pYoung one, it's important to take an\ninterest in all sorts of things.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveYouBroughtBerryPowder
source: Er-hem! Have you brought me some\nBERRY POWDER?$

label: CeruleanCity_House5_Text_ExchangeWithWhat
source: With what would you like to \nexchange it?$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_YoullExchangeBerryPowderForItem
source: Fine, you'll exchange your BERRY\nPOWDER for one {STR_VAR_1}?$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DontHaveEnoughBerryPowder
source: Hm? You don't have enough\nBERRY POWDER.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TradeMoreBerryPowder
source: This is fine BERRY POWDER indeed.\nIt will make excellent medicine.\pWould you like to trade more BERRY\nPOWDER for something else?$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HopeToSeeYouAgain
source: That's fine, then.\nI'll hope to see you back again.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SeeMeIfYoudLikeToTradePowder
source: Come see me if you'd like to trade\nyour BERRY POWDER.$

label: CeruleanCity_Mart_Text_RepelWorksOnWeakMons
source:
REPEL not only keeps bugs away,
it also works on weak POKéMON.\pPut your strongest POKéMON at the
left of the POKéMON LIST.\pIf your first POKéMON is strong,
REPEL's effect is boosted.$

label: CeruleanCity_Mart_Text_DoYouKnowAboutRareCandy
source: Do you know about RARE CANDY?\nThey don't sell it in shops.\pI think it makes POKéMON grow\nvery quickly all of a sudden.$

label: CeruleanMart_Text_CooltrainerM
source: You'll run into many trainers on\nthe way to CERULEAN's CAPE.\pThey want to see how they stack\nup against other trainers.$

label: CeruleanMart_Text_CooltrainerF
source: MISTY is about the only person in\ntown who can beat the trainers at\lCERULEAN's CAPE.$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillDoesWhateverForRareMons
source: That BILL!\pI heard that he'll do whatever it\ntakes to get rare POKéMON.\pHe's not above doing all sorts\nof things, I've heard.$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryoneCallsBillPokemaniac
source: Have you heard about BILL?\pEveryone calls him a POKéMANIAC!\pI think people are just jealous of\nBILL, though.\pWho wouldn't want to boast about\ntheir POKéMON?$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillCollectsRareMons
source: BILL has lots of POKéMON!\nHe collects rare ones, too!$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TryTradingUpstairs
source:
Why don't you go upstairs and try
trading POKéMON with your friends?\pYou could get a lot more variety
by trading.\pThe POKéMON you get in trades grow
quickly, too.$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_SuperNerd
source: For battles, I'd much rather use\nPOKéMON I've been raising, even if\pthey're weaker than some newly\ncaught POKéMON.$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_GymGuide
source: The MAGNET TRAIN travels at over\n340 mph. It goes between KANTO and\lJOHTO in almost no time at all.\pIt really makes JOHTO accessible.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentIntro
source:
You're a rookie trainer,
aren't you? I can tell!\pThat's OK! Everyone is a
rookie at some point!\pIf you'd like, I can teach
you a few things.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentTourStart
source: OK, then!\nFollow me!$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentPokecenter
source: This is a POKéMON CENTER.\pThey heal your POKéMON in no\ntime at all.\pYou'll be relying on them a lot,\nso you better learn about them.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentMart
source: This is a POKéMON MART.\pThey sell BALLS for catching wild\nPOKéMON and other useful items.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentRoute30
source: ROUTE 30 is out this way.\pTrainers will be battling\ntheir prized POKéMON there.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentSea
source: This is the sea, as you can see.\pSome POKéMON are found only in\nin water.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentMap
source: Here…\pIt's my house! Thanks for\nyour company.\pOh, and if you're ever lost, check\nthe MAP on your POKéGEAR!\pI wish you luck on your journey!$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentDecline
source: Oh… It's something I enjoy\ndoing…\pFine. Come see me whenever\nyou like.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_RivalSeen
source: … … … … … … … …\pYou got a POKéMON at the LAB.\pWhat a waste.\nA wimp like you.\p… … … … … … … …\pDon't you get what I'm saying?\nWell, I too, have a good POKéMON.\pI'll show you what I mean!$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_SilverWin
source: Humph. Are you happy you won?$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_RivalAfter
source: … … … … … … … …\pDo you want to know who I am?\pI'm going to be the world's\ngreatest POKéMON trainer.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_RivalID
source: Give it back!\nThat's my TRAINER CARD!\pOh no!\nYou saw my name...$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_TeacherHaveMapCard
source: When you're with POKéMON,\ngoing anywhere is fun.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_YoungsterNoPokedex
source: MR. POKéMON's house is still\nfarther up ahead.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_YoungsterHavePokedex
source: I battled the trainers on the\nroad.\pMy POKéMON lost. They're a\nmess! I must take them to a\lPOKéMON CENTER.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_MysticWaterGuyBefore
source: A POKéMON I caught had an\nitem.\pI think it's MYSTIC WATER.\pI don't need it, so do you\nwant it?$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_MysticWaterGuyAfter
source: Back to fishing for me, then.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_CitySign
source: CHERRYGROVE CITY\pThe City of Cute, Fragrant\nFlowers$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentsHouseSign
source: GUIDE GENT'S HOUSE$

label: CherryGroveCity_Text_Staryu
source: STARYU: Yuuuuuuuu.$

label: CherryGroveCity_Text_Corsola
source: CORSOLA: Corsola! La!$

label: CherryGroveCity_Text_Krabby
source: KRABBY: KOOOOKEEE!$

label: CherrygroveCity_GymSpeechHouse_Text_PokefanM
source: You're trying to see how good\nyou are as a POKéMON trainer?\pYou better visit the POKéMON\nGYMS all over JOHTO and collect\lBADGES.$

label: CherrygroveCity_GymSpeechHouse_Text_BugCatcher
source: When I get older, I'm going to\nbe a GYM LEADER!\pI make my POKéMON battle with\nmy friend's to make them\ltougher!$

label: CherrygroveCity_GuideHouse_Text_GuideGent
source: When I was a wee lad, I was a\nhotshot trainer!\pHere's a word of advice:\nCatch lots of POKéMON!\pTreat them all with kindness!$

label: CherrygroveCity_EvolutionHouse_Text_Youngster
source: POKéMON gain experience in\nbattle and change their form.$

label: CherrygroveCity_EvolutionHouse_Text_Lass
source: POKéMON change?\pI would be shocked if one did\nthat!$

label: Cherrygrove_Pokemart_Text_CooltrainerM
source: They're fresh out of POKé BALLS!\pWhen will they get more of them?$

label: Cherrygrove_Pokemart_Text_CooltrainerM_PokeBallsInStock
source: POKé BALLS are in stock!\nNow I can catch POKéMON!$

label: Cherrygrove_Pokemart_Text_Youngster
source:
When I was walking in the grass, a
bug POKéMON poisoned my POKéMON!\pI just kept going, but then my
POKéMON fainted.\pYou should keep an ANTIDOTE
with you.$

label: CherryGrove_Pokecenter_Text_Fisher
source: It's great. I can store any number\nof POKéMON, and it's all free.$

label: CherryGrove_Pokecenter_Text_Gentleman
source: That PC is free for any\ntrainer to use.$

label: CherryGrove_Pokecenter_Text_Lass
source: They say a watched pot never\nboils. But watching the clock\lin the POKéCENTER makes time fly!$

label: CherryGrove_Pokecenter_Text_Chansey
source: CHANSEY: Chaan! Sii!$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ChucksWifeEasierToFly
source: You crossed the sea to get here?\pThat must have been hard.\pIt would be much easier if your\nPOKéMON knew how to FLY...$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ChucksWifeBeatChuck
source: But you can't use FLY without this\ncity's GYM BADGE.\pIf you beat the GYM LEADER here,\ncome see me.\pI'll have a nice gift for you.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ChucksWifeGiveHM
source: That's CIANWOOD's GYM BADGE!\pThen you should take this HM.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ChucksWifeFlySpeech
source: Teach FLY to your POKéMON.\pYou will be able to FLY instantly\nto anywhere you have visited.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ChucksWifeChubby
source: My husband lost to you, so he needs\nto train harder.\pThat's good, since he was getting\na little chubby.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_Youngster
source: If you use FLY, you can get back\nto OLIVINE instantly.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_PokefanM
source: Boulders to the north of town can\nbe crushed.\pThey may be hiding something.\pYour POKéMON could use ROCK SMASH\nto break them.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_Lass
source: CHUCK, the GYM LEADER, spars with\nhis fighting POKéMON.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_EusineSuicune
source:
EUSINE: Yo, {PLAYER}.\pWasn't that SUICUNE just now?\pI only caught a quick glimpse, but
I thought I saw SUICUNE running on\lthe waves.\pSUICUNE is beautiful and grand.\pAnd it races through towns and
roads at simply awesome speeds.\pIt's wonderful…\pI want to see SUICUNE up close…\pI've decided.\pI'll battle you as a trainer to
earn SUICUNE's respect!\pCome on, {PLAYER}. Let's battle now!$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_EusineBeaten
source: I hate to admit it, but you win.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_EusineAfter
source: You're amazing, {PLAYER}!\pNo wonder POKéMON gravitate to you.\pI get it now.\pI'm going to keep searching for\nSUICUNE.\pI'm sure we'll see each other again.\pSee you around!$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_Sign
source: CIANWOOD CITY\pA Port Surrounded by Rough Seas$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_GymSign
source: CIANWOOD CITY POKéMON GYM\pLEADER: CHUCK\pHis Roaring Fists Do the Talking$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_PharmacySign
source: 500 Years of Tradition\pCIANWOOD CITY PHARMACY\pWe Await Your Medicinal Queries$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_Safari
source: CLIFF EDGE CAVE\nRoad to the SAFARI ZONE.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_Engineer
source: This path is under construction.\nWe're getting the new SAFARI ZONE\lup and running!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_GymStatue
source: CIANWOOD CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: CIANWOOD CITY POKéMON GYM\pCHUCK'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckGotoDojo
source: WAHAHAHA {PLAYER}!\nI'm in the middle of my training!\pIf you want another match, come to\nthe FIGHTING DOJO in SAFFRON!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckAtDojo
source: I will see you at the DOJO!\nWAHAHAHAHAHA$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckIntro1
source: WAHAHAH!\pSo you've come this far!\pLet me tell you, I'm tough!\pMy POKéMON will crush stones and\nshatter bones!\pWatch this!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckIntro2
source: CHUCK: Urggh!\n…\pOooarrgh!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckIntro3
source: There! Scared now, are you?\pWhat? It has nothing to do with\nPOKéMON?\pThat's true!\pCome on. We shall do battle!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckLoss
source: Wha? Huh? I lost?\pHow about that!\nYou're worthy of STORMBADGE!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_GetStormBadge
source: {PLAYER} received STORMBADGE.$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckBadgeSpeech
source: STORMBADGE makes all POKéMON up to\nL70 obey, even traded ones.\pIt also lets your POKéMON use FLY\nwhen you're not in a battle.\pHere, take this too!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckTMSpeech
source: That is FOCUS PUNCH.\pIt moves slow but deals huge\ndamage. Just don't get hit first!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckAfter
source: WAHAHAH! I enjoyed battling you!\pBut a loss is a loss!\pFrom now on, I'm going to train\n24 hours a day!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckRematch
source: WAHAHAH! JOHTO CHAMPION!\pYou've come back for more!\pI see your skills have improved!\pReady to see who's stronger?$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckRematchDefeat
source: Wha? Huh? I lost?\nAgain?$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltYoshiSeen
source: My POKéMON and I are bound togeth-\ner by friendship.\pOur bond will never be broken!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltYoshiBeaten
source: This isn't real!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltYoshiAfter
source: You seem to have a strong bond\nwith your POKéMON too!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltLaoSeen
source: We martial artists fear nothing!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltLaoBeaten
source: That's shocking!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltLaoAfter
source: Fighting POKéMON are afraid of\npsychics…$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltNobSeen
source: Words are useless.\nLet your fists do the talking!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltNobAfter
source: I lost! I'm speechless!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltLungSeen
source: My raging fists will shatter your\nPOKéMON!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltLungBeaten
source: I got shattered!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltLungAfter
source: My POKéMON lost…\nMy… my pride is shattered…$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_OldManIntro
source:
I don't remember the last time
someone came to visit me.\pWhen I was young, I was a
POKéMON Trainer, too.\lI tried to reach the tower and\ldive into the ocean.\pI put a lot of effort into many
things.\pWell, I take things easy now,
listening to the waves and winds\lon this beach.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_BellTowerStory
source:
Have you heard of the TIN TOWER
in ECRUTEAK?\pThere are what they call Clear Bells
on top of the tower.\pThey don't make a single noise
in strong winds.\pThere is only one way to make them
ring.\pIt is to obtain another CLEAR BELL
just like the ones at the top of the\ltower.\pI went after it when I was young.
But I never got one...$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_WhirlIslandsStory
source:
Have you heard of WHIRL ISLANDS?\pThere are what they call Tidal Bells
at its waterfall basin.\pThey don't make a single noise
in crashing waves.\pThere is only one way to make them
ring.\pIt is to obtain another Tidal Bell
just like the ones at the waterfall\lbasin.\pI went after it when I was young.
But I never got one...$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ClearBellReaction
source:
Oh! You've managed to get a
CLEAR BELL?\pThe old-time dream of mine...
I see...\pYou've done it...
...\l...I can hear it!\pThe chime of the bells on the wind
coming from the direction of the\lTIN TOWER...$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_TidalBellReaction
source:
Oh! You've managed to get a
Tidal Bell?\pThe old-time dream of mine...
I see...\pYou've done it...
...\l...I can hear it!\pThe chime of the bells on the sea
breeze coming from the direction of\lthe WHIRL ISLANDS...$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_LugiaHouseTeacher
source: You came from OLIVINE?\pDo you remember the four islands\nalong the way?\pI heard that a mythical sea crea-\nture is hiding in them.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_LugiaHouseLass
source: I heard that you can only see it\nif you have a SILVER WING.\pIt must have the same scent as\nthe creature.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_LugiaHouseTwin
source: I've heard that the whirlpools\naround the islands are caused by\lthe sea creature.\pYou might need a special move\nto get past them.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacAskShuckle
source:
I, I'm in shock!\pA guy about your age with piercing
eyes and long hair came in.\pHe scared me into giving him my
prized POKéMON!\pI still have one left, but what if
he comes back?\pYou look strong. Could you look
after my POKéMON for a while?$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacTakeCareShuckle
source: Oh, thank you!\pTake good care of it, please!$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacGotShuckle
source: {PLAYER} received a POKéMON.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacPartyFull
source: Your POKéMON party is full.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacIfHeComesBack
source: Oh, no… What'll I do if he comes\nback?$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacHowsdoing
source: Hi! How's my POKéMON?$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacAskReturn
source: Hi! How's my POKéMON?\pI think I'm safe now, so may I\nhave it back?$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacThankYou
source: Thank you!$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacShuckleNotThere
source: Hey, you don't have my POKéMON\nwith you.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacShuckleLikesYou
source: My POKéMON has come to like you.\pAll right, you should keep it.\pBut promise to be good to it!$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacRobbed
source: Huh, something's not right.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacRobbed2
source: Oh, no, no… That's the same as\nbeing robbed.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacHappinessSpeech
source: For POKéMON, happiness is being\nwith a person who treats them well.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacLastMon
source: If I take my POKéMON back,\nwhat are you going to use\nin battle?$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacReturnedMon
source: {PLAYER} returned SHUCKIE.$

label: CianwoodPokemoncenter_Text_Fisher1
source: As far as water POKéMON go,\nTENTACOOL is the best by a\lnautical mile!$

label: CianwoodPokemoncenter_Text_Fisher2
source: You seem like you need a water\nPOKéMON.\pHere, take this one, I have plenty.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_PokecenterLass
source: Did you meet the POKéMANIAC?\pHe's always bragging about his\nrare POKéMON.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_GymGuide
source:
The POKéMON GYM trainers here are
macho bullies.\pIf I stick around, they might
come after me.\pHere's some advice: the GYM LEADER
uses the FIGHTING-type.\pSo you should confound him with
psychic POKéMON.\pWipe out his POKéMON before they
can use their physical strength.\pAnd those boulders in the middle
of the GYM?\pIf you don't move them correctly,
you won't reach the GYM LEADER.\pIf you get stuck, go outside.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_GymGuideWin
source: {PLAYER}! You won!\nI could tell by looking at you!$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_PokecenterSuperNerd
source: I love showing off the POKéMON\nthat I've raised.\pDon't you?\pI'm going to get into a bunch of\nbattles, and show off my POKéMON!$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_PharmacistGivePotion
source: Your POKéMON appear to be fine.\pIs something worrying you?\p…\pThe LIGHTHOUSE POKéMON is in\ntrouble?\pI got it!\pThis ought to do the trick.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ReceivedSecretpotion
source: {PLAYER} received SECRET POTION.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_PharmacistDescribePotion
source: My SECRET POTION is a tad too\nstrong, so I only offer it in an\lemergency.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_DoorIsLocked
source: The door is locked…$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_BlaineLivedHereSinceBeforeLab
source: CINNABAR GYM's BLAINE is quite the\nodd fellow.\pHe's lived on the island since way\nbefore the LAB was built.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_ScientistsExperimentInMansion
source: Scientists conduct experiments \nin the burned-out building.\pYou know, the one they call the\nPOKéMON MANSION.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_IslandSign
source: CINNABAR ISLAND\nThe Fiery Town of Burning Desire$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_PokemonLab
source: POKéMON LAB$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_GymSign
source: CINNABAR ISLAND POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\lThe Hotheaded Quiz Master!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_HeyIfItIsntPlayer
source: Huh?\nHey, if it isn't {PLAYER}!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_ComeWithMeToOneIsland
source:
Look, it's me, BILL.
Long time no see!\pI hope you're still using my
PC system.\pWell, listen, since we met up here,
how about spending time with me?\pThere's this little island in the far
south called ONE ISLAND.\pA friend invited me, so I'm on my
way out there.\pHow about it?
Do you feel like coming with me?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_AllRightLetsGo
source: All right, then.\nLet's go!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_IllBeWaitingInPokeCenter
source:
What, are you too busy?\pWell, all right.
The boat hasn't arrived yet anyway.\pI'll be waiting at the POKéMON
CENTER over there.\pCome see me when you're done with
your business here.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_MyPalsBoatArrived
source: Looks like my pal's boat arrived,\ntoo.\pHe sent it specially here to\nCINNABAR to pick me up.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_IfYouHaveTriPassYouCanGoAgain
source:
Hey, wasn't that a long cruise?\pMy buddy CELIO seemed to enjoy
your company.\pI'm sure he'd welcome you if you
were to visit him again.\pIf you have a TRI-PASS, you can
always take a ferry there from\lVERMILION PORT.\pAll right, thanks for your company!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineIntro
source:
Hah!\pI am BLAINE, the red-hot LEADER
of CINNABAR GYM!\pMy fiery POKéMON are all rough
and ready with intense heat!\pThey incinerate all challengers!\pHah!
You better have BURN HEAL!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineDefeat
source: I have burned down to nothing!\nNot even ashes remain!\pYou have earned the VOLCANOBADGE.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_FireBlastIsUltimateFireMove
source: FIRE BLAST is the ultimate fire\ntechnique.\pDon't waste it on WATER POKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ExplainVolcanoBadge
source: Hah!\pThe VOLCANOBADGE heightens the\nSPECIAL stats of your POKéMON.\pHere, you can have this, too!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM38FromBlaine
source: {PLAYER} received TM38\nfrom BLAINE.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlainePostBattle
source: TM38 contains FIRE BLAST.\nTeach it to FIRE-type POKéMON.\pVULPIX or CHARMELEON would be\nideal for that move.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_MakeSpaceForThis
source: Make space for this, child!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikIntro
source: Do you know how hot POKéMON fire\nbreath can get?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikDefeat
source: Yow!\nHot, hot, hot!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikPostBattle
source: Fire, or to be more precise,\ncombustion…\p…Oxygen in the air…\nBlah, blah, blah, blah…$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnIntro
source: I was a thief, but I went straight\nas a TRAINER.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnDefeat
source: I surrender!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnPostBattle
source: I get this uncontrollable urge to\nsteal other people's POKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryIntro
source: I've studied POKéMON thoroughly.\nYou can't win!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryDefeat
source: Waah!\nMy studies were insufficient!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryPostBattle
source: My theories are too complicated\nfor you to understand.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonIntro
source: I like using FIRE-type POKéMON.\nI just do.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonDefeat
source: Too hot to handle!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonPostBattle
source: I wish there were a thief POKéMON.\nI'd use that!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekIntro
source: I know why BLAINE became a\nTRAINER.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekDefeat
source: Ow!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekPostBattle
source:
Our LEADER, BLAINE, became lost
in the mountains but good.\pNight fell when a fiery bird
POKéMON appeared.\pIts light allowed BLAINE to find
his way down safely.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyIntro
source: I've been to many GYMS, but this\none best suits my style.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyDefeat
source: Yowza!\nToo hot!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyPostBattle
source: PONYTA, NINETALES…\nThose are popular FIRE POKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacIntro
source: Fire is weak against H2O.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacDefeat
source: Oh!\nSnuffed out!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacPostBattle
source: Water beats fire, of course.\pBut fire melts ice, so the FIRE\ntype beats ICE-type POKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
source:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pThe hotheaded BLAINE is a FIRE
POKéMON pro.\pDouse his spirits with water!\pYou'd better take some
BURN HEALS, too.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
source: {PLAYER}!\nYou beat that firebrand!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: CINNABAR POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: CINNABAR POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PokemonQuizRules
source:
POKéMON Quiz!\pGet it right, and the door opens to
the next room.\pGet it wrong, and face a TRAINER!\pIf you want to conserve your
POKéMON for the GYM LEADER…\pThen get it right!
Here we go!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion1
source: CATERPIE evolves into METAPOD?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion2
source: There are nine certified POKéMON\nLEAGUE BADGES?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion3
source: POLIWAG evolves three times?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion4
source: Are electric moves effective\nagainst GROUND-type POKéMON?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion5
source: POKéMON of the same kind and level\nare not identical?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion6
source: TM28 contains TOMBSTONY?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_CorrectGoOnThrough
source: You're absolutely correct!\pGo on through!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_SorryBadCall
source: Sorry!\nBad call!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_Blaine
source: BLAINE: I'll never give up\nuntil the day I've rebuilt\lCINNABAR GYM!\pI'll be at the FIGHTING DOJO\nuntil then.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_BlueBefore
source:
Who are you?\pWell, it's plain to see that you're
a trainer…\pMy name's BLUE.\pI was once the CHAMPION, although
it was for only a short time…\pThat meddling RED did me in…\pAnyway, what do you want? You want
to challenge me or something?\p…I hate to say it, but I'm not in
the mood for a battle now.\pTake a good look around you…\pA volcano erupts, and just like
that, a whole town disappears.\pWe can go on winning and losing in
POKéMON. But if nature so much as\ltwitches, we can lose in a second.\p…\pThat's the way it is…\pBut, anyway, I'm still a trainer.\pIf I see a strong opponent, it
makes me want to battle.\pIf you want to battle me, you'll
need 15 badges first.\pI'll take you on then.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_Blue
source:
Who are you?\pWell, it's plain to see that you're
a trainer…\pMy name's BLUE.\pI was once the CHAMPION, although
it was for only a short time…\pThat meddling RED did me in…\pAnyway, what do you want? You want
to challenge me or something?\p…I hate to say it, but I'm not in
the mood for a battle now.\pTake a good look around you…\pA volcano erupts, and just like
that, a whole town disappears.\pWe can go on winning and losing in
POKéMON. But if nature so much as\ltwitches, we can lose in a second.\p…\pThat's the way it is…\pBut, anyway, I'm still a trainer.\pIf I see a strong opponent, it
makes me want to battle.\pIf you want to battle me, come to
the VIRIDIAN GYM.\pI'll take you on then.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_GymSign
source: There's a notice here…\pCINNABAR GYM has relocated to\nSEAFOAM ISLANDS.\pBLAINE$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_Sign
source: CINNABAR ISLAND\pThe Fiery Town of Burning Desire$

label: CinnabarIsland_Mart_Text_DontTheyHaveXAttack
source: Don't they have X ATTACK?\pI like it because it raises the\nATTACK stat in battle.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Mart_Text_ExtraItemsNeverHurt
source: It never hurts to have extra items.\nYou never know what might happen.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CinnabarGymLocked
source:
I came to visit the CINNABAR GYM,
but the door is locked tight.\pThere should be a key for it
somewhere.\pCould it be in that burned-out
mansion?\pThe GYM LEADER's friend used to
live there, they say.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitUnionRoom
source:
Do you have lots of friends?\pLinking up with the usual friends
is fun, of course.\pBut how about visiting the
UNION ROOM every so often?\pWho knows, you may end up making
new friends.\pI think it would be worth your time
to check the UNION ROOM.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EvolutionCanWaitForNewMoves
source: POKéMON can still learn techniques\nafter canceling evolution.\pEvolution can wait until new moves\nhave been learned.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReadyToSailToOneIsland
source: BILL: Hey, you kept me waiting!\nReady to set sail to ONE ISLAND?$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OhNotDoneYet
source: Oh, you're still not done yet?$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LetsGo
source: Well, that's it.\nLet's go!$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter1F_Text_CooltrainerF
source: CINNABAR GYM's BLAINE apparently\nlives alone in the SEAFOAM ISLANDS\lcave…$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Fisher
source: It's been a year since the volcano\nerupted.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PhotoOfBlaineAndFuji
source: It's a photo of BLAINE and\nMR. FUJI.\pThey're standing shoulder to\nshoulder with big grins.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_StudyMonsExtensively
source: We study POKéMON extensively\nevery day.\pPeople often bring us rare POKéMON\nfor examination.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_PhotoOfLabFounderDrFuji
source: A photo of the LAB's founder…\nDR. FUJI?!$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_MeetingRoomSign
source: POKéMON LAB\nMeeting Room$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_RAndDRoomSign
source: POKéMON LAB\nR & D Room$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_TestingRoomSign
source: POKéMON LAB\nTesting Room$

label: Text_MetronomeTeach
source:
Tch-tch-tch!
I'll teach you a nifty move.\pTeach it to a POKéMON, and watch
the fun unfold!\pIt's a move called METRONOME.
Does it strike your fancy?$

label: Text_MetronomeDeclined
source: I tell you, it's a lot of fun!$

label: Text_MetronomeWhichMon
source: Okay!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?$

label: Text_MetronomeTaught
source: Tch-tch-tch!\nThat's the sound of a METRONOME.\pIt tweaks your POKéMON's brain into\nusing moves it doesn't even know.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_HaveYouAFossilForMe
source:
Hiya!\pI am important doctor.
Yes, very much so, indeed.\pHere, I study rare POKéMON fossils.
All the time, I study.\pYou!
Have you a fossil for me?$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_NoIsTooBad
source: No!\nIs too bad!$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_TakesTimeGoForWalkJP
source: ちょっと　じかん　かかるよ！\pそこらへんを　すこし\nブラブラ　してくると　よろしー！$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_FossilMonBackToLife
source: You late.\nWhere were you?\pYour fossil is back to life!\nIt was {STR_VAR_1} like I think!$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_ReceivedMonFromDoctor
source: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}\nfrom the doctor.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_NoRoomForPokemon
source: ポケモン　いっぱいで　もてないね！$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_ThatFossilIsOfMonMakeItLiveAgain
source:
Oh!
That is {STR_VAR_2}, it is!\pIt is fossil of {STR_VAR_1},
a POKéMON that is already extinct!\pMy Resurrection Machine will make
that POKéMON live again!$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_HandedFossilToWeirdDoctor
source: So!\nYou hurry and give me that!\p{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} handed over the\n{STR_VAR_2} to the weird doctor.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_TakesTimeGoForWalk
source: I take a little time!\nYou go for walk a little while!$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_YouComeAgain
source: Aiyah!\nYou come again!$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Lounge_Text_FoundFossilInMtMoon
source: I found this most remarkable fossil\ninside MT. MOON.\pI think it's of a rare, prehistoric\nPOKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_Text_EeveeCanEvolveIntroThreeMons
source: EEVEE can evolve into one of three\nkinds of POKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_Text_LegendaryBirdEmail
source:
There's an e-mail message.\p… … …\pThere are three legendary bird
POKéMON.\pThey are ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS, and
MOLTRES.\pTheir whereabouts are unknown.\pWe plan to explore the cavern
close to CERULEAN.\pFrom: POKéMON RESEARCH TEAM…$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_Text_AnAmberPipe
source: An amber pipe!$

label: CliffEdgeCave_Text_Baldman
source: If you see a fork in the road\ninside a cave, most likely one\lway is right and the other leads\lto a dead end.\pBut people can't help trying both.$

label: CliffEdgeGate_Text_IntroOpen
source:
Did you know? There's a SAFARI ZONE
just around the corner.\pIt's really fun!
You will see many different kinds of\lPOKéMON, and it's all you can catch!\pThere is no reason not to go, right?
Just around the corner.$

label: CliffEdgeGate_Text_Expectations
source: I appreciate that everybody is looking\nforward to it.\pBut the lady at the reception seems\na bit too dramatic...\pDon't get your expectations too high!$

label: CliffEdgeGate_Text_SignOpen
source: Everything Is Thrilling!\nExplore to Find Wild POKéMON!\lWarden BAOBA's SAFARI ZONE\lUp and Running!$

label: DarkCave2_Text_Nerd
source:
Whoa! You startled me there!\pI had my BLACK-GLASSES on, so I
didn't notice you at all.\pWhat am I doing here?\pHey, don't you worry about it.\pI'll give you a pair of BLACK-
GLASSES, so forget you saw me,
OK?$

label: DarkCave2_Text_Nerd2
source: BLACK-GLASSES ups the power of\nDARK-type moves.$

label: DesertUnderpass_Text_FoundRootFossil
source: {PLAYER} found the ROOT FOSSIL.$

label: DesertUnderpass_Text_FoundClawFossil
source: {PLAYER} found the CLAW FOSSIL.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_TinyIslandCommunity
source: DEWFORD is a tiny island community.\nIf something gets trendy here,\leveryone picks up on it right away.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_TownSign
source: DEWFORD TOWN\n“A tiny island in the blue sea.”$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GymSign
source: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BRAWLY\l“A big wave in fighting!”$

label: DewfordTown_Text_HallSign
source: DEWFORD HALL\n“Everyone's information exchange!”$

label: Route104_Text_LandedInDewfordDeliverLetter
source: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've hit land in DEWFORD.\pI suppose you're off to deliver that\nLETTER to, who was it now, STEVEN!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_SetSailBackToPetalburg
source: MR. BRINEY: Have you delivered your\nLETTER?\pOr were you meaning to sail back to\nPETALBURG?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail2
source: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG it is, then!\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GoDeliverIllBeWaiting
source: MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver\nthe LETTER. I'll be waiting.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInDewford
source: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've hit land in DEWFORD!\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail again!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_WhereAreWeBound
source: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!\pNow, my friend, where are we bound?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail
source: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG, is it?\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_SlateportWereSettingSail
source: MR. BRINEY: SLATEPORT, is it?\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_JustTellMeWhenYouNeedToSetSail
source: MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever\nyou need to set sail again!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GettingItchToFish
source: This is a renowned fishing spot.\nAre you getting the itch to fish?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GiveYouOneOfMyRods
source: I hear you, and I like what\nyou're saying!\pI'll give you one of my fishing RODS.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice
source:
And, as an added bonus, I'll even throw
in a little fishing advice!\pFirst, you want to face the water,
then use the ROD.\pFocus your mind…
If you get a bite, pull on the ROD.\pSometimes you can snag something
immediately, but with bigger catches,\lyou need to time the pulls on your ROD\lto haul them in.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThatsTooBadThen
source: Oh, is that so?\nThat's too bad, then.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_HowsYourFishing
source: Yo!\nHow's your fishing?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GreatHaulInSomeBigOnes
source: Is that right! That's great!\nHaul in some big ones!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice
source:
Oh, hey, don't get down on yourself!
I'll give you a little fishing advice.\pFirst, you want to face the water,
then use the ROD.\pFocus your mind…
If you get a bite, pull the ROD.\pSometimes you can snag something
immediately, but with bigger catches,\lyou need to time the pulls on your ROD\lto haul them in.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
source:
I like what's hip, happening, and trendy.
I'm always checking it out.\pListen, have you heard about this new
“{STR_VAR_1}”?\pThat's right!
Of course you know!\pI mean, sheesh,
“{STR_VAR_1}”…\lIt's the hottest thing in cool!\pWherever you're from,
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lis the biggest happening thing, right?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_TellMeWhatsNewAndIn
source: Hunh?\nIt's not the hip and happening thing?\pWell, hey, you have to tell me,\nwhat's new and what's “in”?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
source:
Hunh?
“{STR_VAR_2}”?\p… …\p…Uh… Yeah! That's right!
Yeah, I knew that! Knew it all along!\pOf course I know about that!
“{STR_VAR_2},” right?\pYeah, that's it, it's there!
Isn't “{STR_VAR_2}”\lthe coolest, or what?\pIt's the hippest thing in hip.
You think I'd not know about it?\p“{STR_VAR_1}”…
It's, like, so five minutes ago.\pNow, “{STR_VAR_2}” is
what's vital and in tune with the times!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_XHuhIThinkYIsCool
source: Hmm…\n“{STR_VAR_2},” huh?\pBut personally, I think\n“{STR_VAR_1}”\lis what's real in cool.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_HearOfAnyTrendsComeShareWithMe
source: Well, if you hear of any happening new\ntrends, come share them with me, okay?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_YeahDefinitionOfInRightNow
source: Yeah, absolutely right!\p“{STR_VAR_1}” is the\ndefinition of “in” right now.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
source:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pDEWFORD's GYM LEADER BRAWLY commands
FIGHTING-type POKéMON.\pGoing against him with NORMAL-type
POKéMON is asking for trouble.\pFIGHTING POKéMON will lay a serious
smack down on NORMAL POKéMON,\lso be careful!\pWhat's worse, the GYM is as dark as
the ocean floor.\pBut it will get brighter after defeating
the TRAINERS in your way.\pHey, okay, go for it!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
source: Whoah! It's turned too bright in here!\pYour future is bright, too!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoIntro
source: Might is right!\nCome on!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoDefeat
source: Not enough power…$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoPostBattle
source: Your skill overcame my strength!\nYour technique is commendable!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynIntro
source: There's no need for BRAWLY to be\ninvolved!\pI'll crush you!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynDefeat
source: But… How?\nHow could I lose so easily?$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynPostBattle
source: I'm not going to waste this loss.\nI'll use it to motivate me to train!\pOne day I'll become a GYM LEADER…\pNo, I'll become the POKéMON LEAGUE\nCHAMPION!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraIntro
source: Don't you dare brush me off!\nIt's not my fault if you cry!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraDefeat
source: Waaaaaaah!\nI lost!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraPostBattle
source: I battle in the dark to make my heart\nstronger.\pBut because it's so dark, I can never\nsee BRAWLY's face…$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithIntro
source: Ufufu…\nAre you stumbling around in the dark?$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithDefeat
source: Oh, you…\nI don't want to know you!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithPostBattle
source: You deserve to stay lost and end up\nback at the entrance again!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenIntro
source: I'll show you the gumption of\na sailing man!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenDefeat
source: How'd this happen?\nIt's not like me to lose this way!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenPostBattle
source: Oh, aye! You're worthy of seeing\nour GYM LEADER.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianIntro
source: If you mean to pass, it has to be\nthrough me!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianDefeat
source: Grrrrr!\nVastly overpowered!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianPostBattle
source: You win!\nGo after that BADGE!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyIntro
source:
I'm BRAWLY!
DEWFORD's GYM LEADER!\pI've been churned in the rough waves
of these parts, and I've grown tough\lin the pitch-black cave!\pSo you wanted to challenge me?
Let me see what you're made of!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyDefeat
source: Whoah, wow! You made a much bigger\nsplash than I expected!\pYou swamped me!\pOkay, you've got me.\nTake this GYM BADGE!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ReceivedKnuckleBadge
source: {PLAYER} received the KNUCKLE BADGE\nfrom BRAWLY.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_KnuckleBadgeInfoTakeThis
source:
The KNUCKLE BADGE makes all POKéMON
up to Level 30, even those you get in\ltrades, obey without question.\pAnd, you'll be able to use the HM move
FLASH outside of battle.\pIf you'd like, use this TECHNICAL
MACHINE, too.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ExplainBulkUp
source: That TM08 contains BULK UP.\pIt's a move that raises both ATTACK\nand DEFENSE stats.\p… … … … … …$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_RegisteredBrawly
source: Registered GYM LEADER BRAWLY\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostBattle
source: I can see your talent becoming a giant\nwave to cause a storm of astonishment\lamong TRAINERS one day!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM\pBRAWLY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPreRematch
source:
BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it
always returns to the shore.\pA giant wave of a talent like you…
I knew you would return!\pShow me how much higher
you've gone!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchDefeat
source: Wow!\nSwamped again!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostRematch
source: BRAWLY: Battling is vast and it's deep.\nYou can't see the bottom.\lIt's just like the sea of HOENN!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTwoMons
source:
BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it
always returns to the shore.\pA giant wave of a talent like you…
I knew you would return!\pOh? You only have one POKéMON
that can battle.\pI'm sorry, but I'd like you to come back
with at least two POKéMON.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_CantImagineLifeWithoutTrend
source: What's in vogue? Why, it has to be\n“{STR_VAR_1}”!\pI can't imagine what life would be like\nwithout “{STR_VAR_1}”!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_GettingBoredOfTrend
source: What's in vogue? Why, it has to be\n“{STR_VAR_1}”!\pBut I'm getting kind of bored with it.\pI should look for the next big thing.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TeachingMonAboutTrend
source: I'm teaching my POKéMON about\n“{STR_VAR_1},”\lbut it's not going well.\pIt's a bit too much, I think.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_DeepLinkBetweenXAndY
source: I'm studying up on the hip and trendy\n“{STR_VAR_1}” now.\pIs it true that there's a deep link\nbetween “{STR_VAR_1}”\land “{STR_VAR_2}”?$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_MyHunchWasRight
source: Oh!\nSo, my hunch was right!\pI'm one step closer to being hip and\nhappening, yowza!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_NotEasyToKeepUp
source: What?!\nIs that so?!\pIt's not easy for an older fellow like\nme to keep up with trends!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TVShowAboutTrend
source: This whole business about\n“{STR_VAR_1}”…\lIsn't there a TV show on it?$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_IsTrendMorePopularAcrossSea
source: Across the sea…\pIs “{STR_VAR_1}”\neven more popular?$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_CollectTrendMerchandise
source:
I collect official
“{STR_VAR_1}”\llicensed merchandise.\pI have official
“{STR_VAR_1}” DOLLS…\pOfficial “{STR_VAR_1}”
brand clothing…\pAnd officially licensed
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lpicture books.\pHeheh, I own!
I'm not sharing anything with you!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BooksAboutTrend
source:
IDENTIFYING GOOD
“{STR_VAR_1}” &\lBAD “{STR_VAR_1}”…\pTHE LINK BETWEEN
“{STR_VAR_1}” AND\lPOKéMON…\pUSEFUL
“{STR_VAR_1}”…\pIt's neatly jammed with books about
“{STR_VAR_1}.”$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendsScream
source: “{STR_VAR_1}'S\nSCREAM” is the title.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendsSmile
source: “{STR_VAR_1}'S\nSMILE” is the title.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_LastTrend
source: It's titled “THE LAST\n{STR_VAR_1}”.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BirthOfTrend
source: It's titled “THE BIRTH OF\n{STR_VAR_1}”.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_SawTrendCoolestThing
source: I saw “{STR_VAR_1}”!\nCool, huh?\pIt's, like, the coolest thing going!\pIt was awesome!\nIt was the real thing, oh yeah!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_AllegedTrendNotAuthentic
source: Oh, no, no, no.\pThat alleged\n“{STR_VAR_1}”\lyou claim to have seen--it's not.\pThe authentic article is much…\nHow should I say it?\lSharper, yet more mellow!\pAh, no matter. It's astonishing!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_ComposedTrendThemeSong
source:
Hey, listen, I composed a theme song
for “{STR_VAR_1}.”\p“{STR_VAR_1}”
is really popular right now.\pOkay, listen!
… …\pOh!
{STR_VAR_1}!\pWonderful
{STR_VAR_1}!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_WorkOnYourSinging
source: … …\pI dare say, chap, it would pay for you\nto work on your singing before you\ltrifle yourself with\l“{STR_VAR_1}.”$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_OrganizeTrendParty
source: Anyway, as I was saying earlier, we\nshould get together and organize a\l“{STR_VAR_1}” party\lon the island.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BrilliantIndeed
source: Oh, a smashing good idea!\pIt will settle once and for all\nwho is the best at\l“{STR_VAR_1}.”\lBrilliant, indeed!\pStarting today, our lives will revolve\naround “{STR_VAR_1}”!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendHasBecomePartOfLife
source: I was thinking, though…\pWouldn't you agree that\n“{STR_VAR_1}” has\lgrown from being something trendy to\lbeing a part of our daily lives?$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendWeighsHeavilyOnMind
source:
Beg pardon?
That much, what?\pHowever, it's true that
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lweighs heavily on your mind, whether\lyou're awake or asleep.\pAbsolutely, you're the
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lPROFESSOR, old sport!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_IfWeTeamUpWellBeInvincible
source: If you and me team up as a combo,\nwe'll be invincible when it comes to all\lthings “{STR_VAR_1}”!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_WellBeTrendDuo
source: Spot on, my friend!\pWe shall be the\n“{STR_VAR_1}” DUO!\pIsn't that a ripe image?\nHahahah!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_GiveYouSludgeBomb
source:
For me, SLUDGE BOMB is at the peak
of popularity. It's the one.\pHunh? You're telling me that you don't
know about SLUDGE BOMB?\pThat's outright pitiful.
I'll give you one.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_LoveSludgeBombButTrendInToo
source: I love SLUDGE BOMB.\pBut POKéMON with the move\n“{STR_VAR_1}”\lare in, too.$

label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_LotToBeSaidForLivingOnIsland
source: There's a lot to be said for living on\na small island like this in harmony with\lPOKéMON and the family.$

label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_LifeGoesSlowlyOnIsland
source: I left the major port of SLATEPORT\nCITY when I married my husband here.\pLife goes by slowly on this little\nisland. But being surrounded by the\lbeautiful sea--that's happiness, too.$

label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_Zigzagoon
source: ZIGZAGOON: Guguuh!$

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveSilkScarf
source:
Gorge your eyes on this!\pIt's a SILK SCARF. It's right at the
cutting edge of fashion, yeah!\pOh, I can see your eyes twinkling!
You appreciate my dazzling style!\pOh, you're a delight!
Here you go. I want you to have it!$

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_NoRoom
source: Oh, you don't have room?\pNow, listen tight, this SCARF is a must-\nhave! Why, I would sell all my items\lin order to get it!$

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_ExplainSilkScarf
source: The SILK SCARF raises the power of\nNORMAL-type moves.\pIt's a marvelous SCARF that will go\nwith almost all POKéMON!$

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_BrawlySoCool
source:
Wow, you bothered to cross the sea
to visit DEWFORD?\pDid you maybe come here because you
heard about BRAWLY?\pHe's so cool…
Everyone idolizes him.$

label: DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_StoneCavern
source: There's a stone cavern at the edge\nof town.\pI've heard you can find rare stones\nthere.$

label: DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FaintedMonCanUseHM
source: Even if a POKéMON faints and can't\nbattle, it can still use a move learned\lfrom a HIDDEN MACHINE (HM).$

label: DiglettsCave_EntranceNorth_Text_Brock
source: BROCK: Small spaces surrounded by\nrocks make you feel peaceful,\ldon't you agree?\pIf you want another match, I'll be\nat the FIGHTING DOJO.$

label: DiglettsCave_NorthEntrance_RockTunnelPitchBlack
source: I went inside ROCK TUNNEL, but it's\npitch-black and scary in there.\pIf I could get a POKéMON to use\nFLASH and light it up…$

label: DiglettsCave_SouthEntrance_Text_DiglettDugThisTunnel
source: Well, isn't this a surprise!\nDIGLETT dug this long tunnel!\pIt goes right to VIRIDIAN CITY,\nthey tell me.$

label: DragonsDen_Text_Clair
source: {PLAYER}… So you're here.\pIf you think you can keep up,\nwith me, come to the FIGHTING\lDOJO in SAFFRON.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_Clair_GiveTM
source: CLAIR: WAIT!\pI'm sorry about this.\nHere, take this as my apology.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_Clair_ExplainTM
source: DRAGON PULSE is a kind of er...\nnever mind!\pIt's a huge energy of some kind.\pIf you don't want it, you don't have\nto take it.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_ClairWhatsTheMatter
source:
What's the matter? Aren't
you going on to the POKéMON\lLEAGUE?\pAfter you become CHAMPION, you
can rematch any GYM LEADER you\lwant.\pGo to the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pDo you know how to get there?\pFrom here, go to NEW BARK TOWN.\pThen SURF east to POKéMON LEAGUE.\pThe route there is very tough.\pDon't you dare lose at the POKéMON
LEAGUE!\pIf you do, I'll feel even worse
about having lost to you!\pGive it everything you've got.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_DragonShrineSign
source: DRAGON SHRINE\pA shrine honoring the dragon\nPOKéMON\psaid to have lived in DRAGON'S\nDEN.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_SilverTraining1
source:
…
What? {PLAYER}?\p…No, I won't battle you now…\pMy POKéMON aren't ready to beat
you.\pI can't push them too hard now.\pI have to be disciplined to become
the greatest POKéMON trainer…$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_SilverTraining2
source: …\pWhew…\pLearn to stay out of my way…$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_CooltrainermDarinSeen
source: You! How dare you enter\nuninvited!$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_CooltrainermDarinBeaten
source: S-strong!$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_CooltrainermDarinAfter
source: The SHRINE ahead is home to the\nMASTER of our dragon-user clan.\pYou're not allowed to just go in!$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_CooltrainerfCaraSeen
source: You shouldn't be in here!$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_CooltrainerfCaraBeaten
source: Oh yikes, I lost!$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_CooltrainerfCaraAfter
source: Soon I'm going to get permission\nfrom our MASTER to use dragons.\pWhen I do, I'm going to become an\nadmirable dragon trainer and gain\lour MASTER's approval.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_TwinsLeaandPia1Seen
source: It's a stranger we don't know.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_TwinsLeaandPia1Beaten
source: Ouchies.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_TwinsLeaandPia1After
source: It was like having to battle\nLANCE.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_TwinsLeaandPia2Seen
source: Who are you?$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_TwinsLeaandPia2Beaten
source: Meanie.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_TwinsLeaandPia2After
source: We'll tell on you.\pMASTER will be angry with you.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ElderGreeting
source:
Hm… Good to see you here.\pNo need to explain why you came.
CLAIR sent you here, didn't she?\pThat girl is a handful…
I am sorry, but I must test you.\pNot to worry, you are to answer
only a few questions.\lReady?$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Question1
source: What are POKéMON to you?$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Question2
source: What helps you to win battles?$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Question3
source: What kind of trainer do you wish\nto battle?$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Question4
source: What is most important for\nraising POKéMON?$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Question5
source: Strong POKéMON. Weak POKéMON.\nWhich is more important?$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_WrongAnswer1
source: Hah? I didn't quite catch that…$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_WrongAnswer2
source: What was it you said?$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_RightAnswer
source: Oh, I understand…$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_PassedTest
source: Hm… I see…\pYou care deeply for POKéMON.\pVery commendable.\pThat conviction is what is\nimportant!\p{PLAYER}, don't lose that belief.\pIt will see you through at the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ClairYouPassed
source: So how did it go?\pI guess there's no point\nin asking. You did fail?\p..................................\p…What? You passed?$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ClairThatCantBe
source: That can't be!$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ClairYoureLying
source: You're lying!\pEven I haven't been approved!$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_MustIInformLance
source: CLAIR!\pThis child is impeccable,\nin skill and spirit!\pAdmit defeat and confer the\nRISINGBADGE!\p…Or must I inform LANCE of this?$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_IUnderstand
source: I-I understand…$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_HereRisingBadge
source: Here, this is the RISINGBADGE…\pHurry up! Take it!$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_PlayerReceivedRisingBadge
source: {PLAYER} received RISINGBADGE.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_RisingBadgeExplanation
source: RISINGBADGE will enable your\nPOKéMON to use the move for\lclimbing waterfalls.\pAlso, all POKéMON will recognize\nyou as a trainer and obey your\levery command without question.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ElderScoldsClair
source: CLAIR…\pReflect upon what it is that you\nlack and this child has.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ComeAgain
source: Come again, if you so desire.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_SilverIsInTraining
source: A boy close to your age is in\ntraining here.\pHe is much like CLAIR when she was\nyounger. It is a little worrisome…$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Elder2
source: It's been quite some time since a\ntrainer has gained our MASTER's\lrare approval.\pIn fact, not since Master LANCE.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Elder3
source: You know young Master LANCE?\pHe looks so much like our MASTER\ndid in his youth.\pIt's in their blood.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_TakeThisDratini
source: Hm… Good to see you here.\pYour arrival is most fortunate.\pI have something for you.\pTake this DRATINI as proof that I\nhave recognized your worth.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_SymbolicDragon
source: Dragon POKéMON are symbolic of our\nclan.\pYou have shown that you can be\nentrusted with one.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ClairsGrandfather
source: CLAIR appears to have learned an\ninvaluable lesson from you.\pI thank you as her grandfather.$

label: EcruteakCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: ECRUTEAK CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: EcruteakCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: ECRUTEAK CITY POKéMON GYM\pMORTY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: MortyIntroText
source:
Good of you to have come.\pHere in ECRUTEAK, POKéMON have
always been revered.\pIt's said that a rainbow-colored
POKéMON will come down to\lappear before a true Trainer.\pI believed that tale, so I've
trained here in secret.\pAs a result, I can now see what
others cannot.\pJust a bit more...\pWith a little more, I could see
a future where I meet the\lrainbow-colored POKéMON.\pYou're going to help me reach
that level!$

label: MortyWinLossText
source: I'm not good enough yet...\pAll right. This BADGE is yours.$

label: Text_ReceivedFogBadge
source: {PLAYER} received the FOGBADGE.$

label: MortyText_FogBadgeSpeech
source: With the FOGBADGE, POKéMON up\nto Level 50 will obey you.\pAlso, any POKéMON that knows\nSURF will be able to use it\lanytime.\pI want you to have this too.$

label: MortyText_ShadowBallSpeech
source: That's SHADOW BALL.\nIt causes damage and may\llower SP. DEF.\pUse it if it suits you.$

label: MortyFightDoneText
source: I see...\pYour journey has taken you to\nfar-off places.\pYou've witnessed more than I\never have.\pI envy you for that...$

label: MortyRematchText
source:
Ah, the JOHTO CHAMPION!
Good of you to come.\pYou've shown strength and skill,
but have you grown since we\llast battled?\pI've trained with my GHOST-type
POKéMON ever since.\pLet's see if you can overcome
the shadows again.\pWant to have a rematch?$

label: Morty_RematchDefeatText
source: I'm not good enough yet...\pYou've witnessed more than I\never have.\pI envy you for that...$

label: SageJeffreySeenText
source: I spent the spring with my\nPOKéMON.\pThen summer, fall, and winter...\pThen spring came again.\nWe've been together a long time.$

label: SageJeffreyBeatenText
source: Wins and losses--I've known\nthem both.$

label: SageJeffreyAfterBattleText
source: Where did POKéMON come from?$

label: SagePingSeenText
source: Can you inflict any damage\non our POKéMON?$

label: SagePingBeatenText
source: Ah! Well done!$

label: SagePingAfterBattleText
source: We use GHOST-type POKéMON.\pNo NORMAL-type attacks can\nharm them!$

label: MediumMarthaSeenText
source: I shall win!$

label: MediumMarthaBeatenText
source: I... I... I lost!$

label: MediumMarthaAfterBattleText
source: The one who wants to win the\nmost is the one who will!$

label: MediumGraceSeenText
source: Stumped by our dark corridors?\nDefeat me if you want a hint!$

label: MediumGraceBeatenText
source: Wha-what?$

label: MediumGraceAfterBattleText
source: Fine. I'll tell you the secret\nof the shadows.\pThe path is right in front of\nyour eyes!$

label: EcruteakCity_GymGuideText
source:
Hey CHAMP! You're almost
halfway there!\pTrainers here use GHOST and
DARK-type POKéMON.\pWhile MORTY is a GHOST-type
expert, be wary of his mystic\ldeer.\pIt's said to cause strange
nightmares...$

label: EcruteakCity_GymGuideWinText
source: Whew, {PLAYER}. You did great!\pI was cowering in the corner\nout of pure terror!$

label: EcruteakCity_GymClosedText
source: MORTY, the GYM LEADER, is\nabsent.\pSorry, but you'll have to\nleave.\pHohohoho.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Silver1
source: THUD!!$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Silver2
source: {RIVAL}: How...? How is this\npossible? How can I lose to mere\lKIMONO GIRLS...?$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Silver3
source:
{RIVAL}: You were watching me,
{PLAYER}...\pYeah, that's right!\pI never thought defeating five
KIMONO GIRLS would be so hard...\pI got beaten to a pulp...\p...\pYou must have come here for the
same reason, right?\pDon't get cocky just because you
defeated TEAM ROCKET!\pThese KIMONO GIRLS are insanely
strong.\pSee if you can defeat them.\pBut I'm not going back, I don't
want to see you win.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Eevee
source: EEVEE: Veee!$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Vulpix
source: VULPIX: Vullll Pix!$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_UnusedMissingDaughter
source: Oh, no. Oh, no…\pMy daughter is missing.\pNo… She couldn't have gone to the\nBURNED TOWER.\pI told her not to go near it…\pPeople seem to disappear there…\pOh, what should I do…?$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Gramps1
source: ECRUTEAK used to have two towers:\none each in the east and west.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Gramps2
source: Ah, child. Have you learned to\ndance like the KIMONO GIRLS?\pIf you go to their DANCE THEATER,\nan odd old man will give you\lsomething nice, I hear.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Lass1
source: I'm going to practice at the DANCE\nTHEATER. Care to join me?$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Lass2
source: The tower that used to be here…\pMy grandma told me it used to be\nmuch taller.\pI hear there are ghosts in it now.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Lass2_ReleasedBeasts
source: Three big POKéMON ran off in different\ndirections. What were they?$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Fisher
source: I heard a rumor about OLIVINE\nLIGHTHOUSE.\pThe POKéMON that serves as the\nbeacon fell ill. Sounds like they\lare in trouble.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Fisher_JasmineReturned
source: The POKéMON at OLIVINE LIGHTHOUSE\nhas been cured.\pBoats can safely sail out to sea at\nnight again.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Youngster
source: I hear POKéMON are rampaging at the\nLAKE OF RAGE. I'd like to see that.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Gramps3
source:
In the distant past…\pThis tower burned in a fire. Three
nameless POKéMON perished in it.\pA rainbow-colored POKéMON descended
from the sky and resurrected them…\pIt's a legend that has been passed
down by ECRUTEAK GYM LEADERS.\pMe?\pI was a trainer way back when.
Hohoho!$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_SageGym
source: Gym Leader MORTY is not here right\nnow. You may find him at the\lBURNED TOWER.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Sign
source: ECRUTEAK CITY\nA Historical City\pWhere the Past Meets the Present$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_TinTowerSign
source: TIN TOWER\pA legendary POKéMON is said to\nroost here.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_OfficeSign
source: Barrier Station to TIN TOWER\pNo Trespassing by the Unworthy.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_GymSign
source: ECRUTEAK CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MORTY\pThe Mystic Seer of the Future$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_DanceTheaterSign
source: ECRUTEAK DANCE THEATER$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_BurnedTowerSign
source: BURNED TOWER\pIt was destroyed by a mysterious\nfire.\pPlease stay away, as it is unsafe.$

label: EcruteakLugiaSpeechHouse_Text_Gramps
source: This happened when I was young.\pThe sky suddenly turned black. A\ngiant flying POKéMON was blocking\lout the sun.\pI wonder what that POKéMON was?\pIt was like a bird and a dragon.$

label: EcruteakLugiaSpeechHouse_Text_Youngster
source: Is there really a POKéMON that big?\pIf it exists, it must be powerful.$

label: Ecruteak_Text_ItemfinderAdventure
source: Ah. You're on an adventure with\nyour POKéMON?\pWell, what's an adventure without\ntreasure hunting?\pAm I right, or am I right?$

label: Ecruteak_Text_ItemfinderTrueSpirit
source: Good! You understand the true\nspirit of adventure.\pI like that! Take this with you.$

label: Ecruteak_Text_ItemfinderExplanation
source:
There are many items lying about
that aren't obvious.\pUse DOWSING MACHINE to check if there
is an item on the ground near you.\pIt doesn't show the exact spot,
so you'll have to look yourself.\pOh yeah--I heard there are items
in ECRUTEAK's BURNED TOWER.$

label: Ecruteak_Text_ItemfinderToEachHisOwn
source: Oh… To each his own, I suppose…$

label: Ecruteak_Text_ItemFinderMan
source: ECRUTEAK is a very old city.\nMany generations passed down\ltheir history in books like these.$

label: Ecruteak_Text_HistoryBook
source: HISTORY OF ECRUTEAK\pWant to read it?$

label: Ecruteak_Text_TwoTowers
source:
In ECRUTEAK, there were two towers.\pEach tower was the roost of
powerful flying POKéMON.\pBut one of the towers burned to
the ground.\pThe two POKéMON haven't been seen
since…\pKeep reading?$

label: Ecruteak_Text_ThreeMon
source:
ECRUTEAK was also home to three
POKéMON that raced around the town.\pThey were said to have been born
of water, lightning and fire.\pBut they could not contain their
excessive power.\pSo they say the three ran like the
wind off into the grassland.$

label: EcruteakMart_Text_SuperNerd
source: My EEVEE evolved into an ESPEON.\pBut my friend's EEVEE turned into\nan UMBREON.\pI wonder why? We both were raising\nour EEVEE in the same way…$

label: EcruteakMart_Text_Granny
source: If you use REVIVE, a POKéMON that's\nfainted will wake right up.$

label: EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Bill1
source: Hi, I'm BILL. And who are you?\pHmm, {PLAYER}, huh?\nYou've come at the right time.$

label: EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Bill2
source:
I just finished adjustments on my
POKéMON STORAGE SYSTEM.\pYou know that PC you use to store
all your POKéMON?\pI developed that myself!\pNow that I've installed this one,
my PC is running at all\lPOKéMON CENTERS in JOHTO and KANTO.\pI have to hurry on back to
GOLDENROD and see my folks. Feel\lfree to visit anytime!\pBuh-bye!$

label: EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_PokefanM
source: The way the KIMONO GIRLS dance is\nmarvelous.\pJust like the way they use their\nPOKéMON.$

label: EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_PokefanM_Mobile
source: You must be hoping to battle more\npeople, right?\pThere's apparently some place where\ntrainers gather.\pWhere, you ask?\pIt's a little past OLIVINE CITY.$

label: EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_CooltrainerF
source: MORTY, the GYM LEADER, is soooo\ncool.\pHis POKéMON are really tough too.$

label: EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_GymGuide
