label: LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HotSpringCanInvigorate
source: It's sort of magical how just sitting\nin a hot-spring pool can invigorate.\pI wish I could let my POKéMON\nsoak, too.$

label: LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainersShouldRestToo
source: Hohoho! Hey, kid, you can reach\nthe hot springs from here.\pIf POKéMON are getting rest, so too\nshould their TRAINERS.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_DoYouBelieveInGhosts
source: Do you believe in ghosts?$

label: LavenderTown_Text_SoThereAreBelievers
source: Really?\nSo there are believers…$

label: LavenderTown_Text_JustImaginingWhiteHand
source: Hahaha, I guess not.\pThat white hand on your shoulder…\nI'm just imagining it.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_TownKnownAsMonGraveSite
source: This town is known as the grave\nsite of POKéMON.\pMemorial services are held in\nPOKéMON TOWER.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_GhostsAppearedInTower
source: Ghosts appeared in POKéMON TOWER.\pI think they're the spirits of\nPOKéMON that the ROCKETS killed.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_TownSign
source: LAVENDER TOWN\nThe Noble Purple Town$

label: LavenderTown_Text_SilphScopeNotice
source: New SILPH SCOPE!\nMake the Invisible Plain to See!\pSILPH CO.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_VolunteerPokemonHouse
source: LAVENDER VOLUNTEER\nPOKéMON HOUSE$

label: LavenderTown_Text_PokemonTowerSign
source: POKéMON TOWER\nBecalm the Spirits of POKéMON$

label: LavenderTown_Text_PokefanM
source: That's quite some building, eh?\pIt's KANTO's RADIO TOWER.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_Teacher
source: KANTO has many good radio shows.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_Gramps
source: People come from all over to pay\ntheir respects to the departed\lsouls of POKéMON.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_Youngster
source: You need a POKé FLUTE to wake\nsleeping POKéMON.\pEvery trainer has to know that!$

label: LavenderTown_Text_Sign
source: LAVENDER TOWN\pThe Noble Purple Town$

label: LavenderTown_Text_KantoRadioStationSign
source: KANTO RADIO STATION\pYour Favorite Programs On-Air\nAround the Clock!$

label: LavenderTown_Text_VolunteerPokemonHouseSign
source: LAVENDER VOLUNTEER POKéMON\nHOUSE$

label: LavenderTown_Text_SoulHouseSign
source: SOUL HOUSE\pMay the Souls of POKéMON Rest\nEasy$

label: LavenderTown_House1_Text_Cubone
source: CUBONE: Kyarugoo!$

label: LavenderTown_House1_Text_RocketsKilledCubonesMother
source: Those horrible ROCKETS!\nThey deserve no mercy!\pThat poor CUBONE's mother…\pIt was killed trying to escape from\nTEAM ROCKET.$

label: LavenderTown_House1_Text_GhostOfPokemonTowerIsGone
source: The ghost of POKéMON TOWER is\ngone!\pSomeone must have soothed its\nrestless spirit!$

label: LavenderTown_House1_Text_Girl
source: Can you believe it?\pSome people get bored with taking\ncare of POKéMON.\pGRANPDA takes in such poor homeless\nPOKéMON and takes care of them.$

label: LavenderTown_House1_Text_Guy
source: MR. FUJI does live here but he's\naway now. He should be at the\lSOUL HOUSE.$

label: LavenderTown_House1_Text_Marowak2
source: The MAROWAK is quiet, though it\nappears quite happy.$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_WantMeToRateNicknames
source: Hello, hello!\nI am the official NAME RATER!\pWant me to rate the nicknames of\nyour POKéMON?$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_CritiqueWhichMonsNickname
source: Which POKéMON's nickname should\nI critique?$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_GiveItANicerName
source: {STR_VAR_1}, is it?\nThat is a decent nickname!\pBut, would you like me to give it\na nicer name?\pHow about it?$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_WhatShallNewNicknameBe
source: Ah, good. Then, what shall the new\nnickname be?$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_FromNowOnShallBeKnownAsName
source: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!\pIt is a better name than before!\nHow fortunate for you!$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_ISeeComeVisitAgain
source: I see.\nDo come visit again.$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_FromNowOnShallBeKnownAsSameName
source: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!\pIt looks no different from before,\nand yet, this is vastly superior!\pHow fortunate for you!$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_TrulyImpeccableName
source: {STR_VAR_1}, is it?\nThat is a truly impeccable name!\pTake good care of {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_ThatIsMerelyAnEgg
source: Now, now.\nThat is merely an EGG!$

label: LavenderSpeechHouse_Text_PokefanF
source: LAVENDER is a tiny, quiet town at\nthe foot of the mountains.\pIt's gotten a bit busier since\nthe RADIO TOWER was built.$

label: LavenderTown_Mart_Text_SearchingForStatRaiseItems
source:
I'm searching for items that raise
the stats of POKéMON.\pThey're effective over the course
of a single battle.\pX ATTACK, X DEFEND, X SPEED, 
and X SPECIAL are what I'm after.\pDo you know where I can get them?$

label: LavenderTown_Mart_Text_DidYouBuyRevives
source: Did you buy some REVIVES?\nThey revive any fainted POKéMON!$

label: LavenderTown_Mart_Text_TrainerDuosCanChallengeYou
source: Sometimes, a TRAINER duo will\nchallenge you with two POKéMON\lat the same time.\pIf that happens, you have to send\nout two POKéMON to battle, too.$

label: LavenderTown_Mart_Text_SoldNuggetFromMountainsFor5000
source: この　あいだ　やまおくで\nきんのたまを　ひろい　ましてね！\pつかえない　しなもの　ですが\nうったら　なんと　5000¥でした$

label: LavenderMart_Text_PokefanM
source: REPEL is a necessity if you are\ngoing to explore a cave.\pEven though I like exploring,\nI still haven't made it to all\lthe caves.$

label: LavenderMart_Text_Rocker
source: I heard about a craftsman who\nmakes custom BALLS in the JOHTO\ltown of AZALEA.\pI wish I had some.$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RocketsDoAnythingForMoney
source: TEAM ROCKET will do anything for\nthe sake of money!\pThere is no job too dirty, no deed\ntoo heinous, no crime too wicked!$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CubonesMotherKilledByRockets
source: I saw CUBONE's mother trying to\nescape from TEAM ROCKET.\pShe was killed trying to get away…$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PeoplePayForCuboneSkulls
source: You know how the CUBONE species\nwears skulls, right?\pPeople will pay a lot for one.$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Gentleman
source: To the north of LAVENDER is ROCK\nTUNNEL. Go through it to get to\lthe POWER PLANT.$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Teacher
source:
There's a radio program that plays
POKé FLUTE music.\pOh? Ah, your radio needs a RADIO
UPGRADE to tune into it.\pMaybe the RADIO STATION here
in town can provide you one?$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Youngster
source: If the POWER PLANT isn't running,\nthe MAGNET TRAIN won't run either…\pIt also means the RADIO STATION\ncan't broadcast…$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Youngster_ReturnedMachinePart
source: The DIRECTOR of the RADIO STATION\nsure was happy.\pHe said they're back on the air\nbecause the POWER PLANT is running\lsmoothly again.$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_Receptionist
source: Welcome! Feel free to look around\nanywhere on this floor.$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_Officer
source: Sorry, but you can only tour the\nground floor.\pEver since JOHTO's RADIO TOWER\nwas taken over by a criminal gang,\lwe have had to step up our\lsecurity.$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_SuperNerd1
source: Many people are hard at work here\nin the RADIO TOWER.\pThey must be doing their best to\nput on good shows.$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_Gentleman
source: Oh, no, no, no!\pWe've been off the air ever since\nthe POWER PLANT shut down.\pAll my efforts to start this\nstation would be wasted if I can't\lbroadcast.\pI'll be ruined!$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_Gentleman_ReturnedMachinePart
source:
Ah! So you're the {PLAYER} who
solved the POWER PLANT's problem?\pThanks to you, I never lost my
job.\pI tell you, you're a real
lifesaver!\pPlease take this as my thanks.$

label: LavendertownRadioStation_Text_Upgraded_Radio
source: {PLAYER} obtained the\nRADIO UPGRADE!$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_Gentleman_GotExpnCard
source: With that thing, you can tune into\nthe radio programs here in KANTO.\pGahahahaha!$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_SuperNerd2
source: Hey there!\pI am the super MUSIC DIRECTOR!\pmy music programs. How unfortunate!\pIf you get an EXPN CARD upgrade,\nyou can tune in. You'd better get\lone!$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_SuperNerd2_GotExpnCard
source: Hey there!\pI am the super MUSIC DIRECTOR!\pI'm responsible for the gorgeous\nmelodies that go out over the air.\pDon't be square. Grab your music\noff the air!$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_Directory
source: 1F RECEPTION 2F SALES\p3F PERSONNEL 4F PRODUCTION\p5F DIRECTOR'S OFFICE$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_PokeFluteSign
source: Perk Up POKéMON with Mellow\nSounds of the POKé FLUTE on\lCHANNEL 20$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_ReferenceLibrary
source: Wow! A full rack of POKéMON CDs\nand videos.\pThis must be the reference\nlibrary.$

label: MrFuji_Text_Main
source:
MR.FUJI: Welcome.\pHmm… You appear to be raising
your POKéMON in a kind and\lloving manner.\pPOKéMON lovers come here to pay
their respects to departed\lPOKéMON.\pPlease offer condolences for the
souls of the departed POKéMON.\pI'm sure that will make them
happy.$

label: SoulHouse_Text_Teacher
source: There are other graves of POKéMON\nhere, I think.\pThere are many chambers that only\nMR.FUJI may enter.$

label: SoulHouse_Text_Lass
source: I came with my mom to visit\nPOKéMON graves…$

label: SoulHouse_Text_Granny
source: The POKéMON that lived with me…\pI loved them like my\ngrandchildren…$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HearMrFujiNotFromAroundHere
source: I recently moved to this town.\pI hear that MR. FUJI's not from\nthese parts originally, either.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_WhereDidMrFujiGo
source: That's odd, MR. FUJI isn't here.\nWhere'd he go?$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_MrFujiWasPrayingForCubonesMother
source: MR. FUJI had been praying alone\nfor CUBONE's mother.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_MrFujiLooksAfterOrphanedMons
source: This is really MR. FUJI's house.\pHe's really kind.\pHe looks after abandoned and\norphaned POKéMON.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_MonsNiceToHug
source: It's so warm!\nPOKéMON are so nice to hug.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_Nidorino
source: NIDORINO: Gaoo!$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_Psyduck
source: PSYDUCK: Gwappa!$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_IdLikeYouToHaveThis
source:
MR. FUJI: {PLAYER}…\pYour POKéDEX quest is one that
requires strong dedication.\pWithout deep love for POKéMON,
your quest may fail.\pI'm not sure if this will help you,
but I'd like you to have it.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_ReceivedPokeFluteFromMrFuji
source: {PLAYER} received a POKé FLUTE\nfrom MR. FUJI.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_ExplainPokeFlute
source: Upon hearing the POKé FLUTE,\nsleeping POKéMON will spring awake.\pTry using it on POKéMON that are\nsleeping obstacles.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_MustMakeRoomForThis
source: You must make room for this!$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_HasPokeFluteHelpedYou
source: MR. FUJI: Has my POKé FLUTE\nhelped you?$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_GrandPrizeDrawingClipped
source: POKéMON FAN MAGAZINE\nMonthly Grand Prize Drawing!\pThe application form is…\pGone! It's been clipped out.\nSomeone must have applied already.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_PokemonMagazinesLineShelf
source: POKéMON magazines line the shelf.\pPOKéMON INSIDER…\pPOKéMON FAN…$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayShoppingLetsBattle
source:
MAY: Oh, hey?
{PLAYER}{KUN}, are you shopping, too?\pI bought a whole bunch of DOLLS and
POSTERS.\pOf course, I've also caught a lot of
POKéMON, and I'm raising them\lproperly, too.\pActually, I'm more worried if you're
raising POKéMON properly, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pI'll battle with you, so you can show
me your POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayNotRaisingPokemon
source: MAY: Oh, why? {PLAYER}{KUN}, haven't you\nbeen raising your POKéMON?\pThat's not a very good showing as a\nTRAINER…$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayBattleMe
source: MAY: Come on, battle with me, so I can\ncheck out your POKéMON!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayWontBeBeaten
source: MAY: The POKéMON I raised won't be\nbeaten by your POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayDefeat
source: … … … … … … … …\pI remember the battle I had with you,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, on ROUTE 103.\pThat battle helped you become this\nstrong, {PLAYER}{KUN}, didn't it?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayGoingBackToLittleroot
source: MAY: I'm thinking of going back to\nLITTLEROOT soon.\pI've caught a decent group of POKéMON,\nand my POKéDEX is coming along, so\lI'm going home to show my dad.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToCollectBadges
source: {PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do?\pCollect all the GYM BADGES and take\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?\pWell, while you're collecting BADGES,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'm going to work on my\lPOKéDEX. I'll complete it before you!\pSee you!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToPokemonLeague
source:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do?\pAre you taking the POKéMON LEAGUE
challenge?\pOr, are you going to complete your
POKéDEX?\pI might've lost to you in battling,
but I'll finish my POKéDEX before you!\pSee you!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToBattleFrontier
source:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do?\pAre you taking the BATTLE FRONTIER
challenge?\pOr, are you going to complete your
POKéDEX?\pI might've lost to you in battling,
but I'll finish my POKéDEX before you!\pSee you!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanShoppingLetsBattle
source: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, it's {PLAYER}.\pI'm running an errand for my dad.\nNo, I'm not buying any DOLLS.\pAnyways, it's been a while.\pWant to have a battle to see who's been\nraising POKéMON better?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanNoConfidence
source: BRENDAN: Oh, what's the matter?\nDon't have the confidence?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanBattleMe
source: BRENDAN: Want to battle to see who's\nbeen raising POKéMON better?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanWontBeBeaten
source: BRENDAN: Aww, but you know I'm not\ngoing to lose to no {PLAYER}.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanDefeat
source: Humph…\nYou've done a lot of raising.\pThat stings a bit--I had a head start\non you as a TRAINER…$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanGoingBackToLittleroot
source: BRENDAN: I…\nI plan on going home to LITTLEROOT.\pYou know I'm helping out my dad on his\nPOKéDEX. It's coming together pretty\ldecently, so I should go show him.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToCollectBadges
source: {PLAYER}, what are you going to do?\pCollect all the GYM BADGES and take\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?\pMaybe I'll do that, too…\pWell, anyway, hang in there!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToPokemonLeague
source: {PLAYER}, what are you going to do?\pSince you're that strong, are you\ntaking the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?\pHeh, even me--if I trained my POKéMON\na bit more, I should be stronger than\lyou, {PLAYER}.\pWell, anyway, hang in there!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToBattleFrontier
source:
{PLAYER}, what are you going to do?\pAre you taking the BATTLE FRONTIER
challenge?\pOr, are you going to complete your
POKéDEX?\pSince you're that strong, you should
consider the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pHeh, if I train my POKéMON a bit more,
I'll get stronger than you, {PLAYER}.\pMaybe I should go to the BATTLE
FRONTIER.\pWell, anyway, hang in there!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MovedLootIntoHideoutToday
source: Fufufu…\pWe moved more loot into our secret\nHIDEOUT today…\pWh-who are you?!\nI was just talking to myself!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ChanceToDoBigThings
source:
I'm just a GRUNT, so I don't know what
the BOSS is thinking…\pBut being on TEAM AQUA, I know I'll get
the chance to do big things!\pWh-who are you?!
I was just talking to myself!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_DontGoNearCaveInCove
source: Hey, you!\pDon't go near the cave in the cove!\pWhy? You don't need a reason why!\nI'm an adult, so you just listen to me!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_IfWorldBecomesOurs
source: If this whole wide world becomes ours,\nTEAM AQUA's, it will be a happier\lplace for POKéMON, too.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_WailmerLeapOutOfWater
source: There! WAILMER!\nLeap out of the water now!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_GetLostMessingUpTraining
source: Hunh? What do you want?\pYou're messing up our training,\nso can you, like, get lost?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ContestHallInTown
source: There's a POKéMON CONTEST HALL\nright in this here town. \pThat means well-raised POKéMON will\ncome from all over the country.\pMy heart swells with excitement!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_StrangeCaveInCove
source: Have you seen that strange cave in\nthe cove at the edge of town?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_GoingToMoveDeleterForHMs
source: I'm going to teach my POKéMON some new\nmoves for entering a CONTEST.\pSo, I'm going to see the MOVE DELETER\nand make it forget HM moves.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ImFromKanto
source: I came from KANTO.\pThe HOENN region is beautiful with\nall its water and verdant nature.\pHunh? Wait a second…\pCould there be rare POKéMON that live\nonly in this area?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaBeenTrainingWailmer
source: TEAM AQUA's been training their\nWAILMER in the cove.\pWe SAILORS can't get our boats out\nto sea with them in the way!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SomeonePuntedTeamAquaOut
source: Ahoy, did you know?\pSomeone punted TEAM AQUA out of\nthe way for us!\pThat got the WAILMER out of the cove,\nso we can get our boats out again.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SomeoneStoleMyPokemon
source: I was taking a relaxing snooze at the\nseaside inn to the sound of waves…\pWhen someone stole my POKéMON!\pWho's the abductor?\nTEAM AQUA? Is it TEAM AQUA?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MissingPokemonCameBack
source: My missing POKéMON…\nIt came back without me noticing!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ImArtDealer
source: I'm an ART DEALER.\pI am a buyer and seller of fine art,\nespecially paintings.\pI've heard that the MUSEUM here has\nmagnificent works on exhibit…$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SeaRemainsForeverYoung
source: Even as we grow old and wrinkled,\nthe sea remains forever young with\lthe vivid brilliance of life…\pFwohoho fwohohohoho…$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SixtyYearsAgoHusbandProposed
source: It was sixty years ago that my husband\nproposed to me here.\lThe sea remains as beautiful as ever.\pMufufufu mufufufufufu…$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaRenovatedCavern
source:
Hm, you know of the peculiar cavern
in this cove?\pThat had been a natural formation,
but then that TEAM AQUA lot came\lalong and made their renovations.\pThey call themselves
the “nature-loving TEAM AQUA”!\pBut what they do and what they say
don't match at all!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaLotGoneForGood
source: That cave in the cove…\pI didn't notice it right away,\nbut it's completely empty now.\pThat TEAM AQUA lot, they must\nhave gone away for good.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_CitySign
source: LILYCOVE CITY\p“Where the land ends and the\nsea begins.”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ContestHallSign
source: POKéMON CONTEST HALL\n“The gathering place for TRAINERS!”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MotelSign
source: COVE LILY MOTEL\p“Remember us as COVE LILY of\nLILYCOVE.”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MuseumSign
source: LILYCOVE MUSEUM\p“POKéMON Masterpiece Collection\non exhibit!”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MuseumSignPlayersExhibit
source: LILYCOVE MUSEUM\p“{PLAYER}'s POKéMON Collection\non exhibit!”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HarborSignUnderConstruction
source: LILYCOVE CITY HARBOR\p“The ferry S.S. TIDAL is under\nconstruction in SLATEPORT CITY.\p“Service is scheduled to begin\nshortly.”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HarborSign
source: LILYCOVE CITY HARBOR\p“Enjoy a delightful cruise on\nthe ferry S.S. TIDAL.”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TrainerFanClubSign
source: POKéMON TRAINER FAN CLUB\pThe names of TRAINERS are scribbled\nall over the sign…$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_DepartmentStoreSign
source: LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE\p“Overflowing with great merchandise\nand excitement!\p“A great place to find that something\nyou need!”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MoveDeletersHouseSign
source: MOVE DELETER'S HOUSE\p“Unwanted POKéMON moves deleted.”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_DoYouKnowAboutBerryBlender
source: Do you know about the machine\nBERRY BLENDER?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_FasterSpinBetterPokeblocks
source: People have to work together to get it\nto spin faster.\pThe faster you can make it spin, the\nbetter {POKEBLOCK}S you can get, I've heard.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ExplainBerryBlender
source: It's used for making a kind of candy\ncalled a {POKEBLOCK}.\pIf you give a good {POKEBLOCK} to a POKéMON,\nits condition will improve by a lot.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HeardTowerCalledSkyPillar
source: I heard there's a tower somewhere out\non the sea routes.\pIt's called the SKY PILLAR, I hear.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SawTallTowerOnRoute131
source: I saw this tall tower somewhere\naround ROUTE 131.\pCould that possibly be…?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_JustArrivedAndSawRarePokemon
source:
We just arrived here on our
honeymoon vacation.\pWe happened to see a DRAGON-type
POKéMON flying way up in the sky.\pDo cool POKéMON like that live in
the HOENN region?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HoneymoonVowToSeeRarePokemon
source: On our honeymoon, we vowed to see as\nmany rare POKéMON as we can.\pSo we were delighted to see a rare\nPOKéMON as soon as we arrived.\pI mean, we are totally happy!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_TodayWonSmartnessContest
source: This POKéMON won the BEAUTY CONTEST\nhere before.\pWell, guess what? Today, I made it\nwin a SMARTNESS CONTEST!\pMy abilities scare even me…$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredBunchOfContests
source:
I've entered a bunch of CONTESTS,
so I'm seeing how things work.\pIf you're in a COOLNESS CONTEST,
cool moves go over as appeals.\pBut smart moves and cute moves
don't go over well, for instance.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ManWhoWonEarlierHadPokeblocks
source: That young man who won earlier had\na whole bunch of different {POKEBLOCK}S.\pCan you win if you had that many\nof those things?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IsntThisPlaceHumongous
source: Whoa, isn't this place humongous!\pThe tension in the air… It's not\nlike a CONTEST hall in the sticks.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GiveItBestSmartAppeal
source: MC: Okay, SMART POKéMON and their\nTRAINERS, are you ready?!\pGive it your best showing!\nLet's appeal!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnjoyingThisContest
source: JUDGE: Are you enjoying this CONTEST?\pCome back with three friends, and\nall of you may enter a CONTEST!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredWrongContest
source:
Ayayayay…
I entered the wrong CONTEST.\pI entered this tough POKéMON in
the SMARTNESS CONTEST…\pCome on, wow them with a smart-looking
ROCK SMASH.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeSmart
source: I've spent many a year, and all my\nwisdom besides, raising this POKéMON\lto be smart.\pIt won't be easily bested by some\nyoung pup's POKéMON.\pMy dear wife, are you seeing this?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IfMonPullsSmartMoveNext
source: There it is!\pIf my POKéMON pulls a smart move next,\nthe audience's excitement will peak!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_DontAppreciateCuteLeechLife
source: Oh, dear, no!\pMy darling ZUBAT's LEECH LIFE is so\ncute I kept using it over and over!\pBut these mean people don't appreciate\nit at all!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_YoureBeautifulGrandpa
source: Kiyaaah! You're beautiful, Grandpa!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AllSeemToUseDifferentMoves
source: Even when TRAINERS enter the same\nkind of POKéMON, they all seem to use\ldifferent moves for appeals.\pIt's just like the way people have\ndifferent styles for battling.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonSmarterThanTrainers
source: I think the POKéMON look smarter\nthan their TRAINERS. By a lot.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_StillLoveSmartnessContests
source: When all's said and done, I still love\nSMARTNESS CONTESTS.\pThat intellectual green color…\nIt's so… So… Cool.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnteringBeautyContest
source: MC: Are you entering the BEAUTY\nCONTEST, too? Good luck!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EveryPokemonPristineBeauty
source: JUDGE: Ah, every POKéMON here is\na model of pristine beauty!\pWhy, I almost forgot to score them!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EyesWillBeGluedToMyBeauty
source: A POKéMON this beautiful…\nThere isn't another one like it.\pEveryone's eyes will be glued to\nmy beauty.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGrooming
source: Waaaah!\pI brushed and groomed my POKéMON\ncarefully for this CONTEST…\pBut I overdid it…\nMy POKéMON's coat turned all scraggly…\pWhat should I do?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWontSeeAuroraBeam
source: This AURORA BEAM is so dazzling,\nthe JUDGE won't be able to see it.\pUh, wait a second…\nThat'll be meaningless, then!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonLooksLikeYoungerMe
source: This pretty POKéMON looks just like\nme when I was younger.\pRight when I said that, my husband\nspewed the coffee he was drinking.\pDid I say something funny?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WinBeautyContestMakesMeHappy
source: You know, if I win at a BEAUTY\nCONTEST, sure it makes me\lhappy. More than usual, anyway.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GanderAtAllThosePrettyPokemon
source: Wahahahah!\pWill you take a gander at all those\npretty POKéMON!\lI just love this sort of glitz!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CantWinOnBeautyAlone
source: You can't always win on just beauty\nalone.\pYou have to groom your POKéMON so\nit's nice and glossy like mine.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_InTheMiddleOfContest
source: MC: Uh-oh! Hello!\nWe're in the middle of a CONTEST!\pPlease enter at our registration\ncounter and come out, okay?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SuchCharmingCuteAppeals
source: JUDGE: Oh, such charming and cute\nappeals!\pOh, my goodness! What a perfectly\nadorable WATER SPORT appeal!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyAzurillWasDistracted
source: Oh, no… My sweet AZURILL was\ndistracted by another POKéMON.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_NeverWonBattleButContest
source: My POKéMON has never won in a battle,\nbut put it in a CONTEST and look out!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PetalDanceIsMarvel
source: My POKéMON's PETAL DANCE is a marvel\nof elegance.\pI won't let anyone disturb its\nperformance.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonAppealSoMuchCuter
source: Everyone's POKéMON are very cute.\pHowever, if my POKéMON were to make\na cute appeal…\pI'm sure that it would be so much \ncuter than the others.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyChildIsInContest
source: My child is in this CONTEST.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ComeOnDear
source: Come on, dear. Go for it!\nYour POKéMON is the best!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ThatGirlThereIsCutest
source: I think that girl over there is\nthe cutest of the lot.\pWhat's that? They're judging\nPOKéMON by their looks?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WantCuteMonOfMyOwn
source: Ohh, seeing all these cute POKéMON,\nthey make we want to get my own!\pI'm going to go catch some!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_BeautyContestStage
source: BEAUTY CONTEST STAGE\nBE ALLURED BY BEAUTIFUL POKéMON!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CuteContestStage
source: CUTENESS CONTEST STAGE\nBE CHARMED BY CUTE POKéMON!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SmartContestStage
source: SMARTNESS CONTEST STAGE\nBE IMPRESSED BY SMART POKéMON!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_TodayWonSmartnessContest_hns
source: This POKéMON won the BEAUTY CONTEST\nhere before.\pWell, guess what? Today, I made it\nwin a SMARTNESS CONTEST!\pMy abilities scare even me…$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredBunchOfContests_hns
source:
I've entered a bunch of CONTESTS,
so I'm seeing how things work.\pIf you're in a COOLNESS CONTEST,
cool moves go over as appeals.\pBut smart moves and cute moves
don't go over well, for instance.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ManWhoWonEarlierHadPokeblocks_hns
source: That young man who won earlier had\na whole bunch of different {POKEBLOCK}S.\pCan you win if you had that many\nof those things?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IsntThisPlaceHumongous_hns
source: Whoa, isn't this place humongous!\pThe tension in the air… It's not\nlike a CONTEST hall in the sticks.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GiveItBestSmartAppeal_hns
source: MC: Okay, SMART POKéMON and their\nTRAINERS, are you ready?!\pGive it your best showing!\nLet's appeal!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnjoyingThisContest_hns
source: JUDGE: Are you enjoying this CONTEST?\pCome back with three friends, and\nall of you may enter a CONTEST!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredWrongContest_hns
source:
Ayayayay…
I entered the wrong CONTEST.\pI entered this tough POKéMON in
the SMARTNESS CONTEST…\pCome on, wow them with a smart-looking
ROCK SMASH.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeSmart_hns
source: I've spent many a year, and all my\nwisdom besides, raising this POKéMON\lto be smart.\pIt won't be easily bested by some\nyoung pup's POKéMON.\pMy dear wife, are you seeing this?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IfMonPullsSmartMoveNext_hns

source: Make {POKEBLOCK}S and put them in there.\pWhen you make a {POKEBLOCK}, everyone\nhas to put in a different BERRY.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_YourPokemonSpurredMeToPaint
source: Congratulations!\pI did a painting of your POKéMON to\ncommemorate its victory…\pWell, your POKéMON's appeals were\nso fantastic, it spurred me into\lpainting better than I usually do.\lLook, see?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ShouldITakePaintingToMuseum
source:
What do you think? I'm confident in
what I've done, but do you like it?\pA work of this caliber, it wouldn't look
out of place in an art museum.\pHuh? An art museum really is looking
for paintings?\pDo you think I should take this there?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_IllTakePaintingToMuseum
source:
What, really? Then, sure, I will take
this painting there right now.\pI'll give it a proper title, too.\pI hope they'll like it and consider
exhibiting this.\pPlease check if they did accept this.
Thank you!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeMementoOfPainting
source: Oh, that's right!\pAs a memento of me painting your\nPOKéMON, please take this.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ReceivedARibbon
source: {PLAYER} received a RIBBON.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PutTheRibbonOnMon
source: {PLAYER} put the RIBBON on\n{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_OkaySeeYou
source: Okay, see you!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeHomeButIdLikeToTakeToMuseum
source: Oh… Then, I guess I'll just take\nthis home with me…\pBut, you know, I would like to take\nthis to the art museum… Okay?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_FineThatsTheWayItIs
source: Oh, fine, that's the way it is.\nI will hang this in my own house.\pI'll just have to try harder next time.\nWell, be seeing you.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MasterRankHereICome
source: Hoo, boy… Master Rank CONTESTS,\nhere I come.\pThe world will know that my dearest\nPOKéMON is the cutest being in all\lexistence. The time has come!\lUheheheh.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WholeVarietyOfPokemonHere
source: You can see a whole variety of\nPOKéMON here.\pThat's why I make this place a regular\npart of my daily stroll.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ContestFeastForEyes
source: Wow, coming out to a CONTEST is\na feast for these eyes!\pWould you look at all the POKéMON\nthat just scream to be painted?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ToughContestIsExtreme
source: The TOUGHNESS CONTEST is like\nextreme, man!\pThose muscular appeals…\nCascading sweat… I swoon!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LavishedCareOnMon
source: Day in and day out, I lavished my care\non this POKéMON.\pIts condition is peaking.\nToday, victory is mine!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MadePokeblocksWithFamily
source: I made {POKEBLOCK}S with Mom, Dad, and\nBig Sister. They turned out great!\pI bet you can make smoother, better\n{POKEBLOCK}S if you have more people.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_GuestsDoubledByMascot
source:
Hm, so they doubled the guests by
using POKéMON as attractions?\pHm, well, maybe I should make a cute
POKéMON our inn's mascot.\pI wonder if that will attract more
guests to stay with us?$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_NoGuestsWithTeamAqua
source: Oh, sorry, sorry!\nI was too involved in watching TV!\pSince that TEAM AQUA came to town,\nthe tourists have been staying away.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_CantSeeTheTV
source: Hey, down in front!\nI can't see the TV!$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_MonFoundLostItem
source:
Amazing! You're telling me a POKéMON
found someone's lost item?\pThat's something. If we had some smart
POKéMON like that…\pWe could recover anything that our
guests mislaid…$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HeardAquaHideoutBusted
source:
Oh, sorry, sorry!
I was too involved in watching TV!\pI heard that someone busted
the TEAM AQUA HIDEOUT.\pThanks to that, we just booked
a reservation from a big group.\pIt was a company called… Uh…
GAME something…$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HouseSittingMonCaughtBurglar
source:
Amazing! A house-sitting POKéMON
caught a burglar?\pThat's something. If we had a tough
POKéMON as a security guard…\pWe would be able to provide our guests
with greater safety.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_BetterGetWorkingOnGuestsDinner
source:
Oh, sorry, sorry!
I was too involved in watching TV.\pOh, yes. A big group of guests arrived
a little while ago.\pThey booked in as GAME FREAK,
so I guess they must make games.\pUh-oh, I'd better get working on
their dinner!$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ShowMeCompletedDex
source:
I'm the GAME DESIGNER.\pOh, is that right?
You're working on a POKéDEX?\pIt's tough trying to complete it,
but don't give up.\pIf you do complete it, please come
show me.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_FilledPokedexGiveYouThis
source:
Wow! That's awesome!
Yep, it's totally awesome!\pThis POKéDEX is completely filled!
You really must love POKéMON!\pI'm so impressed!\pLet me give you something in
recognition of your feat!$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ImTheProgrammer
source: Me? You're talking to me?\nI'm the PROGRAMMER.\pI wonder what the SLOTS are\nlike here.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ImTheGraphicArtist
source: I'm the GRAPHIC ARTIST! Aren't the\nPOKéMON of HOENN interesting?$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_GirlsAreCute
source: The girl TUBERS, they're cute, hey?\nTo battle against a cute TUBER…\pWhoop, it's so awesome!\pAnd the TWINS! Aren't they cute?\nA 2-on-2 battle with TWINS…\pWhoop, it's unbearably fun!$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_SeaBreezeTicklesHeart
source: The sea breeze tickles my heart.\nIt feels wonderful here!$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_NeverLeaveWithoutGameBoy
source: You never know when and where\npeople will challenge you.\pThat's why I never leave home without\nmy GAME BOY ADVANCE.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_SnoozingPreferBattles
source:
SCOTT: … … … … …
… … … … … Zzz…\p… … … … … Huh?!
Oh, sorry, sorry! I was snoozing!\pI came to check out this POKéMON
CONTEST thing.\pI have to admit, it does look quite
entertaining, but…\pConsider me a purist--I prefer
battles and tough TRAINERS.\pBut that's just me.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I hope you'll enjoy everything
like the GYMS, CONTESTS, BATTLE TENT,\lthe whole works!$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ContestsDoTakeStrategy
source: SCOTT: I think it does take strategy\nto win a CONTEST.\pDevising CONTEST strategies is one way\nof becoming a better TRAINER, I'd say.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_SetDatesForClearOutSales
source: Don't they have set dates for their\nclear-out sales?\pI watch TV, but they never show any\ncommercials.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_BeenWaitingForClearOutSale
source: Yes! I've been waiting a long time for\nthis clear-out sale.\pThey have items that you can only get\nhere. I'm going to load up, that I am!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_BoneDryThirsty
source: Ohh… I'm bone-dry thirsty!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_WhichDrinkWouldYouLike
source: It's a VENDING MACHINE.\nWhich drink would you like?$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_CanOfDrinkDroppedDown
source: Clang!\pA can of {STR_VAR_1} dropped down.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_ExtraCanOfDrinkDroppedDown
source: Clang!\pScore! An extra can of {STR_VAR_1}\ndropped down!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_NotEnoughMoney
source: Not enough money…$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_DecidedAgainstBuyingDrink
source: Decided against buying a drink.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WelcomeToDeptStore
source: Welcome to LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_IBuyAllSortsOfThings
source: Whenever I come to the DEPARTMENT\nSTORE, I always end up buying all sorts\lof things because it's so fun.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_MomBuyingMeFurniture
source: Today, my mom is going to buy me some\nnice furniture.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_BuyingSomethingForAzumarill
source: I'm buying something for my AZUMARILL\nas a reward for winning a CONTEST.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Azumarill
source: AZUMARILL: Maririroo!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
source: 1F: SERVICE COUNTER\n    LOTTERY CORNER\p2F: TRAINER'S ZONE\p3F: BATTLE COLLECTION\p4F: TM CORNER\p5F: POKé DOLL FLOOR\pROOFTOP: ROOFTOP PLAZA$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WirelessCommIsFun
source:
Wireless Communication is a
lot of fun, isn't it?\pI think it lets you do things that
weren't possible before.\pFor instance, you can now trade
with people you couldn't before.\pI think it's going to be exciting!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_SpreadWordAboutWirelessComm
source: I want to spread the word about how\nfun Wireless Communication can be.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_LearnToUseItemsProperly
source: Learn to use items properly.\nThat's basic, really.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_GoodGiftForHusband
source: My husband is waiting at home.\nWhat would make a good gift for him?$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_StockUpOnItems
source: I'm leaving on a long journey soon.\nI need to stock up on items.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_ItemsBestForTougheningPokemon
source: For quickly toughening up POKéMON,\nitems are the best.\pPROTEIN boosts ATTACK,\nand CALCIUM raises SP. ATK.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_WantMoreEndurance
source: I want my POKéMON to have more\nendurance.\pI'm trying to decide whether to raise\nDEFENSE with IRON, or SP. DEF with ZINC.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_GaveCarbosToSpeedUpMon
source: I gave a CARBOS to my POKéMON,\nand its SPEED went up.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_AttackOrDefenseTM
source: Hmm…\pAn attacking move…\nOr a defensive move…\pIt's no easy matter to decide which TM\nmoves should be taught to POKéMON…$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_FiftyDifferentTMs
source: There are so many different kinds of\nTM moves.\pA catalog I read said there are fifty\ndifferent kinds.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_PokemonOnlyHaveFourMoves
source: I'd like to get all the different TMs,\nbut a POKéMON learns only four moves.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_PlaceFullOfCuteDolls
source: This place is full of cute DOLLS.\pI should buy some for me, instead of\njust for my children.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_GettingDollInsteadOfPokemon
source: I'm not big enough to raise POKéMON,\nso I'm getting a cute DOLL instead.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_SellManyCuteMatsHere
source: They sell many cute MATS here.\pI wonder which one I should get?\nMaybe I'll buy them all…$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_ClosedRooftopForWeather
source: I think they closed the rooftop\nbecause the weather is wild today.$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_FerryUnavailable
source: I beg your pardon?\nYou're looking for a ship?\pI'm sorry, the ferry service isn't\navailable at present…$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
source: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_NoTicket
source: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…\pI'm terribly sorry.\pYou must have a TICKET to board\nthe ferry.$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_FlashTicketWhereTo
source: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.\pPerfect! That's all you need!\pAnd where would you like to go?$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailAnotherTime
source: Please sail with us another time!$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SlateportItIs
source: SLATEPORT CITY it is, then!$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_BattleFrontierItIs
source: BATTLE FRONTIER it is, then!$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_PleaseBoard
source: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
source: Then, where would you like to go?$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryUnavailable
source: Until they finish making the ferry,\nwe sailors have nothing to do…\pI wish they'd get a move on, the folks\nat the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT.$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryAvailable
source: The ferry S.S. TIDAL is finally in\noperation.\pThe folks at the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT\nmust've worked extra hard.\pWell, it's my turn to get busy now!$

label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_PokemonPartnersNotTools
source: POKéMON are partners to people.\nThey aren't our tools.\pUnfortunately, there are some people\nwho fail to understand that…$

label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_Kecleon
source: KECLEON: Ruroro?$

label: LilycoveCity_House2_Text_NotAwakeYetHaveThis
source: Huh? What? What's that?\pI'm not near awake yet…\nYou can have this…$

label: LilycoveCity_House2_Text_SleepIsEssential
source: Yawn…\pSleep is essential for good health…\nSleep and regain health…$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LearnFromMasterOfPokeblocks
source:
Oh, my, my! Are you traveling alone?
But you're so young! Good for you!\pI'm sure my kids could learn a thing
or two from you!\pMe? I'm a master of {POKEBLOCK}S.\pIf I get serious just a little, why,
I can concoct great {POKEBLOCK}S.\pWould you like to learn from me,
a master of {POKEBLOCK}S?$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_OhAreYouSure
source: Oh? Are you sure?\pYou shouldn't always try to do\neverything by yourself, dear!$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
source:
Oh, good! You're a smart soul!
This is a bit long, so listen up!\pAre you ready?\pIf you look at {POKEBLOCK}S, you should see
that they are rated on how they feel.\pThe lower the feel rating,
the better it is. Don't forget this!\pA good {POKEBLOCK} has a low feel
rating and a high level.\pA POKéMON can eat more good
{POKEBLOCK}S than ordinary ones, too.\pAnd this is important.\pIf you want to make smooth {POKEBLOCK}S,
use different kinds of BERRIES.\pDon't be stingy--the kinds of BERRIES
affect the smoothness of {POKEBLOCK}S.\pAnd another thing.\pThe more people blending BERRIES,
the smoother the {POKEBLOCK}S.\pThat's why you should talk to other
people and make {POKEBLOCK}S together.\pThat's about all you need to know to
make good {POKEBLOCK}S.\pIf everyone had POKéMON they love,
smooth {POKEBLOCK}S, and a loving family,\lthe world would be a happier place.\pDon't give up, dear!$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_HappyToHaveQuadruplets
source: When my wife gave birth to quadruplets,\nyou bet I was shocked.\pBut, now, seeing them play together,\nit makes me happy.$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_GoingToWinMultiBattles
source: We're having MULTI BATTLES, but I know\nI'm going to win.$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LikeMixingAtRecordCorner
source: We like mixing stuff at\nthe RECORD CORNER.\pBut what gets mixed up?$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_MakePokeblocksWithBerryBlender
source: We're going to make super {POKEBLOCK}S\nwith a BERRY BLENDER!$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_GoingToEnterContest
source: I want to brag about how tough my\nPOKéMON is, so we're going to enter\la CONTEST together.$

label: LilycoveCity_House4_Text_MysteriesAtBottomOfSea
source: This planet's biggest mysteries are\nat the bottom of the sea.\pSomebody said that, but I don't know…$

label: LilycoveCity_House4_Text_UnderwaterTrenchMossdeepSootopolis
source: There's a deep underwater trench\nbetween MOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS.\pThat's what someone told me, anyway.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_WelcomeToLilycoveMuseum
source: Welcome to LILYCOVE MUSEUM.\pPlease take the time to enjoy our\ncollection of fantastic artwork\lfeaturing POKéMON.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ImCuratorHaveYouViewedOurPaintings
source:
I'm the CURATOR of this MUSEUM of
fine arts.\pIt's heartening to see someone so
young as you in our MUSEUM.\pHave you viewed our collection of
paintings already?$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_NotDisturbYouTakeYourTime
source: Ah, then let me not disturb you.\nPlease, do take your time.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HaveYouAnInterestInPaintings
source: Oh? I do believe that you seem to\nbe a POKéMON TRAINER.\pHave you an interest in paintings,\ntoo?$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HonoredYoudVisitInSpiteOfThat
source: I see…\pI'm honored that you would visit\nus in spite of that.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ExcellentCanYouComeWithMe
source: Ah, excellent!\nYou do like paintings!\pThen, may I ask you to come with me?$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_VeryOldPainting
source: It's a very old painting.\nThe paint is peeling here and there.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_OddLandscapeFantasticScenery
source: It's an odd landscape with bizarre\nand fantastic scenery.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfBeautifulWoman
source: It's a painting of a beautiful, smiling\nwoman with a POKéMON on her lap.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfLegendaryPokemon
source: It's a painting of a legendary POKéMON\nfrom long ago.\pThe artist painted this from\nimagination.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfGrassPokemon
source: It's a painting of GRASS POKéMON\nswaying in a breeze.\pThey appear to be enjoying the wind's\ngentle caress.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfBerries
source: It's a delicious-looking painting\nof BERRIES.\pThis painting could make you hungry!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_Text_BirdPokemonSculptureReplica
source: It's a replica of a famous sculpture.\pIt depicts an ancient BIRD POKéMON.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_BigPokeBallCarvedFromStone
source: It's a big POKé BALL carved from\na black stone.\pIt was apparently used in festivals\nin the olden days.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_StoneTabletWithAncientText
source: It's a huge stone tablet inscribed\nwith POKéMON and dense text in the\lsmall characters of an ancient,\lunreadable language.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_WorksOfMagnificence
source: Hmmm…\nWhat works of great magnificence…$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MustntForgetLoveForFineArts
source: Battling with POKéMON is fun,\nI'll grant you that.\pBut one mustn't forget our love for\nthe fine arts.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisMuseumIsInspiration
source: This ART MUSEUM… Well, you could\nsee many fantastic paintings.\pAnd the CURATOR is a wonderful person.\pAmong artists like myself, this MUSEUM\nis an inspiration.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisLadyIsPretty
source: This lady is pretty!\nShe's like Mommy!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisPokemonIsAdorable
source: This POKéMON is adorable!\nJust like our little boy!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HeardMuseumGotNewPaintings
source: I'd heard that this ART MUSEUM got\nin some new paintings.\pSo, naturally I hurried over.\pAre the new paintings up on\nthe second floor?$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_CuratorHasBeenCheerful
source: Lately, the CURATOR has been\nunusually cheerful.\pI bet something good happened for him.\nDefinitely.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_AimToSeeGreatPaintings
source: I aim to see many great paintings\nhere and learn from them.\pI have this dream of one day having\nmy artwork exhibited here.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MuseumTouristDestination
source:
The ART MUSEUM has become a favorite
tourist destination.\pIt's great for LILYCOVE…
No, great for the HOENN region!\pThis is what I've heard--a lone TRAINER
procured all the paintings upstairs.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThisIsExhibitHall
source: This is our special exhibit hall.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
source:
As you can plainly see, there is not
a single painting on exhibit.\pHere, I don't wish to exhibit works of
so-called classical art.\pSuch classical works you can see on
our ground floor.\pI wish to exhibit work that is far
different from the classics.\pArt, after all, is not restricted to old,
famous works!\pThis exhibit hall, I wish to fill it with…\pModern and vibrant artworks of
POKéMON seemingly ready to spring\lforth into glorious life!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PleaseObtainPaintingsForExhibit
source:
I beg your pardon. I didn't intend
to monopolize the conversation.\pNow, as you are young, and yet
obviously well traveled…\pYou must encounter lively POKéMON
and works of art depicting them.\pIf you were to come across such
a painting, may we ask you to obtain\lthe artist's permission to exhibit\lit here?$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_WishToFillExhibit
source: I wish to fill this exhibit hall with\nmodern and vibrant paintings of\lPOKéMON.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThanksAddedNewPainting
source: Thanks to you, we've added a new\npainting to our collection!\pI've heard it depicts your POKéMON.\nTruly magnificent!\pThank you so very, very much!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsYouPlayer
source: Ah! It's you!\n{PLAYER}!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PaintingsAttractedMoreGuests
source:
Isn't this marvelous?
This collection of paintings!\pEach one of them flawless!
None better than another!\pThese paintings have attracted
more guests to our ART MUSEUM.\pSincerely, I thank you, {PLAYER}.
This is my dream come true!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_TokenOfGratitude
source: This is merely a token of my gratitude.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_KeepThisForYou
source: I will keep this for you until we\nmeet again.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_HonorToHaveYouVisit
source: Ah, so good to see you, {PLAYER}!\pIt's an honor to have you visit us\non your busy journeys.\pPlease, relax and do enjoy your\nvisit with us.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsPinkPictureFrame
source: It's a picture frame with pink-colored\nadornments.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsYellowPictureFrame
source: It's a picture frame with\nyellow-colored adornments.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsBluePictureFrame
source: It's a picture frame with\nblue-colored adornments.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsRedPictureFrame
source: It's a picture frame with\nred-colored adornments.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsGreenPictureFrame
source: It's a picture frame with\ngreen-colored adornments.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsPaintingOfPokemon
source: It's a painting of POKéMON.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsSurprisedMe
source: I've been away awhile, so the new\npaintings up here surprised me.\pI wish someone would paint my POKéMON\nthis pretty.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsRatherAmusing
source: Well… So this is where they show\nthe topical POKéMON paintings.\pI see, these new paintings are indeed\nrather amusing.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThesePaintingsOfYourPokemon
source: Wow, is that right?\nThese paintings are of your POKéMON.\pIsn't that just the ultimate joy for\na TRAINER?$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ICanMakeMonForgetMove
source: Uh…\nOh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.\pI can make POKéMON forget their moves.\pWould you like me to do that?$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_WhichMonShouldForget
source: Which POKéMON should forget a move?$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_WhichMoveShouldBeForgotten
source: Which move should be forgotten?$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonOnlyKnowsOneMove
source: {STR_VAR_1} knows only one move\nso it can't be forgotten…$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonsMoveShouldBeForgotten
source: Hm! {STR_VAR_1}'s {STR_VAR_2}?\nThat move should be forgotten?$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonHasForgottenMove
source: It worked to perfection!\p{STR_VAR_1} has forgotten\n{STR_VAR_2} completely.$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ComeAgain
source: Come again if there are moves that\nneed to be forgotten.$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_EggCantForgetMoves
source: What?\nNo EGG should know any moves.$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_CantForgetSurf
source: Hm!\pYour {STR_VAR_1} doesn't seem willing\nto forget SURF.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HowManyKindsOfPokemon
source: I wonder how many kinds of POKéMON\nthere are in the world.\pIt'd be great to cross seas and\ntrade POKéMON with people far away.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HeardAboutRottenScoundrels
source: I've been hearing about some rotten\nscoundrels who steal POKéMON and rip\loff METEORITES.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HaventSeenRottenScoundrels
source: Those rotten scoundrels who steal\nPOKéMON and rip off METEORITES…\pI haven't seen them around recently.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OhWowItsPlayer
source: Oh, wow!\nIt's {PLAYER}!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HeardAboutYouImYourFan
source:
I've heard the news!
You're really strong, aren't you?\pWe always argue about who is the
strongest of all TRAINERS here.\pSo when I heard about you, I decided
to be your fan!\pI hope you'll keep on battling other
tough TRAINERS.\pThat way, we'll be able to see more
of your hot, hot battles.\pThat will make the others here see
exactly how great you are.\pRemember, I'm cheering for you,
{PLAYER}!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YoureOneWeWantToWin
source: Yo, {PLAYER}!\nYou're the one we want to win!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OthersDontKnowYoureTheBest
source: The others, they don't know that\nyou're the best of the best!\pIsn't that right, {PLAYER}?\nShow them you've got guts!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainersPowerIsOutOfTheOrdinary
source: I hate to say this, but the TRAINER\neverybody's talking about is\l{STR_VAR_1}, no question about it!\pThat TRAINER's power…\nIt's out of the ordinary.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerIsBestNoOneWantsToListen
source: Darn it… I've been telling people\nthat {STR_VAR_1} is the best now…\pBut no one wants to listen…$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HearingAboutToughNewTrainer
source:
I've been hearing things about
a tough new TRAINER.\pThis TRAINER's supposed to be beating
GYM LEADERS, even.\pDo you know anything about this
new TRAINER?$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImPullingForYou
source: Oh!\n{PLAYER}!\pGo for it!\nI'm pulling for you!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BrawlyNoImYourFan
source:
Sigh…
BRAWLY…\pOh, no! Wait!
That's not right! No, no, no!\pI'm your fan through and through!\pSo make me proud!
Go for it!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ICantHelpLikingBrawly
source: I can't help it, I can only get to\nlike BRAWLY…$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NobodyUnderstandsBrawly
source: Nobody understands the charm of\nBRAWLY…\pI don't care!\pEven if I'm the only one, I'm going\nto keep cheering for BRAWLY!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_MyFavoriteTrainerIsBrawly
source: Whatever anyone says, my favorite\nTRAINER is DEWFORD's GYM LEADER\lBRAWLY!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouveSurpassedYourFather
source: You've surpassed your own father in\nevery regard!\pI'm telling you, so there's no question\nabout it at all!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourFatherNeverGaveUpSoKeepOnBattling
source: Even when things turned bleak,\nyour father never gave up.\pThis I know to be true.\pYou never give up even if you lose!\nSo keep on battling!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_LongWayToGoComparedToNorman
source:
NORMAN battled with more power,
charisma, and showmanship than you.\pEven though people may say that
you're strong…\pYou've still got a long way to go
compared to your father.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouAndNormanAreDifferent
source:
You're beginning to get the same
air of awe NORMAN exudes.\pBut there's something conclusively
different between you and NORMAN.\pI can't tell you what that is.
You'll have to find it yourself.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WeDiscussStrongestTrainers
source:
Everyone here, we're all huge fans
of POKéMON battles.\pWe discuss who we consider to be
the strongest of all TRAINERS.\pIf you were to become famous,
we might even become your fans!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OhWoweeItsPlayer
source: Oh, woweee! It's {PLAYER}!\nFor real, too!\pPlease, shake my hand, shake my hand!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_AlwaysCheerForYou
source:
I'll always cheer for you, {PLAYER}!
Always, always!\pI don't want to see you lose ever,
{PLAYER}.\pBecause I know you're really,
really strong, {PLAYER}!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_EveryoneThinksTrainerIsCool
source: {STR_VAR_1} is really cool…\pEveryone thinks so, right, right?$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerIsReallyCoolItsJustMe
source: {STR_VAR_1} really is cool, don't\nyou think so?\pEven if it's just me, I'm going to keep\ncheering my favorite TRAINER.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WishThereWasTrainerLikeThat
source: My favorite TRAINER is…\pCool…\pStrong…\pAnd really nice…\pI wish there was a TRAINER like that…$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WantToBeStrongLikeYou
source: Whoa! It's {PLAYER}!\nWicked!\pWhen I grow up, I want to be strong\nlike you, {PLAYER}!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OnlyOneWhoCheersForYou
source: Even if I'm the only one…\pYou'll always be the only one\nI cheer for, {PLAYER}!\pBecause I believe in you, {PLAYER}!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerIsWickedlyCool
source: {STR_VAR_1} is so wickedly cool…\nI want to shake hands with my hero.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NeverGoingToStopBeingTrainersFan
source: Even if I'm the only one…\pI'm never going to stop being\n{STR_VAR_1}'s fan!\pBecause I've heard, {STR_VAR_1}\nnever loses!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YoureAmazingAfterAll
source: {PLAYER}!\nYou are amazing after all!\pEver since I set eyes on you,\nI knew that you were great.\pIt looks like my eyes didn't deceive me.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImInYourCorner
source: Who cares about the others.\nI'm in your corner!\pYou don't need to worry. Just get\nout there and battle like always.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ThinkTrainerIsNumberOne
source:
You're a pretty decent TRAINER,
I think.\pBut I also think that {STR_VAR_1}
is number one right now.\pThat's just my opinion.
Don't worry about it too much.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YoureMaybeStrongerThanTrainer
source: Wow, you really are strong.\nMaybe even stronger than {STR_VAR_1}.\pBut {STR_VAR_1} needs me.\pIf I don't cheer for {STR_VAR_1},\nwho will?$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouChangedMyMind
source: You've changed my mind!\nYou are strong, aren't you?\pI'd like you to tell me how you managed\nto get so strong!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouBattleAttractivelyInToughSituation
source: The tougher the situation, the more\nattractively you battle.\pI can't wait for your next battle!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerIsStandout
source: Among the recently hot TRAINERS,\n{STR_VAR_1} is the standout.\pThat toughness, it's simply not normal.\pYou're doing okay, but you're not in\nthe same class as {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NoOneCanKnockYouButTrainerStronger
source: You are really popular…\pYou're strong, and you're caring to\nPOKéMON. No one can knock you.\pBut, you know, I believe in {STR_VAR_1}.\p{STR_VAR_1} is definitely stronger!\nI'm positive!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouImpressive
source: You…\pImpressive!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OnlyIRecognizeYourTrueWorth
source: Your true worth, it is fine if only\nI recognized it.\pThe others I doubt will understand\nthe hidden power that beats within.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HaventRealizedPotential
source: Yes, I see strength in your eyes.\pBut!\pYou still haven't realized your\npotential.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourePowerfulButNotTrueStrength
source:
It is true that you are tremendously
powerful.\pBut!
I can tell…\pThat strength cannot be considered
true strength yet!\pTrue strength is…!
… …\pActually, I have no idea, either.$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
source:
MOM: {PLAYER}, we're here, honey!\pIt must be tiring riding with our things
in the moving truck.\pWell, this is LITTLEROOT TOWN.\pHow do you like it?
This is our new home!\pIt has a quaint feel, but it seems to be
an easy place to live, don't you think?\pAnd, you get your own room, {PLAYER}!
Let's go inside.$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WaitPlayer
source: MOM: Wait, {PLAYER}!$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
source:
MOM: {PLAYER}! {PLAYER}! Did you
introduce yourself to PROF. BIRCH?\pOh! What an adorable POKéMON!
You got it from PROF. BIRCH. How nice!\pYou're your father's child, all right.
You look good together with POKéMON!\pHere, honey! If you're going out on an
adventure, wear these RUNNING SHOES.\pThey'll put a zip in your step!$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_SwitchShoesWithRunningShoes
source: {PLAYER} switched shoes with the\nRUNNING SHOES.$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
source:
MOM: {PLAYER}, those shoes came with
instructions.\p“Press the B Button while wearing these
RUNNING SHOES to run extra-fast!\p“Slip on these RUNNING SHOES and race
in the great outdoors!”$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ComeHomeIfAnythingHappens
source:
… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pTo think that you have your very own
POKéMON now…\lYour father will be overjoyed.\p…But please be careful.
If anything happens, you can come home.\pGo on, go get them, honey!$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanUsePCToStoreItems
source: If you use a PC, you can store items\nand POKéMON.\pThe power of science is staggering!$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSpendsDaysInLab
source: PROF. BIRCH spends days in his LAB\nstudying, then he'll suddenly go out in\lthe wild to do more research…\pWhen does PROF. BIRCH spend time\nat home?$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_IfYouGoInGrassPokemonWillJumpOut
source: Um, um, um!\pIf you go outside and go in the grass,\nwild POKéMON will jump out!$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_DangerousIfYouDontHavePokemon
source: It's dangerous if you don't have\nyour own POKéMON.$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
source:
Um, hi!\pThere are scary POKéMON outside!
I can hear their cries!\pI want to go see what's going on,
but I don't have any POKéMON…\pCan you go see what's happening
for me?$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_YouSavedBirch
source: You saved PROF. BIRCH!\nI'm so glad!$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_GoodLuckCatchingPokemon
source: Are you going to catch POKéMON?\nGood luck!$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_TownSign
source: LITTLEROOT TOWN\n“A town that can't be shaded any hue.”$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ProfBirchsLab
source: PROF. BIRCH'S POKéMON LAB$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_PlayersHouse
source: {PLAYER}'s HOUSE$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ProfBirchsHouse
source: PROF. BIRCH'S HOUSE$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
source:
PROF. BIRCH: Well, well, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
That was good work out there!\pI knew there was something special
about you when I first saw you,\lbut I never expected this.\pOh, yes. Do you still have the POKéDEX
I gave you?\pI have something to show you.
Let's go to my LAB.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsntItNiceInHere
source: MOM: See, {PLAYER}?\nIsn't it nice in here, too?$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MoversPokemonGoSetClock
source:
The mover's POKéMON do all the work
of moving us in and cleaning up after.\lThis is so convenient!\p{PLAYER}, your room is upstairs.
Go check it out, dear!\pDAD bought you a new clock to mark
our move here.\lDon't forget to set it!$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ArentYouInterestedInRoom
source: MOM: Well, {PLAYER}?\pAren't you interested in seeing your\nvery own room?$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoSetTheClock
source: MOM: {PLAYER}.\pGo set the clock in your room, honey.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_OhComeQuickly
source: MOM: Oh! {PLAYER}, {PLAYER}!\nQuick! Come quickly!$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MaybeDadWillBeOn
source: MOM: Look! It's PETALBURG GYM!\nMaybe DAD will be on!$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ItsOverWeMissedHim
source: MOM: Oh… It's over.\pI think DAD was on, but we missed him.\nToo bad.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoIntroduceYourselfNextDoor
source: Oh, yes.\nOne of DAD's friends lives in town.\pPROF. BIRCH is his name.\pHe lives right next door, so you should\ngo over and introduce yourself.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_SeeYouHoney
source: MOM: See you, honey!$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DidYouMeetProfBirch
source: MOM: Did you introduce yourself to\nPROF. BIRCH?$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_YouShouldRestABit
source: MOM: How are you doing, {PLAYER}?\nYou look a little tired.\pI think you should rest a bit.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TakeCareHoney
source: MOM: Take care, honey!$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GotDadsBadgeHeresSomethingFromMom
source: MOM: Oh? Did DAD give you that BADGE?\pThen here's something from your MOM!$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DontPushYourselfTooHard
source: Don't push yourself too hard, dear.\nYou can always come home.\pGo for it, honey!$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsThatAPokenav
source: MOM: What is that, honey? A POKéNAV?\nSomeone from DEVON gave it to you?\pWell, honey, how about registering\nyour mom?\p… … …$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_RegisteredMom
source: Registered MOM\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_Vigoroth1
source: Fugiiiiih!$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_Vigoroth2
source: Huggoh, uggo uggo…$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ReportFromPetalburgGym
source: INTERVIEWER: …We brought you this\nreport from in front of PETALBURG GYM.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TheresAMovieOnTV
source: There is a movie on TV.\pTwo men are dancing on a big piano\nkeyboard.\pBetter get going!$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_RunningShoesManual
source:
It's the instruction booklet for the
RUNNING SHOES.\p“Press the B Button to run while
wearing your RUNNING SHOES.\p“Lace up your RUNNING SHOES and hit
the road running!”$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TicketFromBrineyCameForYou
source:
DAD: Hm?\pHey, it's {PLAYER}!\pIt's been a while since I saw you,
but you look…stronger, somehow.\pThat's the impression I get.
But your old man hasn't given up yet!\pOh, yes, I have something for you.
This came to you from someone named\lMR. BRINEY.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_PortsInSlateportLilycove
source: DAD: Hm, a TICKET for a ferry?\pIf I recall, there are ferry ports in\nSLATEPORT and LILYCOVE.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_BetterGetBackToGym
source: I'd better get back to PETALBURG GYM.\pMOM, thanks for looking after the house\nwhile I'm away.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DadShouldStayLonger
source: MOM: That DAD of yours…\pHe comes home for the first time in a\nwhile, but all he talks about is POKéMON.\pHe should relax and stay a little longer.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsThatABreakingStory
source: MOM: Is that a breaking news story?$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LatiEmergencyNewsFlash
source:
We bring you this emergency
news flash!\pIn various HOENN locales, there have
been reports of a BZZT…colored\lPOKéMON in flight.\pThe identity of this POKéMON is
currently unknown.\pWe now return you to the regular
movie program.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_WhatColorDidTheySay
source: MOM: {PLAYER}, did you catch that?\pWhat color did the announcer say\nthat POKéMON was?$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_StillUnknownPokemon
source: MOM: Well, isn't that something!\nThere are still unknown POKéMON.$

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_ClockIsStopped
source: The clock is stopped…\pBetter set it and start it!$

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_HowDoYouLikeYourRoom
source:
MOM: {PLAYER}, how do you like your
new room?\pGood! Everything's put away neatly!\pThey finished moving everything in
downstairs, too.\pPOKéMON movers are so convenient!\pOh, you should make sure that
everything's all there on your desk.$

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_Notebook
source: {PLAYER} flipped open the notebook.\pADVENTURE RULE NO. 1\nOpen the MENU with START.\pADVENTURE RULE NO. 2\nRecord your progress with SAVE.\pThe remaining pages are blank…$

label: Common_Text_LookCloserAtMap
source: {PLAYER} took a closer look at the\n{REGION} region map.$

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_ItsAGameCube
source: It's a Nintendo GameCube.\pA Game Boy Advance is connected to\nserve as the Controller.$

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_OhYoureTheNewNeighbor
source:
Oh, hello. And you are?\p… … … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … … …\pOh, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}, our new next-door
neighbor! Hi!\pWe have a {STR_VAR_1} about the same
age as you.\pOur {STR_VAR_1} was excited about making
a new friend.\pOur {STR_VAR_1} is upstairs, I think.$

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_LikeChildLikeFather
source: Like child, like father.\pMy husband is as wild about POKéMON\nas our child.\pIf he's not at his LAB, he's likely\nscrabbling about in grassy places.$

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_TooBusyToNoticeVisit
source: That {RIVAL}!\pI guess our child is too busy with\nPOKéMON to notice that you came\lto visit, {PLAYER}{KUN}.$

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_WentOutToRoute103
source: Oh, {RIVAL} went out to ROUTE 103\njust a little while ago.\pLike father, like child.\n{RIVAL} can't stay quietly at home.$

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_ShouldGoHomeEverySoOften
source:
I think it's wonderful for people to
travel with POKéMON.\pBut you should go home every so often
to let your mother know you're okay.\pShe might not say it, but I'm sure she
worries about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.$

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
source:
Huh?
Who… Who are you?\p… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pOh, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}.
So your move was today.\pUm… I'm MAY.
Glad to meet you!\pI…
I have this dream of becoming friends\lwith POKéMON all over the world.\pI… I heard about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}, from
my dad, PROF. BIRCH.\pI was hoping that you would be nice,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, and that we could be friends.\pOh, this is silly, isn't it?
I… I've just met you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pEheheh…\pOh, no! I forgot!\pI was supposed to go help Dad catch
some wild POKéMON!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll catch you later!$

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
source:
Hey!
You…\pWho are you?\pOh, you're {PLAYER}, aren't you?
Moved in next door, right?\pI didn't know that you're a girl.\pDad, PROF. BIRCH, said that our new
next-door neighbor is a GYM LEADER's\lkid, so I assumed you'd be a guy.\pMy name's BRENDAN.
So, hi, neighbor!\pHuh? Hey, {PLAYER}, don't you have
a POKéMON?\pDo you want me to go catch you one?\pAw, darn, I forgot…\pI'm supposed to go help my dad catch
some wild POKéMON.\pSome other time, okay?$

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_DoYouHavePokemon
source: Hi, neighbor!\pDo you already have your\nown POKéMON?$

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
source:
Huh?
Who… Who are you?\p… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pOh, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}.
So your move was today.\pUm… I'm MAY.
Glad to meet you!\pI…
I have this dream of becoming friends\lwith POKéMON all over the world.\pI… I heard about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}, from
my dad, PROF. BIRCH.\pI was hoping that you would be nice,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, and that we could be friends.\pOh, this is silly, isn't it?
I… I've just met you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pEheheh…\pOh, no! I forgot!\pI was supposed to go help Dad catch
some wild POKéMON!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll catch you later!$

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayGettingReady
source: POKéMON fully restored!\nItems ready, and…$

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
source:
Hey!
You…\pWho are you?\pOh, you're {PLAYER}, aren't you?
Moved in next door, right?\pI didn't know that you're a girl.\pDad, PROF. BIRCH, said that our new
next-door neighbor is a GYM LEADER's\lkid, so I assumed you'd be a guy.\pMy name's BRENDAN.
So, hi, neighbor!\pHuh? Hey, {PLAYER}, don't you have
a POKéMON?\pDo you want me to go catch you one?\pAw, darn, I forgot…\pI'm supposed to go help my dad catch
some wild POKéMON.\pSome other time, okay?$

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanGettingReady
source: POKéMON fully restored…\nItems all packed, and…$

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_ItsRivalsPokeBall
source: It's {RIVAL}'s POKé BALL!\pBetter leave it right where it is.$

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayJustCheckingMyPokedex
source:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI was just checking my POKéDEX.\pThere's still a lot of POKéMON that
I've seen but haven't caught.\pAnd there are many others that
I think will evolve.\pI wonder where I should go catch
some POKéMON next?$

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhereShouldIGoNext
source: MAY: I wonder where I should go catch\nsome POKéMON next?\pWouldn't it be funny if we ran into each\nother, {PLAYER}{KUN}?$

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanJustCheckingMyPokedex
source: BRENDAN: Hey, it's {PLAYER}.\pI was just checking out my POKéDEX.\pThere are still many POKéMON that\nI need to catch, I know, but this\lis looking pretty good.\pChecking this POKéDEX out gives me\nthe urge to hit the road again.$

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhereShouldIGoNext
source: BRENDAN: I'm having a hard time deciding\nwhere I should catch POKéMON next.\pHey, {PLAYER}, if I see you while I'm out\ncatching POKéMON, I can pitch you a\lbattle if you'd like.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchAwayOnFieldwork
source:
Hunh? PROF. BIRCH?\pThe PROF's away on fieldwork.
Ergo, he isn't here.\pOh, let me explain what fieldwork is.\pIt is to study things in the natural
environment, like fields and mountains,\linstead of a laboratory.\pThe PROF isn't one for doing desk work.
He's the type of person who would\lrather go outside and experience\lthings than read about them here.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchIsntOneForDeskWork
source: The PROF isn't one for doing desk work.\nHe's the type of person who would\lrather go outside and experience\lthings than read about them here.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchEnjoysRivalsHelpToo
source: PROF. BIRCH is studying the habitats\nand distribution of POKéMON.\pThe PROF enjoys {RIVAL}'s help, too.\nThere's a lot of love there.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_LikeYouToHavePokemon
source:
PROF. BIRCH: So, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pI've heard so much about you from
your father.\pI've heard that you don't have your
own POKéMON yet.\pBut the way you battled earlier,
you pulled it off with aplomb!\pI guess you have your father's blood
in your veins after all!\pOh, yes. As thanks for rescuing me,
I'd like you to have the POKéMON you\lused earlier.\p{PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_WhyNotGiveNicknameToMon
source: PROF. BIRCH: While you're at it, why not\ngive a nickname to that {STR_VAR_1}?$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MightBeGoodIdeaToGoSeeRival
source:
PROF. BIRCH: If you work at POKéMON
and gain experience, I think you'll make\lan extremely good TRAINER.\pMy kid, {RIVAL}, is also studying
POKéMON while helping me out.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, don't you think it might be
a good idea to go see {RIVAL}?$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GetRivalToTeachYou
source: PROF. BIRCH: Great!\n{RIVAL} should be happy, too.\pGet {RIVAL} to teach you what it\nmeans to be a TRAINER.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_DontBeThatWay
source: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, don't be that way.\nYou should go meet my kid.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchRivalGoneHome
source:
PROF. BIRCH: {RIVAL}?
Gone home, I think.\pOr maybe that kid's scrabbling around
in tall grass again somewhere…\pIf you or your POKéMON get tired,
you should get some rest at home.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_HeardYouBeatRivalTakePokedex
source:
PROF. BIRCH: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI heard you beat {RIVAL} on
your first try. That's excellent!\p{RIVAL}'s been helping with my research
for a long time.\p{RIVAL} has an extensive history as
a TRAINER already.\pHere, {PLAYER}{KUN}, I ordered this for my
research, but I think you should have\lthis POKéDEX.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ReceivedPokedex
source: {PLAYER} received the POKéDEX!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ExplainPokedex
source:
PROF. BIRCH: The POKéDEX is a high-tech
tool that automatically makes a record\lof any POKéMON you meet or catch.\pMy kid, {RIVAL}, goes everywhere
with it.\pWhenever my kid catches a rare POKéMON
and records its data in the POKéDEX,\lwhy, {RIVAL} looks for me while I'm out\ldoing fieldwork, and shows me.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CountlessPokemonAwait
source: PROF. BIRCH: Countless POKéMON\nawait you!\pArgh, I'm getting the itch to get out\nand do fieldwork again!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayGotPokedexTooTakeThese
source: MAY: Oh, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nYou got a POKéDEX, too!\pThat's great! Just like me!\nI've got something for you, too!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CatchCutePokemonWithPokeBalls
source:
MAY: It's fun if you can get a lot of
POKéMON!\pI'm going to look all over the place
because I want different POKéMON.\pIf I find any cute POKéMON, I'll catch
them with POKé BALLS!$
