label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OhYourBagsFull
source: Oh? Your BAG's full.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayWhereShouldIGoNext
source: MAY: I wonder where I should go look\nfor POKéMON next?$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanGotPokedexTooTakeThese
source: BRENDAN: Huh…\nSo you got a POKéDEX, too.\pWell then, here.\nI'll give you these.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CatchCoolPokemonWithPokeBalls
source:
BRENDAN: You know it's more fun to
have a whole bunch of POKéMON.\pI'm going to explore all over the place
to find different POKéMON.\pIf I find any cool POKéMON, you bet
I'll try to get them with POKé BALLS.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_HeyYourBagsFull
source: Hey, your BAG's full.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanWhereShouldIGoNext
source: BRENDAN: Where should I look for\nPOKéMON next…$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_SeriousLookingMachine
source: It's a serious-looking machine.\nThe PROF must use this for research.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_PCUsedForResearch
source: It's a PC used for research.\nBetter not mess around with it.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CrammedWithBooksOnPokemon
source: It's crammed with books on POKéMON.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BookTooHardToRead
source: It's a book that's too hard to read.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OtherRegionsUpgradeToNational
source:
PROF. BIRCH: Now…\p{PLAYER}{KUN} and {RIVAL}, I've had the two
of you help me study POKéMON.\pThanks to your help, new facts
are coming to light.\pIt appears that in the HOENN region,
there are also POKéMON from other\lregions.\pIt goes to show how rich and varied
the natural environments of HOENN\lhappen to be.\pThat's why I think it's necessary for
me to upgrade your POKéDEX to\lthe NATIONAL Mode.\pHere, let me see your POKéDEX units.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayUpgradeSoCool
source: MAY: Eheheh!\pIt's so cool that even my POKéDEX\nis getting updated!\pIt's because you went out and caught\nso many POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanYouCanThankMe
source: BRENDAN: I went out all over HOENN\nand checked out POKéMON.\pYou can thank me for getting\nthe NATIONAL Mode POKéDEX.\pYep, you're lucky, {PLAYER}!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OkayAllDone
source: PROF. BIRCH: Okay, all done!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_PokedexUpgradedToNational
source: {PLAYER}'s POKéDEX was upgraded\nto the NATIONAL Mode!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GrassyPatchWaiting2
source:
PROF. BIRCH: But listen.
You've become the CHAMPION,\lbut your POKéMON journey isn't over.\pThere is no end to the road
that is POKéMON.\pSomewhere, there is a grassy patch
that's waiting for you!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayTakeBreakFromFieldwork
source: MAY: I think I'll take a short break\nfrom fieldwork.\pI think I'll help the PROF here for\na while.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanTakeBreakFromFieldwork
source: BRENDAN: For the time being,\nI'm taking a break from fieldwork.\pI'll be helping out the PROF here\nfor a while.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CompletedDexChoosePokemon
source:
PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Let's have a look at your POKéDEX.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pYes, there's no doubt about it.\pYou really have completed the HOENN
region's POKéDEX.\pThat's more than just impressive.\pI have a gift for you.\pConsider it my show of appreciation
for the fantastic work you've done.\pMy gift is a rare POKéMON only found
in another region!\pYou can have any one of these
three POKéMON!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CanHaveAnyOneOfRarePokemon
source: PROF. BIRCH: These are rare POKéMON\nonly found in another region!\pYou can have any one of these\nthree POKéMON!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_YoullTakeCyndaquil
source: PROF. BIRCH: The FIRE POKéMON\nCYNDAQUIL caught your eye!\pYou're as sharp as ever!\pSo the CYNDAQUIL is your choice?$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_YoullTakeTotodile
source: PROF. BIRCH: The WATER POKéMON\nTOTODILE is your choice!\pYou know how to pick a good one.\pSo, you'll take the TOTODILE?$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_YoullTakeChikorita
source: PROF. BIRCH: The GRASS POKéMON\nCHIKORITA is your choice!\pYou sure know what you're doing.\pSo, you'll take the CHIKORITA?$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_TakeYourTimeAllInvaluable
source: PROF. BIRCH: Take your time before\nyou decide.\pThey're all invaluable POKéMON.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_PickedFinePokemon
source: PROF. BIRCH: I see!\nYou picked a fine POKéMON!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ReceivedJohtoStarter
source: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}\nfrom PROF. BIRCH!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_NicknameJohtoStarter
source: Want to give a nickname to\nthe {STR_VAR_1} you received?$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GrassyPatchWaiting
source:
PROF. BIRCH: Listen, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
You've completed the HOENN POKéDEX,\lbut your POKéMON journey isn't over.\pThere is no end to the road
that is POKéMON.\pSomewhere, there is a grassy patch
that's waiting for you!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BetterLeaveOthersAlone
source: You received the promised POKéMON.\nBetter leave the others alone.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_DontHaveAnyRoomForPokemon
source: Oh, you don't have any room for\nthis POKéMON.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayWhatNextImStayingHere
source:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, after this…
What are you going to do?\pAre you going to keep battling
and sharpening your skills?\pOr are you going to try filling
the NATIONAL POKéDEX?\pI'm staying here to help the PROF.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanPreferCollectingSlowly
source: BRENDAN: Rather than collecting\nPOKéMON, I prefer slowly and \lsteadily raising the one I chose.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayHaveYouGoneToBattleFrontier
source: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nHave you gone to that place,\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER?$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanHaveYouGoneToBattleFrontier
source: BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nHave you gone out to that place,\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER?$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ScottAboardSSTidalCall
source:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!\pSCOTT: Hi, hi, {PLAYER}!
It's me, SCOTT.\pI'm aboard the S.S. TIDAL now.
It feels great to be on the sea!\pBy the way…\pThere's this place that I'd like to
invite you to for a visit.\pIf you're interested, board a ferry
at either SLATEPORT or LILYCOVE.\pI'll fill you in on the details when
we meet. I'll be waiting!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!$

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: When TEAM MAGMA has roll call, we get\nimportant guarding assignments in\lthe order that we line up.\pThat's why I'm stuck off in this corner.\nI'm always late to roll call!$

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: I'm always late for training sessions,\ntoo!\pI hate to say it, but I'm wimpy…$

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: Okay, I'll try to put a little more\neffort into things from now on…$

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
source:
Our leader told us to dig into
MT. CHIMNEY, so we dug and dug.\pAnd in the course of digging, we came
across something that blew our minds!\pWhat did we find?\pFuhahaha!
I'll tell you if you beat me!$

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: Arrgh!\nTaken down!$

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: I won't tell you after all.\nYou'll find out when you get there!\pIt'd be better if you saved surprises\nto the end, don't you think?$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Intro
source:
What, what, what?\pOnly TEAM MAGMA members are supposed
to be in here!\pBut you're not dressed in TEAM MAGMA's
uniform…\pYou rouse my suspicion!
Battle with me!$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Defeat
source: Aiyiyi…\nMy pride as a TEAM MAGMA member…$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14PostBattle
source: If you suffer from chills, you should\njoin TEAM MAGMA.$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3Intro
source: Hold it right there!\pYou don't really expect me to keep\nmy trap shut and let you waltz by me?$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3Defeat
source: Ooh wow!\nI concede!$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
source: Maybe it would've been better if I did\njust let you go unchallenged…$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4Intro
source: Ahah!\nAn intruder!$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4Defeat
source: Graaah!$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
source: I've already lost.\pDo I really need to keep running\naround in a circle?$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5Intro
source: Oh, oh!\nAn intruder!$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5Defeat
source: Mutter…$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
source: Actually, I'm no expert at battling…$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15Intro
source: I don't have a bone to pick with you.\nI'm just following orders!$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15Defeat
source: I may have lost, but…$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15PostBattle
source: We dug up something beyond belief!\nAnd, we got the BLUE ORB!\pAll that's left is for our leader to…\nFufufu… Fwahahaha!$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Intro
source: I can't stand heat. Maybe I should've\njoined TEAM AQUA instead…$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Defeat
source: Yeah, I really may not be right for\nTEAM MAGMA…$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
source: Don't you get lonely for the sea\nbeing in a place like this?$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Intro
source: You can hear tremors here sometimes.\pCould it be the volcano rattling?\nOr is it GROU…\pWhoops!\nNo, no, never mind!$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Defeat
source: You're a fiery battler.\nJust like a volcano!$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
source: You just happened to win this time,\nbut that doesn't matter.\pTEAM MAGMA's goal is about to be\nreached!$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8Intro
source: One of our guys was freaking out that\nhe lost his MAGMA EMBLEM…\pWait a minute!\nWas it you who found it?$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8Defeat
source: I'm having trouble believing this…$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8PostBattle
source: I'm getting this feeling that our plan\nis going to end in failure…$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9Intro
source: What did I do to deserve this guard\nposting?\pMy left ear is burning up!$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9Defeat
source: I'm getting heat exhaustion…$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9PostBattle
source: Do you think it's odd that we're wearing\nhoods in this magma-filled volcano?$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16Intro
source:
We joined so we can help our leader
achieve his fantastic vision.\pI don't care if you're with TEAM AQUA
or if you're just some kid passing by.\pNo one interferes with us and gets
away with it!$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16Defeat
source: Oh, no!\nYou're not to be trusted at all!$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16PostBattle
source: Listen to me.\nTEAM MAGMA is right!\pDon't listen to TEAM AQUA.\nDon't believe their lies!$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Intro
source:
I understand everything our leader
says. But you know what?\pDoing stuff like digging up a super-
ancient POKéMON and ripping off\lsomeone's METEORITE…\pI think we're going a little too far.
What do you think?$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Defeat
source: Yeah, I think we are doing something\nwrong somehow.$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10PostBattle
source: You know, losing to you cleared my mind.\pThe next time I see our leader,\nI'm going to ask him about what we do.$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Intro
source: I want to see GROUDON, too, but they\nwon't let me see even its tail…\pIt's got me feeling really frustrated.\pOh, no!\nI blabbed about GROUDON!$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Defeat
source: I guess it's impossible to win if one\ndoesn't have a calm mind…$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11PostBattle
source: I wonder if GROUDON even has a tail?$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Intro
source: Fuhahaha!\nSoon! Very soon!\lOur grand objective will be achieved!$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Defeat
source: Grrr…\nI've come so far, but now this?$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12PostBattle
source: MAXIE, sir!\nAn intruder is headed your way!$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Intro
source: You're not finished yet!\nYou're not getting by me easily!$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Defeat
source: Was I that easy to knock down?$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13PostBattle
source: C-come on, one more match…$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaIntro
source:
Hehehe!
You made it this far, so I'll tell you!\pThat's right!
Up ahead, GROUDON is sleeping!\pMAXIE went to GROUDON just seconds
ago!\pIt's going to awaken real soon!
Hehe! Hehehe!$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaDefeat
source: Taken down again…\nHehe…$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaPostBattle
source: …And while you wasted time with me,\nMAXIE should have awakened GROUDON…$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieAwakenGroudon
source:
MAXIE: GROUDON…\pNothing could awaken you from your
sleep bathed in magma…\pThis BLUE ORB is what you sought.
Wasn't it?\pI have brought you the BLUE ORB.
Let its shine awaken you!\pAnd show me…
Show me the full extent of your power!$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieGroudonWhatsWrong
source: MAXIE: GROUDON!\nWhat's wrong?\pWasn't the BLUE ORB the key?\pGROUDON!\nWhere have you gone…$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieOhItWasYou
source: MAXIE: Oh, so it was you?\pI've seen you poking around uninvited\nhere and there…\pI get it now!\nYou must have pulled a cheap stunt!$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieDefeat
source: What makes you so adept at handling\nPOKéMON?$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGroudon
source:
MAXIE: There has to be some reason
why GROUDON fled…\pThat's what you're trying to say,
aren't you?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pHumph…
You think I didn't know that?\pWith GROUDON gone, there is no longer
any need for this blasted volcano.\pI am going after GROUDON, so this
is where we part!$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: MAHOGANY TOWN POKéMON GYM$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: MAHOGANY TOWN POKéMON GYM\pPRYCE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_PryceIntro
source:
POKéMON have many experiences
in their lives, just like we do.\pI, too, have seen and suffered
much in my life.\pSince I am your elder, let me
show you what I mean.\pI have been with POKéMON since
before you were born.\pI do not lose easily.\pI, PRYCE--the winter trainer--
shall demonstrate my power!$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_PryceImpressed
source: Ah, I am impressed by your\nprowess.\pWith your strong will, I know you\nwill overcome all life's obstacles.\pYou are worthy of this BADGE!$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_ReceivedBadge
source: {PLAYER} received GLACIERBADGE.$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_GlacierBadgeSpeech
source: That BADGE will raise the SPECIAL\nATTACK of POKéMON.\pIt also lets your POKéMON use\nWHIRLPOOL to get across\lreal whirlpools.\pAnd this… This is a gift from me!$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_HailSpeech
source: That TM contains HAIL.\pIt inflicts damage every\nturn for 5 turns.\pIt demonstrates the harshness\nof winter.$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_CherishPokemon
source: When the ice and snow melt,\nspring arrives.\pYou and your POKéMON will be\ntogether for many years to come.\pCherish your time together!$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_PryceRematch
source:
Ah, JOHTO CHAMPION!\pYour skills are indeed
remarkable.\pI am impressed.\pBut even now, there is much to
learn from each other.\pI, PRYCE--the winter trainer--
still have a few tricks left.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_PryceRematchDefeat
source: Ah, yet again I'm impressed by\nyour prowess.\pWith your strong will, I know you\nwill overcome all life's obstacles.$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_Guide
source:
PRYCE is a veteran who has
trained POKéMON for some 50 years.\pHe's got a solid lineup of
POKéMON to cover whatever\lyou bring his way.\pFire is a good place to start,
but watch out for the rain!$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_GuideWin
source: PRYCE is something, but you're\nsomething else!\pThat was a hot battle that\nbridged the generation gap!$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderRonaldSeen
source: I'll freeze your POKéMON,\nso you can't do a thing!$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderRonaldBeaten
source: Darn. I couldn't do a thing.$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderRonaldAfter
source: I think there's a move a\nPOKéMON can use while it's\lfrozen.$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderBradSeen
source: This GYM has a slippery floor.\pIt's fun, isn't it?\pBut hey--we're not playing\ngames here!$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderBradBeaten
source: Do you see how serious we are?$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderBradAfter
source: This GYM is great.\nI love boarding with my\lPOKéMON!$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderDouglasSeen
source: I know PRYCE's secret.$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderDouglasBeaten
source: OK. I'll tell you PRYCE's secret.$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderDouglasAfter
source: The secret behind PRYCE's power…\pHe meditates under a waterfall\ndaily to strengthen his mind\land body.$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_SkierRoxanneSeen
source: To get to PRYCE, our GYM LEADER,\nyou need to think before you skate.$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_SkierRoxanneBeaten
source: I wouldn't lose to you in skiing!$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_SkierRoxanneAfter
source: If you don't skate with precision,\nyou won't get far in this GYM.$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_SkierClarissaSeen
source: Check out my parallel turn!$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_SkierClarissaBeaten
source: No! You made me wipe out!$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_SkierClarissaAfter
source: I shouldn't have been bragging\nabout my skiing…$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_RageCandyBarMerchantTryOne
source: Hiya, kid!\pI see you're new in MAHOGANY TOWN.\pSince you're new, you should try a\nyummy RAGECANDYBAR!\pRight now, it can be yours for just\n¥300! Want one?$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_RageCandyBarMerchantSavorIt
source: Good! Savor it!$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_RageCandyBarMerchantNotEnoughMoney
source: You don't have enough money.$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_RageCandyBarMerchantRefused
source: Oh, fine then…$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_RageCandyBarMerchantSoldOut
source: RAGECANDYBAR's sold out.\pI'm packing up. Don't bother me,\nkiddo.$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_Gramps
source: Are you off to see the GYARADOS\nrampage at the LAKE?$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_GrampsClearedRocketHideout
source: MAGIKARP have returned to LAKE\nOF RAGE.\pThat should be good news for the\nanglers there.$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_Fisher
source: Since you came this far, take the\ntime to do some sightseeing.\pYou should head north and check\nout LAKE OF RAGE right now.$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_Lass
source: Visit Grandma's shop. She sells\nstuff that nobody else has.$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_Sign
source: MAHOGANY TOWN\pWelcome to the Home of the Ninja$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_RagecandybarSign
source: While visiting MAHOGANY TOWN, try\na RAGECANDYBAR!$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_GymSign
source: MAHOGANY TOWN POKéMON GYM\pLEADER: PRYCE\pThe Teacher of Winter's Harshness$

label: ElmPhoneRadioTowerRocketTakeoverText
source:
PROF.ELM: {PLAYER}, how are
things going?\pI called because something weird
is happening with the radio\lbroadcasts.\pThey were talking about TEAM
ROCKET.\p{PLAYER}, do you know anything
about it?\pMaybe TEAM ROCKET has returned.
No, that just can't be true.\pSorry to bug you.
Take care!$

label: MahoganyRedGyaradosHouse_Text_BlackBelt
source: I heard that a red GYARADOS appeared\nat the LAKE.\pThat's odd, since even ordinary\nGYARADOS are rare in that lake…$

label: MahoganyRedGyaradosHouse_Text_Teacher
source: My favorite radio program? I'd say\nPOKéMON MUSIC.$

label: MahoganyRedGyaradosHouse_Text_Teacher_Rockets
source: I've been hearing laughter on the\nradio…\pIt's creepy.$

label: MahoganyTown_PokemonCenter_Text_PokefanM
source: What's this? TEAM ROCKET has come\nback?\pI saw some men in black at LAKE OF\nRAGE…$

label: MahoganyTown_PokemonCenter_Text_Youngster
source: I stop my POKéMON from evolving too\nearly.\pI make them learn certain moves\nbefore I let them evolve.$

label: MahoganyTown_PokemonCenter_Text_CooltrainerF
source: POKéMON do become stronger when they\nevolve,\pbut they also learn moves more\nslowly.$

label: MahoganyTown_Shop_Text_Granny
source: Please come back another time.\nThe store is... closed\lright now.$

label: MahoganyMart1F_Text_Pharmacist_Lance
source: ROCKETS have hijacked my basement!$

label: MahoganyMart1F_Text_BlackBelt
source: Heheh! The experi- ment worked like\na charm.\pMAGIKARP are just worthless, but\nGYARADOS are big moneymakers.$

label: MahoganyMart1F_Text_BlackBelt_Lance
source: Urrgh…\pThat guy's POKéMON are tough…$

label: MahoganyMart1F_Text_Lance_HyperBeam
source: LANCE: DRAGONITE, HYPER BEAM.$

label: MahoganyMart1F_Text_Lance_Radio
source: What took you, {PLAYER}?\pJust as we thought, that strange\nradio signal is coming from here.$

label: MahoganyMart1F_Text_Lance_Stairs
source: Excellent work finding the stairs,\nDRAGONITE!$

label: MahoganyMart1F_Text_Lance_SplitUp
source: LANCE: {PLAYER}, we should split up\nto check this place.\pI'll go first.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleHesTooPeppy
source: UNCLE: It's because of POKéMON that\nthis boy's got more pep, I suppose…\lBut he's become a bit too peppy…$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWantToChallengeGym
source: WALLY: Aww, UNCLE, please?\pI want to challenge this GYM and see\nhow much better I've become.\pPlease? May I, please?$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleYourePushingIt
source: UNCLE: Now hold on, WALLY.\pSince you started living with POKéMON,\nyou have grown quite a lot stronger.\pBut don't you think you're pushing it\nto suddenly challenge a GYM?$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWeCanBeatAnyone
source: WALLY: I'm not pushing it.\pIf I combine forces with RALTS,\nwe can beat anyone!$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWillYouBattleMe
source:
WALLY: Oh! Hi, {PLAYER}!\pI've gotten a lot stronger since
we met.\p{PLAYER}, I want you and my UNCLE to
understand that.\p{PLAYER}, please, will you have
a battle with me?$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyMyUncleWontKnowImStrong
source: WALLY: Oh… If you won't battle me,\n{PLAYER}, my UNCLE won't know that I've\lbecome really strong.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleCanYouBattleWally
source: UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, was it?\nOn WALLY's behalf, can I ask you to\lbattle with him just this once?\pI don't think he's going to listen to\nany reason the way he is now.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyPleaseBattleMe
source: WALLY: {PLAYER}, please!\nBattle with me, please.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyHereICome
source: WALLY: {PLAYER}, thank you.\pOkay… Here I come!$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyIllGoBackToVerdanturf
source: WALLY: UNCLE…\nI'll go back to VERDANTURF…$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ThankYouNotEnoughToBattle
source: {PLAYER}, thank you.\nBeing a TRAINER is tough, isn't it?\pIt's not enough just to have POKéMON\nand make them battle. That isn't what\lbeing a real TRAINER is about.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleNoNeedToBeDown
source:
UNCLE: WALLY, there's no need to be so
down on yourself.\pWhy, what's keeping you from becoming
stronger and stronger?\pCome on, let's go home.
Everyone's waiting for you.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleVisitUsSometime
source: UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, it just dawned on me\nthat you must be the TRAINER who kept\lan eye out for WALLY when he caught\lhis POKéMON.\pWhy don't you visit us in VERDANTURF\nsometime?\lI'm sure WALLY would enjoy it.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyPokenavCall
source:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!\pWALLY: Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!\pI just wanted to tell you that
my uncle bought me a POKéNAV!\pNow I can get in touch with you
anytime, {PLAYER}!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_RegisteredWally
source: Registered WALLY\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ScottYouDidntHoldBack
source:
SCOTT: Hehe…
I was watching that match!\pYou're friends with that boy WALLY,
aren't you?\pBut you didn't hold anything back
and beat him impressively.\pYeah! That's what a real POKéMON
battle is all about!\pI idolize TRAINERS like that!\p… … … … … …
I'll be cheering for you!$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKey
source:
WATTSON: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You look like you have a lot of zip!\lThat's a good thing, wahahahaha!\pFine! I've decided!
I need a favor, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pMAUVILLE CITY has an underground
sector called NEW MAUVILLE.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'd like you to go there and
switch off the GENERATOR.\pThe GENERATOR has been running a bit
haywire. It's getting unsafe.\pHere, this is the KEY to get into
NEW MAUVILLE.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonWontBeChallenge
source:
WATTSON: Don't you worry about it.
It won't be a challenge to you.\pThe entrance to NEW MAUVILLE is just
a short SURF away from ROUTE 110.\pThat's it, then, you have my trust!
Wahahahaha!$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonThanksTakeTM
source: WATTSON: Wahahahaha!\pI knew it, {PLAYER}{KUN}! I knew I'd made\nthe right choice asking you!\pThis is my thanks--a TM containing\nTHUNDERBOLT!\pGo on, you've earned it!$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonYoungTakeCharge
source: WATTSON: Wahahahaha!\pIt pleases me to no end to see\nthe young step up and take charge!$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_NurseHurtMonBackToHealth
source: You know, it's cool to have POKéMON\nbattles and stuff…\pBut if your POKéMON gets hurt,\nyou have to nurse it back to health.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_AllSortsOfPeopleComeThrough
source: The roads of this town stretch north\nand south, and east and west.\pBecause of that, we get all sorts of\npeople coming through.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_RydelVeryGenerous
source: Have you been to RYDEL'S CYCLES yet?\pRYDEL, the owner, is a very generous\nman.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_PokemonCanJumpYouOnBike
source: Even if you're riding a BIKE,\nwild POKéMON could jump you.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_CitySign
source: MAUVILLE CITY\n“The bright and shiny city of fun!”$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_GymSign
source: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: WATTSON\l“The cheerfully electrifying man!”$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_BikeShopSign
source: “Ride in gravel and shake up your\nsoul!”\lRYDEL'S CYCLES$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_GameCornerSign
source: “The play spot for all!”\nMAUVILLE GAME CORNER$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ExplainTV
source:
Hi, do you check out TV at all?\pThey've added a bunch of cool new
shows recently.\pTV is so cool. I've seen my friends on
TV just out of the blue.\pAnd, sometimes, they even put you on TV
without telling you.\pI wish I would be on TV sometime.\pThat's why I think you should check
out TVs whenever you can.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_BeenCheckingOutTV
source: Hi, have you been checking out TVs?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_RydelGreeting
source: Well, well, what have we here?\nA most energetic customer!\pMe? You may call me RYDEL.\nI'm the owner of this cycle shop.$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_DidYouComeFromFarAway
source: RYDEL: Your RUNNING SHOES…\nThey're awfully filthy.\pDid you come from far away?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_GuessYouDontNeedBike
source: RYDEL: Is that right?\pThen, I guess you have no need for\nany of my BIKES.$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
source:
RYDEL: Hm, hm… … … … …\pYou're saying that you came all this
way from LITTLEROOT?\pMy goodness!
That's ridiculously far!\pIf you had one of my BIKES, you could
go anywhere easily while feeling the\lgentle caress of the wind!\pI'll tell you what!
I'll give you a BIKE!\pOh, wait a second!\pI forgot to tell you that there are
two kinds of BIKES!\pThey are the MACH BIKE and
the ACRO BIKE!\pThe MACH BIKE is for cyclists who want
to feel the wind with their bodies!\pAnd an ACRO BIKE is for those who
prefer technical rides!\pI'm a real sweetheart, so you can
have whichever one you like!\pWhich one will you choose?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ChoseMachBike
source: {PLAYER} chose the MACH BIKE.$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ChoseAcroBike
source: {PLAYER} chose the ACRO BIKE.$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ComeBackToSwitchBikes
source: RYDEL: If you get the urge to switch\nBIKES, just come see me!$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_WantToSwitchBikes
source: RYDEL: Oh? Were you thinking about\nswitching BIKES?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_IllSwitchBikes
source: RYDEL: Okay, no problem!\nI'll switch BIKES for you!$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedMachForAcro
source: {PLAYER} got the MACH BIKE exchanged\nfor an ACRO BIKE.$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedAcroForMach
source: {PLAYER} got the ACRO BIKE exchanged\nfor a MACH BIKE.$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HappyYouLikeIt
source: RYDEL: Good, good!\nI'm happy that you like it!$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsInPC
source:
Oh? What happened to that BIKE
I gave you?\pOh, I get it, you stored it using your PC.\pWell, take it out of PC storage,
and I'll be happy to exchange it!\pMay the wind always be at your back
on your adventure!$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HandbooksAreInBack
source: I'm learning about BIKES while\nI work here.\pIf you need advice on how to ride your\nBIKE, there're a couple handbooks in\lthe back.$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_MachHandbookWhichPage
source: It's a handbook on the MACH BIKE.\pWhich page do you want to read?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMachBike
source: A BIKE moves in the direction that\nthe + Control Pad is pressed.\pIt will speed up once it gets rolling.\pTo stop, release the + Control Pad.\nThe BIKE will slow to a stop.\pWant to read a different page?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMachBike
source:
A MACH BIKE is speedy, but it can't
stop very quickly.\pIt gets a little tricky to get around
a corner.\pRelease the + Control Pad a little
before the corner and slow down.\pWant to read a different page?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes
source:
There are small sandy slopes
throughout the HOENN region.\pThe loose, crumbly sand makes it
impossible to climb normally.\pBut if you have a MACH BIKE, you can
zip up a sandy slope.\pWant to read a different page?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_AcroHandbookWhichPage
source: It's a handbook on the ACRO BIKE.\pWhich page do you want to read?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies
source: Press the B Button while riding,\nand the front wheel lifts up.\pYou can zip around with the front\nwheel up using the + Control Pad.\pThis technique is called a wheelie.\pWant to read a different page?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops
source: Keeping the B Button pressed,\nyour BIKE can hop on the spot.\pThis technique is called a bunny hop.\pYou can ride while hopping, too.\pWant to read a different page?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps
source:
Press the B Button and the + Control
Pad at the same time to jump.\pPress the + Control Pad to the side
to jump sideways.\pPress it backwards to make the BIKE
change directions while jumping.\pWant to read a different page?$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ThisIsMauvilleGameCorner
source: This is the GAME CORNER.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCaseForCoins
source: Okay, you wanted some COINS for\nthe games?\pBut you don't have a COIN CASE for\nstowing the COINS.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_WereYouLookingForCoins
source: Were you looking for COINS?\pIt's ¥500 for 50 COINS.\nWould you like some?$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ThankYouHereAreYourCoins
source: Thank you very much!\nHere are your COINS!$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontHaveEnoughMoneyFor50
source: Um… You don't appear to have\nenough money to buy COINS…\pPlease come back when you have\nat least ¥1000!$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontHaveEnoughMoney
source: Um… You don't appear to have\nenough money for that many COINS…$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NoRoomFor50Coins
source: Oh! Your COIN CASE is too full to buy\nany more COINS!\pEnjoy the GOLDENROD GAME CORNER or\nexchange your COINS for prizes before\lcoming back!$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NoRoomForCoins
source: Oh?\nYour COIN CASE can't fit those COINS...$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontNeedCoinsThen
source: Oh… You don't need COINS, then?\nGood luck on your adventure!$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ThanksBuyCoins
source: Thank you for buying some COINS!\nGood luck on your adventure!$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ExchangeCoinsForPrizes
source: Welcome.\pYou can exchange your COINS for\nprizes here.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_WhichPrize
source: Which prize would you like?$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SoYourChoiceIsTheTMX
source: So your choice is\nthe {STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2}?$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SendToYourHomePC
source: Thank you!\nWe'll send it to your PC at home.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NotEnoughCoins
source: You don't have enough COINS.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NoRoomForPlacingDecor
source: There isn't any room available for\nplacing {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_OhIsThatSo
source: Oh, is that so? \nYou need to save some COINS before\lcoming back here.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SoYourChoiceIsX
source: So your choice is {STR_VAR_1}?$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HereYouGo
source: Here you go!$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantCarryAnyMore
source: Oh, you can't carry any more than that.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_GotTwoOfSameDollWantOne
source: I made a mistake and got two of\nthe same DOLLS.\pWould you like one of them?$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HereYouGo2
source: Here you go!$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_YouWantItButNotNow
source: Huh?\nYou want it, but not right now?$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontBeNegative
source: Oh, don't be so negative!\nYou can have this!$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantWinJackpot
source: There's a prize I want, but I can't win\nthe jackpot.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCaseGoNextDoor
source: Hey, kid, if you want to play here,\nyou need a COIN CASE.\pI think the young lady next door\nhad one. Go see her!$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_LuckOnlyLastSoLongTakeCoins
source: My luck can only last so long.\nThis is too much for me.\lHere, take some COINS!$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_MauvilleSomethingForEveryone
source: MAUVILLE has something for\neveryone.\pFor me, it's the GAME CORNER.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteTablesDifferentRates
source: The ROULETTE tables have different\nrates.\pCheck your COINS if you're going to\npick a table.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_EasyToLoseTrackOfTime
source: It's easy to lose track of time in here. \nI should get back to work.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinsAreNeededToPlay
source: COINS are needed to play here\nin the GAME CORNER.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteOnlyLuck
source: This ROULETTE thing…\nIt's rather demanding.\pWin or lose, it's only by luck.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_UpTo3CoinsCanBeUsed
source: Up to three COINS can be used to play\nthe SLOTS.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DifficultToStopOn7
source: It's very difficult to make it stop\nright on “7.”\pIf it stops on “7” during the REEL TIME\nbonus game, you'll receive extra COINS.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HeresSomeSlotsInfo
source:
Here's some information for you
about the SLOTS.\pThe more lightning bolts you stock,
the more REEL TIME chances you get.\pIn a game with the maximum five
REEL TIME chances…\pIt is possible to receive four regular
bonuses, then a big bonus.\pThat would total 660 COINS, but it's
very difficult to get.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantPlayWithNoCoinCase
source: You can't play if you don't have\na COIN CASE.$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
source:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pWATTSON, the LEADER of MAUVILLE
GYM, uses ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.\pIf you challenge him with WATER-type
POKéMON, he'll zap them! Bzzt!\pAnd, he's put in switch-controlled
doors all over his GYM! Eccentric!\pHey, go for it!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
source: Whoa, you're electrifying!\nYou've powered the door open!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro
source: My electric soul, it'll shatter your\ndreams whole, whoa-yeahah!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkDefeat
source: That was plugged in, amped up,\nover-driven electric, man!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle
source: POKéMON and rock, it's all about heart,\nwhoa-yeah!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro
source: I trained under WATTSON!\nThere ain't no way I'll lose easily!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnDefeat
source: Unplugged and turned off…$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle
source: WATTSON, our GYM LEADER, has been\naround for a long, long time.\pHe was battling even before your\ndaddy was born, that tough coot.$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenIntro
source: This GYM's got puzzles!\nIsn't it fun?$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenDefeat
source: It's no fun to lose…$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenPostBattle
source: WATTSON says he likes setting up\nlittle traps with switches.$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianIntro
source: With my charm and my POKéMON's moves,\nyou'll be shocked!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianDefeat
source: I'm shocked by your power!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianPostBattle
source: I've heard that MAUVILLE was founded\nby WATTSON.\pHe was a TRAINER long before we\nbecame TRAINERS.\lHe must know all sorts of things!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloIntro
source: I love shiny things!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloDefeat
source: Oh…\nMy eyes are frazzled…$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloPostBattle
source: MAUVILLE GYM's WATTSON has a shiny\nforehead. It makes me happy!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
source:
I've given up on my plans to convert
the city, I have.\pAnd so, I put my time into making
door traps in my GYM.\pOh? Now, what are you doing here?\pWhat's that? You say you've gotten
past all my rigged doors?\pWahahahah!
Now, that is amusing!\pThen, I, WATTSON, the LEADER of
MAUVILLE GYM, shall electrify you!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonDefeat
source: Wahahahah!\nFine, I lost!\pYou ended up giving me a thrill!\nTake this BADGE!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedDynamoBadge
source: {PLAYER} received the DYNAMO BADGE\nfrom WATTSON.$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainDynamoBadgeTakeThis
source:
With the DYNAMO BADGE, POKéMON can
use ROCK SMASH out of battle.\pAnd, it will make your POKéMON a little
bit faster, too.\pHmm…
You should take this, too!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainShockWave
source: That TM34 there contains SHOCK WAVE.\pIt's a trustworthy move that never\nmisses! You can count on it!\p… … … … … …$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWattson
source: Registered GYM LEADER WATTSON\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostBattle
source: I swell with optimism, seeing a promising\nyoung TRAINER like you!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonGoForthAndEndeavor
source: Wahahahah!\nGo forth and endeavor, youngster!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM\pWATTSON'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPreRematch
source: WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last!\nI know what you want.\lYou want to battle my POKéMON!\pWahahahaha!\pI'll make sparks fly from you!\nDon't say I didn't warn you!$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchDefeat
source: Oof…\nOur batteries ran dry…$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostRematch
source:
WATTSON: We'll have to recharge our
batteries again.\pWhen we're fully charged up, we'll
gladly accept your challenge.\pSo, come back again sometime,
won't you?$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchNeedTwoMons
source:
WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last!
I know what you want.\lYou want to battle my POKéMON!\pWahahahaha!\pOops! Wait!
You've only one POKéMON with you!\pCome see me with two or more
POKéMON, all right?$

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ImRockSmashDudeTakeThis
source:
Woohoo!\pI hear people call me the ROCK SMASH
GUY, but I find that sort of degrading.\pI think I deserve a bit more respect,
like maybe the ROCK SMASH DUDE.\pWoohoo!\pAnyways, your POKéMON look pretty
strong.\pI like that!
Here, take this HIDDEN MACHINE!$

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ExplainRockSmash
source:
That HM contains ROCK SMASH.\pIf you come across large boulders
that block your path…\pWell, use that HM move and smash
them right out of your way!\pYes, sir! Smash rocks aside, I say!
Woohoo!$

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_MonCanFlyOutOfSmashedRock
source: Oh, yes, if you smash a rock, a POKéMON\ncould come flying out of hiding.\pWoohoo!$

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_BuyHarborMailAtSlateport
source: If I had a BIKE, it'd be easy to cycle to\nSLATEPORT for some shopping.\pI'd be able to buy HARBOR MAIL at the\nPOKéMON MART in SLATEPORT…$

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_TradeHarborMailForCoinCase
source: Oh! You have HARBOR MAIL?\nWill you trade it for a COIN CASE?$

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_IllTradeYouCoinCase
source: Oh, I'm so happy!\nOkay, I'll trade you a COIN CASE!$

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_UseCoinCaseAtGameCorner
source: That COIN CASE can be used\nat the GAME CORNER.$

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_ThatsDisappointing
source: Oh, that's disappointing.\pA COIN CASE is needed for the\nGAME CORNER.$

label: MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_ItemsToTemporarilyElevateStats
source:
There are items that temporarily
elevate the stats of POKéMON.\pThe ones I know you use in battle
are X ATTACK and X DEFEND…\pI do believe that there are others
like them.$

label: MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_DecisionsDetermineBattle
source: Use a certain move, or use an item\ninstead…\pThe TRAINER's decisions determine how\nbattles turn out, I think.$

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManOverThereSaysWeirdThings
source: That man over there, he says weird\nthings!\pHe's funny in a weird way.\nI doubt I'll forget about him!$

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MyDataUpdatedFromRecordCorner
source: When I accessed the RECORD CORNER,\nthe data for what's hot in DEWFORD\lgot updated.\pNow that bit of data is the same\nas my friend's!$

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RecordCornerSoundsFun
source: A RECORD CORNER opened upstairs in\nthe POKéMON CENTER.\pI don't know what it's about, but it\nsounds fun. I'll go check it out!$

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_2F_Text_Youngster
source:
Did you know that you can link battle
at the COLOSSEUM here?\pThey put up your record on the wall
for everyone to see.\pIt's embarrassing if you lose more
often than you win…$

label: Alola_Melemele_GetOffBoat_Text_0
source: Welcome back to the ISLES!\pCome back if you'd like to take a trip\nto mainland KANTO!$

label: Alola_Melemele_TravelToKanto_Text_0
source: Ahoy!\pWould you like to travel to mainland\nKANTO?$

label: Alola_Melemele_TravelToKanto_Text_1
source: Ahoy! Let's get you on board!$

label: Alola_Melemele_TravelToKanto_Text_2
source: Ahoy!\nCome back when you'd like to set sail.$

label: Alola_Melemele_Mailbox_Text_0
source: SAMSON OAK's VILLA$

label: Alola_Melemele_Melemele_Sign_Text_0
source: Welcome to MELEMELE ISLE!$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_Sign_Text_0
source: Welcome to the MELEMELE ISLE\nPOKéMON CENTER!\pThis is the only POKéMON CENTER on the\nALOLA ISLES but you can rest on\lbenches around the ISLES.$

label: Alola_Melemele_MelemeleMart_Sign_Text_0
source: MELEMELE ISLE MART$

label: Alola_Melemele_BattleSandygast_Text_0
source: Coorr!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOak_Trigger_Beginning_Text_0
source: ALOLA!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOak_Trigger_Beginning_Text_1
source: Welcome to the ALOLA ISLES!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOak_Trigger_Beginning_Text_2
source: My name is SAMSON OAK!\nI'm a POKéMON PROFESSOR.\pWhat's your name?$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOak_Trigger_Beginning_Text_3
source: Ah, {PLAYER}.\nA fine name!\pYou may know my cousin, PROFESSOR OAK,\nfrom the KANTO region.\pLet me show you to town!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOak_Trigger_Beginning_Text_4
source: This is the main town on these islands.\pIt's eerily similar to HAU'OLI CITY in\nALOLA… {PAUSE 30}And when I think about it…\pThis whole island reminds me of MELEMELE\nISLAND…$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOak_Trigger_Beginning_Text_5
source:
Well, anyways!\pI research variations of POKéMON that 
can be found in different regions!\pOn my way back from the ALOLA region,
I stumbled across these isles…\pSurprisingly, many of the POKéMON I saw
in ALOLA were here as well, so I've\lcalled this place… {PAUSE 30}the ALOLA ISLES!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOak_Trigger_Beginning_Text_6
source:
Now I haven't completely explored the
ISLES yet… {PAUSE 30}I just landed here myself.\pI'd like to know if all of the variants
native to ALOLA are here.\pIf you happen to come across any,
please come by my villa on the east side\lof the ISLE and show them to me!\pOh. And feel free to explore the ISLE
while on your way!\pSee you there!$

label: Alola_Melemele_NeedToTalkToSamsonOak_Text_0
source: SAMSON is waiting for you at his villa…\n{PAUSE 30}best not make him wait too long!$

label: Alola_Melemele_TotemBattle_Text_0
source: Leee!$

label: Alola_Melemele_TotemBattle_Text_1
source: Totem LEAFEON was defeated!\nIt scampered off somewhere…$

label: Alola_Melemele_TotemBattle_Text_2
source: Thhhh!$

label: Alola_Melemele_TotemBattle_Text_3
source: Totem RATICATE was defeated!\nIt scampered off somewhere…$

label: Alola_Melemele_Totem_sign_Text_0
source: The totem is emanating a strong\nenergy…\pTouch the totem to teleport to another\nIsle?$

label: Alola_Melemele_Totem_sign_Text_1
source: MELEMELE ISLE$

label: Alola_Melemele_Totem_sign_Text_2
source: AKALA ISLE$

label: Alola_Melemele_Totem_sign_Text_3
source: ULA'ULA ISLE$

label: Alola_Melemele_Totem_sign_Text_4
source: PONI ISLE$

label: Alola_Melemele_Totem_sign_Text_5
source: Cancel$

label: Alola_Melemele_Totem_sign_Text_6
source: A strange totem stands here,\npower is emanating from it…$

label: Alola_Melemele_BattleVsTapuKoko_Text_0
source: Ko-Ko-Kooo!$

label: Alola_Melemele_TrainerBattleSwimmer_Text_0
source: The waters are warm here by the ISLES!$

label: Alola_Melemele_TrainerBattleSwimmer_Text_1
source: Maybe I should dry off on land for\na bit…$

label: Alola_Melemele_TrainerBattleSwimmer_Text_2
source: There are plenty of neat POKéMON in\nthe water, try all your fishing rods!$

label: Alola_Melemele_Bugcatcher_Text_0
source: The bug POKéMON on the ALOLA ISLES\nare much bigger than those in KANTO!$

label: Alola_Melemele_camper_Text_0
source: I traveled all the way from KANTO to see\na variant of my favorite cat POKéMON,\lMEOWTH!$

label: Alola_Melemele_Picnicker_Text_0
source: These ISLES are chock full of unique\nPOKéMON!\pI need to stock up on POKé BALLS so I\ncan catch them all!$

label: Alola_Pokemart_Cook_Text_0
source: The MALASADAS here are delicious.\nJust like the real ones in ALOLA!$

label: Alola_Pokemart_BaldMan_Text_0
source: I'm looking for some sunscreen!\pIt's sunnier here on the ISLES!$

label: Melemele_House3_Woman_Text_0
source: Island life here is so peaceful!\pAnd it's nice that my grandkids are just\na quick boat ride away in KANTO!$

label: Melemele_House3_Man_Text_0
source: Dang tourists!\pMy realtor said this place would be\nquiet… but I guess its cheaper to \ltravel here than all the way to ALOLA.$

label: Melemele_House4_Man_Text_0
source: We're vacationing on the ALOLA ISLES!\pIt's just like the ALOLA region,\nbut closer to KANTO!\pI saved so much on travel expenses!$

label: Melemele_House4_Woman_Text_0
source: My boyfriend told me we were going to\nALOLA…\pI had assumed it would be the ALOLA\nregion, not the small isles off the\lcoast of KANTO.$

label: Melemele_House5_Mom_Text_0
source: I'm thinking of moving to the ALOLA\nregion with my son, ELIO.\pWe're just getting a little taste here\non the ISLES!$

label: Melemele_House5_Son_Text_0
source: Hehe... tag is so fun!$

label: Melemele_House5_Son_Text_1
source: Try to catch me MEOWTH!$

label: Melemele_House5_Cat_Text_0
source: Mwaaawwwrrrrrrrr!!!$

label: Melemele_House6_Hiker_Text_0
source: I bought this place so that my son\nand I could explore the outdoors…\pAll he wants to do is play on that\nGame Boy Advance.$

label: Melemele_House6_GameboyKid_Text_0
source:
I have a game on my Game Boy Advance
that lets me explore the ALOLA Region!\pIt's just like the real thing.\pIt's called ULTRA ECLIPSE,
by PHANTONOMY!\pHaha, look!
I'm riding an icy NOIVERN!$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_Text_Swimmer
source: Ah, it's so hard to keep these\nisles straight!\pI always seem to mix them up!\pThank goodness for this map!$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_AceTrainer_Text_0
source: There are so many unique POKéMON here!\nI'm gonna catch 'em all!$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_BugCatcher_Text_0
source: I found some brand new POKéMON\nhere on the ISLES!\pLike my new friend RATTATA here!$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_Grubbin_Text_0
source: Grrr!$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_Jessica_Text_WantToTrade
source: The {STR_VAR_2} out here aren't like\nthe ones on the mainland.\pWant to trade for my {STR_VAR_2}?$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_Jessica_Text_TakeCare
source: Thanks!\nTORY, you take care!$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_Jessica_Text_DeclineTrade
source: You don't want to trade? Aww...$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_Jessica_Text_TradeCompleted
source: Hi, how's my old TORY doing?$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_Map_Text_0
source: {PLAYER} took a closer look at the\nALOLA ISLES map.$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVillaIntro_Trigger_Text_0
source: Alola, {PLAYER}!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVillaIntro_Trigger_Text_1
source:
I'm glad you're here!
Welcome to my villa!\pI'm staying here while I research the
ALOLA ISLES for their similarity to\lthe ALOLA region.\pI'm particularly interested in the
phenomenon of “Regional Variants”.$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVillaIntro_Trigger_Text_2
source:
You seem quite capable.\pYou'd be perfect to help with my survey
of the ALOLA ISLES!\pExplore all the ISLES have to offer,
and if you find any familiar POKéMON\lthat resemble those from KANTO…\lcome back and show me your POKéDEX!\pI'll be here patiently waiting to hear
about your progress!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_0
source: Wow!\nYou saw the Guardian Deities!\pIncredible work, {PLAYER}.\pI found this while wandering about.\pI'm not entirely sure what it's for,\nbut you should take it.$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_1
source: The ALOLA ISLES must truly be special if\nthe Guardians themselves visited!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_2
source:
Thanks for your help with my research,
{PLAYER}!\pOur understanding of the ALOLA ISLES
has greatly improved thanks to you!\pI hope you continue to explore the
ISLES to find all the secrets that\lthey hold!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_3
source: Alola {PLAYER}!\pSo you managed to defeat all of the\nTotem POKéMON on the ISLES, did you?\pThat's quite an accomplishment!\pIt's been long enough…\pI think it's about time we had a battle,\ndon't you?$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_4
source: Great!\nI won't be taking it easy on you!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_5
source: Incredible, {PLAYER}!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_6
source:
Wow, {PLAYER}!
You really are a powerful Trainer!\pYou've proven worthy of a secret
I've been keeping about these ISLES…\pI'm not the only one who's noticed a
striking resemblance between the ALOLA\lISLES and the ALOLA region…\pIt seems the Tapu Guardians themselves
have been visiting the ISLES.\pIf you see them fly over the ISLES, head
to the totems… They may be there \lwaiting for you!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_7
source: What are you waiting for, {PLAYER}?\nGo out there and explore!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_8
source: No worries, {PLAYER}!\pTake your time to prepare for the\nbattle, and come back when you're\lready!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_9
source: Alola {PLAYER}!\pSo you've found all the Alolan variants\non the ISLES, but have you defeated all\lthe Totem POKéMON yet?\pYou should look for a strange pillar on\neach isle, the Totem POKéMON will be\lguarding it!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_10
source: Hello again, {PLAYER}!\pHow's your research on the ALOLA ISLES\ncoming along?\pWould you like to share your progress\nabout a specific isle with me?$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_11
source: MELEMELE ISLE$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_12
source: AKALA ISLE$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_13
source: ULA'ULA ISLE$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_14
source: PONI ISLE$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_15
source: Not right now.$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_16
source: Let me take a look at your POKéDEX{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_17
source: Wow, {PLAYER}!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_18
source: You found all the Alolan variants living\non MELEMELE ISLE!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_19
source: And it looks like you've found all the\nAlolan variants on the other ISLES too!\pThat's amazing, {PLAYER}!\pYou should be very proud of yourself!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_20
source:
You've helped me validate that all
of the Alolan variants are present on\lthe ALOLA ISLES!\pI'd like you to help me with one more
thing…\pCould you help me investigate the Totem
POKéMON that are said to be guarding\lthe totems on each ISLE?\pBut beware! These Totem POKéMON are
said to be much stronger than their\lnormal counterparts…\pYou never know who might be watching
to see if you are a worthy opponent!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_21
source: Keep exploring the other ISLES and\nreport your progress to me!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_22
source: It seems you've already found all the\nAlolan variants on MELEMELE ISLE!\pGreat job!\pKeep exploring the other ISLES and\nreport your progress to me!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_23
source:
Let me take a look at your POKéDEX{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.\pIt seems you haven't quite found all of
the Alolan variants on MELEMELE ISLE\ljust yet.\pI've heard MELEMELE ISLE has {COLOR RED}4 {COLOR DARK_GRAY}Alolan
variants for you to find…\p{COLOR RED}RATTATA{COLOR DARK_GRAY}, {COLOR RED}RATICATE{COLOR DARK_GRAY}, {COLOR RED}MEOWTH{COLOR DARK_GRAY}, and
{COLOR RED}PERSIAN{COLOR DARK_GRAY}.\pKeep on searching and come back when
you've caught them all!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_24
source: You found all the Alolan variants living\non AKALA ISLE!$

all of the Alolan variants are present\lon the ALOLA ISLES.\pI'd like you to help me with one more

POKéMON that are said to be guarding\lthe totems on each isle?\pBut beware! These Totem POKéMON are
said to be much stronger than their\lnormal counterparts…\pYou never know who might be watching
to see if you are a worthy opponent!$

source: It seems you've already found all the\nAlolan variants on AKALA ISLE!\pGreat job!\pKeep exploring the other ISLES and\nreport your progress to me!$

source:
Let me take a look at your POKéDEX{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.\pIt seems you haven't quite found all of

source:
Let me take a look at your POKéDEX{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.\pIt seems you haven't quite found all of

source: It seems you've already found all the\nAlolan variants on PONI ISLE!\pGreat job!\pKeep exploring the other ISLES and\nreport your progress to me!$

source:
Let me take a look at your POKéDEX{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.\pIt seems you haven't quite found all of
