label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_34
source: No worries, {PLAYER}!\pCome back when you'd like to share your\nfindings about the ALOLA ISLES!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WithThisMeteorite
source: Hehehe!\pWith this METEORITE, that thing in\nMT. CHIMNEY will…$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_DontExpectMercyFromMagma
source: Heh?\pI don't know who you are, but if you get\nin the way of TEAM MAGMA, don't\lexpect any mercy!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_HoldItRightThereMagma
source: Hold it right there, TEAM MAGMA!\pYou're badly mistaken if you think you\ncan have your way with the world!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAqua
source:
Hehehe!
Even TEAM AQUA joins us!\pBut it's too much trouble to deal with
you all…\pHeh, it doesn't matter!\pWe've got the METEORITE, so off to
MT. CHIMNEY we go!\pHehehe! Be seeing you, you TEAM
AQUA dingbats!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
source:
ARCHIE: Didn't I see you before?
At SLATEPORT's MUSEUM?\pAh, so your name is {PLAYER}.\pAt the time, I thought you were one
of TEAM MAGMA's goons.\pHumph…
You're one odd kid.\pTEAM MAGMA is a dangerous group of
total fanatics.\pThey engage in destruction, claiming
to expand the land mass.\pThey are the rivals to us,
the sea-loving TEAM AQUA!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BossWeShouldChaseMagma
source: BOSS, we should give chase to\nTEAM MAGMA…$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieYesNoTellingWhatMagmaWillDo
source: ARCHIE: Yes, yes, we must!\nWe've got to hurry.\pThere's no telling what TEAM MAGMA\nwill do at MT. CHIMNEY!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieFarewell
source: ARCHIE: {PLAYER}, you should keep\nan eye out for TEAM MAGMA, too.\pFarewell!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
source:
I… I'm COZMO…
I'm a PROFESSOR…\pTEAM MAGMA asked me to guide them
to METEOR FALLS…\pBut they tricked me.
They even took my METEORITE away…\pAnd then another similar bunch,
TEAM AQUA showed up.\pAfter that…
I don't understand any of it.\pBut that TEAM MAGMA…\pWhat are they going to do with that
METEORITE at MT. CHIMNEY?$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WhatsTeamMagmaDoingAtMtChimney
source: PROF. COZMO: But that TEAM MAGMA…\pWhat are they going to do with that\nMETEORITE at MT. CHIMNEY?$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasIntro
source: This is where we DRAGON users do our\ntraining.\pThe CHAMPION even visits.\nNow do you see how special it is here?$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasDefeat
source: Urgh!\nI didn't expect you to be so strong!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostBattle
source: The road ahead remains long and harsh.\pWhen will my POKéMON and I become\nthe best?$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRegister
source: I want to know more about your power.\nLet me register you in my POKéNAV.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchIntro
source: Since we met, we have trained hard\nwith our sights on number one.\pHelp us see how much stronger we've\nbecome!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchDefeat
source: Urgh!\nI didn't expect you to be so strong!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostRematch
source: You've obviously kept up your\nPOKéMON training.\pSo long as you remain strong, I, too,\ncan become stronger!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnIntro
source: JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON\ntogether as a twosome.\lWe've confidence in ourselves.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnDefeat
source: JOHN: Oh, my.\nWe've lost, dear wife.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostBattle
source: JOHN: We've been married for\nfifty years.\pCome to think of it, I've yet to beat\nmy dear wife in a battle.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnNotEnoughMons
source: JOHN: Well, well, what a young TRAINER!\pWill you battle with us? If so, you'll\nhave to return with more POKéMON.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRegister
source: JOHN: Young TRAINER, if the chance\narises, will you battle with us again?$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayIntro
source: JAY: We've been married for\nfifty years.\pThe bond we share as a couple could\nnever be broken.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayDefeat
source: JAY: Oh, dear.\nWe've lost, my dear husband.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostBattle
source: JAY: Fifty years of marriage…\pIf we ever argued, we always settled\nit with a POKéMON battle…$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayNotEnoughMons
source: JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young\nTRAINER?\pIf you'd care to battle with us, you'll\nhave to come back with more POKéMON.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchIntro
source: JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON\ntogether as a twosome.\lWe've confidence in ourselves.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchDefeat
source: JOHN: Oh, my.\nWe've lost, dear wife.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostRematch
source: JOHN: Married for fifty years…\pOn reflection, the dear wife and I,\nwe battled day in and day out…$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchNotEnoughMons
source: JOHN: Well, well, what a young TRAINER!\pWill you battle with us? If so, you'll\nhave to return with more POKéMON.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchIntro
source: JAY: We've been married for\nfifty years.\pWe've supported each other all that\ntime. We've made ourselves strong.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchDefeat
source: JAY: Oh, dear.\nWe've lost, my dear husband.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostRematch
source: JAY: Fifty years of marriage…\nMany things have happened.\pI hope that we will continue to make\nhappy memories together.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchNotEnoughMons
source: JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young\nTRAINER?\pIf you'd care to battle with us, you'll\nhave to come back with more POKéMON.$

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_ShouldKnowHowGoodIAmExpectWorst
source:
STEVEN: Oh, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
I'm amazed you knew where to find me.\pDo you, uh…maybe think of me as
just a rock maniac?\pNo, that can't be right.\pWe battled alongside each other at
the SOOTOPOLIS SPACE CENTER.\pYou should have a very good idea
about how good I am.\pOkay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, if you're going to mount
a serious challenge, expect the worst!$

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_StevenDefeat
source: You…\nI had no idea you'd become so strong…$

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_MyPredictionCameTrue
source:
STEVEN: Come to think of it, ever since
our paths first crossed in GRANITE\lCAVE in DEWFORD, I had this feeling.\pI thought that you would eventually
become the CHAMPION.\pMy predictions usually come true.\pAnd where will you go from here?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pFufufu, even I couldn't tell you that.$

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_TakeRootFossil
source: You found the ROOT FOSSIL.\pIf this FOSSIL is taken, the ground\naround it will likely crumble away…\pTake the ROOT FOSSIL anyway?$

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_LeftRootFossilAlone
source: {PLAYER} left the ROOT FOSSIL alone.$

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_TakeClawFossil
source: You found the CLAW FOSSIL.\pIf this FOSSIL is taken, the ground\naround it will likely crumble away…\pTake the CLAW FOSSIL anyway?$

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_LeaveClawFossilAlone
source: {PLAYER} left the CLAW FOSSIL alone.$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WantKingsRockStevenGaveMe
source: I got this from STEVEN, but I don't\nknow what it's good for.\pI think it's called KING'S ROCK.\nDo you want it?$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_YouCanKeepIt
source: Why would you want it?\nYou're weird.\pYou can keep it, but keep it a secret\nfrom STEVEN.$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_StevensHouseOverThere
source: STEVEN's house is right over there!$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WhatToDoWithWeirdRock
source: Yeah, you think so, too! What are you\nsupposed to do with some weird rock?$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WailmerWatching
source: Around MOSSDEEP, you can see wild\nWAILMER.\pIt's called, uh…\nWhat was it now…\pWAI, WAI, WAI…\pWAILMER watching!$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterReceivedLetter
source: The island's SPACE CENTER has been\nlaunching huge rockets.\pThere's been some kind of an uproar\nover a letter they received recently.$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterLaunchingRockets
source: The island's SPACE CENTER has been\nlaunching huge rockets.$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_MossdeepTargetedByMagma
source:
I heard from a SAILOR buddy that
TEAM AQUA set up shop in LILYCOVE.\pI also heard that someone came along
and wiped the floor with them!\pBut MOSSDEEP here's been targeted
by that TEAM MAGMA.\pIf you want to know what they're up to,
go visit the SPACE CENTER.$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_FeelReliefOnLand
source: I'm a SAILOR, so the sea's obviously\nmore important to me.\pBut you know? When I get back on land\nafter a long voyage, I do feel relief!$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_NiceIfWorldCoveredByFlowers
source: Wouldn't it be nice?\pIf the whole world was covered in\nplants and flowers like this island?$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive
source:
All life needs the sea to live, even
though it makes its home on the land.\pLife, having run its course, becomes
soil and returns to the land.\pAnd the sea is always connected to
the land.\pYes, like the very shoreline here.$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SurfExhilarating
source: A voyage on a ship is fine.\pBut crossing the sea with POKéMON\nusing SURF…\pNow that's an exhilarating trip!\nWouldn't you agree, youngster?$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpecialSpaceCenterRock
source:
This rock has a special meaning to
the people at the SPACE CENTER.\pThey put it here as their wish for
their rockets to fly safely.\pWhen you make a wish, what do you use?
Do you wish upon a star?\pI use a wish tag to make it happen.
That's what I do.$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ItsAWhiteRock
source: It's a white rock.$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_GymSign
source: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADERS: LIZA & TATE\p“The mystic combination!”$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_CitySign
source: MOSSDEEP CITY\n“Our slogan: Cherish POKéMON!”$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterSign
source: MOSSDEEP SPACE CENTER\n“The closest place to space.”$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWithTown
source:
SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, feeling good?
I'm doing great!\pI'd heard MOSSDEEP's GYM LEADER is
pretty strong, so I decided to come\ltake a look-see for myself.\pBut there's something wrong about
this town.\pPeople are going on about a warning
letter and the SPACE CENTER…\pI don't think it concerns me in any
way, though.$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SootopolisNewGymLeader
source:
Ahh… It feels great letting the waves
wash over my feet…\pSpeaking of the waves, you know that
island city SOOTOPOLIS?\pI think the GYM there had a new
LEADER come in.\pPeople tell me the new LEADER once
mentored WALLACE.$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_OldManGreeting
source: When I was young, I traveled the world\nas a POKéMON TRAINER.\pNow that I've become an old buzzard,\nmy only amusement is watching young\lTRAINERS battle.$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_DoorIsLocked
source: The door appears to be locked.$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_ChallengeVisitingTrainer
source: A TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1} is\nvisiting my home.\pWould you like to challenge\n{STR_VAR_1}?$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_YouWontBattle
source: You won't battle? I'm disappointed\nthat I can't see you battle…$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_KeepItToA3On3
source: Oh, good, good!\pBut my house isn't all that sturdy.\pCould I ask you to keep it down to\na 3-on-3 match?$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_SaveYourProgress
source: Before you two battle, you should\nsave your progress.$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_HopeToSeeAGoodMatch
source: I hope to see a good match!$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleTie
source: So, it became a standoff.\pIt was a brilliant match in which\nneither side conceded a step!$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleWon
source: That was superlative!\pWhy, it was like seeing myself in\nmy youth again!$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleLost
source: Ah, too bad for you!\pBut it was a good match.\nI hope you can win next time.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
source:
Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-bound
{PLAYER}?\pThe GYM LEADERS here use
PSYCHIC-type POKéMON.\pIf you go up against them with
FIGHTING- or POISON-type POKéMON,\lthey'll inflict horrible damage!\pPlus, they'll come at you with
outstanding combination attacks.\pIf you want to win, you'll need to show
them how tight you are with your\lPOKéMON. Go for it!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
source: Wow, you're astounding!\nYou're one great TRAINER!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro
source: Battles hinge on the strength of your\nspirit! The weak-spirited will never win!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonDefeat
source: I lost!\nI must temper my spirit again!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle
source: The indecisive lose.\nThat's my warning to you.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilIntro
source: Let me see your talent!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilDefeat
source: You possess spectacular talent!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilPostBattle
source: If there are prodigies in the world,\nthen our GYM LEADERS are them!\pHowever, you may be even more talented\nthan them…$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro
source: Fufufufu… Watch me levitate a POKé\nBALL telekinetically!\pWrooooooooaaaar!\n… … … … … … …\pSometimes, I'm out of sync…$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeDefeat
source: My POKéMON battling skills are out\nof sync, too!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakePostBattle
source:
A POKé BALL was too heavy to lift
psychically. But this dust bunny…\pWhoooooooooooooooh!
… … … … … …\pNo, I'm not cheating!
I didn't blow on it! Honestly!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahIntro
source: When you lose to me, don't be too hard\non yourself.\pIt's not that you're weak--I'm just\ntoo strong!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahDefeat
source: You're just too strong!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahPostBattle
source: I'm not going to get down on myself for\nlosing. I just need to train harder.\pPositive thinking--that's my strong\npoint!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaIntro
source: I see it…\nI see your future…\pIf you can beat me, I will tell you\nyour future!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaDefeat
source: I surrender!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaPostBattle
source: You will wage a terrifically intense\nbattle with our GYM LEADERS…\pThe result…\nYou won't hear it from me!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraIntro
source: The roads you have traveled…\nWhat you have experienced…\pCome at me with everything you've\nlearned!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraDefeat
source: You've traveled a path of greatness!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraPostBattle
source: A bright future awaits those who have\nworked diligently.\pFor those who lazed idly, there is\nonly despair at the end.\pWhat goes around comes around…$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaIntro
source: Even at the risk of life, I will win\nthis battle!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaDefeat
source: What you do…\nIt horrifies me…$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaPostBattle
source: How dare you beat me…\pIt won't be my fault if something\nhorrible befalls you…$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro
source: Hohoho.\pYou need me to show you how tenacious\nthe PSYCHIC type can be.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateDefeat
source: Oh! My, my!\nYour battle style is fantastic!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle
source: I… I don't let defeat rattle m-me,\nhowever b-badly.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenIntro
source: Let me show you a perfectly awful,\nhorrifying time!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenDefeat
source: N-nooooo!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenPostBattle
source: Your vitality is contagious!\nGet away from me quickly!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordIntro
source: I may be past my prime, but I suggest\nyou not patronize me.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordDefeat
source: Ah, you overflow with the power\nof youth!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordPostBattle
source: It seems that I could not overcome\nyour youthful energy.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyIntro
source: You're not getting through to the end!\nNot if I can help it!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyDefeat
source: How could you be so ludicrously\nstrong?$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyPostBattle
source: Humph! You may be strong, but you're\nnot suitable for the PSYCHIC type!\pThe way you battle is somehow brutal!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasIntro
source: Wroooar! Have a taste of my super\nPOKéMON hard-battling power!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasDefeat
source: Oh!\nDone in!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasPostBattle
source: All right! I think I'll develop a special\ninvincible POKéMON power next.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
source:
TATE: Hehehe… Were you surprised?\pLIZA: Fufufu… Were you surprised?\pTATE: That there are two GYM LEADERS?
LIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?\pTATE: We're twins!
LIZA: We're twins!\pTATE: We don't need to talk because…
LIZA: We can each determine what…\pTATE: The other is thinking…
LIZA: All in our minds!\pTATE: This combination of ours…
LIZA: Can you beat it?$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaDefeat
source: TATE: What?! Our combination…\nLIZA: Was shattered!\pTATE: It can't be helped. You've won…\nLIZA: So, in recognition, take this.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedMindBadge
source: {PLAYER} received the MIND BADGE\nfrom TATE and LIZA.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMindBadgeTakeThis
source: TATE: The MIND BADGE enhances the\nSP. ATK and SP. DEF of POKéMON.\pLIZA: It also lets you use the HM move\nDIVE outside of battle.\pTATE: You should also take this, too.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCalmMind
source:
TATE: That TM04 contains…
LIZA: CALM MIND!\pTATE: It raises SP. ATK and…
LIZA: It raises SP. DEF!\pTATE: It's a move that's perfect…
LIZA: For PSYCHIC POKéMON!\p… … … … … …$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredTateAndLiza
source: Registered GYM LEADERS TATE & LIZA\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostBattle
source: TATE: Looks like the bond between you\nand your POKéMON is far stronger than\lthe bond that we share as twins.\pLIZA: You will become even stronger!\nWe've battled you, so we know.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaNeedTwoMons
source: TATE: Hehehe… Were you surprised?\pLIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?\pTATE: Oops, you have only one…\nLIZA: POKéMON that can battle.\pTATE: We can't battle that way!\pLIZA: If you want to challenge us,\nbring some more POKéMON.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM\pLIZA AND TATE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPreRematch
source:
TATE: POKéMON…
LIZA: POKéMON…\pTATE: By changing the party's mix…
LIZA: The battle style changes.\pTATE: But me…
LIZA: But me…\pTATE: I'll always be with LIZA!
LIZA: I'll always be with TATE!\pTATE: Our combination…
LIZA: We'll show you again and again!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematchDefeat
source: TATE: You and your POKéMON…\nLIZA: It's as if you were siblings!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostRematch
source: TATE: You can knock us down,\nbut we'll never stay down!\pLIZA: Because the two of us,\nwe always support each other!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematchNeedTwoMons
source:
TATE: You're back again…
LIZA: You're back again…\pTATE: To give us a rematch.
LIZA: To give us a rematch.\pTATE: But…
LIZA: For our match…\pTATE: You brought just one POKéMON!
LIZA: You brought just one POKéMON!\pTATE: We need you to bring at least…
LIZA: Two POKéMON when you come back.$

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_HmmYourPokemon
source: Hmm!\nYour {STR_VAR_1}…$

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_ItLikesXPokeblocks
source: It likes {STR_VAR_1}S,\ndoesn't it?\pNo, I'm positive of it! It definitely\nlikes {STR_VAR_1}S!$

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_DoesntLikeOrDislikePokeblocks
source: It doesn't appear to like or dislike\nany {POKEBLOCK}S.$

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_HusbandCanTellPokeblockMonLikes
source: My husband can tell what kind of\n{POKEBLOCK}S a POKéMON likes at a glance.$

label: MossdeepCity_House2_Text_SisterMailsBoyfriendInFortree
source: My little sister exchanges MAIL with\nher boyfriend in FORTREE.\pI don't envy her one bit at all.$

label: MossdeepCity_House2_Text_PokemonCarriesMailBackAndForth
source: Even though I can't see my friend in\nFORTREE, my POKéMON carries MAIL\lback and forth for us.\pI'm not lonesome, even though we're\napart.$

label: MossdeepCity_House2_Text_Wingull
source: WINGULL: Pihyoh!$

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_YouWantSuperRod
source:
Hey there, TRAINER!
A SUPER ROD really is super!\pSay all you want, but this baby can
catch POKéMON off the seafloor!\pWhat do you think?
You want it, don't you?$

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_SuperRodIsSuper
source: You bet, you bet!\nAfter all, a SUPER ROD is really super!$

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_TryDroppingRodInWater
source: If there's any water, try dropping in\nyour ROD and see what bites!$

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_DontYouLikeToFish
source: Hunh?\nDon't you like to fish?$

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_GoAfterSeafloorPokemon
source: Go after the seafloor POKéMON with\nyour SUPER ROD.$

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToFindBases
source: My little brother says he likes to go\nfind people's SECRET BASES.$

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToVisitBasesAndBattle
source: My little brother says he likes to\nvisit people's SECRET BASES and have\lPOKéMON battles.$

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_YouMadeSecretBaseNearX
source: Was it you who made a SECRET BASE\nnear {STR_VAR_1}?$

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_MakeSecretBase
source: You should make a SECRET BASE\nsomewhere. I'll go find it!$

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_Skitty
source: SKITTY: Miyaan?$

label: MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_ReviveIsFantastic
source: REVIVE is fantastic!\pGive it to a fainted POKéMON,\nand the POKéMON will arise.\pBut be careful, REVIVE doesn't restore\nthe used-up PP of moves.$

label: MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_MaxRepelLastsLongest
source: MAX REPEL keeps all weak POKéMON away.\pOut of all the REPEL sprays, it lasts\nthe longest.$

label: MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_NetAndDiveBallsRare
source:
The NET and DIVE BALLS are rare POKé
BALLS that are only made in MOSSDEEP.\pA NET BALL is effective against
BUG-type and WATER-type POKéMON.\pA DIVE BALL works best on POKéMON
at the bottom of the sea.$

label: MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GymLeaderDuoFormidable
source: The GYM LEADERS in this town are\na formidable duo.\pTheir combination attacks are, like,\nexcellent and wow!$

label: MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AbilitiesMightChangeMoves
source: Depending on the special abilities of\nPOKéMON, some moves might change\lor not work at all.$

label: MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_2F_Text_Woman5
source: If I win a whole lot of link battles\nand show everyone how good I am,\lI might get a fan following!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketLaunchImminent
source: The rocket's launch is imminent!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_SuccessfulLaunchNumber
source: The rocket launched safely!\nThat's successful launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButRocketLaunchImminent
source: I know that things are a little\nhaywire right now, but…\pThe rocket's launch is imminent!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButSuccessfulLaunchNumber
source: I know that things are a little\nhaywire right now, but…\pThe rocket launched safely!\nThat's successful launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketLaunchDemandsPerfection
source:
A rocket launch demands perfection.
Not even a 1% margin of error is allowed.\pEven if it's 99% okay, the whole thing
is useless if 1% happens to be no good.\pDespite that, we never stop trying.
Why? It's a dream that never ends.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaHaveSightsOnSpaceCenter
source: Those MAGMA thugs have their sights\nset on our SPACE CENTER.\pBut we can't allow anything that minor\nto interfere with our rocket launch!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_FoundThisYouCanHaveIt
source: I was taking a stroll down the beach\nwhen I found this.\pIt's not anything I need, so you can\nhave it.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HoennFamousForMeteorShowers
source: The HOENN region has been famous for \nits meteor showers for a long time.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaCantStealFuelTakeThis
source: TEAM MAGMA can't be allowed to steal\nthe rocket fuel.\pOh, by the way, you can have this stone\nI found on the beach.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_CantStrollOnBeachWithMagma
source: With TEAM MAGMA around, I guess\nstrolls on the beach aren't safe.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_DidPokemonComeFromSpace
source: Some people claim that POKéMON came\nfrom space. Could it be true?$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_AquaShouldBeatMagma
source: TEAM AQUA should take care of\nTEAM MAGMA!\pBut if they did that, TEAM AQUA will\nbecome bold and brazen, won't they?$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketsBoggleMyMind
source: A giant chunk of metal bursts through\nthe skies and flies into space…\pIt boggles my mind!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaWantsToSpoilMyDream
source: A giant chunk of metal bursts through\nthe skies and flies into space…\pBut TEAM MAGMA wants to spoil\nthat dream of mine!\pI'm not having any of that!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenMagmaCantBeAllowedToTakeFuel
source:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, have you read that
proclamation already?\pTEAM MAGMA is coming after the rocket
fuel on this island.\pI don't know what they'd need it for,
but they can't be allowed to take it.\pI'll keep an eye on things for
a while longer.\pIn the meantime, why don't you go
check out the town?$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
source: As promised, we've come for\nthe rocket fuel!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
source: Ran out of fuel…$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
source: Don't think you're on a roll just\nbecause you've beaten me!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: We gave you fair warning!\nThere's nothing sneaky about us!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: Grrr…\nWe should've used sneaky treachery…$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: Okay, I get it already! The next time,\nwe'll come unannounced.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4Intro
source: The rocket fuel the SPACE CENTER has\nin storage--that's what we're after.\pWe mean to take every last bit of it!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
source: Please, can you spare some fuel?\nEven a chintzy cup will do!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
source: What are we going to do with\nthe rocket fuel?\pHow would I know?\nAsk our leader upstairs!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
source: Our leader said no one, but no one,\ngets past me!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: Ack! Ack! Aaack!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: Please, tell our leader that\nI never abandoned my post.\lThat I stayed to the bitter end…$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIntentToStealNotice
source:
This is…
An intent-to-steal notice?\p“To the staff of the SPACE CENTER:
How are you? We are doing fine.\p“We will soon visit you to take your
rocket fuel.\p“Please don't try to stop us.
We will take the fuel no matter what.\p“Let there be more land!
                                          TEAM MAGMA”$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MossdeepIdealForRockets
source: MOSSDEEP has mainly sunny weather,\nand its winds are stable.\pIt's an ideal location for launching\nrockets.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WhyWouldMagmaStealRocketFuel
source: Why would TEAM MAGMA want to steal\nour rocket fuel in the first place?$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WouldveLikedToBeAstronaut
source: If only I was a little younger, I would\nhave liked being an astronaut…\pNo… It's not too late!\nI can and will try!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MagmaCantGetAwayWithThis
source: If TEAM MAGMA takes the rocket fuel,\nI won't be able to go to space!\pThey can't be allowed to get away\nwith such an outrage!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WishOrdinaryPeopleCouldGoIntoSpace
source: I wish ordinary people could go into\nspace one day…$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_DoesMagmaWantToGoToSpace
source: TEAM MAGMA…\nDo they want to go to space, too?$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_YoureOutnumberedTakeUsOn
source: What's wrong with you?\pYou're outnumbered three to one,\nbut you still want to take us on?$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_GoodAnswer
source: Good answer!\nThat's what a smart person'll do!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5Intro
source: A reckless go-getter, are you?\nOkay, I'll go first!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
source: I lost!\nBut!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6Intro
source: It's too soon to be relieved!\nI'm up next!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6Defeat
source: I lost, too!\nBut!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7Intro
source: I bet you want to take a break.\nBut I'm not about to let you do that!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7Defeat
source: We should've taken a break…\nThat's what we should've done…$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
source: Three of us here, and look at the sorry\nmess we got ourselves into.$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
source: We three losing like this…\nWe look worse than usual by triple!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
source: Are we being useful to our leader\nat all?$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WellTakeCareOfYou
source: Hehehe!\pWe come all the way here to get some\nfuel, and we're interfered with again!\pIf you're going to mess with us too,\nwe'll take care of you at the same time!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieDontInterfere
source: MAXIE: Clear out of the way!\nDon't you dare interfere!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenWhyStealRocketFuel
source: STEVEN: TEAM MAGMA…\pWhat's the point of stealing rocket\nfuel?$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieUseFuelToEruptVolcano
source:
MAXIE: Fufufu… Since you're so
curious, you deserve an explanation.\pWe're going to jettison the entire
load into MT. CHIMNEY!\pWith GROUDON gone, we have no need
for that slag heap of a mountain!\pSo we'll use the fuel's power to make
the volcano erupt!\pIt will be savage!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenAreYouReadyToBattle
source: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nYou're going to help me?\pLet's go into battle together!\nAre you ready?$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenHurryGetReadyQuickly
source: STEVEN: Then, hurry!\nGet ready quickly!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_JustWantToExpandLand
source: All I want…\nI just want to expand the land mass…$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_Text_TabithaDefeat
source: I'm with our leader…$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWeFailedIsAquaAlsoMisguided
source:
MAXIE: We failed to make the volcano
erupt…\pWe failed to control GROUDON after
we had awoken it…\pIs our goal to expand the land
misguided?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pIf…
If we, TEAM MAGMA, are wrong…\l… … … … … …\pThen might TEAM AQUA's goal to expand
the sea also be equally misguided?$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWeWillGiveUp
source: MAXIE: All right…\nWe will give up on the fuel…\pThere appear to be more important\nmatters that I must examine…$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenThankYouComeSeeMeAtHome
source:
STEVEN: Whew, that was too tense.
{PLAYER}{KUN}, thank you.\pI have something to give you as
thanks for your support.\pPlease come see me at home
after this.\pOh, yes, I don't live in RUSTBORO CITY.
I live right here on this island.$

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_YouveEarnedHMDive
source:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pAs you can see, there's not much here,
but this is my home.\pThank you for all that you've done.\pThis is my token of appreciation.
It's the HIDDEN MACHINE DIVE.\pNo need to be shy--you've earned
this HM.$

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ExplainDive
source:
STEVEN: While you're using SURF, you
should notice dark patches of water.\pUse DIVE if you come to deep water
like it. You'll drop to the seafloor.\pWhen you want to come back up, use
DIVE again.\pIn some places, it won't be possible
for you to surface, though.$

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_UnderwateCavernBetweenMossdeepSootopolis
source: STEVEN: Apparently, there's an\nunderwater cavern between\lMOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS.\pYou know, the one that CAPT. STERN\nfound in his submarine.$

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_TakeBallContainingBeldum
source: {PLAYER} checked the POKé BALL.\pIt contained the POKéMON\nBELDUM.\pTake the POKé BALL?$

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ObtainedBeldum
source: {PLAYER} obtained a BELDUM.$

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_NoSpaceForAnotherMon
source: There is no space for another POKéMON.$

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LeftPokeBallWhereItWas
source: {PLAYER} left the POKé BALL where\nit was.$

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
source:
It's a letter.\p… … … … … …\pTo {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pI've decided to do a little soul-
searching and train on the road.\pI don't plan to return home for some
time.\pI have a favor to ask of you.\pI want you to take the POKé BALL on
the desk.\pInside it is a BELDUM, my favorite
POKéMON.\pI'm counting on you.\pMay our paths cross someday.\pSTEVEN STONE$

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_CollectionOfRareRocks
source: It's a collection of rare rocks and\nstones assembled by STEVEN.$

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteWillActivateVolcano
source: The power contained in the METEORITE…\pBy amplifying its power with this\nmachine, MT. CHIMNEY's volcanic\lactivity will instantly intensify…\pIts energy will grow deep inside\nthe crater and…\lFufufu…$

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
source:
MAXIE: Hm?
Who are you?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pI'd heard ARCHIE bemoaning a child
who's been meddling in TEAM AQUA's\laffairs.\pIt must be you he meant.\pHumph! So you're thinking of
interfering with us, TEAM MAGMA?\pNow you listen.
Long ago, living things used the\lland to live and grow.\pThat is why land is all important!
It is the cradle of all!\pThat is why TEAM MAGMA is dedicated
to the expansion of the land mass.\pIt is for further advancement of
humankind and POKéMON!\pAnd for that, we need the power of
what sleeps within this mountain…\pOh! There was no need for you to
learn that much.\pBut, no matter!
I'll teach you the consequences of\lmeddling in our grand design!$

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieDefeat
source: What?!\pI, MAXIE, was caught off guard?!$

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieYouHaventSeenLastOfMagma
source:
MAXIE: But, enough.
I will back off this time.\pBut don't think that this is the last
you've seen of TEAM MAGMA.\pFufufu…\pEven without the METEORITE, if we
obtain that ORB… Fufufu…$

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaIntro
source: Hehehe!\pSo you've come all the way here!\pBut you're too late!\nI've already delivered the METEORITE\lfrom METEOR FALLS to the BOSS!$

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaDefeat
source: Hehehe…\pEven though I've lost, if our leader\nawakens that thing…$

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaPostBattle
source: BOSS, hurry!\nGive it the METEORITE's energy!\pHehehe…$

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Intro
source: We of TEAM MAGMA are working hard for\neveryone's sake.\pLike, if that thing's power made more\nland, there'd be more places to live.\pEveryone'd be happy!$

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: Hunh?\nWhat do you mean I lost?$

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: Our BOSS says, “It will make everyone\nhappy.”\pBut why does everyone keep getting\nin our way?$

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: If there were more land, I'd be able\nto get a big house of my own!\pI'm going to build it on hardened lava!$

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: My dream of a big house…$

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: A kid like you, you ought to be\nsplashing about in the waves!$

label: MtChimney_Text_TeamAquaAlwaysMessingWithPlans
source: That annoying TEAM AQUA…\nThey always mess with our plans!$

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoritesPackAmazingPower
source: METEORITES pack amazing power!$

label: MtChimney_Text_YouBetterNotMessWithUs
source: You'd better not mess with us!\pWe're trying to awaken that thing\nfor the benefit of everyone!$

label: MtChimney_Text_AquasNameSimilar
source: We're TEAM MAGMA!\pThey're TEAM AQUA!\pIt totally annoys me that they'd\nuse a name like ours!$

label: MtChimney_Text_DouseThemInFire
source: Yeah!\nDouse them in fire!$

label: MtChimney_Text_KeepMakingMoreLand
source: We're going to keep making more land!$

label: MtChimney_Text_Bufoh
source: Bufoh!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieGoStopTeamMagma
source:
ARCHIE: Grr, {PLAYER}!
I should've guessed you'd show up!\pSee for yourself what the fanatics
of TEAM MAGMA are up to!\pThey're trying to inject the stolen
METEORITE's power into the volcano!\pDoing something like that will cause
the volcano's eruption!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieIHaveMyHandsFull
source: ARCHIE: Grrr…\pI want to stop that MAXIE,\nbut I can't!\pNot when I have my hands full battling\nthree opponents at once!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou
source:
ARCHIE: {PLAYER}!
Thank you!\pWith your help, we thwarted TEAM
MAGMA's destructive plan!\pBut… You…
Whose side are you on?\pAh, it doesn't matter.\pWe will remain vigilant and keep up
our pursuit of TEAM MAGMA.\p{PLAYER}, we shall meet again!$

label: MtChimney_Text_MagmaOutnumbersUs
source: Darn… TEAM MAGMA outnumbers us!\nWe can't keep up with them!$

label: MtChimney_Text_LessHabitatForWaterPokemon
source: If they expand the land, there'll be\nless habitats for WATER POKéMON!$

label: MtChimney_Text_MagmasNameSimilar
source: We're TEAM AQUA!\pThey're TEAM MAGMA!\pIt burns me up that they'd use such\na confusing name!$

label: MtChimney_Text_Bushaa
source: Bushaa!$

label: MtChimney_Text_LavaCookiesJust200
source: LAVA COOKIES are MT. CHIMNEY's local\nspecialty.\pTry one. It's just ¥200.$

label: MtChimney_Text_ThankYouDear
source: Thank you, dear!$

label: MtChimney_Text_YouveNotGotTheMoney
source: Oh, dear. You can't buy a thing if\nyou've not got the money.$

label: MtChimney_Text_OhFineThen
source: Oh, fine then.$

label: MtChimney_Text_MetoriteFittedOnMachine
source: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious\nmachine…\pThe machine seems to be storing\nenergy in the METEORITE.$

label: MtChimney_Text_RemoveTheMeteorite
source: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious\nmachine…\pDo you want to remove the METEORITE?$

label: MtChimney_Text_PlayerRemovedMeteorite
source: {PLAYER} removed the METEORITE from\nthe mysterious machine.$

label: MtChimney_Text_PlayerLeftMeteorite
source: {PLAYER} left the METEORITE where\nit was.$

label: MtChimney_Text_MachineMakesNoResponse
source: This mysterious machine…\nIt makes no response whatsoever.$

label: MtChimney_Text_RouteSign
source: {DOWN_ARROW} JAGGED PATH\nLAVARIDGE TOWN AHEAD$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyIntro
source: I've been to the hot springs and\nrefreshed my tired bones.\lRight now I'm feeling strong!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyDefeat
source: Oh, my goodness.\nNow, aren't you something!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyPostBattle
source: Well, well, I've lost. I can't call\nmyself an EXPERT now, can I?$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRegister
source: Thank you, child. It was fun, as if\nI were battling my own grandchild.\pPlease, come see me again for\na rematch.$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchIntro
source: If you can mesh your heart with those\nof your POKéMON, why, you should be\lable to achieve great things.$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchDefeat
source: Oh, my goodness.\nNow, aren't you something!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyPostRematch
source: Perhaps your heart has become one\nwith the hearts of your POKéMON.$

label: MtChimney_Text_MelissaIntro
source: I've got the fire in me, baby.\nI can't stand it! I have to battle!$

label: MtChimney_Text_MelissaDefeat
source: Ooh, that was a scorching-hot match!$

label: MtChimney_Text_MelissaPostBattle
source: The heat of MT. CHIMNEY warms\nme up, baby!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaIntro
source: I've finally made it to MT. CHIMNEY.\nI want to make my POKéMON battle!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaDefeat
source: The way you battle…\nIt's like a MT. CHIMNEY eruption!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaPostBattle
source: Like I said, I've finally made it to\nMT. CHIMNEY. It would be a shame if\lI only do a little sightseeing…\pI want to get in some battles and buy\nCOOKIES as souvenirs.$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyIntro
source: Since I bathed in the hot springs,\nI've been feeling great!\lI'm sure I'm going to win!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyDefeat
source: Yowch!\nI'm getting a chill out of the water.$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyPostBattle
source: I'll have to take another dip in the\nhot springs. Want to join me?\pJust joking!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerIntro
source: This is one fine mountain! Plenty of\nhot people around for company!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerDefeat
source: Oh, you're a real firebrand, too!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerPostBattle
source: I think I need a dip in LAVARIDGE\nHOT SPRING with the locals!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerRegister
source: I like little fireballs like you.\nLet me register you in my POKéNAV.$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchIntro
source: I'm happily surrounded by hot people\naround these parts. I won't lose!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchDefeat
source: Gosh, you're still the same\nfirebrand as before!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerPostRematch
source: Actually, it really is hot here.\nI'm overdressed for these parts.$

label: MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_CableCarReadyGetOn
source: The CABLE CAR is ready to go down.\nWould you like to be on it?$

label: MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_StepThisWay
source: Please step this way.$

label: MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_RideAnotherTime
source: Please ride with us another time.$

label: Text_ExplosionTeach
source:
Can you imagine?
If this volcano were to erupt?\pThe explosion would be the end of
us. How terrifying is that?\pWhile we're terrified, would you
like me to teach EXPLOSION?$

label: Text_ExplosionDeclined
source: Yeah, you're right.\nIt is too terrifying.$

label: Text_ExplosionWhichMon
source: You're terribly brave!\pWhich POKéMON should I teach\nEXPLOSION?$

label: Text_ExplosionTaught
source: Using EXPLOSION while on this\nvolcano…\pWhat a terrifying thrill!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WellTryDiggingHere
source: Over here.\nWe'll try digging here.\pThat treasure the ADMINS've been\ntalking about should be here.$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_YoureInTheWayGetLost
source: What the…?\nYou're in the way. Get lost.$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_PunchedThroughAtLast
source: Whew, punched through at last.\nLet's go treasure hunting!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WhatsPasswordAgain
source: Any treasure we find, we haul back\nto the WAREHOUSE, understood?\p…Oh, and what're the passwords?\nAt the ROCKET WAREHOUSE, I mean.$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_FirstPasswordGoldeen
source: What, you forgot the password?\nThere're actually two.\pThe first one's “GOLDEEN need\nlog.”\pAnd the second one is…$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_SnoopsBeenListeningIn
source: Hey!\nThis snoop's been listening in!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: You've been eavesdropping on us,\nhaven't you?$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: Huh, what?$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: Why'd you have to win?$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2Intro
source: Trying to horn in on our treasure?\nDon't bet on it!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: Wait!\nBut how?$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: Develop amnesia conveniently and\nforget everything you heard!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WellRegroupDontStepInsideThere
source:
What a setback…
We'll have to regroup.\pYou! Don't even think about taking
a step inside here!\pIf you know what's good for you,
don't even think about this!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganIntro
source: An active volcano is one that's\nerupting, or about to.$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganDefeat
source: Whew… That was hot!\nSweat's erupting from me!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganPostBattle
source: They say there're over 1,500\nactive volcanoes in the world.\pJust thinking about them makes me\nfeel all hot and gooey inside!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_BethIntro
source: Do you know how caves form inside\nvolcanoes?$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_BethDefeat
source: Atchah!\nYou're shockingly good!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_BethPostBattle
source: When lava at the surface of magma\nhardens, and the magma inside flows\lout, caverns are left behind.$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynIntro
source: I've been in training so I can mend\nmy broken heart…\pIt toughened me up physically at\nleast! Hi-yah!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynDefeat
source: I think I tried to overdo it…$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynPostBattle
source: The way you battle, it reminds me\nof the guy who dumped me…$

label: MtEmber_RubyPath_B3F_Text_FoundARuby
source: {PLAYER} found a RUBY!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosIntro
source: WHOA!\nYou shocked me!\l…Oh, you're just a kid!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosDefeat
source: Wow!\nShocked again!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosPostBattle
source: Kids like you shouldn't be\nwandering around here in the dark.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JoshIntro
source: Did you come to explore the cave,\ntoo?$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JoshDefeat
source: Losing stinks!\nIt's so uncool.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JoshPostBattle
source: I came all the way down here to\nshow off to girls.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MiriamIntro
source: Wow! It's way bigger in here than\nI thought!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MiriamDefeat
source: Oh!\nI lost it!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MiriamPostBattle
source: How do you get out of here?\nIt's so big, I may get lost.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JovanIntro
source: What!\nDon't sneak up on me!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JovanDefeat
source: My POKéMON won't do!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JovanPostBattle
source: I have to find stronger POKéMON.\nWhere might they be?$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_IrisIntro
source: What?\nI'm waiting for my friends to find\lme here.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_IrisDefeat
source: I lost?$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_IrisPostBattle
source: I came because I heard there are\nsome very rare fossils here.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_KentIntro
source: Suspicious men are in the cave.\nWhat about you?$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_KentDefeat
source: You got me!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_KentPostBattle
source: I saw them!\nI'm sure they're from TEAM ROCKET!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyIntro
source: You need to go through this cave\nto get to CERULEAN CITY.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyDefeat
source: I lost.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyPostBattle
source: ZUBAT is tough!\nBut if you can catch one, you'll\lbe able to count on it.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_ZubatIsABloodsucker
source: Beware!\nZUBAT is a bloodsucker!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_BrockHelpsExcavateFossils
source: Hi, I'm excavating for fossils here\nunder MT. MOON.\pSometimes, BROCK of PEWTER GYM\nlends me a hand.$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_MiguelIntro
source: Hey, stop!\pI found these fossils!\nThey're both mine!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_MiguelDefeat
source: Okay!\nI'll share!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_WellEachTakeAFossil
source: We'll each take a fossil!\nNo being greedy!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_ThenThisFossilIsMine
source: All right.\nThen this fossil is mine!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_LabOnCinnabarRegeneratesFossils
source: Far away, on CINNABAR ISLAND,\nthere's a POKéMON LAB.\pThey do research on regenerating\nfossils.$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: We, TEAM ROCKET, shall find the\nfossils!\pReviving POKéMON from them will\nearn us huge riches!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: Urgh!\nNow I'm mad!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: You made me mad!\nTEAM ROCKET will blacklist you!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt2Intro
source: We, TEAM ROCKET, are POKéMON\ngangsters!\lWe strike fear with our strength!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: I blew it!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: Darn it all!\nMy associates won't stand for this!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt3Intro
source: We're pulling a big job here!\nGet lost, kid!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
source: So, you are good…$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
source: If you find a fossil, give it to me\nand scram!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt4Intro
source: Little kids shouldn't be messing\naround with grown-ups!\pIt could be bad news!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
source: I'm steamed!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
source: POKéMON lived here long before\npeople came.$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_YouWantDomeFossil
source: Do you want the DOME FOSSIL?$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_YouWantHelixFossil
source: Do you want the HELIX FOSSIL?$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_ObtainedHelixFossil
source: Obtained the HELIX FOSSIL!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_ObtainedDomeFossil
source: Obtained the DOME FOSSIL!$

label: MtMoon_Cave_Text_Rival_Before
source: ..................................\pIt's been a while, {PLAYER}.\p…Since I lost to you, I thought about\nwhat I was lacking with my POKéMON…\pAnd we came up with an answer.\p{PLAYER}, now we'll show you!$

label: MtMoon_Cave_Text_Rival_Win
source: ..................................\pI thought I raised my POKéMON to be the\nbest they could be…\p…But it still wasn't enough…$

label: MtMoon_Cave_Text_Rival_After
source: ..................................\p…You won, fair and square.\pI admit it. But this isn't the end.\pI'm going to be the greatest POKéMON\ntrainer ever.\pBecause these guys are behind me.\p…Listen, {PLAYER}.\pOne of these days I'm going to prove\nhow good I am by beating you.$

label: MtMoon_Cave_Text_Rival_Loss
source: ..................................\pI've repaid my debt to you.\pWith my POKéMON, I'm going to beat the\nCHAMPION and become the world's greatest\ntrainer.$

label: MtMoon_Cave_Text_Sign
source: MT MOON SQUARE ->$

label: MtMoon_Outside_Text_WhiteRockTouchIt
source: An unusual white rock.\nThe color reminds you of the moon.\pTouch it?$

label: MtMoon_Outside_Text_WhiteRockTouchDay
source: {PLAYER} touched the unusual rock.\n..........................\l..........................\lBut nothing happened.$

label: MtMoon_Outside_Text_DontLitterSign
source: MT.MOON SQUARE\nDON'T LITTER$

label: MtMoon_Outside_Text_Jirachi
source: JIRACHI: Chi!$

label: MtMoon_Outside_Text_Clefairy
source: CLEFAIRY: Pi pippippi!$

label: MtMoon_Shop_Text_GiftShopLass
source: When the sun goes down, CLEFAIRY\ncome out to play.$

label: MountMortar2_Text_PokemaniacMillerSeen
source: I'm not losing this time!$

label: MountMortar2_Text_PokemaniacMillerBeaten
source: I lost to some kid...?$

label: MountMortar2_Text_PokemaniacMillerAfter
source:
A while back, this karate dude
wanted to battle.\pHe was ridiculously good.
He just thrashed us silly.\pHe went in deeper saying it
was for his training.\pI wonder how he is?$

label: MountMortar2_Text_SupernerdMarkusSeen
source: Hey! HUGH!$

label: MountMortar2_Text_SupernerdMarkusBeaten
source: I mistook you for someone\nelse…$

label: MountMortar2_Text_SupernerdMarkusAfter
source: I came to explore MT.MORTAR,\nbut I got separated from my\lpartner…\pDid you run into a trainer\nwho uses a SEADRA that knows\lWATERFALL?$

label: MtMortar_2F_Text_SupernerdHughSeen
source: Yo! MARKUS!$

label: MtMortar_2F_Text_SupernerdHughBeaten
source: Sorry, my mistake.\nI misjudged you.$

label: MtMortar_2F_Text_SupernerdHughAfter
source: I'm investigating MT.MORTAR,\nbut my pal's gone AWOL.\pHave you seen a trainer who\nhas a SLOWPOKE that can use\lSTRENGTH?$

label: MountMortar4_Text_KiyoIntro
source: Hey!\pI am the KARATE KING!\nI train alone here in the dark!\pYou! Battle with me!\nHwaaarggh!$

label: MountMortar4_Text_KiyoWin
source: Waaaarggh!\nI'm beaten!$

label: MountMortar4_Text_KiyoTyrogueReward
source:
I... I'm crushed...\pMy training is still not
enough...\pBut a loss is a loss.
I admit it.\pAs proof that you defeated me,
I'll give you a rare fighting\lPOKéMON.$

label: MountMortar4_Text_ReceiveTyrogue
source: {PLAYER} received TYROGUE.$

label: MountMortar4_Text_KiyoGotTyrogue
source: TYROGUE is a FIGHTING-type.\pIt evolves into a tougher\nPOKéMON.\pKeep up the hard work.\nI'll keep training too.\pFarewell!$

label: MountMortar4_Text_KiyoFullParty
source: You have no room in your party!$

label: MtPyre_1F_Text_TakeThisForYourOwnGood
source: All sorts of beings wander the slopes\nof MT. PYRE…\pThere is no telling what may happen.\nTake this. It's for your own good.$

label: MtPyre_1F_Text_ExplainCleanseTag
source: Have a POKéMON hold that\nCLEANSE TAG.\pIt will help ward off wild POKéMON.$

label: MtPyre_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespects
source: Did you come to pay your respect\nto the spirits of departed POKéMON?\pYou must care for your POKéMON a lot.$

label: MtPyre_1F_Text_RestingPlaceOfZigzagoon
source: This is the final resting place of my\nZIGZAGOON. I cherished it…$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MemoriesOfSkitty
source: Memories of my darling SKITTY…\nMy eyes overflow thinking about it.$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_TumbledFromFloorAbove
source: Ooch, ouch… There are holes in the\nground here and there.\pI didn't notice and took a tumble from\nthe floor above.$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkIntro
source: Hey! Are you searching for POKéMON?\nYou came along after me! You're rude!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkDefeat
source: Ayieeeeh!\nI'm sorry, forgive me, please!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkPostBattle
source: People don't come here often, so\nI thought there'd be rare POKéMON.$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeIntro
source: LUKE: We're here on a dare.\pHeheh, if I show her how cool I am,\nshe'll fall for me. I know it!\pI know! I'll cream you and show her\nhow cool I am!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeDefeat
source: LUKE: Whoopsie!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukePostBattle
source: LUKE: Well, we lost but that's okay!\nI'm right here by your side.\lWe'll make it through this dare!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeNotEnoughMons
source: LUKE: If you want to take me on,\nbring some more POKéMON.\pIf you don't, I won't be able to show\noff to my girl how cool I am!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezIntro
source:
DEZ: I came here on a dare with my
boyfriend.\pIt's really scary, but I'm with my
boyfriend. It's okay.\pI know! I'll get my boyfriend to look
cool by beating you!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezDefeat
source: DEZ: Waaaah! I'm scared!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezPostBattle
source: DEZ: We're lovey-dovey, so we don't\ncare if we lose!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezNotEnoughMons
source: DEZ: If you want to challenge us, you\nshould bring at least two POKéMON.\pMy boyfriend's strong.\nJust one POKéMON won't do at all.$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahIntro
source: You are an unfamiliar sight…\nDepart before anything befalls you!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahDefeat
source: Hmm…\nYou're durable.$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahPostBattle
source: Our family has been TRAINERS here\nsince my great-grandmother's time…\pIt is my duty to protect this\nmountain…$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderIntro
source: Kiyaaaaah!\nI'm terrified!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderDefeat
source: Nooooooo!\nI lost my wits!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderPostBattle
source: I get freaked out every time I see\nanything move…\pI shouldn't have come here to train…$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamIntro
source: The rich atmosphere of the mountain\nhas elevated my psychic power!\pA mere child like you…\nYou dream of winning?$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamDefeat
source: I drown in self-pity…$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamPostBattle
source: My psychic powers have surely\ngrown several times, but…$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaIntro
source: Ahahahaha!\pThis is no place for children, least\nof all you!$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaDefeat
source: I lost that cleanly…$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaPostBattle
source: This means my training is still not\nenough…\pI've got to keep working toward the\nsummit…\pGo, me!$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleIntro
source: Why have you come here?$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleDefeat
source: That was amazing!\nYou're a very special TRAINER.$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostBattle
source:
POKéMON no longer of this world.
POKéMON that are with you now.\pAnd the POKéMON that you will meet
in the future…\pThey are all to be equally cherished.
Please remember that.$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRegister
source: I would like to see your POKéMON\nwhen they grow up some more…\pPlease, I need to see your POKéNAV.$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchIntro
source: Oh, it's you…\pHave you come to show me your grown\nPOKéMON?$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchDefeat
source: How amazing!\nYou are a special person.$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostRematch
source:
POKéMON no longer of this world.
POKéMON that are with you now.\pAnd the POKéMON that you will meet
in the future…\pThey are all to be equally cherished.
I see that you've remembered that.$

label: MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiIntro
source: Teacher…\nPlease watch over my progress!$

label: MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiDefeat
source: Teacher…\nPlease forgive me!$

label: MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiPostBattle
source: Until I improve, my teacher, who rests\nhere, will never find true peace…$

label: MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaIntro
source: I love all things horrifying…\nIt's like a disease…\pWhen I'm here…\nI shiver with fear…$

label: MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaDefeat
source: Losing, I dislike…$

label: MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaPostBattle
source: I want to see dreadful things…\nI can't leave…\pStay…\nWon't you stay with me?$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieIntro
source: When I'm here…\nA curious power flows into me…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieDefeat
source: The power is ebbing away…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValeriePostBattle
source: Perhaps the power is from the spirits\nof POKéMON in fitful sleep here…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRegister
source: Fufufu… I lost the match, but…\nI have this little ability…\pWithout ever laying my hands on\nyour POKéNAV… Hiyah!$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRematchIntro
source: Behind you…\nWhat is it…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRematchDefeat
source: Something faded away…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValeriePostRematch
source: The POKéMON at rest here…\nSometimes, they play…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricIntro
source: Have you lost your bearings?\nHave no fear for I am here!$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricDefeat
source: Weren't you lost?$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricPostBattle
source: I had this feeling that a lost TRAINER\nwould be panicked and easy to beat.\pIt's dirty and I won't try it again…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: No! Those TEAM MAGMA goons got\nhere ahead of us!\pWe can't fall behind!$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: I thought you were one of the MAGMAS\nwho happened to come back…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: Yeah, so you are strong…\nBut there're a lot of us!$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Intro
source:
Hah!
Too bad for you!\pIf you came earlier, you only would've
had to battle the wimpy TEAM MAGMA.\pBut since you arrived now, you have
to take on us toughies!$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: Urgh… I should've let you take on\nTEAM MAGMA first…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: You don't know anything!\nSo why are you messing with us?$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Intro
source: You…\nWe saw you at MT. CHIMNEY.\pYou don't belong to either TEAM,\nso why would you be here?$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Defeat
source: If you're going to mess with anyone,\nlet it be TEAM MAGMA…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
source: Heh, it doesn't matter!\nWe bought ourselves some time!\pThe BOSS should have snatched what\nhe was after!$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Intro
source: Oh, I know!\nYou tried to join TEAM MAGMA,\lbut they wouldn't have you!\pWell, don't think that we'll let you\njoin our TEAM AQUA!$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Defeat
source: If you want to join TEAM AQUA that\nbadly, we can consider it…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
source: We have a great combination going\nwith us members and our leader.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_ArchieWeGotTheOrbLetsGo
source:
ARCHIE: TEAM MAGMA's MAXIE got ahead
of us, but we also got what we wanted.\pThe RED ORB preserved at MT. PYRE…
I, ARCHIE, now have it in my possession!\pFufufu… Now we can bring our ultimate
objective to fruition!\pOkay, TEAM!
We're pulling out!$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_BothOrbsTakenMagmaLeftThis
source:
Oh, no…
This cannot happen…\pNot only the BLUE ORB, but even
the RED ORB has been taken…\pThe BLUE ORB and RED ORB must never
be separated. They belong together.\pWhat are those men trying to do with
the two ORBS?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pOh, yes. Was it TEAM MAGMA who came
and took the BLUE ORB first?\pWell, in their haste, they left this
behind.\pI couldn't imagine what exactly it
could be.\pI would like you to have it.
Perhaps it will be useful in some way.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_OrbsHaveBeenTaken
source: The BLUE ORB and RED ORB taken by\nthose sinister men…\pThey must never be apart…\nI fear something terrible will happen…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreAwakened
source:
Oh, my goodness…\pYou say that both GROUDON and KYOGRE
have been awakened?\pIt is said that the BLUE ORB and
the RED ORB quelled the rage of\lthe two POKéMON…\pIt is also said that the true owner
of the ORBS still exists.\pHowever, no one knows who, or what
exactly, the ORBS belong to.\pIt could be a human, or perhaps
a POKéMON, but no one knows.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_ThoseTwoMenReturnedOrbs
source: The two men who took the ORBS came\nback to return them on their own.\pThose men…\nPerhaps they are not so evil after all…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_SuperAncientPokemonTaughtUs
source:
The embodiments of the land, sea,
and the sky…\pThat is said to be the identities of
the super-ancient POKéMON…\pIn the same way that we humans and
POKéMON have life, our world, too,\lis alive…\pThe super-ancient POKéMON have
taught us that…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_WillYouHearOutMyTale
source:
MT. PYRE is where we calm the spirits
of POKéMON that have passed on…\pThis is a high place where one can
see all of HOENN…\pThe disembodied spirits of POKéMON
must find solace here…\pIs it coincidence that you are here…\pWill you hear out my tale? A tale long
told in the HOENN region?$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreTale
source:
It happened long, long ago…\pThe world was wracked by a ferocious
clash between the POKéMON of the land\land the POKéMON of the sea…\pThe POKéMON of the land raised
mountains and created continents…\pThe POKéMON of the sea raised huge
waves and carved out oceans…\pTheir fierce duel raged without end.\pThe world was engulfed in massive
infernos and vicious storms.\pThe BLUE ORB and the RED ORB brought
an end to the calamity.\pLight poured from the two ORBS and
becalmed the enraged adversaries.\pThe pair, made docile, dove deep into
the sea where eventually they\ldisappeared…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_WellThatTooIsFine
source: I see…\nWell, that, too, is fine…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_MaxieSilence
source: MAXIE: {PLAYER}…\p… … … … … …\n… … … … … …$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HearTheNewLegendOfHoenn
source:
It is my role to pass on the legends
of HOENN to future generations.\pAnd the crisis that just ended in
SOOTOPOLIS rewrote a legend…\pHave you the time to hear the new
legend of HOENN?$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale
source:
It happened long, long ago…\pThe world was wracked by a ferocious
clash between the POKéMON of the land\land the POKéMON of the sea…\pThe POKéMON of the land raised
mountains and created continents…\pThe POKéMON of the sea raised huge
waves and carved out oceans…\pTheir fierce duel raged without end.\pThe world was engulfed in massive
fires and vicious storms.\pIt was then that the POKéMON of
the sky descended from a storm.\pThe POKéMON, shining a vivid green,
becalmed the two enraged POKéMON.\pThen, its duty done, the green POKéMON
flew off into the wild blue yonder…$

findings.\pHe's so famous for his research
on POKéMON evolution.\p…sigh…\pI wish I could be a researcher
like him…$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmIntro
source:
ELM: {PLAYER}! There you are!\pI needed to ask you a favor.\pI'm conducting new POKéMON
research right now. I was\lwondering if you could help\lme with it, {PLAYER}.\pYou see…\pI'm writing a paper that I
want to present at a conference.\pBut there are some things I
don't quite understand yet.\pSo!\pI'd like you to raise a
POKéMON that I recently caught.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAccepted
source: Thanks, {PLAYER}!\nYou're a great help!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmRefused
source: But… Please, I need your\nhelp!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmResearchAmbitions
source: When I announce my findings,\nI'm sure we'll delve deeper\pinto the many mysteries of\nPOKéMON.\pYou can count on it!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGotAnEmail
source: Oh, hey! I got an e-mail!\p… … … … … … … …\nHm… Uh-huh…\pOkay…$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmMissionFromMrPokemon
source:
Hey, listen.\pI have an acquaintance called
MR. POKéMON.\pHe keeps finding weird things and
raving about his discoveries.\pAnyway, I just got an e-mail
from him saying that this\ltime it's real.\pIt is intriguing, but we're
busy with our POKéMON research...\pWait!
I know!\p{PLAYER}, can you go in our
place?$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmChooseAPokemon
source: I want you to raise one of\nthe POKéMON contained in these BALLS.\pYou'll be that POKéMON's\nfirst partner, {PLAYER}!\pGo on. Pick one!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmWhereGoing

source: ELM: So, you like {STR_VAR_1},\nthe {STR_VAR_2} POKéMON?$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ReceivedStarter
source: {PLAYER} received {STR_VAR_1}!$

source: If a wild POKéMON appears, let\nyour POKéMON battle it!\pIf your POKéMON is hurt, you\nshould heal it with the machine\lto my right, or at the POKéCENTER.\pI'm counting on you!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_GotElmsNumber
source: {PLAYER} got ELM's phone\nnumber.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmDescribesMrPokemon
source: MR. POKéMON goes everywhere and\nfinds rarities.\pToo bad they're just rare and\nnot very useful…$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmPokeBall
source: It contains a POKéMON caught\nby PROF.ELM.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAfterTheft1
source: ELM: {PLAYER}, this is terrible…\pOh, yes, what was MR. POKéMON's\nbig discovery?$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAfterTheft2
source: {PLAYER} handed the MYSTERY EGG\nto PROF.ELM.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAfterTheft3
source: ELM: This?$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAfterTheft4
source:
But… Is it a POKéMON EGG?\pIf it is, it is a great
discovery!\pELM: What?!?\pPROF.OAK gave you a POKéDEX?\p{PLAYER}, is that true?
Th-that's incredible!\pHe is superb at seeing the
potential of people as trainers.\pWow, {PLAYER}. You may have what
it takes to become the CHAMPION.\pYou seem to be getting on
great with POKéMON too.\pYou should take the POKéMON
GYM challenge.\pThe closest GYM would be the
one in VIOLET CITY.\p…{PLAYER}. The road to the
championship will be a long one.\pBefore you leave, make sure
that you talk to your mom.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmStudyingEgg
source: ELM: Don't give up!\nI'll call if I learn anything\labout that EGG!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAideHasEgg
source:
ELM: {PLAYER}? Didn't you meet
my assistant?\pHe should have met you with
the EGG at VIOLET CITY's\pPOKéMON CENTER.\pYou must have just missed him.
Try to catch him there.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmWaitingEggHatch
source: ELM: Hey, has that EGG changed\nany?$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmThoughtEggHatched
source: {PLAYER}? I thought the EGG\nhatched.\pWhere is the POKéMON?$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ShowTogepi1
source: ELM: {PLAYER}, you look great!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ShowTogepi2
source: What? That POKéMON!?!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ShowTogepi3
source:
The EGG hatched! So, POKéMON
are born from EGGS…\pNo, perhaps not all POKéMON
are.\pWow, there's still a lot of
research to be done.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveEverstone1
source: Thanks, {PLAYER}! You're helping\nunravel POKéMON mysteries for us!\pI want you to have this as a\ntoken of our appreciation.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveEverstone2
source:
That's an EVERSTONE.\pSome species of POKéMON evolve
when they grow to certain levels.\pA POKéMON holding the EVERSTONE
won't evolve.\pGive it to a POKéMON you don't
want to evolve.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmCallYou
source: ELM: {PLAYER}, I'll call you if\nanything comes up.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideAfterTheft
source: …sigh… That stolen POKéMON.\pI wonder how it's doing.\pThey say a POKéMON raised by a\nbad person turns bad itself.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveMasterBall1
source: ELM: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pThanks to you, my research is\ngoing great!\pTake this as a token of my\nappreciation.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveMasterBall2
source:
The MASTER BALL is the best!\pIt's the ultimate BALL! It'll
catch any POKéMON without fail.\pIt's given only to recognized
POKéMON researchers.\pI think you can make much better
use of it than I can, {PLAYER}!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_KimonoGirls
source:
By the way...
A group of beautiful KIMONO\lGIRLS were looking for you.\pThey told me they are
waiting for you at the\lECRUTEAK DANCE THEATER.\pI know you've gone through many
things since that EGG got you\linvolved in all this...\pI hope you'll carry through it.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_KimonoWaiting
source: PROF.ELM: The KIMONO\nGIRLS are waiting for you at\lthe ECRUTEAK DANCE THEATER.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_League
source:
PROF.ELM: Hahaha...
Good job!\pThat rare EGG has brought you
a lot of trouble, huh?\pThe KIMONO GIRLS said something
about me?\pI have nothing to do with it.\pYou made your decision and went
through with it.\pHaving done so much, you should
be able to face the LEAGUE now!\pYou should head for INDIGO
PLATEAU!\pDo you know how to get there?
Follow ROUTE 27 to ROUTE 26.\pOnce there, go straight north!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveTicket1
source: ELM: {PLAYER}! There you are!\pI called because I have\nsomething for you.\pSee? It's an S.S.TICKET.\pNow you can catch POKéMON in\nKANTO.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveTicket2
source:
The ship departs from OLIVINE
CITY.\pBut you knew that already,
{PLAYER}.\pAfter all, you've traveled all
over with your POKéMON.\pGive my regards to PROF.OAK in
KANTO!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_LabMonEgg
source: It's the POKéMON EGG being\nstudied by PROF.ELM.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideGivePotion
source: {PLAYER}, I want you to have\nthis for your errand.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideAlwaysBusy
source: There are only three of us, so\nwe're always busy.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideSave
source: Don't forget to save your game\nregularly!\pPress the START button, then\nSAVE the game!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideTheftTestimony
source:
There was a loud noise
outside…\pWhen we went to look,
someone stole a POKéMON.\pIt's unbelievable that anyone
would do that!\p…sigh… That stolen POKéMON.\pI wonder how it's doing.\pThey say a POKéMON raised by a
bad person turns bad itself.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideGiveBalls
source: {PLAYER}!\pUse these on your POKéDEX\nquest!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideExplainBalls
source: To add to your POKéDEX, you\nhave to catch POKéMON.\pThrow POKé BALLS at wild\nPOKéMON to get them.$

source:
I heard a POKéMON was stolen
here…\pI was just getting some
information from PROF.ELM.\pApparently, it was a young
male with long, red hair…\pWhat?\pYou battled a trainer like
that?\pDid you happen to get his
name?$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_Officer2_1
source: OK! So {RIVAL} was his name?$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_Officer2
source: Thanks for helping my\ninvestigation!$

source: Surely you got his name?!$

source: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pHow's your POKéDEX coming along?\nI'm busy now, but call me sometime\land I can check your progress!$

Oh, {PLAYER}…! Our neighbor,
PROF.ELM, was looking for you.\pHe said he wanted you to do
something for him.\pOh! I almost forgot! Your POKéGEAR
is back from the repair shop.\pHere you go!$

source: {PLAYER} obtained the POKéGEAR.$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ExplainPokeGear
source: MOM: Phone numbers are stored\nin memory.\pJust choose a name you want to call.\nI've already registered my number.\pGee, isn't that convenient?$
