source: DAD: Hm… {PLAYER}, you have gotten\nstronger.\pI can tell by the number of BADGES\nthat you've earned.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanIntro
source:
DAD: Hm…
So, you did get four GYM BADGES.\pFine, as I promised, we will have
a POKéMON battle.\p{PLAYER}…\pI'm so happy that I can have
a real battle with my own child.\pBut, a battle is a battle!\pI will do everything in my power as
a GYM LEADER to win.\p{PLAYER}, you'd better give it your
best shot, too!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanDefeat
source: …\pI… I can't…\pI can't believe it. {PLAYER}…\pI lost to {PLAYER}?\pBut, rules are rules!\nHere, take this.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedBalanceBadge
source: {PLAYER} received the BALANCE BADGE\nfrom DAD!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainBalanceBadgeTakeThis
source:
DAD: With that BADGE, the DEFENSE
of all your POKéMON will increase.\pPOKéMON that know the HM move SURF
will be able to travel over water.\pThis is my gift to you. {PLAYER}, I'm
sure you can use it correctly.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFacade
source: DAD: TM42 contains FACADE.\pIt doubles the power of moves if\nthe POKéMON is poisoned, paralyzed,\lor burned.\pIt might be able to turn a bad\nsituation into an advantage.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadHappyAndSad
source: DAD: As the GYM LEADER, I can't\nexpress how upset I am…\pBut as a father, it makes me both\nhappy and a little sad. It's odd…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
source: Ah, there you are, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pPlease come with me.\nI have something I want you to have.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_LetMeBorrowPlayer
source: NORMAN, you don't mind, do you?\pLet me borrow your {PLAYER}{KUN} for\na minute or two.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoingToKeepTraining
source:
DAD: {PLAYER}, you should go visit
your mother every so often.\pI'm going to stay here and redouble
my training.\pIt would bother me as a TRAINER to
not avenge my loss to you, {PLAYER}!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadNoAmountOfTrainingIsEnough
source: DAD: {PLAYER}, how are things going?\pThe world of POKéMON is deep.\pI honestly think that no amount of\ntraining would ever be enough.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
source:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pThe doors in this GYM open when you
beat the awaiting TRAINERS.\pWhoops! The doors in this room are
already open, so don't attack me!\pThe TRAINERS of PETALBURG GYM
use all kinds of items.\pThe door at the left leads to
the SPEED ROOM.\pThe door at the right leads to
the ACCURACY ROOM.\pThe room's name will be on
the door, so choose carefully.\pOnce you've chosen the door…
Well, hey, go for it!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
source: {PLAYER}! Whoa! You've overcome even\nyour own father!\pLike, whoa!\nWhat a stunning turn of events!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallIntro
source: The ability to attack before the\nopponent…\pJust that alone puts me at a great\nadvantage, don't you agree?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallDefeat
source: That was a magnificent battle!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBattle
source: Go on to the next room where a new\nchallenge awaits you.\pAt the left is the CONFUSION ROOM.\pThe right door leads to the DEFENSE\nROOM.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBadge
source: Whomever you beat, and whomever you\nmay lose to, you never shirk from\ltraining yourself and your POKéMON.\pThat's what I think being a\nGYM LEADER is all about.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerIntro
source: This is the CONFUSION ROOM.\pLet me see how well bonded you are\nwith your POKéMON!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerDefeat
source: I couldn't confuse your team enough…\nYou share a strong bond together.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBattle
source: The next room is the STRENGTH ROOM.\nCan you withstand brute force?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBadge
source: After you beat our LEADER, the\ntraining has become a lot tougher.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeIntro
source:
Just when you think you're going to
win, your opponent restores HP…\pCan you just imagine how awful that
must feel?\pI'll show you exactly how awful it
feels!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeDefeat
source: I couldn't restore HP enough…\nWhat ATTACK power…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBattle
source:
I should have expected no less from
our LEADER's kid.\pNo, wait! A TRAINER's abilities are
earned only through effort.\pI lost because my own efforts
weren't enough.\pGo on! The ONE-HIT KO ROOM is next.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBadge
source: I'm going to keep training at GYMS.\nOne day, I'll become a LEADER.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeIntro
source: I'm not going to take it easy just\nbecause you're our LEADER's kid.\pI'll show you how horrid it is for\na POKéMON to take a critical hit!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeDefeat
source: Your power…\nYou're the real deal.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBattle
source:
Your father really is strong.
He's a TRAINER worth my respect.\pAnd, I sense the same glow coming
from you as your father.\pI hope that you'll stage a terrific
battle with your father!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBadge
source: Since your dad became the LEADER,\nthe TRAINERS of PETALBURG CITY have\lbecome a lot tougher.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro
source: Giggle…\nThis is the ACCURACY ROOM.\pIt's pretty nasty when every attack\nlands without fail.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryDefeat
source: You were a cut above me…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle
source:
There are some even stronger
TRAINERS waiting for you.\pThe left is the DEFENSE ROOM, and
the right is the RECOVERY ROOM.\pYour POKéMON's ATTACK power will be
on trial either way.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBadge
source: Do you know what we're trying to\nachieve as TRAINERS?\pWe're striving to become soul mates\nwith our POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaIntro
source: The higher the DEFENSE, the more\nreckless I can be in attack.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaDefeat
source: Our defenses weren't enough…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBattle
source:
I think you've taught me a valuable
lesson here.\pNow, go on! The left door goes to
the STRENGTH ROOM.\pThe right door opens to
the ONE-HIT KO ROOM.\pBoth of them have TRAINERS who are
skilled at offense.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBadge
source: Hi! Have you tried using SURF?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyIntro
source: Our GYM LEADER told us to go all out\nand beat you.\pEven if you happen to be the\nLEADER's kid!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyDefeat
source: But… I went all out!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBattle
source: The way you use your POKéMON…\nIt's like your father's style.\pGo on through! The GYM LEADER, your\nfather, is waiting!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBadge
source: Sure, it's fine to make your POKéMON\nstronger.\pBut what decides the winner?\pWhy, it's the feelings TRAINERS have\nfor their POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked
source: This door appears to be locked\nright now…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterSpeedRoom
source: “SPEED ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked2
source: This door appears to be locked\nright now…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterAccuracyRoom
source: “ACCURACY ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterConfusionRoom
source: “CONFUSION ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterDefenseRoom
source: “DEFENSE ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterRecoveryRoom
source: “RECOVERY ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterStrengthRoom
source: “STRENGTH ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterOHKORoom
source: “ONE-HIT KO ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterGymLeadersRoom
source: “GYM LEADER'S ROOM\p“See for yourself what POKéMON await\nyou!” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM\pNORMAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPreRematch
source:
DAD: {PLAYER}…
I had a feeling that you would come.\pI would never refuse to accept
a challenge from you.\pYou do understand, don't you?\pInside a GYM, it doesn't matter that
we are a parent and child.\p…No, because we are parent and child,
we owe it to each other to do the best\lwe can. Isn't that right, {PLAYER}?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchDefeat
source: Uh… Haha…\nMaybe that was going too hard…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPostRematch
source: DAD: {PLAYER}…\nWhat is your dream?\pMy dream…\nHahaha…\lIt has already come true, actually.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeedTwoMons
source:
DAD: {PLAYER}…
I had a feeling that you would come.\pI would never refuse to accept
a challenge from you.\pYou do understand, don't you?\pInside a GYM, it doesn't matter that
we are a parent and child.\pHm? Wait a second, {PLAYER}.\pDo you only have one POKéMON that is
capable of battle?\pSorry, but you'll have to come back
with at least two POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_TravelingIsWonderful
source: Traveling is wonderful!\pWhen I was young, I roamed the seas\nand the mountains!$

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure
source:
Sigh…\pI wish I could go on an adventure
with some POKéMON…\pCrawl through some damp grass…
Climb rocky, rugged mountains…\pCross the raging seas…
Wander about in dark caves…\pAnd, sometimes, even get a little
homesick…\pIt must be fabulous to travel!$

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_NormanBecameGymLeader
source: NORMAN became our town's new\nGYM LEADER.\pI think he called his family over from\nsomewhere far away.$

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanOnce
source: I battled NORMAN once, but, whew,\nhe was way too strong.\pHow would I put it?\pI just got the feeling that he\nlives for POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_WeakWillGrowStronger
source: Even if a POKéMON is weak now,\nit will grow stronger.\pThe most important thing is love!\nLove for your POKéMON!$

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_RepelIsUseful
source: Do you use REPEL?\nIt keeps POKéMON away, so it's\luseful when you're in a hurry.$

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_TakeSomeAntidotesWithYou
source: Do you have any ANTIDOTES with\nyou?\pIf you walk around with a poisoned\nPOKéMON, it will lose HP until it faints.\lTake some ANTIDOTES with you.$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCStorageSystem
source: That PC-based POKéMON Storage\nSystem…\pWhoever made it must be some kind\nof a scientific wizard!$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OranBerryRegainedHP
source: When my POKéMON ate an\nORAN BERRY, it regained HP!$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManyTypesOfPokemon
source: There are many types of POKéMON.\pAll types have their strengths and\nweaknesses against other types.\pDepending on the types of POKéMON,\na battle could be easy or hard.$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TreeckoIsGrassType
source:
For example, your TREECKO
is a GRASS type.\pIt's strong against the WATER and
GROUND types.\pBut, it's weak against FIRE-type
POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TorchicIsFireType
source:
For example, your TORCHIC
is a FIRE type.\pIt's strong against the GRASS and
BUG types.\pBut, it's weak against WATER-type
POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MudkipIsWaterType
source: For example, your MUDKIP\nis a WATER type.\pIt's strong against the FIRE type.\pBut, it's weak against GRASS-type\nand ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
source:
You're…
Ah, you must be {PLAYER}{KUN}, right?\pThank you for playing with WALLY a
little while ago.\pHe's been frail and sickly ever
since he was a baby.\pWe've sent him to stay with my relatives
in VERDANTURF TOWN for a while.\pThe air is a lot cleaner there
than it is here.\pWhat's that? Where's WALLY?
He's already left, our WALLY.\pI wonder where he could have
gotten by now?$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WonderHowWallyIsDoing
source: I wonder how our WALLY is doing?$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
source:
{PLAYER}{KUN}! Please excuse us for
dragging you here this way.\pBut our WALLY's become very healthy
since he went to VERDANTURF TOWN.\pWe owe it all to you!\pWhen WALLY left town, you helped
him catch a POKéMON, right?\pI think that made WALLY really
happy.\pActually, not just WALLY.
It made me, his father, happy too.\pHappy that he's gained such a great
friend as you.\pThis isn't a bribe or anything, but
I'd really like you to have this.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_SurfGoAllSortsOfPlaces
source: If your POKéMON can SURF, you'll be\nable to go to all sorts of places.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyIsComingHomeSoon
source: WALLY's coming home soon.\nI'm looking forward to that.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWallyInEverGrandeCity
source: Oh? You met WALLY in\nEVER GRANDE CITY?\pOh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, don't be silly.\pHe may have gotten healthy, but he\ncan't go somewhere far away like\lthat all by himself.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyWasReallyHappy
source: WALLY was really happy when he told\nus that he caught a POKéMON.\pIt's been ages since I've seen him\nsmile like that.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
source:
I want you to keep this a secret
from my husband…\pBut our WALLY left VERDANTURF TOWN
without telling anyone.\pYou know, WALLY is frail, but
he's surprisingly strong-willed.\pI'm sure that he'll come back safe
and sound one day!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_NotAOneToBeFound
source: Hmmm…\nNot a one to be found…$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HaveYouSeenShroomish
source: Hello, have you seen any POKéMON\ncalled SHROOMISH around here?\pI really love that POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWasGoingToAmbushYou
source: I was going to ambush you, but you\nhad to dawdle in PETALBURG WOODS\lforever, didn't you?\pI got sick of waiting, so here I am!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HandOverThosePapers
source: You! DEVON RESEARCHER!\pHand over those papers!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YouHaveToHelpMe
source: Aiyeeeh!\pYou're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?\nYou've got to help me, please!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_NoOneCrossesTeamAqua
source: Hunh? What do you think you're doing?\nWhat, you're going to protect him?\pNo one who crosses TEAM AQUA\ngets any mercy, not even a kid!\pCome on and battle me!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YoureKiddingMe
source: You're kidding me! You're tough!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YouveGotSomeNerve
source:
Grrr… You've got some nerve
meddling with TEAM AQUA!\lCome on and battle me again!\pI wish I could say that, but I'm out of
POKéMON…\pAnd, hey, we of TEAM AQUA are also
after something in RUSTBORO.\pI'll let you go today!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ThatWasAwfullyClose
source:
Whew…
That was awfully close!\pThanks to you, he didn't rob me of
these important papers.\pI know, I'll give you a GREAT BALL as
my thanks!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TeamAquaAfterSomethingInRustboro
source: Didn't that TEAM AQUA thug say\nthey were after something in\lRUSTBORO, too?$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ICantBeWastingTime
source: Uh-oh! It's a crisis!\nI can't be wasting time!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems
source: You're loaded with items.\nI can't give you this GREAT BALL.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_GoBugPokemonTeam
source: I caught a whole bunch of POKéMON!\pGo, go, go!\nMy BUG POKéMON team!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ICouldntWin
source: I have all these POKéMON,\nbut I couldn't win…$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ImOutOfPokeBalls
source: I caught a bunch of POKéMON.\nNow I'm out of POKé BALLS.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_InstantlyPopularWithBugPokemon
source: If you take BUG POKéMON to school,\nyou get to be instantly popular!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfILose
source: I can't be popular if I lose.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_PeopleRespectYou
source: If you have a big BUG POKéMON,\npeople respect you for it.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch1
source: I want a rematch when my BUG\nPOKéMON grow up!\pI'm registering you in my POKéNAV!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch2
source: I want a rematch when my BUG \nPOKéMON grow up!\pI'm registering you in my POKéNAV!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_MyPokemonHaveGrown
source: My BUG POKéMON have grown.\nI'll be popular again.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfLose
source: I can't be popular if I lose.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IveBeenTrainingHard
source: You get to be popular if you have\nstrong POKéMON, right?\lSo, I've been training hard.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_StayOutOfTallGrass
source: Yo, there!\nYour POKéMON doing okay?\pIf your POKéMON are weak and you want\nto avoid battles, you should stay out\lof tall grass.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HiddenItemsExplanation
source: Sometimes, there are things on the\nground even if you can't see them.\pThat's why I always check where I'm\nwalking.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TryUsingThisItem
source: Oh, neat!\nThat's the BADGE from RUSTBORO GYM!\pYou must be a TRAINER.\nYou should try using this item.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_MiracleSeedExplanation
source: It's a MIRACLE SEED.\nIf a POKéMON holds that item, its\lGRASS-type moves become stronger.\pBesides MIRACLE SEED, I think there are\nother convenient items for POKéMON\lto hold.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperience
source:
TRAINER TIPS\pAny POKéMON that appears even once
in a battle is awarded EXP Points.\pTo raise a weak POKéMON, put it at the
left of the team list.\pAs soon as a battle starts, switch it
out. It will earn EXP Points without\lbeing exposed to any harm.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP
source: TRAINER TIPS\pIn addition to Hit Points (HP), POKéMON\nhave Power Points (PP) that are used to\lmake moves during battle.\pIf a POKéMON runs out of PP, it must be\ntaken to a POKéMON CENTER.$

label: Text_DreamEaterTeach
source:
Yawn!
I must have dozed off in the sun.\pI had this weird dream about
a DROWZEE eating my dream.\pAnd…
I learned how to eat dreams…\pOogh, this is too spooky!\pLet me teach it to a POKéMON so
I can forget about it!$

label: Text_DreamEaterDeclined
source: …Snore…$

label: Text_DreamEaterWhichMon
source: Which POKéMON wants to learn\nDREAM EATER?$

label: Text_DreamEaterTaught
source: …ZZZ…\nI…can't eat…anymore…$

label: PewterCity_Text_ClefairyCameFromMoon
source: CLEFAIRY came from the moon.\nThat's what the rumor is.\pThey appeared after MOON STONES\nfell on MT. MOON.$

label: PewterCity_Text_BrockOnlySeriousTrainerHere
source:
There aren't many serious POKéMON
TRAINERS here.\pThey're all like BUG CATCHERS,
you know, just hobbyists.\pBut PEWTER GYM's BROCK isn't like
that, not one bit.$

label: PewterCity_Text_DidYouCheckOutMuseum
source: Did you check out the MUSEUM?$

label: PewterCity_Text_WerentThoseFossilsAmazing
source: Weren't those fossils from MT. MOON\namazing?$

label: PewterCity_Text_ReallyYouHaveToGo
source: Really?\nYou absolutely have to go!$

label: PewterCity_Text_ThisIsTheMuseum
source: This is it, the MUSEUM.\pYou have to pay to get in, but it's\nworth it. See you around!$

label: PewterCity_Text_DoYouKnowWhatImDoing
source: Psssst!\nDo you know what I'm doing?$

label: PewterCity_Text_ThatsRightItsHardWork
source: That's right!\nIt's hard work!$

label: PewterCity_Text_SprayingRepelToKeepWildMonsOut
source: I'm spraying REPEL to keep wild\nPOKéMON out of my garden!$

label: PewterCity_Text_BrocksLookingForChallengersFollowMe
source: You're a TRAINER, right?\pBROCK's looking for new\nchallengers. Follow me!$

label: PewterCity_Text_GoTakeOnBrock
source: If you have the right stuff,\ngo take on BROCK!$

label: PewterCity_Text_TrainerTipsEarningEXP
source: TRAINER TIPS\pAll POKéMON that appear in battle,\nhowever briefly, earn EXP Points.$

label: PewterCity_Text_CallPoliceIfInfoOnThieves
source: NOTICE!\pThieves have been stealing POKéMON\nfossils from MT. MOON.\pPlease call the PEWTER POLICE if\nyou have any information.$

label: PewterCity_Text_MuseumOfScience
source: PEWTER MUSEUM OF SCIENCE$

label: PewterCity_Text_GymSign
source: PEWTER CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\lThe Rock-Solid POKéMON TRAINER!$

label: PewterCity_Text_CitySign
source: PEWTER CITY\nA Stone Gray City$

label: PewterCity_Text_OhPlayer
source: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$

label: PewterCity_Text_AskedToDeliverThis
source: I'm glad I caught up to you.\nI'm PROF. OAK's AIDE.\pI've been asked to deliver this,\nso here you go.$

label: PewterCity_Text_ReceivedRunningShoesFromAide
source: {PLAYER} received the\nRUNNING SHOES from the AIDE.$

label: PewterCity_Text_SwitchedShoesWithRunningShoes
source: {PLAYER} switched shoes with the\nRUNNING SHOES.$

label: PewterCity_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
source: Press the B Button to run.\nBut only where there's room to run!$

label: PewterCity_Text_MustBeGoingBackToLab
source: Well, I must be going back to\nthe LAB.\pBye-bye!$

label: PewterCity_Text_RunningShoesLetterFromMom
source: There's a letter attached…\pDear {PLAYER},\pHere is a pair of RUNNING SHOES\nfor my beloved challenger.\pRemember, I'll always cheer for\nyou! Don't ever give up!\pFrom Mom$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockIntro
source:
So, you're here. I'm BROCK.
I'm PEWTER's GYM LEADER.\pMy rock-hard willpower is evident
even in my POKéMON.\pMy POKéMON are all rock hard, and
have true-grit determination.\pThat's right - my POKéMON are all
the ROCK type!\pFuhaha! You're going to challenge
me knowing that you'll lose?\pThat's the TRAINER's honor that
compels you to challenge me.\pFine, then!
Show me your best!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockDefeat
source:
I took you for granted, and so
I lost.\pAs proof of your victory, I confer
on you this…the official POKéMON\lLEAGUE BOULDERBADGE.\p{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} received the BOULDERBADGE
from BROCK!{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}\p{FONT_MALE}Just having the BOULDERBADGE makes
your POKéMON more powerful.\pIt also enables the use of the
move FLASH outside of battle.\pOf course, a POKéMON must know the
move FLASH to use it.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_TakeThisWithYou
source: Wait!\nTake this with you.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM39FromBrock
source: {PLAYER} received TM39\nfrom BROCK.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM39
source:
A TM, Technical Machine, contains a
technique for POKéMON.\pUsing a TM teaches the move it
contains to a POKéMON.\pA TM is good for only one use.\pSo, when you use one, pick the
POKéMON carefully.\pAnyways…
TM39 contains ROCK TOMB.\pIt hurls boulders at the foe and
lowers its SPEED.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockPostBattle
source:
There are all kinds of TRAINERS in
this huge world of ours.\pYou appear to be very gifted as a
POKéMON TRAINER.\pSo let me make a suggestion.\pGo to the GYM in CERULEAN and test
your abilities.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_DontHaveRoomForThis
source: You don't have room for this.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamIntro
source: Stop right there, kid!\pYou're ten thousand light-years \nfrom facing BROCK!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamDefeat
source: Darn!\pLight-years isn't time…\nIt measures distance!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamPostBattle
source: You're pretty hot.\n…But not as hot as BROCK!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LetMeTakeYouToTheTop
source:
Hiya!
Do you want to dream big?\pDo you dare to dream of becoming
the POKéMON champ?\pI'm no TRAINER, but I can advise
you on how to win.\pLet me take you to the top!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LetsGetHappening
source: All right!\nLet's get happening!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_TryDifferentPartyOrders
source:
The first POKéMON out in a match is
at the left of the POKéMON LIST.\pBy changing the order of POKéMON,
you may gain an advantage.\pTry different orders to suit your
opponent's party.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ItsFreeLetsGetHappening
source: It's a free service!\nLet's get happening!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_YoureChampMaterial
source: Just as I thought!\nYou're POKéMON champ material!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: PEWTER POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: PEWTER POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_Brock_Intro
source: BROCK: Wow, it's not often that we get a\nchallenger from JOHTO.\pI'm BROCK, the PEWTER GYM LEADER.\pI'm an expert on ROCK-type POKéMON.\pMy POKéMON are impervious to most\nphysical attacks. You'll have a hard\ltime inflicting any damage.\pCome on!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_Brock_WinLoss
source: BROCK: Your POKéMON's powerful attacks\novercame my rock-hard defense…\pYou're stronger than I expected…\pGo ahead--take this BADGE.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedBoulderBadge
source: {PLAYER} received BOULDERBADGE.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_Brock_GiveTM
source: Here, take this TM with you.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_Brock_ExplainTM
source: It contains ROCK SLIDE.\pIt drops rocks on your opponents\nwith a chance to cause flinching.\pUse it to stop them in their tracks.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_Brock_BoulderBadge
source: BROCK: {PLAYER}, thanks. I enjoyed\nbattling you, even though I am a bit\lupset.\pThat BOULDERBADGE will make your\nPOKéMON even more powerful.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_Brock_FightDone
source: BROCK: The world is huge. There are\nstill many strong trainers like you.\pJust wait and see. I'm going to become\na lot stronger too.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_CamperJerry_Seen
source: The trainers of this GYM use ROCK-type\nPOKéMON.\pThe ROCK-type has high DEFENSE.\pBattles could end up going a long time.\nAre you ready for this?$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_CamperJerry_Beaten
source: I have to win these battles…$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_CamperJerry_AfterBattle
source: Hey, you! Trainer from JOHTO! BROCK is\ntough. He'll punish you if you don't\ltake him seriously.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_Guide
source:
Yo! CHAMP in making! You're really
rocking.\pAre you battling the GYM LEADERS of
KANTO?\pThey're strong and dedicated people,
just like JOHTO's GYM LEADERS.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_Guide_Win
source: Yo! CHAMP in making! That GYM didn't\ngive you much trouble.\pThe way you took charge was really\ninspiring. I mean that seriously.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: PEWTER POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: PEWTER POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED, {PLAYER}$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockWantToTrade
source:
BROCK: Hey, {PLAYER}. I found this
little BONSLY while training in the\lmountains.\pIt's cute, but I think it needs
a different kind of trainer.\pWould you trade a {STR_VAR_1}
for my {STR_VAR_2}?$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockTakeCare
source: BROCK: Thanks! Take good care of\nWOODY for me!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockDeclineTrade
source: BROCK: No? That's okay.\nWOODY and I will keep training.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockNotRequestedMon
source: BROCK: That's not a {STR_VAR_1}.\nThat's not what I'm after.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockTradeCompleted
source: BROCK: How's WOODY doing?\nBONSLY are tougher than they look!$

label: PewterCity_Text_CooltrainerF
source: Have you visited PEWTER GYM?\pThe LEADER uses ROCK-type POKéMON.$

label: PewterCity_Text_BugCatcher
source: At night, CLEFAIRY come out to play at\nMT.MOON.\pBut not every night.$

label: PewterCity_Text_Gramps
source:
Ah, you came all the way out here from
JOHTO?\pThat brings back memories. When I was
young, I went to JOHTO to train.\pYou remind me so much of what I was like
as a young man.\pHere. I want you to have this item I
found in JOHTO.$

label: PewterCity_Text_Gramps_GotSilverWing
source: Going to new, unknown places and seeing\nnew people…\pThose are the joys of travel.$

label: PewterCity_Text_Sign
source: PEWTER CITY\nA Stone Gray City$

label: PewterCity_Text_GymSign
source: PEWTER CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\pThe Rock Solid POKéMON Trainer$

label: PewterCity_Text_MuseumSign
source: There's a notice here…\pPEWTER MUSEUM OF SCIENCE is closed for\nrenovations…$

label: PewterCity_Text_MtMoonGiftShopSign
source: There's a notice here…\pMT.MOON GIFT SHOP NOW OPEN!$

label: PewterCity_Text_WelcomeSign
source: WELCOME TO PEWTER CITY!$

label: PewterCity_House1_Text_Nidoran
source: NIDORAN♂: Bowbow!$

label: PewterCity_House1_Text_NidoranSit
source: NIDORAN, sit!$

label: PewterCity_House1_Text_TradeMonsAreFinicky
source:
Our POKéMON's an outsider, so it's
finicky and hard to handle.\pAn outsider is a POKéMON that you
get in a trade.\pIt grows fast, but it may ignore an
unskilled TRAINER in battle.\pIf only we had some BADGES…$

label: PewterCity_House1_Text_SuperNerd
source: NIDORAN, shake!$

label: PewterCity_House1_Text_Nidoran
source: NIDORAN: Gau gau!$

label: PewterCity_House2_Text_MonsLearnTechniquesAsTheyGrow
source: POKéMON learn new techniques as\nthey grow.\pBut some moves must be taught to\nthem by people.$

label: PewterCity_House2_Text_MonsEasierCatchIfStatused
source:
A POKéMON becomes easier to 
catch if it has a status problem.\pSleep, poison, burn, or paralysis…
Those are all effective.\pBut catching POKéMON is never
a sure thing!$

label: PewterCity_House2_Text_Gramps
source: I like snoozing with the radio on…\n…Zzzz…$

label: PewterCity_Mart_Text_BoughtWeirdFishFromShadyGuy
source: A shady old guy sucked me into\nbuying this weird fish POKéMON!\pIt's totally weak and it cost ¥500!$

label: PewterCity_Mart_Text_GoodThingsIfRaiseMonsDiligently
source: Good things can happen if you raise\nPOKéMON diligently.\pEven the weak ones can surprise\nyou if you don't give up on them.$

label: PewterCity_Mart_Text_Youngster
source: Hi! Check out my GYARADOS!\pI raised it from a MAGIKARP. I can't\nbelieve how strong it has become.$

label: PewterCity_Mart_Text_SuperNerd
source: There once was a weird old man who sold\nMAGIKARP.\pHe was saying the MAGIKARP from the\nLAKE OF RAGE were excellent.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Its50YForChildsTicket
source: Yes, yes.\nIt's ¥50 for a child's ticket.\pWould you like to come in?$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ComeAgain
source: Come again!$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Right50YThankYou
source: Right, ¥50!\nThank you!$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DontHaveEnoughMoney
source: You don't have enough money.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
source: Please enjoy yourself.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DoYouKnowWhatAmberIs
source: You can't sneak in the back way!\nNice try, kid, but no.\pOh, whatever!\nDo you know what AMBER is?$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberContainsGeneticMatter
source: AMBER contains the genetic matter\nof ancient POKéMON.\pThere's a LAB somewhere trying to\nresurrect POKéMON from AMBER.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberIsFossilizedSap
source: AMBER is actually sap, that gooey\nstuff that oozes from trees.\pThe ancient sap fossilized over\ntime to become rock-hard AMBER.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PleaseGoAround
source: あちらへ　おまわりください$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ShouldBeGratefulForLongLife
source: I should be grateful for my long\nlife.\pNever did I think I would get to\nsee the bones of a dragon!$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WantYouToGetAmberExamined
source:
Ssh! Listen, I need to share a
secret with someone.\pI think that this chunk of AMBER
contains POKéMON DNA!\pIt would be a shattering scientific
breakthrough if POKéMON could be\lresurrected from it.\pBut, my colleagues just ignore
what I have to say.\pSo, I have a favor to ask!\pI want you to get this examined at
a POKéMON LAB somewhere.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ReceivedOldAmberFromMan
source: {PLAYER} received the OLD AMBER\nfrom the man.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_GetOldAmberChecked
source: Ssh!\nGet the OLD AMBER checked!$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DontHaveSpaceForThis
source: You don't have space for this.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WeHaveTwoFossilsOnExhibit
source: We have two fossils of rare,\nprehistoric POKéMON on exhibit.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_BeautifulPieceOfAmber
source: There is a beautiful piece of\nAMBER in a clear gold color.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AerodactylFossil
source: AERODACTYL Fossil\nA primitive and rare POKéMON.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_KabutopsFossil
source: KABUTOPS Fossil\nA primitive and rare POKéMON.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Recptionist
source: Welcome!\pJust to let you know, all the large\nspecimens have been taken to the\lother museums for display.\pSo for now, admission is free of\ncharge!\pPlease go ahead.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_FossilWoman
source: You must be a strong trainer.\pWe don't have much use for the\nfossils on the counter over there.\pA strange man with silver hair\ndropped a ton of them off here.\pGo ahead and take them if you like.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_FossilWomanAfter
source: We often share research with the\nRUINS OF ALPH researchers.\pWe even share fossils with them\nthrough the PC!$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Oldman
source: I should be grateful for my long\nlife.\pNever did I think I would get to\nsee the bones of a dragon!$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Bones
source: Bones of an ancient dragon\nPOKéMON.$

label: Text_SeismicTossTeach
source:
The secrets of space…
The mysteries of earth…\pThere are so many things about
which we know so little.\pBut that should spur us to study
harder, not toss in the towel.\pThe only thing you should toss…\pWell, how about SEISMIC TOSS?
Should I teach that to a POKéMON?$

label: Text_SeismicTossDeclined
source: Is that so?\nI'm sure you'll be back for it.$

label: Text_SeismicTossWhichMon
source: Which POKéMON wants to learn\nSEISMIC TOSS?$

label: Text_SeismicTossTaught
source: I hope you won't toss in the towel.\nKeep it up.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WhatsSpecialAboutMoonStone
source: MOON STONE, huh?\pWhat's so special about it?\nLooks like an ordinary rock to me.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_BoughtColorTVForMoonLanding
source: July 20, 1969!\pHumankind first set foot on the\nmoon that day.\pI bought a color TV just so I\ncould watch that news.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_RunningSpaceExhibitThisMonth
source: This month, we're running a space\nexhibit.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AskedDaddyToCatchPikachu
source: I want a PIKACHU!\nIt's so cute!\pI asked my daddy to catch me one!$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PikachuSoonIPromise
source: Yeah, a PIKACHU soon, I promise!$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_SpaceShuttle
source: Space Shuttle$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_MeteoriteThatFellOnMtMoon
source: A meteorite that fell on MT. MOON.\nIt is thought to be a MOON STONE.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_2F_Text_Nerd
source:
They say that meteorites struck
BIRTH ISLAND.\pWe would love to display them here
in our museum, but...\pThese meteorites are said to emit
strange energy and cannot be\lcarried away...$

label: PewterCity_Museum_2F_Text_AskedDaddyToCatchPikachu
source: I want a PIKACHU!\nIt's so cute!\pI asked my daddy to catch me one!$

label: PewterCity_Museum_2F_Text_PikachuSoonIPromise
source: Yeah, a PIKACHU soon, I promise!$

label: PewterCity_Museum_2F_Text_SpaceShuttle
source: Space Shuttle$

label: PewterCity_Museum_2F_Text_MeteoriteThatFellOnMtMoon
source: A meteorite that fell on MT. MOON.\nIt is thought to be a MOON STONE.$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRocketMtMoonImOnPhone
source: What!?\pTEAM ROCKET is at MT. MOON?\nHuh?\pI'm on the phone!\nScram!$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Jigglypuff
source: JIGGLYPUFF: Puu pupuu!$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WhenJiggylypuffSingsMonsGetDrowsy
source: Yawn!\pWhen JIGGLYPUFF sings, POKéMON get\ndrowsy…\p…Me, too…\nSnore…$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradingMyClefairyForPikachu
source: I really want a PIKACHU, so I'm\ntrading my CLEFAIRY for one.$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradingPikachuWithKid
source: I'm trading POKéMON with that kid\nthere.\pI had two PIKACHU, so I figured\nI might as well trade one.$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Teacher
source: …Yeah, and the GYM in CINNABAR's gone.\pI was really amazed.\p…Yes? I'm on the phone. Go away!$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Jigglypuff
source: JIGGLYPUFF: Puu pupuu.$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_Text_WantToTrade
source: I've been traveling all over, looking\nfor a good {STR_VAR_1}.\pWould you trade one for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_Text_TakeCare
source: Thanks a bunch!\nTake good care of my {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_Text_DeclineTrade
source: No? That's too bad…\nI think you'd like my HAUNTER.$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_Text_NotRequestedMon
source: Hmm, that's not a {STR_VAR_1}.\nThat's not what I'm looking for.$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_Text_TradeCompleted
source: How's that HAUNTER treating you?\nIt's a real trickster!$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_BugCatcher
source: Most POKéMON get drowsy if they hear a\nJIGGLYPUFF singing.\pThere are several moves that can be\nused only while a POKéMON is asleep.$

label: PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_Intro
source:
I am AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR.\pI hear OAK's taken a lot of
interest in you, child.\pThat old duff was once tough and
handsome.\pBut that was decades ago.
He's a shadow of his former self.\pNow he just wants to fiddle with
his POKéDEX.\pHe's wrong.
POKéMON are for battling!\p{PLAYER}! I'll show you how a real
TRAINER battles!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_RematchIntro
source:
I am AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR.\pYou're the child that OAK's taken
under his wing, aren't you?\pThat old duff was once tough and
handsome.\pBut that was decades ago.
He's a shadow of his former self.\pNow he just wants to fiddle with
his POKéDEX.\pHe's wrong.
POKéMON are for battling!\p{PLAYER}! I'll show you how a real
TRAINER battles!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_Defeat
source: Oh, my!\nYou're something special, child!$

label: PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_PostBattle
source: You win!\pI see what the old duff sees in\nyou now.\pI have nothing else to say.\nRun along now, child!$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_Intro
source:
I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR!\pThrough rigorous training, people
and POKéMON can become stronger\lwithout limit.\pI've lived and trained with my
fighting POKéMON!\lAnd that will never change!\p{PLAYER}!\pWe will grind you down with our
superior power!\pHoo hah!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_RematchIntro
source:
I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR!\pThrough rigorous training, people
and POKéMON can become stronger\lwithout limit.\pI've lived and trained with my
fighting POKéMON!\lAnd that will never change!\p{PLAYER}!\pWe will grind you down with our
superior power!\pHoo hah!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_Defeat
source: Why?\nHow could I lose?$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_PostBattle
source: My job is done.\nGo face your next challenge.$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_RematchBefore
source:
BRUNO: Welcome back, young
warrior.\pThrough rigorous training, we have
grown stronger.\pMy rock-hard will is even more firm
and unyielding.\pAre you prepared to face an even
greater challenge?\pShow me the results of your
training.\pHoo hah!$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_Before
source:
I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR.\pI always train to the extreme be-
cause I believe in our potential.\pThat is how we became strong.\pCan you withstand our power?\pHm? I see no fear in you. You look
determined. Perfect for battle!\pReady, {PLAYER}? You will bow down
to our overwhelming power!\pHoo hah!$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_Beaten
source: Why? How could we lose?$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_Defeat
source: Having lost, I have no right to\nsay anything…\pGo face your next challenge!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Intro
source:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pI was looking forward to seeing
you, {PLAYER}.\pMy rival should be strong to keep
me sharp.\pWhile working on my POKéDEX, I
looked all over for POKéMON.\pNot only that, I assembled teams
that would beat any POKéMON type.\pAnd now…\pI'm the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!\p{PLAYER}!
Do you know what that means?\pI'll tell you.\pI am the most powerful TRAINER in
the world!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_RematchIntro
source:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pYou came back, {PLAYER}!
Hahah, that is so great!\pMy rival should be strong to keep
me sharp.\pWhile working on my POKéDEX, I
looked all over for POKéMON.\pNot only that, I assembled teams
that would beat any POKéMON type.\pAnd now…\pI'm the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!\p{PLAYER}!
Do you know what that means?\pI'll tell you.\pI am the most powerful TRAINER in
the world!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
source:
NO!
That can't be!\lYou beat me at my best!\pAfter all that work to become
the LEAGUE CHAMP?\pMy reign is over already?
It's not fair!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Victory
source:
はーはッ！
かった！　かった！　かった！\p{PLAYER}に　まける　ような
おれさま　では　なーい！\pま！　ポケモンの
てんさい　{RIVAL}さま　あいてに\lここまで　よく　がんばった！\pほめて　つかわす！
はーッ！　はーはッはッ！$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattle
source:
Why?
Why did I lose?\pI never made any mistakes raising
my POKéMON…\pDarn it! You're the new POKéMON
LEAGUE CHAMPION!\pAlthough I don't like to admit it…$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakPlayer
source: OAK: {PLAYER}!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakCongratulations
source:
OAK: So, you've won!
Sincerely, congratulations!\pYou're the new POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION!\pYou've grown up so much since you
first left with {STR_VAR_1} to work\lon the POKéDEX.\p{PLAYER}, you have come of age!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakImDisappointedRival
source:
OAK: {RIVAL}…
I'm disappointed in you.\pI came when I heard you'd beaten
the ELITE FOUR.\pBut, when I got here, you had
already lost!\p{RIVAL}, do you understand why
you lost?\pYou have forgotten to treat your
POKéMON with love and trust.\pWithout them, you will never
become a CHAMP again!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakPlayerComeWithMe
source:
OAK: {PLAYER}.\pYou understand that your victory
was not just your own doing.\pThe bond you share with your
POKéMON is marvelous.\p{PLAYER}!
Come with me!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_RematchBattleIntro
source:
LANCE: Welcome back!\pYou've proven yourself in JOHTO,\pacquiring all 8 badges and even
besting me once.\pBut now, you're in the big
leagues.\pThe KANTO LEAGUE!\pA region with its own trials and
champions.\pHere, I am the final challenge,
with a team stronger than ever\lbefore.\pThis is the true test,\pa battle to determine the
CHAMPION of KANTO.\pAre you ready to rise to this new
challenge?\pTo prove yourself once more?\pShow me the strength that
conquered JOHTO, CHAMPION.$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_BattleIntro
source:
LANCE: I've been waiting for you.\p{PLAYER}!\pI knew that you, with your skills,
would eventually reach me here.\pThere's no need for words now.\pWe will battle to determine who is
the stronger of the two of us.\pAs the most powerful trainer and as
the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION…\pI, LANCE the dragon master, accept
your challenge!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_BattleWin
source: …It's over.\pBut it's an odd feeling.\pI'm not angry that I lost. In fact,\nI feel happy.\pHappy that I witnessed the rise\nof a great new CHAMPION!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_BattleAfter
source:
…Whew.\pYou have become truly powerful,
{PLAYER}.\pYour POKéMON have responded to your
strong and upstanding nature.\pAs a trainer, you will continue to
grow strong with your POKéMON.$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_MaryOhNoOak
source: MARY: Oh, no! It's all over!\pPROF.OAK, if you weren't so slow…$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakCongratulations
source:
PROF.OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pIt's been a long while.\pYou certainly look more impressive.\pYour conquest of the JOHTO LEAGUE
is just fantastic!\pYour dedication, trust and love for
your POKéMON made this happen.\pYour POKéMON were outstanding too.\pBecause they believed in you as a
trainer, they persevered.\pCongratulations, {PLAYER}!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_RematchOakCongratulations
source:
PROF.OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pI've been following your progress
since PROF.ELM sent you on your\lway.\pYou've certainly become more
impressive.\pConquering both the JOHTO and now
the KANTO LEAGUE is no small feat.\pYou've truly outdone yourself!\pIt's clear that your POKéMON trust
you immensely,\pand that trust has been the
foundation of your success.\pBut remember, a trainer's journey
is never truly over.\pCongratulations on your victory,
{PLAYER}!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_MaryInterview
source: MARY: Let's interview the brand new\nJOHTO CHAMPION!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_RematchMaryInterview
source: MARY: Let's interview the brand new\nKANTO CHAMPION!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Noisy
source: LANCE: This is getting to be a bit\ntoo noisy…\p{PLAYER}, could you come with me?$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_MaryNoInterview
source: MARY: Oh, wait! We haven't done\nthe interview!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_RematchMaryNoInterview
source: MARY: Come on! You can't blow off\nthe interview AGAIN!$

label: PokemonLeague_HallOfFame_Text_OakCongratulations
source:
OAK: Er-hem!
Congratulations, {PLAYER}!\pThis floor is the POKéMON HALL OF
FAME.\pPOKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPIONS are
honored for their exploits here.\pTheir POKéMON are also recorded in
the HALL OF FAME.\p{PLAYER}!\pYou have worked hard to become
the new LEAGUE CHAMPION.\pCongratulations, {PLAYER}, you and
your POKéMON are HALL OF FAMERS!$

label: PokemonLeague_HallOfFame_LanceText
source:
LANCE: It's been a long time since I
last came here.\pThis is where we honor the LEAGUE
CHAMPIONS for all eternity.\pTheir courageous POKéMON are also
inducted.\pHere today, we witnessed the rise
of a new LEAGUE CHAMPION--a\ptrainer who feels compassion for,
and trust toward, all POKéMON.\pA trainer who succeeded through
perseverance and determination.\pThe new LEAGUE CHAMPION who has
all the makings of greatness!\p{PLAYER}, allow me to register you
and your partners as CHAMPIONS!$

label: PokemonLeague_HallOfFame_Rematch_LanceText
source:
LANCE: I remember, it wasn't long ago
I stood here, welcoming you as\pthe CHAMPION of JOHTO.\pAnd now, here we are again, in this
sacred place where we honor the very\pbest trainers and their POKéMON.\pToday, you've proven yourself not
just in JOHTO, but in KANTO as well,\lbesting even my strongest team.\pYou've shown remarkable compassion
and trust in your POKéMON,\la bond that has carried you to\lvictory time and again.\pYour journey, marked by
perseverance and unwavering\ldetermination,\lspeaks to your true spirit as a\ltrainer.\pYou have all the makings of a true
great, perhaps even the greatest.\p{PLAYER}, it is my honor to register
you, and your trusted partners,\las champions once again.$

label: PokemonLeague_KarensRoom_Text_RematchBefore
source:
KAREN: Ah, it's you again.\pI trust you haven't forgotten
my belief:\pTrue strength arises from trust
in one's POKéMON.\pSince our last encounter, my
bond with my POKéMON has\ldeepened further.\pAre you ready to face a team
united by an unbreakable bond?\pShow me the power of the bond
with your POKéMON.$

label: PokemonLeague_KarensRoom_Text_Before
source: I am KAREN of the ELITE FOUR.\pYou're {PLAYER}? How amusing.\pI love DARK-type POKéMON.\pI find their wild, tough image\nto be so appealing. And they're\lso strong.\pThink you can take them?\nJust try to entertain me.\pLet's go.$

label: PokemonLeague_KarensRoom_Text_Beaten
source: Well, aren't you good. I like that\nin a trainer.$

label: PokemonLeague_KarensRoom_Text_Defeat
source:
Strong POKéMON.\pWeak POKéMON.\pThat is only the selfish
perception of people.\pTruly skilled trainers should
try to win with their favorites.\pI like your style. You understand
what's important.\pGo on--the CHAMPION is waiting.$

label: PokemonLeague_KogasRoom_Text_RematchBefore
source: KOGA: Fwahahahaha!\pYou return, brave challenger.\pMy ninja skills have sharpened.\pNew sinister traps await you.\pPoison, sleep, and more...\nBe ready!\pFwahahahaha!\pShow me how you've grown!$

label: PokemonLeague_KogasRoom_Text_Before
source:
Fwahahahaha!\pI am KOGA of the ELITE FOUR.\pI live in shadows, a ninja!\pMy intricate style will confound
and destroy you!\pConfusion, sleep, poison…\pPrepare to be the victim of my
sinister technique!\pFwahahahaha!\pPOKéMON is not merely about brute
force--you shall see soon enough!$

label: PokemonLeague_KogasRoom_Text_Beaten
source: Ah!\nYou have proven your worth!$

label: PokemonLeague_KogasRoom_Text_Defeat
source:
I subjected you to everything I
could muster.\pBut my efforts failed. I must hone
my skills.\pGo on to the next room, and put
your abilities to test!$

label: PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_Intro
source:
Ah! I've heard about you,
{PLAYER}!\pI lead the ELITE FOUR.\pYou can call me LANCE the dragon
TRAINER.\pYou know that dragons are
mythical POKéMON.\pThey're hard to catch and raise,
but their powers are superior.\pThey're virtually indestructible.
There's no being clever with them.\pWell, are you ready to lose?\pYour LEAGUE challenge ends with
me, {PLAYER}!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_RematchIntro
source:
Ah!
So, you've returned, {PLAYER}!\pI lead the ELITE FOUR.\pYou can call me LANCE the dragon
TRAINER.\pYou know that dragons are
mythical POKéMON.\pThey're hard to catch and raise,
but their powers are superior.\pThey're virtually indestructible.
There's no being clever with them.\pWell, are you ready to lose?\pYour LEAGUE challenge ends with
me, {PLAYER}!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_Defeat
source: That's it!\pI hate to admit it, but you are a\nPOKéMON master!$

label: PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_PostBattle
source:
I still can't believe my dragons
lost to you, {PLAYER}.\pYou are now the POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION!\p…Or, you would have been, but
you have one more challenge left.\pThere is one more TRAINER to face!
His name is…\p{RIVAL}!\pHe beat the ELITE FOUR before
you.\pHe is the real POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION.$

label: PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Intro
source:
Welcome to the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI am LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR.\pNo one can best me when it comes
to icy POKéMON.\pFreezing moves are powerful.\pYour POKéMON will be at my mercy
when they are frozen solid.\pHahaha!
Are you ready?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_RematchIntro
source:
Welcome to the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI, LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR,
have returned!\pYou know how it goes.
No one can best me when it comes\lto icy POKéMON.\pFreezing moves are powerful.\pYour POKéMON will be at my mercy
when they are frozen solid.\pHahaha!
Are you ready?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Defeat
source: …Things shouldn't be this way!$

label: PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_PostBattle
source: You're better than I thought.\nGo on ahead.\pYou only got a taste of the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE's power.$

label: PokemonLeague_WillsRoom_Text_Before
source:
Welcome to POKéMON LEAGUE,
{PLAYER}.\pAllow me to introduce myself.
I am WILL.\pI have trained all around the
world, making my psychic\lPOKéMON powerful.\pAnd, at last, I've been accepted
into the ELITE FOUR.\pI can only keep getting better!\pLosing is not an option!$

label: PokemonLeague_WillsRoom_Text_Beaten
source: I… I can't… believe it…$

label: PokemonLeague_WillsRoom_Text_Defeat
source:
Even though I was defeated, I
won't change my course.\pI will continue battling until I
stand above all trainers!\pNow, {PLAYER}, move on and
experience the true ferocity of\lthe ELITE FOUR.$

label: PokemonLeague_WillsRoom_Text_RematchBefore
source:
WILL: Ah, welcome back.\pI have foreseen this encounter.\pMy psychic POKéMON and
I have evolved, developing\lnew tactics.\pPrepare yourself for a battle of
enhanced strategy and might.\pLet us see if your foresight
matches mine.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_TedIntro
source: Who are you?\nThere shouldn't be anyone here.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_TedDefeat
source: Ouch!$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_TedPostBattle
source: A key? I don't know what you're\ntalking about.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_JohnsonIntro
source: W-w-waah! You startled me!\nI thought you were a ghost.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_JohnsonDefeat
source: Tch!\nI can't get any wins.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_JohnsonPostBattle
source: I was exploring here by myself,\nbut I feel spooked.\pI ought to go soon.$

label: PokemonMansion_Text_PressSecretSwitch
source: A secret switch!\pPress it?$

label: PokemonMansion_Text_WhoWouldnt
source: Who wouldn't?$

label: PokemonMansion_Text_NotQuiteYet
source: Not quite yet!$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ArnieIntro
source: I can't get out!\nThis old place is one big puzzle.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ArnieDefeat
source: Oh, no!\nMy bag of loot!$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ArniePostBattle
source: The switches here open and close\nalternating sets of doors.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_NewMonDiscoveredInGuyanaJungle
source: Diary: July 5\nGuyana, South America\pA new POKéMON was discovered deep\nin the jungle.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ChristenedDiscoveredMonMew
source: Diary: July 10\nWe christened the newly discovered\lPOKéMON, MEW.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_SimonIntro
source: This place is, like, huge!$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_SimonDefeat
source: Ayah!$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_SimonPostBattle
source: I wonder where my partner went.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_BraydonIntro
source: My mentor once lived here.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_BraydonDefeat
source: Whew!\nOverwhelming!$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_BraydonPostBattle
source: So, you're stuck?\nTry jumping off over there!$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_MewGaveBirthToMewtwo
source: Diary: Feb. 6\nMEW gave birth.\pWe named the newborn MEWTWO.$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_LewisIntro
source: Uh-oh…\nWhere am I now?$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_LewisDefeat
source: Awooh!$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_LewisPostBattle
source: You can find stuff lying around.\nThe residents must've left them.$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_IvanIntro
source: This place is ideal for a lab.\nLook at all this space.$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_IvanDefeat
source: What was that for?$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_IvanPostBattle
source: I like it here.\nIt's conducive to my studies.$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_MewtwoIsFarTooPowerful
source: Diary: Sept. 1\nMEWTWO is far too powerful.\pWe have failed to curb its vicious\ntendencies…$

label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_ErectedInMemoryOfDeadMons
source: POKéMON TOWER was erected in the\nmemory of POKéMON that died.$

label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespectsSon
source: Did you come to pay respects?\pBless your POKéMON-loving heart,\nson.$

label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespectsGirl
source: Did you come to pay respects?\pBless your POKéMON-loving heart,\ngirl.$

label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_CameToPrayForDepartedClefairy
source: I came to pray for my dearly\ndeparted CLEFAIRY.\pSniff!\nI'm awash in tears…$

label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_GrowlitheWhyDidYouDie
source: My GROWLITHE…\nWhy did you die?$

label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_SenseSpiritsUpToMischief
source: I am a CHANNELER.\pThere are spirits up to mischief.\nI sense them high in the TOWER.$

label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalIntro
source: {RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nWhat brings you here?\lIs your POKéMON dead?\pHey! It's alive!\pI can at least make them faint!\nLet's go!$

label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalDefeat
source: What?\nYou stinker!\pI took it easy on you, too!$

label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalPostBattle
source:
How's your POKéDEX coming?
I just caught a CUBONE!\pI can't find the bigger MAROWAK.
Where could they be?\pI bet there aren't any left!\pWell, I better get going.
I've got a lot to accomplish,\lunlike you.\pSmell ya later!$

label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_SilphScopeCouldUnmaskGhosts
source: Even we could not identify the\nwayward ghosts.\pA SILPH SCOPE might be able to\nunmask them.$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_HopeIntro
source: Urrg… Awaa…\nHuhu… Graa…$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_HopeDefeat
source: Hwa!\nI'm saved!$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_HopePostBattle
source: The ghosts can be identified by\nthe SILPH SCOPE.$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_CarlyIntro
source: Kekeke…\nKwaaah!$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_CarlyDefeat
source: Hmm?\nWhat am I doing?$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_CarlyPostBattle
source: Sorry!\nI was possessed!$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_PatriciaIntro
source: Be gone!\nMalevolent spirit!$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_PatriciaDefeat
source: Whew!\nThe spirit left!$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_PatriciaPostBattle
source: The others above…\nThey must have been possessed.$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_PaulaIntro
source: Ghost! No!\nKwaaah!$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_PaulaDefeat
source: Where is the ghost?$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_PaulaPostBattle
source: I must have been dreaming…$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_LaurelIntro
source: Be cursed with me!\nKwaaah!$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_LaurelDefeat
source: What!$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_LaurelPostBattle
source: We can't determine the identity of\nthe ghosts…$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_JodyIntro
source: Huhuhu…\nBeat me not!$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_JodyDefeat
source: Huh?\nWho? What?$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_JodyPostBattle
source: May the departed POKéMON rest in\npeace…$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_RestHereInPurifiedSpace
source: Come, child!\nI have purified this space.\lYou can rest here.$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_TammyIntro
source: Give…me…\nyour…all…$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_TammyDefeat
source: Gasp!$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_TammyPostBattle
source: I was under possession.$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_RuthIntro
source: You…shall…\njoin…us…$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_RuthDefeat
source: What a nightmare!$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_RuthPostBattle
source: I was possessed.$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_KarinaIntro
source: Zombies!$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_KarinaDefeat
source: Ha?$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_KarinaPostBattle
source: I regained my senses.$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_JanaeIntro
source: Urgah…\nUrff…$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_JanaeDefeat
source: Whoo!$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_JanaePostBattle
source: I fell to evil spirits despite my\ntraining in the mountains…$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_PurifiedZoneMonsFullyHealed
source: Entered the purified and protected\nzone.\p{PLAYER}'s POKéMON were fully\nhealed.$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_AngelicaIntro
source: Give…me…\nblood…$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_AngelicaDefeat
source: Groan!$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_AngelicaPostBattle
source: I feel anemic and weak…$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_EmiliaIntro
source: Urff…\nKwaah!$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_EmiliaDefeat
source: Something fell out!$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_EmiliaPostBattle
source: My hair didn't fall out!\nIt was a malevolent spirit!$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_JenniferIntro
source: Ke…ke…ke…\nke…ke…ke!$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_JenniferDefeat
source: Keee!$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_JenniferPostBattle
source: What's going on here?$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_BeGoneIntruders
source: Be gone…\nIntruders…$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_GhostWasCubonesMother
source: The ghost was the restless spirit\nof CUBONE's mother!$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_MothersSpiritWasCalmed
source: The mother's spirit was calmed.\pIt departed to the afterlife…$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: What do you want?\nWhy are you here?$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: I give up!$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: I'm not going to forget this!$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt2Intro
source:
This old guy marched right up to
our HIDEOUT.\pThen, he starts ranting about how
TEAM ROCKET's abusing POKéMON.\pSo, we're just talking it over as
adults.$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: Please!\nNo more!$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: POKéMON are only good for making\nmoney. Why not use them?\pYou stay out of our business!$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt3Intro
source: You're not saving anyone, kid!$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
source: Don't fight us ROCKETS!$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
source: You're not getting away with this!$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_MrFujiThankYouFollowMe
source:
MR. FUJI: Heh?
You came to save me?\pThank you. But, I came here of my
own free will.\pI came to calm the spirit of
CUBONE's mother.\pI think MAROWAK's spirit has
finally left us.\pI must thank you for your kind
concern.\pFollow me to my home, POKéMON
HOUSE, at the foot of this tower.$

label: Alola_Poni_BattleExeggutor_Text_0
source: Gaah-aah!$

label: Alola_Poni_Island_Sign_Text_0
source: PONI ISLE$

label: Alola_Poni_TotemBattle_Text_0
source: Buzz!!$

label: Alola_Poni_TotemBattle_Text_1
source: Totem ELECTIVIRE was defeated!\nIt scampered off somewhere…$

label: Alola_Poni_Totem_sign_Text_0
source: The totem is emanating a strong\nenergy…\pTouch the totem to teleport to another\nIsle?$

label: Alola_Poni_Totem_sign_Text_1
source: MELEMELE ISLE$

label: Alola_Poni_Totem_sign_Text_2
source: AKALA ISLE$

label: Alola_Poni_Totem_sign_Text_3
source: ULA'ULA ISLE$

label: Alola_Poni_Totem_sign_Text_4
source: CANCEL$

label: Alola_Poni_Totem_sign_Text_5
source: A strange totem stands here,\npower is emanating from it…$

label: Alola_Poni_BattleVsTapuFini_Text_0
source: Fiiin!$

label: Alola_Poni_TrainerBattleSwimmer1_Text_0
source: Warmer water, no problem!$

label: Alola_Poni_TrainerBattleSwimmer1_Text_1
source: Gah, I forgot my sunscreen…$

label: Alola_Poni_TrainerBattleSwimmer1_Text_2
source: I've swam into so many cool POKéMON!\nIt must be something in the water.$

label: Alola_Poni_TrainerBattleSwimmer2_Text_0
source: Hey, don't block my current!$

label: Alola_Poni_TrainerBattleSwimmer2_Text_1
source: Ugh, fine,\njust let me swim…$

label: Alola_Poni_TrainerBattleSwimmer2_Text_2
source: The current is great for tubing.\nI don't think I'll tube anywhere else!$

label: Alola_Poni_NPC_girl_Text_0
source: PONI ISLE is my favorite.\nThe wilderness just speaks for itself!$

label: Alola_Poni_Bench_Heal_Text_0
source: Would you like to take a rest on this\nbench?$

label: Alola_Poni_BattleGolem_Text_0
source: Gaaah!$

label: ReceptionGate_Text_Janine
source:
JANINE: I'm on the way to my dad's
house to give him his lunch.\pThe ELITE FOUR has no time to rest
day or night. It's such hard work,\lyou know?\pIf you're ready for another battle,
I'll be at the DOJO later.$

label: VictoryRoadGate_Text_Officer
source: Only trainers who have proven\nthemselves may pass.$

label: VictoryRoadGate_Text_Kimono
source: Sorry kid, this way is closed until\nsomeone deals with that LEGENDARY\lPOKéMON...$

label: VictoryRoadGate_Text_NotEnoughBadges
source: You don't have all the GYM BADGES\nof JOHTO.\pI'm sorry, but I can't let you go\nthrough.$

label: VictoryRoadGate_Text_EightBadges
source: Oh! The eight BADGES of JOHTO!\pPlease, go right on through!$

label: VictoryRoadGate_Text_LeftBlackBelt
source: This way leads to MT.SILVER.\pYou'll see scary-strong POKéMON out\nthere.$

label: VictoryRoadGate_Text_RightBlackBelt
source: Off to the POKéMON LEAGUE, are you?\pThe ELITE FOUR are so strong it's\nscary, and they're ready for you!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: Who are you?\nHow did you get here?$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: Oww!\nBeaten!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: Blast it… You're dissing TEAM\nROCKET, aren't you?$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
source: You broke into TEAM ROCKET's\noperation? What nerve!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: Boom!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: You're not going to get away with\nthis, brat!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
source: Intruder alert!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
source: I can't do it!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
source: SILPH SCOPE? Humph!\nI don't know where it is.$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt4Intro
source: Why did you come here?$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
source: This won't do!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
source: Okay, I'll talk…\nTake the elevator to see my BOSS.$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Intro
source: Are you lost, you little mouse?$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
source: Why…?$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
source: Uh-oh, that ruckus somehow opened\nthe door!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_CameraGrunt1Seen
source: Hey!\nIntruder alert!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_CameraGrunt1Beaten
source: Dang… I failed…$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_CameraGrunt2Seen
source: It's my turn! There's no escape!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_CameraGrunt2Beaten
source: Surveillance cams are in the\nPOKéMON statues.\pWe'll keep appearing until you\ntrip a secret switch.$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_ScientistJedSeen
source: This was once a ninja hideout.\pThere are traps to confound\nintruders like you.$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_ScientistJedBeaten
source: I get it…$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_ScientistJedAfter
source:
All right. I'll divulge a secret
about our hideout.\pThat thing on the floor up ahead
is a warp panel.\pIf you step on it, you'll be
warped back to the entrance.$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_GruntM16Seen
source: Heheh. Feeling lucky, punk?$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_GruntM16Beaten
source: Kaboom!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_GruntM16After
source: I don't even know where the traps\nare planted.\pYou'll just have to collect your\ncourage and walk.$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_SecurityCameraStatue
source: It's a PERSIAN statue…$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_NothingThere
source: A strange panel... Nothing here.$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_SecretSwitch
source: A secret switch! Better press it.$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_SwitchOff
source: The switch is turned off.$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntIntro
source: BOSS said you can see ghosts with\nthe SILPH SCOPE.$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntDefeat
source: I surrender!$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntPostBattle
source: The TEAM ROCKET HQ has four\nunderground floors.\pThink you can reach the BOSS?$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_MurkrowUnlock
source: MURKROW screamed the password,\nmimicking the voice of PETREL.\p..................\nThe voice-recognition system\lunlocked the door!$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_ArianaHoldIt
source: ARIANA: Hold it right there!$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_ArianaChallenge
source:
ARIANA: We can't let a brat like you
do as you please forever.\pIt'll hurt Team Rocket's pride over
and over again. Making it lessen,\lyou see.\p...So, it's time to finish you.
However strong you may be,\pif the two of us fight at the same
time, you'll have no chance of\lwinning. Don't you agree?\pHee hee hee! Sorry, baby.
Now, get ready to be thrashed.$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceInterrupt
source: LANCE: Hold it!\nA two-on-one battle?\pThat is so unfair!\nTypical of Team Rocket to be so\lsneaky.\pAllow me to join the battle!$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_ArianaOutraged
source: ARIANA: What? You had an accomplice?\nWhere is your sense of dignity?\pAs interim boss in place of GIOVANNI,\nI'll show you how wrong it is to meddle\lwith Team Rocket!$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceChooseMons
source: LANCE: Quickly {PLAYER}, choose\nyour POKéMON!$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_ArianaLoss
source: Tch, you really are strong.\nIt's too bad.\pIf you were to join Team Rocket,\nyou could become an Executive.$

label: RocketHideout_Text_ArianaRetreat
source:
ARIANA: But that's fine.
The broadcast experiment was a\ltotal success.\pIt doesn't matter what happens to
this hideout now.\pWe have much bigger plans.
You'll come to appreciate Team\lRocket's true power soon enough.\pEnjoy yourself while you can...
Hee hee hee...$

label: RocketHideout_Text_LanceStepBack
source: Sorry, {PLAYER}. I saw how well you\nwere doing, so I just hung back.\pNow all there is left to do is to turn\noff that odd radio signal.$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceElectrodeFaint
source:
It's this machine that's causing
all the problems.\pI don't see a switch on it…\pWe have no choice. We have to
make all the ELECTRODE faint.\pThat should stop this machine
from transmitting that strange\lsignal.\pIt's no fault of the POKéMON, so
it makes me feel guilty.\p{PLAYER}, let's split the job.$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceSide
source: LANCE: Leave this side to me.$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceElectrodeDone
source:
LANCE: That odd signal has
finally stopped.\pThe LAKE should be back to
normal.\pYou're the hero! Let me thank
you on behalf of all the\lPOKéMON.\pOh, yes. You should take this.
I found it here, but I don't\lhave any need for it.$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceWhirlpool
source: That's WHIRLPOOL. Teach it to a\nPOKéMON to get across wild water.\pBut keep this in mind.\pYou can use that out of battle\nonly with the BADGE from\lMAHOGANY GYM.$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceMonMaster
source:
{PLAYER}…\pThe journey to becoming the
POKéMON MASTER is long and\ldifficult.\pKnowing that, will you keep
going?\p…\pI see. No, you're right.\pIf you would give up that easily,
you would have never chased that\ldream in the first place.\pI look forward to seeing you
again!$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_B2FTransmitter
source: It's the radio transmitter that's\nsending the sinister signal.\pIt's working at full capacity.$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_B2FDeactivateTransmitter
source: The radio transmitter has finally\nstopped its evil broadcast.$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceHeals1
source: LANCE: Are you all right?\pYour POKéMON are hurt and tired.\pHere, give them some of my\nmedicine.$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceHeals2
source: LANCE: {PLAYER}, let's give it\nour best for POKéMON.$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM17Seen
source: The door won't open?\pWell, duh. It has to have a\npassword that only TEAM ROCKET\lknows.$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM17Beaten
source: What? I lost?$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM17After
source: Heh, I'm just a GRUNT.\pI don't know the password.\nToo bad for you.$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM18Seen
source: Oh, a kid? I don't really like\nthis, but eliminate you I must.$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM18Beaten
source: I knew I'd lose…$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM18After
source: I got wiped out on the last\nmission by a kid too.\pWhen we were abducting POKéMON,\nthis kid with long red hair and\lmean-looking eyes just\lcreamed me…$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM19Seen
source: You rotten little pest!$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM19Beaten
source: Grrrr…$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM19After
source: Heh, only the boss knows the\npassword for that door.\pWhere's the boss? Who knows?\nGo look for yourself.$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: Stop meddling in TEAM ROCKET's\naffairs or else!$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: Oof!\nTaken down!$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: SILPH SCOPE?\nOh, that machine the BOSS stole.\pIt's here somewhere.$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt2Intro
source: We got word from upstairs that you\nwere coming!$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: What?\nI lost? No!$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: Go ahead and go!\pBut you can't run the elevator\nwithout the LIFT KEY.$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_LanceGetPassword
source:
LANCE: It takes two passwords
to get into the boss' quarters.\pThose passwords are known only
to a few ROCKETS.\pThat ROCKET there very graciously
told me so.\p{PLAYER}, let's go get the
passwords.$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_B3FRocket
source: Urrggh… The guy in the cape is\nincredibly tough…$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_B3FLockedDoorNeedsPassword
source: The door's closed…\pIt needs two passwords to open.$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_B3FLockedDoorOpenSesame
source: The door's closed…\p{PLAYER} entered the two passwords.\pThe door opened!$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Rival
source:
…\pDidn't I tell you that I was
going to destroy TEAM ROCKET?\p…Tell me, who was the guy in the
cape who used dragon POKéMON?\pMy POKéMON were no match at all.\pIt's what he said that bothers
me…\pHe told me that I don't love and
trust my POKéMON enough.\pIt's not my fault my team is so
useless.\pI'm furious that I lost to a
bleeding heart like him.\pBut it makes me question myself.\pIs there something I'm doing
wrong?\pCould it be that love made his
team so powerful?$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_PetrelIntro
source:
Muhahaha, we've been waiting
for you. So, you are {PLAYER}...\pMe? You don't know who I am?
It is me, GIOVANNI.\pThe majestic GIOVANNI himself!
Wahahaha!$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_PetrelDisbelief
source: ...Huh?\nI don't sound anything like\lGIOVANNI?\pI don't even look like GIOVANNI?\nHow come? I've worked so hard\lto mimic him!$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_PetrelReveal
source:
PETREL: I am a Team Rocket
Executive!\pYou must be trying to sneak into
the radio-transmitter room.\pWell, that's not going to happen.
That room is protected with a\lspecial password.\pThe password is “Hail GIOVANNI.”
Surprised to hear it from me?\pKnowing the password won't help
you though.\pThe door won't open unless I say
the password. It only reacts to\lmy voice.$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_PetrelBeaten
source: I… I couldn't do a thing…\pGIOVANNI, please forgive me…$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_PetrelAfterBattle
source:
PETREL: Since disbanding Team
Rocket three years ago, our\lGIOVANNI has been missing.\pBut we're certain he's been
waiting for the right time for\lour revival... Wahahaha!\pLosing to you won't change the
fact that you are unable to get\lin the radio-transmitter room!\pYou need my voice to unlock it!$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_MurkrowSpeak1
source: MURKROW: Hail GIOVANNI.$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_MurkrowMimic
source: MURKROW is mimicking\nthe voice of PETREL!\pYou may be able to...!?$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Murkrow
source: MURKROW: The password is…\pHAIL GIOVANNI.$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_GruntF5Seen
source: Do I know the password?\pMaybe.\pBut no weakling's going to get\nit!$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_GruntF5Beaten
source: All right. Stop. I'll tell you.$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_GruntF5After
source: The password to the boss' room\nis SLOWPOKETAIL.\pBut it's useless unless you have\ntwo passwords.$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_GruntM28Seen
source: Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!\pI remember you from the well!\pYou're challenging me again?\pHah! You're nuts, but you have\nguts!\pI'll warn you, I got better!\pIf you can beat me, I'll tell\lyou a password to the boss'\nroom!$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_GruntM28Beaten
source: Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck! You're good!$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_GruntM28After
source: Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!\pThe password to the boss' room…\pUh…, I think it is RATICATE TAIL.$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_ScientistRossSeen
source: I used to work for SILPH, but now\nI run research for TEAM ROCKET.\pA meddlesome child like you needs\nto be punished.$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_ScientistRossBeaten
source: A mere tactical error cost me…$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_ScientistRossAfter
source:
A radio signal that drives
POKéMON mad…\pMy experiment is a complete
success.\pMy promotion is assured. This
loss means absolutely nothing.$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_ScientistMitchSeen
source: I don't care that POKéMON are hurt\nby our experiment.$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_ScientistMitchBeaten
source: Thinking is my strong suit, not\nbattling.$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_ScientistMitchAfter
source: If we turn up the power of our\nradio signal for broadcast\lnationwide…\pThe very thought excites me!$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_GiovanniIntro
source:
So! I must say, I am impressed you
got here.\pTEAM ROCKET captures POKéMON from
around the world.\pThey're important tools for keeping
our criminal enterprise going.\pI am the leader, GIOVANNI!\pFor your insolence, you will feel a
world of pain!$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_GiovanniDefeat
source: WHAT!\nThis can't be!$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_GiovanniPostBattle
source: I see that you raise POKéMON with\nutmost care.\pA child like you would never\nunderstand what I hope to achieve.\pI shall step aside this time!\pI hope we meet again…$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt2Intro
source: I know you!\nYou ruined our plans at MT. MOON!$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: Burned again!$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: Do you have something against TEAM\nROCKET?$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt3Intro
source: How can you not see the beauty of\nour evil?$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
source: Ayaya!$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
source: BOSS!\nI'm sorry I failed you!$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: The elevator doesn't work?\nWho has the LIFT KEY?$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: No!$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: Oh, no!\nI dropped the LIFT KEY!$

label: RocketHideout_Elevator_Text_AppearsToNeedAKey
source: It appears to need a key.$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyIntro
source: This tunnel goes a long way, kid!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyDefeat
source: Doh!\nYou win!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyPostBattle
source: Watch for ONIX.\nThey appear only occasionally.\pHigh-level ones can put the\nsqueeze on you!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverIntro
source: Hmm.\nMaybe I'm lost in here…$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverDefeat
source: Ease up!\nWhat am I doing?\lWhich way is out?$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverPostBattle
source: That sleeping POKéMON on ROUTE 12\nforced me to take this detour.$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LucasIntro
source: Outsiders like you need to show me\nsome respect!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LucasDefeat
source: I give!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LucasPostBattle
source: You're talented enough to hike!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_AshtonIntro
source: POKéMON fight!\nReady, go!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_AshtonDefeat
source: Game over!$
