source:
Thanks for showing me so many
cute POKéMON.\pI really enjoyed myself. I'm
glad I've lived such a long life.\pFeel free to use the TELEPORTER
whenever you like.$

label: Route25_BillsHouse_Text_WrongPokemon
source: Hm?\pThat's not the POKéMON that I\nwas told about.$

label: Route25_Text_JoeyIntro
source: Local TRAINERS come here to\npractice.$

label: Route25_Text_JoeyDefeat
source: You're decent.$

label: Route25_Text_JoeyPostBattle
source: All POKéMON have weaknesses.\nEven the strongest ones.\pThat's why it's best to raise\nPOKéMON of different types.$

label: Route25_Text_DanIntro
source: Dad took me to a great party on\nthe S.S. ANNE at VERMILION CITY.$

label: Route25_Text_DanDefeat
source: I'm not mad!$

label: Route25_Text_DanPostBattle
source: On the S.S. ANNE, I saw TRAINERS\nfrom around the world.$

label: Route25_Text_FlintIntro
source: I'm a cool guy.\nI've got a girlfriend!$

label: Route25_Text_FlintDefeat
source: Aww, darn…$

label: Route25_Text_FlintPostBattle
source: Oh, well.\nMy girlfriend will cheer me up.$

label: Route25_Text_KelseyIntro
source: Hi!\nMy boyfriend is cool!$

label: Route25_Text_KelseyDefeat
source: My conditioning isn't the best…$

label: Route25_Text_KelseyPostBattle
source: I wish my boyfriend was as good\nas you.$

label: Route25_Text_ChadIntro
source: I had this feeling…\nI knew I had to battle you!$

label: Route25_Text_ChadDefeat
source: I knew I'd lose, too!$

label: Route25_Text_ChadPostBattle
source: If your POKéMON gets confused,\nswitch it out.\pThat's a good tactic.$

label: Route25_Text_HaleyIntro
source: My friend has many cute POKéMON.\nI'm so jealous!$

label: Route25_Text_HaleyDefeat
source: I'm not so jealous!$

label: Route25_Text_HaleyPostBattle
source: You came from MT. MOON?\nMay I have a CLEFAIRY?$

label: Route25_Text_FranklinIntro
source: I just got down from MT. MOON,\nbut I've still got gas in the tank!$

label: Route25_Text_FranklinDefeat
source: You worked hard!$

label: Route25_Text_FranklinPostBattle
source: Drat!\nA ZUBAT bit me back in that cave.$

label: Route25_Text_NobIntro
source: I'm off to see a POKéMANIAC's\ncollection at the cape.$

label: Route25_Text_NobDefeat
source: You done got me, and real good,\ntoo!$

label: Route25_Text_NobPostBattle
source: The POKéMANIAC sure lives up to\nhis name.\pHis collection includes many rare\nspecies of POKéMON.$

label: Route25_Text_WayneIntro
source: You're going to see BILL?\nFirst, we battle!$

label: Route25_Text_WayneDefeat
source: You're something.$

label: Route25_Text_WaynePostBattle
source: The trail below is a shortcut to\nCERULEAN CITY.$

label: Route25_Text_SeaCottageSign
source: SEA COTTAGE\nBILL lives here!$

label: Route25_Text_MistyHighHopesAboutThisPlace
source: This cape is a famous date spot.\pMISTY, the GYM LEADER, has high\nhopes about this place.$

label: Route25_Text_AreYouHereAlone
source: Hello, are you here alone?\pIf you're out at CERULEAN's cape…\nWell, it should be as a couple.$

label: Route25_Text_Misty
source: MISTY: I love the sunset here!\nIt gives me the courage to go on,\lyou know?\pRight!\pIf you're ready for a real splash,\nmeet me at the FIGHTING DOJO!$

label: Route25_Text_Eusine1
source:
EUSINE: Puff, puff...
I am... no match for you.\p...As I predicted.
..........................\l... Go ahead.\pSince I met you in the BURNED TOWER
at ECRUTEAK CITY, I've sort of\lknown that SUICUNE would choose\lyou.$

label: Route25_Text_Eusine2
source: Take a look at it!\pSUICUNE is waiting for you!\nIt has been waiting for a battle\lwith a worthy trainer to whom it\lcan entrust itself.$

label: Route25_Text_Eusine3
source:
{PLAYER}...
You two are truly amazing...\pI have never seen a battle this
intense!\lI have no regrets...\pFarewell, SUICUNE!
Farewell... {PLAYER}!$

label: Route25_Text_MistyDate
source:
MISTY: Aww! Why did you have to
show up and bug us now?\pDo you know what they call
people like you?\pPests! You heard me right,
pest!\p…\p…Oh? Those BADGES you have…
Are they JOHTO GYM BADGES?\pIf you have eight, you must be
good.\pOK, then. Come to CERULEAN GYM.\pI'll be happy to take you on.\pI'm MISTY, the GYM LEADER in
CERULEAN.$

label: Route25_Text_SchoolboyDudleySeen
source: Beat the six of us trainers to\nwin a fabulous prize!\pThink you've got what it takes?$

label: Route25_Text_SchoolboyDudleyBeaten
source: Whoo! Good stuff.$

label: Route25_Text_SchoolboyDudleyAfter
source: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$

label: Route25_Text_LassEllenSeen
source: I'm second.\nNow it's serious!$

label: Route25_Text_LassEllenBeaten
source: How could I lose?$

label: Route25_Text_LassEllenAfter
source: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$

label: Route25_Text_SchoolboyJoeSeen
source: Here's No. 3!\nI won't be easy.$

label: Route25_Text_SchoolboyJoeBeaten
source: Ow! Stomped flat!$

label: Route25_Text_SchoolboyJoeAfter
source: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$

label: Route25_Text_LassLauraSeen
source: I'm No. 4!\nGetting tired?$

label: Route25_Text_LassLauraBeaten
source: I lost too…$

label: Route25_Text_LassLauraAfter
source: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$

label: Route25_Text_CamperLloydSeen
source: OK! I'm No. 5.\nI'll stomp you!$

label: Route25_Text_CamperLloydBeaten
source: Whoa! Too much.$

label: Route25_Text_CamperLloydAfter
source: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$

label: Route25_Text_LassShannonSeen
source: I'm the last in line, but I tell\nyou, I'm tough!$

label: Route25_Text_LassShannonBeaten
source: You're kidding.$

label: Route25_Text_LassShannonAfter
source: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$

label: Route25_Text_SupernerdPatSeen
source: Mufufufu…\pI have nothing to do with the\nsix-pack trainers.\pI waited here to beat you when\nyou were tired out by all the\lbattles.$

label: Route25_Text_SupernerdPatBeaten
source: Aren't you tired at all?$

label: Route25_Text_SupernerdPatAfter
source: I'm sorry… I won't cheat\nanymore…$

label: Route25_Text_CooltrainerKevinNugget
source: You took on one more battle than\nyou expected, but you won\lanyway.\pAs promised, you win a prize.$

label: Route25_Text_CooltrainerKevinSeen
source: But after seeing how you battle,\nI want to see how I'll fare.\pHow about it? Let me take you\non.$

label: Route25_Text_CooltrainerKevinBeaten
source: I've never had a battle this\ngood!$

label: Route25_Text_CooltrainerKevinAfter
source: That was a great battle!\pYou and your POKéMON are truly\noutstanding!$

label: Route25_Text_BillsHouseSign
source: SEA COTTAGE\nBILL'S HOUSE$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ImBillHelpMeOutPal
source:
Hiya! I'm a POKéMON…
…No I'm not!\pCall me BILL!
I'm a true-blue POKéMANIAC!\pHey!
What's with that skeptical look?\pI'm not joshing you, pal.\pI screwed up an experiment and got
combined with a POKéMON!\pSo, how about it?
Help me out here!$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ImBillHelpMeOutLady
source:
Hiya! I'm a POKéMON…
…No I'm not!\pCall me BILL!
I'm a true-blue POKéMANIAC!\pHey!
What's with that skeptical look?\pI'm not joshing you, lady.\pI screwed up an experiment and got
combined with a POKéMON!\pSo, how about it?
Help me out here!$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_RunCellSeparationOnPC
source: Wait till I get inside the\nTELEPORTER.\pWhen I do, go to my PC and run\nthe Cell Separation System.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_NoPleaseChief
source:
No!?
Now don't be so cold!\pCome on, you gotta help a guy in
deep, deep trouble!\pWhat do you say, chief?
Please?\lOkay?\lAll right!$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_NoPleaseBeautiful
source:
No!?
Now don't be so cold!\pCome on, you gotta help a guy in
deep, deep trouble!\pWhat do you say, beautiful?
Please?\lOkay?\lAll right!$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ThanksBudTakeThis
source:
BILL: Yeehah!
Thanks, bud! I owe you one!\pSo, did you come to see my
POKéMON collection?\pYou didn't?
That's a bummer.\pI've got to thank you…
Oh, here, maybe this'll do.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ThanksLadyTakeThis
source:
BILL: Yeehah!
Thanks, lady! I owe you one!\pSo, did you come to see my
POKéMON collection?\pYou didn't?
That's a bummer.\pI've got to thank you…
Oh, here, maybe this'll do.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ReceivedSSTicketFromBill
source: {PLAYER} received an S.S. TICKET\nfrom BILL.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_YouveGotTooMuchStuff
source: You've got too much stuff!$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_SSAnnePartyYouGoInstead
source:
That cruise ship S.S. ANNE is in
VERMILION CITY.\pI hear there are lots of TRAINERS
on board, too.\pThey invited me to their party, but
I can't stand fancy do's.\pWhy don't you go instead of me?
Go on and have a good time.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_CheckOutRareMonsOnPC
source: BILL: Feel like checking out some\nof my rare POKéMON on my PC?\pGo on, check out my PC.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_TeleporterIsDisplayed
source: TELEPORTER is displayed on the PC\nmonitor.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_InitiatedTeleportersCellSeparator
source: {PLAYER} initiated the TELEPORTER's\nCell Separator.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_BillsFavoriteMonList
source: BILL's favorite POKéMON list!$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_SeeWhichMon
source: Which POKéMON do you want to see?$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainermJakeSeen
source: I'm making my final preparations\nfor the POKéMON LEAGUE.$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainermJakeBeaten
source: I blew it!$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainermJakeAfter
source: It's going to be tough to win at\nthe LEAGUE.\pI need to do some more training.\pI hear that the LEAGUE's ELITE\nFOUR are tougher than GYM LEADERS.$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainermGavenSeen
source: By experiencing tough battles, you\ngain power.$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainermGavenBeaten
source: Gaah! Life is even tougher!$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainermGavenAfter
source: To get to POKéMON LEAGUE, you have\nto get through VICTORY ROAD.\pBut VICTORY ROAD is tough.\pPractically nobody goes there!$

label: Route26_Text_GavenRegister
source: To get to POKéMON LEAGUE, you have\nto get through VICTORY ROAD.\pBut VICTORY ROAD is tough.\pPractically nobody goes there!$

label: Route26_Text_GavenRematchIntro
source: By experiencing tough battles, you\ngain power.$

label: Route26_Text_GavenRematchDefeat
source: Gaah! Life is even tougher!$

label: Route26_Text_GavenPostRematch
source: To get to POKéMON LEAGUE, you have\nto get through VICTORY ROAD.\pBut VICTORY ROAD is tough.\pPractically nobody goes there!$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainerfJoyceSeen
source: Since you've come this far,\nyou must be good.\pI'm going to give this battle\neverything I've got!$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainerfJoyceBeaten
source: No! I don't believe this!$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainerfJoyceAfter
source: I've defeated eight GYM LEADERS,\nso I was feeling confident.\pI'll have to try harder next time.$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainerfBethSeen
source: I lost to a trainer named {RIVAL}.\pHe was really strong, but…\pIt was as if he absolutely had to\nwin at any cost.\pI felt sorry for his POKéMON.$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainerfBethBeaten
source: POKéMON aren't tools of war.$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainerfBethAfter
source: POKéMON are in-valuable, lifelong\npartners.$

label: Route26_Text_BethRegister
source: POKéMON are invaluable, lifelong\npartners.$

label: Route26_Text_BethRematchIntro
source: I lost to a trainer named {RIVAL}.\pBut I won't lose to you!$

label: Route26_Text_BethRematchDefeat
source: POKéMON aren't tools of war.$

label: Route26_Text_BethPostRematch
source: POKéMON are invaluable, lifelong\npartners.$

label: Route26_Text_PsychicRichardSeen
source: Wow, look at all those BADGES!\nI'm impressed.\pBut you're not satisfied by just\ncollecting them, right?$

label: Route26_Text_PsychicRichardBeaten
source: Good battle!$

label: Route26_Text_PsychicRichardAfter
source: People and POKéMON grow from their\nexperiences.\pDon't get lazy and complacent.$

label: Route26_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 26\pPOKéMON LEAGUE\nRECEPTION GATE$

label: Route26_Text_HealHouseRest
source: Your POKéMON look a little tired.\pYou should rest them a while.$

label: Route26_Text_HealHouseKeepAtIt
source: There!\pYour POKéMON are looking good!\pKeep at it!$

label: DayOfWeekSiblingsHouse_Text_Pokedex1
source: There's something written here.\pRead it?$

label: DayOfWeekSiblingsHouse_Text_Pokedex2
source:
To my brothers and sisters:\pWe take pride in serving POKéMON
trainers.\pWhen trainers talk to you, give
them something useful.\pLove,
MONICA\pKeep reading?$

label: DayOfWeekSiblingsHouse_Text_Pokedex3
source:
Monday, MONICA
ROUTE 40\pTuesday, TUSCANY
ROUTE 29\pWednesday, WESLEY
LAKE OF RAGE\pThursday, ARTHUR
ROUTE 36\pFriday, FRIEDA
ROUTE 32\pSaturday, SANTOS
BLACKTHORN CITY\pSunday, SUNNY
ROUTE 37$

label: Route27_Text_BaobaName
source: BAOBA$

label: Route27_Text_FisherHey
source: Hey!$

label: Route27_Text_FisherMessage
source: Do you know what you just did?\pYou've taken your first step into\nKANTO.\pCheck your POKéGEAR MAP and see.$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainermBlakeSeen
source: You look pretty strong.\nLet me battle you!$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainermBlakeBeaten
source: Yow!$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainermBlakeAfter
source: If you prevail on this harsh trek,\nthe truth will be revealed!\pHeh, sorry, I just wanted to say\nsomething cool.$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainermBrianSeen
source: Hm? You're good, aren't you?$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainermBrianBeaten
source: Just as I thought!$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainermBrianAfter
source: A good trainer can recognize other\ngood trainers.$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainerfReenaSeen
source: You shouldn't underestimate the\nwild POKéMON in these parts.$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainerfReenaBeaten
source: Oh! You're much too strong!$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainerfReenaAfter
source: You're just a kid, but you're not\nto be underestimated either.$

label: Route27_Text_ReenaRegister
source: You're just a kid, but you're not\nto be underestimated either.$

label: Route27_Text_ReenaRematchIntro
source: You shouldn't underestimate the\nwild POKéMON in these parts.$

label: Route27_Text_ReenaRematchDefeat
source: Oh! You're much too strong!$

label: Route27_Text_ReenaPostRematch
source: You're just a kid, but you're not\nto be underestimated either.$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainerfMeganSeen
source: It's rare to see anyone come here.\pAre you training on your own?$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainerfMeganBeaten
source: Oh! You're really strong!$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainerfMeganAfter
source:
I'm checking out pre- and post-
evolution POKéMON.\pEvolution really does make
POKéMON stronger.\pBut evolved forms also learn
moves later on.$

label: Route27_Text_PsychicGilbertSeen
source: Don't say a thing!\pLet me guess what you're thinking.\pMmmmmmm…\pI got it! You're on the POKéMON\nLEAGUE challenge!$

label: Route27_Text_PsychicGilbertBeaten
source: You're too much!$

label: Route27_Text_PsychicGilbertAfter
source: With your skills, you'll do well at\nthe LEAGUE.\pThat's what my premonition says.$

label: Route27_Text_BirdKeeperJoseSeen
source: Tweet! Tweet! Tetweet!$

label: Route27_Text_BirdKeeperJoseBeaten
source: Tweet!$

label: Route27_Text_BirdKeeperJoseAfter
source: BIRD KEEPERS like me mimic bird\nwhistles to command POKéMON.$

label: Route27_Text_JoseRegister
source: BIRD KEEPERS like me mimic bird\nwhistles to command POKéMON.$

label: Route27_Text_JoseRematchIntro
source: Tweet! Tweet! Tetweet!$

label: Route27_Text_JoseRematchDefeat
source: Tweet!$

label: Route27_Text_JosePostRematch
source: BIRD KEEPERS like me mimic bird\nwhistles to command POKéMON.$

label: Route27_Text_JoseHasItem
source: Hey! I found something\nshiny while bird-watching!\pHere, you can have it!$

label: Route27_Text_JoseGaveItem
source: I find all sorts of things\nout here on ROUTE 27.\pI'll let you know if I find\nanything else!$

label: Route27_Text_JoseNoRoom
source: Hmm, your BAG is full.\pCome back when you have room.$

label: TohjoFalls_Text_Sign
source: TOHJO FALLS\pTHE LINK BETWEEN KANTO AND JOHTO$

label: Route27_Text_FisherScottSeen
source: I'm feeling great today!\pI feel like I could boot even the\nLEAGUE CHAMP!$

label: Route27_Text_FisherScottBeaten
source: No! Not in this battle!$

label: Route27_Text_FisherScottAfter
source: Just like in fishing, it's all over\nin POKéMON if you give up.$

label: SandstormHouse_Text_Woman1
source: Where are you off to with\nPOKéMON?\pPOKéMON LEAGUE?\pAre your POKéMON loyal enough for\nyou to win?\pLet me see…$

label: SandstormHouse_Text_LoyalMon
source: Ah! Your POKéMON trusts you very\nmuch.\pIt's nice to see a good trainer.\pHere. A gift for your journey.$

label: SandstormHouse_Text_TM37Description
source: TM37 happens to be SANDSTORM.\pIt's a move that inflicts damage\non both battlers.\pIt's for advanced trainers only.\pUse it if you dare. Good luck!$

label: SandstormHouse_Text_DisloyalMon
source: If it doesn't come to trust you\nsome more, it could be tough going.\pTrust is the tie that binds POKéMON\nand trainers.$

label: Route28_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 28$

label: Route28_Text_Scientist
source: Hiya, Boss.\pYes, I've found several artifacts,\nbut no sign of the AZURE FLUTE.\pIt may be inside the MOUNTAIN, but\nthe wild POKéMON here are strong,\land my team needs some rest...\p..................\pYou're breaking up...\lBoss....?\pI'm going to the POKéMON CENTER.\pI'll call back if I find the FLUTE.$

label: Route28_Text_Scientist2
source: .......CLICK\pThe signal in SINJOH sucks...$

label: Route28House_Text_Celebrity1
source: Oh, dear. You've found me.\pPlease don't tell anyone about me.\pI'll give you this for keeping my\nsecret. Please?$

label: Route28House_Text_Celebrity2
source: It's tough being a top celebrity.\pEverywhere I go, people chase me.\pI just want to be left alone…$

label: Route28House_Text_Fearow
source: FEAROW: Feero!$

label: Route29_Text_PressAorB
source: Press A or B to stop viewing.$

label: Route29_Text_OldMan1
source: POKéMON hide in the grass.\nWho knows when they'll pop out…$

label: Route29_Text_OldMan2
source: I've seen you a couple times.\nHow many POKéMON have you caught?\pWould you like me to tell you\nhow to catch POKéMON?$

label: Route29_Text_OldManExplanation
source:
If you weaken them first,
POKéMON are easier to catch.\pThen, throw a ball at them from
your bag! Any ball will do.\pIf you want to learn more,
go to the ACADEMY in VIOLET CITY!\pThe students there know a lot
about POKéMON.$

label: Route29_Text_OldManDeclined
source:
Oh. Fine, then.\pCheck every route to find
different types of POKéMON.\pYour POKéDEX shows where you can
find them too!\pIf you want to learn more,
go to the ACADEMY in VIOLET CITY!\pThe students know a lot about
POKéMON.$

label: Route29_Text_Youngster
source: Yo. How are your POKéMON?\pIf they're weak and not ready\nfor battle, keep out of the grass.$

label: Route29_Text_Lass
source: See those ledges?\nIt's scary to jump off them.\pBut you can go to NEW BARK\nwithout walking through the grass.$

label: Route29_Text_Girl
source: I wanted to take a break,\nso I saved to record my progress.$

label: Route29_Text_Boy_WaitingForDay
source: I'm waiting for POKéMON that\nappear only later in the day.$

label: Route29_Text_Boy_WaitingForNight
source: I'm waiting for POKéMON that\nappear only at night.$

label: Route29_Text_MeetTuscany
source: TUSCANY: I do believe that this\nis the first time we've met?\pI'm TUSCANY of the WEEKDAY FAMILY.\pIf you can guess my favorite day,\nI'll give you a reward.$

label: Route29_Text_TuscanyNope
source: Not quite!$

label: Route29_Text_TuscanyGivesGift
source: Yes! By way of introduction,\nplease accept this gift, a SILK\lSCARF.$

label: Route29_Text_TuscanyGaveGift
source: TUSCANY: Wouldn't you agree\nthat it is most adorable?\pIt strengthens NORMAL-type\nmoves.\pI am certain it will be of use.$

label: Route29_Text_TuscanyTuesday
source: TUSCANY: Have you met MONICA,\nmy older sister?\pOr my younger brother, WESLEY?\pI am the third of seven\nchildren.$

label: Route29_Text_Sign1
source: ROUTE 29\pCHERRYGROVE CITY - NEW BARK TOWN$

label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_GiveHM05IfSeen10Mons
source:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on ten species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with
HM05 for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
ten kinds of POKéMON?$

label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_GreatHereYouGo
source: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!$

label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_ReceivedHM05FromAide
source: {PLAYER} received HM05\nfrom the AIDE.$

label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_ExplainHM05
source: HM05 contains the hidden move\nFLASH.\pFLASH lights up even the darkest\nof caves and dungeons.$

label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_CanGetThroughRockTunnel
source: Once a POKéMON learns FLASH, you\ncan get through ROCK TUNNEL.$

label: Route2_Text_RouteSign
source: ROUTE 2\nVIRIDIAN CITY - PEWTER CITY$

label: Route2_Text_DiglettsCave
source: DIGLETT'S CAVE$

label: Route2_Text_RobRegister
source: Let me get your number!$

label: Route2_Text_RobRematchIntro
source: I've caught even more bugs!\nCheck them out!$

label: Route2_Text_RobRematchDefeat
source: I need better bugs!$

label: Route2_Text_RobPostRematch
source: I caught every bug in VIRIDIAN.\nIs there a better FOREST somewhere?$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherRob_Seen
source: My bug POKéMON are tough. Prepare to\nlose!$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherRob_Beaten
source: I was whipped…$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherRob_AfterBattle
source: I'm going to look for stronger bug\nPOKéMON.$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherEd_Seen
source: If you walk in tall grass wearing\nshorts, do you get nicks and cuts?$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherEd_Beaten
source: Ouch, ouch, ouch!$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherEd_AfterBattle
source: They'll really sting when you take a\nbath.$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherDoug_Seen
source: Why don't girls like bug POKéMON?$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherDoug_Beaten
source: No good!$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherDoug_AfterBattle
source: Bug POKéMON squish like plush toys\nwhen you squeeze their bellies.\pI love how they feel!$

label: Route2_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 2\pVIRIDIAN CITY - PEWTER CITY$

label: Route2_Text_DiglettsCaveSign
source: DIGLETT'S CAVE$

label: Route2_House_Text_FaintedMonsCanUseFieldMoves
source: A fainted POKéMON just has no\nenergy left to battle.\pIt can still use moves like CUT\noutside of battle.$

label: Route2_House_Text_Fisher
source: Hi! Wow, I'm glad to see you.\pYou're the first visitor I've had in a\nlong time.\pI'm super-happy! Let me give you a\nlittle present.$

label: Route2_House_Text_Fisher_GotNugget
source: That's a NUGGET.\pI can't give you any nuggets of\nwisdom, so that'll have to do!$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_NorthEntrance_Text_ManyMonsOnlyInForests
source: Many POKéMON live only in forests \nand caves.\pYou need to be persistent and look\neverywhere to get different kinds.$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_NorthEntrance_Text_CanCutSkinnyTrees
source: Have you noticed the skinny trees\non the roadside?\pThey can be cut down by a special\nPOKéMON move, I hear.$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_NorthEntrance_Text_CanCancelEvolution
source:
Do you know the evolution-cancel
technique?\pWhen a POKéMON is evolving, you
can stop the process.\pIt's a technique for raising
POKéMON the way they are.$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_SouthEntrance_Text_ForestIsMaze
source: Are you going to VIRIDIAN FOREST?\nIt's a natural maze in there.\lBe careful you don't get lost.$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_SouthEntrance_Text_RattataHasWickedBite
source: RATTATA may be small, but don't\nunderestimate its wicked bite.\pHave you caught one already?$

label: Route30_Text_Mailbox
source: MR.POKéMON's House$

label: Route30_Text_UseTackle
source: Go, RATTATA!\pTACKLE!$

label: Route30_Text_ThisIsABigBattle
source: What? This is a big battle!\nLeave me alone!$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterJoey1Seen
source: I just lost, so I'm trying to\nfind more POKéMON.\pWait! You look weak! Come on,\nlet's battle!$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterJoey1Beaten
source: Ack! I lost again!\nDoggone it!$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterJoey1After
source: Do I have to have more POKéMON\nin order to battle better?\pNo! I'm sticking with this one\nno matter what!$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterMikeySeen
source: You're a POKéMON trainer,\nright?\pThen you have to battle!$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterMikeyBeaten
source: That's strange.\nI won before.$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterMikeyAfter
source: Becoming a good trainer is\nreally tough.\pI'm going to battle other\npeople to get better.$

label: Route30_Text_BugCatcherDonSeen
source: Instead of a bug POKéMON,\nI found a trainer!$

label: Route30_Text_BugCatcherDonBeaten
source: Argh! You're too strong!$

label: Route30_Text_BugCatcherDonAfter
source: I ran out of POKé BALLS while\nI was catching POKéMON.\pI should've bought some more…$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterDirectionsToMrPokemon
source: MR. POKéMON's house?\nIt's a bit farther ahead.$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterEveryoneIsBattling
source: Everyone's having fun\nbattling!\pYou should too!$

label: Route30_Text_CooltrainerF
source: I'm not a trainer.\pBut if you look one in the\neyes, prepare to battle.$

label: Route30_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 30\pVIOLET CITY - CHERRYGROVE CITY$

label: Route30_Text_MrPokemonsHouseDirectionsSign
source: MR. POKéMON'S HOUSE\nSTRAIGHT AHEAD!$

label: Route30_Text_MrPokemonsHouseSign
source: MR. POKéMON'S HOUSE$

label: Route30_Text_TrainerTips
source: TRAINER TIPS\pNo stealing other people's\nPOKéMON!\pPOKé BALLS are to be thrown\nonly at wild POKéMON!$

label: Route30_Text_JoeyRegister
source: You're pretty good!\pMy RATTATA's raring to go,\njust like always.\pIt's the only one I have.\nI'm going to become a great\lTRAINER with it!\pLet's battle again sometime!$

label: Route30_Text_JoeyRematchIntro
source: I promised things would be\ndifferent! Let's battle!$

label: Route30_Text_JoeyRematchDefeat
source: Ack! I lost again!\nDoggone it!$

label: Route30_Text_JoeyPostRematch
source: I'm checking out my\nRATTATA's moves and devising\lsome strategies.\pWhen I come up with a good\none, let's battle!$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterJoeyGiveHPUp
source:
I lost again…
Gee, you're tough!\pOh yeah, I almost forgot that
I had to give you this.\pUse it to get even tougher,
OK?\pI'm going to get tougher too.$

label: Route30_Text_ElmName
source: PROF.ELM$

label: Route30_Text_Elm_Disaster
source: PROF.ELM: H-hello? {PLAYER}? It's\na disaster!\pUh, um, it's just terrible!\pWhat should I do? It…\nOh, no…\pPlease get back here now!$

label: Route30_Text_Poliwag
source: POLIWAG: Wag waag!$

label: Route30_BerryHouse_Text_MonEatBerries
source:
When you follow that path up north,
you will see MR. POKéMON’s house.\pBut before you go, allow me to
tell you about BERRIES!\pPOKéMON get healthier by eating
BERRIES.\pThey can even eat BERRIES
they're holding in battle.\pBERRIES can also be turned into
BALLS by KURT in AZALEA TOWN.\pHere. I'll share one with you!$

label: Route30_BerryHouse_Text_CheckTrees
source: Check trees for BERRIES.\nThey grow back after a few hours.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Intro1
source: Hello, hello! You must be\n{PLAYER}.\pPROF.ELM said that you would\nvisit.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Intro2
source: This is what I want PROF.ELM\nto examine.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_GotEgg
source: {PLAYER} received MYSTERY EGG.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Intro3
source:
I know a couple who run a
POKéMON DAY-CARE service.\pThey gave me that EGG.\pI was intrigued, so I sent
mail to PROF.ELM.\pFor POKéMON evolution,
PROF.ELM is the authority.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Intro4
source: Even PROF.OAK here recognizes\nthat.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Intro5
source: If my assumption is correct,\nPROF.ELM will know it.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Heal
source: You are returning to PROF.ELM?\pHere. Your POKéMON should have\nsome rest.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_DependingOnYou
source: I'm depending on you!$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_AlwaysNewDiscoveries
source: Life is delightful!\nAlways, new discoveries to be made.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_OakIntro
source:
OAK: Aha! So you're {PLAYER}!\pI'm OAK! A POKéMON researcher.\pI was just visiting my old friend
MR. POKéMON.\pI heard you were running an errand
for PROF.ELM, so I waited here.\pOh! What's this? A rare POKéMON!\pLet's see…
Hm, I see!\pI understand why PROF.ELM gave
you a POKéMON for this errand.\pTo researchers like PROF.ELM and
I, POKéMON are our friends.\pHe saw that you would treat your
POKéMON with love and care.\p…Ah!\pYou seem to be dependable. How
would you like to help me out?\pSee? This is the latest version of
the POKéDEX.\pIt automatically records data on
POKéMON you've seen or caught.\pIt's a hi-tech encyclopedia!\pIt shows their habitats, how
they evolve, and their moves.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_GetDex
source: {PLAYER} received POKéDEX!$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_OakParting
source: Go meet many kinds of POKéMON and\ncomplete that POKéDEX!\pBut I've stayed too long.\pI have to get to GOLDENROD\nfor my usual radio show.\p{PLAYER}, I'm counting on you!$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_GimmeTheScale
source:
Hm? That SCALE! What's that?
A red GYARADOS?\pThat's rare! I, I want it…\p{PLAYER}, would you care to
trade it?\pI can offer this EXP.SHARE
that I got from PROF.OAK.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Disappointed
source: That's disappointing.\nThat happens to be very rare.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_ExpShare
source: I also have a special item\nfor you.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_ForeignMagazines
source: It's packed with foreign\nmagazines.\pCan't even read their titles…$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_BrokenComputer
source: It's a big computer.\nHmm. It's broken.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_StrangeCoins
source: A whole pile of strange coins!\pMaybe they're from another\ncountry…$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_GotExpShare
source: {PLAYER} received EXP. SHARE!$

label: Route31_Text_CooltrainerM
source: DARK CAVE…\pIf POKéMON could light it up,\nI'd explore it.$

label: Route31_Text_BugCatcherWade1_Seen
source: I caught a bunch of POKéMON.\nLet me battle with you!$

label: Route31_Text_BugCatcherWade1_Beaten
source: Awwwww…$

label: Route31_Text_BugCatcherWade1_After
source: You can catch POKéMON even if\nyou have six with you.\pIf you catch one, it'll go to\nyour BOX automatically.$

label: Route31_Text_SleepyMan
source: … Hnuurg… Huh?\pI walked too far today looking\nfor POKéMON.\pMy feet hurt and I'm sleepy…\pIf I were a wild POKéMON, I'd\nbe easy to catch…\p…Zzzz…$

label: Route31_Text_SleepyManGotMail
source: …Zzzz… Huh?\pWhat's that? You have MAIL\nfor me?$

label: Route31_Text_SleepyManFail
source: …Zzzz…$

label: Route31_Text_HandOverMailMon
source: {PLAYER} handed over the\nPOKéMON holding the MAIL.$

label: Route31_Text_ReadingMail
source:
Let's see…\pThanks for bringing this to
me.\pMy friend's a good guy, and
you're swell too!\pI'd like to do something good
in return too!\pI know! I want you to have
this!$

label: Route31_Text_DescribeRest
source: ...Zzz...\p...Umm... Rest!\pThe phrase 'recover fast' became\nshortened to 'Rest,' you see?\pThis is a move to sleep and recover\nsome HP.$

label: Route31_Text_WrongMail
source: This MAIL isn't for me.$

label: Route31_Text_MissingMail
source: Why is this POKéMON so special?\pIt doesn't have any MAIL.$

label: Route31_Text_DeclinedToHandOverMail
source: What? You don't want\nanything?$

label: Route31_Text_CantTakeLastMon
source: If I take that POKéMON from\nyou,\pwhat are you going to use in\nbattle?$

label: Route31_Text_Youngster
source:
I found a good POKéMON in DARK
CAVE.\pI'm going to raise it to take
on FALKNER.\pHe's the leader of VIOLET
CITY's GYM.$

label: Route31_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 31\pVIOLET CITY - CHERRYGROVE CITY$

label: Route31_Text_WadeRegister
source:
You're awesome! I like you!\pI look for POKéMON here every
day.\pWhen I'm in the grass, I find
all kinds of BERRIES.\pIf you'd like, I'll share
some.$

label: Route31_Text_WadeRematchIntro
source: I was waiting for you.\nLet's battle!$

label: Route31_Text_WadeRematchDefeat
source: Awwwww…$

label: Route31_Text_WadePostRematch
source: You'll hear from me as soon\nas I find anything that you\lmight like.$

label: Route31_Text_WadeHasItem
source: Hey! I've been looking for\nyou!\pI found something while I\nwas in the grass.\pHere, you can have it!$

label: Route31_Text_WadeGaveItem
source: I'll let you know if I find\nanything else!$

label: Route31_Text_WadeNoRoom
source: Hmm, looks like your BAG\nis full.\pCome back when you have\nroom!$

label: Route31_Text_DarkCaveSign
source: DARK CAVE$

label: Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_WhatsTheHurry
source: Wait up!\nWhat's the hurry?$

label: Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_AideIsWaiting
source: {PLAYER}, right?\nSome guy wearing glasses\pwas looking for you.\pSee for yourself. He's waiting for\nyou at the POKéMON CENTER.$

label: Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_SproutTower
source: Have you gone to SPROUT TOWER?\nIf you ever visit VIOLET CITY,\pthey'll expect you to train there.\nThat's basic for trainers.\pGo to SPROUT TOWER!$

label: Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_VioletGym
source: Have you gone to the POKéMON GYM?\nYou can test your POKéMON and\pyourself there.\nIt's a rite of passage for all\ptrainers!$

label: Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_HaveThisSeed
source:
You have some good POKéMON there.
It must be from the training you\pgave them around VIOLET CITY.
The training at the GYM must have\pbeen especially helpful. As a
souvenir of VIOLET CITY, take this.\pIt increases the power of GRASS-
type moves.$

label: Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_Experiences
source: Your experiences in VIOLET CITY\nshould be useful for your journey.$

label: Route32_Text_SlowpokeTailOffer
source: How would you like to have this\ntasty, nutritious SLOWPOKETAIL?\pFor you right now, just\n¥1,000,000!\pYou'll want this!$

label: Route32_Text_ThoughtKidsLoaded
source: Tch! I thought kids\nthese days were loaded…$

label: Route32_Text_RefusedSlowpokeTail
source: You don't want it?\nThen scram. Shoo!$

label: Route32_Text_FisherJustin_Seen
source: Whoa!\pYou made me lose that fish!$

label: Route32_Text_FisherJustin_Beaten
source: Sploosh!$

label: Route32_Text_FisherJustin_After
source: Calm, collected… The essence of\nfishing and POKéMON is the same.$

label: Route32_Text_FisherRalph1_Seen
source: I'm really good at both\nfishing and POKéMON.\pI'm not about to lose to any kid!$

label: Route32_Text_FisherRalph1_Beaten
source: Tch! I tried to rush\nthings…$

label: Route32_Text_FisherRalph1_After
source: Fishing is a lifelong\npassion.\pPOKéMON are lifelong friends!$

label: Route32_Text_RalphRegister
source: Fishing is a lifelong\npassion.\pPOKéMON are lifelong friends!$

label: Route32_Text_RalphRematchIntro
source: I'm really good at both\nfishing and POKéMON.\pI'm not about to lose to any kid!$

label: Route32_Text_RalphRematchDefeat
source: Tch! I tried to rush\nthings…$

label: Route32_Text_RalphPostRematch
source: Fishing is a lifelong\npassion.\pPOKéMON are lifelong friends!$

label: Route32_Text_FisherHenry_Seen
source: My POKéMON? Freshly caught!$

label: Route32_Text_FisherHenry_Beaten
source: SPLASH?$

label: Route32_Text_FisherHenry_After
source: Freshly caught POKéMON are\nno match for properly raised ones.$

label: Route32_Text_YoungsterAlbert_Seen
source: I haven't seen you around before.\nSo you think you are pretty tough?$

label: Route32_Text_YoungsterAlbert_Beaten
source: You're strong!$

label: Route32_Text_YoungsterAlbert_After
source: I'm going to try to be the\nbest with my favorites.\pI'm not using the same tough\nPOKéMON as everyone else.$

label: Route32_Text_YoungsterGordon_Seen
source: I found some good POKéMON\nin the grass!\pI think they'll do it for me!$

label: Route32_Text_YoungsterGordon_Beaten
source: Darn. I thought I could win.$

label: Route32_Text_YoungsterGordon_After
source: The grass is full of\nclingy things.$

label: Route32_Text_CamperRoland_Seen
source: That glance… It's intriguing.$

label: Route32_Text_CamperRoland_Beaten
source: Hmmm. This is disappointing.$

label: Route32_Text_CamperRoland_After
source: If you don't want to battle,\njust avoid eye contact.$

label: Route32_Text_PicnickerLiz1_Seen
source: Uh-huh. Yeah, and you know…\pPardon? Battle? I'm on the phone.\nOh, all right. But make it fast.$

label: Route32_Text_PicnickerLiz1_Beaten
source: Oh! I've got to relieve\nmy anger!$

label: Route32_Text_PicnickerLiz1_After
source: I was having a nice chat too.$

label: Route32_Text_LizRegister
source: I was having a nice chat too.$

label: Route32_Text_LizRematchIntro
source: Uh-huh. Yeah, and you know…\pPardon? Battle? I'm on the phone.\nOh, all right. But make it fast.$

label: Route32_Text_LizRematchDefeat
source: Oh! I've got to relieve\nmy anger!$

label: Route32_Text_LizPostRematch
source: I was having a nice chat too.$

label: Route32_Text_BirdKeeperPeter_Seen
source: That BADGE! It's from VIOLET CITY!\nYou beat FALKNER?$

label: Route32_Text_BirdKeeperPeter_Beaten
source: I know what my weaknesses are.$

label: Route32_Text_BirdKeeperPeter_After
source: I should train again at the\nGYM in VIOLET CITY.$

label: Route32_Text_RoarIntro
source: WROOOOAR! PEOPLE RUN WHEN I\nROAR! BUT YOU CAME LOOKING!\pTHAT PLEASES ME! NOW TAKE THIS!$

label: Route32_Text_RoarOutro
source: WROOOOAR! IT'S ROAR!\pEVEN POKéMON RUN FROM A GOOD\nROAR!$

label: Route32_Text_MeetFrieda
source: FRIEDA: Yahoo!\pI'm FRIEDA of the WEEKDAY FAMILY!\nNice to meet you!\pIf you can guess my favorite day,\nI'll give you a reward.$

label: Route32_Text_FriedaGivesGift
source: Here's a POISON BARB for you!$

label: Route32_Text_FriedaGaveGift
source: FRIEDA: Give it to a POKéMON\nthat has POISON-type moves.\pOh!\pIt's wicked!\pYou'll be shocked how good it\nmakes poison moves!$

label: Route32_Text_FriedaFriday
source: FRIEDA: Hiya! What day do\nyou like?\pI love Friday. No doubt about\nit!\pDon't you think it's great too?$

label: Route32_Text_FriedaNope
source: FRIEDA: Not that one!$

label: Route32_Text_Sign1
source: ROUTE 32\pVIOLET CITY - AZALEA TOWN$

label: Route32_Text_Sign2
source: RUINS OF ALPH\nEAST ENTRANCE$

label: Route32_Text_Sign3
source: UNION CAVE\nAHEAD$

label: Route32_Pokecenter_Text_FishingGuruQuestion
source: This is a great fishing spot.\pYou saw people fishing?\nHow about you?\pWould you like one of my RODS?$

label: Route32_Pokecenter_Text_FishingGuruYes
source: Heh, that's good to hear.\pNow you're an angler too!$

label: Route32_Pokecenter_Text_FishingGuruGiveRod
source: Fishing is great!\pIf there's water, be it the sea or\na stream, try out your ROD.$

label: Route32_Pokecenter_Text_FishingGuruNo
source: Oh. That's rather disappointing…$

label: Route32_Pokecenter_Text_FishingGuruAfter
source: Yo, kid. How are they biting?$

label: Route32_Pokecenter_Text_CooltrainerF
source: What should I make my POKéMON hold?\pMaybe an item that increases\nATTACK power…$

label: Route33_Text_HikerAnthony2Seen
source: I came through the tunnel,\nbut I still have plenty\lof energy left.$

label: Route33_Text_HikerAnthony2Beaten
source: Whoa! You've got more zip\nthan me!$

label: Route33_Text_HikerAnthony2After
source: We HIKERS are at our best\nin the mountains.$

label: Route33_Text_AnthonyRegister
source: We HIKERS are at our best\nin the mountains.$

label: Route33_Text_AnthonyRematchIntro
source: I came through the tunnel,\nbut I still have plenty\lof energy left.$

label: Route33_Text_AnthonyRematchDefeat
source: Whoa! You've got more zip\nthan me!$

label: Route33_Text_AnthonyPostRematch
source: We HIKERS are at our best\nin the mountains.$

label: Route33_Text_HikerAnthonyDunsparce
source: Hey, did you get a DUNSPARCE?\pI caught one too.\pTake a look at it in the light.\nIt's got a funny face!$

label: Route33_Text_Lass
source: Pant, pant…\pThat cave was bigger than\nI'd expected.\pI got too tired exploring\nfor MARILL, so I came outside.$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_Bookshelf1
source: A BABY POKéMON encyclopedia!\pVOLUME 1: ALL ABOUT ABILITIES$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_Bookshelf2
source: A BABY POKéMON encyclopedia!\pVOLUME 2: TYPICAL TYPES$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_Bookshelf3
source: A BABY POKéMON encyclopedia!\pVOLUME 3: BABIES' CRIES$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_Bookshelf4
source: A BABY POKéMON encyclopedia!\pVOLUME 4: ADORABLE ACTIONS$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_ClerkBefore
source: I'm the DAY-CARE couple's son.\pAn ODD EGG was found with a TRAINER's\nPOKéMON, but they didn't want it...\pI'd offer it to you...\nBut how can I know you'll take good\lcare of it?$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_ClerkNoRoom
source: It looks like you can't carry another\nPOKéMON anyway.$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_ClerkQuestion
source: Answer this question for me.\nHow do you feel about this ODD EGG?$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_Rejection
source: Hmm, I think this EGG isn't for you.\pIt would be irresponsible of me to\ngive out a precious EGG like this\lto someone who isn't as well-read\lon the subject of baby POKéMON!$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_ReceivedOddEgg
source: {PLAYER} Received the ODD EGG.$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_TakeCare
source: I knew you were the right trainer\nfor the job. Take good care of it!$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_ClerkAfter
source: We see a lot of those eggs around\nhere.\pSomething was different about that\none, though.$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_Ditto
source: DITTO: Tto!$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_ClosedForChallenge
source: Sorry, we can't look after your\nPOKéMON during a party limit\lchallenge!$

label: Route34_Text_SeeWifeIfYoudLikeMeToRaiseMon
source: I'm the DAY-CARE MAN.\pI help take care of the precious\nPOKéMON of TRAINERS.\pIf you'd like me to raise your POKéMON,\nhave a word with my wife.$

label: Route34_Text_DoYouWantEgg
source: Ah, it's you!\pWe were raising your POKéMON,\nand my goodness, were we surprised!\pYour POKéMON had an EGG!\pWe don't know how it got there,\nbut your POKéMON had it.\pYou do want it, yes?$

label: Route34_Text_YourMonIsDoingFine
source: Ah, it's you! Good to see you.\nYour {STR_VAR_1}'s doing fine.$

label: Route34_Text_IllKeepIt
source: Well then, I'll keep it.\nThanks!$

label: Route34_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForIt
source: You have no room for it…\nCome back when you've made room.$

label: Route34_Text_ReceivedEgg
source: {PLAYER} received the EGG from\nthe DAY-CARE MAN.$

label: Route34_Text_TakeGoodCareOfIt
source: Take good care of it.$

label: Route34_Text_FriendlyWithOtherTrainersMon
source: By the way, about your {STR_VAR_1},\nit seemed to be friendly with\l{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}.\pI may even have seen it receiving\na piece of MAIL.$

label: Route34_Text_SeeWifeIfYouWantToPickUpMon
source: If you want to pick up your POKéMON,\nhave a word with my wife.$

label: Route34_Text_YourMonsAreDoingFine
source: Ah, it's you! Your {STR_VAR_1} and\n{STR_VAR_2} are doing fine.$

label: Route34_Text_IWillKeepDoYouWantIt
source: I really will keep it.\nYou do want this, yes?$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_WouldYouLikeUsToRaiseAMon
source: I'm the DAY-CARE LADY.\pWe can raise POKéMON for you.\pWould you like us to raise one?$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_WhichMonShouldWeRaise
source: Which POKéMON should we raise for\nyou?$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_WellRaiseYourMon
source: Fine, we'll raise your {STR_VAR_1}\nfor a while.\pCome back for it later.$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_WeCanRaiseOneMore
source: We can raise two of your POKéMON.\nWould you like us to raise one more?$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_HusbandWasLookingForYou
source: My husband was looking for you.$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_FineThenComeAgain
source: Oh, fine, then.\nCome again.$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_NotEnoughMoney
source: You don't have enough money…$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_TakeOtherOneBackToo
source: Will you take back the other one,\ntoo?$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_ComeAgain
source: Fine.\nCome again.$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_GoodToSeeYou
source: Ah, it's you! Good to see you.\nYour POKéMON can only be doing good!$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_YourMonHasGrownXLevels
source: By level, your {STR_VAR_1} has\ngrown by {STR_VAR_2}.$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_YourTeamIsFull
source: Your POKéMON team is full.\nMake room, then come see me.$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_TakeBackWhichMon
source: Which POKéMON will you take back?$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_ItWillCostX
source: If you want your {STR_VAR_1} back,\nit will cost ¥{STR_VAR_2}.$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_HeresYourMon
source: Perfect!\nHere's your POKéMON.$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_TookBackMon
source: {PLAYER} took back {STR_VAR_1} from\nthe DAY-CARE LADY.$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_YouHaveJustOneMon
source: Oh? But you have just one\nPOKéMON.\pCome back another time.$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_TakeYourMonBack

a POKéMON steal a foe's move\lright before it's used.\pIf more than one POKéMON use

label: Route39_Text_ChooseLegend
source: BAOBA: GOOD HEAVENS! Did that\nshadow belong to a POKéMON?\pDid you get a good look at it?\nI can't tell what color it was...$

label: Route39_Text_BaobaIntro
source:
How strange...\p...Ohh!
What you are holding is...\lwhat they call... a POKéDEX!\pHaven't seen one of those in ages.\pMy name is BAOBA!
I used to run a SAFARI ZONE in\lFUCHSIA CITY, but it was becoming\lout of date with new entertainment\loptions coming out.\pI decided to go overseas to learn
the newest technology and open a\lstate-of-the-art SAFARI ZONE\lin CIANWOOD.\pIt may be more than a coincidence
that we are chatting.\pWhy don't we register each other's
numbers in the POKéGEAR?\pI can give you a call once the
SAFARI ZONE is open before I call\lanyone else!$

label: Route39_Text_Registered

source: Hey!\nI saw you in VIRIDIAN FOREST!$

label: Route3_Text_ColtonDefeat
source: You beat me again!$

label: Route3_Text_ColtonPostBattle
source: There are other kinds of POKéMON\nthan the ones you find in forests.$

label: Route3_Text_BenIntro
source: Hi!\nI like shorts!\pThey're delightfully comfy and\neasy to wear!$

label: Route3_Text_BenDefeat
source: I don't believe it!$

label: Route3_Text_BenPostBattle
source: Are you using a POKéMON CENTER's\nPC for storing your POKéMON?\pEach BOX can hold up to\n30 POKéMON.$

label: Route3_Text_JaniceIntro
source: Excuse me!\nYou looked at me, didn't you?$

label: Route3_Text_JaniceDefeat
source: You're mean!$

label: Route3_Text_JanicePostBattle
source: You shouldn't be staring if you\ndon't want to battle!$

label: Route3_Text_GregIntro
source: Are you a TRAINER?\nLet's get with it right away!$

label: Route3_Text_GregDefeat
source: If I had new POKéMON, I would've\nwon!$

label: Route3_Text_GregPostBattle
source: If a POKéMON BOX on the PC gets\nfull, just switch to another BOX.$

label: Route3_Text_SallyIntro
source: That look you gave me…\nIt's so intriguing!$

label: Route3_Text_SallyDefeat
source: Be nice!$

label: Route3_Text_SallyPostBattle
source: You can avoid battles by not\nletting TRAINERS see you.$

label: Route3_Text_CalvinIntro
source: Hey! You're not wearing shorts!\nWhat's wrong with you?$

label: Route3_Text_CalvinDefeat
source: Lost!\nLost! Lost!$

label: Route3_Text_CalvinPostBattle
source: I always wear shorts, even in\nwinter. That's my policy.$

label: Route3_Text_JamesIntro
source: I'll battle you with the POKéMON\nI just caught.$

label: Route3_Text_JamesDefeat
source: Done like dinner!$

label: Route3_Text_JamesPostBattle
source: Trained POKéMON are stronger than\nthe wild ones.$

label: Route3_Text_RobinIntro
source: Eek!\nDid you touch me?$

label: Route3_Text_RobinDefeat
source: That's it?$

label: Route3_Text_RobinPostBattle
source: ROUTE 4 is at the foot of\nMT. MOON.$

label: Route3_Text_RouteSign
source: ROUTE 3\nMT. MOON AHEAD$

label: Route3_Text_FirebreatherOtis_Seen
source: Ah! The weather's as fine as ever.$

label: Route3_Text_FirebreatherOtis_Beaten
source: It's sunny, but I'm all wet…$

label: Route3_Text_FirebreatherOtis_AfterBattle
source: When it rains, it's hard to get\nignition…$

label: Route3_Text_YoungsterWarren_Seen
source: Hmmm… I don't know what to do…$

label: Route3_Text_YoungsterWarren_Beaten
source: I knew I'd lose…$

label: Route3_Text_YoungsterWarren_AfterBattle
source: You looked strong.\pI was afraid to take you on…$

label: Route3_Text_YoungsterJimmy_Seen
source: I can run like the wind!$

label: Route3_Text_YoungsterJimmy_Beaten
source: Blown away!$

label: Route3_Text_YoungsterJimmy_AfterBattle
source: I wear shorts the whole year round.\pThat's my fashion policy.$

label: Route3_Text_FirebreatherBurt_Seen
source: Step right up and take a look!$

label: Route3_Text_FirebreatherBurt_Beaten
source: Yow! That's hot!$

label: Route3_Text_FirebreatherBurt_AfterBattle
source: The greatest fire-breather in KANTO,\nthat's me.\pBut not the best trainer…$

label: Route3_Text_MtMoonSquareSign
source: MT.MOON SQUARE\pJust go up the stairs.$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmermSimonSeen
source: You have to warm up before\ngoing into the water.\pThat's basic.$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmermSimonBeaten
source: OK! Uncle! I give!$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmermSimonAfter
source: CIANWOOD CITY is a good\ndistance away from here.$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmermRandallSeen
source: Hey, you're young and fit!\pDon't ride your POKéMON!\nSwim!$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmermRandallBeaten
source: Uh-oh. I lost…$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmermRandallAfter
source: Swimming exercises your\nentire body. It's healthy.$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmerfElaineSeen
source: Are you going to CIANWOOD?\pHow about a quick battle\nfirst?$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmerfElaineBeaten
source: I lost that one!$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmerfElaineAfter
source: I'd say I'm a better swimmer\nthan you. Yeah!$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmerfPaulaSeen
source: No inner tube for me.\pI'm hanging on to a sea\nPOKéMON!$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmerfPaulaBeaten
source: Ooh, I'm feeling dizzy!$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmerfPaulaAfter
source: While I float like this,\nthe waves carry me along.$

label: Route40_Text_Lass1
source: Although you can't see it from here,\nCIANWOOD is across the sea.$

label: Route40_Text_Lass2
source: I came to OLIVINE by ship to see\nthe sights and soak up the\latmosphere.\pBeing a port, it feels so\ndifferent from a big city.$

label: Route40_Text_StandingYoungster
source:
Have you gone to the TRAINER
HILL?\pI think a lot of tough trainers
have gathered there already.\pBut since you have so many BADGES
you shouldn't do badly at all.$

label: Route40_Text_Monica
source: MONICA: Glad to meet you.\nI'm MONICA of the WEEKDAY FAMILY.\pI bet you can't guess my favorite\nday of the week!$

label: Route40_Text_MonicaGivesGift
source: That's right!\pAs a token of our friendship,\nI have a gift for you!$

label: Route40_Text_MonicaGaveGift
source: MONICA: It's an item that raises\nthe power of FLYING-type moves.\pYou should equip a bird\nPOKéMON with that item.$

label: Route40_Text_MonicaMonday
source: MONICA: My brothers and\nsisters are all over the place.\pSee if you could find\nthem all!$

label: Route40_Text_MonicaNotMonday
source: MONICA: I don't think today\nis Monday. How sad…$

label: Route40_Text_MonicaNope
source: Not that one.$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermCharlieSeen
source: The water's warm here.\nI'm loose and limber.\pSure, I'll take you on!$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermCharlieBeaten
source: Yikes! I've got prune skin!$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermCharlieAfter
source: Isn't it relaxing just floating\nlike this?$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermGeorgeSeen
source: I'm a bit tired.\nIf I win, lend me your POKéMON.$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermGeorgeBeaten
source: Pant, pant…$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermGeorgeAfter
source: It's so far to CIANWOOD.\pBut it's no easy return trip\nto OLIVINE either.\pWhat should I do?$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermBerkeSeen
source: See those islands that are\nblocked by whirlpools?\pThere just has to be a secret!$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermBerkeBeaten
source: What's the secret to your\nstrength?$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermBerkeAfter
source: It was a dark and stormy night…\pI saw this giant POKéMON flying\nfrom the islands.\pIt was scattering feathers\nfrom its silver wings.$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermKirkSeen
source: The waves are wild here.\pThey tire you out while\nyou swim.$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermKirkBeaten
source: I'm beat!$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermKirkAfter
source: The currents keep me from\nreaching that island.$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermMathewSeen
source: Are you seeking the secrets\nof WHIRL ISLANDS?$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermMathewBeaten
source: Ooh, you've got great endurance!$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermMathewAfter
source: A secret about WHIRL ISLANDS…\pIt's pitch-black inside!$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfKayleeSeen
source: I'm on my way to WHIRL ISLANDS.\pI'm going exploring with friends.$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfKayleeBeaten
source: Is that how you do it?$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfKayleeAfter
source: There's supposed to be a big\nPOKéMON deep beneath WHIRL ISLANDS.\pI wonder what it could be?$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfSusieSeen
source: You look so elegant,\nriding your POKéMON.$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfSusieBeaten
source: I'm crushed…$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfSusieAfter
source: Wasn't there a hit song about\na boy riding a LAPRAS?$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfDeniseSeen
source: The weather is so beautiful,\nI'm in a daze!$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfDeniseBeaten
source: Ohhh!$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfDeniseAfter
source: A sunburn is the worst for skin.\pBut I don't use a sunblock.\pI won't pollute the water.$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfKaraSeen
source: If you need to rest,\njust tread water.\pYou'll get your wind back,\nso you can keep on going strong.$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfKaraBeaten
source: Oh! You have more energy than I do.$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfKaraAfter
source: I heard roars from deep inside\nthe ISLANDS.$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfWendySeen
source: At night, STARYU gather near\nthe water's surface.$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfWendyBeaten
source: Oh, dear…$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfWendyAfter
source: The clusters of STARYU light up\nat the same time.\pIt's so beautiful, it's scary.$

label: Route41_Text_Tentacruel
source: TENTACRUEL: Cruooo...$

label: Route41_Text_TentacruelAttack
source: TENTACRUEL: CRUOOOOOO!$

label: Route41_Text_TentacruelHeal
source: The TENTACRUEL used RECOVER!\nIt is fully healed!$

label: Route42_Text_EusineAdmireSuicune
source: EUSINE: SUICUNE...\nHow brave it is!\pHow refreshing it is!\nHow beautiful it is!\pAnd how quickly it moves!$

label: Route42_Text_EusineJealous
source:
{PLAYER}!\pYou seem to be around where
SUICUNE would appear.\pWell, that's OK.\lMy desire to search for
SUICUNE is far beyond yours...\pMy grandpa was... quite into
myths.\pI've heard so many stories
about SUICUNE from him.$

label: Route42_Text_EusineWontGiveUp
source: SUICUNE...\nI won't stop following you\luntil I've found out what\lyou're after...\pYou hear me!$

label: Route42_Text_FisherTullySeen
source: Let me demonstrate the power\nof the POKéMON I caught!$

label: Route42_Text_FisherTullyBeaten
source: What? That's not right.\nI can't believe this!$

label: Route42_Text_FisherTullyAfter
source: I want to become the trainer\nCHAMP using the POKéMON I\lcaught myself.\pThat's the best part of fishing!$

label: Route42_Text_HikerBenjaminSeen
source: Ah, it's good to be outside!\nI feel so free!$

label: Route42_Text_HikerBenjaminBeaten
source: Gahahah! That was a good\nbattle!$

label: Route42_Text_HikerBenjaminAfter
source: Losing feels insignificant\nif you look up at the big sky!$

label: Route42_Text_PokemaniacShaneSeen
source: HEY!\pThis is my secret place!\nGet lost, you outsider!$

label: Route42_Text_PokemaniacShaneBeaten
source: I should have used my\nMOON STONE…$

label: Route42_Text_PokemaniacShaneAfter
source: You're working on a POKéDEX?\pWow, you must know some\npretty rare POKéMON!\pMay I please see it?\nPlease?$

label: Route42_Text_MtMortarSign1
source: MT.MORTAR\pWATERFALL CAVE INSIDE$

source: I want to become the trainer\nCHAMP using the POKéMON I\lcaught myself.\pThat's the best part of fishing!$

source: I want to become the trainer\nCHAMP using the POKéMON I\lcaught myself.\pThat's the best part of fishing!$

source: I'll let you know if I\nreel in anything else!$

label: Route42_Text_TullyNoRoom
source: Hmm, your BAG is full.\pCome back when you have room.$

label: Route43_Text_PokemaniacBenSeen
source: I love POKéMON!\pThat's why I started--and why I'll\nkeep on collecting POKéMON!$

label: Route43_Text_PokemaniacBenBeaten
source: How could you do this to me?$

label: Route43_Text_PokemaniacBenAfter
source: What else do I like besides\nPOKéMON?\pMARY on the radio. I bet she's\ncute!$

label: Route43_Text_PokemaniacBrentSeen
source: Hey! Do you have any rare\nPOKéMON?$

label: Route43_Text_PokemaniacBrentBeaten
source: Oh, my poor POKéMON! Darlings!$

label: Route43_Text_PokemaniacBrentAfter
source: I'd be happy just to own a single\nrare POKéMON.$

label: Route43_Text_BrentRegister
source: I'd be happy just to own a single\nrare POKéMON.$

label: Route43_Text_BrentRematchIntro
source: Hey! Do you have any rare\nPOKéMON?$

label: Route43_Text_BrentRematchDefeat
source: Oh, my poor POKéMON! Darlings!$

label: Route43_Text_BrentPostRematch
source: I'd be happy just to own a single\nrare POKéMON.$

label: Route43_Text_PokemaniacRonSeen
source: Would you get this?\pSome {RIVAL} guy made fun of my\nPOKéMON!\pDarn it! My POKéMON's great!$

label: Route43_Text_PokemaniacRonBeaten
source: My NIDOKING did pretty right on!$

label: Route43_Text_PokemaniacRonAfter
source: It's okay for people to like\ndifferent types of POKéMON.\pPOKéMON isn't just about having the\nmost powerful one.$

label: Route43_Text_FisherMarvinSeen
source: I'm in a slump.\pMaybe it's the gear I'm using.\pLet's battle for a change of pace!$

label: Route43_Text_FisherMarvinBeaten
source: I lost, but I feel better anyway.$

label: Route43_Text_FisherMarvinAfter
source: KURT's LURE BALL is the best for\ncatching hooked POKéMON.\pIt's much more effective than a\nULTRA BALL.$

label: Route43_Text_CamperSpencerSeen
source: I can do so much with my\nPOKéMON--it's super-fun!$

label: Route43_Text_CamperSpencerBeaten
source: Losing isn't fun at all…$

label: Route43_Text_CamperSpencerAfter
source: What is going on at LAKE OF RAGE?\pWe were planning to camp there.$

label: Route43_Text_PicnickerTiffanySeen
source: Are you going to LAKE OF RAGE too?\pLet's play for a little while!$

label: Route43_Text_PicnickerTiffanyBeaten
source: I played too much!$

label: Route43_Text_PicnickerTiffanyWantsPicnic
source: I'm having a picnic with POKéMON.\pWon't you join us?$

source: I'm having a picnic with POKéMON.\pWon't you join us?$

source: I played too much!$

source: I'm having a picnic with POKéMON.\pWon't you join us?$

label: Route43_TrainerTips
source:
TRAINER TIPS\pAll POKéMON have pros and cons
depending on their types.\pIf their types differ, a higher-
level POKéMON may lose in battle.\pLearn which types are strong and
weak against your POKéMON's type.$

label: Route44_Text_FisherWilton1Seen
source: Aack!\pYou made me lose a POLIWAG!\nWhat are you going to do about it?$

label: Route44_Text_FisherWilton1Beaten
source: Just forget about it.$

label: Route44_Text_FisherWiltonHugePoliwag
source: That POLIWAG that got away…\nit was huge.\pI swear it must've been\n16 feet long!$

label: Route44_Text_WiltonRegister
source: That POLIWAG that got away…\nit was huge.\pI swear it must've been\n16 feet long!$

label: Route44_Text_WiltonPostRematch
source: That POLIWAG that got away…\nit was huge.\pI swear it must've been\n16 feet long!$

label: Route44_Text_WiltonHasItem
source: Hey! I reeled in something\nother than a POKéMON!\pHere, you can have it!$

label: Route44_Text_WiltonGaveItem
source: I'll let you know if I\nfish up anything else!$

label: Route44_Text_WiltonNoRoom
source: Hmm, your BAG is full.\pCome back when you have room.$

label: Route44_Text_FisherEdgarSeen
source: I fish until I can't anymore.\pI also battle until I drop.\pThat's my relationship with my\nPOKéMON.$

label: Route44_Text_FisherEdgarBeaten
source: Hmmmm… This isn't right.$

label: Route44_Text_FisherEdgarAfter
source: That's 100 wins to 101 losses.\pI won't battle again for a while.$

label: Route44_Text_BirdKeeperVance1Seen
source: Do you know about the legendary\nbird POKéMON?$

label: Route44_Text_BirdKeeperVance1Beaten
source: Whew! You're hot stuff.$

label: Route44_Text_BirdKeeperVanceBirds
source: ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS and MOLTRES are\nthe three legendary bird POKéMON.\pI heard there are other legendary\nbirds, though.$

label: Route44_Text_VanceRegister
source: ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS and MOLTRES are\nthe three legendary bird POKéMON.\pI heard there are other legendary\nbirds, though.$

label: Route44_Text_VanceRematchIntro
source: Do you know about the legendary\nbird POKéMON?$

label: Route44_Text_VanceRematchDefeat
source: Whew! You're hot stuff.$

label: Route44_Text_VancePostRematch
source: ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS and MOLTRES are\nthe three legendary bird POKéMON.\pI heard there are other legendary\nbirds, though.$

label: Route44_Text_PsychicPhilSeen
source: I'm gonna win, for sure!$

label: Route44_Text_PsychicPhilBeaten
source: Arrgh… That's a shocking loss…$

label: Route44_Text_PsychicPhilAfter
source: It's important to have conviction\non your side.$

label: Route44_Text_PokemaniacZachSeen
source: I'll do anything to get my hands\non rare POKéMON!$

label: Route44_Text_PokemaniacZachBeaten
source: Oooh, your POKéMON are so\nappealing.$

label: Route44_Text_PokemaniacZachAfter
source: If a POKéMON has different colors\nfrom usual, it's more valuable.\pWhat? You mean that's not true?$

label: Route44_Text_CooltrainermAllenSeen
source: I can tell you're a good trainer\nby looking at you.\pI'm good at POKéMON, and I can\nsee that you are too.$

label: Route44_Text_CooltrainermAllenBeaten
source: Tch! It's a total loss on my part.$

label: Route44_Text_CooltrainermAllenAfter
source: Wow. You have a lot of BADGES.\pNo wonder you're so tough.\pI wonder if ECRUTEAK GYM's MORTY\nis still in training?\pHe really hammered me.$

label: Route44_Text_CooltrainerfCybilSeen
source: You look strong.\pGood trainers seek tough\nopponents instinctively.$

label: Route44_Text_CooltrainerfCybilBeaten
source: Nope! This won't do at all.$

label: Route44_Text_CooltrainerfCybilAfter
source: We all get better by experiencing\nmany battles.\pI battled a lot to become what I\nam today--an elite.$

label: Route44_Text_Sign1
source: ROUTE 44\nICE PATH AHEAD$

label: Route44_Text_Sign2
source: ROUTE 44\pMAHOGANY TOWN - BLACKTHORN CITY$

label: Route45_Text_HikerErikSeen
source: Be prepared for anything!\pLet me see if your POKéMON have\nbeen raised properly!$

label: Route45_Text_HikerErikBeaten
source: Oh, I lost that!$

label: Route45_Text_HikerErikAfter
source: I'll head back to BLACKTHORN's\nICE PATH and train some more.$

label: Route45_Text_HikerMichaelSeen
source: Yo! You're spunky! But you know\nwhat?\pWhen it comes to sheer\nspunkiness, I'm the man!$

label: Route45_Text_HikerMichaelBeaten
source: My POKéMON weren't spunky enough!$

label: Route45_Text_HikerMichaelAfter
source: Boy, do I love HP UP! Mmmm, yum!\pI keep drinking my POKéMON's!\pI can't help it!$

label: Route45_Text_HikerParrySeen
source: My POKéMON are power packed!$

label: Route45_Text_HikerParryBeaten
source: Wahahah! I'm the big loser!$

label: Route45_Text_HikerParryAfter
source: I'm not much good at thinking,\nsee?\pSo, I just plow ahead with power!$

label: Route45_Text_ParryRegister
source: I'm not much good at thinking,\nsee?\pSo, I just plow ahead with power!$

label: Route45_Text_ParryRematchIntro
source: My POKéMON are power packed!$

label: Route45_Text_ParryRematchDefeat
source: Wahahah! I'm the big loser!$

label: Route45_Text_ParryPostRematch
source: I'm not much good at thinking,\nsee?\pSo, I just plow ahead with power!$

label: Route45_Text_HikerTimothySeen
source: Why do I climb mountains?\pBecause they're there.\pWhy do I train POKéMON?\pBecause they're there!$

label: Route45_Text_HikerTimothyBeaten
source: Losses… They're there too!$

label: Route45_Text_HikerTimothyAfter
source: The best thing to ever happen to\nme was discovering POKéMON.$

label: Route45_Text_HikerParryGivesIron
source: I just can't find a way to win!\pKeep it up!\pOh, and take this -- it's the\ngift you couldn't take when we\nlast met.$

label: Route45_Text_BlackbeltKenjiSeen
source: I was training here alone.\pBehold the fruits of my labor!$

label: Route45_Text_BlackbeltKenjiBeaten
source: Waaaargh!$

label: Route45_Text_BlackbeltKenjiAfter
source: This calls for extreme measures.\pI must take to the hills and train\nin solitude.$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiRegister
source: This calls for extreme measures.\pI must take to the hills and train\nin solitude.$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiRematchIntro
source: I was training here alone.\pBehold the fruits of my labor!$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiRematchDefeat
source: Waaaargh!$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiPostRematch
source: This calls for extreme measures.\pI must take to the hills and train\nin solitude.$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiHasItem
source: Hey! I'm taking a break from\ntraining.\pI found something good while I\nwas out. Here, take it!$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiGaveItem
source: Use it well!\pI need to get back to my\ntraining. Oooooaaarrrgh!$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiNoRoom
source: Hmm, your BAG is full.\pCome back when you have room.$

label: Route45_Text_BlackbeltKenjiMorning
source: I'm going to train a bit more\nbefore I break for lunch.$

label: Route45_Text_BlackbeltKenjiNight
source: We had plenty of rest at lunch, so\pnow we're all ready to go again!\pWe're going to train again!$

label: Route45_Text_CooltrainermRyanSeen
source: What are your thoughts on\nraising POKéMON?$

label: Route45_Text_CooltrainermRyanBeaten
source: You've won my respect.$

label: Route45_Text_CooltrainermRyanAfter
source: I see you're raising your POKéMON\nwith care.\pThe bond you build will save you\nin tough situations.$

label: Route45_Text_CooltrainerfKellySeen
source: What is your battle strategy?\pIt is foolish to use strong moves\nindiscriminately.$

label: Route45_Text_CooltrainerfKellyBeaten
source: Fine. I lost.$

label: Route45_Text_CooltrainerfKellyAfter
source: I'm not in favor of overly\npowerful moves.\pI want to win, but I also don't\nwant to harm POKéMON.$

label: Route45_Text_CamperQuentinSeen
source: I'm really, really tough!$

label: Route45_Text_CamperQuentinBeaten
source: I was tough at the TRAINER HILL…$

label: Route45_Text_CamperQuentinAfter
source: Have you been to the TRAINER HILL?\pI never, ever lose there, but…$

label: Route45_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 45\nMOUNTAIN RD. AHEAD$

label: Route46_Text_HikerBaileySeen
source: Awright! I'll show you the\npower of mountain POKéMON!$

label: Route46_Text_HikerBaileyBeaten
source: Mercy! You showed me your\npower!$

label: Route46_Text_HikerBaileyAfterBattle
source: It's over. I don't mind.\nWe HIKERS are like that.$

me again and again.\pHere's that present from the
other time.$

source: ROUTE 46\nMOUNTAIN RD. AHEAD$

label: Route47_Text_HikerSeen
source: Longing for others is...\nwhat it is. \pBut battles are battles,\nso let's go!$

source: Wahaha!$

label: Route47_Text_CamperAfter
source: See ya!$

label: Route47_Text_Couple1Seen
source: THOM: One plus one is two. But the\ntwo of us together is much\lstronger!\pKAE: The two of us aren't just some\nboring pair!$

source: THOM: That wasn't what I expected.\lKAE: You're unusual too!$

label: Route47_Text_Couple1After1
source: THOM: It seems your power is\nimpossible to predict!$

label: Route47_Text_Couple1After2
source: KAE: I figured you were an ordinary\nlone trainer. Boy was I wrong!$

label: Route47_Text_Couple2Seen
source: DUFF: Watching over my girlfriend\nmakes my heart soar!\pEDA: My heart's feelings for my\nboyfriend are as wide and deep\lthe ocean!$

label: Route47_Text_Couple2Beaten
source: DUFF: I was no match for you...\lEDA: You are really something...$

label: Route47_Text_Couple2After1

source: EDA: You should really find a\nwonderful partner, too!$

label: EmbeddedTower_Text_OldManIntro
source:
Well, hello!\pIt's said that past this hole used to
be a huge tower reaching far into\lthe sky.\pThey say that it was a rather strange
tower with half of it embedded\lin the cliff.\pIt was not just a tall tower reaching
up to the sky, but also reaching deep\ldown underground!\pIt is rumored that it even reached
the bottom of the ocean!\pIn short, the ruins used to connect
the sky, the land, and the sea to\leach other...\pMost of the tower is now crumbled,
and the only things that remain are\lthe entrance and its interior, where\lyou'll see strange patterns.$

label: Route47_Text_Chinchou
source: CHINCHOU: Chou!$

label: Route49_Text_SkylarDefeat
source: OKAY, you can have the PLATE.$

label: Route49_Text_SkylarAfter
source: As cool as that PLATE is,\nyou earned it fair and square.\pI'll just buy something at the gift\nshop instead.$

label: Route49_Text_SkylarBeforeBattle
source: What?\pYou want the PLATE?\nIt's an artifact imbued with an\lancient power with a connection\lto the legendary POKéMON?!\pWell now I'm definitely keeping it.\pFine.\pYou'll just have to battle me for it.$

label: Route49_Text_SkylarBefore
source: When I was hitting the slopes, my\nskis snagged on something.\pIt was this strange SKY-blue PLATE.\pI think I'll hold onto it as a\nsouvenir!$

label: Route49_Text_SkierM
source: Hey, watch out for my board!\pWhat? You want to battle?\nNo way, these slopes are too wicked!$

label: Route49_Text_KimonoGirl
source: You....\pYou must be {PLAYER}, correct?\nI've heard all about you and\lyour deeds from my cousins\lin ECRUTEAK CITY.\pMy sisters wish to meet with you.\lIf you find the time, please\nseek us out in the town up ahead.$

label: Route49_Text_Sign
source: The sign is faded.\nROUTE 49$

label: Route4_Text_TrippedOverGeodude
source: Ouch! I tripped over a rocky\nPOKéMON, GEODUDE!$

label: Route4_Text_CrissyIntro
source: I came to MT. MOON in search of\nmushroom POKéMON.$

label: Route4_Text_CrissyDefeat
source: After all I did to catch them!$

label: Route4_Text_CrissyPostBattle
source: There might not be any more\nmushrooms here.\pI think I got them all.$

source: MT. MOON\nTunnel Entrance$

label: Route4_Text_RouteSign
source: ROUTE 4\nMT. MOON - CERULEAN CITY$

label: Text_MegaPunchTeach
source: A punch of roaring ferocity!\pPacked with destructive power!\pWhen the chips are down,\nMEGA PUNCH is the ultimate attack!\lYou agree, yes?\pNow!\nLet me teach it to your POKéMON!$

label: Text_MegaPunchDeclined
source: You'll be back when you understand\nthe worth of MEGA PUNCH.$

label: Text_MegaPunchWhichMon
source: Fine!\nWhich POKéMON will learn it?$

label: Text_MegaPunchTaught
source: Now, we are comrades in the way of\npunching!\pYou should go before you're seen\nby the misguided fool who trains\lonly his silly kicking over there.$

label: Text_MegaKickTeach
source: A kick of brutal ferocity!\pPacked with destructive power!\pWhen you get right down to it,\nMEGA KICK is the ultimate attack!\lDon't you agree?\pOkay!\nI'll teach it to your POKéMON!$

label: Text_MegaKickDeclined
source: You'll come crawling back when you\nrealize the value of MEGA KICK.$

label: Text_MegaKickWhichMon
source: All right!\nWhich POKéMON wants to learn it?$

label: Text_MegaKickTaught
source: Now, we are soul mates in the way\nof kicking!\pYou should run before you're seen\nby the deluded nitwit who trains\lonly simple punching over there.$

label: Route4_Text_PeopleLikeAndRespectBrock
source:
Oh, wow, that's the BOULDERBADGE!
You got it from BROCK, didn't you?\pBROCK is cool. He's not just tough.
People like and respect him.\pI want to become a GYM LEADER
like him.$

label: Route4_Text_BirdKeeperHank_Seen
source: I'm raising my POKéMON. Want to battle\nwith me?$

label: Route4_Text_BirdKeeperHank_Beaten
source: Ack! I lost that one…$

label: Route4_Text_BirdKeeperHank_AfterBattle
source: If you have a specific POKéMON that you\nwant to raise, put it out first, then\lswitch it right away.\pThat's how to do it.$

source: I have a feeling that I can win.\pLet's see if I'm right!$

label: Route4_Text_PicnickerHope_Beaten
source: Aww, you are too strong.$

label: Route4_Text_PicnickerHope_AfterBattle

source: Um…\nI…$

label: Route4_Text_PicnickerSharon_AfterBattle
source: ……I'll go train some more…$

source: MT.MOON NEW ENTRANCE\nDUE TO CAVE-IN\pWATCH YOUR STEP$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CanHaveSixMonsWithYou
source: Okay, set six POKé BALLS in my\nbelt…\pYeah, that'll do it. At most, you\ncan have six POKéMON with you.$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRocketAttacksCerulean
source: TEAM ROCKET attacks CERULEAN\ncitizens…\pNot a day goes by without TEAM\nROCKET being in the news.$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LaddieBuyMagikarpForJust500
source: MAN: Hello there, laddie!\nHave I got a deal just for you!\pI'll let you have a secret POKéMON\n- a MAGIKARP - for just ¥500!\pSo, you'll buy it, am I right?$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SweetieBuyMagikarpForJust500
source: MAN: Hello there, sweetie pie!\nHave I got a deal just for you!\pI'll let you have a secret POKéMON\n- a MAGIKARP - for just ¥500!\pSo, you'll buy it, am I right?$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PaidOutrageouslyForMagikarp
source: {PLAYER} paid an outrageous ¥500\nand bought the MAGIKARP…$

source: No? You say no? I'm only doing this\nas a favor to you!$

source: There's no more room for any more\nPOKéMON, it looks like.$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoullNeedMoreMoney
source: You'll need more money than that!$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IDontGiveRefunds
source: MAN: Well, I don't give refunds.\nYou knew what you were getting!$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ShouldStoreMonsUsingPC
source: Sometimes, you'll have too many\nPOKéMON with you to add any more.\pIn that case, you should just\nstore some using any PC.$

source: It's a newspaper.$

label: Route50_Text_BlackBelt1
source: The body must be hardened\nand the mind strengthened\lin the harshest of conditions!$

label: Route50_Text_BlackBelt2
source: Phew!\pI'm not as hardcore as he is.\pThere's really not much else\nto do here but train.$

label: Route50_Text_WesselBefore
source:
Incredible, A VOLTORB!\pBut it appears to be made
of... Wood?\pMy hypothesis that this route
would contain many STEEL TYPE\lPOKéMON is disproven yet again.\pBut why else would I have found
this STEEL PLATE here?\pI must collect more data!$

label: Route50_Text_WesselBeforeBattle
source: You want this PLATE?\nBut I haven't analyzed it yet!\pFine, we will battle for it.$

label: Route50_Text_WesselDefeat
source: My hypothesis was wrong...$

label: Route50_Text_WesselAfter
source: Take the PLATE. I don't want to\ntalk about it.$

label: Route50_Text_FinleyBefore
source:
How are the villagers treating
you?\pThey can be very unwelcoming to
strangers.\pBut meeting new people is one
of life's greatest joys.\pOne day, I hope to meet CHAMPION
LANCE.\pHe is a legendary dragon tamer,
much like myself.\lWho am I?\pWell, I am FINLEY, keeper of the
DRACO PLATE.$

label: Route50_Text_FinleyBeforeBattle
source: I know the KIMONO's have sent you\nto collect these PLATES.\pThey say you are worthy...\nBut can you conquer my dragons?$

label: Route50_Text_FinleyDefeat
source: My dragons fought well.$

label: Route50_Text_FinleyAfter
source: Perhaps you are even strong enough\nto beat LANCE...$

source: Things didn't work today.$

source: You should be informed.\nYou need strategy to win at this!$

source: It's not logical!$

source: Go with GRIMER first…and…\n…and…then…$

source: I like NIDORAN, so I collect them!$

source: Why?\nWhy??$

source: I got grass caught up in my\nspokes, man.$

source: Clear the way, or I'll run you\ndown!$

label: Route8_Text_JarenDefeat
source: You for real, kid?$

label: Route8_Text_JarenPostBattle
source: Don't think you're all special and\nall just because of this.$

label: Route8_Text_BikerDwayneBeaten
