source: SPD$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_WouldYouLikeToBattle
source: Battle {STR_VAR_1} for 3 {STR_VAR_2} EVs?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_BlackBelt
source: You enter the FIGHTING DOJO!\pHere, you may hone the stats of\nof your POKéMON by battle!$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Sign1
source: Left: HP, DEFENSE, SPECIAL DEFENSE$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Sign2
source: RIGHT: ATTACK, SPECIAL ATTACK, SPEED$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Cooltrainer
source: Only trainers with all KANTO badges\nmay enter the VIP lounge.$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Ability_Finish_Text
source: That's it! You're welcome!$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Ability_Text1
source: Welcome! I'm the ABILITY EXPERT!\pI can swap POKéMON's abilities in\na heartbeat, only for 25.000¥!\pWould you like me to swap any\nPOKéMON's ability?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Ability_Text_No
source: Sure. I'll be here if you need me.$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Ability_Text_Cant
source: I cannot do that. This POKéMON\ndoes not have a second ABILITY!$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Ability_Text_NoChampion
source: Welcome! I'm the ABILITY EXPERT!\pI can swap POKéMON's abilities\nin a heartbeat.\pUnfortunately, my back hurts and\nI can't work today.\pCome again later!$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_SetZeroTextNoMoney
source: You don't have enough money.\pCome back when you have.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_WhatDoYouWantGetLost
source: What do you want?\nGet lost!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_BossTakeTownForTeamRocket
source: BOSS said he'll take this town\nin the name of TEAM ROCKET!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_DontGetDefiantOrIllHurtYou
source: Don't get defiant!\nOr I'll have to hurt you!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_SaffronBelongsToTeamRocket
source: SAFFRON belongs to TEAM ROCKET!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_CriminalLifeMakesMeFeelAlive
source: My life as a criminal makes me feel\nso alive!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_WatchWhereYoureWalking
source: Ow!\nWatch where you're walking!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_WeCanExploitMonsAroundWorld
source: With SILPH under control, we can\nexploit POKéMON around the world!\pWe'll get stinking rich, yeahah!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_YouBeatTeamRocket
source: You beat TEAM ROCKET all alone?\nThat's amazing!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_SafeToGoOutAgain
source: Yeah! TEAM ROCKET is gone!\nIt's safe to go out again!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_PeopleComingBackToSaffron
source: People fled from here in droves\nwhen those ROCKETS came.\pThey should be flocking back to\nSAFFRON now.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_FlewHereOnPidgeot
source: I flew here on my PIDGEOT when\nI read about SILPH.\pIt's already over?\nI missed the media action…$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Pidgeot
source: PIDGEOT: Bi bibii!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_SawRocketBossEscaping
source: I saw the ROCKET BOSS escaping\nSILPH's building.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_ImASecurityGuard
source: I'm a security guard.\pSuspicious kids I don't allow in!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_HesTakingASnooze
source: …\nSnore…\pHah! He's taking a snooze!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_CitySign
source: SAFFRON CITY\nShining, Golden Land of Commerce$

label: SaffronCity_Text_FightingDojo
source: FIGHTING DOJO$

label: SaffronCity_Text_GymSign
source: SAFFRON CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\lThe Master of PSYCHIC POKéMON!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_FullHealCuresStatus
source: TRAINER TIPS\pFULL HEAL cures all ailments like\nburns, paralysis, poisoning,\lfreezing, and sleep.\pIt costs a bit more, but it's more\nconvenient than buying other items.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_GreatBallImprovedCatchRate
source: TRAINER TIPS\pThe new GREAT BALL offers improved\ncatching rates.\pTry it on those hard-to-catch\nPOKéMON.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_SilphCoSign
source: SILPH CO. OFFICE BUILDING$

label: SaffronCity_Text_MrPsychicsHouse
source: MR. PSYCHIC'S HOUSE$

label: SaffronCity_Text_SilphsLatestProduct
source: SILPH's latest product!\nRelease to be determined…$

label: SaffronCity_Text_TrainerFanClubSign
source: POKéMON TRAINER FAN CLUB\pMany TRAINERS have scribbled their\nnames on this sign.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_HowCanClubNotRecognizeLance
source:
This FAN CLUB…
No one here has a clue!\pHow could they not recognize
the brilliance that is LANCE?\pHe stands for justice!
He's cool, and yet passionate!\lHe's the greatest, LANCE!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaIntro
source:
I had a vision of your arrival.\pI have had psychic powers since
I was a child.\pIt started when a spoon I
carelessly tossed, bent.\pI dislike battling, but if you wish,
I will show you my powers!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaDefeat
source:
This loss shocks me!
But, a loss is a loss.\pI admit, I didn't work hard enough
to win.\pYour victory has earned you the
MARSHBADGE.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaPostBattle
source: Psychic power isn't something that\nonly a few people have.\pEveryone has psychic power.\nPeople just don't realize it.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMarshBadgeTakeThis
source:
The MARSHBADGE makes POKéMON up
to Lv. 70 obey you.\pStronger POKéMON will become wild,
ignoring your orders in battle.\pJust don't raise your POKéMON too
much to avoid that problem.\pWait, please take this TM with you.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM04FromSabrina
source: {PLAYER} received TM04 from\nSABRINA.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM04
source: TM04 is CALM MIND.\pIt makes the POKéMON concentrate\nto raise both SP. ATK and SP. DEF.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_BagFullOfOtherItems
source: Your BAG is full of items.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AmandaIntro
source: SABRINA is far younger than I,\nbut she has earned my respect.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AmandaDefeat
source: Not good enough!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AmandaPostBattle
source: In a battle of equals, the one\nwith the stronger will wins.\pIf you wish to beat SABRINA, focus\nand will yourself to victory.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_JohanIntro
source: Does our unseen power scare you?$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_JohanDefeat
source: I never foresaw this!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_JohanPostBattle
source: PSYCHIC POKéMON fear only ghosts\nand bugs!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StacyIntro
source: POKéMON take on the appearance of\ntheir TRAINERS.\pYour POKéMON must be tough, then!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StacyDefeat
source: I knew it!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StacyPostBattle
source: I have much to learn still…\pI must master PSYCHIC and teach it\nto my POKéMON…$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TyronIntro
source: You understand, don't you?\pThat power alone isn't enough to\nwin in the world of POKéMON?$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TyronDefeat
source: I don't believe this!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TyronPostBattle
source: SABRINA just wiped out the KARATE\nMASTER next door.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TashaIntro
source: You and I, our POKéMON shall\nbattle!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TashaDefeat
source: I lost after all!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TashaPostBattle
source: I knew that this was going to take\nplace.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_CameronIntro
source: SABRINA is young, but she's also\nour highly skilled LEADER.\pYou won't reach her easily!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_CameronDefeat
source: Ow!\nDown and out!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_CameronPostBattle
source:
There used to be two POKéMON GYMS
in SAFFRON.\pThe FIGHTING DOJO next door lost
its GYM status, though.\pWe simply creamed them when we
decided to have just one GYM.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro
source: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM is famous for\ntraining psychics.\pYou want to see SABRINA, don't\nyou? I can tell!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PrestonDefeat
source: Arrrgh!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle
source: That's right! I used telepathy to\nread your mind!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
source:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pSABRINA's POKéMON use psychic
power instead of force.\pFIGHTING POKéMON are especially
weak against PSYCHIC POKéMON.\pThey'll get destroyed before they
can even aim a punch!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
source: Psychic power, huh?\pIf I had that, I'd make a bundle\nat the slots!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaIntro
source:
SABRINA: I knew you were coming…\pThree years ago I had a vision
of your arrival.\pYou're after my BADGE.\pI don't enjoy battling, but it's
my duty as a LEADER to confer\lBADGES on anyone who has proven\lhim- or herself worthy.\pSince you wish it, I will show
you my psychic powers!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaWinLoss
source: SABRINA: Your power…\pIt far exceeds what I foresaw…\pMaybe it isn't possible to fully\npredict what the future holds…\pOK, you win. You earned yourself\nMARSHBADGE.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedMarshBadge
source: {PLAYER} received MARSHBADGE.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MarshBadgeInfo
source:
SABRINA: MARSHBADGE draws out
your subliminal powers…\pAlthough I failed to accurately
predict your power, this much I\lknow to be true.\pYou will become a celebrated and
beloved CHAMPION!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_Sabrina_GiveTM
source: Here, take this as well.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_Sabrina_ExplainTM
source: It holds SKILL SWAP.\pIt can take your opponents' abilities\naway from them and give them your own.\pUse it wisely...$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaPostBattle
source: SABRINA: Your love for your\nPOKéMON overwhelmed my psychic\lpower…\pThe power of love, I think, is\nalso a kind of psychic power…$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaRematch
source: SABRINA: Ah, the KANTO CHAMPION.\pI sensed your return.\pYour power has grown immensely.\pEven now, I feel your aura.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaRematchDefeat
source: SABRINA: Your love for your\nPOKéMON again overwhelmed my\lpsychic power…$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MediumRebeccaSeen
source: The power of all those you\ndefeated comes to me!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MediumRebeccaBeaten
source: Strong… Far too strong…$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MediumRebeccaAfter
source: What is the source of your power?$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PsychicFranklinSeen
source: Psychic power is the power of\nyour soul.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PsychicFranklinBeaten
source: Your soul has more power than\nmine!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PsychicFranklinAfter
source: You made your soul stronger, not\njust your abilities.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MediumDorisSeen
source: Fufufufu… I see it clearly.\pI can see into your soul!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MediumDorisBeaten
source: Though I read you, I still lost…$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MediumDorisAfter
source: Darn! I forgot that I predicted I\nwould lose to you.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PsychicJaredSeen
source: The FIGHTING DOJO next door was\nonce this city's GYM.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PsychicJaredBeaten
source: I was no match…$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PsychicJaredAfter
source: KARATE KING, the master of the\nFIGHTING DOJO, was just destroyed\lby SABRINA.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideIntro
source: Yo, CHAMP in making!\pA trainer as skilled as you\ndoesn't need to be told how to\ldeal with PSYCHIC-type POKéMON,\lright?\pI expect great things from you!\pGood luck!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideWin
source: That was another fantastic battle!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED, {PLAYER}$

label: SaffronCity_Text_BaobaName
source: BAOBA$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Baoba
source:
WARDEN BAOBA: {PLAYER}!\pThis is WARDEN BAOBA.\pI'm calling to tell you that the
SAFARI ZONE has expanded again!\pFinally, my SAFARI ZONE has been
fully realized!\pYou remember where it is, right?\pJust west of CIANWOOD CITY!
see you soon!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Elli
source: I love VULPIX! :D$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Lass1
source: A little girl who is an expert at\nmimicking people lives here.\pShe even mimics the people she's\nconversing with. It's confusing.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Lass1_ReturnedPart
source: The COPYCAT girl looked unhappy.\pShe said she lost her favorite\nPOKé DOLL--CLEFAIRY.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_PokefanM
source: You came out from JOHTO?\pYou can zip back home if the\nMAGNET TRAIN's running.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_PokefanM_ReturnedPart
source: You came out from JOHTO?\pYou can zip back home by hopping\non the MAGNET TRAIN.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_CooltrainerM
source: I went to the GYM, raring for\nbattles against trainers…\pIt turns out, I stumbled into the\nunused GYM next door.\pBoy, I was pretty embarrassed.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_CooltrainerF
source: This is SILPH CO., famous for\nPOKéMON merchandise.\pIn the past, TEAM ROCKET wanted\nthe company because of that.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Fisher
source: Chew… Chew…\pI hear there's big trouble brewing\nat the POWER PLANT.\pChew… Chew…$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Fisher_ReturnedPart
source: Chew… Chew…\pI hear there was big trouble at the\nPOWER PLANT.\pChew… Chew… Haaah, I'm full!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Youngster1
source: Going into an alley for the first\ntime makes me sorta anxious.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Youngster2
source: There's a place called the CONTEST\nHALL in VIRIDIAN where trainers\lgather from all over the place.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Lass2
source: Our city was featured on a radio\nprogram.\pIt's nice to hear praise for your\ncity, but it's a bit embarrassing\ltoo.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Sign
source: SAFFRON CITY\pShining, Golden Land of Commerce$

label: SaffronCity_Text_GymSign
source: SAFFRON CITY\nPOKéMON GYM\lLEADER: SABRINA\pThe Master of Psychic POKéMON!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_FightingDojoSign
source: Everyone Welcome!\nFIGHTING DOJO$

label: SaffronCity_Text_SilphCoSign
source: SILPH CO.\nOFFICE BUILDING$

label: SaffronCity_Text_MrPsychicHouseSign
source: MR.PSYCHIC'S\nHOUSE$

label: SaffronCity_Text_MagnetTrainStationSign
source: SAFFRON CITY\nMAGNET TRAIN STATION$

label: MrPsychic_Text_1
source: …\p…\p…\p…I got it!\pYou wanted this!$

label: MrPsychic_Text_2
source: TM29 is PSYCHIC.\pIt may lower the target's\nSP.DEF.$

label: SaffronCity_House_Text_DontLookAtMyLetter
source: …Thank you for writing.\nI hope to see you soon!\p…Hey!\nDon't look at my letter!$

label: SaffronCity_House_Text_Pidgey
source: PIDGEY: Kurukkoo!$

label: SaffronCity_House_Text_GettingCopycatPokeDoll
source: The COPYCAT is cute!\nI'm getting her a POKé DOLL.$

label: SaffronCity_House_Text_ExplainPPUp
source: I was given a PP UP as a gift.\pIt's used to increase the PP of\na POKéMON's move.\pI should use it on a powerful move\nwith only a few PP.$

label: SaffronCity_Mart_Text_MaxRepelMoreEffectiveThanSuper
source: MAX REPEL keeps weaker POKéMON\nfrom appearing.\pMAX REPEL stays effective longer\nthan SUPER REPEL.$

label: SaffronCity_Mart_Text_ReviveIsCostly
source: REVIVE is costly, but it revives\nfainted POKéMON!$

label: SaffronMart_Text_CooltrainerM
source: There's a big RADIO TOWER in\nLAVENDER.$

label: SaffronMart_Text_CooltrainerF
source: I want to become stronger, but\nI'm not good yet…\pCould you show me how sometime?$

label: SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_YouWantedThis
source: …Wait! Don't say a word!\pYou wanted this!$

label: SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_ReceivedTM29FromMrPsychic
source: {PLAYER} received TM29\nfrom MR. PSYCHIC.$

label: SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_ExplainTM29
source: You already know, don't you?\nTM29 is PSYCHIC.\pIt's an attack that may also lower\nthe target's special stats.$

label: SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_YouveNoRoom
source: Where do you plan to put this?\nYou've no room.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GrowthRatesDifferBySpecies
source: POKéMON growth rates differ from\nspecies to species.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SilphCoVictimOfFame
source: SILPH CO. is widely known to all.\pIt's a victim of its own fame - it\nattracted TEAM ROCKET.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GreatIfEliteFourCameBeatRockets
source: Sigh…\nWouldn't this be great?\pIf the ELITE FOUR came and\nstomped TEAM ROCKET?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRocketTookOff
source: TEAM ROCKET took off!\nWe can go out safely again!\lThat's great!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Teacher
source:
What are JOHTO's POKéMON CENTERS
like?\p…Oh, I see. So they're not much
different from the ones in KANTO.\pI can go to JOHTO without
worrying, then!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Fisher
source: I just happened to come through\nROCK TUNNEL.\pThere was some commotion at the\nPOWER PLANT.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Fisher_ReturnedPart
source: There's an odd cave in CERULEAN.\pAs a pro HIKER, I should explore it,\nbut that place scares even me.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Youngster
source: SILPH CO.'s HEAD OFFICE and the\nMAGNET TRAIN STATION--they're the\lplaces to see in SAFFRON.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HuhYou
source: Huh?\nYou…$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourePlayerWereYourFansNow
source:
Are you maybe…
… …\pYou are!
You are {PLAYER}!\pWe were just talking about you!\pWe were talking about how an
incredibly good TRAINER appeared.\pAnd that someone is you!
You're so cool!\pSo, we decided that we'll become
your FAN CLUB!\pWe all hope you'll keep battling
and show us how cool you are.\pThat way, maybe other people will
become fans just like me.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_AlwaysCheerForYou
source: I'll always be cheering for you!\pGo, {PLAYER}, go!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_IllAlwaysBelieveInYou
source: I'll always believe in you,\n{PLAYER}.\pPlease show the others what you're\nlike when you battle seriously.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WasYourFanNotAnymore
source:
I'm sorry.
I was your fan before.\pBut now, you seem to have lost
the drive you had before.\pLately, I think {STR_VAR_1} has been
a lot cooler.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_EveryonesYourFanButICantBe
source:
Oh!
{PLAYER}!\pEveryone's been all excited about
you recently.\pI can understand why.
I know that you're strong.\pBut, do you know what?\pOnce I became {STR_VAR_1}'s fan,
I can't just stop being a fan.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainersCoolWhenBattling
source: I think TRAINERS are so cool when\nthey're battling.\pDon't you think so, too?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_CanYouAutographShorts
source:
Oh! It's {PLAYER}!
Too cool!\pOh!
Oh, yeah!\pCan you autograph something?
How about my shorts?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_CountingOnYou
source:
However hot it's been…\pAnd however cold it may get…\pI've always believed in, and worn,
shorts!\pI'm counting on you to keep
winning!\pI believe in you just as much as
I believe in shorts!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BrocksMyHero
source:
BROCK's my hero!
He's a man among men!\pHeheh, I got my mom to do
something for me.\pI got her to embroider “BROCK”
on my shorts!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BrocksFanToBitterEnd
source: …  …\p…  …\nI'm BROCK's fan!\pEven if I were his only fan,\nI swear it on my rock-hard will,\land on my shorts!\pI'll be his fan to the bitter end!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BrocksLastWordOnCool
source: BROCK's the last word on cool,\nend of story!\pNow there's a guy who I want to\nbe like!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HadPleasureOfWatchingYouBattle
source:
{PLAYER}, I've had the pleasure of
watching you battle.\pIt brings back sweet memories of
my own long-lost youth.\pMay you continue to find success.
You have a fan in me!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NeverSeenTrainerOfYourMagnificence
source:
I have journeyed far and wide
across the lands.\pBut never have I seen a TRAINER
of your magnificence.\pTake courage in your abilities
and keep battling on!\pMake that a promise to me,
my young idol!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HmmAndYouAre
source: Hmm…\nAnd you are?\pWere you hoping to sign up for\na membership in our FAN CLUB?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouveStillAWaysToGo
source:
Ah, so you are the much-
talked-about {PLAYER}.\pYou certainly do have the look of
a winner.\pBut for me to accept you as
a true POKéMON great…\p… …\pYou've still a ways to go!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YoullBeTalkedAboutIfYouKeepWinning
source:
All of us gathered here are fans
of POKéMON TRAINERS.\pThe way they look in battle…
They are the picture of coolness.\pPerhaps you will be talked about
here, too, if you keep winning.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WantToBeLikeYouOneDay
source: It's {PLAYER}!\nIt's {PLAYER}!\pI want to be like {PLAYER} one day!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_EveryoneButMeStoppedBeingYourFan
source:
Everyone stopped being {PLAYER}'s
fan…\pBut that means I can have {PLAYER}
all to myself!\pYay! Go for it!
My one and only {PLAYER}!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WantToBeLikeSabrina
source: Do you know what?\nI want to be like SABRINA!\pI want to be a psychic girl just\nlike her!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WontStopBeingSabrinasFan
source:
Even if I'm the only one, I won't
stop being SABRINA's fan.\pMy dream is to be like SABRINA,
cute, but cool.\pI want to be a psychic girl just
like her!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_CanIBecomeCoolTrainerOneDay
source: I wonder if I can become a cool\nTRAINER one day?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TheWayYouBattleIsCool
source:
Oh, man, oh, man!
Cool! Too cool!\p…Huh?
No, not you.\pJust the way you battle.
That's cool.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImOnlyOneLeftOfYourFans
source: Yo, {PLAYER}!\pLooks like I'm the only one left\nout of your fans.\pBut, you know, I like being an only\nfan… It's less stressful.\pKeep up and at it!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_LoveWayTrainerTalks
source: {STR_VAR_1}'s cool, huh?\nI love the way he talks.\pI'd really relish a chance to meet\nhim in person once.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImLoneTrainerFan
source:
Huh, can you believe it?
Everyone turned into your fans.\pSo after all we've been through,
I'm the lone {STR_VAR_1} fan?\pEh, being the one and only
{STR_VAR_1} fan's my style, anyway.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_AdoreWayYouBattle
source:
Oh, my goodness!
Is it really you, {PLAYER}?\pI have to tell you, I adore the
way you battle.\pI hope you'll keep at it.
I'll be your number one fan!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImYourNumberOneFan
source:
Oh, my goodness!
If it isn't {PLAYER}!\pIt's so disappointing… I realized
I'm your number-one-and-only fan!\pWell, it can't be helped!
Let me cheer you on, at least!\pHurray, hurray, {PLAYER}!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerHasBeenOnFire
source: Recently, {STR_VAR_1} has been on\nfire.\pThe way he battles… It's just \nthe way that I like it!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_EveryoneTalksAboutYou
source:
Oh, hello!
If it isn't {PLAYER}!\pLately, all everyone talks about
is you.\pI'm feeling lonesome because I
prefer {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouReallyAreAmazing
source: Amazing!\n{PLAYER}, you really are amazing!\pInstead of just watching, maybe\nI should become a TRAINER, too.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImYourOnlyFan
source: I'm your only fan…\nSigh… This is lonely…\pCan't you try harder and make the\nothers take notice of you?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WhyCantOthersSeeMastersDignity
source: Master {STR_VAR_1} is so dignified…\nHe is so my type.\pWhy can't the others see the\ndignity he simply oozes?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BelieveInMasterWithAllMyHeart
source:
I believe in Master {STR_VAR_1}
with all my heart.\pEven if I am the only one to
believe in him.\pI won't ever feel lonesome, though.\pNot if I keep thinking about Master
{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourBattleStyleIsEducational
source: Hiyah!\pYour battling style is most\neducational.\pI hope that you will keep plugging\naway at success, hiyah!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WontStopBeingYourFan
source:
Instead of just watching others
battle, battle yourself!\p…My DOJO's MASTER chewed me out
like that…\pBut I won't let that stop me from
being your fan!\pI can't stop being your fan!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OnlyMasterHasMyRespect
source:
Hiyah! There is but one TRAINER
who has my respect.\pAnd that is none other than my
MASTER at the FIGHTING DOJO.\pYou should become a fan of my
MASTER like me! Hiyah!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NeverBeFanOfAnyoneButMaster
source:
Hiyah! I respect my MASTER at the
FIGHTING DOJO.\pI will never become a fan of
anyone other than my MASTER!\pI will even sneak out of the DOJO
to spread word of his greatness.\pHiyah!$

label: SaffronCity_SilphCo_Text_Steven1
source: Hello...\nYou're breaking up...\lI think it depends on my dad.\lI see...\nI'll be on my way. See you soon.$

label: SaffronCity_SilphCo_Text_Steven2
source:
STEVEN: You are... I remember your
eyes.\pWhen I see a trainer whose eyes
twinkle, I always remember.\pYou have a POKéDEX! So you are
also in search of POKéMON!\lLet me see...\pI think I can help you with that.\pLet's say that you have stones in
front of you. Which color would\l you pick?$

label: SaffronCity_SilphCo_Text_Steven3
source: You chose correctly! I'll give you\n{STR_VAR_1}!$

label: SaffronCity_SilphCo_Text_Steven4
source: Take good care of it. Your caring\nfor it will make me very happy.$

label: SilphCo_Text_Sign1
source: SILPH CO.\n1F RECEPTION.$

label: SilphCo_Text_Sign2
source: SILPH CO.\nELEVATOR OUT OF SERVICE$

label: SilphCo_Text_Receptionist
source: Welcome. This is SILPH CO.'s HEAD\nOFFICE BUILDING.$

label: SilphCo_Text_Officer
source: Only employees are permitted to\ngo upstairs.\pBut since you came such a long\nway,\phave this neat little souvenir.$

label: SilphCo_Text_Officer_GotUpGrade
source: It's SILPH CO.'s latest product.\pIt's not for sale anywhere yet.$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerTrainHasntComeIn
source: The train hasn't come in…\pI know! I'll carry the passengers\non my back!\pThat won't work.$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerComingAboard
source: We'll soon depart for GOLDENROD.\pAre you coming aboard?$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerRightThisWay
source: May I see your rail PASS, please?\pOK. Right this way, please.$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerNoRailPass
source: Sorry. You don't have a rail PASS.$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerHopeToSeeYouAgain
source: We hope to see you again!$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerArrivedInSaffron
source: We have arrived in SAFFRON.\pWe hope to see you again.$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_Officer_TrainNotOperating
source: I'm sorry, but the MAGNET TRAIN\nisn't operating now.$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_GymGuide
source:
The MAGNET TRAIN is a super-modern
rail liner that uses electricity\pand magnets to attain incredible
speed.\pHowever, if there isn't any
electricity…$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_GymGuide_ReturnedPart
source: Whew…\pHow many times have I gone back\nand forth between KANTO and JOHTO?$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_Teacher
source: Before the MAGNET TRAIN STATION\nwas built, there was a house there.\pA little girl named COPYCAT used\nto live there.$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_Lass
source: Hi. Do you have a rail PASS?\nI have one.\pAll the people in SAFFRON who ride\nthe MAGNET TRAIN have PASSES.$

label: SaffronCity_Tunnel_NS_Text_BaldingManIntro
source:
Don't be afraid, I'm not a bad
person.\pA place like this...
attracts mean people.\pThey would eventually cause
trouble...\pIt makes me mad just thinking about
it.$

label: SaffronCity_Tunnel_NS_Text_BaldingManCandybarDetected
source: Aha!\nThat's a RAGE CANDYBAR!\pCan I have it?\nPlease!$

label: SaffronCity_Tunnel_NS_Text_BaldingManGaveCandybar
source: {PLAYER} Gave the RageCandyBar to the\nguy at the underground path.\pMunch!\pHow upsetting!\pBut this is so good!\pMunch munch!\pAargh! It makes me mad!\pMunch munch!\pAargh...\p...................Phew!\pI am feeling much better!\nThank you for your candy!\lI want you to have this!$

label: SaffronCity_Tunnel_NS_Text_BaldingManGaveTm
source: TM 64 contains........\ptick-\n            tock\ltick-\l            tock\ltick-\l            tock\ltick-\l            tock\ltick.....\l......................\l......................\lKA-BOOM!!!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
source:
Hey!
I remember your face!\pIf you're here, it must mean that
you're about to mess with us again!\pA punk like you, do you really think
you can take on TEAM AQUA?\pI'd say you're too early by about
a trillion years!\pYou're a perfect fit for the likes of
TEAM MAGMA!\pSpeaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they
were spotted near MOSSDEEP.\pThat bunch of goons, they sure don't
look good near the sea!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeepShort
source:
A punk like you, do you really think
you can take on TEAM AQUA?\pI'd say you're too early by about
a trillion years!\pYou're a perfect fit for the likes of
TEAM MAGMA!\pSpeaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they
were spotted near MOSSDEEP.\pThat bunch of goons, they sure don't
look good near the sea!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: We don't need a kid around!\nGo on home already!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: I want to go home…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: I want to get a promotion so I can\nboss around the GRUNTS…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2Intro
source: That submarine… It's tiny inside.\nI'm sore all over!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: Losing makes me sore!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: That submarine we jacked, man,\nit's brutal as a ride.\lIt's way too tight in there!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro
source:
Ahahahaha!\pHow did you manage to get here without
a submarine?\lWhat an impressive child!\pBut… It won't do to have you
meddling about here.\pAnd, I do want payback for what
happened at the WEATHER INSTITUTE…\pI'm going to give you a little taste
of pain! Resign yourself to it!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyDefeat
source: Ahahahaha!\pOuch!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyPostBattle
source:
Ahahahaha!
You're so darn strong.\pIt's terribly disappointing that you're
not a TEAM AQUA member.\pYou could have enjoyed the fabulous
world our BOSS has promised as\lone of us…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Intro
source:
For our dream to become real, we need
the power of POKéMON.\pBut meddlers like you use the power of
POKéMON to mess with us even at\la place like this!\pLife just doesn't work the way we
need it to!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Defeat
source: Gwah!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
source:
You know, we don't dare question
the motives of our leader.\pBut here you are, just some punk,
going up against our BOSS.\pMaybe…
You must be something…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3Intro
source: Who are you?\nWhere did you come in from?$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3Defeat
source: Lost it…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
source: I can't find the way out!\pI'm not afraid. Don't get me wrong!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4Intro
source: Who are you?\nWhere do you think you're going?$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4Defeat
source: I failed to win!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
source: My partner forgot the map in that\nsubmarine!\pHow's that for being useless?$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieHoldItRightThere
source: ARCHIE: Hold it right there.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieSoItWasYou
source: ARCHIE: Fufufu…\nSo it was you, after all.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieBeholdKyogre
source: ARCHIE: Behold!\pSee how beautiful it is, the sleeping\nform of the ancient POKéMON KYOGRE!\pI have waited so long for this day to\ncome…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieYouMustDisappear
source: ARCHIE: It surprises me, how you've\nmanaged to chase me here.\pBut that's all over now.\pFor the realization of my dream,\nyou must disappear now!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDefeat
source: What?!\nI lost to a mere child like you?!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWithThisRedOrb
source: ARCHIE: Fufufu…\pI commend you. I must recognize that\nyou are truly gifted.\pBut!\nI have this in my possession!\pWith this RED ORB, I can make KYOGRE…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_RedOrbShinesByItself
source: The RED ORB suddenly began shining\nby itself!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhereDidKyogreGo
source: ARCHIE: What?!\pI didn't do anything.\nWhy did the RED ORB…\pWhere did KYOGRE go?$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieAMessageFromOutside
source: ARCHIE: Hm? It's a message from our\nmembers outside…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
source:
ARCHIE: Yes, what is it?\pHm…
It's raining heavily?\pGood… That should have happened.
That is why we awakened KYOGRE,\lto realize TEAM AQUA's vision of\lexpanding the sea.\pWhat?!\pIt's raining far harder than we
envisioned? You're in danger?\pThat can't be…
That's just not possible…\pHold your position and monitor
the situation!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKyogreDisappear
source: ARCHIE: There's something wrong…\pThe RED ORB is supposed to awaken\nand control KYOGRE…\pBut… Why?\nWhy did KYOGRE disappear?\pWhy?!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveYouWrought
source:
MAXIE: What have you wrought?\pARCHIE… You've finally awoken KYOGRE,
haven't you?\pWhat will happen to the world if this
downpour continues for all eternity?\pThe world's landmass will drown in
the deepening sea…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetAllHighAndMighty
source:
ARCHIE: W-what?!
Don't get all high and mighty with me!\pWasn't it you, TEAM MAGMA, that
infuriated GROUDON?\pSo long as I have this RED ORB,
I should be able to control KYOGRE…\pI should be able to control it…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWeDontHaveTimeToArgue
source: MAXIE: We don't have the time to\nargue about it here!\pGet outside and see for yourself!\pSee if what you've wrought is the\nworld that we desired!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieComeOnPlayer
source: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, come on, you have\nto get out of here, too!$

label: SeafoamIslands_B1F_Text_ArticunoBattle
source: Gyaoo!$

label: Text_RockSlideTeach
source:
When you're up on a rocky mountain
like this, rockslides are a threat.\pCan you imagine?
Boulders tumbling down on you?\pThat'd be, like, waaaaaaaaaaah!
Total terror!\pYou don't seem to be scared.
Want to try using ROCK SLIDE?$

label: Text_RockSlideDeclined
source: Oh, so you are scared after all.$

label: Text_RockSlideWhichMon
source: Which POKéMON should I teach\nROCK SLIDE?$

label: Text_RockSlideTaught
source: It might be scary to use it in this\ntunnel…$

label: SeafoamIslands_B4F_Text_BouldersMightChangeWaterFlow
source: Hint: Boulders might change the\nflow of water.$

label: SeafoamIslands_B4F_Text_DangerFastCurrent
source: DANGER\nFast current!$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: CINNABAR POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: CINNABAR POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED, {PLAYER}$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_Blaine_GiveTM
source: Take this too!$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_Blaine_ExplainTM
source:
This TM contains
the awesome OVERHEAT!\pThe overwhelming heat scorches your
opponents, but then drops your power.\pI hope your next opponent has an
extra BURN HEAL! Waaah!$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_BlaineIntro
source:
BLAINE: Waaah!\pMy GYM in CINNABAR burned down.\pMy fire-breathing POKéMON and I are
homeless because of the volcano.\pWaaah!\pBut I'm back in business as a GYM
LEADER here in this cave.\pIf you can beat me, I'll give you
a BADGE.\pHa! You'd better have BURN HEAL!$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_BlaineWinLoss
source: BLAINE: Awesome. I've burned out…\pYou've earned VOLCANOBADGE!$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_ReceivedVolcanoBadge
source: {PLAYER} received VOLCANOBADGE.$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_BlaineAfterBattle
source: BLAINE: I did lose this time, but\nI'm going to win the next time.\pWhen I rebuild my CINNABAR GYM,\nwe'll have to have a rematch.$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_BlaineFightDone
source: BLAINE: My fire POKéMON will be\neven stronger.\pJust you watch!$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_BlaineRematch
source: BLAINE: Whoa!\pI see you've become the KANTO\nCHAMPION!\pThat's blazing!\pYour skills are top-notch.\pI'm always up for a battle.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_BlaineRematchDefeat
source: BLAINE: Your skills are truly fiery!\pYou've burned right through my\ndefenses.$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_GymGuideWin
source: Yo!\p… Huh? It's over already?\pSorry, sorry!\pCINNABAR GYM was gone, so I didn't\nknow where to find you.\pBut, hey, you're plenty strong even\nwithout my advice. I knew you'd win!$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_GymGuideWin2
source: A POKéMON GYM can be anywhere as\nlong as the GYM LEADER is there.\pThere's no need for a building.$

label: Text_SwordsDanceTeach
source: Not many people come out here.\pIf I train here, I'm convinced that\nI'll get stronger and stronger.\pYep, stronger and stronger…\pHow would you like to learn a move\nlike that? It's SWORDS DANCE.$

label: Text_SwordsDanceDeclined
source: Well, that's fine, too.$

label: Text_SwordsDanceWhichMon
source: All right, pick which POKéMON\nI should teach it to.$

label: Text_SwordsDanceTaught
source: If only we could keep getting\nstronger and stronger, eh?$

label: SevenIsland_Text_IslandSign
source: SEVEN ISLAND\nQuest Island of Infinity$

label: SevenIsland_Text_IslandsMadeInSevenDays
source:
These islands are called the SEVII
ISLANDS because there are seven.\p…Or at least that's what the young
people believe.\pThe truth is, these islands are so
named because they are said to\lhave been made in seven days.$

label: SevenIsland_Text_IslandVirtuallyUntouched
source: This island has been left virtually\nuntouched in its natural state.\pIt could be a little difficult to\nhike around because of that.$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_OnlyEnjoymentWatchingBattles
source:
I may not look like much now,
but when I was younger…\pI flew everywhere, challenging
TRAINERS wherever I found them.\pNow, my only source of enjoyment
is reminiscing about the past while\lwatching battles.$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_SlightBreezeAroundBox
source: There is a slight breeze blowing\naround the box.$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_ChallengeVisitingTrainer
source:
Ah!
Welcome, my friend!\pLet me tell you something. There's
a hidden room in the basement.\pA TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1} is
waiting there now.\pTell me, you did come to challenge
{STR_VAR_1}, am I right?$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_OhYouWontBattle
source:
Oh…
You won't battle…\pI see, I see.
… …\pWell, perhaps if you change your
mind, do come back.$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_LimitThreeMonsPerSide
source:
Ah!
You will battle for me?\pIt was worth my time moving the
box aside, then.\p… …
But there is one slight problem.\pThis hidden room is not built very
sturdy.\pCan I get you to limit it to
battles of three POKéMON per side?$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_SaveProgressBeforeBattle
source: Fine! Before your battle, would\nyou like to save your game?$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_DontHoldAnythingBack
source: All right.\nDon't hold anything back!$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_StrVar1_1
source: {STR_VAR_1}$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room2_Text_MatchEndedUpDraw
source: The match ended up a draw.$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_DrawWasIt
source: A draw, was it?\pHowever, let me say that it was\na worthy spectacle.\pI'd say it was a wonderful battle\nwith a real sense of depth!$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_StrVar1_2
source: {STR_VAR_1}$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_AstoundingBattle
source:
Bravo!\pBravo, indeed!
What an astounding battle!\pIt was so astounding, why, it keeps
filling my eyes with tears!\pThe thrust and parry of expertly
used techniques!\pThe clash of power upon power!\pYes!
It was sheer magnificence!$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_StrVar1_3
source: {STR_VAR_1}$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_FeelYourDisappointment
source:
Too bad!
I feel your disappointment.\pHowever, that disappointment is
what will make you better.\pUse it, learn from it, and make it
motivate you to seek greatness.\pForget not this disappointment
and redouble your training!$

label: SevenIsland_Mart_Text_MonHavePersonalitiesOfTheirOwn
source: POKéMON have personalities of their\nown, just like people.\pMy PIKACHU has a HASTY nature,\nso it grew to be a speedy POKéMON.$

label: SevenIsland_Mart_Text_PreparationsCompleteForRuins
source: Okay, preparations are complete\nfor me to explore the RUINS.$

label: SevenIsland_Mart_Text_NeedToFishOnSevenIsland
source: I need to fish on SEVEN ISLAND.\pThat will complete my fishing tour\nof the SEVII ISLANDS.\pI'd better stock up on some\nPOKé BALLS first, though.$

label: SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EventsDependingOnConnections
source: On this island, different events\noccur depending on connections.\pWhat are those connections?\pThey are for you to discover on\nyour own.$

label: SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DidYouRideSeagallopHere
source:
Did you ride a SEAGALLOP ferry
to get here?\pThere are at least ten of those
high-speed ships.\pI don't know where they all go,
though.$

label: SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CheckOutTrainerTower
source: If you're confident, you should\ncheck out TRAINER TOWER.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MiahIntro
source: Kyahaha!\nI'll flick you away effortlessly!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MiahDefeat
source: Tch!\nToo strong for me!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MiahPostBattle
source: What's that?\nI don't act the way I look?\pHeh, that's a part of my strategy!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MasonIntro
source: Howdy!\nAre you a member of my fan club?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MasonDefeat
source: Oh, so you're not a fan…\pWell, I can change that.\nLet me sing for you!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MasonPostBattle
source: Lalalah…\nMy POKéMON, I send them out,\lall the girls scream and shout!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_NicolasIntro
source: This island is too spread out…\nIt's not easy patrolling the place.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_NicolasDefeat
source: Uh-huh…$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_NicolasPostBattle
source: TRAINERS like you from cities,\nthey sure are tough.\pYou'll be headed for the TOWER,\nwon't you?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MadelineIntro
source: I punish people who abuse\nPOKéMON!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MadelineDefeat
source: You don't seem to be a problem\nTRAINER.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MadelinePostBattle
source: If you treat your POKéMON with\nkindness, they'll understand.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EveIntro
source: EVE: I'll team up with JON and\nbattle together.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EveDefeat
source: EVE: Me and JON, we lost.\nEhehe.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EvePostBattle
source: EVE: I'm going to work harder with\nJON.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EveNotEnoughMons
source: EVE: I want to team up with JON\nwhen I battle you.\pCome back with two POKéMON, okay?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonIntro
source: JON: When I'm with EVE, it feels\nlike we could never lose.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonDefeat
source: JON: When I'm with EVE,\nit doesn't feel like I've lost!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonPostBattle
source: JON: When I'm with EVE, I feel\ngiddy whether I win or lose.\pIt's magical!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonNotEnoughMons
source: JON: If it's with EVE, I'll be\nhappy to battle with you.\pSo, I'd like to make it a\ntwo-on-two battle, if I may.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_RouteSign
source: SEVAULT CANYON ENTRANCE\pTRAINERS are asked to refrain from\ndamaging plants in the CANYON.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_CyndyIntro
source: My conditioning's in top form!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_CyndyDefeat
source: Huh?\nSomething's not right…$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_CyndyPostBattle
source: The way I am now, I may have to\nhold off on TRAINER TOWER…$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanIntro
source: It doesn't matter if you happen to\nhave the strongest POKéMON…\pIt doesn't mean a thing if you don't\nknow how to use them properly!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanDefeat
source: You're a master at this.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanPostBattle
source: You see them every so often,\nTRAINERS with awesome POKéMON\lwho have no idea what to do.\pBefore training POKéMON, TRAINERS\nthemselves need to grow up.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonIntro
source: I work to protect the environment.\nIn turn, nature protects me!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonDefeat
source: Whoa! You're tough!\nHow about protecting me?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonPostBattle
source: From far out among the stars, our\nplanet is just a drop of water.\pBut we want to protect that drop\nof water for everyone.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynIntro
source: Those shoes you have are pretty\nsnazzy.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynDefeat
source: You're hot stuff in spite of your\ncute looks.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynPostBattle
source: Your mom bought those snazzy\nRUNNING SHOES for you?\pShe must adore you.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyIntro
source: You look strong.\nLet me battle you, please!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyDefeat
source: I knew it!\nYou're as tough as I thought!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyPostBattle
source: The way you battle has given me\na lot of useful data.\pThanks so much!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleIntro
source: I was given the best possible\neducation to become this strong.\pI don't want to lose to anyone!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleDefeat
source: Thank you. I feel like I've been\nset free by losing to you.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichellePostBattle
source: For some reason, I get furious\nover the slightest thing.\pI'll calm myself by breathing\ndeeply.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexIntro
source: LEX: My darling NYA, together\nwe could win!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexDefeat
source: LEX: I seem to have been too\ncareless…$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexPostBattle
source: LEX: I think it was a good\nexperience for NYA.\pYou have my gratitude.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexNotEnoughMons
source: LEX: May I ask you to battle the\nboth of us at the same time?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaIntro
source: NYA: I'll do my best so I won't\ndrag down my mentor, LEX!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaDefeat
source: NYA: Oh, no…\nI'm so sorry, I…$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaPostBattle
source: NYA: I think I'm going to need\nmuch more seasoning and tutoring\lunder LEX…\p…So, LEX, please, may I stay with\nyou like this?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaNotEnoughMons
source: NYA: I'm sorry, but may we battle\nin two-on-two style?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_RouteSign
source: SEVAULT CANYON\nTANOBY RUINS AHEAD$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_BrunoTrainedWithBrawly
source:
Training by oneself is certainly
not a bad thing.\pBut it's also not bad to aim for
the top with a partner.\pEven BRUNO…
He trained with a fellow by the\lname of BRAWLY before.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_ChanseyDanceJoinIn
source: Dance, dance!\nCHANSEY Dance!\pYou join in, too!\nDance, dance!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_WouldYouLikeToDance
source: Would you like to dance?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_ComeOnDance
source: Come on, dance!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_DancedChanseyDance
source: {PLAYER} danced the CHANSEY Dance!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_YoureAllChipperNow
source: Ahahahaha!\pThere, you're all chipper now!\nLucky!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_Chansey
source: CHANSEY: Chansi! Chansi!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_TanobyKey_Text_MysteriousRumbleFarAway
source: A mysterious rumble echoed\nsomewhere far away.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonIntro
source: Do you know anything about this\nstone chamber?$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonDefeat
source: That was uncalled for.\nYou didn't have to be so rough.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonPostBattle
source: The TANOBY RUINS date back at\nleast 1,500 years.\pBut it's a baffling mystery as to\nwhy it was built in the first place.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminIntro
source: A mystic POKéMON is said to sleep\ninside here.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminDefeat
source: I'm not much good in battle.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminPostBattle
source: I hear there are other ruins like\nthe one here.\pMight they be the resting places\nof other mystic POKéMON?$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaIntro
source: CLIFFORD is teaching me how to\npaint.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaDefeat
source: We might get in trouble for being\nnoisy here.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaPostBattle
source: I said that I wanted to paint an\nold building.\pSo CLIFFORD brought me here.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordIntro
source: Today, in addition to our lesson,\nwe came to see the chamber.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordDefeat
source: My, how extraordinary.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordPostBattle
source: Ah, so you are studying POKéMON\non your own…\pYes, you certainly are quite the\nextraordinary person, indeed.$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_DarioIntro
source: I sensed your approach.$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_DarioDefeat
source: Give up…$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_DarioPostBattle
source: In your future, I sense that you\nwill meet many others.\pI think you will be linked to each\nother by a strange power.$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodetteIntro
source: Somewhere on this island, peculiar\nPOKéMON are sleeping.$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodetteDefeat
source: What an amazing TRAINER!$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodettePostBattle
source: Somewhere on this island, peculiar\nPOKéMON are sleeping.\pCould it be that they're waiting\nfor you?$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_TrainerTowerSign
source: TRAINER TOWER ENTRANCE\nRise to the Challenge, TRAINERS!$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_TrainerTowerAhead
source: TRAINER TOWER AHEAD$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom_Text_CanOvercomeColdWithFocus
source: The penetrating cold around these\nparts is an impediment to training.\pBut with focus, one can overcome!\pWith this FOCUS BAND, buckle down and\nwithstand the cold!$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom_Text_EverythingStartsWithFocus
source: Everything starts with focus!$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntIntro
source: Welcome to 10F!\nSo good of you to join me!$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntDefeat
source: I'm stunned!$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntPostBattle
source: Nice try, but the boardroom is up\none more floor.$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_TravisIntro
source: Enough of your silly games!$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_TravisDefeat
source: No continues left!$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_TravisPostBattle
source: Are you satisfied with beating me?\nThen go on home!$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_WaaaImScared
source: Waaaaa!\nI'm scared!$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_KeepMeCryingASecret
source: About me crying…\nPlease keep it a secret.$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_FloorSign
source: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n10F$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ThanksForSavingMeDearBoy
source:
PRESIDENT: Oh, dear boy!
Thank you for saving SILPH.\pI will never forget you saved us in
our moment of peril.\pI have to thank you in some way.\pBecause I am rich, I can give you
anything.\pHere, maybe this will do.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ThanksForSavingMeDearGirl
source:
PRESIDENT: Oh, dear girl!
Thank you for saving SILPH.\pI will never forget you saved us in
our moment of peril.\pI have to thank you in some way.\pBecause I am rich, I can give you
anything.\pHere, maybe this will do.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ObtainedMasterBallFromPresident
source: {PLAYER} obtained a MASTER BALL\nfrom the PRESIDENT!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ThatsOurSecretPrototype
source:
PRESIDENT: You can't buy that
anywhere.\pIt's our secret prototype MASTER
BALL.\pIt will catch any POKéMON without
fail!\pYou should be quiet about using it,
though.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForThis
source: You have no room for this.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ThanksForRescuingUs
source: SECRETARY: Thank you for rescuing\nall of us.\pWe, from the PRESIDENT down,\nare indebted to you.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniIntro
source:
Ah, {PLAYER}!
So we meet again!\pThe PRESIDENT and I are discussing
a vital business proposition.\pKeep your nose out of grown-up
matters…\pOr, experience a world of pain!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniDefeat
source: Arrgh!!\nI lost again!?$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniPostBattle
source: Blast it all!\nYou ruined our plans for SILPH!\pBut, TEAM ROCKET will never fall!\p{PLAYER}! Never forget that all\nPOKéMON exist for TEAM ROCKET!\pI must go, but I shall return!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt2Intro
source: Stop right there!\nDon't you move!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: Don't…\nPlease!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: So, you want to see my BOSS?$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: Halt! Do you have an appointment\nwith my BOSS?$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: Gaah!\nDemolished!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: Watch your step…\nMy BOSS likes his POKéMON tough!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_MonitorHasMonsOnIt
source: The monitor has POKéMON on it!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_FloorSign
source: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n11F$

label: SilphCo_1F_Text_WelcomePresidentInBoardroom
source: Welcome.\pThe PRESIDENT is in the boardroom\non 11F.$

label: SilphCo_1F_Text_FloorSign
source: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n1F$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_ConnorIntro
source: Help!\nI'm a SILPH employee.$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_ConnorDefeat
source: How did you know\nI was a ROCKET?$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_ConnorPostBattle
source: I work for both SILPH and TEAM\nROCKET.$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_JerryIntro
source: It's off-limits here!\nGo home!$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_JerryDefeat
source: You're good.$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_JerryPostBattle
source: Can you solve the maze in here?\nIt's not easy, I tell you!$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: No kids are allowed in here!$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: Tough!$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: Diamond-shaped tiles are teleport\nblocks.\pThey're transporters for this\nhigh-tech building.$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt2Intro
source: Hey, kid!\nWhat are you wandering here for?$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: I goofed!$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: SILPH CO. will be associated with\nTEAM ROCKET!$

label: Text_ThunderWaveTeach
source:
Eeek!
No! Stop! Help!\pOh, you're not with TEAM ROCKET.
I'm sorry, I thought…\pWill you forgive me if I teach
you the THUNDER WAVE technique?$

label: Text_ThunderWaveDeclined
source: Oh…\nBut THUNDER WAVE is convenient…$

label: Text_ThunderWaveWhichMon
source: Which POKéMON should I teach\nTHUNDER WAVE?$

label: Text_ThunderWaveTaught
source:
THUNDER WAVE causes paralysis in
the target POKéMON.\pA paralyzed POKéMON may be unable
to move in battle.\pIt's an ELECTRIC-type move, so it
won't work on some POKéMON.$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_FloorSign
source: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n2F$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_WhatAmIToDo
source: I work for SILPH CO.\nWhat am I to do?$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_YouAndYourMonsSavedUs
source: {PLAYER}!\nYou and your POKéMON saved us!$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_GruntIntro
source: Quit messing with us, kid!$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_GruntDefeat
source: I give up!$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_GruntPostBattle
source: A hint? You can open doors with\na CARD KEY!$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_JoseIntro
source: I support TEAM ROCKET more than\nI support SILPH CO.!$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_JoseDefeat
source: You really got me!$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_JosePostBattle
source: Humph…\pTEAM ROCKET said that if I helped\nthem, they'd let me study POKéMON.$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_FloorSign
source: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n3F$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_CantYouSeeImHiding
source: Sssh!\nCan't you see I'm hiding?$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_TeamRocketIsGone
source: Huh?\nTEAM ROCKET is gone?$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: TEAM ROCKET has taken control\nof SILPH CO.!$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: Arrgh!$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: Fwahahaha!\nMy BOSS has been after this place!$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_RodneyIntro
source: My POKéMON is my loyal servant.$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_RodneyDefeat
source: Darn!\nYou weak POKéMON!$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_RodneyPostBattle
source: The doors are electronically\nlocked.\pIt takes a CARD KEY to open the\ndoors here.$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt2Intro
source: Intruder spotted!$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: Who are you?$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: I better tell the BOSS on 11F!$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_FloorSign
source: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n4F$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_RocketsInUproarAboutIntruder
source: TEAM ROCKET is in an uproar over\nsome intruder.\pThat's you, right?$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_YoureOurHeroThankYou
source: TEAM ROCKET took off!\nYou're our hero! Thank you!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: I heard a kid was wandering\naround.$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: Boom!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: It's not smart to pick a fight with\nTEAM ROCKET!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_BeauIntro
source: We study POKé BALL technology on\nthis floor.$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_BeauDefeat
source: Dang!\nBlast it!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_BeauPostBattle
source: We worked on the ultimate POKé\nBALL which would catch anything.$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_DaltonIntro
source: Whaaat?\pThere shouldn't be any children\nhere!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_DaltonDefeat
source: Oh, goodness!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_DaltonPostBattle
source: You're only on 5F.\nIt's a long way to my BOSS!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2Intro
source: Show TEAM ROCKET a little respect!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: Cough…\nCough…$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: Which reminds me.\pKOFFING evolves into WEEZING!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_PorygonFirstVRMon
source: It's a POKéMON REPORT!\pPOKéMON LAB created PORYGON,\nthe first virtual-reality POKéMON.$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Over350TechniquesConfirmed
source: It's a POKéMON REPORT!\pOver 350 POKéMON techniques have\nbeen confirmed.$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_SomeMonsEvolveWhenTraded
source: It's a POKéMON REPORT!\pSome POKéMON have been confirmed\nto evolve when they are traded.$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_FloorSign
source: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n5F$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_RocketBossLookingForStrongMons
source:
Those thugs that took over our
building…\pTheir BOSS said he was looking for
strong POKéMON.\pI hope our PRESIDENT managed to
avoid trouble…$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_RocketsTookOverBuilding
source: The ROCKETS came and took over\nthe building!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_BetterGetBackToWork
source: Well, better get back to work.$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_HelpMePlease
source: Oh dear, oh dear.\nHelp me, please!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_WeGotEngaged
source: We got engaged.\nHeheh!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_ThatManIsSuchACoward
source: That man next to me…\nHe's such a coward!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_NeedsMeToLookAfterHim
source: He's so helpless, he needed\nsomeone like me to look after him.$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_RocketsTryingToConquerWorld
source: TEAM ROCKET is trying to conquer\nthe world with POKéMON.$

source: ARCEUS: Dodogyuuun!\pThe ARCEUS is weakened...\nCan be caught?$

label: SinjohRuins_ArceusRoom_Text_StevenCongrats
source:
STEVEN: You did it, {PLAYER}!\pThat battle was breathtaking.\pSeeing your power made me realize.\pThe KIMONO GIRLS didn't send you
to help our research.\pI think they sent you because
you were the only one worthy of\ltaming the legendary POKéMON.\pThey didn't trust my team and I
to handle it.\pAnd after what I've just seen...\pI think they were right.\pI've brought a lot of unwanted
attention to this town.\pI think I'll spend some time
with the locals.\pAfter all of this, you and your
POKéMON deserve some rest.\pI'll be at the village if you need me.\pFufufu, what could you need from me?$

label: SinjohRuins_Text_StevenGotoStairs1
source: STEVEN: This could only mean one thing.$

label: SinjohRuins_Text_StevenGotoStairs2
source:
{PLAYER}. We were able to decipher
the rest of the glyphs...\pIf the translation is right, 
the POKéMON at the top of that\lstaircase is the most powerful\lbeing in the universe.\pAnd it is my duty as former
CHAMPION of the HOENN LEAGUE\lto make sure you are strong\lenough to face it.\pMeet me at that landing
when you are ready.$

label: SinjohRuins_Text_HealParty
source: STEVEN: Let me heal your POKéMON\nbefore you go.$

label: SinjohRuins_Text_StevenAfterPlate
source: STEVEN: Good luck, {PLAYER}\pGo on, I'm right behind you.$

label: SinjohRuins_Text_StevenAfterBattle
source: STEVEN: To think, another trainer \nwould defeat me like this.\pIncredible.\pTake this, it's the final plate.$

label: SinjohRuins_Text_StevenReadytoBattle
source: STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pEver since I first saw the\ndetermination in your eyes,\lI felt it would lead to this.\pI will test the bond between you\nand your POKéMON.\pAre you ready?$

label: SinjohRuins_Text_ChallengeSteven
source: Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, if you're going to mount\na serious challenge, expect the worst!$

label: SinjohRuins_Text_StevenDefeat
source: You...\nYou are ready.$

label: SinjohRuins_Text_Sign
source: SINJOH RUINS$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenIntroCutscene1
source: STEVEN: Hm?$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenIntroCutscene2
source: STEVEN: {PLAYER}!\pI'd recognize those eyes anywhere.\pWhat brings you this far north?\p.............\pI see, the KIMONO GIRLS of NEW SINJOH\nhave sent you to aid our\linvestigation.\pIn that case, allow me to bring you\nup to speed.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenIntroCutscene3
source:
STEVEN: When I first heard about
these ruins, I had to come see\lthem for myself.\pI assembled a team from DEVON CORP.
and we set off on a research\lexpedition.\pWho knows what we'll find buried
here.\pWe've learned quite a lot
already.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenIntroCutscene4
source:
LINGUIST: While the full translation
of the glyphs found around the ruins\lstill eludes me, I've been able\lto make out some aspects.\pThere are 17 peculiar PLATES.\pThey have some significance
to the ruins, but we've only\lfound 1 so far.\pThe rest are said to be guarded
by POKéMON and trainers of\lawesome power.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenIntroCutscene5
source:
STEVEN: That's the story, {PLAYER}.\pThe NOBLE POKéMON that guard the
remaining PLATES are too strong\lfor my team, I'm afraid.\pAnd I need to stay here to oversee
the research.\pBut I think you could do it.
Will you help us?$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenIntroCutscene6
source: Excellent.\pThe glyphs say the PLATES are\nheld by NOBLE POKéMON and\lstrong trainers across SINJOH.\pI'll call your POKéGEAR if we\nlearn anything new.\pThank you, {PLAYER}.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenIntroCutsceneRefused
source: Are you sure?\pWho knows what we'll find buried\nhere.\pWon't you reconsider?$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_FinalPlateScene1
source: STEVEN: {PLAYER}!\pI think I know what's going to\nhappen we bring together all 17 of\lthe PLATES.\pI feel...\l.....................$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_FinalPlateScene2
source: STEVEN: I need to see this for\nmyself!\pOutside, {PLAYER}!$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenFindPlates
source: STEVEN: Ah, {PLAYER}.\p{STR_VAR_1} PLATES so far.\nNot bad at all.\pI have to admit, I'm curious\nwhat will happen once they're\lall gathered.\pWell, let's see what you find.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenFindPlates3
source: STEVEN: Ah, {PLAYER}.\p{STR_VAR_1} PLATES so far.\nNot bad at all.\pHave you investigated that\nchamber yet?\lIt's all quite mysterious.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenFindPlates9
source:
STEVEN: Ah, {PLAYER}.\p{STR_VAR_1} PLATES so far.
Making great progress.\pThe chambers that have opened
up bear a striking similarity\lto a series of chambers\lin the HOENN region.\pEach of those was also home to a
legendary POKéMON.\pBut in HOENN, only 3 were ever
discovered.\pAnd here, there are at least 6.\pWho knows what we'll find next.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenAfterAll
source:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}!\pThis expedition has been the
experience of a lifetime.\pEver since I heard about these ruins,
I had this feeling.\pI thought we would discover something
amazing.\pAnd my predictions usually come true.\pThank you for all your help,
Champion.\pWhere will you go from here?\pI hope we can meet again somewhere.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Geologist
source: Ground-penetrating radar shows\n6 subterranean chambers in this\lvalley.\p5 of them appear to be closer\nto the surface level, with 1\lburied even deeper.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_GeologistDuring
source: All this time I've directed my\nequipment downward to image\lthe underground.\pWhen clearly I should've pointed\nit up!$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_GeologistAfter
source: Those PLATES were related to the\nmost powerful POKéMON??\pI wish I had more time to study them.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Linguist
source: Ugh....\nThere's so many glyphs to\ltranslate..\pWe don't have anything like this\nin the HOENN region.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_LinguistDuring
source:
Imagine my surprise as I
translated the glyph!\pI triple and quadruple checked
it before telling STEVEN!\pI mean, really, the God of
POKéMON?\pIt's incredible.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_LinguistAfter
source: This expedition has been a\njoy, {PLAYER}.\pThanks for taking care of all\nthe field-work.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Archaeologist
source:
The existence of a civilization
in this area changes our whole\lunderstanding of history.\pMany of the artifacts we've found
are over a thousand years old.\pThe carbon dating lines up with
artifacts found in the SINNOH region.\pAlthough, that flute you found...
It seems far older.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_ArchaeologistDuring
source: Those plates...\nThe connection to the SINNOH\lregion...\lThat flute....\lIt's all starting to make sense.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_ArchaeologistAfter
source: The historical value of what\nyou've helped us unearth here\lcannot be overstated, \l{PLAYER}.\pTruly, thank you.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Growlithe_Cry
source: Growh owh!!$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_GrowlitheBall
source: This appears to be Growlithe's ball..\nBetter leave it alone.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Biologist
source:
Look at this wonderful specimen!\pThis species of GROWLITHE is unlike
those found anywhere else in the\lworld.\pDNA analysis reveals that it shares
a common ancestor with GROWLITHE\lfound in other regions.\pYet, its temperament and typing
differ significantly.\pDescriptions of GROWLITHE found in
ancient SINNOH records seem to match.\pPerhaps this species once occupied
a much larger territory, stretching\lnorth through ancient SINNOH.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_BiologistDuring
source: If the creature at the top of\nthose stairs really is the God\lof all POKéMON, does that mean\lit is the first common ancestor?$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_BiologistAfter
source: I've been able to gather so much\ndata on regional forms and\ldivergent evolution from this\lexpedition. Thank you,\l{PLAYER}.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Hiker
source:
For ten years, I've hiked these
wilds.\pNo, make that twenty years.\pUntil one day I found those big
stone pillars and that ominous\ltemple.\pThat's the SINJOH RUINS.
Or so I've heard.\pI didn't know about the town then.\pAll I did was tell a few of my
pals. But word travels fast.\pI never thought it would bring
so much attention to the area.\pMakes me feel kinda funny.
Y'know?$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_HikerDuringAfter
source:
Don't tell anyone, {PLAYER},
But I saw that temple on\lthe mountaintop when I first\ldiscovered this place.\pI kept it to myself.\pI've blabbed enough about
these ruins.\pIt seems like everything worked
out, at least.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note1
source:
Research Log 1: May 3, 1975\pWe've arrived at the location
of the ruins.\pThe harsh cold of Mt.Silver
can be felt from all the way\ldown here...\pSoon the main excavation team
will make it through the mountain..\lI cannot wait to see what waits for us\lunderneath our feet!$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note2
source:
Research Log 2:  May 10, 1975\pA week of digging has yielded
no result whatsoever.\pThe ice here is impossibly thick,
and the rock just breaks our\lequipment entirely.\pNot even MACHAMP was able to
make a dent.\pWhat is this place?\pWe must find out.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note3
source:
Research Log 3:  May 14, 1975\pYou don't get ahead in life by
standing by and doing nothing.\pI'm just a worker.\pBut I had an idea of how we could
break through the ice.\pOr rather, melt through it.\pWe need FIRE-TYPE POKéMON and
lots of them.\pBut how will we get them here
all the way from SINNOH?$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note4
source:
Research Log 4:  May 21, 1975\pWe've been busy.\pMy idea worked to get us through
the ice. Only we didn't get the\lFIRE-TYPEs from back home.\pThe boss insisted we get them locally.\pWe found a hot spring by a nearby
village....\pAnd we took what we needed...\pI'm not proud of it. But sacrifices
are sometimes required for progress.\pSo, the ice is gone.\pThere are 6 chambers, and a sealed
temple in the center.\pThe architecture of the main 
structure indicates it may be of the\lthe ancient Celestica peoples...\pOur ancestors. Before they moved north.\pThe boss wants that temple open as
soon as possible...$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note5
source:
Research Log 5:  June 2, 1975\pWe managed to get it open...\pI thought I'd be overjoyed...\pBut we lost good men in the blast
of energy that sprung from the\ltemple.\pNot to mention the POKéMON that
helped us get it open.\lGod rest their souls...\p........................\pRegardless.\pThe temple is open, but we are
only left with more questions.\pThere is no legendary POKéMON
inside. No treasure.\pOur supplies are starting to run
out and we have nothing to show\lfor our efforts...$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note6
source: Research Log 6:  June 10, 1975\pThe expedition is done.\nThe rest of the men are packing up.\pBut I can't.\pI can't abandon this mission.\nNot after what we've lost.\pI'm going to stay behind.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note7
source:
Research Log 7:  September 10, 1975\pIt's been months since we got
here. Since I got here.\pThe rest of the men are gone.\pNow it's just me and the
POKéMON we captured to help us\lwith the work.\pI've been training them to get
stronger.\pMy TYPHLOSION, most of all.\pWe must find out what's beneath
the temple.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note8
source:
Research Log 8:  September 15, 1975\pFailure.\p......................\pMy POKéMON....\pTogether, all 6 of my POKéMON
were able to smash through
A false wall in the temple.\pBut it was waiting for us...\pSomething like a giant titan...\pThe energy it released was just
like what happened before.\pThey were all destroyed...\pAnd worst of all, that beast
sealed the wall back up.\pI can't go home.
They won't recognize me anymore...\pThis place has changed me...\pI'm going to talk with the
villagers.\pThey don't know what I've done.\pSince the other men are long
gone, they'll think I'm just a\llost hiker.\pThere is no place left for me
but here.$

source: It's a display case neatly\npacked and lined with samples\land artifacts!$

label: SinjohRuins_WallSign_Text

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_DropedItem

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenName
source: STEVEN$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenCall3Plates
source:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pWe felt a tremor at the ruins
just now.\pEveryone's fine, don't worry.\pIt's quite intriguing, one of the
subterranean chambers beneath the\lruins has sprung open.\pThe markings inside remind
me of something from HOENN.\pYou should come take a look
when you can.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenCall6Plates
source:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pHow's the search going?\pWe had another tremor here.
A second chamber opened up\lthis time.\pI've asked our geologist to keep
his instruments ready in case it\lhappens again.\pThe deeper we dig... The more
questions we find.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenCall9Plates
source:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pAnother tremor here at the ruins.\pThe data paints an intriguing
picture.\pIt wasn't an earthquake at all.\pSome kind of energy built up
underground and cracked the\lrock open from the inside.\pWhat could cause that...
I honestly don't know.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenCall12Plates
source:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pAnother tremor. Another chamber
opening up.\pWe still can't figure out the
pattern behind the timing.\pSay, {PLAYER}... you're not
doing something to cause all\lthis, are you?\pNo, that can't be right.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenCall15Plates
source: STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pDid you just find another PLATE?\p.................\pOf course.\pThe legendary POKéMON lying\nin these ruins... they're responding\lto you, aren't they?\pAs if they want to be found.\pMy predictions usually come true.\nI should have known better than\lto doubt you.$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenCall16Plates
source: STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pWe're very close now. I can feel it.\p..................\pYou should come see this for\nyourself.$

here, so it belongs to me!\pI'll sell it to TEAM ROCKET for
serious money.\p…D-don't glare at me like that!\pIf you want it back, why don't you
go get it after I sell it?\pI'll even tell you one of the
passwords to TEAM ROCKET's\lWAREHOUSE.\pThe WAREHOUSE password I know is
“Yes, nah, CHANSEY.”\pI'm done.
Don't think badly of me!$

label: SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynDefeat

source: GREEN PATH\nThink Green, Keep Nature Clean!$

label: SixIsland_House_Text_GoodPlaceForNatureAndHistory
source: There's nothing that young people'd\nfind exciting here on this island.\pBut, this is a good place in terms\nof nature and history.\pRelax and enjoy your stay.$

label: SixIsland_Mart_Text_AgathaOldestEverEliteFourMember
source: Play with POKéMON lots and live\na long life!\pTake AGATHA, for example.\pShe set a record for being the\noldest-ever ELITE FOUR member.\pShe spurs me to do bigger things.$

label: SixIsland_Mart_Text_ShouldBuyMailAndWriteLetter
source: I should buy some MAIL and write\nhim a letter…$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_RocketIntro
source: There're no rare POKéMON around\nthese parts! Not a one!\pThat burns me up, man.\nI'll take it out on you!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_RocketDefeat
source: …Huh?$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_RocketPostBattle
source: So listen, you haven't seen any\nrare POKéMON, have you?$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorIntro
source: I'm having no luck at all.\nA battle'd be a change of pace!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorDefeat
source: Nope, no luck at all…$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorPostBattle
source: I can't very well go home without\ncatching something, though.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoIntro
source: Gasp… Gasp…\pI swam here from SIX ISLE PORT\nin one go.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoDefeat
source: Gasp…\nGasp…$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoPostBattle
source: I'm only at the halfway point…\nI'm beat…$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicoleIntro
source: It's not so easy sending POKéMON\nout while swimming, you know?$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicoleDefeat
source: I didn't lose to you at swimming.\nThis doesn't bother me.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicolePostBattle
source: Are you headed for the island up\npast here?\pI didn't see anything interesting\nthere.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaIntro
source: AVA: Let's have a two-on-two\nmarine battle!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaDefeat
source: AVA: Oh, you're amazing!\nEven better, you're on your own!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaPostBattle
source: AVA: You know, I do prefer the\nsea over any pool.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaNotEnoughMons
source: AVA: You're challenging us to\na battle?\pYou'll need at least two POKéMON\nif you want to do that.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebIntro
source: GEB: Big Sister, help!\nPlease battle with me!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebDefeat
source: GEB: Wow, Big Sister, this person's\nreally good!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebPostBattle
source: GEB: I'm hanging onto my sister\nbecause I can't touch the bottom.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebNotEnoughMons
source: GEB: Please battle against me and\nmy sister!\p…Oh, you don't have two POKéMON?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyIntro
source: I'm curious, how do you raise your\nPOKéMON?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyDefeat
source: You raise your POKéMON with a\nwhole lot of love!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyPostBattle
source: In the same way your mother raised\nyou full of love, you should raise\lyour POKéMON.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonIntro
source: I'm working to preserve the natural\necology of POKéMON here.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonDefeat
source: Oh, for someone so young, you are\ntremendous!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonPostBattle
