source: I'm not saying that you shouldn't\ncatch POKéMON.\pI just want people to raise their\nPOKéMON responsibly.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_GarretIntro
source: I caught a BUG POKéMON that lives\nonly around here!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_GarretDefeat
source: Heheh…\nIsn't my POKéMON awesome?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_GarretPostBattle
source: There's a girl near the BUSH who\nmeasures HERACROSS for TRAINERS.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahIntro
source: You know, it just doesn't feel right\nif I don't use BUG POKéMON.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahDefeat
source: It's okay, losing is a fun part of\nPOKéMON's appeal, too.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahPostBattle
source: By the way, “appeal” is a weird\nword, if you think about it.\pLike, is it like an orange peel?\nOr like a ringing bell?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VanceIntro
source: Yeah, yeah, yeah!\nLook at all the BUG POKéMON!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VanceDefeat
source: I got beat while I was still busy\ncelebrating!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VancePostBattle
source: I'm going to bring my little brother\nhere next time.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_NashIntro
source: Look, look! There are funny\npatterns on the ground.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_NashDefeat
source: Super awesome!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_NashPostBattle
source: The funny patterns on the ground…\pThey look like the patterns on my\ngrandpa's clothes.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellIntro
source: I bet you think I'm just some guy,\ndon't you, eh?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellDefeat
source: I bet you think I'm weak,\ndon't you, eh?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellPostBattle
source: Ayup, you townies come around all\nso dandy with a hat that flashy…\pHow about giving me that?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaIntro
source: Take a deep breath.\nIsn't the air delicious?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaDefeat
source: If you'd like, I can teach you how\nto breathe properly.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaPostBattle
source: First, exhale.\nBlow everything out.\pWhen you can't exhale anymore,\ninhale the clean air!\pIsn't it refreshing?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaIntro
source: I love BUG POKéMON.\nThat's why I'm here all the time.\pAm I the only girl like that?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaDefeat
source: I lost, but I'm still laughing.\nAm I the only girl like that?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaPostBattle
source: I'm going to keep on collecting\nBUG POKéMON.\pAm I the only girl like that?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_RileyIntro
source: This is a good spot.\nI'll pitch my tent here.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_RileyDefeat
source: Wimped out…$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_RileyPostBattle
source: I'm going to observe the night sky\nhere.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyIntro
source: Oh, yuck!\nI think a bug stung me!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyDefeat
source: It wasn't a bug.\nI cut my shin on some grass.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyPostBattle
source: A little cut like that…\nA little spit's enough to cure it!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonIntro
source: Have you noticed something odd\nabout these parts?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonDefeat
source: Have you taken a good look around\nyour feet?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonPostBattle
source: There are places here in PATTERN\nBUSH where grass won't grow.\pWhat could be the cause of such\na phenomenon?$

label: SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SomethingHiddenOnThisIsland
source: For ten years, I've searched for\nRUINS.\pNo, make that twenty years.\pI get this feeling that there's\nsomething hidden on this island.$

label: SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SomeMonsEvolveByTradingWithHeldItem
source:
You know of POKéMON that evolve
only upon trading, yes?\pBut did you know that there are
still others?\pSome POKéMON evolve only when
traded while holding specific items.$

label: SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RivalImpossibleToGetAllMonsAroundHere
source:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!
How's your POKéDEX filling up?\pIt looks like it's impossible to get
all the POKéMON by hanging around\ljust these parts.\pMaybe there are POKéMON we don't
know about somewhere far away…\p… … …  … … …  … … …\pWell, if I can't do it, there's no
way for you to get it done.\pI'm not going to get all desperate
over this.\pI'll keep collecting POKéMON at my
own pace while I train them.\pThat's what I'll do.
So there's no point staying here.\lI may as well leave for home.\pThat's that, then!
Smell ya later!$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_CantFigureOutHowToGetInside
source: I can't figure out how I'm supposed\nto get inside.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_IFoundThisPlace
source: Let me tell you, I found this\nplace.\pDon't look so envious, will you?$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_CheckDoorMoreThoroughly
source: The door doesn't budge at all.\nCheck it more thoroughly?$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LeftDoorAlone
source: {PLAYER} left the door alone.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_SeveralDotsOnTheDoor
source: On closer inspection, there are\nseveral dots on the door…$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DoorIsOpen
source: The door is open.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyIntro
source: There appear to be many secrets\nstill unsolved in this world.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyDefeat
source: Hmm…$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyPostBattle
source: I suggest to you that you, too,\ngive a thought to the secrets and\lmysteries of our world once a day.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterIntro
source: I'm curious, what compelled you to\ncome here?$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterDefeat
source: It's been so long since I battled,\nmy instincts are off.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterPostBattle
source: There are several ruins on the\nSEVII ISLANDS.\pThe majority of them date back\na long way.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryIntro
source: It's been said that there are\nmysterious stones on this island.\pI suspect it has something to do\nwith the ruins here.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryDefeat
source: Oh, interesting.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryPostBattle
source: Those ruins over there…\pI haven't had any luck in finding\nhow I can get inside.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylIntro
source: A battle with you, so high up!$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylDefeat
source: Oh, the heartbreak of losing so\neasily to you!$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylPostBattle
source: Experience the joy of climbing!$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorIntro
source: I'm pretty familiar with the land\naround these parts.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorDefeat
source: You don't need to be so pushy.\nI'll be happy to tell you.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorPostBattle
source: The door to the ruins…\nIt has these strange patterns\lengraved on the outside.\pI don't know what they mean,\nthough.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RoseIntro
source: I let a pleasant breeze lead me\nall the way here.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RoseDefeat
source: Giggle… You're so cute when you're\ndetermined.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RosePostBattle
source: I want to go to the woods over\nthere, but…\pThere are lots of BUG POKéMON.\nThey scare me a little.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardIntro
source: I'm practicing in secret so no one\ncan see me.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardDefeat
source: Nobody saw me losing, right?$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardPostBattle
source: As a performer, I don't want people\nto know about the effort I put in.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirIntro
source: What, you're suggesting that you're\nsick of seeing SWIMMERS like me?\pAww, don't be hatin'!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirDefeat
source: Oh, no, no, no.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirPostBattle
source: I couldn't lift the stigma of being\na SWIMMER…$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DeniseIntro
source: My boyfriend's always busy, so I\ncome swimming by myself.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DeniseDefeat
source: Awww, I knew this would happen!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DenisePostBattle
source: When I can't be with my boyfriend,\nI spend time with the POKéMON he\lgave me.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlIntro
source: Tell me, where are the mountains\naround these parts?$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlDefeat
source: I lost my way while I was busy\nbattling!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlPostBattle
source: Aren't there any mountains around\nthese parts?$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuIntro
source: MIU: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to play!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuDefeat
source: MIU: Oh, no!\nMommy!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuPostBattle
source: MIU: It makes me all sad inside\nwhen we lose…$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuNotEnoughMons
source: MIU: MIA and I are TWINS.\nWe want to battle together.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaIntro
source: MIA: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to battle!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaDefeat
source: MIA: You're mean!\nYou're bad for winning!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaPostBattle
source: MIA: Ohh…\nI'm sorry, my POKéMON…$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaNotEnoughMons
source: MIA: Oh, you only have one\nPOKéMON?\pDon't you feel lonesome?$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_WantedUltimateHorn
source: Wanted!\nThe Ultimate Horn!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RouteSign
source: WATER PATH\nLeads to RUIN VALLEY$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_LoveItNeedItHeracross
source: Hera, hera, HERACROSS!\nBig and shiny, it's the bug boss!\lLove it, need it, HERACROSS!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_MayIMeasureHeracross
source: Eeeeek!\nThat's a HERACROSS!\pPlease, please, may I measure how\nbig it is?$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInchesDeserveReward
source: Eeeek, it's {STR_VAR_2} inches!\nI've never seen anything like this!\lYou deserve a reward!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_WantToSeeBiggerOne
source: I want to see a much, much bigger\nHERACROSS than that one.\pOh, how I adore them, big\nHERACROSS!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInchesSameAsBefore
source: Huh? This {STR_VAR_2}-inch measurement…\nOh, boo! It's the same as before.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInchesYInchesWasBiggest
source: Oh, it's just {STR_VAR_2} inches.\nThe HERACROSS before was bigger.\pIt was {STR_VAR_3} inches, the biggest\nHERACROSS you've brought me.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ThisWontDo
source: Oh, no! This won't do!\pHERACROSS looks much more macho\nand cool, and has a lovely horn!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_YourBagIsFull
source: Your BAG is full.\nMy reward won't fit.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_BiggestHeracrossIsXInches
source: The biggest HERACROSS that I have\never seen measured so far is:\p{STR_VAR_3} inches!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_BlankChartOfSomeSort
source: It's a blank chart of some sort.\pIt has spaces for writing in\nrecords of some kind.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House2_Text_MyNeighborMeasuredMe
source: My height is 67.0 inches on the\nbutton.\pI know it is this precisely because\nmy neighbor measured me.$

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_DoorIsClosed
source: The door is closed.$

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_OpenedDoorToSkyPillar
source: WALLACE: Oh, my, I'm terribly sorry!\pIn my haste, I didn't notice that\nI'd left you behind!\pI've opened the locked door of\nthe SKY PILLAR.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, let's be on our way!$

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_EarthquakeNotMomentToWaste
source: WALLACE: It's an earthquake!\pThere's not a moment to waste!\nWe've got to hurry!$

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_SituationGettingWorse
source: WALLACE: Hmm…\nThe situation is getting worse…$

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
source:
WALLACE: This isn't good…\pThe weather distortion is spreading
even here…\p{PLAYER}{KUN}.\pRAYQUAZA should be farther up
from here.\pI'm worried about SOOTOPOLIS.
I've got to go back.\pEverything is in your hands now.
Don't fail us!$

label: SkyPillar_Top_Text_RayquazaFlewOff
source: The awakened RAYQUAZA flew off…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_EnergyGuruSellWhatYouNeed
source: I'm the ENERGY GURU! I'll go for it and\nsell you what you need!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_OhYourPokemon
source: Oh?\nYour {STR_VAR_1}…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_PleaseGiveItThisEffortRibbon
source: Went for it stupendously!\pAs its reward, please give it this\nEFFORT RIBBON.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ReceivedEffortRibbon
source: {PLAYER} received the EFFORT RIBBON.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_PutEffortRibbonOnMon
source: {PLAYER} put the EFFORT RIBBON\non {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_GoForItLittleHarder
source: You have to go for it a little harder.\pIf you do, I'll give your POKéMON\nsomething nice.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_EffortRibbonLooksGoodOnIt
source: Oh! Your {STR_VAR_1}, that EFFORT\nRIBBON looks good on it!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_WonderIfLighthouseStartlesPokemon
source: The light of the lighthouse reaches\ndozens of miles away.\pI wonder if it doesn't startle POKéMON\nin the sea.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SeaweedFullOfLife
source: Ooh, look at this!\pThe seaweed you can get around these\nparts is fresh and full of life.\pWhy, it looks like it can even rear up\nand attack!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_HowTownIsBornAndGrows
source: Where the water is clean, the fruits\nof bountiful harvest gather.\pAnd where people gather, a market\nsoon starts.\pThat is how a town is born and grows.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SlateportWonderfulPlace
source: Shopping where you can breathe the\nscent of the ocean…\pSLATEPORT is such a wonderful place!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BuyBricksSoDecorWontGetDirty
source: If you put DOLLS or CUSHIONS on\nthe floor, they'll get dirty.\pI'm going to buy some BRICKS so my\nDOLLS and CUSHIONS won't get dirty\lwhen I leave them out.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_GoingToCompeteInBattleTent
source: Wroooar! I'm going to compete in\nthe BATTLE TENT, too!\pBut before that, I need to catch\nsome POKéMON!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BushedHikingFromMauville
source: Whew… I'm just bushed…\pI hiked over from MAUVILLE CITY.\nBut, boy, this city's huge.\pIf I'd known this, I would've ridden\nmy BIKE here.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_EveryoneCallsHimCaptStern
source: STERN, the fellow who built the\nMUSEUM, also happens to be the leader\lof an undersea exploration team.\pSo, everyone calls him CAPT. STERN.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhatsLongLineOverThere
source: What is that over there?\nThat long line…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_VisitedMuseumOften
source: When I was a child, I visited\nthe MUSEUM often.\pI used to dream about the mysteries of\nthe sea after seeing the exhibits.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_QuitPushing
source: Hey, there! Quit pushing!\nThis is the line, can't you see?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_AquaHasPolicy
source: TEAM AQUA has a policy of\nassembling and dispersing at\lthe operation site.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BossIsBrilliant
source: Our BOSS is brilliant.\pWhat would he want to do with\na MUSEUM now?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhatsNewSchemeIWonder
source: What's the new scheme, I wonder?\pOur BOSS is scary when he's mad, so\nI'd better not screw things up…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ShouldTakeItAll
source: If there's something we need in\nthe MUSEUM, we should take it all!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_DontButtIn
source: Hey, you there!\nDon't butt in!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_RemindsMeOfLongLineForGames
source: A long line, huh?\pIt reminds me of the times I lined up to\nbuy smash-hit games…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhyAreWeLiningUp
source: Why are we even lining up and paying?\nWe should just march in!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhatDoYouWant
source: What?\nWhat do you want?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_IllReadSignForYou
source: You want to read this sign?\nI'll read it for you!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SaysSomethingLikeSeaIsEndless
source: Let's see…\pUm… I think it says something like\n“the life in the sea is endless.”\pYup, I'm pretty sure that's what\nit says.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ShouldveBroughtMyGameBoy
source: Grumble…\pI should've brought my Game Boy\nAdvance so I wouldn't get bored in line…\pGrumble…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_HotSpringsAfterOperation
source: When this operation's over, I'll take\nyou to a hot spring spa!\pThat's what our leader said.\nI can't wait!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SeaIsSoWet
source: The sea is just so vast…\pCould the sea have been made by\nthe tears shed by POKéMON?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SinkOldBoats
source: Do you know what they do with old\nships that become too creaky to sail?\pThey sink them in the sea so they\nbecome habitats for POKéMON.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BuyTooMuch
source: Whenever I visit here, I get carried\naway and buy too much.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_GetNameRaterToHelpYou
source: If you want to change your POKéMON's\nnickname, you'll have to get the NAME\lRATER to help you.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_CantChangeTradeMonName
source: Any POKéMON you get in a trade,\nyou can't change its nickname.\pThe original TRAINER's love for that\nPOKéMON is in the nickname.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentBuiltRecently
source:
Recently, a BATTLE TENT was built
in SLATEPORT.\pGYMS are fun, but the BATTLE TENT's
awesome in its own way.\pYou should go find tough POKéMON
for the BATTLE TENT!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_CaptSternBeingInterviewed
source: I was hoping that it was a famous star\nso I could get an autograph.\pBut who's that being interviewed?\nIsn't that CAPT. STERN?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_InterviewerSoCool
source: That lady interviewer is so cool\nand pretty.\pWhen I grow up, I'm going to be\nan international journalist!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternSaysDiscoveredSomething
source: CAPT. STERN says they discovered\nsomething at the bottom of the sea.\pI wonder what it is?\nWhat could it be?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_CaptainComeBackWithBigFish
source: What's going on here?\pDid the good CAPTAIN come back with\na big fish from the ocean floor?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_AmIOnTV
source: Hey! Are you watching?\nAm I on TV?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_CaptainsACelebrity
source: A TV interview! Here!\nThe CAPTAIN's a celebrity!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BigSmileForCamera
source: TY: Okay, CAPT. STERN, a big smile\nfor the camera!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_MostInvaluableExperience
source: GABBY: I see, I see. You've had a most\ninvaluable experience…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternMoveAheadWithExploration
source: CAPT. STERN: Yes, indeed. We intend to\nmove ahead with our exploration.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_GabbyWonderfulThanksForInterview
source: GABBY: That's wonderful, CAPT. STERN!\nThank you for taking the time from\lyour busy schedule to talk to us.\pWe hope we can interview you again\nwith news of more discoveries!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternWhewFirstInterview
source: CAPT. STERN: Whew…\pThat was my first time to be filmed for\nTV. That was nerve-wracking.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_OhPlayerWeMadeDiscovery
source:
Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You're looking great!\pWe made a huge discovery on our last
seafloor exploration.\pWe found an underwater cavern on
ROUTE 128.\pWe think it's the habitat of a POKéMON
that's said to have been long extinct.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_AquaWillAssumeControlOfSubmarine
source:
Fufufu…
CAPT. STERN, I presume.\pWe of TEAM AQUA will assume
control of your submarine!\pYour objections are meaningless!
We expect your total cooperation!\pFufufu…
Just watch and learn what TEAM\lAQUA has planned!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternWhatWasAllThat
source: CAPT. STERN: What was that all about?\pIt sounded like someone using\na megaphone…\pWhere did it come from?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_FromHarborTryingToTakeSub
source: It's from the HARBOR!\pThe submarine!\nThey're trying to take it!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
source: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nPlease, come with me!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentSign
source: BATTLE TENT SLATEPORT SITE\n“Find it! The ultimate POKéMON!”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardWantedSign
source: STERN'S SHIPYARD\p“Wanted: A sailor capable of sailing\nin all currents.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardNearsCompletion
source: STERN'S SHIPYARD\p“The ferry S.S. TIDAL nears\ncompletion for serving the ports of\lSLATEPORT and LILYCOVE.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardFerryComplete
source: STERN'S SHIPYARD\p“Boarding of the SLATEPORT-LILYCOVE\nferry S.S. TIDAL is handled at the\lHARBOR.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_PokemonFanClubSign
source: POKéMON FAN CLUB\n“Calling all fans of POKéMON!”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_OceanicMuseumSign
source: “The endless sea sustains\nall life.”\pOCEANIC MUSEUM$

label: SlateportCity_Text_CitySign
source: SLATEPORT CITY\p“The port where people and POKéMON\ncross paths.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_MarketSign
source: SLATEPORT MARKET\n“Unique items found nowhere else!”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_HarborFerryUnderConstruction
source: SLATEPORT HARBOR\p“The ferry S.S. TIDAL is under\nconstruction in the SHIPYARD.\p“Service is scheduled to begin\nshortly.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_HarborSign
source: SLATEPORT HARBOR\p“Enjoy a delightful cruise on\nthe ferry S.S. TIDAL.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_NameRatersHouseSign
source: NAME RATER'S HOUSE\n“POKéMON nicknames rated.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerries
source:
If a wild POKéMON gets hurt, it heals
itself by chewing on BERRIES.\pDid you know that?\pSomebody saw that and got the idea
of making medicine from BERRIES.\pDid you know that?\pTo turn BERRIES into medicine,
they must be crushed into powder.\pDid you know that?\pYou seem to have an interest
in BERRIES!\pI've got something good for someone
like you.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerryPowder
source:
I recently had machines installed at
POKéMON CENTERS for crushing BERRIES.\pThe BERRY CRUSH machines are at
the DIRECT CORNER upstairs.\pDid you know?\pCould you make BERRY POWDER for
me using those machines?\pI can make you all sorts of medicine
if you bring me lots of BERRY POWDER.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BroughtMeSomeBerryPowder
source: Have you brought me some\nBERRY POWDER?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExchangeWhatWithIt
source: What would you like to exchange\nit with?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExchangeBerryPowderForItem
source: Okay, you want to exchange your\nBERRY POWDER for one {STR_VAR_1}?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_DontHaveEnoughBerryPowder
source: Oh, dear. You don't have enough\nBERRY POWDER.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_FineBerryPowderTradeSomethingElse
source: This is fine BERRY POWDER.\nIt will make excellent medicine.\pWould you like to trade more of your\nBERRY POWDER for something else?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhenYouGetMoreBringItToMe
source: Okay! When you get some more\nBERRY POWDER, bring it to me, please!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ComeBackToTradeBerryPowder
source: Come back if you'd like to trade your\nBERRY POWDER for some medicine.\pI'm always running a bazaar here.\pDid you know?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_YouDroveTeamAquaAway
source:
SCOTT: Huh?
I'm sure I met you somewhere before.\pHave I introduced myself to you?
If not, my name's SCOTT.\pI just saw TEAM AQUA run away from
here like they were stung.\pLet me guess--you drove them away?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_MaybeThisTrainer
source: SCOTT: Hmm…\nMaybe, just maybe, this TRAINER…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_LetsRegisterEachOther
source: SCOTT: All right! I think you're going\nto become a good friend.\pSo, let's register each other in our\nPOKéNAVS.\p… … … … … …$

label: SlateportCity_Text_RegisteredScott
source: Registered this SCOTT person\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_KeepEyeOnTrainersBeSeeingYou
source: SCOTT: What I'd like to do is tag along\nwith you, but I do want to keep an eye\lon the talents of other people, too.\pSo, I'll be off to roam other towns\na bit more.\pBe seeing you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_TakingBattleTentChallenge
source:
SCOTT: Oh, hey!
If it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, let me guess--you're going
to take the BATTLE TENT challenge?\pYeah! That's a good idea!
That's a really great idea!\pAfter all, a tough TRAINER is
the perfect fit for the BATTLE TENT!\pGive it your best effort!$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceForContests
source:
Want a tasty little bit of advice
for CONTESTS?\pUsing a certain move after another
certain kind of move sometimes gets\lyou extra attention.\pIf you know what you're doing,
you can score big in appeal.\pOf course, your opponents might try
disrupting your POKéMON's showing.$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyPapaIsContestJudge
source: My papa, he's a CONTEST JUDGE.\pI wonder what I should be when I\ngrow up, a JUDGE or a GYM LEADER?$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMajorlyCheesed
source:
Hey, man, I'm like majorly cheesed,
you know. Like, you know, I just\lwanted to know why my POKéMON\lnever won, you know, like, hey?\pSo, like, I gave the JUDGE my two
cents, you know, they're free.\pAnd he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey!
So, like, total bummer, man!\pHey, like, you! Zip it, you know?
Just, you know, take this!$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ExplainTorment
source:
That's, like, TM41, you know?
Hey, it's TORMENT, you hearing me?\pLike, it won't let the other guy
use the same move twice in a row, see?\pHey, now, you listen here, like,
I'm not laying a torment on you!$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MCStepUpTakePartInContest
source:
MC: Oh, my, my!
Now isn't that a dandy of a POKéMON?\pPlease! Do step right up and take
part in our splendid CONTESTS!\pYou'll do well! I'm sure of it!
My eyes have never failed me!$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWouldntDoToMissContest
source:
JUDGE: Well, hello there!
I see that you're a TRAINER!\pThen, it just wouldn't do for you
to miss a POKéMON CONTEST!\pGet a CONTEST PASS in VERDANTURF
CITY and enter anytime!$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ItsAppealTime
source: It's appeal time!\nWhat should I lead with?$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_DidntPayAttentionToAppeal
source: They didn't pay much attention to\nmy POKéMON's appeal…\pHumph, that JUDGE, he doesn't know\na good thing when he sees it.$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
source:
Oh, hi! You must be a serious fan to get
this close to the action.\pI'll reward your enthusiasm with
this sage advice.\pIf a move goes over really well,
the audience will get excited.\pThe POKéMON that makes its appeal
right when everyone's excited…\pWell, you'd think something good has
to happen!$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MoreFreakedOutThanMon
source: I can't do this! I'm more freaked out\nthan my POKéMON.\pI'm shivering and my heart is racing!$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_BattleAndContestAlike
source: A battle and a CONTEST aren't the\nsame, but they are alike, too.\pYou need to work hard and believe\nin the POKéMON you've raised.$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MonLooksOnTopOfGame
source: That POKéMON looks like it's on top\nof its game, huh?\pA POKéMON that does good in the\nsecondary judging seems to be more\lrelaxed when it's doing appeals.$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonBetterThanThatLot
source: Will you look at that sorry sight?\pHeh, my POKéMON's absolutely better\nthan that lot!$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_GetUrgeToMoveWithMon
source: Don't you get the urge to move with\nPOKéMON if they're putting on an\lenergetic appeal?$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_HyperRankStage
source: POKéMON CONTESTS\nHYPER RANK STAGE!$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_CouldntFindMonForMe
source:
So, like, I couldn't find myself any
POKéMON that were, like, for me.\pSo, I figured, like, hey, I should file
a complaint to the guy there?\pAnd he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey!
So, like, total bummer, man!\pHey, like, you! Zip it, you know?
Just, you know, take this!$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainTorment
source:
That's, like, TM41, you know?
Hey, it's TORMENT, you hearing me?\pLike, it won't let the other guy
use the same move twice in a row, see?\pHey, now, you listen here, like,
I'm not laying a torment on you!$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_IllTryUsingBugMons
source: I don't really like BUG POKéMON,\nbut maybe I'll try using some for\la change of pace.\pWho knows, I might even get to like\nthem!$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_BattleEvenWithoutToughMons
source: You can battle all you want here even\nif you don't have any tough POKéMON.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_NiceIfMoreSelection
source: Wouldn't it be nice if they had more of\na selection?$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_CouldntFindMonForMe
source:
So, like, I couldn't find myself any
POKéMON that were, like, for me.\pSo, I figured, like, hey, I should file
a complaint to the guy there?\pAnd he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey!
So, like, total bummer, man!\pHey, like, you! Zip it, you know?
Just, you know, take this!$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_ExplainTorment
source:
That's, like, TM41, you know?
Hey, it's TORMENT, you hearing me?\pLike, it won't let the other guy
use the same move twice in a row, see?\pHey, now, you listen here, like,
I'm not laying a torment on you!$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_IllTryUsingBugMons
source: I don't really like BUG POKéMON,\nbut maybe I'll try using some for\la change of pace.\pWho knows, I might even get to like\nthem!$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_BattleEvenWithoutToughMons
source: You can battle all you want here even\nif you don't have any tough POKéMON.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_NiceIfMoreSelection
source: Wouldn't it be nice if they had more of\na selection?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FerryServiceUnavailable
source: I beg your pardon?\nYou're looking for a ship?\pI'm sorry, the ferry service isn't\navailable at present…$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
source: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_YouMustHaveTicket
source: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…\pI'm terribly sorry.\pYou must have a TICKET to board\nthe ferry.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FlashedTicketWhereTo
source: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.\pPerfect! That's all you need!\pAnd where would you like to go?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SailAnotherTime
source: Please sail with us another time!$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_LilycoveItIs
source: LILYCOVE CITY it is, then!$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_BattleFrontierItIs
source: BATTLE FRONTIER it is, then!$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_PleaseBoardFerry
source: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
source: Then, where would you like to go?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_LoveToGoDeepUnderwaterSomeday
source: A journey to the bottom of the sea…\nI wonder what it'd be like?\pI'd love to go deep underwater like\nthat someday.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_AbnormalWeather
source:
For a ship to sail safely, we need to
know about the weather!\pSpeaking of weather, I heard something
from a guy at the WEATHER INSTITUTE.\pHe was saying abnormal weather has
been reported all over the place!\pYou should visit the WEATHER INSTITUTE
and ask around!$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SubTooSmallForMe
source: I wanted to go with CAPT. STERN on\nthe ocean floor exploration.\pBut the sub's too small for me.\pIf I squeezed in, there wouldn't be\nany room for the CAPTAIN…$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SameThugsTriedToRobAtMuseum
source: CAPT. STERN: Those thugs…\pThey're the same lot who tried to rob\nthe DEVON GOODS at the MUSEUM.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgainHideoutInLilycove
source:
ARCHIE: Oh?
Not you again…\pYou are tenacious to track us here,
that much I will give you.\pBut now…
No one can stop us! No one!\pOr, will you follow us back to our
HIDEOUT in LILYCOVE CITY?\pFwahahahaha…$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_CaptSternWhyStealMySubmarine
source:
CAPT. STERN: Why…\pWhy would TEAM AQUA steal my
SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1?\pThey can't be after the slumbering
POKéMON at the bottom of the sea…\pBut even if I were to chase them,
I don't stand a chance against them…$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
source:
CAPT. STERN: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pOkay… So TEAM AQUA left before you
could stop them…\pOh, no, don't blame yourself.
You're not responsible for this.\pTrying to catch a submarine…
It's impossible for most people.\pYou would need a POKéMON that knows
how to DIVE…\pPerhaps if you went out to
MOSSDEEP CITY…\pA lot of divers live out there, so
someone might teach you…$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_NeedDiveToCatchSub
source:
CAPT. STERN: Trying to catch a
submarine… It's impossible.\pYou would need a POKéMON that knows
how to DIVE…\pPerhaps if you went out to
MOSSDEEP CITY…\pA lot of divers live out there, so
someone might teach you…$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WontBeLongBeforeWeFinishFerry
source: CAPT. STERN: Oh, yes.\nMR. BRINEY came to our SHIPYARD.\pIt won't be long now before we finish\nmaking the ferry!$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FinishedMakingFerry
source: CAPT. STERN: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pWe finally finished making the ferry\nS.S. TIDAL!\pWe couldn't have done it without\nyour friend MR. BRINEY.\pPlease go for a short cruise on it!$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WouldYouTradeScanner
source:
CAPT. STERN: Oh?
{PLAYER}{KUN}, that item you have…\pThat's a SCANNER! That would sure
help us on our explorations.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, would you trade your
SCANNER for something?\pLike, say, a DEEPSEATOOTH or
a DEEPSEASCALE that I have?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_IfYouWantToTradeLetMeKnow
source: CAPT. STERN: Are you certain?\nIt's useless to you, {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pWell, okay, then. If you want to trade\nyour SCANNER, let me know.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TradeForDeepSeaTooth
source: CAPT. STERN: So you'll trade it for\nmy DEEPSEATOOTH?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TradeForDeepSeaScale
source: CAPT. STERN: So you'll trade it for\nmy DEEPSEASCALE?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WhichOneDoYouWant
source: CAPT. STERN: Which one do you want?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_HandedScannerToStern
source: {PLAYER} handed the SCANNER to\nCAPT. STERN.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ThisWillHelpResearch
source: CAPT. STERN: Thanks, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nThis will help our research a lot!$

label: SlateportCity_House_Text_NatureToDoWithStatGains
source: My POKéMON has a HASTY nature.\pIt has higher SPEED compared to\nmy other POKéMON.\pMaybe their nature has something to\ndo with the stat gains of POKéMON.$

label: SlateportCity_House_Text_MustBeGoingToBattleTent
source: You're a TRAINER, aren't you?\pSince you came to SLATEPORT CITY,\nyou must be going to the BATTLE TENT.$

label: SlateportCity_Mart_Text_SomeItemsOnlyAtMart
source: The MARKET does have some interesting\nmerchandise.\pBut there are some items you can only\nget at a POKéMON MART.$

label: SlateportCity_Mart_Text_GreatBallIsBetter
source: A GREAT BALL is better than a POKé BALL\nat catching POKéMON.\pWith this, I should be able to get that\nelusive POKéMON…$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_PleasedToRateMonNickname
source: Hi, hi! I'm the NAME RATER!\nI'm the fortune-teller of names!\pI shall be pleased to rate your\nPOKéMON's nickname.$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_CritiqueWhichMonNickname
source: Which POKéMON's nickname should\nI critique?$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_FineNameSuggestBetterOne
source: Hmmm… {STR_VAR_1}, is it? That is\nquite a fine name you bestowed.\pBut! What say you, if I were to\nsuggest a slightly better name?$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_WhatShallNewNameBe
source: Ah, good. Then, what shall the new\nnickname be?$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_MonShallBeKnownAsName
source: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!\pIt is a better name than before!\nHow fortunate for you!$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_DoVisitAgain
source: I see.\nDo come visit again.$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_NameNoDifferentYetSuperior
source: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!\pIt looks no different from before,\nand yet, this is vastly superior!\pHow fortunate for you!$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_MagnificentName
source: Hmmm… {STR_VAR_1} it is!\pThis is a magnificent nickname!\nIt is impeccably beyond reproach!\pYou'll do well to cherish your\n{STR_VAR_1} now and beyond.$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_ThatIsMerelyAnEgg
source: Now, now.\nThat is merely an EGG!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WouldYouLikeToEnter
source: Welcome to the OCEANIC MUSEUM.\pThe entrance fee is ¥50.\nWould you like to enter?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
source: Please enjoy yourself.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_NotEnoughMoney
source: Oh? I'm sorry, but you don't seem to\nhave enough money.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_CatchUpWithYourGroup
source: Oh? You're with that group that\nwent in earlier?\pYou're the only one who's late.\nYou'd better go catch up to them!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_AquaExistForGoodOfAll
source: We, TEAM AQUA, exist for the good\nof all!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OurBossIsntHere
source: We were told to assemble here,\nso we did, but…\pOur BOSS, the linchpin, isn't here.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WouldStuffHereMakeMeRich
source: If I ripped off the stuff here,\nwould it make me rich?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_CanLearnForNefariousDeeds
source: What I learn here, I can put to use on\nnefarious deeds…$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_RustboroBungled
source: If our goons didn't bungle things\nin RUSTBORO, we wouldn't be here!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_DidntHaveMoney
source: I didn't have ¥50, so it took a long\ntime getting by the receptionist.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_LearnAboutSeaForBattling
source: I want to learn about the sea and\nuse that knowledge for battling.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_SternIsRoleModel
source: I get all giddy and gooey when\nI see the sea!\pFor me, CAPT. STERN is the number\none role model!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_MustBePokemonWeDontKnow
source: The sea is vast without end, and\ninfinitely deep…\pThere must be many POKéMON that\nwe don't know about.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WantSeaPokemon
source: I want a sea POKéMON.\pI think it would feel cool and nice\nto hug.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_RememberMeTakeThis
source:
Aiyeeeh!
What are you doing here?\pMe? I'm the TEAM AQUA member
you thumped before, remember?\lBack in RUSTURF TUNNEL?\pHere, take this!
You have to forgive me!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_HopeINeverSeeYouAgain
source: That TM, it suits you more than it\ndoes me.\pHope I never see you again!\nWahahaha!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_YouHaveToTakeThis
source: Awww, come on!\nYou have to take this and let me go!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WhirlpoolExperiment
source: A blue fluid is spiraling inside\na glass vessel.\p“This is an experiment to create a\nWHIRLPOOL artificially using wind.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WaterfallExperiment
source: A red ball is bobbing up and down\ninside a glass vessel.\p“This is an experiment simulating a\nWATERFALL using the ball's buoyancy.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanSoilDisplay
source:
It's a sample of soil from the ocean
floor.\p“Over many years, the remains of
life-forms settle at the bottom of\lthe sea, making sedimentary layers.\p“By analyzing these layers, the
ancient past is revealed.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_BeachSandDisplay
source: It's a sample of beach sand.\p“Stones from mountains are washed\ndown by rivers where they are\lchipped and ground down.\p“They are reduced to grains and end\nup as sand on beaches.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact1
source:
“OCEANIC MINIFACT 1
Why is seawater blue?\p“Light is composed of many colors.\p“When light passes through water,
most kinds of light lose color.\p“However, blue light retains its
color, making the sea appear blue.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact2
source:
“OCEANIC MINIFACT 2
Why is the sea salty?\p“Seawater contains dissolved salt in
the form of sodium and chlorine ions.\p“These ions leech out of rocks
and are carried out to sea by rain.\p“The concentration of dissolved salt
makes the sea salty.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact3
source:
“OCEANIC MINIFACT 3
Which is bigger? The sea or land?\p“The sea covers about 70% of
the planet, and the rest is land.\p“The sea is therefore more than twice
the size of land.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_FossilDisplay
source:
It's a fossil with wavy ridges on it.\p“Soil on the ocean floor gets scoured
by the tide.\p“The flowing seawater marks the soil
with small ridges and valleys.\p“If this soil becomes fossilized, it is
called a ripple mark.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_DepthMeasuringMachine
source: A strange machine is rotating under\na glass dome.\pMaybe it's for measuring the depth\nof something…$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ThankYouForTheParts
source:
Yes? If you're looking for STERN,
that would be me.\pAh! Those must be the parts I ordered
from MR. STONE of DEVON.\pThank you! That's great!
We can prepare for our expedition now.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WellTakeThoseParts
source: Hehehe, hold it!\nWe'll take those parts!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternWhoAreYou
source: CAPT. STERN: Wh-what?\nWho are you people?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WereTeamAqua
source: We're TEAM AQUA!\pOur BOSS wants those parts!\nShut your yap and fork them over!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: Awaaaah!\nA kid beat me!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_BossGoingToBeFurious
source: Oh, man, what a disaster…\nThe BOSS is going to be furious…$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_LetMeTakeCareOfThis
source: Humph, sniveling wimp!\nLet me take care of this!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: What?!\nI lost, too!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_MeddlingKid
source: Now what? If we don't get the parts,\nwe're in for it!\pArrgh, I didn't count on being meddled\nwith by some meddling kid!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_CameToSeeWhatsTakingSoLong
source: I came to see what was taking so\nlong to snatch some parts, and you\lsimps are held up by a mere child?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ArchieWarning
source:
We are TEAM AQUA,
and we love the sea!\pAnd I am TEAM AQUA's leader,
ARCHIE!\pWhat makes you interfere with us?\p…No! You can't be!
You're not one of TEAM MAGMA?\pWait, that can't be right.
You're not dressed for the part.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pPOKéMON, people… All life depends on
the sea.\pSo, TEAM AQUA is dedicated to
the expansion of the sea.\pDon't you agree? What we are doing
is a magnificent undertaking.\pAh, fine…
You're still too young to understand\lour noble objective.\pBut, I warn you, don't even consider
interfering with our plans again.\pThe consequences will cost you
dearly!\pAnd don't you forget it!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternThankYouForSavingUs
source:
CAPT. STERN: You're…
Ah, okay, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pAnyway, that was a tense situation!
Thank you for saving us!\pOh, yes, I almost forgot that you
even brought the parts from DEVON!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternIveGotToGo
source:
CAPT. STERN: Whoops!
There's no time to lose!\pWe have to set out on our ocean-floor
expedition really soon.\pThanks again, but now I've got
to go!\pFeel free to wander around and check
out our facilities, though.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_RemindsMeOfAbandonedShip
source: I saw a model of a ship here.\pIt reminded me of the ABANDONED SHIP\nnear DEWFORD TOWN…$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_DontRunInMuseum
source: Don't you dare run around inside\nthe MUSEUM!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WantToRideSubmarine
source: Wow, the submarine's awesome!\nI want to go for a ride!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WaterQualitySample1
source: “WATER QUALITY SAMPLE 1,” the\nlabel says.\pThe sea is all connected, but the\nwater seems to differ by region.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WaterQualitySample2
source: “WATER QUALITY SAMPLE 2,” the\nlabel says.\pDoes the saltiness of seawater differ\nby region, too?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_PressureExperiment
source:
A rubber ball is expanding and
shrinking.\p“In the sea, the weight of water itself
exerts pressure.\p“In shallow water, the pressure is not
very heavy.\p“However, in extremely deep water,
the pressure can reach even tens of\lthousands of tons on a small area.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_HoennModel
source: “MODEL OF HOENN REGION”\pIt's a miniature diorama of the\nHOENN region.\pWhere is LITTLEROOT TOWN on this?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_DeepSeawaterDisplay
source: It's a display on the flow of seawater.\p“Near the bottom of the sea, water\nflows due to differences in such\lfactors as temperature and salinity.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SurfaceSeawaterDisplay
source: It's a display on the flow of seawater.\p“Toward the surface, seawater flows\nas currents driven by the winds.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSTidalReplica
source: “THE FERRY S.S. TIDAL\p“A scale replica of the ship under\nconstruction at STERN'S SHIPYARD.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SubmarineReplica
source: “SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1\p“A replica of the high-performance\nocean floor exploration submarine.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SumbersibleReplica
source: “SUBMERSIBLE POD\p“A replica of a compact, unmanned\npod for seafloor exploration.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSAnneReplica
source: “S.S. ANNE\p“A replica of the luxury liner that\ncircles the globe.”$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RaiseDifferentTypesOfPokemon
source:
Want a tip for battling?\pI'd say it's raising different kinds
of POKéMON in a balanced manner.\pIt's no good to make just one
POKéMON strong.\pIf it has a type disadvantage,
it might not stand a chance.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedMonWithFriend
source: I trade POKéMON with my friends.\pIf a traded POKéMON is holding an\nitem, it makes me twice as happy!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MeetChairman
source:
Er-hem! I am the CHAIRMAN of the
POKéMON FAN CLUB!\pBeing the CHAIRMAN, I am naturally
the most important!\pNo one can best me when it comes
to raising POKéMON. No one!\pWell, let me tell you about
POKéMON CONTESTS.\pThey're events where one can show off
POKéMON for the world to see!\pHowever, they're held in far-off towns,
so I cannot participate often enough.\pThat is why we gather here to show
off our POKéMON, and have others\lshow us theirs.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_LikeToSeeEnteredContestPokemon
source: The POKéMON of a TRAINER who has\nentered a POKéMON CONTEST…\lThat, I would like to see.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AllowMeToExamineYourPokemon
source:
Er-hem! I see you've participated in
a POKéMON CONTEST!\pPlease! Allow me to examine how you
have raised your POKéMON.\pIt delights me no end to see POKéMON
raised by other TRAINERS.\pThe happy expressions of POKéMON
raised with proper care…\pThe kindly eyes of the TRAINER that
nurtured and raised the POKéMON…\pThe very thought fills my heart to
overwhelming with joy.\pOh! I do beg your pardon!
Forgive me for prattling on so!\pPlease! Allow me to examine how much
your POKéMON has grown!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_HowIsYourPokemonGrowing
source: How is your POKéMON growing?\nAllow me to examine it.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_HmHmISee
source: Hm, hm…\nI see…$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_GiveMonMorePokeblocks
source:
Hmmm… It's not bad, but it's not
good, either…\pYou, the TRAINER, must put more
effort into raising this POKéMON!\pFor instance, may I suggest that
you give it more {POKEBLOCK}S?$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_NoSpaceForReward
source: Oh, my…\pYour POKéMON is growing quite well,\nso you deserve a reward.\pUnfortunately, you have no space for\nthis in your BAG.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonMostImpressiveGiveItThis
source: Your {STR_VAR_1}, it is growing in\na most impressive manner!\lIt is one fine specimen!\pBut! If you were to give it this,\nit would grow even better! Indeed!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainRedScarf
source: Let a POKéMON hold that RED SCARF.\pEveryone will recognize the coolness\nof that POKéMON!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainBlueScarf
source: Let a POKéMON hold that BLUE SCARF.\pIts beauty will be accentuated much\nmore than now!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainPinkScarf
source: Let a POKéMON hold that PINK SCARF.\pIt will draw out the cuteness of\nthe POKéMON some more!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainGreenScarf
source: Let a POKéMON hold that GREEN SCARF.\pThat will enhance the\nsmartness of POKéMON!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainYellowScarf
source: Let a POKéMON hold that YELLOW SCARF.\pIt will bolster your POKéMON's\ntoughness so much more!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_NothingElseToGiveYou
source: I'm sorry, but I've nothing else to\ngive you! None at all!\pAfter all, you're blessed with the gift\nof raising POKéMON without resorting\lto any items!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ShowMePokemonThatLoveYou
source:
I love seeing POKéMON that love
their TRAINERS.\pPOKéMON are very sensitive to
the feelings of their TRAINERS.\pIf you treat your POKéMON with love
and care, they'll love you back.\pWhen your POKéMON grow to love you,
please come show me.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_PokemonAdoresYou
source: Your POKéMON really adores you.\pFor you, a most compassionate\nTRAINER, a gift from the FAN CLUB!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_TreatPokemonWithLove
source: POKéMON are very sensitive to\nthe feelings of their TRAINERS.\pIf you treat your POKéMON with love\nand care, they'll love you back.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_PokemonDontLikeFainting
source:
If you keep letting a POKéMON faint
in battle, it'll come to resent it.\pSoon, it will become less trusting
of the TRAINER.\pIn other words, it certainly won't
like you very much.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonEnjoyedProtein
source: Do POKéMON enjoy having items used\non them?\pMine acted really happy when I gave\nit some PROTEIN.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Skitty
source: SKITTY: Fffnyaaaah…$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Zigzagoon
source: ZIGZAGOON: Kyuuu…$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Azumarill
source: AZUMARILL: Marimari?$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CantMakeHeadsOrTails
source:
Umm… If this goes here, and that
goes over there…\pThen where does this thing go?
And what about that doohickey?\pAaargh! I can't make heads or tails
of this!$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
source:
Hm?
Hi, I'm DOCK.\pCAPT. STERN commissioned me to
design a ferry.\pOh! That there…
Are they DEVON GOODS?\pBut, hmm…
This won't do…\pCAPT. STERN went off somewhere.
He said he had some work to do.\pCould I get you to go find CAPT.
STERN and deliver that to him?$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldYouFindStern
source: DOCK: Where could CAPT. STERN have\ngone off to?\pCould you go find CAPT. STERN and\ndeliver that parcel to him?$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldUseAdviceFromVeteran
source: DOCK: Shipbuilding is an art.\pA lot of things can't be figured out\njust by calculating.\pI really could use advice from a veteran\nwho knows the seas…$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_BrineyJoinedUs
source: DOCK: Hi! MR. BRINEY's joined us to\nlend us his help.\pThanks to the veteran sailor, the\nferry is steadily coming together.$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_FerryIsReady
source:
DOCK: The ferry is finally ready!\pThe new S.S. TIDAL is truly a marvel
of technology!\pBut, I get the feeling that we can
make something even better.\pYou know, there's never an end to
technology's march.$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
source:
MR. BRINEY: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
It's been too long!\pAye, since I met you, this old sea dog's
been feeling frisky!\pSo I've decided to help DOCK make
a ferry.\pAye, after all, a ferry would be able
to carry a lot of people.\pBut, you know, that DOCK is really
something special.\pWith his knack for technology and
my experience, I'm sure that we can\lbuild one great ship, aye!$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_SeaIsLikeLivingThing
source:
The seasons, the weather, where
the moon sits in the sky…\pThese and other conditions make
the sea change its expression.\pThat's right!
The sea is like a living thing!$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_GetSeasickEasily
source: I get seasick real easily.\nSo I get to help out here instead.$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_ShipDesignMoreLikeBuilding
source: Designing a large ship is more like\nmaking a big building than putting\ltogether a transportation vehicle.$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_FloatsBecauseBuoyancy
source: Don't you think it's strange that\na ship made of heavy iron floats?\pIt floats because of a principle\ncalled buoyancy.$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_KurtIntro
source:
KURT: Hey there, {PLAYER}!\pThe guard up top took off when
I shouted at him.\pBut then I took a tumble down
the WELL.\pI slammed down hard on my back,
so I can't move.\pRats! If I were fit, my POKéMON
would've punished them…\pAh, it can't be helped.\p{PLAYER}, show them how gutsy
you are in my place!$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_KurtAfter
source: KURT: Way to go, {PLAYER}!\pTEAM ROCKET has taken off.\pMy back's better too.\nLet's get out of here.$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntM29Seen
source:
Darn! I was standing guard up
top when some old coot yelled\lat me.\pHe startled me so much that
I fell down here.\pI think I'll vent my anger by
taking it out on you!$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntM29Beaten
source: Arrgh! This is NOT my day!$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntM29After
source: Sure, we've been hacking the\ntails off SLOWPOKE and selling\lthem.\pEverything we do is for profit.\pThat's right! We're TEAM ROCKET,\nand we'll do anything for money!$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_ProtonSeen
source: What do you want?\pIf you interrupt our work,\ndon't expect any mercy!$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_ProtonBeaten
source: You did OK today,\nbut wait till next time!$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_ProtonAfter
source:
Yeah, TEAM ROCKET was broken up
three years ago.\pThe boss went into hiding.\pBut we continued our activities
underground!\pA small obstacle like you won't be
much of a problem for our mission.\pI advise you to be very afraid of
what is to come!$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntM2Seen
source: Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!\nQuit taking SLOWPOKETAILS?\pYou're nuts!\nIf we obeyed you, TEAM ROCKET's\lrep would be ruined!$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntM2Beaten
source: Hyuck…\nToo strong…$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntM2After
source: We need the money,\nbut selling SLOWPOKETAILS?\pIt's tough being a ROCKET GRUNT!$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntF1Seen
source: Stop taking TAILS?\pYeah, just try to defeat all\nof us!$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntF1Beaten
source: You rotten brat!$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntF1After
source: SLOWPOKETAILS grow back fast!\pWhat's wrong with selling them?$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_SlowpokeWithMail
source: A SLOWPOKE with its TAIL cut off…\pHuh? It has MAIL.\nRead it?$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_SlowpokeMail
source: {PLAYER} read the MAIL.\pBe good and look after the\nhouse with Grandpa and SLOWPOKE.\pLove, Dad$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_TaillessSlowpoke
source: A SLOWPOKE with its TAIL cut off…$

label: Snowswept_Cavern_Text_DroppedItem
source: The MACHAMP dropped an item...$

label: Snowswept_Text_Machamp_Cry
source: Mahh!!$

label: Snowswept_Text_Machamp_Plate
source: The MACHAMP seems to be holding\na PLATE in one of its hands.\pBattle it?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GymSign
source: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: JUAN\p“The GYM LEADER with the beauty\nof pure water!”$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CitySign
source: SOOTOPOLIS CITY\p“The mystical city where history\nslumbers.”$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoorIsClosed
source: The door is closed.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_PhysicallyFitLivingHere
source: Diving in the sea. Climbing up and\ndown stairs all the time…\pIf you live in this town, you end up\ngetting physically fit.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiantPokemonSuddenlyAppeared
source:
These giant POKéMON suddenly appeared
in the middle of the city!\pAnd, I've never seen them before!\pWhy are they smashing into each
other like that?\pWhy can't they be friends, those
POKéMON?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhatIsThatGreenPokemon
source: What? What? What?\nWhat is that green POKéMON?!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhereDidLegendariesGo
source: GROUDON and KYOGRE…\nWhere did they go?\pWill they cause droughts or downpours\nsomewhere else?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TwoPokemonArentAngry
source: I just get this sense somehow that\nthe two POKéMON aren't angry.\pI think… They probably can't control\ntheir own power…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_FlyingMonStoppedRampage
source: That flying POKéMON came down from\nthe sky and stopped the rampaging\lPOKéMON…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WonderWhatWorldIsLike
source: I… I've never been out of this city.\pI wonder what the world is like on\nthe other side of this round sky?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThisIsWicked
source: Wow!\nThis is wicked!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThatWasWicked
source: Wow!\nThat was wicked!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GoRedAndBlueMon
source: Go for it, red POKéMON!\nDon't back off, blue POKéMON!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoYouKnowMonNames
source: … … … … … …\pHi, do you know the names of those\nPOKéMON fighting over there?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GreenOneSettlesThings
source: I was wondering which one would win,\nthe red one or the blue one, but, oh no,\lit's the green one that settles things!\pTalk about a huge turn of events!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SeeingLegendWithOwnEyes
source:
There's an ancient legend that claims
the land and sea were shaped by\la colossal battle between POKéMON.\pWell, I'm seeing that happen with
my very own eyes!\pWhoa! I never expected to be
witness to something this huge!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SawLegendWithOwnEyes
source:
There's an ancient legend that claims
the land and sea were shaped by\la colossal battle between POKéMON.\pWell, I saw that happen with
my very own eyes!\pWhoa! I never expected to be
witness to something this huge!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_BigPokemonFighting
source: A big POKéMON is fighting with\nanother big POKéMON!\pPlease, someone make them stop!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_PrettyMonCameFromSky
source: A pretty POKéMON came down from\nthe sky…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisWillBeWrecked
source: Oh, no!\nSOOTOPOLIS CITY will get wrecked!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisDidntGetWrecked
source: SOOTOPOLIS CITY didn't get wrecked!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NoOrdinaryTourist
source: Hm!\nYou've come all the way to SOOTOPOLIS?\lYou're no ordinary tourist.\pBut I suppose that doesn't make you\nan extraordinary tourist, either.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CityRegainedCalm
source: The city has regained its calm…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginPleaseLeave
source: Who might you be?\pThis is the CAVE OF ORIGIN.\pThe spirits of POKéMON, becalmed at\nMT. PYRE, are said to be revived here.\pPlease leave.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_LeadSuperiorTrainerToCave
source:
A person with a strong will and
superior talent…\pA TRAINER who has knowledge and
experience of many kinds of POKéMON…\pIf such a person were to appear, I was
instructed by WALLACE to lead that\lTRAINER to this CAVE.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AwakenedPokemonClash
source: Oh, my…\pThe clash between the two awakened\nPOKéMON was quelled by the awakening\lof a third POKéMON…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginSleepsToo
source: This is the CAVE OF ORIGIN…\pWith the passing of the crisis,\nthe cave, too, shall sleep…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisSkyBeautiful
source:
SOOTOPOLIS sprang up as a town in
the crater of a volcano.\pIf you look up at the sky, the lip of
the crater is also visible.\lSo, all you see is the sky in a circle.\pBut that's what makes the sky above
SOOTOPOLIS the most beautiful.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiganticPokemonFight
source: When two POKéMON that gigantic\nare fighting that savagely, there's\lnot much that we can do.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_FearedWorstWhenPokemonFlewDown
source: When that third POKéMON flew down,\nI feared the worst.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NightSkyFavoriteScenery
source: A circle of a night sky framed by\nthe crater of a volcano…\pAnd in that ring, stars flicker and\nblink as if they were alive…\lIt's my favorite scenery.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WeatherWentWild
source:
The weather was clear this morning,
but…\pAll of a sudden, dark clouds brewed up,
rain started falling in sheets, and\lthere was thunder and lightning, too.\pThe weather just went completely
wild!\pIs all of this because of those
POKéMON?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_YouBroughtFlyingMon
source: Oh?\pIt was you who brought that flying\nPOKéMON here?\pWell, aren't you amazing!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GroudonPleaseStop
source: MAXIE: G… GROUDON…\nPlease! Stop what you're doing!\pI know the extent of your power now!\pIf you keep going, all HOENN, not just\nSOOTOPOLIS, will be utterly ruined!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AfterAllOurScheming
source:
MAXIE: So the super-ancient POKéMON
weren't only GROUDON and KYOGRE…\pAfter all our fruitless scheming and
frantic efforts, that one POKéMON's\lsimple action puts everything right\lagain as if nothing had happened…\pFu…
Fuhahaha…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_KyogreCalmDown
source:
ARCHIE: KYOGRE! What's wrong?!
Look over here! It's the RED ORB!\lCalm down! KYOGRE!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pIt's no good!
It's not responding at all!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TryingMeaninglessToPokemon
source:
ARCHIE: KYOGRE and GROUDON both
flew off to who knows where.\pThe weather in HOENN has returned
to its normal state…\pHaha…
Hahaha…\pMaybe what we were trying to do was
something small, even meaningless,\lto POKéMON…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
source:
STEVEN: Those POKéMON fighting…
GROUDON… And KYOGRE…\pThe two super-ancient POKéMON
were awakened from a long sleep…\pAnd now they are smashing each other
with their uncontrollable energy…\p…{PLAYER}{KUN}.\pYou being here now I'll take to mean
that you're prepared to become\linvolved in this crisis.\pWell, then, there's someone that
I'd like you to meet.\pCome with me, please.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoesThisMakeYourFearPokemon
source:
STEVEN: Listen, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pDoes seeing GROUDON and KYOGRE make
you think POKéMON are to be feared?\pBut that's not true.
POKéMON are really more…\p…Why am I asking you this?
You already know.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HereWereAreHelpWallace
source: STEVEN: Okay, here we are!\pInside here you'll find someone named\nWALLACE.\pI think you have what's needed to\nhelp him…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_KnowWhatsNeededToHelpHim
source: STEVEN: I think you have what's\nneeded to help him…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NeverBeenToSkyPillar
source: STEVEN: The SKY PILLAR…\pI've never been there.\nI wonder where it could be?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SoThatsRayquaza
source: STEVEN: So that's RAYQUAZA…\pIt's incredible how the two rampaging\nPOKéMON would flee from it in fear…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_MaxieArchieLeft
source: STEVEN: It looks like both MAXIE and\nARCHIE have gone away somewhere.\pPerhaps they've gone to MT. PYRE to\nreturn those ORBS…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HaventYouScaledSkyPillar
source:
WALLACE: Oh?
{PLAYER}{KUN}?\pHaven't you scaled the SKY PILLAR
yet?\pI'm sure that you can make it to
the top of the SKY PILLAR…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AquaMagmaDidntMeanHarm
source: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pThe leaders of TEAM MAGMA and AQUA,\nI don't think they meant harm.\pIt wouldn't hurt to hear what they\nhave to say for themselves.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThankYouForHelpAcceptThis
source:
WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…
My eyes didn't deceive me.\pThanks to your help, SOOTOPOLIS…
No, all of HOENN was saved.\pOn behalf of the people, I thank you.\pThis is a gift from me.
Please accept it.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ExplainWaterfallGoToGym
source:
That HIDDEN MACHINE contains
WATERFALL.\pIf you have the RAIN BADGE, a POKéMON
that has learned that HM move can\lforce its way up waterfalls.\pAnd where does one get the RAIN BADGE?
You know, don't you?\pThat's right! You have to beat
the SOOTOPOLIS GYM LEADER.\pWhen you're all set to go, step through
that door.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DazzledByMentor
source: WALLACE: I'm sure that you will be\ndazzled by my mentor's breathtakingly\lelegant battle style.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
source:
Yo! How's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pSOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER JUAN is
a master of WATER-type POKéMON.\pAnd, to get to JUAN, an icy floor
will hamper your progress…\pListen, I'm sorry, but that's all the
advice that I have for you.\pThe rest of the way, you have to
go for it yourself!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
source: Yow! You've beaten even JUAN, who\nwas supposedly the best in all HOENN!\pOkay! Check out your TRAINER CARD.\pIf you've gotten all the BADGES, you're\nset for the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
source:
Let me ask you.
Did you know?\lAh, I should not be so coy.\pIt was I who taught WALLACE everything
there is to know about POKéMON.\pOnce, I had given up my position as
the GYM LEADER.\pIn my place, I had entrusted WALLACE
with the GYM.\pHowever, a compelling reason arose for
me to make a comeback.\pAh, but enough chatter.
Let us begin our match, shall we?\pPlease, you shall bear witness to
our artistry.\pA grand illusion of water sculpted
by POKéMON and myself!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat
source:
Ahahaha, excellent!
Very well, you are the winner.\pFrom you, I sense the brilliant shine
of skill that will overcome all.\pHowever, compared with me or even
WALLACE, you are lacking in elegance.\pPerhaps I should make you a loan
of my outfit?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pHahaha, I merely jest!\pRather than my clothes, I shall reward
you with this, the RAIN BADGE!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ReceivedRainBadge
source: {PLAYER} received the RAIN BADGE\nfrom JUAN.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainRainBadgeTakeThis
source:
Having the RAIN BADGE shall assure you
the full obedience of all your POKéMON\lto your every command.\pThe RAIN BADGE also allows the use
of the HM move WATERFALL to scale\lwalls of cascading water.\pAnd, so that you never forget the
battle we shared, take this…$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainWaterPulse
source: The TECHNICAL MACHINE I handed you\ncontains WATER PULSE.\pIn use, it will occasionally confuse\nthe target with ultrasonic waves.\p… … … … … …$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_RegisteredJuan
source: Registered GYM LEADER JUAN\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostBattle
source:
The TRAINERS who have gathered all
the GYM BADGES of HOENN should make\lway to the ultimate destination.\pThe POKéMON LEAGUE.\pTravel to the easternmost reaches
of HOENN, to the island EVER GRANDE.\pThere, you shall find the POKéMON
LEAGUE.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GoGetFortreeBadge
source: There remains but one BADGE to\nobtain in HOENN.\pIf you wish to challenge the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you must obtain the last\lBADGE from the GYM in FORTREE.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatue
source: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM\pJUAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPreRematch
source:
JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its
usual state of serenity…\pBut our young typhoon has returned
to put us to the test again!\pWell, my friend, most certainly!\pI shall be delighted to dance with you
as often as you wish!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchDefeat
source: Ahahaha, you are the winner!\nYou have defeated me again!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostRematch
source:
JUAN: If I told you to become my
apprentice, you will refuse, I am sure.\pI would like to make a gift of my coat
to you.\pBut again, you will refuse.
I imagine that to be so.\pAnd that, my friend, is a certain sign
of nobility!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNeedTwoMons
source:
JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its
usual state of serenity…\pBut our young typhoon has returned
to put us to the test again!\pWell, my friend, most certainly!
I shall be delighted to dance with you…\pAh, no, no, no.
You have with you but one POKéMON.\pI wish that you would return with
two, perhaps more, POKéMON, please.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaIntro
source: I'll show you the sublime techniques\nI learned from our LEADER JUAN!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaDefeat
source: Please forgive me, JUAN…$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaPostBattle
source: Watch what happens if you crack all\nthe floor tiles.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyIntro
source: You came all the way here, but you won't\nget to see JUAN.\pNot if you lose to me, you won't!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyDefeat
source: You're strong!\nI was fooled by your cute looks!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyPostBattle
source: You might be good enough to avoid\nbeing wiped out in one hit by JUAN.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneIntro
source: The sight of JUAN conducting\na battle…\pThe very beauty of it compelled me to\nbecome a TRAINER.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneDefeat
source: You battled with more beauty than\nI could muster…$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphnePostBattle
source: The grace you bring to battle is\nfabulous.\pOh… I'm so fortunate to have found\nPOKéMON.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieIntro
source: I should teach you how harsh battles\ncan be.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieDefeat
source: Oh.\nYou're strong.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConniePostBattle
source: I'll tell you something good.\pIf you want to reach JUAN, you\nneed to walk on each floor tile once.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetIntro
source: The POKéMON GYM of the highest level\nin the HOENN region…\pThat's the SOOTOPOLIS GYM.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetDefeat
source: What a high level you are!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetPostBattle
source: Rather than being satisfied by being\nin a strong GYM, I imagine training in\lother places will make you stronger.\lBut above all, it looks more fun.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaIntro
source: I train my POKéMON together with\nJUAN.\pDon't think I'm a pushover.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaDefeat
source: I was beaten…$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaPostBattle
source: I think you have potential.\nWhy don't you stay and train with us?$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyIntro
source: A graceful glide across the ice while\ncrossing no lines…\pA TRAINER putting on that performance\nwould be elegantly beautiful!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyDefeat
source: Well, excuse me?!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyPostBattle
source: This is really obvious, but how strong\nyou are as a TRAINER has nothing to do\lwith how young or old you are.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyIntro
source: When I'm with my POKéMON, the time\nflies by before you can say, “Oops!”$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyDefeat
source: Oops!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyPostBattle
source: I wish I could forget about lost causes\nbefore I can manage an “Oops!”$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaIntro
source: I can battle with really rare POKéMON\nif you'd like.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaDefeat
source: Oh, there now! Did you have a good look\nat my POKéMON?$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaPostBattle
source: I came to this GYM because JUAN\npraised me for my darling POKéMON.\pOh, if only I'd met JUAN years ago\nwhen I was younger…$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaIntro
source: Giggle…\nYour grim look is so charming.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaDefeat
source: Oh, dear.\nI went much too easy on you.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaPostBattle
source: You couldn't lay a finger on JUAN,\nI'm sure. Giggle…$

label: SootopolisCity_House1_Text_DevelopedThisTM
source: For thirty years I've remained in\nSOOTOPOLIS honing my skills.\pI developed a shattering TM.\nI bequeath it to you!$

label: SootopolisCity_House1_Text_ExplainBrickBreak
source: TM31 contains BRICK BREAK! It's a move\nso horrible that I can't describe it.$

label: SootopolisCity_House1_Text_Kecleon
source: KECLEON: Puu puhyaah.$

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_DidYouKnowAboutMtPyreOrbs
source: MT. PYRE…\pAt its peak are two orbs placed side\nby side. Did you know?$

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_YesTwoOrbsSideBySide
source: Yes, two orbs side by side…\pThe sight of them together…\nIt is somehow soothing…$

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_OughtToVisitAndSee
source: Is that so?\nPerhaps you ought to visit and see…$

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_JuanHasManyFansDoYou
source: You're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?\pSOOTOPOLIS's JUAN has many fans.\nEven more than his student WALLACE!\pDo you have any?$

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_YouMustBePrettyStrong
source: Oh, then you must be pretty strong.$

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_LonesomeTryWorkingHarder
source: Oh, dear…\nThat's a little lonesome.\pTry working a little harder to get\na fan following.$

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_TrainerFanClubWasWild
source: Dedicated fans come over from even\noutside of HOENN.\pIt was really wild when I went to the\nTRAINER FAN CLUB in LILYCOVE.$

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_AncientTreasuresWaitingInSea
source:
Listen up, and I'll tell you something
good.\pThere's supposed to be an ancient
ruin in the sea around here.\pThere could be treasures just waiting
to be discovered down there.$

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_StrollUnderwaterWithPokemon
source: Ancient treasures…\pIt would be nice if they existed, but\neven if they didn't, it would be so\lbeautiful to take an underwater\lstroll with my POKéMON.$

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_Azumarill
source: AZUMARILL: Marurii.$

label: SootopolisCity_House5_Text_SootopolisMtPyreConnection
source: There appears to be some connection\nbetween SOOTOPOLIS and MT. PYRE.\pMy friends and I did some research on\nit at the lab where I used to work.$

label: SootopolisCity_House5_Text_BrotherUsedToStudySea
source: My big brother used to study the sea.$

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_FirstGuestInWhileTakeDoll
source: Hello! You're our first guest in\na good while.\pYou've brightened up my day, so I'll\ngive you a big WAILMER DOLL.$

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_TakeGoodCareOfIt
source: Take good care of it!$

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_IllHoldItForYou
source: Oh, you want it, but not right now?\nOkay, then I'll hold it for you.$

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_DontWantThisDoll
source: Are you sure?\nYou don't want this DOLL?$

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_LovePlushDolls
source: I love plush DOLLS!$

label: SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CityFromEruptedVolcano
source:
An underwater volcano erupted and
forced itself up from the depths.\pIts crater emerged from the sea and
became filled with rainwater.\pThat's how SOOTOPOLIS CITY came into
being.$

label: SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CaveMadeToKeepSomething
source: The cave that links SOOTOPOLIS and\nthe outside world…\pIt seems as if the cave was made to\nkeep something from getting out.\pOr am I just imagining things?$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigSeedot
source:
Do you know the POKéMON SEEDOT?
It's hardly ever seen in SOOTOPOLIS.\pAnyway, I love big SEEDOT.
The bigger the better.\pBut my younger brother, he says that
LOTAD is bigger.\pThat's silly.
SEEDOT has to be bigger than that!\pHuh? Do you have a SEEDOT with you?
P-p-please, show me!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_GoshMightBeBiggerThanLotad
source:
{STR_VAR_2}!
Oh, my gosh, this is a big one!\pIt might even beat the big LOTAD
my younger brother saw!\pThanks for showing me.
This is my thanks!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ReceivedPotion1
source: {PLAYER} received a POTION.$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BagCrammedFull1
source: Hunh?\nYour BAG is crammed full.$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_SeenBiggerSeedot
source: {STR_VAR_2}, is it?\pHmm… I've seen a bigger SEEDOT\nthan this one.$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ThatsNotSeedot
source: Oh, now this is quite something…\nBut it's not a SEEDOT!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_DontHaveBigSeedot
source: You don't have a big SEEDOT?\nThat's too bad…\pIf you get a big SEEDOT, please\ncome show me.$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BiggestSeedotInHistory
source: The biggest SEEDOT in history!\n{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3} giant!\pA SEEDOT bigger than a LOTAD\nalways wanted!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigLotad
source:
Do you know the POKéMON LOTAD?
It's rarely seen in SOOTOPOLIS.\pI love, I mean love, big LOTAD!\pMy big brother says that SEEDOT is
bigger.\pBut that's wrong! Everyone knows that
LOTAD is a lot bigger.\pHunh? Do you have a LOTAD?
P-p-please show me!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_WowMightBeBiggerThanSeedot
source:
{STR_VAR_2}!
Wow, that is big!\pIt might be even bigger than the huge
SEEDOT my big brother saw.\pThanks for showing me!
This is my thanks!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ReceivedPotion2
source: {PLAYER} received a POTION.$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BagCrammedFull2
source: Hunh?\nYour BAG is crammed full.$
