label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_SeenBiggerLotad
source: {STR_VAR_2}?\pHmm… I've seen a bigger LOTAD\nthan this one here.$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ThatsNotLotad
source: Well, isn't this something!\nBut it's no LOTAD!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_DontHaveBigLotad
source: Don't you have a big LOTAD?\nHow disappointing…\pIf you get a big LOTAD, please\ncome show me!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BiggestLotadInHistory
source: The biggest LOTAD in history!\n{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3} colossus!\pA LOTAD bigger than a SEEDOT\nalways wanted!$

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_PPUpIsGreat
source: PP UP is great!\pIt raises the POWER POINTS, the PP,\nof a POKéMON move.$

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_TooScaryOutside
source: What…\nWhat is happening?\pI really want to know, but it's too\nscary to go outside.$

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_FullRestoreItemOfDreams
source: Do you know FULL RESTORE?\pFull restoration of HP!\nEradication of all status problems!\pIt's truly an item of your dreams!$

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_DidSomethingAwaken
source: This weather…\nDid something awaken?$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_OnlyAmusementWatchingBattles
source: When I was young, I traveled the world\nas a POKéMON TRAINER.\pNow that I've become an old buzzard,\nmy only amusement is watching young\lTRAINERS battle.$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_DoorAppearsToBeLocked
source: The door appears to be locked.$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_ChallengeVisitingTrainer
source: A TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1}\nis visiting my home.\pWould you like to challenge\n{STR_VAR_1}?$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_YouWontBattle
source: You won't battle? I'm disappointed\nthat I can't see you battle…$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_KeepItTo3On3
source: Oh, good, good!\pBut my house isn't all that sturdy.\pCould I ask you to keep it down to\na 3-on-3 match?$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_SaveProgressBeforeBattle
source: Before you two battle, you should\nsave your progress.$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_HopeToSeeGoodMatch
source: I hope to see a good match!$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_StrVar1Tie
source: {STR_VAR_1}$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_B1F_Text_MatchEndedUpDraw
source: The match ended up a draw.$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_BrilliantStandoff
source: So, it became a standoff.\pIt was a brilliant match in which\nneither side conceded a step!$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_StrVar1Won
source: {STR_VAR_1}$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_ThatWasSuperlative
source: That was superlative!\pWhy, it was like seeing myself in\nmy youth again!$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_StrVar1Lost
source: {STR_VAR_1}$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_TooBadForYou
source: Ah, too bad for you!\pBut it was a good match.\nI hope you can win next time.$

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WallaceToughestInHoenn
source:
WALLACE is rumored to be the toughest
TRAINER in the whole HOENN region.\pThis town's GYM is led by the TRAINER
who taught WALLACE.\pBut the ELITE FOUR… They're said to be
even stronger than WALLACE's mentor.\pHow strong could they be?$

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryoneTakenRefuge
source: Everyone in town has taken refuge\nand won't come out of their homes.\pEven I would rather not venture\noutside.$

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AlwaysBeFriendsWithPokemon
source: Whenever, wherever, and whatever\nhappens, I will always be friends with\lPOKéMON.\pBecause it's fun to be with POKéMON!$

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ArentPokemonOurFriends
source: Aren't POKéMON our friends?\pWhy are they going wild this way?$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageChow_Seen
source: We stand guard in this tower.\pHere, we express our gratitude\nto honor all POKéMON.$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageChow_Beaten
source: Th-Thank you!$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageChow_AfterBattle
source: All living beings coexist\nthrough cooperation.\pWe must always be thankful\nfor this.$

label: SproutTower_Text_1F_Sage1
source: Only if you reach the top will\nyou obtain an HM.$

label: SproutTower_Text_1F_Sage2
source: SPROUT TOWER was built long ago\nas a place for POKéMON training.$

label: SproutTower_Text_1F_Granny
source: A BELLSPROUT over 100 feet\ntall…\pPeople say that it became the\ncenter pillar here.$

label: SproutTower_Text_1F_Teacher
source: See the pillar shaking?\pPeople are training upstairs.$

label: SproutTower_Text_1F_Statue
source: A POKéMON statue…\pIt looks very distinguished.$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageNico_Seen
source: However hard we battle,\nthe TOWER will stand strong.$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageNico_Beaten
source: I fought hard but I'm too weak.$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageNico_AfterBattle
source: The flexible pillar protects the\nTOWER, even from earthquakes.$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageEdmond_Seen
source: …Sway like leaves in the wind…$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageEdmond_Beaten
source: Oh, I'm weak!$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageEdmond_AfterBattle
source: I tried to copy BELLSPROUT's\ngentle movements for battle…\pBut I didn't train well enough.$

label: SproutTower_Text_2F_Statue
source: A POKéMON statue…\pIt looks very distinguished.$

label: SproutTower_Text_ElderLecturesRival
source:
ELDER: You are indeed skilled
as a trainer.\pAs promised, here is your HM.\pBut let me say this: You should
treat your POKéMON better.\pThe way you battle is far too
harsh.\pPOKéMON are not tools of war…$

label: SproutTower_Text_RivalOnlyCaresStrong
source:
…
…Humph!\pHe claims to be the ELDER but
he's weak.\pIt stands to reason.\pI'd never lose to fools who babble
about being nice to POKéMON.\pI only care about strong
POKéMON that can win.\pI really couldn't care less
about weak POKéMON.$

label: SproutTower_Text_RivalUsedEscapeRope
source: {RIVAL} used an ESCAPE ROPE!$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageLi_Seen
source:
So good of you to come here!\pSPROUT TOWER is a place of
training.\pPeople and POKéMON test their
bonds to build a bright future\ltogether.\pI am the final test.\pAllow me to check the ties
between your POKéMON and you!$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageLi_Beaten
source: Ah, excellent!$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageLi_TakeFlash
source: You and your POKéMON should\nhave no problem using this move.\pTake this FLASH HM.$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageLi_FlashExplain
source: FLASH illuminates even the\ndarkest of all places.\pBut to use it out of battle, you\nneed the BADGE from VIOLET's GYM.$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageLi_AfterBattle
source: I hope you learn and grow from\nyour journey.$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageJin_Seen
source: I train to find enlightenment\nin POKéMON!$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageJin_Beaten
source: My training is incomplete…$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageJin_AfterBattle
source: As POKéMON grow stronger,\nso does the trainer.\pNo, wait. As the trainer\ngrows stronger, so do the\lPOKéMON.$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageTroy_Seen
source: Let me see how much you trust\nyour POKéMON.$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageTroy_Beaten
source: Yes, your trust is real!$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageTroy_AfterBattle
source: It is not far to the ELDER.$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageNeal_Seen
source: The ELDER's HM lights even\npitch-black darkness.$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageNeal_Beaten
source: It is my head that is bright!$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageNeal_AfterBattle
source: Let there be light on your\njourney.$

label: SproutTower_Text_3F_Painting
source: It's a powerful painting of a\nBELLSPROUT.$

label: SSAnne_1F_Corridor_Text_LeStrongSilentType
source:
Bonjour!
I am le waiter on this ship!\pI will be happy to serve you
anything you please!\p… … …
Ah! Le strong silent type!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Corridor_Text_PassengersAreRestless
source: The passengers are restless from\nthis long voyage.\pYou might be challenged by the\nmore bored ones!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room1_Text_ImAGlobalPoliceAgent
source: Ssh…!\nI'm a GLOBAL POLICE agent.\pI'm on the trail of TEAM ROCKET.\nThey're up to nothing good!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_TylerIntro
source: I love POKéMON!\nDo you?$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_TylerDefeat
source: Wow! \nYou're great!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_TylerPostBattle
source: Listen, listen!\nLet me be your friend, okay?\pThen we can trade POKéMON and\ndo stuff.$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnIntro
source: I collected these POKéMON\nfrom all around the world!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnDefeat
source: Oh, no!\nI went around the world for these!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnPostBattle
source: You hurt my poor POKéMON!\pI demand that you heal them at a\nPOKéMON CENTER!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_CruisingAroundWorld
source: We are cruising around the world,\nmy children and I.$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room3_Text_CruiseIsElegantAndCozy
source: A world cruise is so elegant yet\ncozy!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room3_Text_AlwaysTravelWithWigglytuff
source: I always travel with WIGGLYTUFF.\nI never leave home without it.$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room3_Text_Wigglytuff
source: WIGGLYTUFF: Puup pupuu!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room4_Text_WaiterCherryPiePlease
source: Waiter, I would like a cherry pie,\nplease!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room4_Text_WaitressCherryPiePlease
source: Waitress, I would like a cherry\npie, please!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurIntro
source: You insolent pup!\nHow dare you barge in!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurDefeat
source: Humph! You rude child!\nYou have no sense of courtesy!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurPostBattle
source: I wish to be left alone!\nGet out!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_TakeAShortRest
source: You look tired. Would you like to\ntake a short rest?$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_GladEveryoneIsRefreshed
source: I'm glad to see that everyone is\nlooking refreshed and chipper.$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_SorryYouLookLikeMyBrother
source: Oh, I'm sorry for fussing over you.\nYou look like my little brother…$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_SorryYouLookLikeMySister
source: Oh, I'm sorry for fussing over you.\nYou look like my little sister…$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasIntro
source: I am but a solitary traveler…\pMy sole companions and friends are\nPOKéMON I caught on my journeys…$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasDefeat
source: My, my friends…$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasPostBattle
source: You should be nice to friends!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_ThisShipIsLuxuryLiner
source: This ship, she is a luxury liner for\nTRAINERS of the world!\pAt every port, we hold parties with\ninvited TRAINERS.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalIntro
source:
{RIVAL}: Bonjour!
{PLAYER}!\pImagine seeing you here!
{PLAYER}, were you really invited?\pSo how's your POKéDEX coming?\pI already caught 40 kinds, pal.
Different kinds are everywhere.\pCrawl around in grassy areas, and
look hard for them.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalDefeat
source: Humph!\pAt least you're raising your\nPOKéMON!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalVictory
source: {PLAYER}..！\nふなよい　してるのか！\pもっと　からだ\nきたえた　ほうが　いいぜ！$

label: SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalPostBattle
source:
{RIVAL}: I heard there was a CUT
master on board.\pBut he was just a seasick old man!\pCUT itself is really useful.
Yup, it'll be handy.\pYou should go see him, too.
Smell ya!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room1_Text_SleepingMonLookedLikeThis
source: I've journeyed far and wide, but in\nall my travels I've never seen\lany POKéMON sleep like this one!\pIt was something like this!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksIntro
source: Competing against the young keeps\nme youthful.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksDefeat
source: Good match!\nAh, I feel young again!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksPostBattle
source: Fifteen years ago, I would\nhave won!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DaleIntro
source: Check out what I fished up!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DaleDefeat
source: I'm all out!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DalePostBattle
source: Party?\pThe cruise ship's party should be\nover by now.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room3_Text_SeenMonsFerryPeople
source: Ah, yes, I have seen some POKéMON\nferry people across the water!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room3_Text_SomeTreesCanBeCutDown
source:
Small trees can be chopped down
using the move CUT.\pBut remember this!
CUT is an HM technique.\pOnce learned, it is not so easily
discarded.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarIntro
source: Which do you find more worthy,\na strong or a rare POKéMON?$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarDefeat
source: I must salute you!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarPostBattle
source: Personally, I prefer strong and\nrare POKéMON.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnIntro
source: I don't believe I saw you at the\nparty?$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnDefeat
source: Take it easy!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnPostBattle
source: Oh, I adore your strong POKéMON!\nOh, how I envy you for them!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room5_Text_HaveYouGoneToSafariZone
source: Have you gone to the SAFARI ZONE\nin FUCHSIA CITY?\pThere are many kinds of rare\nPOKéMON.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room5_Text_WeThinkSafariZoneIsAwesome
source: Me and my daddy think the SAFARI\nZONE is awesome!\lI wish we could go there again.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room6_Text_CaptainIsAwfullySick
source: The CAPTAIN said he's awfully sick.\nHe was all pale.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room6_Text_ManyPeopleGetSeasick
source: I hear many people get seasick.$

label: SSAnne_3F_Corridor_Text_CaptainTeachesCutToMons
source: Our CAPTAIN is a sword master.\nHe's awesome at using CUT.\pThey say he even teaches CUT\nto POKéMON!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipIntro
source: Matey, you're walking the plank if\nyou lose!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipDefeat
source: Argh!\nBeaten by a kid!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipPostBattle
source: When we're out at sea, jellyfish\nPOKéMON sometimes drift by.$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyIntro
source: Hello, stranger!\pI can't tell if you're from the seas\nor mountains, but stop and chat.\pAll my POKéMON are from the sea.$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyDefeat
source: Darn!\nI let that one get away!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyPostBattle
source: I was going to make you my\nassistant, too!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyIntro
source: Even us sailors have POKéMON, too!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyDefeat
source: Okay, you're not bad.$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyPostBattle
source: We caught all our POKéMON while\nwe were out at sea.$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanIntro
source: I like feisty kids like you!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanDefeat
source: Argh!\nLost it!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanPostBattle
source: Sea POKéMON live in deep water.\nYou'll need a ROD to fish them up!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardIntro
source: You know what they say about\nsailors and battling!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardDefeat
source: Right!\nGood battle, mate!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardPostBattle
source: Hahaha!\nWant to be a sailor, mate?$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanIntro
source: Come on, then!\nMy sailor's pride is at stake!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanDefeat
source: Your spirit sank me!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanPostBattle
source: Did you see the FISHING GURU in\nVERMILION CITY?$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room5_Text_MachokeHasStrengthToMoveRocks
source: My buddy MACHOKE is super strong!\pHe has enough STRENGTH to move\nbig rocks!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room5_Text_Machoke
source: MACHOKE: Gwoh! Goggoh!$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_CaptainIFeelSeasick
source: CAPTAIN: Ooargh…\nI feel hideous…\lUrrp! Seasick…$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_RubbedCaptainsBack
source: {PLAYER} rubbed the CAPTAIN's\nback!\pRub-rub…\nRub-rub…$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_ThankYouHaveHMForCut
source:
CAPTAIN: Whew! Thank you!
I'm feeling much better now.\pYou want to see my hidden CUT
technique?\pI could show you my prized CUT
technique if I weren't so ill…\pI know! You can have this!
This HIDDEN MACHINE!\pTeach CUT to your POKéMON, and
you can see it CUT anytime!$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_ObtainedHM01FromCaptain
source: {PLAYER} obtained HM01\nfrom the CAPTAIN!$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_ExplainCut
source: Using CUT, you can chop down\nsmall trees.\pWhy not try it with the trees\naround VERMILION CITY?$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_SSAnneWillSetSailSoon
source: CAPTAIN: …Whew!\pNow that I'm not sick anymore,\nI guess it's time.\pThe S.S. ANNE will set sail soon!\pFarewell, until our return to\nVERMILION CITY!$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForThis
source: Oh, no!\nYou have no room for this!$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_YuckShouldntHaveLooked
source: Yuck!\nShouldn't have looked!$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_HowToConquerSeasickness
source: How to Conquer Seasickness…\nThe CAPTAIN's reading this!$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_ShipDepartingSoon
source: The party's over.\nThe ship will be departing soon.$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_ScrubbingDecksHardWork
source: Whew!\nScrubbing decks is hard work!$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_FeelSeasick
source: Urf… I feel ill…\pI got seasick, so I stepped out to\nget some air…$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_EdmondIntro
source: Hey, matey!\pLet's do a little jig!$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_EdmondDefeat
source: You're impressive!$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_EdmondPostBattle
source: How many kinds of POKéMON do you\nthink there are in this big world?$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_TrevorIntro
source: Ahoy, there!\nAre you seasick?$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_TrevorDefeat
source: I was just careless!$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_TrevorPostBattle
source: My pa said there are 100 kinds of\nPOKéMON. I think there are more.$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_BusyOutOfTheWay
source: You, mon petit!\nWe're busy here!\lOut of the way!$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_SawOddBerryInTrash
source: I saw an odd BERRY in the trash.\nI wonder what that was?$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_SoBusyImDizzy
source: I'm so busy I'm getting dizzy!\nYou have to give me room here!$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_PeelSpudsEveryDay
source: Hum-de-hum-de-ho…\pI peel spuds every day!\nHum-hum…$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_HearAboutSnorlaxItsAGlutton
source: Did you hear about SNORLAX?\nIt's a glutton.\pNo other POKéMON eats and sleeps\nthe way SNORLAX can and does!$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_OnlyGetToPeelOnions
source: Snivel… Sniff…\pI only get to peel onions…\nSnivel…$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_IAmLeChefMainCourseIs
source: Er-hem!\nIndeed I am le CHEF!\pLe main course is$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_SalmonDuSalad
source: Salmon du Salad!\pLes guests may gripe it's fish\nagain, however!$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_EelsAuBarbecue
source: Eels au Barbecue!\pLes guests will mutiny, I fear.$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_PrimeBeefsteak
source: Prime Beefsteak!\pBut, have I enough fillets du\nbeef?$

label: SSAqua_1F_Text_Sailor1_ToVermilion
source: FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA is en route to\nVERMILION CITY.\pWe will make an announcement when\nwe arrive.$

label: SSAqua_1F_Text_Sailor1_ToOlivine
source: FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA is en route to\nOLIVINE CITY.\pWe will make an announcement when\nwe arrive.$

label: SSAqua_1F_Text_Sailor2_FirstTime
source: Here's your cabin.\pIf your POKéMON are hurt, take a\nnap in the bed.\pThat will heal them.$

label: SSAqua_1F_Text_Sailor3
source: The passengers are all trainers.\pThey're all itching to battle in\ntheir cabins.$

label: SSAqua_1F_Text_Grandpa
source: Whoa! Excuse me. I was in a hurry!\pMy granddaughter is missing!\pShe's just a wee girl. If you see\nher, please let me know!$

label: SSAqua_1F_Text_Sailor1_InOlivine
source: FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA has arrived in\nOLIVINE CITY.$

label: SSAqua_1F_Text_Sailor1_InVermilion
source: FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA has arrived in\nVERMILION CITY.$

label: SSAqua_1F_Text_SailorDoorArrived
source: We have arrived in VERMILION CITY.\nWould you like to disembark?$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_BarfCan
source: Yuck!\nShouldn't have looked!$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_FastShipOnDutySailor
source:
Hey, kid. Could I get you to
look for my buddy?\pHe's goofing off somewhere,
that lazy bum!\pI want to go find him, but I'm
on duty right now.$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_FastShipOnDutySailorRefused
source: Oh, gee…\pThe CAPTAIN will be furious…$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_FastShipOnDutySailorThanks
source: Thanks, kid! I chewed him out\ngood so he'll quit slacking off!$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_FastShipOnDutySailorSawGirl
source: A little girl?\pI may have seen her go by here.$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_FastShipOnDutySailorDirections
source: The dining room is up ahead.\pThe stairs at the end lead to\nthe CAPTAIN's cabin.$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorJeffSeen
source: Nothing beats a battle when\nI'm on my break.$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorJeffBeaten
source: Win or lose, my break's over!$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorJeffAfter
source: I guess I can't win if I don't\nget serious.$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_PicnickerDebraSeen
source: I'm so bored. Want to battle?$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_PicnickerDebraBeaten
source: Yow! You're too strong!$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_PicnickerDebraAfter
source: SAFFRON, CELADON… I hear there\nare many big cities in KANTO.$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_JugglerFritzSeen
source: Urrf… I'm seasick!$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_JugglerFritzBeaten
source: I can't move anymore…$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_JugglerFritzAfter
source: No more ships for me.\nNext time,\pI'm taking the MAGNET TRAIN.$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorGarrettSeen
source: This is where we sailors work!$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorGarrettBeaten
source: I lost on my home field…$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorGarrettAfter
source: We get different passengers\nfrom VERMILION CITY to\pOLIVINE CITY.$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_FisherJonahSeen
source: Even though we're out on the\nsea, I can't fish!\pThis is boring! Let's battle!$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_FisherJonahBeaten
source: I… I'm not bored anymore…$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_FisherJonahAfter
source: I plan to fish off\nVERMILION's pier.$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_BlackbeltWaiSeen
source: I'm building up my legs by\nbracing\pagainst the ship's rocking!$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_BlackbeltWaiBeaten
source: Rocked and rolled over!$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_BlackbeltWaiAfter
source: I couldn't find the KARATE KING\nin JOHTO.\pHe's supposed to be training in\na cave somewhere.$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorKennethSeen
source: I'm a sailor man!\pBut I'm training POKéMON, so I\ncan become the CHAMP!$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorKennethBeaten
source: My lack of training is obvious…$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorKennethAfter
source: Eight BADGES! They must prove\nthat you've beaten\pGYM LEADERS.\pNo wonder you're so good!$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_TeacherShirleySeen
source: Don't lay a finger on my\nstudents!$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_TeacherShirleyBeaten
source: Aaack!$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_TeacherShirleyAfter
source: We're on a field trip to the\nRUINS outside VIOLET.$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SchoolboyNateSeen
source: Do you know the RUINS OF ALPH?$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SchoolboyNateBeaten
source: Yaargh!$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SchoolboyNateAfter
source: Radios pick up strange signals\ninside the RUINS.$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SchoolboyRickySeen
source: There are some odd stone panels\nin the RUINS OF ALPH.$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SchoolboyRickyBeaten
source: I was done in!$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SchoolboyRickyAfter
source: I read that there are four of\nthose stone panels.$

label: SSAqua_CaptainsRoom_Text_GranddaughterCaptainPlayWithMe
source: CAPTAIN, play with me, please?\pI'm bored! I want to play more!$

label: SSAqua_CaptainsRoom_Text_GranddaughterHasToFindGrandpa
source: Hi! Will you play with me?\p…Oh!\pGrandpa's worried about me?\pI have to go!\pI have to go find Grandpa!$

label: SSAqua_CaptainsRoom_Text_CaptainExhausting
source: Whew! Thanks for coming along.\pKeeping that little girl amused\nwas exhausting.$

label: SSAqua_CaptainsRoom_Text_CaptainHowDoYouLike
source: How do you like S.S.AQUA's ride?\pShe practically skates across\nthe waves.$

label: SSAquaRooms_Text_TakeRestOnBed_PokecenterChallenge
source: Sorry, you are playing with\nthe POKéCENTER challenge!$

label: SSAquaRooms_Text_TakeRestOnBed
source: There's a bed…\nLet's take a rest.$

label: SSAqua_RoomNE_Text_HikerNolandSeen
source: Are you alone?\nThen let's battle!$

label: SSAqua_RoomNE_Text_HikerNolandBeaten
source: That's too much to handle!$

label: SSAqua_RoomNE_Text_HikerNolandAfterBattle
source: I wonder if there are any\nmountains worth climbing in KANTO?$

label: SSAqua_RoomNE_Text_PokemaniacEthanSeen
source: Do you know LILY?\nShe's a hot DJ in KANTO.$

label: SSAqua_RoomNE_Text_PokemaniacEthanBeaten
source: Gyaaaah!$

label: SSAqua_RoomNE_Text_PokemaniacEthanAfterBattle
source:
LILY's nice, but
MARY's the best!
I want to check
out JOHTO's radio
programs!$

label: SSAqua_RoomNNE_Text_CooltrainermSeanSeen
source: I'm going to KANTO\nto test my skills.$

label: SSAqua_RoomNNE_Text_CooltrainermSeanBeaten
source: I wanted to win!$

label: SSAqua_RoomNNE_Text_CooltrainermSeanAfterBattle
source: Trainers from JOHTO\ncan battle with KANTO\lGYM LEADERS.$

label: SSAqua_RoomNNE_Text_CooltrainerfCarolSeen
source: I'm training to\nbecome the CHAMP!$

label: SSAqua_RoomNNE_Text_CooltrainerfCarolBeaten
source: What's so different\nbetween us?$

label: SSAqua_RoomNNE_Text_CooltrainerfCarolAfterBattle
source: I'm going to beat\nyou someday!$

label: SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_SailorStanlySeen
source: Yeah, I'm a sailor, all right.\pI wasn't goofing off!\pThis cabin was vacant, so I\njust took a quick nap!\pAh, forget it! Let's battle!$

label: SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_SailorStanlyBeaten
source: Sorry! It's all my fault!$

label: SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_SailorStanlyAfterBattle
source: Being a sailor, I have to do\nphysical labor. It's exhausting!$

label: SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_GentlemanEdwardSeen
source: Oh, no. I've lost something\nthat's very important.$

label: SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_GentlemanEdwardBeaten
source: I… I can't find it…$

label: SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_GentlemanEdwardAfterBattle
source: I give up. You don't have to\nlook.\pJust forget about it!$

label: SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_BurglarCoreySeen
source: Yeehaw! Lucky!$

label: SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_BurglarCoreyBeaten
source: How unlucky! I lost!$

label: SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_BurglarCoreyAfterBattle
source: I found a pretty coin here.\pSomeone must have lost it…$

label: SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_PokefanmColinSeen
source: Hey, kid! Want to battle\nwith me?$

label: SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_PokefanmColinBeaten
source: You're strong!$

label: SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_PokefanmColinAfter
source: You're traveling all alone?\nIsn't your mom worried?$

label: SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_TwinsMegandpeg1Seen
source: You think I'm a baby?\nThat's not fair!$

label: SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_TwinsMegandpeg1Beaten
source: Oh! We lost!$

label: SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_TwinsMegandpeg1After
source: Baby is a rude name to call\nus girls!$

label: SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_TwinsMegandpeg2Seen
source: I'm not a baby!\nThat's not nice to say to a lady!$

label: SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_TwinsMegandpeg2Beaten
source: Oh! We lost!$

label: SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_TwinsMegandpeg2After
source: Sometimes, kids are smarter\nthan grown-ups!$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSE_Text_CantFindGranddaughter
source:
Oh, hello…\pI still can't find my
granddaughter.\pIf she's on the ship,
that's OK.\pShe's an energetic child,
so she may be bugging someone\lI'm worried…$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSE_Text_EntertainedGranddaughter
source: {PLAYER}, was it?\nI heard you entertained my\lgranddaughter.\pI want to thank you for that.$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSE_Text_GrandpaHaveThis
source: I know! I'd like you\nto have this!$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSE_Text_GrandpaTravelling
source: We're traveling around\nthe world.$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSE_Text_GranddaughterWasPlaying
source: Grandpa, here I am!\nI was playing with\lthe CAPTAIN and this person!$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSE_Text_GranddaughterHadFun
source: I had lots of fun playing!$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSW_Text_FirebreatherLyleSeen
source: I'm going to KANTO to put\non fire-breathing shows!$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSW_Text_FirebreatherLyleBeaten
source: Fizzle… The flame's tiny…$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSW_Text_FirebreatherLyleAfterBattle
source: I guess fire is weak on the sea.\nIt doesn't matter? Really?$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSW_Text_BugCatcherKenSeen
source: I'm visiting my grandma to\ncatch me some bugs!$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSW_Text_BugCatcherKenBeaten
source: Ooh, wow. You're tough!$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSW_Text_BugCatcherKenAfterBattle
source: You can find lots of POKéMON\nin the trees of JOHTO!$

label: SSAqua_RoomSW_Text_BeautyCassieSeen
source: I'm trying to forget my woes.\nLet's battle!$

label: SSAqua_RoomSW_Text_BeautyCassieBeaten
source: My heart weeps…$

label: SSAqua_RoomSW_Text_BeautyCassieAfterBattle
source: A voyage is best for getting over\na broken heart.\pBut a FAST SHIP trip is too short\nfor grieving.$

label: SSAqua_RoomSW_Text_GuitaristClydeSeen
source: I'm going to audition my songs\nat GOLDENROD's RADIO STATION.$

label: SSAqua_RoomSW_Text_GuitaristClydeBeaten
source: Yowza! Total distortion!$

label: SSAqua_RoomSW_Text_GuitaristClydeAfterBattleMobile
source: I was going to make my debut at\nthe BATTLE TOWER…\pI should go back to VERMILION and\nredo my training…$

label: SSAqua_RoomSW_Text_GuitaristClydeAfterBattle
source: Speaking of the RADIO STATION,\nwhat's this week's lucky number?$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
source:
SCOTT: Well, hi, hi!
{PLAYER}{KUN}, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pSomething's come up, so I have to
disembark, but am I glad to see you!\pCongratulations, LEAGUE CHAMPION!\pThere's a place I'd like to invite
someone like you.\pIt's the…
BATTLE FRONTIER!\pWhat's the place like?
You'll understand when you see it!\pI've spoken with the ship's CAPTAIN
about this.\pThe next time you take a ferry,
you should be able to sail to\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.\pOkay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll be waiting for you
at the BATTLE FRONTIER!$

label: SSTidal_Text_FastCurrentsHopeYouEnjoyVoyage
source: This ferry is built to plow through\nfast-running currents.\pWe hope you enjoy your voyage with us.\nFeel free to explore the ship.$

label: SSTidal_Text_HopeYouEnjoyVoyage
source: We hope you enjoy your voyage on\nour ferry.$

label: SSTidal_Text_MadeLandInSlateport
source: We have made land in SLATEPORT CITY.\nThank you for sailing with us.$

label: SSTidal_Text_MadeLandInLilycove
source: We have made land in LILYCOVE CITY.\nThank you for sailing with us.$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_CanRestInCabin2
source:
It'll be some time before we make land,
I reckon.\pYou can rest up in your cabin if you'd
like. Your cabin's No. 2.\pThe bed in there is soft and plushy.
I can attest to how comfy it is!$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_WeveArrived
source: We've arrived!$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_VisitOtherCabins
source: Go visit other cabins.\nTRAINERS bored of the boat trip will\lbe itching to battle.$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_EnjoyYourCruise
source: Enjoy your cruise!$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_HorizonSpreadsBeyondPorthole
source: The horizon spreads beyond\nthe porthole.$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_BrineyWelcomeAboard
source:
MR. BRINEY: Welcome aboard, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pThey made me honorary captain of
the S.S. TIDAL!\pYou can call me CAPTAIN BRINEY now!\pYou know, I retired once before,
but when I saw this majestic ship…\pLet me just say, it stirred my sleeping
soul as a sailor!$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Peeko
source: PEEKO: Pihyo pihyohyo…$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin1
source: Cabin 1$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin2
source: Cabin 2$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin3
source: Cabin 3$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin4
source: Cabin 4$

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipIntro
source: Arrrgh! I'm fed up and dog-tired of\ncleaning this huge place!\pLet's have a quick battle!$

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipDefeat
source: Little bro, I lost!$

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipPostBattle
source: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS!\pThe old one dumps the detergent,\nand the young one does the scrubbing!$

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardIntro
source: This is the bottom of the ship's hull.\nThere's plenty of room.\lIt'll be alright for a POKéMON battle.$

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardDefeat
source: Big bro, I lost!$

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardPostBattle
source: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS!\pThe old one dumps the detergent,\nand the young one does the scrubbing!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_TakeRestOnBed
source: There's a bed…\nLet's take a rest.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonIntro
source: I often sail to LILYCOVE CITY.\pI enjoy attending CONTESTS,\nyou see.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonDefeat
source: That was an enjoyable match!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonPostBattle
source: I get so excited imagining what kinds\nof POKéMON I'll get to see in the next\lCONTEST. The anticipation of it thrills!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_MicahIntro
source: Are your friends strong?$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_MicahDefeat
source: Your friends are, indeed, strong.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_MicahPostBattle
source: Friends need not be human.\nFor me, POKéMON are treasured friends!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasIntro
source: Child…\nDid you knock on the door?$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasDefeat
source: A loss is to be accepted without haste\nor panic.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasPostBattle
source: To be never ruffled in any situation is\nthe GENTLEMAN's code of conduct.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_JedIntro
source: JED: I feel a little shy about this, but…\nWe'll show you our lovey-dovey power!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_JedDefeat
source: JED: Sigh…$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_JedPostBattle
source: JED: It's the first time that our lovey-\ndovey power couldn't prevail!\lYou must be an awesome TRAINER!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_JedNotEnoughMons
source: JED: You only have one POKéMON?\nIsn't that just too lonesome?$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaIntro
source: LEA: I feel a little silly, but…\nWe'll show you our lovey-dovey power!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaDefeat
source: LEA: Oh, boo!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaPostBattle
source: LEA: I can't believe it!\nOur lovey-dovey power failed…\lYou must be an awesome TRAINER!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaNotEnoughMons
source: LEA: I wanted to battle…\nBut you don't even have two POKéMON…$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_GarretIntro
source: Ah, you've come just in time.\pI'm bored, you see.\nYou may entertain me.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_GarretDefeat
source: …That will do.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_GarretPostBattle
source: Perhaps I shall get Father to acquire\na yacht for me.\lA yacht for me and POKéMON!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiIntro
source: Oh, you're such an adorable TRAINER.\nWould you like to have tea?\lOr would you rather battle?$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiDefeat
source: I see.\nYou're the active sort.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiPostBattle
source: A world cruise on a luxury liner has its\ncharms, I must say…\pBut, I will admit there is an appealing\nside to touring HOENN by ferry.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_NotSuspiciousTakeThis
source: Uh… Hi! I… I'm not acting suspicious!\nUh… You can have this! For free!\pIt… Honestly, I didn't SNATCH it from\nsomeone! I'd never do such a thing!\lIt's clean! You can use it!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ExplainSnatch
source: SNATCH steals the beneficial effects\nof certain moves before they can be\lused by a foe or ally.$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_HelpScaryPokemon
source:
LOSTELLE: Whimper… Sniff…
Oh! Please, help!\pA scary POKéMON appeared there
a little while ago.\pIt kept scaring.
It made LOSTELLE scared.\pI'm too scared to move!
But I want to go home…$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_HereItComesAgain
source: Oh! Here it comes again!\nNo! Go away! It's scaring me!\pWaaaaaaah!\nI want my daddy!$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_ThankYouHaveThis
source: Ohh! That was so scary!\nThank you!\pLOSTELLE came to pick some\nBERRIES.\pYou can have this!$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_LetsGoHome
source: What's your name?\pLOSTELLE's scared, so can I go\nwith you to my daddy's house?\pOkay!\nLet's go home!$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_BerryPouchIsFull
source: Your BERRY POUCH is full.\nI guess you don't want this.$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_WelcomeToBerryForest
source: Welcome to the BERRY FOREST\pBe friendly and share BERRIES with\nothers and POKéMON.$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_BewareWildBerryLovingMons
source: Beware of wild, BERRY-loving\nPOKéMON!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiIntro
source: The salty tang of the sea…\nIt tickles my heart.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiDefeat
source: …Sniff, sniff…\nSomething smells unpleasant…$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiPostBattle
source: Perhaps that reek is your sweaty\nPOKéMON's body odor…$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletIntro
source: Where are you off to in such\na hurry?$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletDefeat
source: You're raising some wonderful\nPOKéMON.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletPostBattle
source: If you keep going this way, you'll\neventually reach BERRY FOREST.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraIntro
source: My mommy said that I can't swim\nwithout my float ring.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraDefeat
source: Waaah!\nWaaah!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraPostBattle
source: This year, I'm going to finally\nlearn how to swim!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AlexisIntro
source: Yay, yay!\nPOKéMON!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AlexisDefeat
source: What happens now?$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AlexisPostBattle
source: Did I just win?\nOr did I lose?$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaIntro
source: Oh, no, don't come here!\nPlease, stay away from me!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaDefeat
source: Okay, you've won!\nNow will you please go away?$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaPostBattle
source: A POKéMON bit through my \nswimsuit.\pI can't get out of the water!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyIntro
source: JOY: We'll teach you what our\nfavorite POKéMON is!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyDefeat
source: JOY: Ohh…\nMEG!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyPostBattle
source: JOY: Wasn't that fun?\nI hope we can battle again!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyNotEnoughMons
source: JOY: I really want to battle with\nMEG.\pOne POKéMON isn't enough.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegIntro
source: MEG: We'll show you our favorite\nPOKéMON.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegDefeat
source: MEG: Ohh…\nJOY!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegPostBattle
source: MEG: JOY, wasn't that fun?$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegNotEnoughMons
source: MEG: I want to battle together\nwith JOY.\pOne POKéMON isn't enough.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_BerryForestAhead
source: BERRY FOREST AHEAD$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_BondBridgeSign
source: BOND BRIDGE\nPlease be quiet when crossing.\pBERRY FOREST AHEAD$

label: ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_ProspectingForGold
source:
Hey, there!
How's it going?\pWhat am I doing here, you ask?
Why, I'm prospecting for gold!\pWhen I strike it rich, I'm buying
a house in KANTO.$

label: ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_StruckGoldThisIsForYou
source:
Hey, there! How's it going?
Did you hear? I've struck gold!\pYou remembered that I was
prospecting, didn't you?\pYou can't begin to imagine just
how happy I am.\pSo, I'll show you!
This is for you!$

label: ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_ThatsANugget
source: That's a NUGGET!\pI can't give you any nuggets of\nwisdom, so that'll have to do!$

label: ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_WhoopsBagCrammedFull
source: Whoops, your BAG is crammed full!\nI'll give this to you later.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_IslandSign
source: THREE ISLAND\nKin Island of Family Bonding$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_IslandBelongsToUs
source: Hyahoo!\pFrom this day on, this island\nbelongs to us!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_GoBackToKanto
source: We don't need you people bringing\nyour noise and trouble here!\pWe're asking you to go back to\nKANTO!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_BossIsOnHisWay
source: Hey, go cry somewhere else.\nOur boss is on his way.\pWhen he gets here, we'll give you\na k-rad motorbike show you won't\lsoon forget!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_GetOffIslandNow
source: W-what!? Not on your life!\nGet off the island now!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_WhosGonnaMakeMe
source: Who's gonna make me?$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_AreYouBossGoBackToKanto
source: Are you the boss?\nGo back to KANTO right now!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_JustGotHerePal
source: Hah?\pI just got here, pal.\pWhat's with the hostile attitude?\nIt's mighty cold of you!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_FollowersRaisingHavoc
source: Your gang of followers have been\nraising havoc on their bikes.\pDo you have any idea how much\ntrouble they've caused us on the\lisland?$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_OughtToBeThankingUs
source:
No, man, I don't get it at all.\pLook at this place.
What do you do for entertainment?\pYou ought to be thanking us for
livening up this sleepy village.\pBut hey, if you insist, you can try
making us leave.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_YouCowardsToughInPack
source: Grr… You cowards…\nSo tough in a pack…$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_WannaMakeSomethingOfYourStaring
source: You, what are you staring at?\nDon't you know it's not polite?\pYou wanna make something of it\nor what?$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_ThatsSmart
source: That's smart.\nKeep your nose out of this.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker1Intro
source: Heh, I like your guts.\nYou'll be losing money to me, but…$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker1Defeat
source: Wha…\nWhat is this kid?!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker1PostBattle
source: Aww, man…\nDon't you dare laugh!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker2Intro
source: Aren't you from KANTO?\nYou should be on our side!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker2Defeat
source: Stop fooling around!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker2PostBattle
source: What's the matter with you,\ngetting all hot like that?\pTotally uncool, man!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker3Intro
source: We invited the boss out here,\nbut you had to mess it up!\pYou embarrassed us, man!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker3PostBattle
source: Boss, I'm telling you, you've gotta\ndo something about this kid!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_PaxtonIntro
source:
I've been watching you, and I'd say
you've done enough.\pWhat are you, their friend or
something?\pThen I guess you'll be battling me
in their place.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_PaxtonDefeat
source: All right, enough!\nWe'll leave like you wanted!\pWe'll be happy to see the last of\nthis boring island!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_PaxtonPostBattle
source: Humph! Yeah, go right on hanging\naround with these hayseeds!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_ThankYouOhYourMonGotHurt
source: Thank you! Those goons were\nnothing but bad trouble.\pOh, look, your POKéMON got hurt\non my account.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_GivenFullRestore
source: {PLAYER} was given\na FULL RESTORE.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_OhYourBagIsFull
source: Oh?\nYour BAG is full.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_YouveGotImpressiveMons
source: You've got seriously impressive\nPOKéMON with you.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_LostelleWentOffTowardsBondBridge
source:
It'd be fantastic if someone as
strong as you lived here.\pI hope you'll at least stay here
a while.\p…I beg your pardon?
You're looking for LOSTELLE?\pLOSTELLE went off towards BOND
BRIDGE a while ago.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_WouldntWantToSeeBikersHereAgain
source: THREE ISLAND is actually the most\npopulous of the islands here.\pStill, it could be less sleepy.\pBut I wouldn't want to see goons\nlike those BIKERS here again.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_WhenDodouEvolvesGoingToPlayGame
source: I'm going to train my DODUO in the\nBERRY FOREST.\pWhen it evolves, I'm going to play\na game on TWO ISLAND.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Doduo
source: DODUO: Gigiih!$

label: ThreeIsland_House1_Text_YoureAlwaysSoCool
source: LOSTELLE: Hi, {PLAYER}!\nYou're always so cool!\pI'll make lunch for you, too, one\nday, {PLAYER}.$

label: ThreeIsland_House1_Text_RareRocksGemsDisplayed
source: Rare rocks and gems are displayed.$

label: ThreeIsland_House2_Text_CantMakeThisSpoonBend
source:
Urrrrrrrrgggghhhh…
Kwaaaaah!\p…It's useless! I can't make this
spoon bend with my mind.\pMaybe I really don't have any
psychic powers.$

label: ThreeIsland_House2_Text_IAdmireSabrina
source:
You know about a girl GYM LEADER
in SAFFRON CITY?\pShe uses PSYCHIC-type POKéMON,
right?\pI admire her, I really do.\pI've heard that she's one cool
customer and beautiful, too.$

label: ThreeIsland_House3_Text_WantedToLiveSomewhereQuiet
source: I bought this house because I\nwanted to live somewhere quiet.\pToday, I think I'll go out fishing.$

label: ThreeIsland_House4_Text_GhostsInBerryForest
source: You must never, ever go out to\nthe BERRY FOREST alone.\pWhy?\nThere are ghosts there.$

label: ThreeIsland_House4_Text_PapaKeepsLyingToMe
source: Papa keeps lying to me, and won't\nlet me go out and play!$

label: ThreeIsland_House5_Text_ImNotLostelle
source:
Me?
I'm not LOSTELLE.\pShe's probably gone to the
BERRY FOREST, I think.\pShe picks BERRIES there for making
lunch.$

label: ThreeIsland_House5_Text_IllGoPlayWithLostelle
source: I think I'll go play with LOSTELLE\ntoday.$

label: ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_TrueThatCeldadonDeptStoreBigger
source: Is it true?\pCELADON DEPT. STORE is several\ntimes bigger than this shop?$

label: ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_PeopleHealWithBerriesFromForest
source: I sometimes buy medicine here.\pBut a lot of people heal POKéMON\nwith BERRIES from BERRY FOREST.\pAfter all, BERRIES are free and\nthey never run out.$

label: ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_BikersWereAboutToTrashMart
source: Those BIKERS were about to trash\nthis POKéMON MART.\pAm I glad they decided to leave!$

label: ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCNetworkCanLinkWithKanto
source: Hey, did you hear the news?\pThe PC network here can now link\nwith PCs in KANTO.\pI don't know how that came about,\nbut it's fantastic!$

label: ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ImpossibleToSurfBetweenIslands
source: It's impossible to SURF between the\nislands around these parts.\pThe tides are too fast and\ntreacherous.$

label: ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AlwaysBerriesInBerryForest
source: Let's crush BERRIES!\n…That'd be wasting BERRIES?\pYou can always find some BERRIES\non the ground in BERRY FOREST.$

label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_WereKantoRiderFederation
source: We're the KANTO RIDER FEDERATION!\nVroom! Vavavavooom! Vroom!\pMy bike's wimpy, so I have to\nmake exhaust noises myself!$

label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_ForkOverMoney
source: Hey, hey, lady!\nFork over some spending money!$

label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_IllCallThePolice
source: Aiyeeh!\pWh-who are you?!\nI… I'll call the police!$

label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_ThankGoodnessBikersGone
source: Those BIKERS…\nAre they gone?\pOh, thank goodness!\nThey certainly had me terrified!$

label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_EverythingTurnedOutForBest
source: Those BIKERS ran off, and\nLOSTELLE was found safe.\pEverything turned out for the best!$

label: TinTower_1F_Sage1_Text
source:
According to legend…
When the souls of POKéMON and humans\pcommune, from the heavens descends a
POKéMON of rainbow colors…\pCould it mean the legendary POKéMON
are testing us humans?$

label: TinTower_1F_Sage2_Text
source:
When the BRASS TOWER burned down,
three nameless POKéMON were said\lto have perished. It was tragic.\pHowever…\pA rainbow-colored POKéMON…
In other words…\pHO-OH descended from the sky and
gave new life to the three POKéMON.\pThey are…
SUICUNE, ENTEI and RAIKOU.\pThat is what they say.$

label: TinTower_1F_Sage3_Text
source: The two TOWERS are said to have been\nbuilt to foster friendship and\phope between POKéMON and people.\nThat was 700 years ago, but the ideal\pstill remains important today.$

label: TinTower_1F_Sage4_Text1
source: HO-OH appears to have descended\nupon this, the TIN TOWER!$

label: TinTower_1F_Sage4_Text2
source: The legendary POKéMON are said\nto embody three powers…\pThe lightning that struck the TOWER.\nThe fire that burned the TOWER.\pAnd the rain that put out the fire…$

label: TinTower_1F_Sage6_Text2
source:
Of the legendary POKéMON, SUICUNE
is said to be the closest to HO-OH.\pI hear there may also be a link to
POKéMON known as UNOWN.\pThe POKéMON UNOWN must be sharing a
cooperative bond with SUICUNE.$

label: TinTower_1F_EusineHoOh_Text
source:
I knew it.\pI knew you'd get to see the POKéMON
of rainbow colors, <PLAYER>.\pIt happened just as I envisioned.
My research isn't bad, I might say.\pI'm going to keep studying POKéMON
to become a famous POKéMANIAC!$

label: TinTower_1F_EusineSuicune_Text
source:
EUSINE: Awesome! Too awesome, even!
I've never seen a battle that great.\pThat was truly inspiring to see.
SUICUNE was tough, but you were even\pmore incredible, <PLAYER>.
I heard SUICUNE's mystic power\psummons a rainbow-colored POKéMON.
Maybe, just maybe, what went on today\pwill cause that POKéMON to appear.
I'm going to study the legends more.\pThanks for showing me that fantastic
battle.\pLater, <PLAYER>!$

label: TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Kimono_AfterNotCaught
source: You have not only made HO-OH\nappear, but you have also defeated\lit...\pThere is nothing more for us to\nsay. Take care of yourself in your\ljourney...$

label: TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Kimono_AfterCaught
source: You have not only made HO-OH\nappear, but you have also caught\lit...\pThere is nothing more for us to\nsay. Take care of yourself in your\ljourney...$

label: TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Zuki_Before
source: ZUKI: Go, face HO-OH. $

label: TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Naoko_Before
source: NAOKO: Go, face HO-OH. $

label: TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Miki_Before
source: MIKI: Go, face HO-OH. $

label: TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Sayo_Before
source: SAYO: Go, face HO-OH. $

label: TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Kuni_Before
source: KUNI: Go, face HO-OH. $

label: TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Kimono_Opening
source:
KIMONO GIRL: That's right.
This is where we welcome HO-OH.\pWhen the dance we practiced many
days becomes one with the sound of the\pCLEAR BELL we entrusted to you, then
HO-OH shall come down from the great\larch of the sky once again. $

label: TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Kimono_Closing1
source:
That is indeed HO-OH...
The guardian of the sky from\pancient times... \pSo many have tried again and again,
only to fail...\p{PLAYER}, your heart in complete
harmony with the CLEAR BELL has finally\pallowed it to appear...
{PLAYER}, don't you see?\pHO-OH... It must have been waiting for
someone like you all this time.\pWouldn't you agree? $

label: TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Kimono_After
source: You have done a great job.\nSay hello to PROF.ELM for us.$

label: TohjoFalls_GiovanniRoom_Text_RadioObject
source: A radio...\nThe battery is dead...$

label: TohjoFalls_GiovanniRoom_Text_Radio
source: RADIO: ... ...\nAhem, we are TEAM ROCKET!\lAfter three years of preparation,\lwe have risen again from the ashes!\lGIOVANNI! Can you hear us?\lWe did it!\lWhere is our boss?\lIs he listening?$

label: TohjoFalls_GiovanniRoom_Text_GiovanniIntro
source:
GIOVANNI: ...\pI don't know why you have come
here.\pAnyway, I have to warn you that
this is not a place for kids like\lyou.\pYou have a certain look.
It reminds me of the kid who stood\lin front of me three years ago...\pYou have the same eyes...\p...\pI'm on my way to GOLDENROD CITY
to answer the call and join my team.\lAre you going to get in my way?$

label: TohjoFalls_GiovanniRoom_Text_GiovanniBeforeBattle
source: My old associates need me...\nWe will not repeat the failure of\lthree years ago!$

label: TohjoFalls_GiovanniRoom_Text_GiovanniDefeat
source: What in the world are you?$

label: TohjoFalls_GiovanniRoom_Text_GiovanniAfter
source:
GIOVANNI: How is this possible...?
The past three years have been a\lwaste...?\pHow can a kid like you manage to
destroy my dream once again?\pThe precious dream of TEAM ROCKET
has become little more than an\lillusion...$

label: BattleTowerOutsideYoungsterText
source: Wow, the TRAINER HILL is huge!\pThere must be many kinds of\nPOKéMON in there!$

label: BattleTowerOutsideBeautyText
source: In the BATTLE TENTS, you can\nuse only three POKéMON.\pIt's so hard to decide which\nthree should go into battle…$

label: BattleTowerOutsideSailorText
source: Hehehe, I snuck out from work.\pI can't bail out until I've won!\pI have to win it all. That I must!$

label: BattleTowerOutsideSignText
source: {UP_ARROW} TRAINER HILL ENTRANCE\p“Scale the heights, you hot-blooded\nTRAINERS!”\p{RIGHT_ARROW} BATTLE TENTS.$

label: BattleTower_Battle_Tent_Text_Factory
source: BATTLE TENT: FACTORY\n“Find it! The ultimate POKéMON!”$

label: BattleTower_Battle_Tent_Text_Palace
source: BATTLE TENT: PALACE\n“Feast Your Eyes on Battles!”$

label: BattleTower_Battle_Tent_Text_Arena
source: BATTLE TENT: ARENA\n“May the Greatest Teams Gather!”$

label: BattleTowerOutsideText_Closed
source: The TRAINER HILL is currently\nclosed for repairs.$

label: TrainerHill_Courtyard_ExchangeServiceCorner_EventScript_OldWTMan_Text
source: Hi! If you are looking for the\nWONDERTRADE, they're now located in\levery POKéMON CENTER. Have fun!$

label: TrainerHill_Courtyard_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_WelcomePleaseChoosePrize
source: Hello, this is the EXCHANGE SERVICE\nCORNER.\pWe exchange the Battle Points you\nhave collected for lovely prizes.\pPlease choose a prize from this list.$

label: TrainerHill_Courtyard_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_WishIHadAllDolls
source: Oh, they're so nice!\nI wish I had them!\lCute cushions!\lBig plush DOLLS!\lLittle plush DOLLS!\lI wish I had them all!$

label: TrainerHill_Courtyard_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_GetYouAnythingYouWant
source: Leave it to your mommy!\pIf it's anything you want, I'll go\nthrough anything to get it, honey!$

label: TrainerHill_Courtyard_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ItemsWillGetMonTougher
source: If I can get hold of the items here,\nmy POKéMON will get tougher.\pYou bet they will!\nNo question about it!$

label: TrainerHill_Courtyard_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_GoGetYourOwnDoll
source:
Hah?
What are you gawking at?\pI don't like you staring at my plush
doll like that.\pIf you want it, go get one yourself!
Isn't that right, SMOOCHUM?$

label: TrainerHill_Courtyard_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_MoreBattlePointsForRecord
source: Did you know?\pIf you stretch your record at any of\nthe BATTLE facilities, they start\lgiving you more and more Battle Points.$

label: TrainerHill_Elevator_hns_Text_ReturnToReception
source: Would you like to return to\nthe reception counter?$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_StillGettingReady
source: This is the TRAINER HILL where\nyou may enjoy tag battles with many\lTRAINERS.\pUnfortunately, we're still getting\nthings ready. Please come back later!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WelcomeToTrainerHill
source: Welcome!\pThis is the TRAINER HILL where\nyou may enjoy tag battles with many\lTRAINERS!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_SaveGameBeforeEnter
source: Is this your first visit here?\pBefore you enter, please save\nyour game.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersUpToFloorX
source: Let's see…\nThe TRAINERS here now are…\pUp to floor no. {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersInEveryRoom
source: Let's see…\nThe TRAINERS here now are…\pThere appear to be TRAINERS gathered\nin every room.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_LikeToChallengeTrainers
source: Would you like to challenge the\nwaiting TRAINERS?$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TimeProgessGetSetGo
source: I will time your progress.\nBest of luck!\pOn your marks…\pGet set…\pGo!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_PleaseVisitUsAgain
source: Please do visit us again!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TooBadTremendousEffort
source: That was too bad.\pI think you put in a tremendous\neffort in your battling.\pPlease come back and try again!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_HopeYouGiveItYourBest
source: I hope you give it your best.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_MovedReceptionHereForSwitch
source: When the TRAINERS switch places,\nthe movement can be hectic.\pTo avoid the stampede, we moved\nthe reception counter here.\pI'm sorry for the inconvenience.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ThankYouForPlaying
source: Thank you for playing!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ExplainTrainerHill
source:
Here at the TRAINER HILL, we conduct
an event called the Time Attack.\pIt is a race that measures how long
you take to reach our owner on\lthe rooftop from this counter.\pThe fastest times are posted on
the Time Board--try competing with\lyour friends.\pIn TRAINER battles along the way,
neither Exp. Points nor money will\lbe awarded.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_NeedAtLeastTwoPokemon
source: Oh, I'm sorry, but you appear to have\nonly one POKéMON with you.\pYou will need at least two POKéMON\nto enter this event.$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
source:
Hm! Hm!\pYou finally came!
Yes, you have arrived!\pWait! Don't say it!
I know why you came all the way\lhere by yourself!\pYou wanted to see me, the owner
of the TRAINER HILL, because…\pYou want to form a tag team with me!
Wa-hoo!\p…Uh?
That's not it?\pAnyway, I watched you on your way up.
Marvelous battling! Bravo, indeed!$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_HaveTheMostMarvelousGift
source: For a marvelous someone like you,\nI have the most marvelous gift!$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_FullUpBeBackLaterForThis
source: Oh, no, full up with things!\nYou'll be back later for this!$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_GotHereMarvelouslyQuickly
source:
Oh, hold on here! Did you possibly get
here marvelously quickly?\pHow splendid! You needn't have
hurried so to see me!\pThat is so delightful. I'll have the Time
Board at the reception updated!$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouWerentVeryQuick
source: But, oh…\nYou weren't very quick getting here.$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_ArriveZippierNextTime
source: Perhaps it would please me more if you\narrived zippier next time.\pThen, I should be pleased to form\na tag team with you!\pUntil we meet again, amigo!$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_BuiltTrainerHillToFindPartner
source: I had the TRAINER HILL built for but\none reason and one only!\pTo find the most suitable partner\nwith whom I may form a tag team!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ChallengeTime
source: {STR_VAR_1} min. {STR_VAR_2}.{STR_VAR_3} sec.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WhatSortOfTrainersAreAhead
source: Who knows what sort of TRAINERS\nand POKéMON combos are ahead?\pAll I know is that I'll knock aside\nanyone that stands in my way!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_CantWaitToTestTheWaters
source: I heard tough TRAINERS come to this\nTRAINER HILL from all over.\pI can't wait to test the waters!\pI'll knock aside anyone that stands\nin my way!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_FriendsTryingToReachTimeBoardTop
source: Do you see the Time Board over there?\pMy friends and I are trying to see who\ncan reach the top in the least time.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_DoYouKnowWhenTheyOpen
source: Do you know when they're opening\nthis place up?\pI'm waiting here to be the first\nchallenger ever!$

label: TrainerHill_Elevator_Text_ReturnToReception
source: Would you like to return to\nthe reception counter?$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_HereToGetMoney
source: I'm here to make some cash!\nWhy? Because every time you reach\lthe top, you get a money reward!\pI wonder when they'll finally open.\nI can't wait!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_Money
source:
Every time you reach the top,
you earn some money.\pI heard you can win up to 1.000.000¥
if you finish within ten minutes!\pBut if it takes longer, the reward
will be reduced…$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_StillGettingReady
source: This is the TRAINER HILL where\nyou may enjoy tag battles with many\lTRAINERS.\pUnfortunately, we're still getting\nthings ready. Please come back later!$

source: Let's see…\nThe TRAINERS here now are…\pUp to floor no. {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_TrainersInEveryRoom
source: Let's see…\nThe TRAINERS here now are…\pThere appear to be TRAINERS gathered\nin every room.$

source: Would you like to challenge the\nwaiting TRAINERS?$

source: I will time your progress.\nBest of luck!\pOn your marks…\pGet set…\pGo!$

source: Please do visit us again!$

source: I hope you give it your best.$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_WelcomeToTrainerTower
source: Hello!\pWelcome to TRAINER TOWER where\nTRAINERS gather from all over!$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_TrainersUpToFloorNum
source: TRAINERS from all over the world\ngather here to battle.\pLet me see…\pRight now, there are TRAINERS only\nup to Floor {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_TrainersUpEighthFloor
source: TRAINERS are awaiting your\nchallenge up to the eighth floor.$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_LikeToChallengeTrainers
source: Would you like to challenge the\nwaiting TRAINERS?$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_StartClockGetSetGo
source: Okay, I'll get the clock started,\nso give it everything you have.\pOn your marks…\pGet set…\pGo!$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_PleaseVisitUsAgain
source: Please do visit us again!$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_TooBadComeBackTryAgain
source: That was too bad.\pI think you put in a tremendous\neffort in your battling.\pPlease come back and try again!$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_GiveItYourBest
source: I hope you give it your best.$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_MoveCounterHereWhenTrainersSwitch
source: When the TRAINERS switch places,\nthe movement can be hectic.\pTo avoid the stampede, we moved\nthe reception counter here.\pI'm sorry for the inconvenience.$

label: TrainerTower_Roof_Text_ImOwnerBattledPerfectly
source: Hello…\pI am the owner of this TOWER…\pHow the sky soars above this\nrooftop…\pThe caress of the winds up here…\pIt's all so perfect…\pThe way you battled…\nIt, too, was perfection…$

label: TrainerTower_Roof_Text_ThisIsForYou
source: This is for you…$

label: TrainerTower_Roof_Text_DoneItInRecordTime
source:
Oh!
Stupendous!\pIt's marvelous how you've come up
here so quickly.\pThe fact is, you've done it in
record time…\pI'll have your record posted at
the reception counter.$

label: TrainerTower_Roof_Text_TookSweetTimeGettingHere
source: You seem to have taken your sweet\ntime getting here…$

label: TrainerTower_Roof_Text_IdLikeToSeeBetterTime
source: What I would like to see is a\nbetter time out of you…\pI'm counting on you.\pUntil then, farewell…$

label: TrainerTower_Text_XMinYZSec
source: {STR_VAR_1} min. {STR_VAR_2}.{STR_VAR_3} sec.$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_HereAreTheResults
source: せいせきひょうです$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_NeedTwoMonsForDouble
source: This is a two-on-two battle.\pYou may not battle unless you have\nat least two POKéMON.$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_ExplainTrainerTower
source:
Here at TRAINER TOWER, there is an
event called TIME ATTACK.\pYou will be timed on how quickly
you can get from the reception\lcounter to the OWNER on the roof.\pThe best times will be recorded on
the Time Board.\pTry competing with friends to see
who can beat it the fastest.\pYou will not earn any EXP. Points
or money by beating TRAINERS here.$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_ThanksForCompeting
source: Thank you for competing!$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_WonderWhatKindsOfTrainers
source: I'm here to see how good I am.\pI wonder what kinds of TRAINERS\nare waiting for me?\pIt's nerve-racking!$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_StairsTougherThanAnyBattle
source: Gasp, gasp…\nGasp…\pNever mind battling! These stairs…\nThey're tougher than any battle…$

label: Text_UltimateMoveThatMon
source:
I perfected the ultimate move of
its type…\pBut will no one take it for
future use?\p…Hm? Hmmm!\pY-you…
Th-that {STR_VAR_1}…$

label: Text_JustMistaken
source: …No…\nI was just mistaken.$

label: Text_AllowMeToTeachMonUltimateMove
source:
Oh! This is the one!
This is the POKéMON!\pThis {STR_VAR_1} is worthy of
learning my ultimate move!\pWill you allow it?\pWill you allow your {STR_VAR_1} to
learn my {STR_VAR_2}?$

label: Text_YouRejectIt
source: Gaah! You reject it?\nNo, I won't be dissuaded!$

label: Text_LetMeConferUltimateMove
source: You will allow it?\pThen, let me confer my ultimate\n{STR_VAR_2} on your {STR_VAR_1}.\pGgggrah-awooo!$

label: Text_TaughtMove
source: Gasp, gasp, gasp…\pI didn't think I could teach that\nmove while I still lived…$

label: Text_MakeBestUseOfMove
source: I implore you to make the best\nuse of that move and gain power!$

label: Text_PassedOnEverythingIKnow
source: Gasp, gasp, gasp…\pI have no regrets now.\nI've passed on everything I know.\pNow I can live out my life knowing\nmy work is done.$

label: Text_FeelRejuvenated
source: After I passed on my knowledge to\nyou, I felt so much relief.\pIn fact, I feel rejuvenated,\nas if I were younger again!$

label: TwoIsland_Text_IslandSign
source: TWO ISLAND\nBoon Island for Two$

label: TwoIsland_Text_JoyfulGameCornerSign
source: Skip & Chomp!\nJoyful GAME CORNER$

label: TwoIsland_Text_DangerFastCurrent
source: DANGER! FAST CURRENT!\nFishing and surfing prohibited!$

label: TwoIsland_Text_WelcomeToShopMerchandiseLimited
source: Oh!\nHello, welcome to my shop!\pWe've only opened up recently.\pOur merchandise is limited, but I\nhope we can serve your needs.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_AddedMerchandiseForLostelle
source:
I can't tell you how grateful I am
for your rescue of LOSTELLE.\pThanks to your feat, the people of
THREE ISLAND have changed their\lattitudes about KANTO people.\pAnd, I'm from KANTO, you see.\pThe people of THREE ISLAND
helped me add to my merchandise.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_HopeYouGiveItYourBest
source: Hi! I'm giving it my best here.\nI hope you do too, {PLAYER}.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_BringingItemsFromDistantLands
source:
Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!
Welcome!\pI've started bringing in items from
distant lands.\pI've got some rare items in, too.
Please have a look!$

label: TwoIsland_Text_FellowMovedFromCeladonCity
source:
That fellow there, he moved here
from CELADON CITY.\pHe started up a shop with his
younger brother.\pYou have to wonder if he knew what
he was getting into.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_ShopkeepersBrotherWorksGameCorner
source: The shopkeeper's brother took\na job at the GAME CORNER.\pHe's trying to pull together money\nso they can buy more merchandise.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_BrunoCameToIslandWhileBack
source:
Listen, listen.
Did you know?\pA famous TRAINER came to the
ISLAND a little while back.\pHe's one of the ELITE FOUR.
His name is BRUNO.\pHe went away disappointed when he
found out that they were all sold\lout of Rage Candybars.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_BuyRareItemsHere
source: The discerning TRAINER knows to\nbuy rare items here!$

label: TwoIsland_Text_OldWomanLivesOutOnCape
source: There's an old woman who lives in\na cottage out on the cape.\pShe gives the eye to POKéMON.\nIt's a bit unnerving.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_HaveYouTriedJumpingGame
source:
Boing! Boing!
Have you tried the jumping game?\pThe POKéMON you can enter…
Boing!\pSome go boing!\pAnd some go boooooooing!\pDid you know that?
Boing!$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_TeachMonMoveForMushroom
source:
I'm the POKéMON MOVE MANIAC.\pI know every single move that
POKéMON learn growing up.\pI'm also a mushroom maniac.\pBring me two TINYMUSHROOMS,
or one BIG MUSHROOM.\pIf you do that for me, I'll teach
a move to one POKéMON.$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_WantMeToTeachMove
source: Sniff, sniff…\nHm! You smell of MUSHROOMS!\pDo you want me to teach a move\nto a POKéMON of yours?$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_TutorWhichMon
source: Which POKéMON needs tutoring?$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_TeachWhichMove
source: Which move should I teach?$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_NoMoveICanTeachThatMon
source: Sorry…\pIt doesn't appear as if I have a\nmove I can teach that POKéMON.$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_IllNeedMushroomOrTwo
source: Then, I'll need a MUSHROOM or two.\nWhat are you going to give me?$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_HandedOverTwoTinyMushrooms
source: {PLAYER} handed over two\nTINYMUSHROOMS in exchange.$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_HandedOverOneBigMushroom
source: {PLAYER} handed over one\nBIG MUSHROOM in exchange.$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_NeedMushroomOrTwoToLearnMove
source: If your POKéMON need to learn a\nmove, I need a MUSHROOM or two.$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_CantTeachAnEgg
source: Hunh? There isn't a single move\nthat I can teach an EGG.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_WhereHasLostelleGottenTo
source: Now, where's LOSTELLE gotten to\ntoday?\pShe always brings me lunch every\nday right about now…$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PleaseHelpFindLostelle
source:
Hm? You, there!
Are you a friend of LOSTELLE's?\pHave you seen LOSTELLE around?
I don't know where she might be.\lShe should've been here long ago.\pLOSTELLE's a cutie - she got my
looks - so what if someone…\pWhat if something's happened to
my LOSTELLE?!\pPlease, help me find her!
Please go search THREE ISLAND!$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_IsThisOnlyThreeIsland
source:
Hah? What is this GAME CORNER?
How much sadder can this get?\pThose clowns…\pThey said they'd be waiting on the
island, so where are they?\pHey, you! Is this the only THREE
ISLAND around here?$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_ThisIsTwoIslandMoveIt
source: Try waking up before you crawl out\nof bed, you punk.\pThis is TWO ISLAND!\pMove it! Get your filthy motorbike\nout of my place!$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_TheseIslandsAreConfusing
source: Huh…\nOh, oh, gotcha.\pTch…\nThese islands are confusing…$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PunkScuffedUpMyFloor
source: Would you look at that?\nThat punk scuffed up my floor.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PleaseGoToThreeIsland
source:
Hey, but listen! I'm begging you,
you have to go to THREE ISLAND.\pIf anything were to happen to my
LOSTELLE…\pMy place is the house with the red
roof on THREE ISLAND.\pShe may just show up late here,
so I can't run off anywhere.\pThat's why I have to get you to do
me this big favor.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_NotRunningAnyGamesToday
source: I'm sorry.\nWe're not running any games today.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_GetGamesGoingSoon
source: We'll get the games going soon\nfor you!$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_YouRescuedLostelle
source: So you rescued LOSTELLE?\nHow can I thank you?\pLOSTELLE, darling, forgive me!\pDaddy didn't know you were scared\nand in trouble!$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_LostelleItsOkayDaddy
source: LOSTELLE: It's okay, Daddy.\nI got to be friends with {PLAYER}!$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_ThisIsForMe
source:
Oh, what's that?
You're saying that this is for me?\pHow did you know that I love rare
rocks and gems?\pYou sure know how to make a guy
happy.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_HandedMeteoriteToLostellesDaddy
source: {PLAYER} handed the METEORITE\nto LOSTELLE's daddy.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_OhThisIsFromBill
source: Oh, I see, this is from BILL!\nYou have to thank him for me!\pYou know, you've been fantastic.\nI want you to have this.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_ReceivedMoonStoneFromLostellesDaddy
source: {PLAYER} received a MOON STONE\nfrom LOSTELLE's daddy.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_NotGoingToFitInBag
