POKéMON GYMS everywhere.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookFourthPage
source:
Fourth page…\pThe ultimate goal for all POKéMON
TRAINERS is simple.\pIt is to defeat the top eight
POKéMON GYM LEADERS.\pDo so to earn the right to face…\pThe ELITE FOUR of the POKéMON
LEAGUE!$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_TurnThePage
source: Turn the page?$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_HeyDontLookAtMyNotes
source: GIRL: Hey!\nDon't look at my notes!$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_BlackboardListsStatusProblems
source: The blackboard lists POKéMON\nSTATUS problems during battles.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ReadWhichTopic
source: Which topic do you want to read?$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainSleep
source:
A POKéMON can't attack if it's
asleep.\pPOKéMON will stay asleep even
after battles.\pUse AWAKENING to awaken one
from sleep.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainBurn
source: A burn reduces ATTACK power.\nIt also causes ongoing HP loss.\pA burn remains after a battle.\nUse BURN HEAL to cure a burn.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainPoison
source: When poisoned, a POKéMON's health\nsteadily drops.\pPoison lingers after battles.\nUse an ANTIDOTE to cure poison!$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainFreeze
source:
A frozen POKéMON becomes
helplessly immobile.\pIt stays frozen even after the
battle ends.\pUse ICE HEAL to thaw out the
suffering POKéMON.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainParalysis
source: Paralysis reduces SPEED and may\nprevent the POKéMON from moving.\pParalysis remains after battles.\nUse PARLYZ HEAL for treatment.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_FriendsItchingToBattle
source: I came here with some friends to\ncatch us some BUG POKéMON!\pThey're all itching to get into\nsome POKéMON battles!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_RickIntro
source: Hey! You have POKéMON!\nCome on!\lLet's battle 'em!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_RickDefeat
source: No!\nCATERPIE can't hack it!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_RickPostBattle
source: Ssh! You'll scare the bugs away.\nAnother time, okay?$

label: ViridianForest_Text_DougIntro
source: Yo!\nYou can't jam out if you're a\lPOKéMON TRAINER!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_DougDefeat
source: Huh?\nI ran out of POKéMON!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_DougPostBattle
source: That totally stinks! I'm going to\ncatch some stronger ones!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_SammyIntro
source: Hey, wait up!\nWhat's the hurry? Why the rush?$

label: ViridianForest_Text_SammyDefeat
source: I give!\nYou're good at this!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_SammyPostBattle
source: Sometimes, you can find stuff on\nthe ground.\pI'm looking for the stuff I\ndropped. Can you help me?$

label: ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyIntro
source: I might be little, but I won't like\nit if you go easy on me!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyDefeat
source: Oh, boo.\nNothing went right.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyPostBattle
source: I lost some of my allowance…$

label: ViridianForest_Text_CharlieIntro
source: Did you know that POKéMON evolve?$

label: ViridianForest_Text_CharlieDefeat
source: Oh!\nI lost!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_CharliePostBattle
source: BUG POKéMON evolve quickly.\nThey're a lot of fun!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_RanOutOfPokeBalls
source: I was throwing POKé BALLS to\ncatch POKéMON, and I ran out.\pThat's why you can never have too\nmany POKé BALLS.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_AvoidGrassyAreasWhenWeak
source: TRAINER TIPS\pIf your POKéMON are weak and you\nwant to avoid battles, stay away\lfrom grassy areas!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_UseAntidoteForPoison
source: For poison, use ANTIDOTE!\nGet it at POKéMON MARTS!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_ContactOakViaPCToRatePokedex
source: TRAINER TIPS\pContact PROF. OAK via a PC to\nget your POKéDEX evaluated!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_CantCatchOwnedMons
source: TRAINER TIPS\pYou can't catch a POKéMON that\nbelongs to someone else.\pThrow POKé BALLS only at wild\nPOKéMON to catch them!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_WeakenMonsBeforeCapture
source: TRAINER TIPS\pWeaken POKéMON before attempting\ncapture!\pWhen healthy, they may escape!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_LeavingViridianForest
source: LEAVING VIRIDIAN FOREST\nPEWTER CITY AHEAD$

label: ViridianForest_Text_Bugsy
source: BUGSY: I came to KANTO to look for\nBUG-TYPE POKéMON, so I can become\la stronger BUG-TYPE POKéMON\lTRAINER!\pIf you're ready for another match,\nI'll be at the DOJO in SAFFRON!$

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Kimono_AfterNotCaught
source: You have not only made LUGIA\nappear, but you have also defeated\lit...\pThere is nothing more for us to\nsay. Take care of yourself in your\ljourney...$

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Kimono_AfterCaught
source: You have not only made LUGIA\nappear, but you have also caught\lit...\pThere is nothing more for us to\nsay. Take care of yourself in your\ljourney...$

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Zuki_Before
source: ZUKI: Go, face LUGIA. $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Naoko_Before
source: NAOKO: Go, face LUGIA. $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Miki_Before
source: MIKI: Go, face LUGIA. $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Sayo_Before
source: SAYO: Go, face LUGIA. $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Kuni_Before
source: KUNI: Go, face LUGIA. $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Kimono_Opening
source: KIMONO GIRL: That's right.\nThis is where we welcome LUGIA.\pWhen the dance we practiced many\ndays becomes one with the sound of the\lTidal Bell we entrusted to you, then\lLUGIA shall come out from deep within\lthe waterfall basin once again. $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Kimono_Closing1
source:
That is indeed LUGIA...
The guardian of these islands from\lancient times... \pSo many have tried again and again,
only to fail...\p{PLAYER}, your heart in complete
harmony with the Tidal Bell has finally\lallowed it to appear...
{PLAYER}, don't you see?\pLUGIA... It must have been waiting for
someone like you all this time.\pWouldn't you agree? $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Kimono_After
source: KIMONO GIRL: You've proven yourself\ntoday, {PLAYER}.$

label: gText_AbnormalWeatherEnded_Rain
source: The massive downpour appears to\nhave stopped…$

label: gText_AbnormalWeatherEnded_Sun
source: The intense sunshine appears to\nhave subsided…$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge0
source: Um, I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.\nSnivel… This tension is getting to me…$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge1
source: I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!\nHere we come!$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge2
source: I'm the no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice of {STR_VAR_1}!\nAccept my challenge!$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge3
source: Um… I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice…\nDo you think someone like me can win?$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge4
source: I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!\nI'll let you challenge me!$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge5
source: I'm horribly busy, but I also happen\nto be {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge6
source: I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.\nGlad to meet you!$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge7
source: I serve as {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.\nMay I begin?$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge8
source: Eek! I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!\nI'll do my best!$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge9
source: Yeehaw! I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!\nPut 'em up!$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge10
source: I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s 1,000th apprentice!\nActually, I'm no. {STR_VAR_2}! Here goes!$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge11
source: Yeah, I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!\nLet's get rockin' and a-rollin'!$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge12
source: Yippee-yahoo! I'm what you call\n{STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge13
source: Cough! I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.\nGood to meet you! Cough!$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge14
source: This is nerve-racking…\nI'm the no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice of {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge15
source: I am {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice,\nand that's no lie.$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach0
source:
Are you… {PLAYER}?
Oh! Sniff…sob…\pOh! S-sorry…
I'm so nervous, I can't help crying…\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}, and I really look up
to you, {PLAYER}.\pI… I had this dream of one day meeting
you and asking you about POKéMON.\pPlease, please, {PLAYER}!
Please teach me about POKéMON!$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching0
source: Oh… B-but…\nSnivel… Waaaaaaah!\pPlease!\nI'm begging you, please!$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode0
source:
Oh, really? You will?
Awesome! Wicked! Awoooh!\pOh… I'm sorry…
I'm so happy, I'm crying…\pUm… Then please tell me!
It's about the BATTLE TOWER.\pWhich would be better for me: Level 50
or the Open Level?$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks0
source:
{STR_VAR_1}?
Waaaaah!\pOh! I'm so sorry!
You've made me happy by choosing\lthe level for me, and it's made me cry…\pSnivel…
Thank you so much!\lPlease talk with me again!$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach1
source:
Wowee! You're {PLAYER}, aren't you?
You're awesomely strong, aren't you?\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}!
I just became a TRAINER!\pPlease, {PLAYER}!
Can you be my teacher and tell me\llots about being a TRAINER?$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching1
source: Aww, why?\nOh, please? Pretty please?\lPlease be my teacher, please!$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode1
source: Yay! Great!\pThe first thing I wanted to ask you is\nabout the BATTLE TOWER!\pThe Level 50 and Open Level Rooms…\nWhich would be perfect for me?$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks1
source: {STR_VAR_1}, huh? That's true!\nI'll do my best there!\pIf we meet here again, please teach\nme something else, teacher!$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach2
source:
Um… Are you {PLAYER}?
My name is {STR_VAR_1}.\pI want to become a POKéMON TRAINER,
but I don't know what to do…\pSo I thought maybe I could ask you for
advice because you're so famous.\p{PLAYER}, could you give me advice?$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching2
source: Oh, but…\pI sincerely want to become a POKéMON\nTRAINER!\pPlease, can you answer my questions?$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode2
source:
Thank you!
Here's my first question right away!\pThe BATTLE TOWER has two levels,
Level 50 and Open Level, right?\pWhich level do you think is more
suitable for me?$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks2
source: Oh, the {STR_VAR_1} challenge?\nUnderstood!\pIf I have another question, I'll come\nback here for your advice!$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach3
source:
Oh? Huh? You're…
No, that can't be true.\pThere isn't any way that someone
like me could meet {PLAYER}.\p…You really are {PLAYER}?
I can't believe I'm talking to you!\pWhen something this good happens,
only terrible things will happen to me\lnow, I just know it…\p…I'm sorry…
I'm… {STR_VAR_1}…\pThere isn't anything special about
me that I can be proud of…\pI shouldn't even say anything about
myself because you'll forget…\pI had this dream that if I ever met
you, {PLAYER}, that maybe I could ask\lyou for advice as a TRAINER.\pBut I don't think you would agree
to that.\p…Or will you be so kind as to give
me advice?$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching3
source:
I knew it…\pIt had to happen because I'm such
a really boring nobody…\pBut I thought just maybe…
You won't reconsider, will you?\pBut I can't give up just like that.
I'll ask you while I'm still lucky!\pPlease, will you be so kind as to give
me advice?$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode3
source:
Really? I can't believe it!
I can't believe you'll advise me!\lI… I'm so happy…\pWhat I want to ask you is really
trivial, but I can't decide…\pAt the BATTLE TOWER, they let you
choose Level 50 or Open Level.\pWhich course do you think even I may
have a chance at?$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks3
source:
{STR_VAR_1}? Okay!
But do you really think someone like\lme would have a chance?\pI'll do my best, even though I don't
think it will work.\pThank you very much for spending
time with someone like me.$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach4
source:
Oh! You're {PLAYER}{KUN}, aren't you?\pI've heard that you're tough at
POKéMON!\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}!
I'll be your friend!\pDid you know?\pYou can't win at the BATTLE FRONTIER
if all you know is what they teach at\lthe TRAINER'S SCHOOL.\pI'm willing to listen to your advice.
You'll agree, of course?$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching4
source: Huh? Why are you refusing me?\nIt's me who's asking you!\lYou have to reconsider!$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode4
source:
Okay, so there is this something.
I want you to decide it for me.\pYou know that the BATTLE TOWER has
Level 50 and Open Level Rooms?\pWhich do you think would be good
for me, {PLAYER}{KUN}?$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks4
source:
Okay, {STR_VAR_1} is suitable for me?
Thank you!\pKnowing that you made the decision,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, I won't be so upset if\lI lose.\pOkay, I'll look to you for advice again.
Bye!$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach5
source:
Oh, hi, there! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I know you because you're famous!\lCall me {STR_VAR_1}! Glad to meet you!\pI'm a TRIATHLETE, so I keep myself
fit even while I raise POKéMON.\pI'm also involved with other things
like work, napping, ballroom dancing…\pBeing this busy, it's not so easy for
me to become a decent TRAINER.\pSo, I have a proposition!\pThere must be a reason why we met.
So, {PLAYER}{KUN}, how about sharing your\lwisdom with me every so often?$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching5
source: Oh, but, please?\nA guy like me needs someone like\lyou, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pHonestly, I need your advice!$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode5
source:
Thank you! That's more like it!
So, let's start with an easy one!\pYou know about the BATTLE TOWER's
two courses, right?\lYou know, Level 50 and Open Level.\pMe being a busy guy, which one should
I gear up for?$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks5
source: {STR_VAR_1}, huh? Okay, gotcha.\nI'll find time somehow and give it a go!\p…Whoops, I'd better go to work!\nThanks! See you around!$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach6
source:
No way! Uh-uh!
Are you maybe the real {PLAYER}?\pA-hah! Awesome! I'm {STR_VAR_1},
so pleased to meet you!\p{PLAYER}, you're very strong,
aren't you?\pEveryone's talking about you!\pOh! I just had this great idea!
I'll get advice off you, {PLAYER}!\lI'm sure it will make me tougher!\pIsn't it a great idea?
Please, I want your advice!$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching6
source: Ahahaha, you can pretend to be mean,\nbut you can't fool me!\lYou really mean okay, don't you?$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode6
source:
Yay! I knew you'd have a big heart,
{PLAYER}!\pWhat should I ask you first?
…Oh, I thought of something!\pDrum roll, please!
The question I have is…\pIf I were to take a BATTLE TOWER
challenge, which way should I go?\pLevel 50 or Open Level?
Which suits me more?$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks6
source:
Oh-oh-oh!
{STR_VAR_1}, you say!\lThank you for a totally cool reply!\pI guess that's about all I wanted
to ask you today.\pLet's meet here again, okay?
Thanks!$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach7
source:
I beg your pardon, but…
Are you {PLAYER}?\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}, and I am delighted to
make your acquaintance.\pI have long been an admirer
of yours…\p… … … … … …\pUm… I hope you don't find this
request too much of a burden, but…\pMay I become your apprentice,
{PLAYER}?$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching7
source:
Oh…!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\p…I must have fainted from shock.
I'm sorry, I must have misheard you.\pPlease! Please say that you will
accept me as your apprentice!$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7
source:
Oh… I'm delighted!\pI don't wish to waste your time,
so please advise me on this.\pI plan to take a BATTLE TOWER
challenge soon.\pHowever, there are two levels…\pWhich would be most suitable for me?
Level 50 or Open Level?$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks7
source: {STR_VAR_1} is your choice!\nI see. I will do my best!\pThank you, {PLAYER}.\nI hope I can count on you again.\lPlease take care!$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8
source:
Eek! Eek! {PLAYER}!
You spoke to me!\lI… I'm overjoyed!\pMe! My name is {STR_VAR_1}!
I just became a TRAINER!\pI'm delighted I met you, {PLAYER},
the big name in POKéMON circles!\pOh-oh-oh, I know!
May I ask a huge favor, {PLAYER}?\pPlease take me in as your apprentice!
I want to learn from you!$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching8
source: Waaaah!\n{PLAYER} turned me down…\lIt… It's an invaluable experience!\p{PLAYER}, please! I want to hear\nan affirmative answer this time!\pI beg you for your guidance!$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode8
source:
Hieeeeh! {PLAYER} said yes!
{PLAYER} said yes!\pI won't be able to sleep tonight…
Thank you ever so much!\pThen, here's my question!\pAt the BATTLE TOWER, what is right
for me, Level 50 or Open Level?$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks8
source: {STR_VAR_1}! Perfectly understood!\nI understand perfectly!\lI'm deliriously delighted!\pI hope you'll be willing to teach me\nsome more another time.$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9
source:
Whoa! Could you be…
Might you be… {PLAYER}{KUN}?!\lThat strong and famous TRAINER?\lWell, hello, aren't I just the luckiest!\pHello, the name's {STR_VAR_1}!\pI've been on the lookout for
a POKéMON teacher.\pAnd with impeccably good timing,
along came you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pSo, there you have it, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Let me apprentice under you!$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching9
source: Gwaaaah!\nYou're quite cool and tough…\pDon't be that way, please.\nI'm asking you!$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode9
source:
Oh, yeah! That's a solid reply!
Excellent, I might add!\pSo how about a first piece of advice
on the BATTLE TOWER?\pIf I were to go, what would be better?
Level 50 or Open Level?$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks9
source: Uh-huh, {STR_VAR_1} it is!\nOK, A-OK!\lI'll go show my mettle, like, jam!\pAll right, I'll look to you as my mentor!\nAdios!$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10
source:
Oh, hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}, right?
The police were looking for you!\p… … …
Of course I'm lying!\pMe, I'm {STR_VAR_1}. Despite the way
I look, I'm the POKéMON CHAMPION!\l…That's a lie, too!\pThis is no lie, though.
I'm not very good at battling.\pSo, how about you becoming my master
about all things POKéMON?$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching10
source:
If you're going to act cold like that,
I'll show you what I'll do!\pWaaah! Waaah! Waaah!
Hiccup!\pHahaha, that was my FAKE TEARS!\pCome on, will you please be
my POKéMON master?$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode10
source:
Yippee!
I'll buy you a boat for that!\pOf course I'm lying again!
But… Thank you, master!\pYou know how there's Level 50 and
Open Level at the BATTLE TOWER?\pI'm having trouble deciding which
level I should challenge…\pCan you decide for me, master?$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks10
source:
Okay, so {STR_VAR_1} is better!
I'll go to the other level, then!\pJust kidding!
I'll obey your teaching, master!\pThanks, master!
I hope you'll keep teaching me!$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
source:
A-H-O-Y!
And that spells ahoy, and it means hi!\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}, the rappin' SAILOR
am I!\pYour turn now, tell me a little about
yourself, give it a try!\pUh-huh, uh-huh!
{PLAYER}{KUN}'s your name,\land POKéMON's your game!\pAnd you're at a delicate age
when all the world's your stage!\pAnyway, I just want to say,
that you're the tenth TRAINER\lI've spoken to today.\pLet's make that a celebration!
Become my mentor for commemoration!$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching11
source: But!\nYou have to work with me!\pDon't be such a tease!\nBecome my mentor, please!$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode11
source:
That's it!
{PLAYER}, you've got the spirit!\pSo here's my first question
that begs your suggestion!\pIt's about the BATTLE TOWER,
and it hinges on my power!\pLevel 50 and Open Level there be,
which is the one that's good for me?$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks11
source: Okay, {STR_VAR_1} it is, you say!\nI'll go and take it on my way!\pIf it's advice I ever need,\n{PLAYER}, your word I'll always heed!$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
source:
Say, hey, aren't you {PLAYER}?
What should I do? Talk to you?\lWhy not? I'm already talking to you!\p{PLAYER}, are you surprised at me?
I'd better tell you who I happen to be!\p{STR_VAR_1} is what you can call me.
The brightest star in guitardom,\lthat's me!\pAre you receiving me?
You are receiving me!\pMy luck's at its best,
I'll hit you with a request!\p{PLAYER}, let me be your underling!
I want you to teach me everything!$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching12
source: You're turning me down, then?\nI'll just have to ask you again!\p{PLAYER}, I beg to be your underling!\nI need you to teach me everything!$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode12
source:
Lucky, yeah, woohoo!
Should I pop a question to you?\pSince we're near the BATTLE TOWER,
how about a question about its power?\pOf the choices you see,
which is the right one for me?$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks12
source: If {STR_VAR_1} is what you suggest,\nit must be the very best!\pWell, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free,\nbut don't you forget about me.\pSee you again, my smart friend!$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
source:
Oh, hi! You there!
Can I get you to massage my shoulder?\p…Yes, there! That's it!
Ouch, ouch! Oooh, that feels great!\pMy name's {STR_VAR_1}.
I take karate training, but my body's\lnot built to take the abuse…\pI decided I'll battle POKéMON and
toughen myself up.\pYou're {PLAYER}{KUN}, aren't you?
The POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMP?\pListen, can I get you to give me
advice?$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching13
source: Oh, why?\pI won't be a big bother, I promise!\nPlease?$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode13
source: Thank you. Mighty good of you!\n…Cough! Cough!\pOogh, I have to toughen up quick…\pI'll be heading off to the BATTLE TOWER\nright away, but what would be better\lfor me? Level 50 or Open Level?$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks13
source: Hm, all right. That's {STR_VAR_1}.\nI'll go there right away.\pI hope I can keep hitting you up for\nhelp--after all, you're my mentor!$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
source:
Er… Um…
{PLAYER}{KUN}…?\pPlease, don't look at me that way.
You're making me all self-conscious.\pI… I'm {STR_VAR_1}.\pI'm really embarrassed to say this,
but I explore ancient ruins and such.\pI'm even more embarrassed to admit

to just turn on my heels and walk away\lfrom a win without saying a word.\pSo, what would be a cool saying to
underline my coolness when I'm done\land walking away? {PLAYER}{KUN}, help me!$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks5
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pOkay, gotcha.
I can find time to say that!\pHonestly, I'm glad I met a good mentor
like you.\pI'm going to make time somehow so
I can get into battling.\pThanks for everything, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
We have to battle, you and me, one day!$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech6
source:
I lucked out again!
{PLAYER}! Am I glad to see you!\lLike usual, I need your advice!\pDrum roll, please!
The last question I have is…\pIf I win a battle and want to end
it with a cool flourish, what\lshould I say?$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks6
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pThat… That's fabulous!
It's dignified and cool! I claim it!\p…Listen, I think I'm getting decent
at this, huh?\pSo, I'm thinking of challenging other
TRAINERS from now on.\p{PLAYER}, your advice really helped me.\pMaybe one day, there'll be a time when
we battle!\pThank you for everything!$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech7
source:
Oh, {PLAYER}.
I'm so glad I met you!\pI no longer have any concerns with
regard to my POKéMON.\pIt's myself that worries me…\pDo you know how a TRAINER says
a few things upon winning a battle?\pDefinitely, I wish I could do that,
too!\pPlease, what should I say when
I win a battle?$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks7
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pAh! That saying! It refreshes me
and makes me feel reborn!\pI must use that right away!\pAnd now, I must take my leave,
{PLAYER}…\pI will go out to battle many others,
but never will I forget your teachings.\pPerhaps one day…
Farewell!$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech8
source:
Eek! I spotted {PLAYER}!
I… I'm overjoyed to see you!\pOh-oh-oh! There's something I just
had to ask you!\pA little while ago, I won a battle.
That part was giddying!\pBut it made me so overjoyed that
I choked up and couldn't say a thing!\pSo now, {PLAYER}, please, I want you to
think up an exit line for when I win!$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks8
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pWaaaaah!
I'm going to say that?!\lI… I'm delirious with joy!\pTh-th-thank you!
I have nothing left to regret now!\pI'm going to travel now and battle
all sorts of people.\pEverything, I owe it to you, {PLAYER}.
Really, really, thank you!\pI've got to go now, but let's meet
in battle one day!$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech9
source:
Hola, bueno!
{PLAYER}{KUN}!\pYou know, I'm getting the itch to roam
and battle where I may.\pBut before I do, I want your advice
once again, please!\pIf I were to win a battle, what would
be a good boast I could say to my\lfallen TRAINER opponent?$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks9
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pUh-huh, that's sweet!
Si, bueno!\lI'll try saying that, like, ham!\pAnd now, it's time to say good-bye!
Thanks for all sorts of things!\pGive me a battle one day, OK?
Adios!$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech10
source:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, there's big trouble!\pWhen I win a battle, I brag about it
for an hour at least!\pOf course I'm lying!
Wahahaha!\pThis is no lie, though.
I'm not very good at chatting.\pSo, how about deciding for me what
I should say after winning a battle,\lmaster?$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pThat's what I should say, huh?
Then, I'll stay away from that!\pJust kidding!
I'll obey your teaching, master!\pThanks for teaching me all this time,
master!\pI'm finally understanding what being
a TRAINER is about.\pI'm going to go out and win battles
against any TRAINER.\pMaybe it'll be you one day, master!\pThat's all!
Farewell, my master!$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech11
source:
A-H-O-Y!
And that spells ahoy!\pThe rappin' SAILOR am I!
This will be my last question,\ldon't you cry!\pIt's a saying question
that begs your suggestion!\pIf I win a match, what can I say
in a real cool way?$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks11
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pPerfect! That's what I'll use.
I was right to make you choose!\pAnd now, I think it'd be best,
if I were to fly the nest!\pThanks for all you taught me.
I'll be off on a battle spree!\pB-O-N-V-O-Y-A-G-E!
And that spells bon voyage,\lto you this is my homage!$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech12
source:
Oh, yeah, {PLAYER}!
I found you again today!\pWhat should I do? Ask you again?
Why not? I'm already asking you!\pAnyways, {PLAYER}…
Are you receiving me?\lYou are receiving me!\lI need some more advice for me!\pIt's about what I should yell.
Something cool to holler when\la battle ends well.\pCome on, I wanna hear you say it!$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pAll right, all right!
I'll use that because it's so tight!\pI'm out of things to ask you.
Waving bye is all that's left to do.\pBut maybe one day we'll meet, with one
destined to go down in defeat.\pBut, it really is time to say farewell.\pWell, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free,
but don't you forget about me!\pTake care, {PLAYER}!
Love ya!$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech13
source:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'm finished…
My nose won't stop dripping…\pI was trying to think up something
cool to say when I win a battle.\pIt inspired me so much, it made me cry,
and now my nose won't stop running…\pSo, things being this way,
I need you to decide for me, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pWhen I win a battle,
what should I say?$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks13
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\p… … …That's good.
No, it's awe inspiring!\lIt's bringing fresh tears to my eyes!\pBut in spite of my tears and runny
nose, I will use that saying!\pI'm plumb out of things to ask you,
{PLAYER}{KUN}.\pFrom now on, we're rivals!
Thanks for everything!$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech14
source:
Er… Um…
{PLAYER}{KUN}…\pPlease, don't look at me that way.
You're making me all nervous.\pI… I need your advice again.
I'll make it my last, though…\pIt's really embarrassing to ask,
but what if I win a battle?\lWhat should I say?$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks14
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pOh… Okay!
I'll try to say that!\lI might be too nervous to say it…\pThank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
I have to say good-bye now.\pI'll obey all that you've taught me,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, and do the best I can.$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech15
source:
Hm? You appear to be {PLAYER}{KUN}…
But are you really?\lPerhaps a clever {PLAYER} DOLL?\pOh, no, no, no, don't worry!
If you really are real, please\lforget about my rudeness.\pNo need to be so angry. All I wish for
is more of your fine advice.\pIt concerns a saying.\pMore precisely, what should I say
if I win a battle?$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\p… … … … … …
When I win a match…\p{STR_VAR_1}\p…Are you serious?\pI see. If you are serious, that's fine.
I thank you for your time.\pI do hope even I will be able to
put that saying to good use.\pI seem to have run dry on what advice
I need.\pI do believe it's high time I bid you
farewell and strike out on my own.\pThank you, my mentor!
I apologize for my skepticism!$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
source: I welcome you to the BATTLE TENT!\pI am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
source: I welcome you to the BATTLE TENT\nFALLARBOR SITE!\pI am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_TakeChallenge
source: Now, do you wish to take the challenge\nof a Set KO Tourney?$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge
source: We await your challenge on\nanother occasion!$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainFallarborTent
source:
In the ARENA BATTLE TENT,
In the FALLARBOR BATTLE TENT,
we undertake the Set KO Tourney.\pAll participants enter with a team of
three POKéMON.\pThe three POKéMON must be lined up
in the order that they are to appear in.\pDuring battle, the POKéMON will appear
one at a time in the preset order.\pOnce a POKéMON enters battle, it must
remain out until the match is decided.\pIf a match remains undecided in
three turns, it goes to judging.\pIf you wish to interrupt your challenge,
please save the game.\pIf you don't save, you will not be able
to continue with your challenge.\pIf you pull off the feat of beating
three TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with a fine prize.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_SaveBeforeChallenge
source: Before showing you to the BATTLE\nTENT, I must save. Is that okay?$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
source: We offer two levels of challenge,\nLevel 50 and Open Level.\lWhich is your choice?$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
source: Very well, now select your\nthree POKéMON, please.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
source:
My dear challenger!\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for entry.\pThey also must not hold the same
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pWhen you have made your preparations,
please do return.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
source:
My dear challenger!\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for entry.\pTo qualify, you must bring three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThey also must not hold the same
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pWhen you have made your preparations,
please do return.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_GuideYouToBattleTent
source: I shall now guide you to\nthe BATTLE TENT.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
source:
My dear challenger!\pYou did not save the game before
shutting down, did you?\pIt is unfortunate, but that has
resulted in your disqualification\lfrom your challenge.\pYou may, of course, start with a fresh
challenge.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_BeatThreeTrainers
source: How splendid! You have beaten\nthree TRAINERS in succession!$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WaitWhileSaveGame
source: Please wait while I save the game.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_PresentYouWithPrize
source: In commemoration of your 3-win streak,\nwe present you with this prize.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
source: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_BagFullReturnForPrize
source: Oh?\nYour BAG seems to be full.\pI urge you to clear space and\nreturn for your prize.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ThankYouWaitWhileSaving
source: Thank you so much for participating!\pPlease wait while I save the game.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge2
source: We await your challenge on\nanother occasion!$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_LookingForwardToArrival
source: We have been looking forward to\nyour arrival.\pBefore I show you to the BATTLE TENT,\nI must save the game. Please wait.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
source: I welcome you to the BATTLE TENT!\pHere, the TRAINER's trust toward\nPOKéMON is tested.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
source: I welcome you to the BATTLE TENT\nVERDANTURF SITE!\pHere, the TRAINER's trust toward\nPOKéMON is tested.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_TakeChallenge
source: Do you wish to take the PALACE\nDo you wish to take the VERDANTURF\nBATTLE TENT challenge?$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainVerdanturfTent
source:
In the PALACE BATTLE TENT,
In the VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT,
there is one crucial rule that must\lbe obeyed.\pTRAINERS are permitted only to switch
their POKéMON in and out.\pTRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to
command their POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON are to behave according
to their nature and battle on their own.\pYou must put your trust in your
POKéMON and watch over them.\pIf you achieve the honor of beating
three TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with a prize.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReturnFortified
source: When you have fortified your heart\nand POKéMON, you must return.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
source: There are two levels of difficulty,\nLevel 50 and Open Level.\lWhich is your choice of a challenge?$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
source:
Sigh…\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for the challenge.\pTo enter, you must provide three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThey also must not be holding
the same kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pCome back when you have made
your preparations.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
source:
Sigh…\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for the challenge.\pTo enter, you must provide three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThey also must not be holding
the same kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pCome back when you have made
your preparations.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
source: Good. Now, you must select your\nthree POKéMON.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_SaveBeforeChallenge
source: I must save before I show you to\nthe BATTLE TENT. Is that okay?$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_NowFollowMe
source: Good.\nNow, follow me.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ResultsWillBeRecorded
source: I feel privileged for having seen\nyour POKéMON's exploits.\pThe results will be recorded.\nI must ask you to briefly wait.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AchievedThreeWinStreak
source: To achieve a 3-win streak…\pThe bonds that bind your heart with\nyour POKéMON seem firm and true.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_FeatWillBeRecorded
source: Your feat will be recorded.\nI must ask you to briefly wait.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_PresentYouWithPrize
source: For the feat of your 3-win streak,\nwe present you with this prize.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
source: Welcome to the BATTLE TENT!\pI am your guide to the Battle Swap\nTournament.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
source: Welcome to the BATTLE TENT\nSLATEPORT SITE!\pI am your guide to the Battle Swap\nTournament.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_TakeChallenge
source: Would you like to take the Battle\nSwap challenge?$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSlateportTent
source:
Here at the FACTORY BATTLE TENT,
Here at the SLATEPORT BATTLE TENT,
we hold Battle Swap events\lusing rental POKéMON.\pFirst, you will be loaned three
POKéMON specifically for this event.\pUsing the supplied rental POKéMON,
you must conduct a SINGLE BATTLE.\pIf you win, you are permitted to trade
one of your rental POKéMON.\pRepeat this cycle of battling and
trading--if you win three times in\la row, you will earn a fine prize.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_LookForwardToNextVisit
source: We look forward to your next visit.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
source: Which level do you wish to challenge?\nLevel 50 or Level 100?$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_SaveBeforeChallenge
source: Before you begin your challenge,\nI need to save data. Is that okay?$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_HoldMonsForSafekeeping
source: Okay, I will hold your POKéMON for\nsafekeeping while you compete.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_StepThisWay
source: Please step this way.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReturnRentalMonsSaveResults
source: Thank you for participating!\pI will return your POKéMON in exchange\nfor our rental POKéMON.\pI must also save your event results.\nPlease wait.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReturnMonsExchangeRentals
source: I will return your POKéMON in exchange\nfor our rental POKéMON.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_WonThreeMatchesReturnMons
source:
Congratulations!
You've won three straight matches!\pI will return your POKéMON in exchange
for our rental POKéMON.\pI must also save your event results.
Please wait.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_AwardYouThisPrize
source: In recognition of your 3-win streak,\nwe award you this prize.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_NoRoomInBagMakeRoom
source: Oh?\nYou seem to have no room for this.\pPlease make room in your BAG and\nlet me know.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_BeenWaitingForYou
source: We've been waiting for you!\pBefore we resume your challenge,\nI must save the game.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
source: I'm sorry to say this, but you didn't\nsave before you quit playing last time.\pAs a result, you have been disqualified\nfrom your challenge.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReturnPersonalMons
source: We'll return your personal POKéMON.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
source: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
source: The Battle Swap rules are listed.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
source: Which heading do you want to read?$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
source: In a Battle Swap event, you may use\nonly three POKéMON.\pWhether you are renting or swapping,\nyour team may not have two or more\lof the same POKéMON.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules
source: You may swap POKéMON only with\nthe TRAINER you have just defeated.\pYou may swap for only those POKéMON\nused by the beaten TRAINER.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules
source: After every battle you win, you may\nswap for one of your defeated\lopponent's POKéMON.\pYou will not be able to swap POKéMON\nwith the third TRAINER in the event.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotes
source:
There are two key points to be aware
of when swapping POKéMON.\pFirst, when swapping, you can't check
the stats of the POKéMON you are\labout to receive.\pSecond, the POKéMON on your team
are lined up in sequence, depending on\lthe order in which you rented them.\pThis sequence remains unchanged
even when swaps are made.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
source: The POKéMON of the SLATEPORT\nBATTLE TENT are all rentals.\pAll rental POKéMON are kept at\nLevel 30.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed2
source: The VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT\nrules are listed.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
source: Which heading do you want to read?$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
source: Here at the VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT,\nPOKéMON are required to think and\lbattle by themselves.\pUnlike in the wild, POKéMON that live\nwith people behave differently\ldepending on their nature.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
source:
Depending on its nature, a POKéMON
may prefer to attack no matter what.\pAnother POKéMON may prefer to protect
itself from any harm.\pYet another may enjoy vexing or
confounding its foes.\pDepending on its nature, a POKéMON
will have favorite moves that it is good\lat using.\pIt may also dislike certain moves that
it has trouble using.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMoveRules
source:
There are offensive moves that inflict
direct damage on the foe.\pThere are defensive moves that are
used to prepare for enemy attacks or\lused to heal HP and so on.\pThere are also other somewhat-odd
moves that may enfeeble the foes with\lstat problems including poison and \lparalysis.\pPOKéMON will consider using moves in
these three categories.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainUnderpoweredRules
source:
When not under command by its TRAINER,
a POKéMON may be unable to effectively\luse certain moves.\pA POKéMON is not good at using any
move that it dislikes.\pIf a POKéMON only knows moves that
do not match its nature, it will often\lbe unable to live up to its potential.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainWhenInDangerRules
source: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may\nstart using moves that don't match its\lnature when it is in trouble.\pIf a POKéMON begins behaving oddly\nin a pinch, watch it carefully.$

label: BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainLevelRules
source: At this BATTLE TENT, the levels of\nyour opponents will be adjusted to\lmatch the levels of your POKéMON.\pHowever, no TRAINER you face will\nhave any POKéMON below Level 30.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
source: The VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT\nrules are listed.$

label: BattleTentLobby_Text_EarnedBattlePoints
source: You've earned {STR_VAR_1} Battle Points!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GiveEnigmaBerry
source: DAD: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pI just received a very rare BERRY.\nI'd like you to have it.$

label: Route104_Text_PlantBerriesInSoilTakeThis
source: If you see BERRIES growing in loamy\nsoil, feel free to take them.\pBut make sure you plant a BERRY in the\nsame spot. That's common courtesy.\pHere, I'll share this with you.$

label: Route104_Text_TrainersOftenMakeMonHoldBerries
source:
The way you look, you must be a
TRAINER, no?\pTRAINERS often make POKéMON hold
BERRIES.\pIt's up to you whether to grow BERRIES
or use them.$

label: Route111_Text_WateredPlantsEveryDayTakeBerry
source: I watered the plants every day.\nThey grew lots of flowers.\pAnd they gave me lots of BERRIES, too.\pHere you go!\nYou can have it!$

label: Route111_Text_GoingToTryToMakeDifferentColorBerries
source: I'm going to try really hard and make\nBERRIES in different colors.\pI hope you try hard, too!$

label: Route111_Text_WhatColorBerriesToLookForToday
source: I wonder what color BERRIES I'll look\nfor today?$

label: Route114_Text_LoveUsingBerryCrushShareBerry
source: I love using the BERRY CRUSH machine,\nso I'm collecting BERRIES.\pI'll share one with you, if you'd like.$

label: Route114_Text_TryBerryCrushWithFriends
source: You should try the BERRY CRUSH\nmachine with your friends.$

label: Route114_Text_FunToThinkAboutBerries
source: Which BERRY should be planted?\nShould you use or hoard BERRIES?\pIt's fun to think about.$

label: Route120_Text_BerriesExpressionOfLoveIsntIt
source: BERRIES grow by soaking up sunlight.\pWe help the BERRIES grow by watering\nthem regularly.\pIt's an expression of love, isn't it?$

label: Route120_Text_YesYouUnderstand
source: Yes, yes.\nYou understand what I mean.\pYou should take this.$

label: Route120_Text_MakeYourOwnImpressions
source: Oh… But it is important to make your\nown impressions, I guess…\pYou can have this.$

label: Route120_Text_BerryIsRareRaiseItWithCare
source: I think that BERRY is rare.\nI hope you raise it with loving care.$

label: Route120_Text_IllGetMoreBerriesFromBerryMaster
source: I'll get more BERRIES from\nthe BERRY MASTER.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BerrySuitsYou
source: When it gets right down to it…\pThe same way suits suit me perfectly,\na crisp breeze suits the sea.\pAnd you, a BERRY suits you to a “T”…\pWhy should that be so?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BecauseYoureTrainer
source: When it gets right down to it…\pIt's because you're a TRAINER!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_PokeblocksSuitPokemon
source: When it gets right down to it…\pThe way dignified simplicity suits me,\n{POKEBLOCK}S perfectly suit POKéMON.$

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_YoureDeservingOfBerry
source: You may call me the BERRY MASTER.\pI dream of filling the world with\nbeautiful flowers, so I raise BERRIES\land hand them out to everyone.\pYou're deserving of one!$

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_WhyBeStingyTakeAnother
source: Why be stingy?\nTake another!$

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_VisitPrettyPetalFlowerShop
source: Be sure to visit the PRETTY PETAL\nflower shop near RUSTBORO.\pLet flowers fill the world!$

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_DoneForToday
source: I'm done for today.\nCome again another day.\pLet flowers fill the world!$

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_HeardAGoodSayingLately
source: The way my husband grows BERRIES,\noh, he's the best in the world.\pHe makes me proud, that he does.\pIncidentally, child, have you heard\na good saying lately?$

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_InspirationalTakeThis
source: Ah! What a remarkable saying!\nInspirational, it is!\pI want you to have this.$

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_GoodSayingTakeThis
source: Oh! A good saying it is.\nYou're quite remarkable.\pI want you to have this.$

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_JoyNeverGoesOutOfMyLife
source: Our four grandchildren should become\nmore accomplished than my husband.\pJoy never goes out of my life!$

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_Ah
source: Ah…$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ThisIsPrettyPetalFlowerShop
source: Hello!\pThis is the PRETTY PETAL flower shop.\nSpreading flowers all over the world!$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_LearnAboutBerries
source: {PLAYER}{KUN}, would you like to learn about\nBERRIES?$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_IntroLearnAboutBerries
source: Your name is?\p{PLAYER}{KUN}.\nThat's a nice name.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, would you like to learn about\nBERRIES?$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
source:
BERRIES grow on trees that thrive
only in soft, loamy soil.\pIf you take some BERRIES, be sure to
plant one in the loamy soil again.\pA planted BERRY will soon sprout,
grow into a plant, flower beautifully,\lthen grow BERRIES again.\pI want to see the whole wide world
filled with beautiful flowers.\lThat's my dream.\pPlease help me, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Plant BERRIES
and bring more flowers into the world.$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_FlowersBringHappiness
source: Flowers bring so much happiness to\npeople, don't they?$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_YouCanHaveThis
source: Hello!\pThe more attention you give to flowers,\nthe more beautifully they bloom.\pYou'll like tending flowers. I'm sure\nof it. You can have this.$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_WailmerPailExplanation
source:
While BERRY plants are growing,
water them with the WAILMER PAIL.\pOh, another thing.\pIf you don't pick BERRIES for a while,
they'll drop off onto the ground.\lBut they'll sprout again.\pIsn't that awesome?
It's like they have the will to live.$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ImGrowingFlowers
source: I'm trying to be like my big sisters.\nI'm growing flowers, too!\pHere you go!\nIt's for you!$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_MachineMixesBerries
source: You can plant a BERRY and grow it big,\nor you can make a POKéMON hold it.\pBut now they have a machine that mixes\nup different BERRIES and makes candies\lfor POKéMON.\pI want some candy, too.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese
source: Hi, what's your name?\p… … …  … … …  … … …\nOkay. That's nice!\pMy name is KIRI.\pMy mommy and daddy named me that so\nI would grow healthy and warmhearted.\lThat's what they wished.\pYou can have one of these.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiveYouThisBerryToo
source: KIRI will give you this BERRY, too!\nI really like it lots!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhatKindOfWishInYourName
source: I wonder what kind of wish is included\nin your name.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_LikeSeasonBornIn
source: Spring, summer, autumn, and winter.\pIf you're born in springtime, do you like\nthe spring, and if you're born in the\lsummer, do you like the summer?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThenILoveAutumn
source: Then KIRI was born in the autumn,\nso I love the autumn!\pWhich season do you like?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_OhDoesntMatter
source: Oh…\nIt doesn't matter…\pThere's so much that I want to know…$

label: gText_Birch_Welcome
source: Hi! Sorry to keep you waiting!\pWelcome to the world of POKéMON!\pMy name is BIRCH.\pBut everyone calls me the POKéMON\nPROFESSOR.\p$

label: gText_Birch_Pokemon
source: This is what we call a “POKéMON.”\p\n$

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
source:
This world is widely inhabited by
creatures known as POKéMON.\pWe humans live alongside POKéMON,
at times as friendly playmates, and\lat times as cooperative workmates.\pAnd sometimes, we band together
and battle others like us.\pBut despite our closeness, we don't
know everything about POKéMON.\pIn fact, there are many, many
secrets surrounding POKéMON.\pTo unravel POKéMON mysteries,
I've been undertaking research.\lThat's what I do.\p$

label: gText_Birch_AndYouAre
source: And you are?$

label: gText_Birch_BoyOrGirl
source: Are you a boy?\nOr are you a girl?$

label: gText_Birch_WhatsYourName
source: All right.\nWhat's your name?$

label: gText_Birch_SoItsPlayer
source: So it's {PLAYER}{KUN}?$

label: gText_Birch_YourePlayer
source: Ah, okay!\pYou're {PLAYER}{KUN} who's moving to my\nhometown of LITTLEROOT.\lI get it now!\p$

label: gText_Birch_AreYouReady
source:
All right, are you ready?\pYour very own adventure is about
to unfold.\pTake courage, and leap into the
world of POKéMON where dreams,\ladventure, and friendships await!\pWell, I'll be expecting you later.
Come see me in my POKéMON LAB.\p$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendWithTheBlendMaster
source: BLEND MASTER: Indeed I am!\nThe BLEND MASTER am I!\pBlend with me, and you shall witness\nthe mastery I bring to blending!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_SeeMyMasteryInAction
source: BLEND MASTER: Hmmm! So, you wish to\nsee my mastery in action?$

label: BerryBlender_Text_TooBusyNowIsee
source: Hmmm!\pSo, you are too busy now, I see!\pBut fear not!\nI shall be here all day!\lHurry back from your errand!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoBerries
source: Hmmm!\pYou haven't got a single BERRY!\pI shall be here all day!\nHurry back with some BERRIES!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterKnowHowToMakePokeblocks
source: Of course!\nOf course!\pIncidentally…\nYou do know how to blend {POKEBLOCK}S\lfrom BERRIES?$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerryBlending
source: Hmmm!\pAh, but it is a simple process!\pWhen the BLENDER's arrow comes to\nyour marker, just press the A Button.\pThat's all you have to do.\pWhen you see how precisely I press\nthe A Button, you will understand.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterLetsBerryBlender
source: Fine!\pLet's get started, then!\pAll together with the BLEND MASTER,\nlet's BERRY BLENDER!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoPokeblockCase
source: Hmmm!\pYou don't appear to have gotten\nthe {POKEBLOCK} CASE!\pI shall be here all day!\nObtain the {POKEBLOCK} CASE and hurry back!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterPokeblockCaseFull
source: Hmmm!\pYour {POKEBLOCK} CASE appears to be full!\pI shall be here all day!\nUse some {POKEBLOCK}S and hurry back!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_WhoaAwesome
source: Whoa!\nAwesome!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_WickedlyFast
source: Wickedly fast!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_WhatAnExpert
source: What an expert!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_MadeAmazingPokeblocksWithMaster
source: When I blended with the MASTER,\nwe made amazing {POKEBLOCK}S!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_QualitiesOfBlendMaster
source:
Eyes that track the arrow with
machinelike intensity…\pA hand that taps the A Button
with clockwork-like precision…\pPossessing these qualities makes
the BLEND MASTER truly great.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_MasterWorksOnSkillsInMountains
source: The BLEND MASTER's supposed to work\non his skills deep in the mountains.\pSometimes, he comes to LILYCOVE\nto blend BERRIES all day long.$

label: MossdeepCity_GameCorner_1F_Text_PokemonJumpInfo
source:
“POKéMON JUMP”\pMake your POKéMON skip the VINE WHIP
rope with the A Button.\pOnly mini POKéMON around 28 inches
or less may participate.\pPOKéMON that only swim, burrow,
or fly are not good at jumping.\pAs a result, those POKéMON may not
participate.\pGood things happen if everyone
jumps in time.$

label: MossdeepCity_GameCorner_1F_Text_DodrioBerryPickingInfo
source:
“DODRIO BERRY-PICKING”\pCommand DODRIO's three heads to
catch falling BERRIES.\pPress right, up, or left on the
{PLUS} Control Pad to move the heads.\pTo play this game, you must have
a DODRIO.$

label: CableClub_Text_ExplainBattleModes
source:
There are three Battle Modes.\pSINGLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS
with one or more POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER can have one POKéMON
in battle at a time.\pDOUBLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS
with two or more POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER will send out two
POKéMON in battle at a time.\pMULTI BATTLE is for four TRAINERS
with one or more POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER can have one POKéMON
in battle at a time.$

source: Welcome to the POKéMON WIRELESS\nCLUB UNION ROOM.\pYou may interact directly with\nother TRAINERS here, some of\lwhom you may not even know.\pWould you like to enter the ROOM?$

label: CableClub_Text_UnionRoomInfo
source:
The TRAINERS in the UNION ROOM
will be those players around you\lwho have also entered the ROOM.\pYou may do all sorts of things
here, such as exchanging greetings.\pYou may enter two POKéMON up to
Lv. 30 for a one-on-one battle.\pYou may take part in a chat with
two to five people.\pOr, you may register a POKéMON for
trade.\pWould you like to enter the ROOM?$

label: CableClub_Text_EnjoyUnionRoom
source: I hope you enjoy your time in\nthe UNION ROOM.$

label: CableClub_Text_FirstTimeRightThisWay
source:
Hello!
My name is TEALA.\pThis must be your first time
up here.\pI'll show you how the Wireless
Communication System works.\pFirst, I need to show you this
floor of our POKéMON CENTER.\pRight this way, please.$

label: CableClub_Text_ExplainWirelessClubFirstTime
source:
On the top floor, there are two
rooms.\pFirst, the room on the left.
It's the UNION ROOM.\pYou may link up with TRAINERS
around you who have also entered\lthe UNION ROOM.\pWith them, you may do things like
chat, battle, and trade.\pSecond, the room on the right is
the DIRECT CORNER.\pYou may trade or battle POKéMON
with your friends in this room.\pIf the Wireless Adapter isn't
connected, you may still link up\lusing a GBA Game Link cable.\pIf that is the case, you must go
to the DIRECT CORNER.\pI hope you enjoy the Wireless 
Communication System.$

label: CableClub_Text_AskAboutLinking
source: Hello, {PLAYER}!\pIt's me, TEALA, the POKéMON\nCENTER 2F attendant.\pIs there something you needed to\nask me about linking?$

label: CableClub_Text_ExplainWirelessClub
source:
Let me explain how the POKéMON
WIRELESS CLUB works.\pOn this, the top floor, there are
two rooms.\pFirst, the room on the left.
It's the UNION ROOM.\pYou may link up with TRAINERS
around you who have also entered\lthe UNION ROOM.\pWith them, you may do things like
chat, battle, and trade.\pSecond, the room on the right is
the DIRECT CORNER.\pYou may trade or battle POKéMON
with your friends in this room.\pSometimes, you may not be able to
find your friends in the UNION ROOM\lor the DIRECT CORNER.\pIn that case, please move closer
to your friends.\pIf the Wireless Adapter isn't
connected, you may still link up\lusing a GBA Game Link cable.\pIf that is the case, you must go
to the DIRECT CORNER.\pI hope you enjoy the Wireless 
Communication System.$

label: CableClub_Text_HopeYouEnjoyWirelessSystem
source: I hope you enjoy the Wireless\nCommunication System.$

source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}You know that dragons are
mythical POKéMON.\pThey're hard to catch and raise,
but their powers are superior.\pThey're virtually indestructible.
There's no being clever with them.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Lance2
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}He stands for justice!\nHe's cool, and yet passionate!\lHe's the greatest, LANCE!$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Lance3
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}We have a customer, LANCE, who\noccasionally comes.\pHe always buys capes.\pI wonder… Does he have many\nidentical capes at home?$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Lance4
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}LANCE's grandfather is thought to\nbe the elder of a famous clan of\ldragon masters.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Lance5
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}From what I've heard, LANCE has\na cousin who's a GYM LEADER\lsomewhere far away.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Bill0
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}After all, BILL's world-famous as a\nPOKéMANIAC.\pHe invented the POKéMON Storage\nSystem on PC, too.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Bill1
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BILL has lots of POKéMON!\nHe collects rare ones, too!$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Bill2
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}He's my grandson!\pHe always liked collecting things,\neven as a child!$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Bill3
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BILL is a POKéMANIAC, so he loves\nevery kind.\pApparently, the first one he caught\nwas an ABRA.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Bill4
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BILL's hometown is GOLDENROD CITY,\nwhere his folks still live.\pI've heard that it's quite the\nfestive, bustling city.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Bill5
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Apparently, BILL simply can't\nstomach milk at all.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_MrFuji0
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}He's really kind.\pHe looks after abandoned and\norphaned POKéMON.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_MrFuji1
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}This old guy marched right up to
our HIDEOUT.\pThen, he starts ranting about how
TEAM ROCKET's abusing POKéMON.\pSo, we're just talking it over as
adults.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_MrFuji2
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}POKéMON FAN MAGAZINE\nMonthly Grand Prize Drawing!\pThe application form is…\pGone! It's been clipped out.\nSomeone must have applied already.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_MrFuji3
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I hear that MR. FUJI's not from\nthese parts originally, either.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_MrFuji4
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}It's a photo of BLAINE and\nMR. FUJI.\pThey're standing shoulder to\nshoulder with big grins.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_MrFuji5
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Editor: The shy MR. FUJI turned\ndown our interview requests.\pHe is a kindly man who is adored\nand respected in LAVENDER TOWN.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Giovanni0
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}TEAM ROCKET captures POKéMON from\naround the world.\pThey're important tools for keeping\nour criminal enterprise going.\pI am the leader, GIOVANNI!$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Giovanni1
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Those thugs that took over our\nbuilding…\pTheir BOSS said he was looking for\nstrong POKéMON.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Giovanni2
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}TEAM ROCKET's BOSS is terribly\ncruel!\pTo him, POKéMON are just tools to\nbe used.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Giovanni3
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Welcome to my hideout!\pIt shall be so until I can restore\nTEAM ROCKET to its former glory.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Giovanni4
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Blow me away! GIOVANNI was the\nGYM LEADER of VIRIDIAN?$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Giovanni5
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}You… You're not GIOVANNI's kid,\nare you?\pNo, that can't be right.\nGIOVANNI's kid has red hair.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_ProfOak
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}PROF. OAK$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_ProfOak
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: PROF. OAK
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Why do POKéMON compete and battle
so hard for you?\pThey do so because they can see
the love and trust you have\ltowards POKéMON.\pNever forget that.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Daisy
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}DAISY$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Daisy
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: DAISY
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}While I was comfortably enjoying
my tea breaks, you've grown very\lskilled and powerful.\pI hope you'll remain a good rival
to my little brother.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Brock
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}BROCK$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Brock
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: BROCK
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}In this big world of ours, there
must be many tough TRAINERS.\pLet's both keep training and
making ourselves stronger!$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Misty
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}MISTY$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Misty
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: MISTY
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I'm going to keep training here at
this GYM.\pWhen I get better, I'd love to hit
the road and travel.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_LtSurge
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}LT. SURGE$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_LtSurge
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: LT. SURGE
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Hey, kid!
You electrified me in our battle!\pI didn't know that there were
gutsy TRAINERS like you.\pIt made me change my mind about
you!$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Erika
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}ERIKA$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Erika
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: ERIKA
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I am so glad that there are strong
TRAINERS like you.\pThat awareness alone inspires and
motivates me to try harder.\pPlease visit me again.
Zzz…$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Koga
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}KOGA$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Koga
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: KOGA\nTo: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}You and I, we must both set our\nsights higher and work towards\lmeeting our challenges.\pNow, I must go train my daughter.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Sabrina
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}SABRINA$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Sabrina
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: SABRINA
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}The love you have towards your
POKéMON…\pIt was a power that was never
bested by my psychic power.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Blaine
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}BLAINE$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Blaine
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: BLAINE
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}My fire POKéMON!
They'll become even more powerful!\pAnd now, a quiz. How many kinds of
FIRE-type POKéMON are there?$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Lorelei
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}LORELEI$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Lorelei
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: LORELEI
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I needed to thank you for your
help.\pBut that has nothing to do with our
battles.\pYou'd better watch out next time!$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Bruno
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}BRUNO$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Bruno
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: BRUNO
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}The super power of your POKéMON
and you I've experienced myself.\pNext time, maybe I should show you
how to train yourself.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Agatha
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}AGATHA$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Agatha
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: AGATHA\nTo: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}When you grow older, don't you\ndare go soft like that coot OAK!\pBe like me and keep battling on!$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Lance
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}LANCE$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Lance
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: LANCE
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I'm considering going back to my
hometown.\pI want to retrain my DRAGON-type
POKéMON and strengthen them.\pI'd like to invite you to my
hometown one day.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Bill
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}BILL$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Bill
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: BILL
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Hey, there! CELIO had nothing but
praise for you.\pHearing that makes me happy.\pWhen you catch some rare POKéMON,
come show me, okay? Promise!$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_MrFuji
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}MR. FUJI$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_MrFuji
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: MR. FUJI
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Instead of hoping for the happiness
of just your POKéMON…\p…Can I get you to wish for the
happiness of all POKéMON?$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Giovanni
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}GIOVANNI$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Giovanni
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: GIOVANNI
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}There is nothing that I wish to say
to you.\pI will concentrate solely on
bettering myself, and none other.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBrock
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: PEWTER GYM\nLEADER BROCK!\pBROCK rarely laughs, but is said to\nbe unable to stop if he starts.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureMisty
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: CERULEAN GYM\nLEADER MISTY!\pMISTY is said to worship LORELEI\nof the ELITE FOUR.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLtSurge
source:
POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: VERMILION GYM
LEADER LT. SURGE!\pLT. SURGE is rumored to have been
a pilot while home in America.\pHe used the electricity generated
by POKéMON to power his plane.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureErika
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: CELADON GYM\nLEADER ERIKA!\pRumor has it that if you peek into\nCELADON GYM, you can often\lsee ERIKA snoozing.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureKoga
source:
POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: FUCHSIA GYM
LEADER KOGA!\pKOGA is said to have a thorough
knowledge of medicine.\pHe even concocts medicine to nurse
his POKéMON to health.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureSabrina
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: SAFFRON GYM\nLEADER SABRINA!\pPeople say that SABRINA can\ncommunicate with her POKéMON\lduring battle without speaking.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBlaine
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: CINNABAR GYM\nLEADER BLAINE!\pBLAINE is said to remove his dark\nshades only when he is thinking up\lnew quiz questions.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLorelei
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's LORELEI!\pKnown for her logical, calculated,\nand cool battling style, LORELEI\lhas a surprising secret!$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBruno
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's BRUNO!\pBRUNO apparently joined the ELITE\nFOUR out of his burning ambition to\lbattle the best TRAINERS.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureAgatha
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's AGATHA!\pIn her youth, AGATHA and PROF.\nOAK were rivals who vied for\lsupremacy as TRAINERS.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLance
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's LANCE!\pLANCE's grandfather is thought to\nbe the elder of a famous clan of\ldragon masters.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureProfOak
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: PROF. OAK,\nthe POKéMON Researcher!\pPROF. OAK reportedly lives with his\ngrandchildren DAISY and {RIVAL}.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureDaisyOak
source:
This is a POKéMON JOURNAL from
years ago…\pPOKéMON JOURNAL
CONTEST Special!\pThe Spring POKéMON CONTEST's
Grand Champion is DAISY OAK of\lPALLET TOWN!$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureMrFuji
source:
POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:
MR. FUJI of POKéMON HOUSE!\pEditor: The shy MR. FUJI turned
down our interview requests.\pHe is a kindly man who is adored
and respected in LAVENDER TOWN.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTeach
source:
Heh! My POKéMON totally rules!
It's cooler than any POKéMON!\pI was lipping off with a swagger in
my step like that when the CHAIRMAN\lchewed me out.\pThat took the swagger out of my step.\pIf you'd like, I'll teach the move
SWAGGER to a POKéMON of yours.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerDeclined
source: What, no? Can't you get into\nthe spirit of things?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerWhichMon
source: All right, which POKéMON wants to\nlearn how to SWAGGER?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTaught
source: I'll just praise my POKéMON from now\non without the swagger.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTeach
source:
Did you know that you can go from
here a long way in that direction\lwithout changing direction?\pI might even be able to roll
that way.\pDo you think your POKéMON will
want to roll, too?\pI can teach one the move ROLLOUT
if you'd like.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutDeclined
source: You don't need to be shy about it.\nLet's roll!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutWhichMon
source: Ehehe, sure thing! It'd be great if\nthe POKéMON looked like me.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTaught
source: Rolling around in the grass makes me\nhappy. Come on, let's roll!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTeach
source:
There's a move that gets stronger
when you keep using it in a row.\pIt's a BUG-type move, and it is
wickedly cool.\pIt's called FURY CUTTER.
Want me to teach it to a POKéMON?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterDeclined
source: We're not on the same wavelength.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterWhichMon
source: Yay!\nShow me which POKéMON I should teach.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTaught
source: I get a thrill watching to see if\nthe move keeps hitting in succession!$

label: MoveTutor_MimicTeach
source: Ah, young one!\pI am also a young one, but I mimic\nthe styles and speech of the elderly\lfolks of this town.\pWhat do you say, young one?\nWould you agree to it if I were to\loffer to teach the move MIMIC?$

label: MoveTutor_MimicDeclined
source: Oh, boo! I wanted to teach MIMIC\nto your POKéMON!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_MimicWhichMon
source: Fwofwo! And so I shall!\nLet me see the POKéMON\lyou wish me to teach.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_MimicTaught
source: MIMIC is a move of great depth.\pCould you execute it to perfection\nas well as me…?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTeach
source:
I want all sorts of things!
But I used up my allowance…\pWouldn't it be nice if there were
a spell that made money appear when\lyou waggle a finger?\pIf you want, I can teach your POKéMON
the move METRONOME.\pMoney won't appear, but your POKéMON
will waggle a finger. Yes?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeDeclined
source: Okay. I'll be here if you change\nyour mind.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeWhichMon
source: Okay! I'll teach it!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTaught
source: When a POKéMON waggles its finger\nlike a METRONOME, all sorts of nice\lthings happen.\pWouldn't it be nice if we could\nuse it, too?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTeach
source:
Humph! My wife relies on HIDDEN
POWER to stay awake.\pShe should just take a nap like I do,
and SLEEP TALK.\pI can teach your POKéMON how to
SLEEP TALK instead. Interested?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkDeclined
source: Oh, fine, fine. You want to stay awake\nwith HIDDEN POWER, too…$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkWhichMon
source: Ah, an appreciative child!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTaught
source: I've never once gotten my wife's\ncoin trick right.\pI would be happy if I got it right\neven as I SLEEP TALK…$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTeach
source:
When I see the wide world from up
here on the roof…\pI think about how nice it would be
if there were more than just one me\lso I could enjoy all sorts of lives.\pOf course it's not possible.
Giggle…\pI know! Would you be interested in
having a POKéMON learn SUBSTITUTE?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteDeclined
source: Oh, no?\pA POKéMON can make a copy of\nitself using it, you know.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteWhichMon
source: Giggle…\nWhich POKéMON do you want me to\lteach SUBSTITUTE?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTaught
source: We human beings should enjoy our\nown lives to the utmost!\pI hope you'll get that way, too!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach
source:
I can't do this anymore!\pIt's utterly hopeless!\pI'm a FIGHTING-type TRAINER,
so I can't win at the GYM\lno matter how hard I try!\pArgh! Punch! Punch! Punch!
Punch! Punch! Punch!\pWhat, don't look at me that way!
I'm only hitting the ground!\pOr do you want me to teach your
POKéMON DYNAMICPUNCH?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchDeclined
source: Darn! You're even making fun of me?\nPunch! Punch! Punch!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchWhichMon
source: What? You do? You're a good person!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTaught
source: I want you to win at the CERULEAN GYM\nusing that DYNAMICPUNCH!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTeach
source:
Sigh…\pThe GYM LEADER is really
lovably admirable.\pBut that also means I have many
rivals for his attention.\pHe's got appeal with a DOUBLE-EDGE.
I couldn't even catch his eye.\pPlease, let me teach your POKéMON
the move DOUBLE-EDGE!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeDeclined
source: Oh…\nEven you rejected me…$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeWhichMon
source: Okay, which POKéMON should I teach\nDOUBLE-EDGE?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTaught
source: I won't live for love anymore!\nI'll become tough!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTeach
source:
I don't intend to be going nowhere
fast in the sticks like this forever.\pYou watch me, I'll get out to the city
and become a huge hit.\pSeriously, I'm going to cause
a huge EXPLOSION of popularity!\pIf you overheard that, I'll happily
teach EXPLOSION to your POKéMON!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionDeclined
source: Gaah! You're turning me down because\nI live in the country?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionWhichMon
source: Fine! An EXPLOSION it is!\nWhich POKéMON wants to blow up?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTaught
source: For a long time, I've taught POKéMON\nhow to use EXPLOSION, but I've yet\lto ignite my own EXPLOSION…\pMaybe it's because deep down,\nI would rather stay here…$

label: MoveTutor_Text_HeadbuttTeach
source: What am I doing?\pI'm shaking trees using HEADBUTT.\pDo you think your POKéMON will\nwant to HEADBUTT, too?\pI can teach one the move HEADBUTT\nif you'd like. It's fun!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_HeadbuttWhichMon
source: Ehehe, sure thing! It'd be great if\nthe POKéMON looked like me.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_HeadbuttDeclined
source: You don't need to be shy about it.\nLet's butt heads!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_HeadbuttTaught
source: Rattle trees with HEADBUTT.\nSometimes, sleeping POKéMON fall out.$
