label: gPikachuIntro_Text_Page1
source:
In the world which you are about to
enter, you will embark on a grand
adventure with you as the hero.

Speak to people and check things
wherever you go, be it towns, roads,
or caves. Gather information and
hints from every source.$

label: gPikachuIntro_Text_Page2
source:
New paths will open to you by helping
people in need, overcoming challenges,
and solving mysteries.

At times, you will be challenged by
others and attacked by wild creatures.
Be brave and keep pushing on.$

label: gPikachuIntro_Text_Page3
source:
Through your adventure, we hope
that you will interact with all sorts
of people and achieve personal growth.
That is our biggest objective.

Press the A Button, and let your
adventure begin!$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_WelcomeToTheWorld
source: Hello, there!\nGlad to meet you!\pWelcome to the world of POKéMON!\pMy name is OAK.\pPeople affectionately refer to me\nas the POKéMON PROFESSOR.\p$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_ThisWorld
source: This world…$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_IsInhabitedFarAndWide
source: …is inhabited far and wide by\ncreatures called POKéMON.\p$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_IStudyPokemon
source: For some people, POKéMON are pets.\nOthers use them for battling.\pAs for myself…\pI study POKéMON as a profession.\p$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_TellMeALittleAboutYourself
source: But first, tell me a little about\nyourself.\p$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_YourNameWhatIsIt
source: Let's begin with your name.\nWhat is it?\p$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_SoYourNameIsPlayer
source: Right…\nSo your name is {PLAYER}.$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_WhatWasHisName
source: This is my grandson.\pHe's been your rival since you both\nwere babies.\p…Erm, what was his name now?$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_YourRivalsNameWhatWasIt
source: Your rival's name, what was it now?$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_ConfirmRivalName
source: …Er, was it {RIVAL}?$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_RememberRivalsName
source: That's right! I remember now!\nHis name is {RIVAL}!\p$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_LetsGo
source: {PLAYER}!\pYour very own POKéMON legend is\nabout to unfold!\pA world of dreams and adventures\nwith POKéMON awaits! Let's go!$

label: gText_Oak_Welcome
source: Hi! Sorry to keep you waiting!\pWelcome to the world of POKéMON!\pMy name is OAK.\pPeople call me the POKéMON\nPROFESSOR.\p$

label: gText_Oak_Pokemon
source: This is what we call a “POKéMON.”\p\n$

label: gText_Oak_MainSpeech
source:
This world is widely inhabited by
creatures known as POKéMON.\pPeople and POKéMON live together,
by supporting each other.\pSome people play with POKéMON,
some battle with them. \pBut we don't know everything about
POKéMON yet. \pThere are still many mysteries
to solve. That's why I study\lPOKéMON every day.\p$

label: gText_Oak_BoyOrGirl
source: Are you a boy?\nOr are you a girl?$

source: What challenge are you\nexpecting?$

label: gText_Oak_ChallengeSelected
source: That sounds like the right\nlevel of challenge to me!$

label: gText_Oak_AreYouReady
source: You'll face fun times and tough\nchallenges.\pA world of dreams and adventures\nwith POKéMON awaits! Let's go!\pI'll be seeing you later!\p$

source: {PLAYER} obtained\nthe {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: gText_NoMoreRoomForPokemon
source: There's no more room for POKéMON!\pThe POKéMON BOXES are full and\ncan't accept any more!$

label: gText_NicknameThisPokemon
source: Do you want to give a nickname to\nthis {STR_VAR_1}?$

label: gText_WouldYouLikeToRestYourPkmn
source: Hello, and welcome to\nthe POKéMON CENTER.\pWe restore your tired POKéMON\nto full health.\pWould you like to rest your POKéMON?$

label: gText_IllTakeYourPkmn
source: Okay, I'll take your POKéMON\nfor a few seconds.$

label: gText_RestoredPkmnToFullHealth
source: Thank you for waiting.\pWe've restored your POKéMON\nto full health.$

label: gText_WeHopeToSeeYouAgain
source: We hope to see you again!$

label: gText_WelcomeCutShort
source: Hello, and welcome to\nthe POKéMON CENTER.\pWe restore your tired POKéMON\nto full health.\pWould you like to…$

label: gText_NoticesGoldCard
source:
Th-that card…
Could it be… The GOLD CARD?!\pOh, the gold color is brilliant!
The four stars seem to sparkle!\pI've seen several TRAINERS with
a SILVER CARD before, but, {PLAYER},\lyou're the first TRAINER I've ever\lseen with a GOLD CARD!\pOkay, {PLAYER}, please allow me
the honor of resting your POKéMON!$

label: gText_YouWantTheUsual
source: I'm delighted to see you, {PLAYER}!\nYou want the usual, am I right?$

label: gText_IllTakeYourPkmn2
source: Okay, I'll take your POKéMON\nfor a few seconds.$

label: gText_ThankYouForWaiting
source: Thank you for waiting.$

label: gText_WeHopeToSeeYouAgain2
source: We hope to see you again!$

label: gText_PkmnCenterChallenge_NoVisitsLeft
source: Sorry, but you are playing with\nthe POKéCENTER challenge!\pGood luck!{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_AreYouCurious
source: PROF. BIRCH: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pAre you curious about how your\nPOKéDEX is coming along?$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_Cancel
source: Hm? Oh, you haven't caught enough\nPOKéMON to make it worthwhile.$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_SoYouveSeenAndCaught
source: Hmhm…\pSo, you've seen {STR_VAR_1} POKéMON,\nand you've caught {STR_VAR_2} POKéMON…$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan10
source: Go into grassy areas more and look\nfor POKéMON more carefully.$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan20
source: I guess you're getting the hang\nof it. But, it gets harder from here.$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan30
source: Some POKéMON only appear in\ncertain areas.\lYou must be persistent.$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan40
source: Well, it could use more quantity,\nbut this is looking more like\la POKéDEX now.$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan50
source: This is coming along pretty good.\nKeep up the effort.$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan60
source: Are you using any RODS?\nThere are many POKéMON in the sea.$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan70
source: Instead of just catching POKéMON,\nhow about making them evolve, too?$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan80
source: This is going to be a fantastic\nPOKéDEX.\lThat's the feeling I'm getting.$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan90
source: You've collected this many…\nYour talent is remarkable!$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan100
source: Have you visited the SAFARI ZONE?\pI hear there are some POKéMON that\ncan only be caught there.$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan110
source: You've finally reached\nthe 100-kind mark.\pThis is an impressive POKéDEX!$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan120
source: There might be POKéMON that can be\nfound using ROCK SMASH.$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan130
source: You should get some more POKéMON\nby trading with others.$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan140
source: I've heard of POKéMON that evolve\nwhen they come to fully love their\lTRAINERS.$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan150
source: I had no idea that there were so\nmany POKéMON species in the HOENN\lregion.$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan160
source: On occasion, some POKéMON appear\nin large numbers like outbreaks.\pDon't miss opportunities like\nthose.$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan170
source: One can get a very good idea about\nthe POKéMON of the HOENN region\lby looking through your POKéDEX.$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan180
source: I would say you already qualify as\na POKéMON PROFESSOR, and a good\lone, too!$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan190
source: With a POKéDEX this complete,\nyou're a real professional at this!$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan200
source: You're very close to completing\nthis POKéDEX.\lI can feel it in my bones!$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_DexCompleted
source: Congratulations!\nYour POKéDEX is complete!$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_OnANationwideBasis
source: Hmhm…\nOn a nationwide basis…\pYou've seen {STR_VAR_1} POKéMON,\nand you've caught {STR_VAR_2} POKéMON…$

label: PokedexRating_Text_HowIsPokedexComingAlong
source: OAK: Good to see you!\nHow is your POKéDEX coming along?\pHere, let me take a look.$

label: PokedexRating_Text_SeenXOwnedY
source: The amount of progress you've made\non your POKéDEX is:\p{STR_VAR_1} POKéMON seen and\n{STR_VAR_2} POKéMON owned.\p{FONT_NORMAL}PROF. OAK's rating:$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan10
source: You still have lots to do.\pGo into every patch of grass you\nsee and look for POKéMON!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan20
source: It looks as if you're getting on\nthe right track!\pI've given one of my AIDES a FLASH\nHM. Make sure you go get it!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan30
source: Your POKéDEX could use a bit more\nvolume still!\pTry to catch other species of\nPOKéMON!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan40
source: Good, it's apparent that you're\ntrying hard!\pI've given one of my AIDES an\nITEMFINDER. Be sure to collect it!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan50
source: Your POKéDEX is coming along quite\nwell!\pI've given one of my AIDES an\nAMULET COIN. Be sure to get it!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan60
source: Ah, you've finally topped 50\nspecies!\pI've given one of my AIDES an EXP.\nSHARE. Be sure to go get it!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan70
source: Hoho! This is turning into quite the\nrespectable POKéDEX!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan80
source: Very good!\pI think you'll collect even more\nPOKéMON by going fishing!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan90
source: Wonderful! Let me guess… You\nlike to collect things, don't you?$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan100
source: I'm impressed!\nIt must have been difficult to do!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan110
source: You've finally hit 100 species!\nI can't believe how good you are!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan120
source: You even have the evolved forms\nof POKéMON! Super!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan130
source: Excellent! Trade with friends to\nget some more!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan140
source: Outstanding!\nYou've become a real pro at this!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan150
source: I have nothing left to say!\nYou're the POKéMON PROFESSOR now!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_Complete
source: Your POKéDEX is entirely complete!\nCongratulations!!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_NationalDexSeenXOwnedY
source: And your NATIONAL POKéDEX is:\p{STR_VAR_1} POKéMON seen and\n{STR_VAR_2} POKéMON owned.$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LookForwardToFilledNationalDex
source: I'll be looking forward to seeing\nyou fill the NATIONAL POKéDEX!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_YouveCompletedDex
source: Finally…\pYou've finally completed the\nPOKéDEX!\pIt's magnificent!\nTruly, this is a fantastic feat!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_Wroooaaarrr
source: Wroooooooaaaaaarrrr!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_ThankYouMadeDreamReality
source: Thank you, {PLAYER}!\nSincerely, thank you!\lYou've made my dream a reality!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LoveSeeingYourPokedex
source: OAK: Ah, welcome!\pTell me, how is your POKéDEX\ncoming along?\pWahaha!\pActually, I know how it is, but I\nlove seeing it anyway!\pLet's see…$

label: gElmDexRatingText_GoFindMrPokemon
source: PROF. ELM: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pHave you found MR. POKéMON's\nhome yet? It is on ROUTE 30,\pyou can't miss it!$

label: gElmDexRatingText_Robbery
source: PROF. ELM: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pGet here quick! Something\nawful has happened!$

label: gElmDexRatingText_AreYouCurious
source: PROF. ELM: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pAre you curious about how your\nPOKéDEX is coming along?$

label: gElmDexRatingText_AreYouCuriousNational
source: PROF. ELM: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pAre you curious about how your\nNational POKéDEX is coming along?$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan10
source: Look for POKéMON in grassy areas!$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan20
source: Good. I see you understand how to\nuse Poké Balls.$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan35
source: You're getting good at this,\nbut you have a long way to go.$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan50
source: Hmm, you're catching POKéMON at a\ndecent pace!$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan65
source: You're trying--I can see that.\nYour POKéDEX is coming together.$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan80
source: You're training them well. You know\nsome POKéMON don't evolve just by\pbattling with others, right?$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan95
source: Do you have a Fishing Rod?\nThere are some POKéMON that can\ponly be found by fishing!$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan110
source: Excellent! You seem to be good at\ncollecting things!$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan125
source: Some POKéMON only appear during\ncertain times of the day.$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan140
source: Your POKéDEX is really filling up.\nKeep up the good work!$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan155
source: I'm impressed.\nYou're evolving POKéMON, not just\pcatching them.$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan170
source: If you can learn how to use the\ncustom Poké Balls made by Kurt\peffectively, you'll be able to catch\nPOKéMON better!$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan185
source: When you trade POKéMON, you can\nalso trade information. Your\pfriends can really help you!$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan200
source: Are you trading your POKéMON?\nIt's tough to do this alone!$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan215
source: Wow! You've reached 200!\nYour POKéDEX is looking great!$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan230
source: You've proven yourself capable.\nThere's nothing to worry about.\pKeep catching POKéMON the way\nyou've been doing so far.$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan245
source: Your POKéDEX is well on the way to\nbeing filled up.\pThis POKéDEX can be considered a\njournal of your adventure.$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan260
source: You've found so many POKéMON!\nYou've really helped my studies!$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan275
source: Magnificent! You have the ability\nto become a great POKéMON\pProfessor someday!$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThanMaxDex
source: Your POKéDEX is amazing!\nYou're ready to turn professional!$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_Complete
source:
Wow!
That is a complete Johto POKéDEX!\pThanks to you, {PLAYER}, the Johto
POKéDEX is complete!\pWow...
You've done an incredible job!$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan100
source: The goal may be far away, but don't\ngive up yet! Keep going!$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan150
source: Don't forget, some POKéMON only\nappear at certain times of the day!$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan200
source: If you break rocks, some POKéMON\nthat were hiding there might come\pjumping out!$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan250
source: That's wonderful you've been able\nto gather this many POKéMON!\pThe path ahead is long. Keep up the\ngreat work!$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan300
source: If you Headbutt a tree, sometimes\na POKéMON might fall out!$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan350
source: A lot of POKéMON not found in the\nJohto region like to congregate\pat the Safari Zone$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan400
source: There are hidden locations all\nover the world containing rare\pand unusual POKéMON, try to find\nthem all!$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan435
source: Wow, you've gotten so far...!\nI'm actually a little surprised!$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan465
source: This is a critical moment!\nYou can't become discouraged!$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan475
source: Just a little more!\nI've got high expectations for you!$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThanMaxDex
source: I have never before in all my years\nseen such an incredible Trainer!$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_Complete
source:
Excellent! That is an amazing
National POKéDEX!\pWow...{PAUSE 10}\pYou've lived up to my
expectations wonderfully!\pNo, you've exceeded them, {PLAYER}.
You've become an amazing Trainer!\pThank you, {PLAYER}!$

label: gPokeNewsTextSlateport_Upcoming
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pSLATEPORT's most popular kind of guy,
the ENERGY GURU, is in the news again!\pHe promises to, “Stupendously go for
it in just this many days: {STR_VAR_1}!”\pWhile he refused to elaborate on what
he will stupendously go for, the\lENERGY GURU advised, “Save up your\lmoney. That'll be good…”\pIt sounds like a trip to SLATEPORT
would be well worth your while that day.\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$

label: gPokeNewsTextSlateport_Ongoing
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pThis is the news you've all been
waiting for!\pSLATEPORT'S ENERGY GURU is going
for it stupendously in the MARKET!\pHe promises unbeatable bargain
prices on CALCIUM and PROTEIN!\pA trip to SLATEPORT CITY sounds
worthwhile. Why not visit and shop\lto your heart's content?\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$

label: gPokeNewsTextSlateport_Ending
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pThis is the news you've all been
waiting for!\pSLATEPORT'S ENERGY GURU is going
for it stupendously in the MARKET!\pHe promises unbeatable bargain
prices on CALCIUM and PROTEIN!\pAccording to the ENERGY GURU, he
still has ample merchandise left.\pWhy not visit SLATEPORT CITY for
a most enjoyable shopping trip?\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$

label: gPokeNewsTextGameCorner_Upcoming
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pIt's approaching!
It's finally coming!\pThe GAME CORNER's service day will be
here in just this many days: {STR_VAR_1}!\pEven those who are usually unlucky
may be lucky on this particular day!\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$

label: gPokeNewsTextGameCorner_Ongoing
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pIt's here!
It's finally arrived!\pGAME CORNER's service day has finally
arrived!\pCould you be lucky at the SLOTS 
and ROULETTE?\pThe location is MAUVILLE CITY.
This is the place!\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$

label: gPokeNewsTextGameCorner_Ending
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pIt's here!
It's finally arrived!\pGAME CORNER's service day has finally
arrived!\pCould you be lucky at the SLOTS
and ROULETTE?\pTime is limited and has almost run out.
The location is MAUVILLE CITY.\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$

label: gPokeNewsTextLilycove_Upcoming
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pWe've just received wonderful news
from LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE.\pThe DEPARTMENT STORE's clear-out sale
will be in just this many days: {STR_VAR_1}!\pThat thingamajig or that doodad that
you've always wanted could be yours!\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$

label: gPokeNewsTextLilycove_Ongoing
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pThis is the news you've all been
waiting for!\pLILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE's clear-out
sale has finally arrived!\pAll the thingamajigs and doodads that
you've always dreamt about…\pYou may be in for fateful encounters
with them all!\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$

label: gPokeNewsTextLilycove_Ending
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pThis is the news you've all been
waiting for!\pLILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE's clear-out
sale has finally arrived!\pAll the thingamajigs and doodads that
you've always dreamt about…\pYou may be in for fateful encounters
with them all!\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$

label: gPokeNewsTextBlendMaster_Upcoming
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pWe have big news for everyone
involved in the making of {POKEBLOCK}S.\pThe legendary BLEND MASTER will be
appearing in LILYCOVE CITY with just\la mere {STR_VAR_1}-day wait to go!\pThe BLEND MASTER is said to be
the best in all HOENN when it comes to\lspinning a BERRY BLENDER.\pThose people who want to make great
{POKEBLOCK}S or see the MASTER in action\lare urged to save their BERRIES.\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$

label: gPokeNewsTextBlendMaster_Ongoing
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pWe have big news for everyone
involved in the making of {POKEBLOCK}S.\pThe legendary BLEND MASTER has
finally appeared!\pThe BLEND MASTER is spinning
the BERRY BLENDER at the LILYCOVE\lCONTEST HALL.\pThose people who want to make great
{POKEBLOCK}S or see the MASTER in action\lshould hurry to LILYCOVE.\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$

label: gPokeNewsTextBlendMaster_Ending
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pIt's incredible!
Too incredible, even!\pThe BERRY BLENDER is spinning at
a dizzying pace!\pThe BLEND MASTER has lived up to
his reputation!\pThe BLEND MASTER will soon be
leaving LILYCOVE.\pIf you haven't seen the MASTER in
action, don't waste this chance!\lHead to LILYCOVE right now!\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$

label: Questionnaire_Text_FillOut
source: There is a questionnaire.\nWould you like to fill it out?$

label: Questionnaire_Text_ThankYou
source: Thank you for taking the time to\nfill out our questionnaire.\pYour feedback will be used for\nfuture reference.$

label: Questionnaire_Text_YouKnowThoseWordsGift
source:
Oh, hello!
You know those words?\pThat means you must know about
the MYSTERY GIFT.\pFrom now on, you should be
receiving MYSTERY GIFTS!$

label: Questionnaire_Text_YouCanAccessMysteryGift
source: Once you save your game, you can\naccess the MYSTERY GIFT.$

label: Questionnaire_Text_YouKnowThoseWordsEvent
source: Oh, hello!\nYou know those words?\pThat means you must know about\nthe MYSTERY EVENT.$

label: Questionnaire_Text_YouCanAccessMysteryEvent
source: Once you save your game, you can\naccess the MYSTERY EVENT.$

label: MysteryGift_Text_TheresATicketForYou
source: Thank you for using the MYSTERY\nEVENT System.\pYou must be {PLAYER}.\nThere is a ticket here for you.$

source: It appears to be for use at\nthe LILYCOVE CITY port.\pWhy not give it a try and see what\nit is about?$

source: Would you like to mix records with\nother TRAINERS?$

source: We hope to see you again!$

source:
WARNING!\pThere is a different game file that
is already saved.\pIf you save now, the other file's
adventure, including items and\lPOKéMON, will be entirely lost.\pAre you sure you want to save now
and overwrite the other save file?$

label: gText_SaveError
source: Save error.\pPlease exchange the\nbackup memory.$

label: gText_SavingDontTurnOffPower
source: SAVING…\nDON'T TURN OFF THE POWER.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0Intro
source: Have you made a SECRET BASE already?\pI went here, there, everywhere before\nchoosing this place.\pSince you're already here, how would\nyou like to battle?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0AcceptBattle
source: Okay!\nHere we come!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0DeclineBattle
source: Hunh?\nOh, you can't now…$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0Defeated
source: Waaargh! You're too strong!\nAbout me losing… Please keep it secret!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0PostBattle
source: What do you think of my SECRET BASE?\nCome visit me again tomorrow.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0PreChampion
source: Have you made a SECRET BASE already?\pI went here, there, everywhere before\nchoosing this place.\pFeel free to hang out!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5Intro
source: There're a lot of places where\nyou can make a SECRET BASE.\pBut I like this spot best.\nDon't you think it's nice?\pOh, would you like to have a battle?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5AcceptBattle
source: Okay, here goes!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5DeclineBattle
source: Oh…\nYou can't now, okay.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5Defeated
source: Hmmm… It's our loss…\nBut don't tell anyone!\lIt's a confidential secret!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5PostBattle
source: If you're in this area again,\nI hope you'll visit me.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5PreChampion
source: There're a lot of places where you can\nmake a SECRET BASE.\pBut I like this spot best.\nDon't you think it's nice?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1Intro
source:
This is a popular spot.
It's always taken.\pOh! Were you thinking about
taking this spot, too?\pI'll tell you what, you can have this
spot if you can beat me.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1AcceptBattle
source: Okay!\nI'm going to defend my SECRET BASE!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1DeclineBattle
source: Hunh? Is that right?\nYou're not interested in this spot?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1Defeated
source: I can't keep going!\nI surrender!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1PostBattle
source: Okay, when I move one day,\nthis place will be yours!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1PreChampion
source: This is a popular spot.\nIt's always taken.\pI waited a long time for it to open.\nI finally got to use it!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6Intro
source: Welcome to my POKéMON LAB.\pI carry out research on battling in\nsecrecy.\pWould you like to see how strong I am?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6AcceptBattle
source: I'm going to go all out!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6DeclineBattle
source: Oh.\nSome other time, then!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6Defeated
source: Hmm… I've still got lots to learn.\nI have to study some more.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6PostBattle
source: Thanks for battling with me.\nPlease come back again tomorrow.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6PreChampion
source: Welcome to my POKéMON LAB.\pI carry out research on battling in\nsecrecy.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2Intro
source: A big mansion is nice, but I like this\nsort of place more.\pI like it because all kinds of people\ncome visit me.\pSo, how would you like a battle?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2AcceptBattle
source: That's the way!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2DeclineBattle
source: When you're ready, give me a shout!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2Defeated
source: Aww! Done in!\nBut it's still fun to battle!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PostBattle
source: Well, anyway, I should go buy some\ndecorations and furniture.\pI want my SECRET BASE to be a place\nother people can enjoy.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PreChampion
source: A big mansion is nice, but I like this\nsort of place more.\pI like it because all kinds of people\ncome visit me.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7Intro
source:
I simply adore shopping for decorations
and furniture.\pI also love raising POKéMON just
as much.\pIf you would be so kind, will you battle
with my POKéMON?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7AcceptBattle
source: Thank you.\nShall we begin?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7DeclineBattle
source: Oh.\nHow disappointing…$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7Defeated
source: I concede…$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7PostBattle
source: That was all in good fun!\nI should go enjoy shopping now.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7PreChampion
source: I simply adore shopping for decorations\nand furniture.\pI also love raising POKéMON just\nas much.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3Intro
source: Some people make their SECRET BASES in\nhard-to-find places.\lDo they want to just lie low?\pBut since you found me, how about we\nhave a battle?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3AcceptBattle
source: I'm not going down easily!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3DeclineBattle
source: Oh… Are you maybe tired from searching\nfor this place?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3Defeated
source: I went down…$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3PostBattle
source: Where's your SECRET BASE?\nI should go visit you there.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3PreChampion
source: Some people make their SECRET BASES in\nhard-to-find places.\lDo they want to just lie low?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8Intro
source: People have told me that you can get\ndecorations in several ways.\pWe should have a race to see who can\nget nicer decorations and furniture!\pIn the meantime, want to battle?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8AcceptBattle
source: This is my SECRET BASE.\nI can't lose!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8DeclineBattle
source: I'll battle with you anytime.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8Defeated
source: Huh?\nDid I just lose?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8PostBattle
source: I won't lose at collecting decorations.\nCome visit again!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8PreChampion
source: People have told me that you can get\ndecorations in several ways.\pWe should have a race to see who can\nget nicer decorations and furniture!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4Intro
source:
I found a spot I liked, and I did it up
with my favorite decorations.\pI raise my favorite POKéMON and grow
stronger with it.\pThat's what I do.
Want to battle with me?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4AcceptBattle
source: Show me what you're made of!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4DeclineBattle
source: I guess there are times when you're not\ninto it.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4Defeated
source: I know exactly what you're made of now.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4PostBattle
source: We can both become stronger.\nLet's keep at it!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4PreChampion
source: I found a spot I liked, and I did it up\nwith my favorite decorations.\pI raise my favorite POKéMON and grow\nstronger with it.\pEvery day is a great day.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9Intro
source: You can learn a lot about the taste\nand sense of people by the kinds of\ldecorations they have, and how they\ldisplay them.\pWhat do you think of my taste?\nAre you speechless?\pWant to see my taste in battling?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9AcceptBattle
source: There's no holding back!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9DeclineBattle
source: I'll be happy to demonstrate my style\nanytime.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9Defeated
source: You're supremely talented!\nYour power seems to be limitless…$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9PostBattle
source: What did you think of my style?\nI'll keep on polishing it!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9PreChampion
source: You can learn a lot about the taste\nand sense of people by the kinds of\ldecorations they have, and how they\ldisplay them.\pWhat do you think of my taste?\nAre you speechless?$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_AreYouPlanningOnGoingInThere
source:
Are you planning on going deep
in there?\pHow about bringing me back some
SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS?\pI can make you something good if
you bring me the ingredients.$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_BringMe4ShoalSaltAndShells
source: If you bring me four each of the\nSHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS,\lI can make you a SHELL BELL…\pYou can get those ingredients\nevery day.$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_WouldYouLikeShellBell
source: Oh, hey! SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS!\nAnd enough of them, too!\pWould you like me to make you\na SHELL BELL with them?$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_MakeShellBellRightAway
source: All righty, then! I'll make you\na SHELL BELL right away.\p… … … … … … … …\n… … … … … … … …\pThere! Done!$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_ExplainShellBell
source:
Have a POKéMON hold on to that.
It'll love it, that's for certain.\pWhy, the SHELL BELL's chime…
It's simply sublime!\pYou can get its ingredients every day,
so I can make you more.$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_WantedToMakeShellBell
source: Oh… Is that so…\nI wanted to make a SHELL BELL…$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_NoSpaceInYourBag
source: You don't have space in your BAG\nif I were to make it for you.\pYou should make room and come back\nfor a SHELL BELL.$

label: ShoalCave_Text_WasShoalSaltNowNothing
source: There was some SHOAL SALT here.\nBut, there's nothing here now.$

label: ShoalCave_Text_WasShoallShellNowNothing
source: There was a SHOAL SHELL here.\nBut, there's nothing here now.$

label: gText_WantToUseSurf
source: The water is dyed a deep blue…\nWould you like to SURF?$

label: gText_PlayerUsedSurf
source: {STR_VAR_1} used SURF!$

label: Text_CurrentTooFast
source: The current is much too fast!\nSURF can't be used here…$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinIntro
source: If you have POKéMON with you, then\nyou're an official POKéMON TRAINER!\lYou can't say no to my challenge!$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinDefeated
source: Arrgh, I lost…\nI should have trained mine more…$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinPostBattle
source: Listen, you. If you're strong,\nyou should have told me before!$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRegister
source: I've been working hard at this since\nI saw you before.\pI'd like to battle you again, so can\nyou register me in your POKéNAV?$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRegisterShort
source: I'd like to battle you again, so can\nyou register me in your POKéNAV?$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchIntro
source: Ever since I lost to you, I desperately\ntrained my POKéMON.\lYou can't say no to my challenge!$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchDefeated
source: Arrgh, I lost…\nIs my training method not right?$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchPostBattle
source: If you're going to get stronger,\nI'll get stronger, too.$

label: Route102_Text_AllenIntro
source: Did you just become a TRAINER?\nWe're both beginners!$

label: Route102_Text_AllenDefeated
source: I called you because I thought\nI could beat you…$

label: Route102_Text_AllenPostBattle
source: I haven't won once yet…\nI wish I would win soon…$

label: Route102_Text_RickIntro
source: Hahah! Our eyes met!\nI'll take you on with my BUG POKéMON!$

label: Route102_Text_RickDefeated
source: Ow! Down and out!$

label: Route102_Text_RickPostBattle
source: If you lock eyes with a TRAINER,\nyou have to challenge! It's a rule!$

label: Route102_Text_TianaIntro
source: I'm going to keep winning and aim\nto be the best TRAINER.\pHelp me further my career!$

label: Route102_Text_TianaDefeated
source: I ended up furthering your career…$

label: Route102_Text_TianaPostBattle
source: To keep winning my way up, I see that\nI have to catch more POKéMON.$

label: Route103_Text_DaisyIntro
source: Did you feel the tug of our\nsoul-soothing fragrance?$

label: Route103_Text_DaisyDefeated
source: You weren't led astray by our aroma…$

label: Route103_Text_DaisyPostBattle
source: Aromatherapy is a form of mental\nhealing that works with fragrances.$

label: Route103_Text_AmyIntro
source: AMY: I'm AMY.\nAnd this is my little sister LIV.\lWe battle together!$

label: Route103_Text_AmyDefeated
source: AMY: Uh-oh, we lost.$

label: Route103_Text_AmyPostBattle
source: AMY: You have to think about all\nkinds of things when you're battling\lagainst two TRAINERS.$

label: Route103_Text_AmyNotEnoughPokemon
source: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one\nPOKéMON with you.\lYou can't battle us like that.$

label: Route103_Text_LivIntro
source: LIV: We battle together as one\nteam.$

label: Route103_Text_LivDefeated
source: LIV: Oh, we lost, big sister…$

label: Route103_Text_LivPostBattle
source: LIV: We work perfectly together,\nme and my big sister…\pBut we still lost…$

label: Route103_Text_AmyLivRegister
source: LIV: Really, we're a lot better…\nIt's true! We'll show you next time!$

label: Route103_Text_LivNotEnoughPokemon
source: LIV: If you want to battle us,\nyou have to have two POKéMON!\lIt's not fair if you don't!$

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchIntro
source: AMY: I'm AMY.\nAnd this is my little sister LIV.\lWe battle together!$

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchDefeated
source: AMY: Aww, boo!\nWe couldn't win again…$

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchPostBattle
source: AMY: You have to think about all\nkinds of things when you're battling\lagainst two TRAINERS.$

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchNotEnoughPokemon
source: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one\nPOKéMON with you.\lYou can't battle us like that.$

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchIntro
source: LIV: We battle together as one\nteam.$

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchDefeated
source: LIV: Awww, we lost again…\nBig sister…$

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchPostBattle
source: LIV: We work perfectly together,\nme and my big sister…\pBut why did we lose again?$

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchNotEnoughPokemon
source: LIV: If you want to battle us, you\nhave to have two POKéMON!\lIt's not fair if you don't!$

label: Route103_Text_AndrewIntro
source: Gah! My fishing line's all snarled up!\nI'm getting frustrated and mean!\lThat's it! Battle me!$

label: Route103_Text_AndrewDefeated
source: Gah! Lost it!\nI'm even more annoyed now!$

label: Route103_Text_AndrewPostBattle
source: Gah, I'm still boiling mad…\nGrrrrr…$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelIntro
source: My POKéMON is delightfully adorable!\nDon't be shy--I'll show you!$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelDefeated
source: Oh, my gosh!\nMy darling POKéMON!$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelPostBattle
source: My delightful POKéMON looks darling\neven when it's fainted!$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRegister
source: I'll get you to come out and look in\non my delightful POKéMON again!$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchIntro
source: Hi, you! My delightfully adorable\nPOKéMON has become more darling!$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchDefeated
source: Oh!\nMy darling POKéMON!$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchPostBattle
source: The more I spend time with it,\nthe more adorable my POKéMON becomes.$

label: Route103_Text_PeteIntro
source: This sort of distance…\nYou should just swim it!$

label: Route103_Text_PeteDefeated
source: Oh, that's good going!$

label: Route103_Text_PetePostBattle
source: Oh, I understand where you're coming\nfrom now.\pIf I had a POKéMON that trusty,\nI'd want to SURF on it, too!$

label: Route103_Text_IsabelleIntro
source: Watch where you're going!\nWe're going to crash!$

label: Route103_Text_IsabelleDefeated
source: Groan…$

label: Route103_Text_IsabellePostBattle
source: I'm a poor swimmer so I was practicing…\nSorry for almost crashing into you.$

label: Route103_Text_RhettIntro
source: Whoa!\nHow'd you get into a space this small?$

label: Route103_Text_RhettDefeated
source: Whoa!\nThe kid can rock!$

label: Route103_Text_RhettPostBattle
source: Do you like cramped quarters\nlike this?$

label: Route103_Text_MarcosIntro
source: Did my guitar's wailing draw you in?$

label: Route103_Text_MarcosDefeated
source: My one-man show is ruined…$

label: Route103_Text_MarcosPostBattle
source: I was playing my guitar where few\npeople were around, but a lot of fans\lhave gathered.\pHeh, maybe I should turn pro.$

label: Route104_Text_GinaIntro
source: GINA: Okay, let's battle with our\nPOKéMON!$

label: Route104_Text_GinaDefeat
source: GINA: Losing upsets me!$

label: Route104_Text_GinaPostBattle
source: GINA: You are strong!\nWe have to train lots more!$

label: Route104_Text_GinaNotEnoughMons
source: GINA: Oh? Only one POKéMON?\nThen, we don't battle with you.\pIf there's only one POKéMON, it will\nbe lonesome. That's not nice.$

label: Route104_Text_MiaIntro
source: MIA: We are twins, so we battle\nPOKéMON together.$

label: Route104_Text_MiaDefeat
source: MIA: We battled together, but we\nboth lost…$

label: Route104_Text_MiaPostBattle
source: MIA: We will train our POKéMON more\nand be strong like you.$

label: Route104_Text_MiaNotEnoughMons
source: MIA: You want to battle with us?\pIt's a big no-no if you don't have two\nPOKéMON with you.\lWe're too strong for you!$

label: Route104_Text_IvanIntro
source: Why keep it a secret?\nI'm the WATER POKéMON expert!\pHuh?\nYou don't know me?$

label: Route104_Text_IvanDefeat
source: I thought I wasn't too bad, if I may\nsay so, but I guess not… Bleah…$

label: Route104_Text_IvanPostBattle
source: I got too into fishing.\nI forgot I had to raise my POKéMON…$

label: Route104_Text_BillyIntro
source: Leaving footprints in the sand is\nso fun!$

label: Route104_Text_BillyDefeat
source: Waah! I got sand in my runners!\nThey're all gritty!$

label: Route104_Text_BillyPostBattle
source: I want to leave my footprints in\nthe sand everywhere, but they\ldisappear quickly…$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyIntro
source: Should I…\nOr shouldn't I?\pOkay, sure, I will battle!$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyDefeat
source: I shouldn't have battled…$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyPostBattle
source: If you're faced with a decision and\nyou let someone else choose for you,\lyou will regret it, however things\lturn out.$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRegister1
source: You're strong, but should I register\nyou in my POKéNAV?\lMaybe I shouldn't…\pOkay, sure, I will register you!$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRegister2
source: You're strong, but should I register\nyou in my POKéNAV?\lMaybe I shouldn't…\pOkay, sure, I will register you!$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRematchIntro
source: Come on, battle with me!$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRematchDefeat
source: Ohh…\nI thought I could win…$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyPostRematch
source: I made the decision to battle, so\nI can accept this loss with grace.\pI am still upset about losing!$

label: Route104_Text_WinstonIntro
source: Oh, sure, I'll accept your challenge.\nI have a lot of money.$

label: Route104_Text_WinstonDefeat
source: Why couldn't I win?$

label: Route104_Text_WinstonPostBattle
source: There are some things money can't buy.\nThat's POKéMON…$

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRegister1
source: Hm?\nAh, you've obtained a POKéNAV.\pI will gladly register you.\nAfter all, I have plenty of money.$

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRegister2
source: Hm?\nAh, you've obtained a POKéNAV.\pI will gladly register you.\nAfter all, I have plenty of money.$

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRematchIntro
source: After I lost to you, I learned a bunch\nof things about POKéMON.$

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRematchDefeat
source: I lost again?\nWhy couldn't I win?$

label: Route104_Text_WinstonPostRematch
source: I'm fabulously wealthy, but I can't\nseem to win at POKéMON…\pIt's so deep, the world of POKéMON…$

label: Route104_Text_CindyIntro
source: We must have been fated to meet.\nMay I ask you for a battle?$

label: Route104_Text_CindyDefeat
source: Oh, my!$

label: Route104_Text_CindyPostBattle
source: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.”\nI hope we meet again.$

label: Route104_Text_CindyRegister1
source: Hello, we meet again.\pWe seem to be drawn together. Let's\nregister each other in our POKéNAVS.$

label: Route104_Text_CindyRegister2
source: We should commemorate how we seem\nto be drawn to each other.\pLet's register each other in our\nPOKéNAVS.$

label: Route104_Text_CindyRematchIntro
source: Hello, we meet again.\nMay I ask you for a battle?$

label: Route104_Text_CindyRematchDefeat
source: Oh, my…\nI did the best that I could…$

label: Route104_Text_CindyPostRematch
source: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.”\nI hope we meet again.$

label: Route104_Text_DarianIntro
source: I fished up a tough-looking POKéMON!\pIt has this magical quality to it!\nIt surely looks tough, yes it does!$

label: Route104_Text_DarianDefeat
source: What the…$

label: Route104_Text_DarianPostBattle
source: Hey, MAGIKARP, you sure don't live up\nto your name, do you?$

label: Route105_Text_FosterIntro
source: There's supposed to be a mystical\nrock around here.\lDo you know anything about it?$

label: Route105_Text_FosterDefeated
source: I was thinking too much about that\nrock, while my POKéMON remained weak…$

label: Route105_Text_FosterPostBattle
source: I can spend hours and hours staring\nat a nice rock without growing bored.$

label: Route105_Text_LuisIntro
source: Whew! I was worried that a kid was\ndrowning when I saw you.\pYou seem to be okay, so what do you\nsay to a battle?$

label: Route105_Text_LuisDefeated
source: Glub… Glub…$

label: Route105_Text_LuisPostBattle
source: If you are drowning, the signal is to\nwave one arm toward the beach.$

label: Route105_Text_DominikIntro
source: Swimming the deep blue sea…\nIt feels the greatest!$

label: Route105_Text_DominikDefeated
source: I lost…\nNow I'm feeling blue…$

label: Route105_Text_DominikPostBattle
source: Why is the sea blue?\pI learned about that at the MUSEUM in\nSLATEPORT, but I forgot.$

label: Route105_Text_BeverlyIntro
source: My body feels lighter in the water.\nIt's as if I've gotten slimmer!$

label: Route105_Text_BeverlyDefeated
source: I'm floating…$

label: Route105_Text_PostBattle
source: Your body weight is reduced to just\none tenth in the water.\pThat would make me…\nWhoops! I'm not telling you my weight!$

label: Route105_Text_ImaniIntro
source: The blue, blue sky…\nThe vast sea…\lIt's so peaceful…$

label: Route105_Text_ImaniDefeated
source: I lost while I was lounging!$

label: Route105_Text_ImaniPostBattle
source: I want to be told I'm relaxing to be\nwith. Giggle.$

label: Route105_Text_AndresIntro
source: I'm convinced that the sea keeps\nsecrets from us.$

label: Route105_Text_AndresDefeated
source: Yes…\nI am no good at battling…$

label: Route105_Text_AndresPostBattle
source: I'm sure there are many secrets to be\ndiscovered in the world's seas.\pI mean to find them all!$

label: Route105_Text_AndresRegister
source: Huh? I'm so weak, but you're willing\nto register me in your POKéNAV?$

label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchIntro
source: I've told you that I'm weak…\nAre you sure you want to do this?$

label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchDefeated
source: Yes…\nI didn't think I could win.$

label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchPostBattle
source: I may be weak at battling, but my\ndrive to explore can't be bested.\pI will travel the seas all around\nthe world!$

label: Route105_Text_JosueIntro
source: I'm exhausted from swimming.\nI'm just not used to it.\pI need a battle for a change of pace!$

label: Route105_Text_JosueDefeated
source: I lost because I battled at sea.$

label: Route105_Text_JosuePostBattle
source: Yeah, for me, the sky is a much better\nmatch than the sea.$

label: Route106_Text_ElliotIntro
source: Which do you prefer, fishing in the\nsea or a stream?$

label: Route106_Text_ElliotDefeated
source: Like in deep-sea fishing, I lost\nspectacularly!$

label: Route106_Text_ElliotPostBattle
source: Fishing is the greatest whether it's\nin the sea or a stream.\lYou agree with me, right?$

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRegister
source: Fishing's great, but so is battling.\nIf you don't mind, can we meet again?$

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRematchIntro
source: I caught a bunch of POKéMON fishing.\nI'll show you an impressive battle!$

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRematchDefeated
source: I lost again spectacularly!$

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRematchPostBattle
source: Win or lose, POKéMON are the greatest!\nYou agree with me, right?$

label: Route106_Text_NedIntro
source: What do people do if they need to go\nto a washroom?\pWhat if my ROD hooks a big one while\nI'm in the washroom? I just can't go…$

label: Route106_Text_NedDefeated
source: I lost because I'm trying to not go\nto the washroom…$

label: Route106_Text_NedPostBattle
source: Oh, no! I've got this feeling I'll hook\na big one!$

label: Route106_Text_DouglasIntro
source: Hahahah! I'm a lousy runner, but in\nthe water you can't catch me!$

label: Route106_Text_DouglasDefeated
source: I give up!$

label: Route106_Text_DouglasPostBattle
source: I wouldn't lose in a swim race…$

label: Route106_Text_KylaIntro
source: The sea is my backyard. I'm not going\nto take it easy because you're a kid!$

label: Route106_Text_KylaDefeated
source: Did you take it easy on me by any\nchance?$

label: Route106_Text_KylaPostBattle
source: Drifting along with the waves…\nI love it! Why don't you give it a try?$

label: Route107_Text_DarrinIntro
source: Yawn…\pI must have drifted off to sleep while\nI was drifting in the waves.$

label: Route107_Text_DarrinDefeated
source: Ahaha, I lost…\nI'll take a snooze, I think…$

label: Route107_Text_DarrinPostBattle
source: Floating and being rocked by\nthe waves--it's like sleeping in\la plush, comfy bed.$

label: Route107_Text_TonyIntro
source: The sea is like my backyard.\nLet's battle!$

label: Route107_Text_TonyDefeated
source: I lost on my home field…\nI'm in shock!$

label: Route107_Text_TonyPostBattle
source: I swim the seas with a heart full of\ndreams…\pIt's a song!\nAnyways, I'm swimming some more.$

label: Route107_Text_TonyRegister
source: You've shocked me to the bone!\nWell, so you won't forget me…$

label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchIntro
source: Swimming in the big, wide sea,\nmy POKéMON has grown stronger!$

label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchDefeated
source: What a shock!\pMy POKéMON has gotten stronger, but\nI stayed weak as a TRAINER!$

label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchPostBattle
source: What you learn in battle makes you\na stronger TRAINER.\lThe waves taught me that.$

label: Route107_Text_DeniseIntro
source: Do you know a little town called\nDEWFORD?$

label: Route107_Text_DeniseDefeated
source: I hate this!$

label: Route107_Text_DenisePostBattle
source: A weird saying is getting really\ntrendy at DEWFORD HALL.$

label: Route107_Text_BethIntro
source: Did you want to battle me?\nSure, I'll go with you!$

label: Route107_Text_BethDefeated
source: I wasn't good enough for you.$

label: Route107_Text_BethPostBattle
source: I think you're going to keep getting\nbetter. I'll go for it, too!$

label: Route107_Text_LisaIntro
source: LISA: We challenge you as a sister\nand brother!$

label: Route107_Text_LisaDefeated
source: LISA: Awesome.\nYou're in a different class of tough.$

label: Route107_Text_LisaPostBattle
source: LISA: Do you have any friends who\nwould go to the beach with you?$

label: Route107_Text_LisaNotEnoughPokemon
source: LISA: If you want to battle with us,\nbring more POKéMON.$

label: Route107_Text_RayIntro
source: RAY: We always battle POKéMON,\nme and my sister.\pI always lose, but we can beat you\n2-on-2!$

label: Route107_Text_RayDefeated
source: RAY: Wowee, you're at a higher level\nthan us!$

label: Route107_Text_RayPostBattle
source: RAY: My sister gave me my POKéMON.\nI raised it, and now it's my important\lpartner!$

label: Route107_Text_RayNotEnoughPokemon
source: RAY: If you want to battle us,\ngo bring some more POKéMON!$

label: Route107_Text_CamronIntro
source: I'm in the middle of a triathlon,\nbut I'm nowhere near tired!$

label: Route107_Text_CamronDefeated
source: That exhausted me…$

label: Route107_Text_CamronPostBattle
source: I still have swimming and running left\nto do after this.\pAm I going to be okay?$

label: Route108_Text_JeromeIntro
source: My dream is to swim the world's seven\nseas!$

label: Route108_Text_JeromeDefeated
source: I won't be able to swim the seven seas\nlike this…$

label: Route108_Text_JeromePostBattle
source: Playing with marine POKéMON is one of\nthe pleasures of swimming!$

label: Route108_Text_MatthewIntro
source: Ahoy, there! Are you going out to\nthe ABANDONED SHIP, too?$

label: Route108_Text_MatthewDefeated
source: I'm sinking!\nGlub… Glub…$

label: Route108_Text_MatthewPostBattle
source: Some people even go inside that\nABANDONED SHIP.$

label: Route108_Text_TaraIntro
source: My liar of a boyfriend told me that\nI look great in a bikini…$

label: Route108_Text_TaraDefeated
source: Oh, boo!$

label: Route108_Text_TaraPostBattle
source: Even if it's a lie, I love being told\nI look great…\lWe girls are so complex…$

label: Route108_Text_MissyIntro
source: I love the sea!\nI forget all my worries when I swim!$

label: Route108_Text_MissyDefeated
source: When I lose a battle, I get all\nstressed out!$

label: Route108_Text_MissyPostBattle
source: Work off your stress by swimming!\nIt's so healthy!$

label: Route108_Text_CoryIntro
source: I love WATER-type POKéMON.\nI love other POKéMON, too!$

label: Route108_Text_CoryDefeated
source: Waaah! I lost!\nWaaah! Waaah!$

label: Route108_Text_CoryPostBattle
source: Shouting is good for me!\nIt uplifts me!$

label: Route108_Text_CoryRegister
source: I love tough TRAINERS, too!\nRegister me in your POKéNAV!$

label: Route108_Text_CoryRematchIntro
source: Win or lose, I love battling at sea!$

label: Route108_Text_CoryRematchDefeated
source: Waaah! I lost again!\nWaaah! Waaah!$

label: Route108_Text_CoryRematchPostBattle
source: If you're faced with a challenge,\ntry shouting at the sea!$

label: Route108_Text_CarolinaIntro
source: I take huge pride in my POKéMON.\nWe'll show you one speedy battle!$

label: Route108_Text_CarolinaDefeated
source: That wasn't cute at all.$

label: Route108_Text_CarolinaPostBattle
source: Since I'm at sea like this, I wouldn't\nmind putting on a pink, frilly swimsuit…$

label: Route109_Text_DavidIntro
source: Hiyah! Look at my chiseled abs!\nThis is what you call “cut”!$

label: Route109_Text_DavidDefeated
source: Aiyah!\nFlubbed out!$

label: Route109_Text_DavidPostBattle
source: Hiyah!\pMy sculpted abs have nothing to do\nwith POKéMON battles!$

label: Route109_Text_AliceIntro
source: Are you properly protected against\nthe sun?$

label: Route109_Text_AliceDefeated
source: Ouch, ouch, ouch!$

label: Route109_Text_AlicePostBattle
source: Cheeks are the most prone to burning!$

label: Route109_Text_HueyIntro
source: I've laid anchor in ports around\nthe world, but SLATEPORT's the best.$

label: Route109_Text_HueyDefeated
source: You're the best!$

label: Route109_Text_HueyPostBattle
source: In the best port was the best\nTRAINER…$

label: Route109_Text_EdmondIntro
source: Urrrrppp…\nBattle? With me?$

label: Route109_Text_EdmondDefeated
source: Urp… Ooooooohhhhhh…\nUrrrrpppp…$

label: Route109_Text_EdmondPostBattle
source: I'm usually stronger than this!\nI'm just seasick as a dog!\pI'm a SAILOR, but…$

label: Route109_Text_RickyIntro
source: I'm thirsty… I could go for a SODA POP\nat the SEASHORE HOUSE…$

label: Route109_Text_RickyDefeated
source: Groan…$

label: Route109_Text_RickyPostBattle
source: I'm getting famished… My inner tube\nlooks like a giant doughnut…$

label: Route109_Text_RickyRegister
source: Will you have another match with me\nwhen I'm not all thirsty?$

label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchIntro
source: I'm hungry, but I've got enough pep in\nme for a battle!$

label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchDefeated
source: I lost…\nIt's because I'm hungry…$

label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchPostBattle
source: When you eat on a beach, everything\nseems to taste a little better.$

label: Route109_Text_LolaIntro
source: Doesn't a beach umbrella look like\na giant flower?$

label: Route109_Text_LolaDefeated
source: Mommy!$

label: Route109_Text_LolaPostBattle
source: If you look at the beach from the sky,\nit looks like a big flower garden!$

label: Route109_Text_LolaRegister
source: Me?\nI'm here every day!$

label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchIntro
source: I'm not losing to you again!\nThat's why I have my inner tube!$

label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchDefeated
source: Mommy!$

label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchPostBattle
source: If I have an inner tube, me and my\nPOKéMON's cuteness goes way up!$

label: Route109_Text_AustinaIntro
source: I can't swim without my inner tube,\nbut I won't lose at POKéMON!$

label: Route109_Text_AustinaDefeated
source: Did I lose because I have an inner\ntube?$

label: Route109_Text_AustinaPostBattle
source: My inner tube is a fashion item.\nI can't be seen without it.$

label: Route109_Text_GwenIntro
source: Hi, big TRAINER.\nWill you battle with me?$

label: Route109_Text_GwenDefeated
source: Oh, you're strong.$

label: Route109_Text_GwenPostBattle
source: How did you get to be so strong?$

label: Route109_Text_CarterIntro
source: Wahahah! This dude's going to catch\nhimself a big one!$

label: Route109_Text_CarterDefeated
source: This dude just lost one…$

label: Route109_Text_CarterPostBattle
source: This dude thinks you're a big one.\nNo, you're a big-one-to-be!$

label: Route109_Text_PaulIntro
source: PAUL: Well, this is a mood-breaker.\pI wish you wouldn't disturb our\nprecious time together.$

label: Route109_Text_PaulDefeated
source: PAUL: Well, I give up.$

label: Route109_Text_PaulPostBattle
source: PAUL: Well, don't tell anyone that\nwe're here.\lThis is just our private world of two!$

label: Route109_Text_PaulNotEnoughPokemon
source: PAUL: We're totally, deeply in love.\nThat's why we make our POKéMON battle\ltogether.$

label: Route109_Text_MelIntro
source: MEL: We're, like, totally in love.\nOur romance is heating up all of HOENN!$

label: Route109_Text_MelDefeated
source: MEL: We lost, and it's my fault!\nPAUL will hate me!$

label: Route109_Text_MelPostBattle
source: MEL: Um, PAUL, are you angry with me?\nPlease don't be angry.$

label: Route109_Text_MelNotEnoughPokemon
source: MEL: We're, like, deeply and truly in love.\nThat's why we make our POKéMON\lbattle together.$

label: Route109_Text_ChandlerIntro
source: Tadaah! See?\nMy inner tube's round!$

label: Route109_Text_ChandlerDefeated
source: Oh, oh!\nToo bad!$

label: Route109_Text_ChandlerPostBattle
source: After I showed you my round inner\ntube, too…$

label: Route109_Text_HaileyIntro
source: I can't swim, so I'm pretending\nto swim.$

label: Route109_Text_HaileyDefeated
source: I thought so!\nI didn't think we could win.$

label: Route109_Text_HaileyPostBattle
source: When I learn how to swim, I think\nmy POKéMON will become tougher.$

label: Route109_Text_ElijahIntro
source: For a guy as macho as me, this kind\nof POKéMON is the perfect match!$

label: Route109_Text_ElijahDefeated
source: I'm cool even in defeat, hey?$

label: Route109_Text_ElijahPostBattle
source: For a guy as macho as me, a port\nis the perfect setting!\pI guess I'll head for SLATEPORT.$

label: Route110_Text_JacobIntro
source: Whoa! Watch it!\nI guess you're not used to BIKE racing.$

label: Route110_Text_JacobDefeated
source: Whoa!\nMy brakes failed!$

label: Route110_Text_JacobPostBattle
source: Flat tires and brake problems can\ncause serious injury!\lInspect your BIKE for problems!$

label: Route110_Text_AnthonyIntro
source: Yo, you!\nCan you keep up with my speed?$

label: Route110_Text_AnthonyDefeated
source: Crash and burn!$

label: Route110_Text_AnthonyPostBattle
source: Speed alone won't let me win at POKéMON.\nI need to reconsider this…$

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminIntro
source: Don't panic if your BIKE's going fast!$

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminDefeated
source: I shouldn't panic during POKéMON\nbattles…$

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminPostBattle
source: There's no need to panic or stress.\nTake it easy. There's plenty of time.$

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRegister
source: I'll keep chugging on without stressing.\nGive me a shout if you're up to it.$

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchIntro
source: Aren't you going a little too fast?\nTake it easy and let's battle.$

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchDefeated
source: I didn't panic, but I still lost…$

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchPostBattle
source: There's no need to panic or stress.\nTake it easy. There's plenty of time.$

label: Route110_Text_AbigailIntro
source: The triathlon is hard in the extreme.\pYou have to complete the three events\nof swimming, cycling, and running.$

label: Route110_Text_AbigailDefeated
source: POKéMON battles are hard, too!$

label: Route110_Text_AbigailPostBattle
source: I'm exhausted, so I need a break.\nIt's important to get proper rest.$

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRegister
source: You know, I like you!\nLet's have a rematch on CYCLING ROAD.$

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchIntro
source: Isn't it neat to hold a battle while\ncycling?$

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchDefeated
source: Wow…\nHow could you be so strong?$

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchPostBattle
source: Were you going after a record?\pI'm sorry if I held you up!$

label: Route110_Text_JasmineIntro
source: I've been riding without stopping.\nMy thighs are like rocks!$

label: Route110_Text_JasmineDefeated
source: I'm worried about muscle cramps…$

label: Route110_Text_JasminePostBattle
source: Oh, you have some GYM BADGES?\nNo wonder you're so strong!$

label: Route110_Text_EdwardIntro
source: I have foreseen your intentions!\nI cannot possibly lose!$

label: Route110_Text_EdwardDefeated
source: I failed to prophesize my own demise!$

label: Route110_Text_EdwardPostBattle
source: I see your future…\pHmm…\nI see a shining light…$

label: Route110_Text_JaclynIntro
source: Ahahahaha!\nI'll dazzle you with my wonders!$

label: Route110_Text_JaclynDefeated
source: I wondrously lost!$

label: Route110_Text_JaclynPostBattle
source: You managed to win only because it was\na wonder! Yes, a wonder!\lDon't think you can win all the time!$

label: Route110_Text_EdwinIntro
source: Could I see your POKéMON?\nJust one look, please?$

label: Route110_Text_EdwinDefeated
source: I wanted to complete\nmy collection…$

label: Route110_Text_EdwinPostBattle
source: When I see a POKéMON that I don't know,\nmy passion as a collector is ignited!$

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRegister
source: I like collecting MATCH CALL\nregistrations, too…$

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchIntro
source: Hi, have you caught any new POKéMON?\pCould I see your POKéMON?\nJust one look, please?$

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchDefeated
source: Your POKéMON…\nI envy you.$

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchPostBattle
source: Oh, I long to make all rare POKéMON\nmine!$

label: Route110_Text_DaleIntro
source: Hey!\nDon't sneak up behind me like that!$

label: Route110_Text_DaleDefeated
source: I lost!\nDrat!$

label: Route110_Text_DalePostBattle
source: Fishing is all about concentration.\nYou have to focus on the floater.$

label: Route110_Text_IsabelIntro
source: Ahahaha! I would go anywhere to show\noff my delightful POKéMON.$

label: Route110_Text_IsabelDefeated
source: Oh, dear, this won't do.$

label: Route110_Text_IsabelPostBattle
source: Rather than battling, perhaps I should\nshow off my POKéMON at the FAN CLUB.$

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRegister
source: That wasn't close to what I could\ndo to show off my POKéMON.\pI'll have you as my captive audience\nas often as possible!$

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchIntro
source: Ahahahaha! I would be happy to show\noff my POKéMON as often as you like!$

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchDefeated
source: Oh, dear, this won't do.$

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchPostBattle
source: I don't think that I could ever stop\nfrom showing off my POKéMON.\pBut I like to battle, too!$

label: Route110_Text_TimmyIntro
source: I found some cool POKéMON in the grass\naround here!$

label: Route110_Text_TimmyDefeated
source: Being cool isn't enough to win…$

label: Route110_Text_TimmyPostBattle
source: It's hard to battle with POKéMON you\njust caught.$

label: Route110_Text_AlyssaIntro
source: I fell off CYCLING ROAD…\pI'll get over my embarrassment by\nbattling with you!$

label: Route110_Text_AlyssaDefeated
source: Oops!\nI ended up losing!$

label: Route110_Text_AlyssaPostBattle
source: Falling… Losing…\nThis is so humiliating for me!$

label: Route110_Text_JosephIntro
source: Okay! Full-throttle time! If you can't\ngroove, you get left behind!$

label: Route110_Text_JosephDefeated
source: You got into the groove all right…$

label: Route110_Text_JosephPostBattle
source: This isn't going to bring me down!\nLosing has made me a better man!$

label: Route110_Text_KalebIntro
source: When cute POKéMON help each other…\nYou won't see a more adorable sight!$

label: Route110_Text_KalebDefeated
source: Have you no compassion or pity?$

label: Route110_Text_KalebPostBattle
source: Okay, okay, you've done the best you\ncould, my pretties.$

label: Route111_Text_DrewIntro
source: Oh, hey! Those GO-GOGGLES suit you.\nBut I think they look better on me.\pLet's decide who they look better on\nwith a battle!$

label: Route111_Text_DrewDefeat
source: I couldn't see what was happening at\nmy sides because of the GO-GOGGLES.$

label: Route111_Text_DrewPostBattle
source: The GO-GOGGLES make it possible to\nget through sandstorms.\lThat makes me happy!$

label: Route111_Text_HeidiIntro
source: I'm having a picnic in the desert.\pYou can always find a TRAINER,\nso I can enjoy a battle here, too!$

label: Route111_Text_HeidiDefeat
source: Ohhh! You're mean!$

label: Route111_Text_HeidiPostBattle
source: When you're battling in a sandstorm,\nwatch out for your POKéMON's HP.\pIt can faint if you don't keep\nan eye on it!$

label: Route111_Text_BeauIntro
source: Wearing these GO-GOGGLES makes me\nfeel like a superhero.\lRight now, nobody can beat me!$

label: Route111_Text_BeauDefeat
source: I can't win on spirit alone…$

label: Route111_Text_BeauPostBattle
source: I'm going to be a real hero one day.\nI'm going to work harder to make me\land my POKéMON stronger.$

label: Route111_Text_BeckyIntro
source: I heard there are fossils to be found\nin the desert. Where could they be?$

label: Route111_Text_BeckyDefeat
source: I came up short…$

label: Route111_Text_BeckyPostBattle
source: If they can find fossils in the desert,\nit must have been a sea before.$

label: Route111_Text_DustyIntro
source: For thirty years I have searched for\nancient ruins!\lI am to be challenged?$

label: Route111_Text_DustyDefeat
source: While I have searched for ruins,\nI've not searched for strong POKéMON.$

label: Route111_Text_DustyPostBattle
source: For thirty years I have searched for\nancient ruins!\pNo, wait, was that forty years?\nWhich was it now?$

label: Route111_Text_DustyRegister
source: I haven't been searching for any\ntough POKéMON.\pBut, for some reason, I sure do like\nPOKéNAVS.$

label: Route111_Text_DustyRematchIntro
source: For thirty years I have searched for\nancient ruins!\pNo, wait, was that forty years?\nAnyway, am I to be challenged?$

label: Route111_Text_DustyRematchDefeat
source: I've found no ruins, nor have I found\nany strong POKéMON…$

label: Route111_Text_DustyPostRematch
source:
For thirty years I have searched for
ancient ruins!\pNo, wait, was that forty years
I've searched?\pHmm… It could even be fifty…
How long have I been at this?$

label: Route111_Text_TravisIntro
source: I'm full of pep!\nAnd my POKéMON is peppy, too!$

label: Route111_Text_TravisDefeat
source: My POKéMON lost its pep…$

label: Route111_Text_TravisPostBattle
source: When I see a TRAINER with a lot of pep,\nI can't help looking.$

label: Route111_Text_IreneIntro
source: I don't know where you're going,\nbut would you like to battle?$

label: Route111_Text_IreneDefeat
source: Oh, you're disgustingly good!$

label: Route111_Text_IrenePostBattle
source: I'm thinking that I should go to\nMT. CHIMNEY, but the view around\lhere is very nice, too.$

label: Route111_Text_DaisukeIntro
source: To train myself, I challenge all\nwhom I meet!$

label: Route111_Text_DaisukeDefeat
source: Uncle! I give up!$

label: Route111_Text_DaisukePostBattle
source: All I can do is keep training until\nI can defeat strong TRAINERS such\las yourself.$

label: Route111_Text_WiltonIntro
source: Show me how much you've toughened\nyour POKéMON.$

label: Route111_Text_WiltonDefeat
source: I see, you've toughened them\nconsiderably.$

label: Route111_Text_WiltonPostBattle
source: POKéMON and TRAINERS learn much\nthrough battling.\pWhat's important is to never give up\neven if you lose.$

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRegister
source: There is much to be learned from\nyour training style.\pI request a rematch if it\nbehooves you.$

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRematchIntro
source: We're training here to elevate our\ngame to the next level.\lStay and train with us!$

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRematchDefeat
source: Ooh, you're decent!$

label: Route111_Text_WiltonPostRematch
source: Since you're that strong, you should\naim for the POKéMON LEAGUE.$

label: Route111_Text_BrookeIntro
source: Oh, your POKéMON look like serious\nactors.\lI have to ask you for an engagement.$

label: Route111_Text_BrookeDefeat
source: They didn't just look strong,\nthey are strong!$

label: Route111_Text_BrookePostBattle
source: I thought I was raising my POKéMON\ndiligently, but, oh no, there is still\lmuch to be done.$

label: Route111_Text_BrookeRegister
source: I wish I could become friends with\nmore strong people like you!$

label: Route111_Text_BrookeRematchIntro
source: You can make POKéMON stronger or\nweaker depending on the moves you\lteach them.\pWhat kinds of moves do your POKéMON\nknow?$

label: Route111_Text_BrookeRematchDefeat
source: You've taught them good moves!$

label: Route111_Text_BrookePostRematch
source: Maybe I should have stopped my\nPOKéMON from evolving until they\llearned better moves…$

label: Route111_Text_CeliaIntro
source: I shouldn't have come to a place like\nthis for a picnic!$

label: Route111_Text_CeliaDefeat
source: Aww!\nI really shouldn't have come!$

label: Route111_Text_CeliaPostBattle
source: In a sandstorm like this, I can't set\nthe places for a picnic even with my\lGO-GOGGLES on…$

label: Route111_Text_BryanIntro
source: How tough are you?\nWe shall expose that secret!$

label: Route111_Text_BryanDefeat
source: Oh! Your strength!\nIt is shrouded in mystery!$

label: Route111_Text_BryanPostBattle
source: This desert hoards mysteries in\nits shifting sands!$

label: Route111_Text_BrandenIntro
source: I'll give you some of my sandwich\nif you'll lose.$

label: Route111_Text_BrandenDefeat
source: Tch! I thought a sandwich would be\nenough of a bribe…$

label: Route111_Text_BrandenPostBattle
source: My SANDSHREW loves eating\nmy sandwiches.$

label: Route111_Text_TyronIntro
source: This is my favorite kind of POKéMON!$

label: Route111_Text_TyronDefeat
source: Wait!\nDid you get a good look at my POKéMON?$

label: Route111_Text_TyronPostBattle
source: When having a battle, I get a kick out\nof showing off my POKéMON.\pI bet everyone feels that way when\nthey enter a battle!$

label: Route111_Text_CelinaIntro
source: Show me how to put a little excitement\ninto my life.$

label: Route111_Text_CelinaDefeat
source: Oh… My…\nThat was too much excitement.$

label: Route111_Text_CelinaPostBattle
source: My pulse is still racing.\nYou're one fabulous TRAINER.$

label: Route111_Text_HaydenIntro
source: When you're as famished as I am,\nthere is no room for pity!$

label: Route111_Text_HaydenDefeat
source: Groan…$

label: Route111_Text_HaydenPostBattle
source: My stomach is grumbling!\nMaybe I can grill some BERRIES…$

label: Route111_Text_BiancaIntro
source: Did you come from MAUVILLE?\nThen you should be full of energy!$

label: Route111_Text_BiancaDefeat
source: Ooh lala!\nThat's a lot to take!$

label: Route111_Text_BiancaPostBattle
source: This road here…\nYou have quite a ways to travel.$

label: Route112_Text_BriceIntro
source: Hahahaha!\nHow about we have a battle?\lYou and me!\lHahahaha!$

label: Route112_Text_BriceDefeat
source: I lost!\nHahahaha!$

label: Route112_Text_BricePostBattle
source: Hahahahaha! Something flew up my nose!\nHahahaha-hatchoo!$

label: Route112_Text_TrentIntro
source: My legs are solid from pounding up\nand down the mountains.\pThey're not going to buckle easily,\nfriend!$

label: Route112_Text_TrentDefeat
source: Ouch! My legs cramped up!$

label: Route112_Text_TrentPostBattle
source: Try hiking, and I mean really\npounding, on these mountain trails\lwith a heavy pack weighing dozens of\lpounds.\pThat, my friend, will get your body\ninto serious shape.$

label: Route112_Text_TrentRegister
source: Ow, my legs have cramped up.\nCan you grab me some bandages from\lmy backpack?\pNo, that's my POKéNAV!\nOh, fine, I'll register you.$

label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchIntro
source: I've been keeping fit by hiking.\nPower, I have in spades!$

label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchDefeat
source: I got trumped in power?$

label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchPostBattle
source: I hear there are some seriously tough\nTRAINERS on top of MT. CHIMNEY.\pI intend to get up there and give them\na challenge!$

label: Route112_Text_LarryIntro
source: I'm strong.\nI won't cry if I lose.$

label: Route112_Text_LarryDefeat
source: Waaaah!$

label: Route112_Text_LarryPostBattle
source: I'm not crying because I miss my mommy!\nSnivel…$

label: Route112_Text_CarolIntro
source: When you're out on a picnic, why,\nyou simply have to sing!\lCome on, sing with me!$

label: Route112_Text_CarolDefeat
source: Oh, you're so strong!$

label: Route112_Text_CarolPostBattle
source: It doesn't matter if you're good or bad\nat singing or POKéMON.\pIf you have the most fun, you win!$

label: Route112_Text_BryantIntro
source: I caught hot POKéMON in FIERY PATH!\nTake a look!$

label: Route112_Text_BryantDefeat
source: What a bumpy ride that was!$

label: Route112_Text_BryantPostBattle
source: I like the way you battle.\nIt has a certain flair to it.$

label: Route112_Text_ShaylaIntro
source: Oh, aren't you an adorable TRAINER!\nPlease, I need a romantic battle!\lI'm somewhat decent!$

label: Route112_Text_ShaylaDefeat
source: Oh, how strong you are!\nYou've given me quite a shock!$

label: Route112_Text_ShaylaPostBattle
source: Are you busy right now?\nI was thinking that maybe we can have\la rematch right now…\lBut it's all right if you're busy.$

label: Route113_Text_JaylenIntro
source: Can you guess why it's so cool\naround here?$

label: Route113_Text_JaylenDefeat
source: Peeuuw!\nThat stinks!$

label: Route113_Text_JaylenPostBattle
source: The volcanic ash blocks the sun,\nso it doesn't get very warm.\pThat's good for me--I can't stand heat!$

label: Route113_Text_DillonIntro
source: The volcano's eruption is proof that\nthe earth is alive.$

label: Route113_Text_DillonDefeat
source: You're some kind of strong!$

label: Route113_Text_DillonPostBattle
source: Ouch! Owww! I can't see!\nI got ashes in my eyelashes!\pGet it? Ashes and eyelashes?\pOkay, that was bad, sorry…$

label: Route113_Text_MadelineIntro
source: I use this parasol to ward off this\nfilthy, yucky volcanic ash from\lmy dear NUMEL.$

label: Route113_Text_MadelineDefeat
source: Huff, huff…\nI am exhausted…$

label: Route113_Text_MadelinePostBattle
source: You're very good at this.\nI must say I'm impressed!$

label: Route113_Text_MadelineRegister
source: Here, slide under my parasol.\nLet me register you in my POKéNAV.$

label: Route113_Text_MadelineRematchIntro
source: Oh, hello, hasn't it been a while?\nMay I invite you to battle?$

label: Route113_Text_MadelineRematchDefeat
source: Oh, how super!$

label: Route113_Text_MadelinePostRematch
source: You've remained very good at this.\nI must say I'm impressed!$

label: Route113_Text_LaoIntro
source: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah!\nI challenge thee!$

label: Route113_Text_LaoDefeat
source: With honor I admit defeat!$

label: Route113_Text_LaoPostBattle
source: I must refine the art of concealment.\nI bid thee farewell.$

label: Route113_Text_LaoRegister
source: Yiiyaah! Witness the ancient ninja\ntechnique of POKéNAV registration!$

label: Route113_Text_LaoRematchIntro
source: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah!\nI challenge thee!$

label: Route113_Text_LaoRematchDefeat
source: With honor I admit defeat!$

label: Route113_Text_LaoPostRematch
source: My flawless concealment was let down\nby my immature battle skills…\pI bid thee farewell.$

label: Route113_Text_LungIntro
source: Thanks for finding me!\nBut we still have to battle!$

label: Route113_Text_LungDefeat
source: I'll use my ninjutsu on you…\n“VOLCANIC ASH SWIRL CLOAK”!\p…What?\nIt's already over?$

label: Route113_Text_LungPostBattle
source: You know what's crummy about hiding?\nIt's lonely if no one comes along.$

label: Route113_Text_ToriIntro
source: TORI: Both of us, we collect ashes.\nWe battle POKéMON, too.$

label: Route113_Text_ToriDefeat
source: TORI: We lost… It's boring, so I'm going\nto get some more ashes.$

label: Route113_Text_ToriPostBattle
source: TORI: How much ash do we have?\nEnough for a WHITE FLUTE, I hope.$

label: Route113_Text_ToriNotEnoughMons
source: TORI: We want to battle 2-on-2.\nIf we didn't, we would lose!$

label: Route113_Text_TiaIntro
source: TIA: Both of us, we collect ashes.\nWe battle POKéMON, too.$

label: Route113_Text_TiaDefeat
source: TIA: We couldn't win… It's boring,\nso I'm getting some more ashes.$

label: Route113_Text_TiaPostBattle
source: TIA: We have a lot of ashes!\nI think enough for a WHITE FLUTE!$

label: Route113_Text_TiaNotEnoughMons
source: TIA: We want to battle 2-on-2.\nIf we don't, we won't win!$

label: Route113_Text_CobyIntro
source: Pfft, with these wings I can\nflick you away!$

label: Route113_Text_CobyDefeat
source: A… What?$

label: Route113_Text_CobyPostBattle
source: I don't know what to say when I get\nbeaten so easily…$

label: Route113_Text_SophieIntro
source: The warmth here is making me drowsy.\nBattle with me so I can stay awake.$

label: Route113_Text_SophieDefeat
source: This is a dream.\nI'm sure of it…$

label: Route113_Text_SophiePostBattle
source: Losing burns me up…\nI'm just going to sleep right here!\lZzz!$

label: Route113_Text_LawrenceIntro
source: Were you maybe in the middle\nof gathering volcanic ashes?$

label: Route113_Text_LawrenceDefeat
source: Ehehe.\nWe got beaten cleanly.$

label: Route113_Text_LawrencePostBattle
source: I ought to hide under the ashes, too.$

label: Route113_Text_WyattIntro
source: Y-you want to battle with me?\nEven though I just caught my POKéMON?$

label: Route113_Text_WyattDefeat
source: Y-you're all happy to win?\nEven though it's only me?$

label: Route113_Text_WyattPostBattle
source: Oh, so now you want to say a word to\nthe loser?\pAren't you just the coolest?\nHumph!$

label: Route114_Text_LennyIntro
source: Yodelayhihoo!\p… …\pYou're supposed to shout\n“yodelayhihoo” since it doesn't\lecho here!$

label: Route114_Text_LennyDefeat
source: Yodelayhihoo!$

label: Route114_Text_LennyPostBattle
source: When I was a wee tyke, I believed there\nwas someone copying me and shouting\lback, “Yodelayhihoo.”$

label: Route114_Text_LucasIntro
source: If you're not prepared, you shouldn't\nbe up in the mountains!$

label: Route114_Text_LucasDefeat
source: The mountains are unforgiving…$

label: Route114_Text_LucasPostBattle
source: In the winter, mountains turn deadly\nwith blizzards and avalanches.$

label: Route114_Text_ShaneIntro
source: Camping's fun! You can fish, roast\nmarshmallows, and tell spooky stories!\pBut the best of all are the POKéMON\nbattles!$

label: Route114_Text_ShaneDefeat
source: Way too strong!$

label: Route114_Text_ShanePostBattle
source: I think it's great that I can go\ncamping with my POKéMON.$

label: Route114_Text_NancyIntro
source: I need to exercise after a meal.\nLet's have a match!$

label: Route114_Text_NancyDefeat
source: Oh, no!$

label: Route114_Text_NancyPostBattle
source: I just had a tasty meal.\nI'm getting drowsy…$

label: Route114_Text_SteveIntro
source: Ufufufufufu…\nWant to battle against my POKéMON?$

label: Route114_Text_SteveDefeat
source: M-My POKéMON…$

label: Route114_Text_StevePostBattle
source: A big body that's all lumpy and hard,\nenormous horns, and vicious fangs…\pUfufufufu…\nI wish I had a POKéMON like that…$

label: Route114_Text_SteveRegister
source: Don't forget what you've done to me!\nI'll make it so you can't forget!$

label: Route114_Text_SteveRematchIntro
source: Ufufufufufu…\nCome on, battle my POKéMON…$

label: Route114_Text_SteveRematchDefeat
source: I feel so lucky getting to see your\nPOKéMON…$

label: Route114_Text_StevePostRematch
source: Ufufufufufu…\pWhen I see POKéMON battling, I get all\nshivery and shaky…$

label: Route114_Text_BernieIntro
source: If you're lighting a campfire,\nmake sure you have water handy.$

label: Route114_Text_BernieDefeat
source: Thanks for dousing my fire!$

label: Route114_Text_BerniePostBattle
source: You really do have to be careful with\nany sort of fire in a forest.\pDon't ever underestimate the power\nof fire.$

label: Route114_Text_BernieRegister
source: You set my spirit on fire.\nLet's register each other!$

label: Route114_Text_BernieRematchIntro
source: Have you learned to keep water handy\nfor campfires?$

label: Route114_Text_BernieRematchDefeat
source: I got hosed down before I could\nflare up, I guess.$

label: Route114_Text_BerniePostRematch
source: You really do have to be careful with\nany sort of fire in a forest.\pDon't ever underestimate the power\nof fire.$

label: Route114_Text_ClaudeIntro
source: If we were fishing, you wouldn't stand\na chance against me.\lSo, bring on your POKéMON!$

label: Route114_Text_ClaudeDefeat
source: If we were fishing, I would've won…$

label: Route114_Text_ClaudePostBattle
