source: Can't you forget that you battled\nwith me?$

label: Route13_Text_JaredRematchIntro
source: What're you starin' at?$

label: Route13_Text_RobertRematchIntro
source: I always go with bird POKéMON.\nI've dedicated myself to them.$

label: Route14_Text_CarterRematchIntro
source: I used TMs to teach good moves\nto my POKéMON.$

label: Route14_Text_MitchRematchIntro
source: My bird POKéMON should be ready\nfor battle this time.$

label: Route14_Text_BeckRematchIntro
source: Are you using TMs on POKéMON?\nJust holding them is useless.$

label: Route14_Text_MarlonRematchIntro
source: Have you taught your bird POKéMON\nhow to FLY?\pYou'll be able to soar with it into\nthe sky! Give it a try.$

label: Route14_Text_DonaldRematchIntro
source: The legend of the winged mirages…\nYou've heard it, right?$

label: Route14_Text_BennyRematchIntro
source: I'm really not into it, but okay.\nLet's go!$

label: Route14_Text_LukasRematchIntro
source: Hey!\nI remember you!\pC'mon, c'mon.\nLet's go, let's go, let's go!$

label: Route14_Text_IsaacRematchIntro
source: You're here again, huh?\nShut up and battle.$

label: Route14_Text_GeraldRematchIntro
source: We've been riding here because of\nthe wide-open spaces.$

label: Route14_Text_MalikRematchIntro
source: POKéMON battle, right?\nCool! Rumble!$

label: Route14_Text_KiriRematchIntro
source: KIRI: JAN, I hope we win today.$

label: Route14_Text_JanRematchIntro
source: JAN: KIRI, here we go!\nLet's win for sure this time!$

label: Route15_Text_KindraRematchIntro
source: I'm going to keep battling with the\nPOKéMON I got in trades.$

label: Route15_Text_BeckyRematchIntro
source: You look gentle, so I think I can\nbeat you.\pI'll give it one more go!$

label: Route15_Text_EdwinRematchIntro
source: When I whistle, bird POKéMON\ngather around.\pThey're amazingly cute!$

label: Route15_Text_ChesterRematchIntro
source: Hmm? My birds are shivering!\nWait, aren't you that TRAINER…$

label: Route15_Text_GraceRematchIntro
source: Oh, you're a little cutie!\nSo like a darling POKéMON!\lI remember you now!$

label: Route15_Text_OliviaRematchIntro
source: I raise POKéMON for protection\nbecause I live alone.\pThat hasn't changed.$

label: Route15_Text_ErnestRematchIntro
source: Hey, kid! C'mon!\nI got these off some loser!$

label: Route15_Text_AlexRematchIntro
source: Fork over all your cash when you\nlose to me, kid!$

label: Route15_Text_CeliaRematchIntro
source: What's cool and happening?\nTrading POKéMON, of course.$

label: Route15_Text_YazminRematchIntro
source: Want to play with my POKéMON\nagain?$

label: Route15_Text_MyaRematchIntro
source: MYA: Hi, we keep meeting,\ndon't we?\pHelp me train my little brother\nagain?$

label: Route15_Text_RonRematchIntro
source: RON: My sister's gotten more\npowerful…$

label: Route16_Text_LaoRematchIntro
source: What do you want?$

label: Route16_Text_KojiRematchIntro
source: Nice BIKE!\nHand it over quick!$

label: Route16_Text_LukeRematchIntro
source: Come out and play, little mouse.\nI'll treat you right!$

label: Route16_Text_HideoRematchIntro
source: Hey, wait a second!\nDon't call me and then run away!$

label: Route16_Text_CamronRematchIntro
source: I'm feeling hungry and mean!\nI really need a punching bag!$

label: Route16_Text_RubenRematchIntro
source: Hey, there!\nWe'll have ourselves a good time!$

label: Route16_Text_JedRematchIntro
source: JED: Are you here to see our\nlove, which knows no bounds?$

label: Route16_Text_LeaRematchIntro
source: LEA: Sometimes, the intensity of\nour love scares me.$

label: Route17_Text_RaulRematchIntro
source: I told you, there's no getting rich\nquick in battling kids.$

label: Route17_Text_IsaiahRematchIntro
source: I'm mighty proud of my bod, kiddo.\nCome on!$

label: Route17_Text_VirgilRematchIntro
source: You out for a stroll?$

label: Route17_Text_BillyRematchIntro
source: We're BIKERS!\nWe rule the roads, man!$

label: Route17_Text_NikolasRematchIntro
source: VOLTORB's going to seriously\nelectrify you today!$

label: Route17_Text_ZeekRematchIntro
source: I leveled up my POKéMON, but it\nabsolutely won't evolve. Why?$

label: Route17_Text_JamalRematchIntro
source: Gaah! I really need to exercise\nand seriously trim some flab!$

label: Route17_Text_CoreyRematchIntro
source: Be a rebel!$

label: Route17_Text_JaxonRematchIntro
source: Yep, that's a nice BIKE!\nHow's it handle?$

label: Route17_Text_WilliamRematchIntro
source: Get lost, kid!\nI'm bushed!$

label: Route18_Text_WiltonRematchIntro
source: I've been checking every grassy\narea for new POKéMON.\pBut it's not always easy…$

label: Route18_Text_RamiroRematchIntro
source: Koorukukukoo!\nIs my birdcall getting better?$

label: Route18_Text_JacobRematchIntro
source: I warned you before, this is my\nturf!\pI don't want you coming around.$

label: Route19_Text_RichardRematchIntro
source: I'm almost warmed up to go\nout for a swim.$

label: Route19_Text_ReeceRematchIntro
source: Wait! Slow down!\nWhat if you have a heart attack?$

label: Route19_Text_MatthewRematchIntro
source: I love swimming!\nI guess you're the surfing type.$

label: Route19_Text_DouglasRematchIntro
source: What's beyond the horizon?\nHave you seen?$

label: Route19_Text_DavidRematchIntro
source: I tried diving for POKéMON again,\nbut it was a no-go like before.$

label: Route19_Text_TonyRematchIntro
source: I look at the sea to forget all\nthe bad things that happened.\p…Like losing to you the last time!$

label: Route19_Text_AnyaRematchIntro
source: You always get to ride your\nPOKéMON…\pIt looks so relaxing.\nCan I have it if I win?$

label: Route19_Text_AliceRematchIntro
source: Swimming's great!\nSunburns aren't!$

label: Route19_Text_AxleRematchIntro
source: These waters are treacherous!\nYou shouldn't come back here!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_InterviewRequest
source:
Oh, hello! You were in a POKéMON
CONTEST, weren't you?\lIt's easy to tell from your POKéMON.\pI'm a reporter. I'm working on a story
on POKéMON CONTESTS.\pIf I may, would you be willing to answer
a few questions?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_DescribeContest
source: Oh, you will?\nThank you.\pBriefly, how would you describe the\nCONTEST you just entered?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WhatImageWhenYouHearX
source:
Ah, I see.
That's a very edifying comment.\pYou get a good feel for what
the CONTEST was like.\pI've got one last question.\pWhen you hear the word “{STR_VAR_2},”
what image do you get?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ThatsAllForInterview
source:
I see!\pSo that's how you imagine the concept
of “{STR_VAR_2}” to be.\pThank you!
You've given me some good ideas.\pI think I can write a good story on
POKéMON CONTESTS now.\pMaybe, just maybe, this story will even
make it to television.\lI hope you'll look forward to it!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PleaseDoShareStoryWithMe
source: Oh, too bad…\pWell, if you come across a good story,\nplease do share it with me.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LookingForwardToNextContest
source: I'll be looking forward to your next\nPOKéMON CONTEST.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_InterviewRequest
source:
Hello! You're the TRAINER who just had
a battle, right?\pI'm gathering interviews with TRAINERS
all over the place.\pMay I get a few words from you about
your impressions on battling?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_HowDidBattleTowerTurnOut
source:
You will? Really?
Thank you!\lThen, uh…\pHow did things turn out in
the BATTLE TOWER today?\pWere you satisfied with the battle?
Or are you unhappy?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_SorryWeDisturbedYou
source: Oh…\nSorry we disturbed you.\pPlease give us an interview the next\ntime you visit the BATTLE TOWER.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ObviousYouHadGreatBattle
source: Well, of course!\pThat unmistakable look of satisfaction\non your face…\pIt's obvious that you've had a great\nbattle.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DifficultToMakeBattleTurnOutAsPlanned
source: Oh, I see…\pWell, it certainly is difficult to make a\nbattle turn out exactly as planned.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DescribeYourBattle
source: Oh, oh, may I ask one more question?\pIf you were to describe your\nimpressions about this battle with\lone saying, what would it be?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ThatsGreatLine
source: Oh, that is stunningly cool!\pThat's a great line!\nI hope you'll do great next time, too.\pI hope to see you again!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_SilentType
source: Oh, I see…\pStill, being the silent type is also\ncool, isn't it?\pI hope you'll give me the opportunity\nto share your thoughts again!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_LookingForwardToNextBattle
source: I'll be looking forward to your\nnext battle!$

Yeah!
It's BRAVO TRAINER time!\pToday, we're going to profile {STR_VAR_1},
who took the BATTLE TOWER challenge!\pFor the challenge, {STR_VAR_1} entered
one wicked {STR_VAR_2}.$

source: The pair set a new record of {STR_VAR_2} wins\nin a row in {STR_VAR_1} competition!\lBravo, TRAINER!$

source: It failed to take advantage of\nthe audience's excitement and make\lan appropriate appeal.\pWe hope {STR_VAR_1} will learn how to get\na feel for the audience and whip their\lexcitement to a fever pitch next time.$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_LostAfterWinningRound1
source:

judging, its appeals in the secondary\ljudging failed to click.\pIt suffered a humiliating come-from-
behind loss.\pI'm sure {STR_VAR_1} is studying how to
make more effective appeals now.$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_NeverExciting
source: The audience never got excited by its\nappeals during the secondary judging.\pWe hope it will stop worrying about\nother POKéMON and learn to pitch\lits appeals to the audience more.$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_LostBySmallMargin
ContestLiveUpdates_Text_RepeatedAppeals
source:
It disappointed the JUDGE by
repeating the same appeals.\pIt's an unforgivable error in any
CONTEST, and the POKéMON paid.\p{STR_VAR_1} should feel guilty for
this sorry showing.$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_ValiantEffortButLost
source: {STR_VAR_1} turned in a valiant effort,\nbut…\pIt was all for naught, finishing last.\p{STR_VAR_1} should learn from this loss\nand put the knowledge to good use.$

source:

usual farewell to the winners.\pThis time, it's {STR_VAR_1} and
the {STR_VAR_2}!\pMC: Is everyone ready?

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyDefeatFirstTime
source: GABBY: My eyes didn't lie!\nI did discover an astonishing TRAINER!$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_WhoAreYouInterview
source:

Who are you?!\pI knew we were onto something wild
when we spotted you!\pOh, please let me explain. We travel
around everywhere interviewing all\lsorts of TRAINERS.\pSo, would you give us a bit of your time
for an interview?$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_QuoteFromLastInterview
source: GABBY: “{STR_VAR_1}!”\pRemember? That's the quote you gave\nus as the battle clincher last time.\pI never, ever forget stuff like that!$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_YouStompedUsInterviewAgain
source: The last time we battled, you stomped\nus before we could brace ourselves…\pAnyway, what do you think?\nDo you want to be interviewed again?$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_YouThrewABallAtUsInterviewAgain

The last time we battled, didn't you
throw a POKé BALL at us?\pWe were shocked! So we told everyone,
just everyone, about it!\pAnyway, what do you think?
Do you want to be interviewed again?$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_CleverItemSkillsInterviewAgain
source: The last time we battled, your item\nskills cleverly did us in.\pAnyway, what do you think?\nDo you want to be interviewed again?$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_WeLookedRespectableInterviewAgain
source: The last time we battled, we managed\nto look respectable.\pAnyway, what do you think?\nDo you want to be interviewed again?$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_InterviewAgain
source: Anyway, what do you think?\nDo you want to be interviewed again?$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_DescribeYourFeelings
source: You will?\nThank you!\pOkay, I need you to describe your\nfeelings about our battle, but it\lhas to be short and sweet. Go!$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_PerfectWellBeSeeingYou
source:
GABBY: Mmm, yeah!
That's the perfect clincher!\pI get the feeling that this will make
a great TV show.\pThere's a chance that they'll air this
on TV, so make sure to look for us!\pOkay!
We'll be seeing you!$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_DontGiveUpKeepingEyeOut

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_KeepingAnEyeOutForYou

since we last battled.\pWe were right about you when we
spotted you as a hot TRAINER.\pSo, anyway, what do you think?
Are you willing to give us an interview\lthis time?$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyDefeat

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyDefeat

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText00
source:
IN SEARCH OF TRAINERS…\pGABBY: Hi! Today I'm visiting an area
near {STR_VAR_1}.\pWe're trying to spot some up-and-
coming new talent in the field.\pToday, we turned our lens on the
TRAINER {PLAYER}.\pThere's something about this TRAINER
that piqued our interest.$

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText01
source: We've battled {PLAYER} before, but we\ncan attest that the TRAINER has most\ldefinitely improved from before.\pI knew we were onto someone special\nwhen we spotted this TRAINER!$

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText02
source:
The best way to determine how strong
a TRAINER is…\pWell, the fastest way is to battle.
And so we began our investigation!\p… …\pThat's how we ended up in battle
with {PLAYER}.\pIn a dominating performance, we were
flattened, rolled up, and tossed aside!\p{PLAYER} is ruthlessly strong…\pHere's our impressions after having
battled our featured TRAINER.$

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText03
source:
The combination of {STR_VAR_1} and
{STR_VAR_3} was divine!\pThe sight of them--{STR_VAR_1} and
{STR_VAR_3}--selflessly supporting\leach other in the thick of battle…\pIt was a marvelous sight to behold!\p{STR_VAR_2} was the move the TRAINER
used last in our battle.\pThe move {STR_VAR_2} is {STR_VAR_1}
and {STR_VAR_3}'s sign of friendship!$

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText04
source:
…I lost confidence in myself as
a result of our encounter.\pWe were beaten before we could launch
a single attack.\lOhhh… Snivel…\pIn spite of that, {PLAYER}'s battles
are worth seeing.\pI recommend confident TRAINERS to
challenge {PLAYER}.$

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText05
source:
There's only one thing to be said.
Don't you dare throw a POKé BALL during\la TRAINER battle!\p{PLAYER} is certainly strong, but has
no clue about the basic rules.\pTo our TV audience, I have a request.\pIf you see {PLAYER}, please caution
the TRAINER!$

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText06
source: {PLAYER} is adept at reading the\nopponent's actions.\pThe timing of item usage was remarkably\neffective!$

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText07
source:
Honestly speaking, I thought that
I might even be pretty good.\pWhile we did end up losing, we did have
a hotly contested battle.\pBut if you're struggling against me,
you have a ways to go, {PLAYER}!$

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText08
source:
After our battle, we asked {PLAYER} for
a succinct summary.\pThe TRAINER replied, “{STR_VAR_1}.”\p{PLAYER}'s POKéMON {STR_VAR_2} and
{STR_VAR_3}…\lAnd “{STR_VAR_1}”…\pMmm! That's deep! There's deep
significance behind that quote!\pIt's no surprise--a good TRAINER has
good things to say.\pThat's all for today!
See you again on our next broadcast!$

programming, and thanks for joining us!\pWe bring you this live from
the scene of a just-completed\l{STR_VAR_1}!\pSpectators: ?!!!!\pMC: Oh! It looks like the CONTEST

?!!!!$

source:

Thanks for joining us on live TV!\pMay I congratulate you on your win?\pWhat was the key factor in today's
stunning victory?\pBEAUTY: We gave it our best effort
today, my {STR_VAR_2} and I!\pBut I'm sure we wouldn't have made it
if it weren't for all the help we\lreceived leading up to the CONTEST!\pMC: Do you have a special someone
with whom you'd like to share your joy?\lLet's hear it live!\pBEAUTY: Hey, out there!\p{STR_VAR_3}! Are you watching?
We did it!\lThank you!$

label: ContestLadyShow_Text_Lost
source:
MC: Excuse me!
Thanks for joining us on live TV!\pYou must be disappointed by that turn
of events. Do you have any comments?\pBEAUTY: It's heartbreaking…
My {STR_VAR_2} and I, we did our best…\pBut I feel like I've let down everyone
who has supported us through this.\pMC: I hate to say it, but the POKéMON's
coloration is a little wanting.\pBEAUTY: {STR_VAR_3}, I'm so sorry…
I'll do better next time, I swear…\l…Sniff… Waaaaah!\pSpectators: See that?
The poor girl!\pMC: Uh… Uh-oh…\pUh… That's all the time we have today!
Thanks for tuning in!$

source:
MC: Excuse me!
Thanks for joining us on live TV!\pHow did your CONTEST appearance go?\pBEAUTY: Nothing went right…
For some reason, my {STR_VAR_2}\lcouldn't attract any popularity.\pMC: I hate to say it, but the POKéMON's
coloration is a little wanting.\pBEAUTY: … … … … … …
…Sniff… Waaaaah!\pSpectators: See that?
The poor girl!\pMC: Uh… Uh-oh…\pUh… That's all the time we have today!
Thanks for tuning in!$
